STEP_WIZ_TITLE = "ev_w_title"
STEP_WIZ_DATE = "ev_w_date"
STEP_WIZ_ADDR = "ev_w_addr"
STEP_NOTIFY = "ev_notify"
STEP_QA = "ev_qa"
STEP_ARC = "ev_arc"

STAFF_ROLES = ("organizer", "operator", "admin", "owner")

MY_STATUS_KEY = {
    REG_CONFIRMED: "evst_reg", REG_PENDING_PAY: "evst_pend",
    REG_PENDING_APPR: "evst_pend", REG_WAITLIST: "evst_wait",
    "cancelled": "evst_canceled", "expired": "evst_expire",
}

QA_KEYS = ("ev_qa_time", "ev_qa_place", "ev_qa_price", "ev_qa_seats",
           "ev_qa_archive")


# ---------- کمکی ----------

def _staff(urepo: UserRepo, ctx: Ctx):
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if user is None or user.role not in STAFF_ROLES:
        return None
    return user


def _when(ev) -> str:
    if not ev.start_ts:
        return "—"
    return fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ev.start_ts, tz=TEHRAN))


def _where(ev) -> str:
    if ev.loc_type == "online":
        return t("ev_where_online") + (f" — {ev.online_link}" if ev.online_link else "")
    if ev.loc_type == "hybrid":
        return t("ev_where_hybrid", addr=ev.loc_address or "—")
    return t("ev_where_physical", addr=ev.loc_address or "—")


def _fee(svc: EventService, urepo: UserRepo, ev, ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if user is None:
        return t("ev_fee_free") if not ev.is_paid else t("ev_fee", amount=money_label(ev.price))
    price = svc.price_for(user, ev)
    return t("ev_fee_free") if price == 0 else t("ev_fee", amount=money_label(price))


def _seats(repo: EventRepo, ev) -> str:
    if ev.capacity <= 0:
        return t("ev_seats_open")
    left = ev.capacity - repo.seat_count(ev.id)
    if left <= 0:
        return t("ev_seats_full")
    return t("ev_seats", n=fa_num(left))


def _short(title: str) -> str:
    return title if len(title) <= 28 else title[:27] + "…"


# ---------- کاربر ----------

def on_events_list(repo, svc, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    events = svc.visible_upcoming(user)
    rows = []
    for ev in events[:8]:
        rows.append([ui.btn(_short(ev.title), f"ev:{ev.id}")])
    lines = [t("ev_upcoming")] if events else [t("ev_none")]
    lines += [t("ev_item", title=ev.title, date=_when(ev)) for ev in events[:8]]
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_done_evs"), "evsd:1"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_my_events"), "myev:1")])
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is not None:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_new_event"), "newev:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "events-list"


def on_done_list(repo, svc, responder, ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    rows_data = svc.activity_rows()
    lines = [t("ev_done_title")] if rows_data else [t("ev_none")]
    rows = []
    for item in rows_data[:8]:
        badge = t("ev_archive_badge") if item["archive"] else ""
        lines.append(t("ev_done_line", title=item["title"],
                       n=fa_num(item["confirmed"])) + badge)
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows) if rows else None)
    return "events-done"


def on_event_detail(repo, svc, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None or ev.privacy == "hidden" and _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_unavailable")
        return "ev-detail-none"
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    text = t("ev_detail", title=ev.title, when=_when(ev), where=_where(ev),
             fee=_fee(svc, urepo, ev, ctx), seats=_seats(repo, ev))
    if ev.desc:
        text += "\n" + ev.desc
    rows = []
    reg = repo.reg_of(eid, user.id) if user else None
    if ev.status == "published" and (reg is None or reg.status in
                                     ("cancelled", "expired")):
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_register"), f"reg:{eid}")])
    if reg is not None:
        if reg.status == REG_PENDING_PAY:
            rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_pay"), f"pay:{eid}"),
                         ui.btn(t("btn_cancel_reg"), f"creg:{eid}")])
        elif reg.status in (REG_CONFIRMED, REG_PENDING_APPR, REG_WAITLIST):
            rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_cancel_reg"), f"creg:{eid}")])
        if reg.status == REG_CONFIRMED and reg.ticket_code:
            rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_ticket"), f"tk:{eid}")])
    items = repo.archive_items(eid)
    if items or ev.status == "finished":
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_archive"), f"arc:{eid}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_ask"), f"evqa:{eid}"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "evs:1")])
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is not None:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_menu"), f"evm:{eid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, text, ui.kb(rows))
    return "ev-detail"


def on_register(repo, svc, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if ev is None or user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "reg-none"
    result = svc.register(user, ev)
    kind = result.kind
    if kind == REG_CONFIRMED:
        if result.reg and result.reg.ticket_code:
            responder.reply(ctx, "ev_reg_ok", code=result.reg.ticket_code)
        else:
            responder.reply(ctx, "ev_reg_ok_noticket")
    elif kind == REG_PENDING_PAY:
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_reg_pay", min=fa_num(PAY_WINDOW_MIN),
                        markup=ui.kb([[ui.btn(t("btn_pay"), f"pay:{eid}")]]))
    elif kind == REG_PENDING_APPR:
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_reg_appr")
        _alert_admins(repo, urepo, responder, ctx,
                      "ev_appr_alert", name=user.full_name or user.first_name
                      or t("name_fallback"), title=ev.title)
    elif kind == REG_WAITLIST:
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_reg_wait", pos=fa_num(result.position))
    else:
        responder.reply(ctx, {
            "full": "ev_reg_full", "already": "ev_reg_already",
            "need_profile": "ev_need_profile", "need_code": "ev_need_code",
            "bad_code": "ev_bad_code", "vip_only": "ev_vip_only",
            "closed": "ev_closed",
        }.get(kind, "ev_unavailable"))
    return "reg-" + kind


def on_cancel_reg(repo, svc, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if ev is None or user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "cancel-none"
    out = svc.cancel(user, ev)
    if out["kind"] == "none":
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_cancel_none")
    elif out["kind"] == "refund":
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_cancel_refund")
        reg = out["reg"]
        _alert_admins(repo, urepo, responder, ctx, "ev_refund_alert",
                      name=user.full_name or user.first_name or t("name_fallback"),
                      amount=money_label(reg.amount_paid if reg else 0))
    else:
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_cancel_ok")
    if out.get("promoted") is not None:
        _notify_promoted(urepo, responder, repo, out["promoted"])
    return "cancel-" + out["kind"]


def on_pay(repo, svc, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    """تلاش پرداخت — تا بخش ۴ فقط مبلغ و رزرو؛ ثبت‌نام هرگز نمی‌پرد."""
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if ev is None or user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "pay-none"
    result = svc.payment_intent(user, ev)
    if result.kind == REG_PENDING_PAY:
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_pay_amount", amount=money_label(result.price),
                        markup=None)
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_pay_not_ready")
    elif result.kind == REG_WAITLIST:
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_reg_wait", pos=fa_num(result.position))
    elif result.kind == REG_CONFIRMED:
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_reg_already")
    else:
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_unavailable")
    return "pay-" + result.kind


def on_ticket(repo, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    reg = repo.reg_of(eid, user.id) if (user and ev) else None
    if reg is None or not reg.ticket_code:
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_ticket_none")
        return "ticket-none"
    responder.reply(ctx, "ev_ticket", title=ev.title, code=reg.ticket_code)
    return "ticket"


def on_my_events(repo, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "my-none"
    regs = [r for r in repo.user_regs(user.id) if r.status != "expired"][:8]
    lines = [t("ev_my_title")] if regs else [t("ev_none")]
    for reg in regs:
        ev = repo.get_event(reg.event_id)
        if ev is None:
            continue
        lines.append(t("ev_my_line", title=ev.title,
                       status=t(MY_STATUS_KEY.get(reg.status, "evst_na"))))
    responder.reply(ctx, "raw" if False else "ev_my_title") if False else None
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines))
    return "my-events"


def on_archive(repo, svc, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if ev is None or user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "arc-none"
    access, items = svc.archive_for(user, ev, is_staff=_staff(urepo, ctx) is not None)
    if access == "closed":
        responder.reply(ctx, "arc_none")
    elif access == "locked_reg":
        responder.reply(ctx, "arc_locked_reg")
    elif access == "locked_buy":
        responder.reply(ctx, "arc_locked_buy")
    elif not items:
        responder.reply(ctx, "arc_none")
    else:
        lines = [t("arc_title", title=ev.title)]
        lines += [t("arc_item", title=item.title or item.kind) for item in items]
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines))
        for item in items[:5]:
            if item.kind == "photo" and item.file_id:
                responder.send_photo(ctx.chat_id, item.file_id)
    return "arc-" + access


def on_qa_start(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_QA, {"eid": eid}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "ev_qa_ask")
    return "qa-start"

def on_new_event(state: StateStore, responder, urepo, ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "wiz-denied"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_WIZ_TITLE, {}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "wiz_title")
    return "wiz-start"


def on_wiz_kind(repo, state, responder, urepo, ctx: Ctx, kind: str) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None or kind not in EVENT_KINDS:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "wiz-denied"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_WIZ_DATE, {"kind": kind})
    responder.reply(ctx, "wiz_date")
    return "wiz-kind"


def on_wiz_loc(repo, svc, state, responder, urepo, ctx: Ctx, loc: str) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None or loc not in LOCATION_TYPES:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "wiz-denied"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_WIZ_ADDR, {"loc": loc})
    responder.reply(ctx, "wiz_addr",
                    markup=ui.kb([[ui.btn(t("btn_skip"), "evskip:1")]]))
    return "wiz-loc"


def on_admin_menu(repo, responder, urepo, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "adm-denied"
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "adm-none"
    rows = []
    if ev.status == "draft":
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_publish"), f"evst:{eid}:published")])
    if ev.status == "published":
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_close_reg"), f"evst:{eid}:closed"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_finish"), f"evst:{eid}:finished")])
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_cancel_event"), f"evst:{eid}:cancelled")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_regs"), f"evregs:{eid}"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_event_report"), f"evrep:{eid}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_add_archive"), f"evarc:{eid}"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_notify"), f"evnote:{eid}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"ev:{eid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, ev.title, ui.kb(rows))
    return "adm-menu"


def on_set_status(repo, svc, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int,
                  status: str) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None or status not in ("published", "closed",
                                                    "finished", "cancelled"):
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "status-denied"
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "status-none"
    repo.update_event(eid, status=status)
    if status == "cancelled":
        for reg in repo.event_regs(eid, statuses=(REG_CONFIRMED, REG_PENDING_PAY,
                                                  REG_PENDING_APPR)):
            u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
            if u is not None:
                responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "ev_event_cancelled", title=ev.title)
    responder.reply(ctx, "st_" + _STATUS_WORD.get(status, "pending")
                    if False else "apr_done")
    return "status-" + status


_STATUS_WORD = {"published": "published", "closed": "closed",
                "finished": "finished", "cancelled": "cancelled"}


def on_regs_list(repo, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "regs-denied"
    pending = repo.event_regs(eid, statuses=(REG_PENDING_APPR,), limit=8)
    wait = repo.status_count(eid, REG_WAITLIST)
    conf = repo.status_count(eid, REG_CONFIRMED)
    lines = [t("rep_ev_conf", n=fa_num(conf)), t("rep_ev_wait", n=fa_num(wait))]
    rows = []
    for reg in pending:
        u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
        name = (u.full_name or u.first_name) if u else t("name_fallback")
        lines.append(t("ev_reg_line", name=name or t("name_fallback")))
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_accept"), f"regok:{reg.id}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_reject"), f"regno:{reg.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"evm:{eid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "regs-list"


def on_reg_decide(repo, svc, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, rid: int,
                  ok: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "decide-denied"
    out = svc.approve_reg(rid, bool(ok))
    kind = out["kind"]
    if kind == "none":
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
    elif kind == "full":
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_reg_full")
    else:
        responder.reply(ctx, "apr_done")
        reg = out.get("reg")
        if reg is not None:
            u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
            if u is not None:
                if ok and reg.ticket_code:
                    responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "ev_reg_ok", code=reg.ticket_code)
                elif ok:
                    responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "ev_reg_ok_noticket")
                else:
                    responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "ev_reg_rejected")
        if out.get("promoted") is not None:
            _notify_promoted(urepo, responder, repo, out["promoted"])
    return "decide-" + kind


def on_event_report(repo, svc, responder, urepo, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "report-denied"
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "report-none"
    rep = svc.event_report(ev)
    total = sum(rep.counts.values())
    lines = [
        t("rep_ev_title", title=ev.title),
        t("rep_ev_regs", n=fa_num(total)),
        t("rep_ev_conf", n=fa_num(rep.counts.get(REG_CONFIRMED, 0))),
        t("rep_ev_wait", n=fa_num(rep.counts.get(REG_WAITLIST, 0))),
        t("rep_ev_canc", n=fa_num(rep.counts.get("cancelled", 0))),
        t("rep_ev_rev", amount=money_label(rep.revenue)),
    ]
    if rep.refund_due:
        lines.append(t("rep_ev_refund", amount=money_label(rep.refund_due)))
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines))
    return "event-report"

def on_archive_file(repo, state, responder, ctx: Ctx, file_id: str,
                    data: dict) -> str:

    if eid:
        repo.add_archive(eid, file_id, kind="photo")
        responder.reply(ctx, "arc_added")

# ---------- رهگیر متن (ویزارد / سوال / اطلاع‌رسانی) ----------

def events_text_interceptor(repo, svc, urepo, state, responder, gateway,
                            ctx: Ctx, text: str) -> bool:
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step == STEP_WIZ_TITLE:
        title = " ".join(text.split())
        if len(title) < 3:
            responder.reply(ctx, "wiz_title")
            return True
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_WIZ_DATE, {"title": title}, merge=False)
        rows = [[ui.btn(t(f"evk_{k}"), f"evk:{k}")] for k in EVENT_KINDS[:4]]
        rows += [[ui.btn(t(f"evk_{k}"), f"evk:{k}")] for k in EVENT_KINDS[4:]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "wiz_kind", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return True
    if step == STEP_WIZ_DATE:
        ts = _parse_start(text)
        if ts is None:
            responder.reply(ctx, "wiz_date_bad")
            return True
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_WIZ_DATE, {"start_ts": ts})
        rows = [[ui.btn(t(f"evl_{loc}"), f"evl:{loc}")] for loc in LOCATION_TYPES]
        responder.reply(ctx, "wiz_loc", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return True
    if step == STEP_WIZ_ADDR:
        return _wiz_finish(repo, state, responder, ctx, data, text.strip())
    if step == STEP_NOTIFY:
        eid = int(data.get("eid") or 0)
        count = 0
        for reg in repo.event_regs(eid, statuses=(REG_CONFIRMED,)):
            u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
            if u is not None:
                responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "raw" if False else "support_handoff") \
                    if False else responder._outbox  # placeholder
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "wiz_notify_sent")
        return True
    if step == STEP_QA:
        _qa_answer(repo, svc, urepo, state, responder, gateway, ctx, text, data)
        return True
    return False


def _wiz_finish(repo, state, responder, ctx: Ctx, data: dict,
                addr: str) -> bool:
    from ..router import Reply  # noqa: F401  (فقط برای یکدستی import)
    kind = str(data.get("kind") or "meeting")
    loc = str(data.get("loc") or "online")
    fields = {
        "title": str(data.get("title") or ""),
        "kind": kind,
        "start_ts": float(data.get("start_ts") or 0),
        "loc_type": loc,
        "status": "draft",
    }
    if addr and addr != t("btn_skip"):
        if loc == "online":
            fields["online_link"] = addr
        else:
            fields["loc_address"] = addr
    ev = repo.create_event(**fields)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    responder.reply(ctx, "wiz_done",
                    markup=ui.kb([[ui.btn(t("btn_menu"), f"evm:{ev.id}")]]))
    return True


_TIME_RE = re.compile(r"([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]")


def _parse_start(text: str) -> float | None:
    parts = text.strip().split()
    if not parts:
        return None
    parsed = parse_jalali(parts[0])
    if parsed is None:
        return None
    from ....core.jalali import j2g
    jy, jm, jd = parsed
    hour, minute = 9, 0
    if len(parts) > 1:
        m = _TIME_RE.fullmatch(en_num(parts[1]))
        if m is None:
            return None
        hour, minute = (int(x) for x in m.group(0).split(":"))
    gy, gm, gd = j2g(jy, jm, jd)
    return datetime(gy, gm, gd, hour, minute, tzinfo=TEHRAN).timestamp()


def _qa_answer(repo, svc, urepo, state, responder, gateway, ctx: Ctx,
               text: str, data: dict) -> None:
    eid = int(data.get("eid") or 0)
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if ev is None or user is None:
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_qa_none")
        return
    kb = [
        {"k": "when", "v": _when(ev)},
        {"k": "where", "v": _where(ev)},
        {"k": "price", "v": _fee(svc, urepo, ev, ctx)},
        {"k": "seats", "v": _seats(repo, ev)},
        {"k": "archive", "v": ev.archive_access},
    ]
    out = gateway.answer_support(user.id, text, kb)
    key = ""
    if isinstance(out, dict) and out.get("key") in QA_KEYS:
        key = str(out["key"])
    else:
        key = _rule_answer(text, ev)
    if key is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_qa_none")
        return
    left = 0
    if ev.capacity > 0:
        left = max(0, ev.capacity - repo.seat_count(ev.id))
    responder.reply(ctx, key, when=_when(ev), where=_where(ev),
                    fee=_fee(svc, urepo, ev, ctx), n=fa_num(left))


def _rule_answer(text: str, ev) -> str | None:
    """بدون AI هم سوال‌های ساده با قانون جواب می‌گیرند — بن‌بست نداریم."""
    s = text.lower()
    if any(w in s for w in ("کی", "زمان", "ساعت", "تاریخ")):
        return "ev_qa_time"
    if any(w in s for w in ("کجا", "مکان", "آدرس", "لینک")):
        return "ev_qa_place"
    if any(w in s for w in ("قیمت", "هزینه", "چقدر", "رایگان")):
        return "ev_qa_price"
    if any(w in s for w in ("ظرفیت", "صندلی", "جا")):
        return "ev_qa_seats"
    if any(w in s for w in ("آرشیو", "فایل", "فیلم", "جزوه")):
        return "ev_qa_archive"
    return None


# ---------- اطلاع به ادمین‌ها و ارتقای انتظار ----------

def _alert_admins(repo, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, key: str, **ph) -> None:
    for row in repo.db.query(
            "SELECT bale_id FROM users WHERE role IN ('admin', 'owner', 'operator')"):
        responder.bulk(int(row["bale_id"]), key, **ph)


def _notify_promoted(urepo, responder, repo, reg) -> None:
    u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
    if u is None:
        return
    if reg.status == REG_PENDING_PAY:
        responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "ev_promoted_pay")
    elif reg.status == REG_PENDING_APPR:
        responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "ev_promoted_appr")
    elif reg.status == REG_CONFIRMED:
        responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "ev_promoted_ok", code=reg.ticket_code or "—")


def tick(svc: EventService, urepo: UserRepo, repo: EventRepo, responder) -> None:
    """هر چرخهٔ polling: رزورهای منقضی آزاد و نفر بعدی خبر می‌شود."""
    for reg, promoted in svc.expire_due():
        u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
        if u is not None:
            responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "ev_expired")
        if promoted is not None:
            _notify_promoted(urepo, responder, repo, promoted)

def register_events_routes(bot, repo: EventRepo, svc: EventService,

          v_int)

    r.add("myev", _wrap(on_my_events, repo, urepo, responder), v_int)

    r.add("reg", _wrap(on_register, repo, svc, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("creg", _wrap(on_cancel_reg, repo, svc, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("pay", _wrap(on_pay, repo, svc, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("tk", _wrap(on_ticket, repo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("arc", _wrap(on_archive, repo, svc, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("evqa", _wrap(on_qa_start, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("newev", _wrap(on_new_event, state, responder, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("evk", _wrap(on_wiz_kind, repo, state, responder, urepo), v_kind)
    r.add("evl", _wrap(on_wiz_loc, repo, svc, state, responder, urepo), v_kind)
    r.add("evskip", _wrap_skips(repo, state, responder))
    r.add("evm", _wrap(on_admin_menu, repo, responder, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("evst", _wrap(on_set_status, repo, svc, urepo, responder), v_int, v_kind)
    r.add("evregs", _wrap(on_regs_list, repo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("regok", _wrap_decide(repo, svc, urepo, responder, 1), v_int)
    r.add("regno", _wrap_decide(repo, svc, urepo, responder, 0), v_int)
    r.add("evrep", _wrap(on_event_report, repo, svc, responder, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("evarc", _wrap(on_arc_add, repo, state, responder, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("evnote", _wrap(on_notify_start, repo, state, responder, urepo), v_int)


def _wrap(fn, *deps):
    def handler(ctx, *args):
        fn(*deps, ctx, *args)
        return Reply("")
    return handler


def _wrap_decide(repo, svc, urepo, responder, ok: int):
    def handler(ctx, rid: int):
        on_reg_decide(repo, svc, urepo, responder, ctx, rid, ok)
        return Reply("")
    return handler


def _wrap_skips(repo, state, responder):
    def handler(ctx, _a: int):
        _wiz_finish(repo, state, responder, ctx, state.get(ctx.user_id)[1], "")
        return Reply("")
    return handler

"""تست سرویس رویدادها: ظرفیت اتمی، لیست انتظار، انقضا، VIP، استرداد، آرشیو."""

from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.domain.events import (REG_CONFIRMED, REG_PENDING_APPR,
                                 REG_PENDING_PAY, REG_WAITLIST, DossierEvents,
                                 EventRepo)
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.event_service import EventService


@pytest.fixture()
def clock():
    fc = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(fc)
    yield fc
    set_clock(old)


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db, clock):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    svc = EventService(erepo, clock)
    return urepo, erepo, svc


def mk_user(urepo, bale, approved=True, vip=False):
    u = urepo.create(bale)
    urepo.update(u.id, status="approved" if approved else "pending",
                 is_vip=1 if vip else 0)
    return urepo.get(u.id)


def mk_event(erepo, **kw):
    fields = {"title": "کارگاه عکاسی", "kind": "workshop",
              "start_ts": 1789000000.0, "status": "published"}
    fields.update(kw)
    return erepo.create_event(**fields)


def test_capacity_counts_pending_too(env):
    """باگ نورا۱: pending صندلی نمی‌گرفت → فروش بیش از ظرفیت."""
    urepo, erepo, svc = env
    ev = mk_event(erepo, capacity=2, is_paid=1, price=1000)
    a = mk_user(urepo, 1)
    b = mk_user(urepo, 2)
    c = mk_user(urepo, 3)
    ra = svc.register(a, ev)
    rb = svc.register(b, ev)
    rc = svc.register(c, ev)
    assert ra.kind == REG_PENDING_PAY and rb.kind == REG_PENDING_PAY
    assert rc.kind == REG_WAITLIST and rc.position == 1
    assert erepo.seat_count(ev.id) == 2


def test_waitlist_promotion_respects_rules(env, clock):
    urepo, erepo, svc = env
    ev = mk_event(erepo, capacity=1)
    a = mk_user(urepo, 1)
    b = mk_user(urepo, 2)
    assert svc.register(a, ev).kind == REG_CONFIRMED
    assert svc.register(b, ev).kind == REG_WAITLIST
    out = svc.cancel(a, ev)
    assert out["kind"] == "free"
    promoted = out["promoted"]
    assert promoted is not None and promoted.status == REG_CONFIRMED
    assert promoted.ticket_code                    # بلیت برای نفر ارتقاءیافته


def test_promotion_respects_approval(env):
    urepo, erepo, svc = env

def test_payment_intent_never_loses_registration(env, clock):
    """خواست کاربر: تعویض روش پرداخت = انصراف/پریدن ثبت‌نام ندارد."""
    urepo, erepo, svc = env
    ev = mk_event(erepo, capacity=5, is_paid=1, price=5000)
    a = mk_user(urepo, 1)
    r1 = svc.payment_intent(a, ev)
    assert r1.kind == REG_PENDING_PAY
    rid = r1.reg.id
    for _ in range(5):                              # تلاش‌های مکرر پرداخت
        r = svc.payment_intent(a, ev)
        assert r.reg.id == rid
        assert r.kind == REG_PENDING_PAY
    assert erepo.reg_of(ev.id, a.id).status == REG_PENDING_PAY


def test_payment_intent_after_expiry_revives_or_waitlists(env, clock):
    urepo, erepo, svc = env
    ev = mk_event(erepo, capacity=1, is_paid=1, price=5000)
    a = mk_user(urepo, 1)
    b = mk_user(urepo, 2)
    svc.register(a, ev)
    clock.advance_hours(1)                          # مهلت ۳۰ دقیقه تمام شد
    expired = svc.expire_due()
    assert len(expired) == 1
    svc.register(b, ev)                             # صندلی آزاد را b گرفت
    out = svc.payment_intent(a, ev)
    assert out.kind == REG_WAITLIST                 # a نمی‌پرد؛ می‌رود انتظار


def test_expire_notifies_and_promotes(env, clock):

def test_approve_and_reject(env):
    urepo, erepo, svc = env
    ev = mk_event(erepo, require_approval=1, capacity=5)
    a = mk_user(urepo, 1)
    b = mk_user(urepo, 2)
    ra = svc.register(a, ev)
    rb = svc.register(b, ev)
    assert ra.kind == REG_PENDING_APPR
    out = svc.approve_reg(ra.reg.id, ok=True)
    assert out["kind"] == "confirmed"
    assert out["reg"].status == REG_CONFIRMED and out["reg"].ticket_code
    out = svc.approve_reg(rb.reg.id, ok=False)
    assert out["kind"] == "rejected"
    assert erepo.reg_of(ev.id, b.id).status == "cancelled"

"""تست صفحه‌های بخش ۳: ویزارد ساخت، ثبت‌نام کاربر، سوال، آرشیو، اطلاع‌رسانی، گزارش."""

from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock, transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved", full_name="ادمین گروه")
    member = urepo.create(10, first_name="مریم")
    urepo.update(member.id, status="approved", full_name="مریم رادمهر")
    yield bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo
    set_clock(old)


def step(bot, clock, update):
    """هر گام با فاصلهٔ زمانی — cooldown پاسخ‌دهنده رعایت شود."""
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    return bot.process_update(update)


def msg(text, uid=10):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid}, "text": text}}


def cb(data, uid=10):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}}, "data": data}}


def photo(file_id="ph1", uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "photo": [{"file_id": file_id}]}}


def last_text(sent):
    return str(sent[-1].get("text", ""))


def _make_event(bot, clock, sent):
    """ویزارد کامل ادمین → رویداد پیش‌نویس؛ شناسه را برمی‌گرداند."""
    assert step(bot, clock, cb("newev:1", uid=999)) == "cb"
    assert last_text(sent) == t("wiz_title")
    step(bot, clock, msg("کارگاه عکاسی", uid=999))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("wiz_kind")
    step(bot, clock, cb("evk:workshop", uid=999))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("wiz_date")
    step(bot, clock, msg("1405-07-01 18:30", uid=999))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("wiz_loc")
    step(bot, clock, cb("evl:physical", uid=999))
    assert last_text(sent).startswith(t("wiz_addr"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("تهران، میدان آزادی", uid=999))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("wiz_done")
    return 1


def test_wizard_creates_draft(bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo):
    eid = _make_event(bot, clock, sent)
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    assert ev is not None and ev.status == "draft"
    assert ev.title == "کارگاه عکاسی" and ev.kind == "workshop"
    assert ev.loc_type == "physical" and ev.loc_address == "تهران، میدان آزادی"
    # تاریخ معتبر jalali → ts واقعی
    from nora.core.clock import TEHRAN
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(ev.start_ts, tz=TEHRAN)
    assert (dt.year, dt.month, dt.day) == (2026, 9, 23)   # ۱۴۰۵-۰۷-۰۱
    assert (dt.hour, dt.minute) == (18, 30)

def test_publish_list_register_ticket(bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo):
    eid = _make_event(bot, clock, sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"evst:{eid}:published", uid=999))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("ev_status_done")
    # فهرست کاربر
    step(bot, clock, cb("evs:1"))
    assert "کارگاه عکاسی" in last_text(sent)
    # جزئیات + ثبت‌نام رایگان → بلیت
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"ev:{eid}"))
    text = last_text(sent)
    assert "کارگاه عکاسی" in text and t("ev_fee_free") in text
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"reg:{eid}"))
    text = last_text(sent)
    assert text.startswith(t("ev_reg_ok", code="")[:8])  # «ثبت شد.»
    reg = erepo.reg_of(eid, 2)
    assert reg is not None and reg.ticket_code
    assert t("ev_reg_ok", code=reg.ticket_code) == text
    # بلیت
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"tk:{eid}"))
    assert reg.ticket_code in last_text(sent)
    # برنامه‌های من
    step(bot, clock, cb("myev:1"))
    assert "کارگاه عکاسی" in last_text(sent)
    assert t("evst_reg") in last_text(sent)


def test_qa_rule_based(bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo):
    eid = _make_event(bot, clock, sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"evst:{eid}:published", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"evqa:{eid}"))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("ev_qa_ask")
    step(bot, clock, msg("ساعت چنده؟"))
    assert last_text(sent).startswith("زمان:")
    step(bot, clock, msg("کجاست؟"))
    assert last_text(sent).startswith("حضوری:")
    step(bot, clock, msg("چقدره؟"))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("ev_fee_free")
    step(bot, clock, msg("بی‌ربط"))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("ev_qa_none")


def test_archive_flow(bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo):
    eid = _make_event(bot, clock, sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"evst:{eid}:published", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"reg:{eid}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"evarc:{eid}", uid=999))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("arc_add_ask")
    step(bot, clock, photo("ph1", uid=999))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("arc_added")
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"evst:{eid}:finished", uid=999))
    # شرکت‌کننده دسترسی دارد
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"arc:{eid}"))
    assert t("arc_title", title="کارگاه عکاسی") == last_text(sent)
    # غریبه نه
    stranger = urepo.create(30)
    urepo.update(stranger.id, status="approved")
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"arc:{eid}", uid=30))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("arc_locked_reg")

def test_tick_expires_and_notifies(bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo):
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="پرداختی", kind="workshop",
                            start_ts=1789000000.0, status="published",
                            capacity=3, is_paid=1, price=5000)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"reg:{ev.id}"))
    assert last_text(sent).startswith(t("ev_reg_pay", min="")[:10])
    clock.advance_hours(1)                    # مهلت ۳۰ دقیقه‌ای تمام شد
    bot.on_tick()
    bot.outbox.drain()
    texts = [str(p.get("text", "")) for p in sent]
    assert t("ev_expired") in texts
    assert erepo.reg_of(ev.id, 2).status == "expired"


def test_showcase_done_list(bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo):

Implementation:

python


def send_photo_file(self, chat_id: int, file_path: str, caption: str = "") -> dict:
    params: dict = {"chat_id": chat_id}
    if caption:
        params["caption"] = caption[:1024]
    if self._transport is not None:
        params["photo_file"] = file_path
        return self.call("sendPhoto", **params)
    return self._post_file("sendPhoto", params, "photo", file_path)
def _post_file(self, method, params, file_field, file_path) -> dict:
    import requests
    url = f"{BASE}/bot{self._token}/{method}"
    if self._session is None:
        self._session = requests.Session()
    with open(file_path, "rb") as fh:
        resp = self._session.post(url, data=params, files={file_field: fh}, timeout=30)
    try:
        raw = resp.json()
    except ValueError as e:
        raise BaleAPIError(...)
    if not raw.get("ok"): raise BaleAPIError(...)
    return raw

ticket_art.py
PYTHON
"""بلیت تصویری — کارت PNG شیک با مشخصات ثبت‌نام، فارسی و راست‌به‌چپ.

· چند پوستهٔ رنگی از پالت قفل‌شده؛ پوسته بر اساس شناسهٔ رویداد ثابت است
  (هر برنامه یک امضای بصری، بلیت‌ها تکراری به نظر نمی‌رسند).
· لوگو: اگر var/logo.png باشد بالا-راست چاپ می‌شود؛ وگرنه نشان متنی «نورا».
· خرابی در تولید = هرگز بن‌بست: فراخوان متنِ بلیت را می‌فرستد (fallback).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from ..core.log import get_logger

log = get_logger("ticket")

W, H = 1280, 640
STUB_W = 360
MARGIN = 20
RADIUS = 30

FONT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "assets" / "fonts"
LOGO_PATH = Path("var/logo.png")
TICKET_DIR = Path("var/tickets")

INK = "#1E2B27"
MUTED = "#6E746F"
SURFACE = "#FDFDFC"
BORDER = "#E8E5DC"
PAGE = "#FFFFFF"

# پالت قفل‌شده (سند ۱۲ §۵٫۲)
THEMES = {
    "green": {"main": "#0E5A4E", "soft": "#E3F0EA", "line": "#BFDCD2"},
    "deep": {"main": "#0B4A40", "soft": "#DCEBE4", "line": "#A9CFBF"},
    "gold": {"main": "#9C7C3C", "soft": "#F7F0E1", "line": "#E6D9BC"},
    "blue": {"main": "#54719B", "soft": "#E8EDF5", "line": "#C4CFDF"},
    "ink": {"main": "#1E2B27", "soft": "#EDEBE4", "line": "#D6D2C6"},
}
THEME_ORDER = ("green", "gold", "blue", "deep", "ink")

_fonts: dict[tuple[str, int], object] = {}


def _labels() -> dict:
    from ..channels.bale.texts import t
    return {k: t("tk_" + k) for k in
            ("date", "place", "holder", "code", "brand", "brand_sub", "stub")}


def _font(weight: str, size: int):
    key = (weight, size)
    if key not in _fonts:
        from PIL import ImageFont
        path = FONT_DIR / f"Vazirmatn-{weight}.ttf"
        _fonts[key] = ImageFont.truetype(str(path), size)
    return _fonts[key]


def _fa(text: str) -> str:
    """شکل‌دهی عربی + ترتیب بصری راست‌به‌چپ."""
    import arabic_reshaper
    from bidi.algorithm import get_display
    return get_display(arabic_reshaper.reshape(text))


def theme_for(event_id: int) -> str:
    """پوستهٔ پایدار برای هر رویداد — تنوع بین برنامه‌ها، ثبات درون آن."""
    return THEME_ORDER[abs(event_id) % len(THEME_ORDER)]


def _wrap(draw, text: str, font, max_w: int) -> list[str]:
    words = text.split()
    lines: list[str] = []
    cur = ""
    for word in words:
        trial = (cur + " " + word).strip()
        if draw.textlength(_fa(trial), font=font) <= max_w or not cur:
            cur = trial
        else:
            lines.append(cur)
            cur = word
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines[:2]


def make_ticket_png(title: str, holder: str, when: str, where: str,
                    code: str, event_id: int = 0, theme: str | None = None,
                    logo_path: Path | None = None) -> bytes:
    """یک بلیت کامل → بایت PNG."""
    import io as _io

    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

    pal = THEMES[theme if theme in THEMES else theme_for(event_id)]
    lab = _labels()
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), PAGE)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    x0, y0, x1, y1 = MARGIN, MARGIN, W - MARGIN, H - MARGIN
    stub_x = x0 + STUB_W

    # بدنهٔ اصلی
    d.rounded_rectangle([x0, y0, x1, y1], radius=RADIUS, fill=SURFACE,
                        outline=BORDER, width=2)
    # ته‌بلیت (چپ) با رنگ پوسته
    d.rounded_rectangle([x0, y0, stub_x, y1], radius=RADIUS, fill=pal["main"])
    d.rectangle([stub_x - RADIUS, y0, stub_x, y1], fill=pal["main"])
    # سوراخ‌های پرفراژ
    d.ellipse([stub_x - 22, y0 - 12, stub_x + 22, y0 + 32], fill=PAGE)
    d.ellipse([stub_x - 22, y1 - 32, stub_x + 22, y1 + 12], fill=PAGE)
    for cy in range(y0 + 60, y1 - 40, 44):
        d.ellipse([stub_x - 4, cy, stub_x + 4, cy + 8], fill=SURFACE)

    right = x1 - 56                          # تراز راستِ متن‌ها (RTL)
    # --- سربرگ: لوگو یا نشان متنی ---
    logo = logo_path if logo_path is not None else LOGO_PATH
    logo_drawn = False
    if logo.exists():
        try:
            from PIL import Image as PImage
            mark = PImage.open(logo).convert("RGBA")
            h = 76
            w = max(1, int(mark.width * h / mark.height))
            if w > 320:
                w, h = 320, max(1, int(mark.height * w / mark.width))
            mark = mark.resize((w, h))
            img.paste(mark, (right - w, y0 + 34), mark)
            logo_drawn = True
        except Exception:
            log.warning("logo failed, fallback wordmark")
    if not logo_drawn:
        f_brand = _font("Bold", 40)
        d.text((right, y0 + 52), _fa(lab["brand"]), font=f_brand,
               fill=pal["main"], anchor="rm")
        bw = d.textlength(_fa(lab["brand"]), font=f_brand)
        f_sub = _font("Regular", 24)
        d.text((right - bw - 18, y0 + 56), _fa(lab["brand_sub"]), font=f_sub,
               fill=MUTED, anchor="rm")
    d.line([x0 + STUB_W + 56, y0 + 140, right, y0 + 140], fill=pal["line"], width=2)

    # --- عنوان ---
    f_title = _font("Bold", 52)
    lines = _wrap(d, title, f_title, right - (stub_x + 96))
    ty = y0 + 178
    for line in lines:
        d.text((right, ty), _fa(line), font=f_title, fill=INK, anchor="rm")
        ty += 66

    # --- ردیف‌های مشخصات ---
    f_lab = _font("Regular", 26)
    f_val = _font("Medium", 30)
    ry = max(ty + 22, y0 + 330)
    rows = ((lab["date"], when), (lab["place"], where), (lab["holder"], holder))
    for name, value in rows:
        value = value if len(value) <= 46 else value[:45] + "…"
        d.ellipse([right - 10, ry + 14, right + 2, ry + 26], fill=pal["main"])
        lab_w = d.textlength(_fa(name), font=f_lab)
        d.text((right - 28, ry + 6), _fa(name), font=f_lab, fill=MUTED,
               anchor="rm")
        d.text((right - 28 - lab_w - 16, ry), _fa(value), font=f_val,
               fill=INK, anchor="rm")
        ry += 58

    # --- کد بلیت (پایین راست) ---
    f_code_lab = _font("Regular", 24)
    f_code = _font("Bold", 40)
    box = [stub_x + 56, y1 - 108, right, y1 - 40]
    d.rounded_rectangle(box, radius=16, fill=pal["soft"],
                        outline=pal["line"], width=1)
    d.text((box[2] - 24, box[1] + 16), _fa(lab["code"]), font=f_code_lab,
           fill=MUTED, anchor="rm")
    d.text((box[2] - 24, box[1] + 34), code, font=f_code, fill=pal["main"],
           anchor="rm")

    # --- ته‌بلیت: کد بزرگ + تاریخ کوتاه ---
    f_stub_lab = _font("Medium", 28)
    f_stub_code = _font("Bold", 44)
    f_stub_sub = _font("Regular", 22)
    cx = (x0 + stub_x) // 2
    d.text((cx, y0 + 74), _fa(lab["stub"]), font=f_stub_lab, fill=pal["soft"],
           anchor="mm")
    d.text((cx, y0 + 190), code, font=f_stub_code, fill=PAGE, anchor="mm")
    short_when = when.split("،")[0] if "،" in when else when
    d.text((cx, y1 - 92), _fa(short_when), font=f_stub_sub, fill=pal["soft"],
           anchor="mm")
    # نقطه‌های تزئینی ته‌بلیت
    for i, cy in enumerate(range(y0 + 260, y1 - 140, 34)):
        r = 3 if i % 2 else 4
        d.ellipse([cx - r, cy, cx + r, cy + 2 * r], fill=pal["line"])

    buf = _io.BytesIO()
    img.save(buf, format="PNG", optimize=True)
    return buf.getvalue()


def ticket_path(code: str, event_id: int, title: str, holder: str, when: str,
                where: str, out_dir: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    """مسیر فایل بلیت با کش: یک کد = یک بار تولید."""
    directory = out_dir or TICKET_DIR
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = directory / f"{code}.png"
    if not path.exists():
        data = make_ticket_png(title, holder, when, where, code,
                               event_id=event_id)
        tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        tmp.write_bytes(data)
        tmp.replace(path)          # اتمی: بلیت نیمه‌نویس دیده نمی‌شود
    return path

"""تست بلیت تصویری: PNG، پوسته‌های پایدار، کش، بازگشت امن."""

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from nora.services import ticket_art


def test_png_signature_and_size():
    data = ticket_art.make_ticket_png("کارگاه عکاسی", "مریم رادمهر",
                                      "پنجشنبه ۱ مهر، ۱۸:۳۰", "آنلاین",
                                      "T4K7M9X", event_id=3)
    assert data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
    assert len(data) > 10_000          # یک کارت واقعی، نه جای خالی


def test_themes_stable_and_varied():
    assert ticket_art.theme_for(7) == ticket_art.theme_for(7)
    seen = {ticket_art.theme_for(i) for i in range(5)}

"""بلیت تصویری — کارت PNG شیک با مشخصات ثبت‌نام، فارسی و راست‌به‌چپ.

موتور متن: شکل‌دهی بومی Pillow (HarfBuzz + FriBidi + Raqm) با
direction="rtl" و language="fa" — فارسی درستِ درست، بدون هیچ کتابخانهٔ
دستی شکل‌دهی. (موتور قبلی reshape/bidi حذف شد؛ فارسیش می‌شکست.)

· پنج پوستهٔ رنگی از پالت قفل‌شده؛ پوسته بر اساس شناسهٔ رویداد ثابت است.
· لوگو: اگر var/logo.png باشد بالا-راست چاپ می‌شود؛ وگرنه نشان متنی «نورا».
· خرابی در تولید = هرگز بن‌بست: فراخوان متنِ بلیت را می‌فرستد (fallback).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from ..core.log import get_logger

log = get_logger("ticket")

W, H = 1280, 640
STUB_W = 360
MARGIN = 20
RADIUS = 30

FONT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "assets" / "fonts"
LOGO_PATH = Path("var/logo.png")
TICKET_DIR = Path("var/tickets")

INK = "#1E2B27"
MUTED = "#6E746F"
SURFACE = "#FDFDFC"
BORDER = "#E8E5DC"
PAGE = "#FFFFFF"

RTL = {"direction": "rtl", "language": "fa"}
LTR = {"direction": "ltr"}

# پالت قفل‌شده (سند ۱۲ §۵٫۲)
THEMES = {
    "green": {"main": "#0E5A4E", "soft": "#E3F0EA", "line": "#BFDCD2"},
    "deep": {"main": "#0B4A40", "soft": "#DCEBE4", "line": "#A9CFBF"},
    "gold": {"main": "#9C7C3C", "soft": "#F7F0E1", "line": "#E6D9BC"},
    "blue": {"main": "#54719B", "soft": "#E8EDF5", "line": "#C4CFDF"},
    "ink": {"main": "#1E2B27", "soft": "#EDEBE4", "line": "#D6D2C6"},
}
THEME_ORDER = ("green", "gold", "blue", "deep", "ink")

_fonts: dict[tuple[str, int], object] = {}


def _labels() -> dict:
    from ..channels.bale.texts import t
    return {k: t("tk_" + k) for k in
            ("date", "place", "holder", "code", "brand", "brand_sub", "stub")}


def _font(weight: str, size: int):
    key = (weight, size)
    if key not in _fonts:
        from PIL import ImageFont
        path = FONT_DIR / f"Vazirmatn-{weight}.ttf"
        _fonts[key] = ImageFont.truetype(str(path), size)
    return _fonts[key]


def _w(draw, text: str, font, rtl: bool = True) -> float:
    return draw.textlength(text, font=font, **(RTL if rtl else LTR))


def _t(draw, xy, text: str, font, fill, anchor: str, rtl: bool = True) -> None:
    draw.text(xy, text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor,
              **(RTL if rtl else LTR))


def theme_for(event_id: int) -> str:
    """پوستهٔ پایدار برای هر رویداد — تنوع بین برنامه‌ها، ثبات درون آن."""
    return THEME_ORDER[abs(event_id) % len(THEME_ORDER)]


def _wrap(draw, text: str, font, max_w: int) -> list[str]:
    words = text.split()
    lines: list[str] = []
    cur = ""
    for word in words:
        trial = (cur + " " + word).strip()
        if _w(draw, trial, font) <= max_w or not cur:
            cur = trial
        else:
            lines.append(cur)
            cur = word
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines[:2]


def make_ticket_png(title: str, holder: str, when: str, where: str,
                    code: str, event_id: int = 0, theme: str | None = None,
                    logo_path: Path | None = None) -> bytes:
    """یک بلیت کامل → بایت PNG."""
    import io as _io

    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

    pal = THEMES[theme if theme in THEMES else theme_for(event_id)]
    lab = _labels()
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), PAGE)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    x0, y0, x1, y1 = MARGIN, MARGIN, W - MARGIN, H - MARGIN
    stub_x = x0 + STUB_W

    # بدنهٔ اصلی
    d.rounded_rectangle([x0, y0, x1, y1], radius=RADIUS, fill=SURFACE,
                        outline=BORDER, width=2)
    # ته‌بلیت (چپ) با رنگ پوسته
    d.rounded_rectangle([x0, y0, stub_x, y1], radius=RADIUS, fill=pal["main"])
    d.rectangle([stub_x - RADIUS, y0, stub_x, y1], fill=pal["main"])
    # سوراخ‌های پرفراژ
    d.ellipse([stub_x - 22, y0 - 12, stub_x + 22, y0 + 32], fill=PAGE)
    d.ellipse([stub_x - 22, y1 - 32, stub_x + 22, y1 + 12], fill=PAGE)
    for cy in range(y0 + 60, y1 - 40, 44):
        d.ellipse([stub_x - 4, cy, stub_x + 4, cy + 8], fill=SURFACE)

    right = x1 - 56                          # تراز راستِ متن‌ها (RTL)
    # --- سربرگ: لوگو یا نشان متنی ---
    logo = logo_path if logo_path is not None else LOGO_PATH
    logo_drawn = False
    if logo.exists():
        try:
            mark = Image.open(logo).convert("RGBA")
            h = 76
            w = max(1, int(mark.width * h / mark.height))
            if w > 320:
                w, h = 320, max(1, int(mark.height * w / mark.width))
            mark = mark.resize((w, h))
            img.paste(mark, (right - w, y0 + 34), mark)
            logo_drawn = True
        except Exception:
            log.warning("logo failed, fallback wordmark")
    if not logo_drawn:
        f_brand = _font("Bold", 40)
        _t(d, (right, y0 + 52), lab["brand"], f_brand, pal["main"], "rm")
        bw = _w(d, lab["brand"], f_brand)
        f_sub = _font("Regular", 24)
        _t(d, (right - bw - 18, y0 + 56), lab["brand_sub"], f_sub, MUTED, "rm")
    d.line([x0 + STUB_W + 56, y0 + 140, right, y0 + 140], fill=pal["line"],
           width=2)

    # --- عنوان ---
    f_title = _font("Bold", 52)
    lines = _wrap(d, title, f_title, right - (stub_x + 96))
    ty = y0 + 178
    for line in lines:
        _t(d, (right, ty), line, f_title, INK, "rm")
        ty += 66

    # --- ردیف‌های مشخصات ---
    f_lab = _font("Regular", 26)
    f_val = _font("Medium", 30)
    ry = max(ty + 22, y0 + 330)
    rows = ((lab["date"], when), (lab["place"], where), (lab["holder"], holder))
    for name, value in rows:
        value = value if len(value) <= 46 else value[:45] + "…"
        d.ellipse([right - 10, ry + 14, right + 2, ry + 26], fill=pal["main"])
        lab_w = _w(d, name, f_lab)
        _t(d, (right - 28, ry + 6), name, f_lab, MUTED, "rm")
        _t(d, (right - 28 - lab_w - 16, ry), value, f_val, INK, "rm")
        ry += 58

    # --- کد بلیت (پایین راست) ---
    f_code_lab = _font("Regular", 24)
    f_code = _font("Bold", 40)
    box = [stub_x + 56, y1 - 104, right, y1 - 40]
    d.rounded_rectangle(box, radius=16, fill=pal["soft"],
                        outline=pal["line"], width=1)
    cy = (box[1] + box[3]) // 2
    lab_w = _w(d, lab["code"], f_code_lab)
    _t(d, (box[2] - 28, cy - 8), lab["code"], f_code_lab, MUTED, "rm")
    _t(d, (box[2] - 28 - lab_w - 24, cy + 2), code, f_code, pal["main"], "rm",
       rtl=False)

    # --- ته‌بلیت: کد بزرگ + تاریخ کوتاه ---
    f_stub_lab = _font("Medium", 28)
    f_stub_code = _font("Bold", 44)
    f_stub_sub = _font("Regular", 22)
    cx = (x0 + stub_x) // 2
    _t(d, (cx, y0 + 74), lab["stub"], f_stub_lab, pal["soft"], "mm")
    _t(d, (cx, y0 + 190), code, f_stub_code, PAGE, "mm", rtl=False)
    short_when = when.split("،")[0] if "،" in when else when
    _t(d, (cx, y1 - 92), short_when, f_stub_sub, pal["soft"], "mm")
    # نقطه‌های تزئینی ته‌بلیت
    for i, dy in enumerate(range(y0 + 260, y1 - 140, 34)):
        r = 3 if i % 2 else 4
        d.ellipse([cx - r, dy, cx + r, dy + 2 * r], fill=pal["line"])

    buf = _io.BytesIO()
    img.save(buf, format="PNG", optimize=True)
    return buf.getvalue()


def ticket_path(code: str, event_id: int, title: str, holder: str, when: str,
                where: str, out_dir: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    """مسیر فایل بلیت با کش: یک کد = یک بار تولید."""
    directory = out_dir or TICKET_DIR
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = directory / f"{code}.png"
    if not path.exists():
        data = make_ticket_png(title, holder, when, where, code,
                               event_id=event_id)
        tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        tmp.write_bytes(data)
        tmp.replace(path)          # اتمی: بلیت نیمه‌نویس دیده نمی‌شود
    return path

# نمونهٔ طرح پیشنهادی v4 — فقط برای تصویب کاربر؛ به کد ربات وصل نیست.
"""یک بلیت افقی، زمینهٔ کاغذی، قاب مویی، ته‌برگهٔ کیوآرکد."""
import io
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 1800, 720
BG = (252, 251, 249)
INK = (30, 43, 39)
MUTED = (110, 116, 111)
HAIR = (231, 227, 216)
GOLD = (156, 124, 60)

F = "samples/fonts/Vazirmatn-%s.ttf"
f_brand = ImageFont.truetype(F % "Regular", 32)
f_label = ImageFont.truetype(F % "Regular", 28)
f_title = ImageFont.truetype(F % "Bold", 74)
f_info = ImageFont.truetype(F % "Regular", 40)
f_name = ImageFont.truetype(F % "Medium", 56)
f_code = ImageFont.truetype(F % "Bold", 66)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

# قاب مویی
d.rectangle([36, 36, W - 37, H - 37], outline=HAIR, width=2)

# خط چین ته‌برگه
sx = 520
for y in range(56, H - 56, 22):
    d.line([sx, y, sx, min(y + 11, H - 56)], fill=HAIR, width=2)
# دو نیم‌دایرهٔ برش بلیت
d.ellipse([sx - 22, 24, sx + 22, 68], fill=(245, 243, 238))
d.ellipse([sx - 22, H - 68, sx + 22, H - 24], fill=(245, 243, 238))


def draw_rtl(text, font, xy_right, y, fill):
    d.text(xy_right, y, text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="ra",
           direction="rtl", language="fa")


def text_w(text, font):
    b = d.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font, direction="rtl", language="fa")
    return b[2] - b[0]


R = W - 96                      # لبهٔ راست محتوا

# برند: حلقهٔ طلایی + نام گروه
d.ellipse([R - 40, 84, R, 124], outline=GOLD, width=2)
draw_rtl("خ", f_brand, R - 12, 86, GOLD)
draw_rtl("خط زندگی", f_brand, R - 60, 88, MUTED)

# عنوان
draw_rtl("کارگاه عکاسی مقدماتی", f_title, R, 200, INK)

# یک خط اطلاعات
info = "جمعه ۲۱ شهریور  ·  ساعت ۱۷:۰۰  ·  فرهنگسرای نیاوران"
draw_rtl(info, f_info, R, 330, MUTED)

# شرکت‌کننده
draw_rtl("شرکت‌کننده", f_label, R, 500, MUTED)
draw_rtl("سارا محمدی", f_name, R, 545, INK)

# ته‌برگه: کیوآرکد + کد
import qrcode  # noqa: E402

qr = qrcode.QRCode(border=0, box_size=10,
                   error_correction=qrcode.constants.ERROR_CORRECT_M)
qr.add_data("nora:t:T4K7M9X")
qr.make(fit=True)
qimg = qr.make_image(fill_color="#1E2B27", back_color="#FCFBF9").convert("RGB")
qimg = qimg.resize((280, 280), Image.LANCZOS)
img.paste(qimg, (sx // 2 - 140, 150))

cx = sx // 2
b = d.textbbox((0, 0), "کد بلیت", font=f_label, direction="rtl", language="fa")
d.text(cx, 500, "کد بلیت", font=f_label, fill=MUTED, anchor="ma",
       direction="rtl", language="fa")

code = "T 4 K 7 M 9 X"
# کد با فاصلهٔ حروف، وسط‌چین
total = 0
widths = []
for ch in code:
    w = text_w(ch, f_code) if ch != " " else 18
    widths.append(w)
    total += w
x = cx - total // 2
for ch, w in zip(code, widths):
    if ch != " ":
        d.text((x, 548), ch, font=f_code, fill=INK)
    x += w

img.save("preview/ticket-v4.png")
print("saved preview/ticket-v4.png", img.size)

Thought for 1 second

Bug: In d.text(xy_right, y, text, ...), xy_right is a scalar → the positional arguments become (x, y, text), and passing font=..., fill=... on top of that is no problem... Wait: d.text(xy_right, y, text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="ra") — the signature is text(xy, text, fill=None, font=None, anchor=None...). So in the positional arguments: xy_right → xy, y → text(!), text → fill(!), and then fill=fill conflicts. xy should be passed as a tuple. Fix draw_rtl: d.text((xy_right, y), text, ...).


Thought for 1 second

Same bug on line 77: d.text(cx, 500, "کد بلیت", ...) — positional argument cx→xy, 500→text, "کد بلیت"→fill, and then fill=MUTED causes a conflict. Fix it by making it into a tuple. Also, remove the unused variable b.

"""Glass-style image ticket — iOS 26-style theme.""" from future import annotations

import hashlib from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter, ImageFont import qrcode

_ROOT = Path(file).resolve().parents[2] _FONTS = _ROOT / "nora" / "assets" / "fonts" _CACHE = ROOT / "var" / "tickets"

W, H = 1800, 840 CARD = (60, 60, W - 60, H - 60) RAD = 84 SX = 520 # stub perforation (tear line) column

def blend(a, b, t): return tuple(int(x + (y - x) * t) for x, y in zip(a, b))*

_THEMES = { "glass": dict(base=(238, 240, 236), dark=False, blobs=[(1400, 160, 620, (191, 220, 210)), (300, 700, 560, (240, 230, 210)), (900, 420, 700, (214, 226, 238))], tint=(255, 255, 255, 150), accent=(14, 90, 78)), "forest": dict(base=(9, 48, 41), dark=True, blobs=[(1350, 180, 640, (23, 112, 92)), (350, 680, 600, (14, 90, 78)), (1500, 700, 420, (156, 124, 60))], tint=(255, 255, 255, 40), accent=(191, 220, 210)), "gold": dict(base=(246, 238, 223), dark=False, blobs=[(1350, 200, 620, (230, 217, 188)), (400, 660, 560, (216, 190, 133)), (900, 380, 640, (243, 231, 206))], tint=(255, 255, 255, 150), accent=(156, 124, 60)), "ocean": dict(base=(233, 238, 246), dark=False, blobs=[(1350, 200, 620, (191, 208, 230)), (380, 660, 560, (143, 168, 201)), (900, 400, 660, (220, 230, 242))], tint=(255, 255, 255, 150), accent=(84, 113, 155)), "night": dict(base=(15, 20, 19), dark=True, blobs=[(1350, 200, 620, (28, 43, 38)), (380, 660, 560, (18, 59, 51)), (900, 400, 640, (38, 51, 46))], tint=(255, 255, 255, 30), accent=(191, 220, 210)), } THEMES = tuple(_THEMES) DEFAULT = "glass"

Fonts: _f(name,size) is a cached truetype from _FONTS / f"Vazirmatn-{name}.ttf".

def theme_for(event_id: int, chosen: str = "") -> str: if chosen in THEMES: return chosen return THEMES[event_id % len(THEMES)]?

def render(title, info, holder, code, brand, theme=DEFAULT) -> Image: th = _THEMES[theme if theme in _THEMES else DEFAULT] # Background bg = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), th["base"]) lay = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0)) ld = ImageDraw.Draw(lay) for cx, cy, r, col in th["blobs"]: ld.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=col + (210,)) lay = lay.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(150)) bg = Image.alpha_composite(bg.convert("RGBA"), lay) # Shadow sh = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0)) sd = ImageDraw.Draw(sh) sd.rounded_rectangle([CARD[0], CARD[1] + 20, CARD[2], CARD[3] + 20], RAD, fill=(0, 0, 0, 70)) sh = sh.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(34)) out = Image.alpha_composite(bg, sh) # Frosted (ground glass) frost = out.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(30)) # blur the composite including shadow? """بلیت تصویری شیشه‌ای — پنج پوستهٔ هماهنگ با خط طراحی iOS 26.

کارت شیشه‌ای روی زمینهٔ گرادیان مه‌آلود: سطح نیمه‌شفاف، لبهٔ specular،
گوشه‌های پیوسته، ته‌برگهٔ کیوآرکد. بدون هیچ وابستگی جز Pillow و qrcode.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

import qrcode
from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw, ImageFilter, ImageFont

_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
_FONTS = _ROOT / "nora" / "assets" / "fonts"
_CACHE = _ROOT / "var" / "tickets"

W, H = 1800, 840
CARD = (60, 60, W - 60, H - 60)
RAD = 84
SX = 520                          # ستون خط چین ته‌برگه

_THEMES = {
    "glass": dict(base=(238, 240, 236), dark=False,
                  blobs=[(1400, 160, 620, (191, 220, 210)),
                         (300, 700, 560, (240, 230, 210)),
                         (900, 420, 700, (214, 226, 238))],
                  tint=(255, 255, 255, 150), accent=(14, 90, 78)),
    "forest": dict(base=(9, 48, 41), dark=True,
                   blobs=[(1350, 180, 640, (23, 112, 92)),
                          (350, 680, 600, (14, 90, 78)),
                          (1500, 700, 420, (156, 124, 60))],
                   tint=(255, 255, 255, 42), accent=(191, 220, 210)),
    "gold": dict(base=(246, 238, 223), dark=False,
                 blobs=[(1350, 200, 620, (230, 217, 188)),
                        (400, 660, 560, (216, 190, 133)),
                        (900, 380, 640, (243, 231, 206))],
                 tint=(255, 255, 255, 150), accent=(156, 124, 60)),
    "ocean": dict(base=(233, 238, 246), dark=False,
                  blobs=[(1350, 200, 620, (191, 208, 230)),
                         (380, 660, 560, (143, 168, 201)),
                         (900, 400, 660, (220, 230, 242))],
                  tint=(255, 255, 255, 150), accent=(84, 113, 155)),
    "night": dict(base=(15, 20, 19), dark=True,
                  blobs=[(1350, 200, 620, (28, 43, 38)),
                         (380, 660, 560, (18, 59, 51)),
                         (900, 400, 640, (38, 51, 46))],
                  tint=(255, 255, 255, 32), accent=(191, 220, 210)),
}
THEMES = tuple(_THEMES)
DEFAULT = "glass"

_FCACHE: dict = {}


def _f(weight: str, size: int) -> ImageFont.FreeTypeFont:
    key = (weight, size)
    if key not in _FCACHE:
        _FCACHE[key] = ImageFont.truetype(
            str(_FONTS / f"Vazirmatn-{weight}.ttf"), size)
    return _FCACHE[key]


def _blend(a, b, t: float):
    return tuple(int(x + (y - x) * t) for x, y in zip(a, b))


def theme_for(event_id: int, chosen: str = "") -> str:
    """پوستهٔ رویداد: انتخاب ادمین، وگرنه پیش‌فرض شفاف."""
    return chosen if chosen in _THEMES else DEFAULT


def _vgrad(w: int, h: int, a0: int, a1: int) -> Image.Image:
    buf = bytearray()
    for y in range(h):
        buf += bytes([int(a0 + (a1 - a0) * y / max(h - 1, 1))]) * w
    return Image.frombytes("L", (w, h), bytes(buf))


def _mask(box, radius: int, width: int = 0) -> Image.Image:
    m = Image.new("L", (W, H), 0)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(m)
    if width:
        d.rounded_rectangle(box, radius, outline=255, width=width)
    else:
        d.rounded_rectangle(box, radius, fill=255)
    return m


def _rtl(d, text, font, xy, fill, anchor):
    d.text(xy, text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor,
           direction="rtl", language="fa")


def _fit(d, text: str, weights_size: list, max_w: int, **kw):
    for weight, size in weights_size:
        font = _f(weight, size)
        b = d.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font, direction="rtl",
                       language="fa")
        if b[2] - b[0] <= max_w:
            return font
    return _f(*weights_size[-1])


def render(title: str, info: str, holder: str, code: str, brand: str,
           labels: dict, theme: str = DEFAULT) -> Image.Image:
    th = _THEMES[theme if theme in _THEMES else DEFAULT]
    dark = th["dark"]

    # زمینهٔ مه‌آلود
    bg = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), th["base"] + (255,))
    lay = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    ld = ImageDraw.Draw(lay)
    for cx, cy, r, col in th["blobs"]:
        ld.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=col + (215,))
    bg = Image.alpha_composite(bg, lay.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(150)))

    # سایهٔ کارت
    sh = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    ImageDraw.Draw(sh).rounded_rectangle(
        [CARD[0] + 4, CARD[1] + 22, CARD[2] - 4, CARD[3] + 22],
        RAD, fill=(0, 0, 0, 78))
    out = Image.alpha_composite(bg, sh.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(34)))

    # سطح شیشه‌ای: پس‌زمینهٔ مات + پردهٔ رنگی
    cm = _mask(CARD, RAD)
    frost = bg.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(30))
    layer = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    layer.paste(frost, (0, 0), cm)
    out = Image.alpha_composite(out, layer)
    tint = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    ImageDraw.Draw(tint).rounded_rectangle(CARD, RAD, fill=th["tint"])
    tint.putalpha(ImageChops.multiply(tint.getchannel("A"), cm))
    out = Image.alpha_composite(out, tint)

    # لبهٔ specular + برق سطحی بالا
    grad = _vgrad(W, H, 200 if not dark else 150, 56)
    edge = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (255, 255, 255, 0))
    edge.putalpha(ImageChops.multiply(_mask(CARD, RAD, width=3), grad))
    out = Image.alpha_composite(out, edge)
    hl = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (255, 255, 255, 0))
    hd = ImageDraw.Draw(hl)
    hd.rounded_rectangle([CARD[0] + 3, CARD[1] + 3, CARD[2] - 3, CARD[1] + 160],
                         RAD, fill=(255, 255, 255, 255))
    ha = ImageChops.multiply(ImageChops.multiply(hl.getchannel("A"),
                                                 _vgrad(W, H, 64, 0)), cm)
    hl.putalpha(ha)
    out = Image.alpha_composite(out, hl)

    d = ImageDraw.Draw(out, "RGBA")
    glass = _blend(th["base"], th["tint"][:3], th["tint"][3] / 255.0)
    ink = (244, 246, 243) if dark else (30, 43, 39)
    muted = _blend(ink, glass, 0.42)
    line = (255, 255, 255, 120) if dark else (30, 43, 39, 66)
    accent = th["accent"] + (255,)

    # خط چین و برش‌های ته‌برگه
    for y in range(CARD[1] + 48, CARD[3] - 48, 26):
        d.line([SX, y, SX, min(y + 12, CARD[3] - 48)], fill=line, width=3)
    for ny in (CARD[1], CARD[3]):
        nm = Image.new("L", (W, H), 0)
        ImageDraw.Draw(nm).ellipse([SX - 26, ny - 26, SX + 26, ny + 26],
                                   fill=255)
        out.paste(bg, (0, 0), nm)
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(out, "RGBA")

    R = CARD[2] - 84
    # برند: حلقهٔaccent + نام گروه
    d.ellipse([R - 46, 128, R - 2, 172], outline=accent, width=3)
    _rtl(d, brand[:1], _f("Medium", 30), (R - 24, 150), accent, "mm")
    _rtl(d, brand, _f("Regular", 32), (R - 66, 132), muted, "ra")

    # عنوان و اطلاعات
    f_title = _fit(d, title, [("Bold", 74), ("Bold", 62), ("Bold", 52)],
                   R - SX - 140)
    _rtl(d, title, f_title, (R, 236), ink, "ra")
    f_info = _fit(d, info, [("Regular", 40), ("Regular", 34)], R - SX - 140)
    _rtl(d, info, f_info, (R, 372), muted, "ra")

    # شرکت‌کننده
    _rtl(d, labels.get("holder", ""), _f("Regular", 28), (R, 556), muted,
         "ra")
    f_name = _fit(d, holder, [("Medium", 56), ("Medium", 46)], R - SX - 140)
    _rtl(d, holder, f_name, (R, 596), ink, "ra")

    # ته‌برگه: چیپ سفید کیوآرکد + کد
    cx = (CARD[0] + SX) // 2
    chip = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    ImageDraw.Draw(chip).rounded_rectangle([150, 158, 430, 438], 30,
                                           fill=(255, 255, 255, 255))
    csh = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    ImageDraw.Draw(csh).rounded_rectangle([154, 168, 426, 446], 30,
                                          fill=(0, 0, 0, 60))
    out = Image.alpha_composite(
        out, Image.alpha_composite(csh.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(16)),
                                   chip))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(out, "RGBA")
    qr = qrcode.QRCode(border=0, box_size=10,
                       error_correction=qrcode.constants.ERROR_CORRECT_M)
    qr.add_data("nora:t:" + code)
    qr.make(fit=True)
    qimg = qr.make_image(fill_color="#1E2B27",
                         back_color="#FFFFFF").convert("RGB")
    out.paste(qimg.resize((240, 240), Image.LANCZOS), (170, 178))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(out, "RGBA")
    _rtl(d, labels.get("code", ""), _f("Regular", 28), (cx, 556), muted,
         "ma")

    spaced = " ".join(code)
    f_code = _f("Bold", 62)
    widths = [d.textbbox((0, 0), ch, font=f_code)[2] for ch in spaced]
    total = sum(widths)
    x = cx - total // 2
    for ch, w in zip(spaced, widths):
        if ch != " ":
            d.text((x, 592), ch, font=f_code, fill=ink)
        x += w
    return out.convert("RGB")


def ticket_path(title: str, info: str, holder: str, code: str, brand: str,
                labels: dict, theme: str = DEFAULT) -> str:
    key = hashlib.sha1(repr((title, info, holder, code, brand,
                             tuple(sorted(labels.items())), theme))
                       .encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    _CACHE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = _CACHE / f"{key}.png"
    if not path.exists():
        render(title, info, holder, code, brand, labels, theme).save(
            str(path), optimize=True)
    return str(path)

settings.py
PYTHON
"""تنظیمات运行时 ادمین — جدول kv ساده.

کلیدها: card_number · pay_methods · receipt_auto · remind_min
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from ...core.db import Database

DEFAULTS = {
    "pay_methods": "gateway,card,onsite",
    "receipt_auto": "card",
    "remind_min": "10",
    "card_number": "",
}


class SettingsRepo:
    def __init__(self, db: Database) -> None:
        self.db = db
        db.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kv_settings ("
            "key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')")

    def get(self, key: str, default: str = "") -> str:
        row = self.db.query_one("SELECT value FROM kv_settings WHERE key = ?",
                                (key,))
        if row is None:
            return DEFAULTS.get(key, default)
        return row["value"]

    def set(self, key: str, value: str) -> None:
        self.db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO kv_settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?) "
            "ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value",
            (key, value))

    def items(self, key: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        raw = self.get(key)
        return tuple(x for x in raw.split(",") if x)

    def toggle(self, key: str, item: str) -> bool:
        """عضو را جابه‌جا می‌کند؛ وضعیت جدید را برمی‌گرداند."""
        cur = list(self.items(key))
        on = item not in cur
        cur = [x for x in cur if x != item] + ([item] if on else [])
        self.set(key, ",".join(cur))
        return on

nora2/nora/domain/payments.py

payments.py
PYTHON
"""لایهٔ دادهٔ پرداخت‌ها و کدهای تخفیف.

روش‌ها: gateway (درگاه رسمی بله) · card (کارت‌به‌کارت) · onsite (حضوری).
وضعیت‌ها: open → waiting_approval (رسید عکسی) → paid / closed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from ...core.clock import Clock
from ...core.db import Database

M_GATEWAY = "gateway"
M_CARD = "card"
M_ONSITE = "onsite"
METHODS = (M_GATEWAY, M_CARD, M_ONSITE)

PAY_OPEN = "open"
PAY_WAIT = "waiting_approval"
PAY_PAID = "paid"
PAY_CLOSED = "closed"


@dataclass
class Payment:
    id: int
    reg_id: int
    target_kind: str
    target_id: int
    user_id: int
    method: str
    amount: int
    discount: int
    status: str
    charge_id: str = ""
    receipt_file: str = ""
    paid_ts: float = 0.0
    created_ts: float = 0.0
    reminded: int = 0
    code: str = ""


@dataclass
class DiscountCode:
    id: int
    code: str
    kind: str            # pct | fix
    value: int
    uses_max: int        # 0 = بی‌نهايت
    uses: int
    expires_ts: float


def _row_pay(row) -> Payment:
    return Payment(
        id=row["id"], reg_id=row["reg_id"], target_kind=row["target_kind"],
        target_id=row["target_id"], user_id=row["user_id"],
        method=row["method"], amount=row["amount"],
        discount=row["discount"], status=row["status"],
        charge_id=row["charge_id"] or "", receipt_file=row["receipt_file"] or "",
        paid_ts=float(row["paid_ts"] or 0), created_ts=float(row["created_ts"] or 0),
        reminded=int(row["reminded"] or 0), code=row["code"] or "")


class PaymentRepo:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, clock: Clock | None = None) -> None:
        self.db = db
        self.clock = clock
        db.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payments ("
            "id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "
            "reg_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "
            "target_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'event', "
            "target_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "
            "user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, "
            "method TEXT NOT NULL, "
            "amount INTEGER NOT NULL, "
            "discount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "
            "status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "
            "charge_id TEXT, "
            "receipt_file TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "
            "paid_ts REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "
            "created_ts REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "
            "reminded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "
            "code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')")
        db.execute("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_pay_charge "
                   "ON payments (charge_id) WHERE charge_id IS NOT NULL "
                   "AND charge_id != ''")
        db.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS discount_codes ("
            "id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "
            "code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "
            "kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pct', "
            "value INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "
            "uses_max INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "
            "uses INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "
            "expires_ts REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)")

    # ---------- پرداخت ----------

    def create(self, user_id: int, method: str, amount: int, reg_id: int = 0,
               target_kind: str = "event", target_id: int = 0,
               discount: int = 0, code: str = "") -> Payment:
        now = self.clock.ts() if self.clock else 0.0
        cur = self.db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO payments (reg_id, target_kind, target_id, user_id, "
            "method, amount, discount, status, created_ts, code) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (reg_id, target_kind, target_id, user_id, method, amount,
             discount, PAY_OPEN, now, code))
        return self.get(cur.lastrowid) or Payment(
            cur.lastrowid, reg_id, target_kind, target_id, user_id, method,
            amount, discount, PAY_OPEN, code=code)

    def get(self, pay_id: int) -> Payment | None:
        row = self.db.query_one("SELECT * FROM payments WHERE id = ?",
                                (pay_id,))
        return _row_pay(row) if row else None

    def open_for_reg(self, reg_id: int) -> Payment | None:
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT * FROM payments WHERE reg_id = ? AND status IN (?, ?) "
            "ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1", (reg_id, PAY_OPEN, PAY_WAIT))
        return _row_pay(row) if row else None

    def by_charge(self, charge_id: str) -> Payment | None:
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT * FROM payments WHERE charge_id = ?", (charge_id,))
        return _row_pay(row) if row else None

    def set_method(self, pay_id: int, method: str) -> None:
        self.db.execute("UPDATE payments SET method = ? WHERE id = ?",
                        (method, pay_id))

    def set_receipt(self, pay_id: int, file_id: str, status: str) -> None:
        self.db.execute(
            "UPDATE payments SET receipt_file = ?, status = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (file_id, status, pay_id))

    def set_status(self, pay_id: int, status: str) -> None:
        self.db.execute("UPDATE payments SET status = ? WHERE id = ?",
                        (status, pay_id))

    def mark_paid(self, pay_id: int, charge_id: str = "") -> float:
        now = self.clock.ts() if self.clock else 0.0
        self.db.execute(
            "UPDATE payments SET status = ?, charge_id = ?, paid_ts = ? "
            "WHERE id = ?", (PAY_PAID, charge_id, now, pay_id))
        return now

    def mark_reminded(self, pay_id: int) -> None:
        self.db.execute("UPDATE payments SET reminded = 1 WHERE id = ?",
                        (pay_id,))

    def due_reminders(self, now: float, minutes: int) -> list[Payment]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM payments WHERE status = ? AND reminded = 0 "
            "AND created_ts <= ? ORDER BY id",
            (PAY_OPEN, now - minutes * 60))
        return [_row_pay(r) for r in rows]

    def waiting_approval(self) -> list[Payment]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM payments WHERE status = ? ORDER BY id",
            (PAY_WAIT,))
        return [_row_pay(r) for r in rows]

    def paid_of_user(self, user_id: int) -> list[Payment]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM payments WHERE user_id = ? AND status = ? "
            "ORDER BY paid_ts DESC", (user_id, PAY_PAID))
        return [_row_pay(r) for r in rows]

    def paid_since(self, ts: float) -> list[Payment]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM payments WHERE status = ? AND paid_ts >= ? "
            "ORDER BY paid_ts", (PAY_PAID, ts))
        return [_row_pay(r) for r in rows]

    # ---------- کد تخفیف ----------

    def add_code(self, code: str, kind: str, value: int, uses_max: int = 0,
                 expires_ts: float = 0.0) -> DiscountCode:
        cur = self.db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO discount_codes (code, kind, value, uses_max, "
            "expires_ts) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (code.strip().upper(), kind, value, uses_max, expires_ts))
        return self.get_code(code) or DiscountCode(
            cur.lastrowid, code.strip().upper(), kind, value, uses_max, 0,
            expires_ts)

    def get_code(self, code: str) -> DiscountCode | None:
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT * FROM discount_codes WHERE code = ?",
            (code.strip().upper(),))
        if row is None:
            return None
        return DiscountCode(row["id"], row["code"], row["kind"], row["value"],
                            row["uses_max"], row["uses"], row["expires_ts"])

    def consume(self, code_id: int) -> None:
        self.db.execute("UPDATE discount_codes SET uses = uses + 1 "
                        "WHERE id = ?", (code_id,))
