PANEL_ROLES = ("organizer", "operator", "admin", "owner")
APPROVER_ROLES = ("operator", "admin", "owner")

_EV_FIELDS = ("title", "desc", "status", "ticket_theme", "capacity", "price",
              "price_vip", "archive_access", "archive_price", "loc_address",
              "online_link", "invite_code", "require_approval", "has_ticket")


def _err(status: int, code: str):
    return status, {"ok": False, "error": code}, "json"


def _ok(payload: dict):
    payload["ok"] = True
    return 200, payload, "json"


def _when_fa(ts: float) -> str:
    if not ts:
        return "—"
    return fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, tz=TEHRAN))


class WebApi:
    def __init__(self, settings, db, urepo, erepo, payrepo, suprepo, setrepo,
                 profile, esvc, psvc, api=None, clock=None) -> None:
        self.cfg = settings
        self.db = db
        self.urepo = urepo
        self.erepo = erepo
        self.payrepo = payrepo
        self.suprepo = suprepo
        self.setrepo = setrepo
        self.profile = profile
        self.esvc = esvc
        self.psvc = psvc
        self.api = api
        self.clock = clock
        self.secret = auth.session_secret(settings.bot_token)
        self.sent: list = []

    # ---------- ورودی/مسیریابی ----------

    def notifier(self) -> WebNotifier:
        return WebNotifier(self.api, self.sent)

    def handle(self, method: str, path: str, query: dict, body: dict,
               headers: dict):
        """(status, payload, kind) — kind: json | bytes:*."""
        path = path.rstrip("/") or "/"
        if path == "/login" and method == "POST":
            return self._login(body, headers)
        user = self._authed(headers)
        if user is None:
            return _err(401, "unauthorized")
        if user.role not in PANEL_ROLES:
            return _err(403, "forbidden")
        route = (method, path)
        simple = {
            ("GET", "/me"): lambda m: self._me(user),
            ("GET", "/dashboard"): lambda m: self._dashboard(user),
            ("GET", "/approvals"): lambda m: self._approvals(user),
            ("GET", "/users"): lambda m: self._users(user, query),
            ("GET", "/events"): lambda m: self._events(user, query),
            ("POST", "/events"): lambda m: self._event_create(user, body),
            ("GET", "/payments"): lambda m: self._pay_queue(user),
            ("GET", "/finance"): lambda m: self._finance(user, query),
            ("GET", "/settings"): lambda m: self._settings_get(user),
            ("POST", "/settings"): lambda m: self._settings_set(user, body),
            ("GET", "/tickets"): lambda m: self._tickets(user),
            ("POST", "/approvals"): lambda m: self._approval_decide(user, body),
        }
        fn = simple.get(route)
        if fn is not None:
            return fn(body)
        for pattern, handler in (
            (r"^/users/(\d+)$", lambda m: self._user_detail(user, int(m[1]))),
            (r"^/events/(\d+)$",
             lambda m: self._event_action(user, int(m[1]), method, body)),
            (r"^/events/(\d+)/regs$",
             lambda m: self._event_regs(user, int(m[1]))
             if method == "GET" else _err(405, "method")),
            (r"^/regs/(\d+)$",
             lambda m: self._reg_action(user, int(m[1]), body)
             if method == "POST" else _err(405, "method")),
            (r"^/payments/(\d+)$",
             lambda m: self._pay_action(user, int(m[1]), body)
             if method == "POST" else _err(405, "method")),
            (r"^/payments/(\d+)/photo$",
             lambda m: self._pay_photo(user, int(m[1]))
             if method == "GET" else _err(405, "method")),
            (r"^/payments/(\d+)/receipt$",
             lambda m: self._pay_receipt(user, int(m[1]))
             if method == "POST" else _err(405, "method")),
            (r"^/tickets/(\d+)$",
             lambda m: self._ticket_detail(user, int(m[1]), method, body)),
        ):
            m = re.match(pattern, path)
            if m and method in ("GET", "POST"):
                return handler(m.groups())
        return _err(404, "not_found")

    # ---------- احراز هویت ----------

    def _login(self, body: dict, headers: dict):
        bale_id = 0
        raw = str(body.get("initData") or "")
        info = auth.validate_init_data(raw, self.cfg.bot_token)
        if info is not None:
            bale_id = int(info.get("id") or 0)
        elif auth.dev_allowed(self.cfg.is_prod):
            try:
                bale_id = int(headers.get("x-dev-login") or 0)
            except ValueError:
                bale_id = 0
        if not bale_id:
            return _err(401, "bad_init_data")
        user = self.urepo.get_by_bale(bale_id)
        if user is None or user.role not in PANEL_ROLES:
            return _err(403, "forbidden")
        return _ok({"session": auth.make_session(user.id, self.secret),
                    "name": user.full_name or user.first_name,
                    "role": user.role, "role_fa": role_fa(user.role)})

    def _authed(self, headers: dict):
        uid = auth.check_session(headers.get("x-session") or "", self.secret)
        return self.urepo.get(uid) if uid else None

    def _me(self, user):
        return _ok({"name": user.full_name or user.first_name,
                    "role": user.role, "role_fa": role_fa(user.role)})

    # ---------- داشبورد ----------

    def _dashboard(self, user):
        now = self.clock.ts() if self.clock else datetime.now(TEHRAN).timestamp()
        day_start = datetime.now(TEHRAN).replace(
            hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0).timestamp()
        new_today = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM users WHERE created_ts >= ?",
            (day_start,))
        upcoming = [e for e in self.erepo.list_events(("published",), limit=20)
                    if e.start_ts >= now]
        fin = self.psvc.finance(now - 30 * 86400)
        per = {t("m_" + k): {"count": fa_num(v[0]),
                             "amount": money_label(v[1])}
               for k, v in fin["per"].items()}
        nxt = upcoming[0] if upcoming else None
        return _ok({
            "users_total": fa_num(self.urepo.count()),
            "users_new_today": fa_num(int(new_today["n"]) if new_today else 0),
            "events_upcoming": fa_num(len(upcoming)),
            "income_30d": {"count": fa_num(fin["count"]),
                           "total": money_label(fin["total"]), "per": per},
            "queues": {"approvals": len(self.profile.open_approvals()),
                       "payments": len(self.payrepo.waiting_approval()),
                       "tickets": len(self.suprepo.list_open())},
            "next_event": None if nxt is None else
            {"id": nxt.id, "title": nxt.title, "when": _when(nxt)},
        })

    # ---------- تأیید پروفایل ----------

    def _approvals(self, user):
        if user.role not in APPROVER_ROLES:
            return _err(403, "forbidden")
        rows = []
        for item in self.profile.open_approvals():
            rows.append({"id": item["id"], "user_id": item["user_id"],
                         "name": item["full_name"] or t("name_fallback"),
                         "field": item["field"], "old": item["old"] or "—",
                         "new": item["new"] or "—"})
        return _ok({"items": rows})

    def _approval_decide(self, user, body: dict):
        if user.role not in APPROVER_ROLES:
            return _err(403, "forbidden")
        try:
            self.profile.decide(int(body.get("id") or 0),
                                bool(body.get("accept")))
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return _err(400, "bad_request")
        except Exception:
            return _err(404, "not_found")
        return _ok({})

    # ---------- کاربران ----------

    def _users(self, user, query: dict):
        if not can(user.role, "view_users"):
            return _err(403, "forbidden")
        q = (query.get("q") or "").strip()
        if not q:
            return _ok({"items": []})
        if q.isdigit():
            rows = self.db.query(
                "SELECT * FROM users WHERE bale_id = ? OR id = ? LIMIT 20",
                (int(q), int(q)))
        else:
            like = f"%{q}%"
            rows = self.db.query(
                "SELECT * FROM users WHERE full_name LIKE ? OR username LIKE ?"
                " OR phone LIKE ? OR first_name LIKE ? LIMIT 20",
                (like, like, like, like))
        items = [{"id": r["id"], "bale_id": r["bale_id"],
                  "name": r["full_name"] or r["first_name"]
                  or t("name_fallback"),
                  "role_fa": role_fa(r["role"] or "guest"),
                  "status_fa": t("st_" + (r["status"] or "pending")),
                  "city": r["city"] or "—"} for r in rows]
        return _ok({"items": items})

    def _user_detail(self, user, uid: int):
        if not can(user.role, "view_dossier"):
            return _err(403, "forbidden")
        target = self.urepo.get(uid)
        if target is None:
            return _err(404, "not_found")
        regs = []
        for reg in self.erepo.user_regs(uid, limit=30):
            ev = self.erepo.get_event(reg.event_id)
            regs.append({"event": ev.title if ev else "—",
                         "status_fa": t("pst_" + reg.status),
                         "ticket": reg.ticket_code or "—",
                         "amount": money_label(reg.amount_paid),
                         "when": _when_fa(reg.created_ts)})
        pays = []
        for pay in self.payrepo.paid_of_user(uid):
            pays.append({"method_fa": t("m_" + pay.method),
                         "amount": money_label(pay.amount),
                         "when": _when_fa(pay.paid_ts)})
        tickets = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE user_id = ?",
            (uid,))
        return _ok({
            "user": {"id": target.id, "bale_id": fa_num(target.bale_id),
                     "name": target.full_name or target.first_name
                     or t("name_fallback"),
                     "username": target.username or "—",
                     "phone": target.phone or "—",
                     "gender": target.gender or "—",
                     "city": target.city or "—",
                     "national_id": target.national_id or "—",
                     "role_fa": role_fa(target.role),
                     "status_fa": t("st_" + target.status),
                     "vip": bool(target.is_vip)},
            "regs": regs, "pays": pays,
            "tickets": fa_num(int(tickets["n"]) if tickets else 0),
        })

    # ---------- برنامه‌ها ----------

    def _event_row(self, ev) -> dict:
        income, refund = self.erepo.revenue(ev.id)
        seats = self.erepo.seat_count(ev.id)
        return {"id": ev.id, "title": ev.title, "when": _when(ev),
                "status": ev.status, "status_fa": t("pev_" + ev.status),
                "kind_fa": t("evk_" + ev.kind) if ev.kind else "—",
                "seats": fa_num(seats), "capacity": fa_num(ev.capacity),
                "price": money_label(ev.price) if ev.is_paid
                else t("ev_free") if hasattr(t, "__call__") else "—",
                "income": money_label(income),
                "refund": money_label(refund)}

    def _events(self, user, query: dict):
        if not can(user.role, "manage_events"):
            return _err(403, "forbidden")
        flt = query.get("filter") or "all"
        now = self.clock.ts() if self.clock else datetime.now(TEHRAN).timestamp()
        evs = self.erepo.list_events(EVENT_STATUSES, limit=60)
        if flt == "upcoming":
            evs = [e for e in evs if e.status == "published"
                   and e.start_ts >= now]
        elif flt == "past":
            evs = [e for e in evs if e.status in ("finished", "cancelled")
                   or e.start_ts < now]
        elif flt in EVENT_STATUSES:
            evs = [e for e in evs if e.status == flt]
        return _ok({"items": [self._event_row(e) for e in evs]})

    def _event_create(self, user, body: dict):
        if not can(user.role, "manage_events"):
            return _err(403, "forbidden")
        title = str(body.get("title") or "").strip()
        if not title or len(title) > 80:
            return _err(400, "bad_title")
        date = str(body.get("date") or "").strip()
        time_s = str(body.get("time") or "09:00").strip()
        start = _parse_start(f"{date} {time_s}")
        if start is None:
            return _err(400, "bad_when")
        try:
            capacity = max(0, int(body.get("capacity") or 0))
            price = max(0, int(body.get("price") or 0))
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return _err(400, "bad_request")
        loc_type = body.get("loc_type") or "online"
        if loc_type not in ("online", "physical", "hybrid"):
            return _err(400, "bad_request")
        ev = self.erepo.create_event(
            title=title, desc=str(body.get("desc") or "").strip(),
            kind=str(body.get("kind") or "meeting"),
            loc_type=loc_type,
            loc_address=str(body.get("loc_address") or "").strip(),
            online_link=str(body.get("online_link") or "").strip(),
            start_ts=start, reg_end_ts=start, capacity=capacity,
            is_paid=1 if price > 0 else 0, price=price,
            status="draft", created_by=user.id,
            organizer=user.full_name or user.first_name)
        return _ok({"id": ev.id})

    def _event_detail(self, user, ev) -> dict:
        rep = self.esvc.event_report(ev)
        counts = {t("pst_" + k): fa_num(v) for k, v in rep.counts.items()}
        regs = []
        for reg in self.erepo.event_regs(ev.id, limit=100):
            u = self.urepo.get(reg.user_id)
            regs.append({"reg_id": reg.id,
                         "name": (u.full_name or u.first_name)
                         if u else t("name_fallback"),
                         "status": reg.status,
                         "status_fa": t("pst_" + reg.status),
                         "ticket": reg.ticket_code or "—",
                         "amount": money_label(reg.amount_paid),
                         "when": _when_fa(reg.created_ts)})
        return {"event": {"id": ev.id, "title": ev.title, "desc": ev.desc,
                          "kind": ev.kind, "kind_fa": t("evk_" + ev.kind),
                          "when": _when(ev), "status": ev.status,
                          "status_fa": t("pev_" + ev.status),
                          "loc_type": ev.loc_type,
                          "loc_address": ev.loc_address or "—",
                          "online_link": ev.online_link or "—",
                          "capacity": fa_num(ev.capacity),
                          "price": money_label(ev.price),
                          "is_paid": bool(ev.is_paid),
                          "ticket_theme": ev.ticket_theme,
                          "themes": list(receipt_art.gk.THEMES),
                          "archive_access": ev.archive_access,
                          "archive_price": fa_num(ev.archive_price),
                          "invite_code": ev.invite_code or "—",
                          "require_approval": bool(ev.require_approval)},
                "report": {"counts": counts,
                           "revenue": money_label(rep.revenue),
                           "refund": money_label(rep.refund_due),
                           "archive": fa_num(rep.archive)},
                "regs": regs}

    def _event_action(self, user, eid: int, method: str, body: dict):
        if not can(user.role, "manage_events"):
            return _err(403, "forbidden")
        ev = self.erepo.get_event(eid)
        if ev is None:
            return _err(404, "not_found")
        if method == "GET":
            return _ok(self._event_detail(user, ev))
        fields: dict = {}
        for key in _EV_FIELDS:
            if key in body:
                fields[key] = body[key]
        if "status" in fields and fields["status"] not in EVENT_STATUSES:
            return _err(400, "bad_status")
        if "ticket_theme" in fields and fields["ticket_theme"] \
                and fields["ticket_theme"] not in receipt_art.gk.THEMES:
            return _err(400, "bad_theme")
        if "archive_access" in fields and fields["archive_access"] not in (
                "registered", "paid", "open"):
            return _err(400, "bad_request")
        for num_key in ("capacity", "price", "price_vip", "archive_price",
                        "require_approval", "has_ticket"):
            if num_key in fields:
                try:
                    fields[num_key] = int(fields[num_key])
                except (ValueError, TypeError):
                    return _err(400, "bad_request")
        if "title" in fields and not str(fields["title"]).strip():
            return _err(400, "bad_title")
        if fields:
            self.erepo.update_event(eid, **fields)
            ev = self.erepo.get_event(eid)
        return _ok(self._event_detail(user, ev))

    def _event_regs(self, user, eid: int):
        if not can(user.role, "manage_events"):
            return _err(403, "forbidden")
        ev = self.erepo.get_event(eid)
        if ev is None:
            return _err(404, "not_found")
        return _ok(self._event_detail(user, ev))

    def _reg_action(self, user, rid: int, body: dict):
        if not can(user.role, "manage_events"):
            return _err(403, "forbidden")
        action = str(body.get("action") or "")
        notifier = self.notifier()
        if action in ("approve", "reject"):
            out = self.esvc.approve_reg(rid, action == "approve")
            kind = out["kind"]
            if kind == "none":
                return _err(404, "not_found")
            if kind == "full":
                return _err(409, "event_full")
            reg = out.get("reg")
            if reg is not None:
                u = self.urepo.get(reg.user_id)
                if u is not None:
                    ok = action == "approve"
                    if ok and reg.ticket_code:
                        ev = self.erepo.get_event(reg.event_id)
                        name = u.full_name or u.first_name \
                            or t("name_fallback")
                        sent_img = ev is not None and _send_ticket(
                            notifier, ev, reg, name, u.bale_id, "ev_reg_ok",
                            code=reg.ticket_code)
                        if not sent_img:
                            notifier.bulk(u.bale_id, "ev_reg_ok",
                                          code=reg.ticket_code)
                    elif ok:
                        notifier.bulk(u.bale_id, "ev_reg_ok_noticket")
                    else:
                        notifier.bulk(u.bale_id, "ev_reg_rejected")
            if out.get("promoted") is not None:
                _notify_promoted(self.urepo, notifier, self.erepo,
                                 out["promoted"])
            return _ok({"kind": kind})
        if action == "onsite":
            reg = self.erepo.get_reg(rid)
            if reg is None or reg.status != REG_PENDING_PAY:
                return _err(409, "bad_reg")
            pay = self.payrepo.open_for_reg(rid)
            if pay is None:
                ev = self.erepo.get_event(reg.event_id)
                target = self.urepo.get(reg.user_id)
                price = self.psvc.esvc.price_for(target, ev) \
                    if (ev and target) else 0
                pay = self.payrepo.create(reg.user_id, M_ONSITE, price,
                                          reg_id=rid, target_kind="event",
                                          target_id=reg.event_id)
            res = self.psvc.mark_manual(pay.id)
            if res.reg is not None:
                notify_paid(self.psvc, self.payrepo, self.erepo, self.urepo,
                            notifier, res.reg, pay)
            return _ok({})
        return _err(400, "bad_action")

    # ---------- پرداخت ----------

    def _pay_row(self, pay) -> dict:
        u = self.urepo.get(pay.user_id)
        ev = self.erepo.get_event(pay.target_id) \
            if pay.target_kind == "event" else None
        return {"id": pay.id,
                "name": (u.full_name or u.first_name)
                if u else t("name_fallback"),
                "user_id": pay.user_id,
                "target": ev.title if ev else
                (t("arc_title") if pay.target_kind == "archive" else "—"),
                "kind": pay.target_kind,
                "method": pay.method, "method_fa": t("m_" + pay.method),
                "amount": money_label(pay.amount),
                "discount": money_label(pay.discount),
                "status": pay.status,
                "has_photo": bool(pay.receipt_file),
                "when": _when_fa(pay.created_ts)}

    def _pay_queue(self, user):
        items = [self._pay_row(p) for p in self.payrepo.waiting_approval()]
        return _ok({"items": items})

    def _pay_action(self, user, pid: int, body: dict):
        action = str(body.get("action") or "")
        pay = self.payrepo.get(pid)
        if pay is None:
            return _err(404, "not_found")
        if pay.status == "paid":
            return _err(409, "already_paid")
        notifier = self.notifier()
        if action == "approve":
            res = self.psvc.mark_manual(pid)
            if pay.target_kind == "archive":
                _notify_archive(self.psvc, self.payrepo, self.erepo,
                                self.urepo, notifier, pay)
            elif res.reg is not None:
                notify_paid(self.psvc, self.payrepo, self.erepo, self.urepo,
                            notifier, res.reg, pay)
            return _ok({})
        if action == "reject":
            self.payrepo.set_status(pid, "open")
            u = self.urepo.get(pay.user_id)
            if u is not None:
                notifier.bulk(u.bale_id, "pay_rejected")
            return _ok({})
        return _err(400, "bad_action")

    def _pay_photo(self, user, pid: int):
        pay = self.payrepo.get(pid)
        if pay is None or not pay.receipt_file or self.api is None:
            return _err(404, "not_found")
        data = self.api.download_file(pay.receipt_file)
        if not data:
            return _err(404, "no_file")
        return 200, data, "bytes:image/jpeg"

    def _pay_receipt(self, user, pid: int):
        pay = self.payrepo.get(pid)
        if pay is None or pay.status != "paid":
            return _err(409, "bad_pay")
        u = self.urepo.get(pay.user_id)
        if u is None:
            return _err(404, "not_found")
        ok = send_receipt(self.psvc, self.payrepo, self.erepo, self.urepo,
                          self.notifier(), pay, u.bale_id)
        return _ok({}) if ok else _err(409, "send_failed")

    # ---------- مالی ----------

    def _finance(self, user, query: dict):
        if not can(user.role, "view_finance"):
            return _err(403, "forbidden")
        try:
            days = int(query.get("days") or 30)
        except ValueError:
            days = 30
        days = days if days in (7, 30, 90) else 30
        now = self.clock.ts() if self.clock else datetime.now(TEHRAN).timestamp()
        fin = self.psvc.finance(now - days * 86400)
        rows = []
        for pay in sorted(self.payrepo.paid_since(now - days * 86400),
                          key=lambda p: p.paid_ts, reverse=True)[:40]:
            rows.append(self._pay_row(pay) | {"paid_when": _when_fa(pay.paid_ts)})
        per = {t("m_" + k): {"count": fa_num(v[0]),
                             "amount": money_label(v[1])}
               for k, v in fin["per"].items()}
        return _ok({"days": days, "count": fa_num(fin["count"]),
                    "total": money_label(fin["total"]), "per": per,
                    "refund": money_label(fin["refund"]), "rows": rows})

    # ---------- تنظیمات ----------

    def _method_items(self, key: str, all_methods) -> list[dict]:
        on = self.setrepo.items(key)
        return [{"key": m, "fa": t("m_" + m), "on": m in on}
                for m in all_methods]

    def _settings_get(self, user):
        return _ok({
            "pay_methods": self._method_items("pay_methods", METHODS),
            "receipt_auto": self._method_items("receipt_auto", METHODS),
            "card_number": self.setrepo.get("card_number"),
            "can_edit": can(user.role, "manage_settings"),
        })

    def _settings_set(self, user, body: dict):
        if not can(user.role, "manage_settings"):
            return _err(403, "forbidden")
        for key, allowed in (("pay_methods", METHODS),
                             ("receipt_auto", METHODS)):
            if key in body:
                vals = body[key]
                if not isinstance(vals, list) or any(
                        v not in allowed for v in vals):
                    return _err(400, "bad_request")
                self.setrepo.set(key, ",".join(str(v) for v in vals))
        if "card_number" in body:
            card = re.sub(r"[^0-9]", "", str(body["card_number"]))
            if len(card) > 20:
                return _err(400, "bad_request")
            self.setrepo.set("card_number", card)
        return self._settings_get(user)

    # ---------- پشتیبانی ----------

    def _tickets(self, user):
        items = []
        for tk in self.suprepo.list_open():
            u = self.urepo.get(tk.user_id)
            msgs = self.suprepo.msgs(tk.id)
            preview = msgs[-1].text[:60] if msgs else ""
            items.append({"id": tk.id,
                          "name": (u.full_name or u.first_name)
                          if u else t("name_fallback"),
                          "when": _when_fa(tk.last_ts or tk.created_ts),
                          "preview": preview})
        return _ok({"items": items})

    def _ticket_detail(self, user, tid: int, method: str, body: dict):
        tk = self.suprepo.get(tid)
        if tk is None:
            return _err(404, "not_found")
        u = self.urepo.get(tk.user_id)
        if method == "GET":
            msgs = [{"sender": m.sender, "text": m.text,
                     "when": _when_fa(m.ts)} for m in self.suprepo.msgs(tid)]
            return _ok({"ticket": {"id": tk.id, "status": tk.status,
                                   "name": (u.full_name or u.first_name)
                                   if u else t("name_fallback")},
                        "msgs": msgs})
        action = str(body.get("action") or "")
        if action == "reply":
            text = str(body.get("text") or "").strip()
            if not text or len(text) > 1000:
                return _err(400, "bad_request")
            self.suprepo.add_msg(tid, "admin", text)
            if u is not None and self.api is not None:
                self.api.send(u.bale_id, text)
                self.sent.append(("text", u.bale_id, "ticket_reply"))
            return _ok({})
        if action == "close":
            if tk.status == "closed":
                return _err(409, "already_closed")
            self.suprepo.close(tid)
            if u is not None:
                self.notifier().bulk(u.bale_id, "sup_closed")
            return _ok({})
        return _err(400, "bad_action")

"""سرور پنل — stdlib خالص، بدون وابستگی تازه.

هدّرها طبق داکیومنت رسمی مینی‌اپ بله:
CSP با frame-src/frame-ancestors روی *.bale.ai و بدون X-Frame-Options
(بله پنل را در iframe خودش باز می‌کند).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import mimetypes
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

from ..channels.bale.api import BaleAPI
from ..core.clock import get_clock
from ..core.config import Settings
from ..core.db import Database
from ..domain.events import EventRepo
from ..domain.payments import PaymentRepo
from ..domain.settings import SettingsRepo
from ..domain.support import SupportRepo
from ..domain.users import UserRepo
from ..services.event_service import EventService
from ..services.pay_service import PayService
from ..services.profile_service import ProfileService
from .api import WebApi

STATIC = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "static"

CSP = ("default-src 'self'; "
       "script-src 'self' https://tapi.bale.ai; "
       "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; "
       "img-src 'self' data: blob:; "
       "connect-src 'self' https://tapi.bale.ai; "
       "font-src 'self' data:; "
       "frame-src https://*.bale.ai; "
       "frame-ancestors https://*.bale.ai; "
       "base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'")


def build_api(settings: Settings, db: Database | None = None,
              clock=None, transport=None) -> WebApi:
    """سیم‌کشی پنل — همان اجزای build_bot، بدون حلقهٔ polling."""
    db = db if db is not None else Database(settings.db_path)
    clock = clock or get_clock()
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db, clock)
    suprepo = SupportRepo(db, clock)
    setrepo = SettingsRepo(db)
    esvc = EventService(erepo, clock)
    psvc = PayService(payrepo, erepo, esvc, setrepo, clock)
    profile = ProfileService(urepo)
    api = BaleAPI(settings.bot_token or "dev-token", transport=transport)
    return WebApi(settings, db, urepo, erepo, payrepo, suprepo, setrepo,
                  profile, esvc, psvc, api=api, clock=clock)


def make_handler(web: WebApi):
    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        server_version = "NoraPanel/1.0"

        def log_message(self, fmt, *args):  # سکوت: لاگ خودمان کافی است
            pass

        def _headers(self, status: int, ctype: str, length: int):
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", ctype)
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(length))
            self.send_header("Content-Security-Policy", CSP)
            self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
            self.send_header("Referrer-Policy", "same-origin")
            self.end_headers()

        def _send(self, status: int, payload, kind: str):
            if kind == "json":
                raw = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
                self._headers(status, "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                              len(raw))
                self.wfile.write(raw)
                return
            ctype = kind.split(":", 1)[1] if ":" in kind else \
                "application/octet-stream"
            self._headers(status, ctype, len(payload))
            self.wfile.write(payload)

        def _api(self, method: str):
            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            if not parsed.path.startswith("/api/"):
                self._send(404, {"ok": False, "error": "not_found"}, "json")
                return
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
            body: dict = {}
            if length:
                try:
                    body = json.loads(
                        self.rfile.read(length).decode("utf-8"))
                except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
                    body = {}
                if not isinstance(body, dict):
                    body = {}
            query = {k: v[0] for k, v in parse_qs(parsed.query).items()}
            headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in self.headers.items()}
            try:
                status, payload, kind = web.handle(
                    method, parsed.path[len("/api"):], query, body, headers)
            except Exception:
                status, payload, kind = 500, {"ok": False,
                                              "error": "server"}, "json"
            self._send(status, payload, kind)

        def do_GET(self):
            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            if parsed.path.startswith("/api/"):
                self._api("GET")
                return
            self._static(parsed.path)

        def do_POST(self):
            self._api("POST")

        def _static(self, path: str):
            rel = "index.html" if path in ("/", "") else path.lstrip("/")
            target = (STATIC / rel).resolve()
            if not str(target).startswith(str(STATIC)) or \
                    not target.is_file():
                self._send(404, {"ok": False, "error": "not_found"}, "json")
                return
            ctype = mimetypes.guess_type(str(target))[0] or \
                "application/octet-stream"
            if ctype.startswith("text/") or ctype in (
                    "application/javascript", "application/json"):
                ctype += "; charset=utf-8"
            data = target.read_bytes()
            self._headers(200, ctype, len(data))
            self.wfile.write(data)

    return Handler


def serve(settings: Settings, host: str = "0.0.0.0", port: int = 8090,
          db: Database | None = None, clock=None, transport=None):
    web = build_api(settings, db=db, clock=clock, transport=transport)
    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer((host, port), make_handler(web))
    return httpd, web


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import argparse

    from ..core.config import load

    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--host", default="0.0.0.0")
    ap.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8090)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    cfg = load()
    srv, _ = serve(cfg, args.host, args.port)
    print(f"panel on http://{args.host}:{args.port}")
    srv.serve_forever()

پنل مدیریت نورا

Open

Thought for 8 seconds

Next is app.js — the biggest file. Write it carefully.

Structure:

Helpers ($, esc, faNum, toast, overlay)
I18N dictionary
Bale WebApp wrapper (version-checked call)
api fetch wrapper + session
Router (hash), tab bar, BackButton
Screens: dash, events, eventDetail, eventNew, pays, finance, tickets, ticketDetail, users, userDetail, approvals, settings, more
Boot: theme, login flow, dev fallback
Details:

WA = window.Bale && window.Bale.WebApp
ready(): if WA exists then WA.ready(); expand()
BackButton: WA.BackButton.show()/hide(), onClick(cb) — show when depth>1.
Theme: WA.colorScheme ('light'|'dark') + onEvent('themeChanged').
Version check: compareVersion(WA.version, '1.0') for BackButton; sendData is 1.2 (not needed).
login: POST /api/login {initData: WA.initData}; if it fails and !WA then: dev prompt: bale id input overlay → retry login with x-dev-login header.
Session is saved in localStorage as 'nora_panel_sess'.
req(): attach x-session; 401 → try re-login once → if that still fails then login screen.
Photo display: fetch with headers → blob → URL.createObjectURL.
Routing: location.hash is in the format like #/dash, #/events, #/event/12, #/evnew, #/pays, #/fin, #/tix, #/tix/3, #/users, #/user/5, #/aprs, #/sets, #/more. onhashchange → render. Tabs map to root groups. Back stack: browser history handles it; BackButton onClick → history.back().

Rendering pattern: each screen function is async: sets view.innerHTML = loading, fetches data, builds HTML string, binds events with delegation on #view using data-act.

Actions go through delegation: view.addEventListener('click', ...) just once, reading data-act and data-id.

Keep functions compact. Now let's write it (about 700 lines). Pay attention to Persian strings inside JS (no problem, the scanner is Python-only).

Forms: collect via id with q().

Event detail actions:

Status chips: buttons for publish (draft→published), close, finish, cancel → POST /events/{id} {status}
Theme picker: select → POST {ticket_theme}
Capacity/price editing: inline input fields + save button → POST
Archive: select archive_access + numeric input archive_price → save
Registration table rows, buttons per status: pending_approval → approve/reject; pending_pay → pay onsite
Report card count + revenue + refunds + archive
Event list: filter chips (all, upcoming, past, draft, published, closed, finished, cancelled) + rows are clickable → detail; FAB "برنامهٔ نو" → #/evnew.

Payments: queue cards; buttons: photo (overlay), approve, reject; after payment: also a "رسید" send button on the finance row? Receipt sending endpoint POST /payments/{id}/receipt (for paid). Add it to the finance detail row? Simply: only for paid ones, add a small "ارسال رسید" button to the finance row.

Tickets: list → detail thread; reply textarea + send; close button.

Users: search box (input event with debounce → GET /users?q=), result rows → user detail dossier.

Approvals: card list: name + field + old→new + approve/reject buttons.

Settings: pay_methods and receipt_auto switches, card number input + save (disabled if !can_edit).

More tab: me card (name/role), links: users, approvals, finance, settings.

Dashboard: grid stats (users_total, new_today, upcoming, income30 total), queue chips with counts (clickable), next event card.

Error map: I18N.err[code].

faNum helper for client-side numbers: use Intl.NumberFormat('fa-IR') — most of the numbers come already formatted from the server.

Now let's write it.

/* پنل مدیریت نورا — مینی‌اپ بله.
   یک منطق، دو پوسته: این فایل فقط ویترین است؛ همهٔ داده‌ها از /api.
   SDK با بررسی نسخه صدا زده می‌شود (کلاینت قدیمی = سقوط نکردن). */
'use strict';

/* ---------- ابزارها ---------- */
const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
const esc = (s) => String(s == null ? '' : s)
  .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
  .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
const faNum = (n) => { try { return new Intl.NumberFormat('fa-IR').format(n); } catch (e) { return String(n); } };

function toast(msg) {
  const el = q('#toast');
  el.textContent = msg;
  el.classList.remove('hidden');
  clearTimeout(el._t);
  el._t = setTimeout(() => el.classList.add('hidden'), 2600);
}

function overlay(html) {
  const el = q('#overlay');
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="sheet">' + html + '</div>';
  el.classList.remove('hidden');
  el.onclick = (e) => { if (e.target === el) overlayClose(); };
}
function overlayClose() { q('#overlay').classList.add('hidden'); q('#overlay').innerHTML = ''; }

/* ---------- لایهٔ بله (نسخه‌دار) ---------- */
const WA = (window.Bale && window.Bale.WebApp) || null;

function verGE(v, want) {
  if (!v) return false;
  const a = String(v).split('.').map(Number), b = String(want).split('.').map(Number);
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.max(a.length, b.length); i++) {
    const x = a[i] || 0, y = b[i] || 0;
    if (x > y) return true;
    if (x < y) return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function waReady() { if (WA && verGE(WA.version, '1.0')) { try { WA.ready(); WA.expand(); } catch (e) { /* کلاینت قدیمی */ } } }
function backShow(on) {
  if (!WA || !verGE(WA.version, '1.0') || !WA.BackButton) return;
  try { on ? WA.BackButton.show() : WA.BackButton.hide(); } catch (e) { /* بی‌صدا */ }
}
function applyTheme() {
  let scheme = 'light';
  if (WA && WA.colorScheme) scheme = WA.colorScheme;
  else if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) scheme = 'dark';
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = scheme;
}

/* ---------- API ---------- */
let SESSION = '';
try { SESSION = localStorage.getItem('nora_panel_sess') || ''; } catch (e) { /* خصوصی */ }
let DEVLOGIN = '';
try { DEVLOGIN = localStorage.getItem('nora_panel_dev') || ''; } catch (e) { /* خصوصی */ }

async function req(method, path, body) {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
  if (SESSION) headers['x-session'] = SESSION;
  if (DEVLOGIN) headers['x-dev-login'] = DEVLOGIN;
  const resp = await fetch('/api' + path, {
    method, headers,
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  let data = null;
  try { data = await resp.json(); } catch (e) { data = null; }
  if (resp.status === 401) throw { code: 'unauthorized' };
  if (!resp.ok || !data || !data.ok) throw { code: (data && data.error) || 'generic' };
  return data;
}
function errText(code) { return I.err[code] || I.err.generic; }

async function doLogin() {
  const initData = WA && WA.initData ? WA.initData : '';
  try {
    const r = await req2('POST', '/login', { initData });
    return r;
  } catch (e) {
    if (!WA) return null; // بیرون از بله: حالت توسعه
    throw e;
  }
}
async function req2(method, path, body) {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
  if (DEVLOGIN) headers['x-dev-login'] = DEVLOGIN;
  const resp = await fetch('/api' + path, { method, headers, body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined });
  let data = null;
  try { data = await resp.json(); } catch (e) { data = null; }
  if (!resp.ok || !data || !data.ok) throw { code: (data && data.error) || 'generic' };
  return data;
}

function devPrompt() {
  overlay(
    '<div class="card-title">' + esc(I.login.title) + '</div>' +
    '<label class="fld"><span class="lb">' + esc(I.login.dev) + '</span>' +
    '<input type="text" id="dev-id" inputmode="numeric"></label>' +
    '<button class="btn primary wide" id="dev-go">' + esc(I.login.go) + '</button>'
  );
  q('#dev-go').onclick = async () => {
    const v = (q('#dev-id').value || '').trim();
    if (!v) return;
    DEVLOGIN = v;
    try { localStorage.setItem('nora_panel_dev', v); } catch (e) { /* خصوصی */ }
    overlayClose();
    await boot(true);
  };
}

/* ---------- روتر ---------- */
let ME = null;
let QUEUES = { approvals: 0, payments: 0, tickets: 0 };

  { key: 'events', hash: '#/events', icon: 'M8 3v4m8-4v4M4 9h16M5 5h14a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v14a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H5a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1Z' },
  { key: 'pays', hash: '#/pays', icon: 'M2 7h20v10H2zM2 11h20M6 15h4' },
  { key: 'tix', hash: '#/tix', icon: 'M21 12a8 8 0 0 1-8 8H4l2-3a8 8 0 1 1 15-5Z' },
  { key: 'more', hash: '#/more', icon: 'M5 12h.01M12 12h.01M19 12h.01' },
];

function tabbar() {
  q('#tabbar').innerHTML = TABS.map((t) => {
    const on = location.hash.startsWith(t.hash) ||
      (t.key === 'pays' && location.hash.startsWith('#/fin')) ||
      (t.key === 'more' && (location.hash.startsWith('#/users') || location.hash.startsWith('#/aprs') || location.hash.startsWith('#/sets') || location.hash.startsWith('#/user')));
    const badge = t.key === 'pays' && QUEUES.payments ? '<span class="badge">' + faNum(QUEUES.payments) + '</span>' : '';
    return '<button class="tab' + (on ? ' on' : '') + '" data-go="' + t.hash + '">' +
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="' + t.icon + '"/></svg>' +
      '<span>' + esc(I.tabs[t.key]) + '</span>' + badge + '</button>';
  }).join('');
}

function route() {
  const h = location.hash || '#/dash';
  const parts = h.replace('#/', '').split('/');
  backShow(parts[0] !== 'dash');
  tabbar();
  const map = {
    dash: sDash, events: sEvents, evnew: sEventNew, event: () => sEvent(parts[1]),
    pays: sPays, fin: sFin, tix: () => parts[1] ? sTicket(parts[1]) : sTickets(),
    users: sUsers, user: () => sUser(parts[1]), aprs: sAprs, sets: sSets, more: sMore,
  };
  const fn = map[parts[0]] || sDash;
  q('#top-title').textContent = I.app;
  fn().catch((e) => {
    q('#view').innerHTML = '<div class="card"><div class="empty">' + esc(errText(e && e.code)) + '</div>' +
      '<button class="btn wide" data-act="reload">' + esc(I.retry) + '</button></div>';
  });
}

function setView(html) { q('#view').innerHTML = html; }
function loading() { setView('<div class="loading"></div>'); }
function head(title, right) {
  return '<div class="section-head"><h2>' + esc(title) + '</h2>' + (right || '') + '</div>';
}

const EV_FILTERS = ['all', 'upcoming', 'past', 'draft', 'published', 'closed', 'finished', 'cancelled'];
async function sEvents() {
  loading();
  const flt = sessionStorage.getItem('ev_filter') || 'all';
  const d = await req('GET', '/events?filter=' + encodeURIComponent(flt));
  const chips = EV_FILTERS.map((f) =>
    '<span class="chip tap' + (f === flt ? ' accent' : '') + '" data-act="evfilter" data-f="' + f + '">' + esc(I.ev.filters[f]) + '</span>').join('');
  const rows = d.items.map((e) =>
    '<div class="row" data-go="#/event/' + e.id + '" style="cursor:pointer">' +
    '<div class="main"><div class="t1">' + esc(e.title) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="t2">' + esc(e.when) + ' · ' + esc(e.kind_fa) + '</div></div>' +
    '<div style="text-align:left;flex:none"><span class="chip ' + statusChip(e.status) + '">' + esc(e.status_fa) + '</span>' +
    '<div class="t2 muted">' + esc(e.seats) + '/' + esc(e.capacity) + ' · ' + esc(e.income) + '</div></div></div>').join('');
  setView(head(I.ev.title, '<button class="btn primary sm" data-go="#/evnew">＋ ' + esc(I.ev.new) + '</button>') +
    '<div class="filterbar">' + chips + '</div>' +
    '<div class="card">' + (rows || '<div class="empty">' + esc(I.empty) + '</div>') + '</div>');
}
function statusChip(st) {
  return { published: 'accent', draft: 'gold', closed: 'info', finished: '', cancelled: 'danger' }[st] || '';
}

async function sEvent(id) {
  loading();
  const d = await req('GET', '/events/' + id);
  const ev = d.event;
  const acts = [];
  if (ev.status === 'draft') acts.push(['publish', 'published', 'primary']);
  if (ev.status === 'published') { acts.push(['close', 'closed', '']); acts.push(['finish', 'finished', 'gold']); }
  if (ev.status === 'closed') acts.push(['reopen', 'published', 'primary']);
  if (ev.status !== 'cancelled' && ev.status !== 'finished') acts.push(['cancel', 'cancelled', 'danger']);
  const actBtns = acts.map((a) => '<button class="btn sm ' + a[2] + '" data-act="evstatus" data-id="' + ev.id + '" data-v="' + a[1] + '">' + esc(I.ev.detail.acts[a[0]]) + '</button>').join('');
  const counts = Object.keys(d.report.counts).map((k) =>
    '<div class="kv"><span class="k">' + esc(k) + '</span><span class="v">' + esc(d.report.counts[k]) + '</span></div>').join('');
  const regs = d.regs.map((r) => {
    let btns = '';
    if (r.status === 'pending_approval') {
      btns = '<button class="btn sm primary" data-act="reg" data-id="' + r.reg_id + '" data-v="approve">' + esc(I.ev.detail.approve) + '</button> ' +
        '<button class="btn sm danger" data-act="reg" data-id="' + r.reg_id + '" data-v="reject">' + esc(I.ev.detail.reject) + '</button>';
    } else if (r.status === 'pending_pay') {
      btns = '<button class="btn sm gold" data-act="reg" data-id="' + r.reg_id + '" data-v="onsite">' + esc(I.ev.detail.onsite) + '</button>';
    }
    return '<div class="row"><div class="main"><div class="t1">' + esc(r.name) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="t2">' + esc(r.status_fa) + (r.ticket !== '—' ? ' · ' + esc(I.ev.detail.ticket) + ' ' + esc(r.ticket) : '') + ' · ' + esc(r.amount) + '</div></div>' +
      '<div style="flex:none">' + btns + '</div></div>';
  }).join('');
  setView('<div class="back-line"><button class="btn sm" data-go="#/events">' + esc(I.back) + '</button></div>' +
    '<div class="card"><div class="section-head" style="margin:0"><h2>' + esc(ev.title) + '</h2>' +
    '<span class="chip ' + statusChip(ev.status) + '">' + esc(ev.status_fa) + '</span></div>' +
    '<div class="muted">' + esc(ev.when) + ' · ' + esc(ev.kind_fa) + '</div>' +
    (ev.desc ? '<div style="margin-top:8px">' + esc(ev.desc) + '</div>' : '') +
    '<div style="margin-top:10px">' +
    '<div class="kv"><span class="k">' + esc(I.ev.detail.where) + '</span><span class="v">' + esc(ev.loc_address !== '—' ? ev.loc_address : ev.online_link) + '</span></div>' +
    '<div class="kv"><span class="k">' + esc(I.ev.capacity) + '</span><span class="v">' + esc(ev.capacity) + '</span></div>' +
    '<div class="kv"><span class="k">' + esc(I.ev.price) + '</span><span class="v">' + esc(ev.price) + '</span></div>' +
    '</div>' +
    (actBtns ? '<div class="btnrow" style="margin-top:12px">' + actBtns + '</div>' : '') +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="card"><div class="card-title">' + esc(I.ev.detail.report) + '</div>' + counts +
    '<div class="kv"><span class="k">' + esc(I.ev.income) + '</span><span class="v">' + esc(d.report.revenue) + '</span></div>' +
    '<div class="kv"><span class="k">' + esc(I.ev.refund) + '</span><span class="v">' + esc(d.report.refund) + '</span></div>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="card"><div class="card-title">' + esc(I.ev.detail.theme) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="filterbar">' + ev.themes.map((th) =>
      '<span class="chip tap' + (th === (ev.ticket_theme || 'glass') ? ' accent' : '') + '" data-act="evtheme" data-id="' + ev.id + '" data-v="' + esc(th) + '">' + esc(th) + '</span>').join('') + '</div>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="card"><div class="card-title">' + esc(I.ev.detail.archive) + '</div>' +
    '<label class="fld"><span class="lb">' + esc(I.ev.detail.archiveAccess) + '</span><select id="a-acc">' +
    ['registered', 'paid', 'open'].map((a) => '<option value="' + a + '"' + (ev.archive_access === a ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(I.ev.detail.acc[a]) + '</option>').join('') +
    '</select></label>' +
    '<label class="fld"><span class="lb">' + esc(I.ev.detail.archivePrice) + '</span><input type="number" id="a-price" value="' + esc(ev.archive_price) + '" min="0"></label>' +
    '<button class="btn sm wide" data-act="evarc" data-id="' + ev.id + '">' + esc(I.set.save) + '</button>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="card"><div class="card-title">' + esc(I.ev.detail.regs) + '</div>' +
    (regs || '<div class="empty">' + esc(I.empty) + '</div>') + '</div>');
}

async function sUsers() {
  setView(head(I.users.title) +
    '<div class="card"><label class="fld"><input type="text" id="u-q" placeholder="' + esc(I.users.search) + '"></label>' +
    '<div id="u-list"></div></div>');
  const input = q('#u-q');
  let tm = 0;
  input.oninput = () => {
    clearTimeout(tm);
    tm = setTimeout(async () => {
      const v = input.value.trim();
      if (!v) { q('#u-list').innerHTML = ''; return; }
      try {
        const d = await req('GET', '/users?q=' + encodeURIComponent(v));
        q('#u-list').innerHTML = d.items.map((u) =>
          '<div class="row" data-go="#/user/' + u.id + '" style="cursor:pointer">' +
          '<div class="main"><div class="t1">' + esc(u.name) + '</div>' +
          '<div class="t2">' + esc(u.role_fa) + ' · ' + esc(u.city) + '</div></div>' +
          '<span class="chip">' + esc(u.status_fa) + '</span></div>').join('') ||
          '<div class="empty">' + esc(I.empty) + '</div>';
      } catch (e) { toast(errText(e.code)); }
    }, 350);
  };
}

/* ---------- اکشن‌ها (واگذاری رویداد) ---------- */
document.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
  const go = e.target.closest('[data-go]');
  if (go) { location.hash = go.dataset.go; return; }
  const act = e.target.closest('[data-act]');
  if (!act) return;
  const a = act.dataset.act, id = act.dataset.id, v = act.dataset.v;
  try {
    if (a === 'reload') { route(); return; }
    if (a === 'histback') { history.back(); return; }
    if (a === 'evfilter') { sessionStorage.setItem('ev_filter', v); sEvents(); return; }
    if (a === 'findays') { sessionStorage.setItem('fin_days', v); sFin(); return; }
    if (a === 'evcreate') {
      const body = {
        title: q('#f-title').value, desc: q('#f-desc').value, kind: q('#f-kind').value,
        date: q('#f-date').value, time: q('#f-time').value,
        capacity: Number(q('#f-cap').value || 0), price: Number(q('#f-price').value || 0),
        loc_type: q('#f-loc').value, loc_address: q('#f-addr').value, online_link: q('#f-link').value,
      };
      const r = await req('POST', '/events', body);
      toast(I.ev.detail.saved);
      location.hash = '#/event/' + r.id;
      return;
    }
    if (a === 'evstatus') { await req('POST', '/events/' + id, { status: v }); toast(I.ev.detail.saved); sEvent(id); return; }
    if (a === 'evtheme') { await req('POST', '/events/' + id, { ticket_theme: v }); toast(I.ev.detail.saved); sEvent(id); return; }
    if (a === 'evarc') {
      await req('POST', '/events/' + id, { archive_access: q('#a-acc').value, archive_price: Number(q('#a-price').value || 0) });
      toast(I.ev.detail.saved); sEvent(id); return;
    }
    if (a === 'reg') {
      const r = await req('POST', '/regs/' + id, { action: v });
      toast(v === 'reject' ? I.pay.rejected : I.pay.done);
      route(); return;
    }
    if (a === 'pay') { await req('POST', '/payments/' + id, { action: v }); toast(v === 'approve' ? I.pay.done : I.pay.rejected); sPays(); return; }
    if (a === 'receipt') { await req('POST', '/payments/' + id + '/receipt'); toast(I.pay.receiptSent); return; }
    if (a === 'photo') {
      const resp = await fetch('/api/payments/' + id + '/photo', { headers: SESSION ? { 'x-session': SESSION } : {} });
      if (!resp.ok) { toast(errText('no_file')); return; }
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(await resp.blob());
      overlay('<img src="' + url + '" alt="receipt"><div style="height:10px"></div>' +
        '<button class="btn wide" onclick="overlayClose()">' + esc(I.back) + '</button>');
      return;
    }
    if (a === 'apr') { await req('POST', '/approvals', { id: Number(id), accept: v === '1' }); toast(I.apr.done); sAprs(); return; }
    if (a === 'tixreply') {
      const text = q('#t-reply').value.trim();
      if (!text) return;
      await req('POST', '/tickets/' + id, { action: 'reply', text });
      toast(I.tix.sent); sTicket(id); return;
    }
    if (a === 'tixclose') { await req('POST', '/tickets/' + id, { action: 'close' }); toast(I.tix.closed); sTicket(id); return; }
    if (a === 'sw') {
      if (!q('#view').dataset.canEdit) { toast(errText('forbidden')); return; }
      const key = act.dataset.key;
      const cur = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-act="sw"][data-key="' + key + '"]')]
        .filter((el) => el.classList.contains('on')).map((el) => el.dataset.v);
      const next = act.classList.contains('on') ? cur.filter((x) => x !== v) : cur.concat([v]);
      const body = {}; body[key] = next;
      await req('POST', '/settings', body);
      act.classList.toggle('on');
      return;
    }
    if (a === 'card') {
      await req('POST', '/settings', { card_number: q('#s-card').value });
      toast(I.set.saved); return;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    if (err && err.code === 'unauthorized') { await boot(true); return; }
    toast(errText(err && err.code));
  }
});

/* ---------- راه‌اندازی ---------- */
async function boot(relogin) {
  applyTheme();
  waReady();
  if (WA && WA.BackButton && verGE(WA.version, '1.0')) {
    try { WA.BackButton.onClick(() => history.back()); } catch (e) { /* بی‌صدا */ }
  }
  if (WA && WA.onEvent) {
    try { WA.onEvent('themeChanged', applyTheme); } catch (e) { /* بی‌صدا */ }
  }
  if (!SESSION || relogin) {
    loading();
    try {
      const r = await doLogin();
      if (r) {
        SESSION = r.session;
        try { localStorage.setItem('nora_panel_sess', SESSION); } catch (e) { /* خصوصی */ }
        ME = { name: r.name, role_fa: r.role_fa };
        q('#top-role').textContent = r.role_fa;
      } else {
        devPrompt();
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!WA) { devPrompt(); return; }
      setView('<div class="card"><div class="empty">' + esc(errText(e && e.code)) + '</div></div>');
      return;
    }
  }
  if (!ME) {
    try {
      ME = await req('GET', '/me');
      q('#top-role').textContent = ME.role_fa;
    } catch (e) {
      if (e && e.code === 'unauthorized') { SESSION = ''; return boot(true); }
    }
  }
  if (!location.hash) location.hash = '#/dash';
  route();
}

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from nora.core.config import load          # noqa: E402
from nora.core.db import Database          # noqa: E402
from nora.domain.payments import PAY_WAIT  # noqa: E402
from nora.web.server import build_api      # noqa: E402


def main() -> None:
    cfg = load()
    db = Database(cfg.db_path)
    web = build_api(cfg, db=db)
    urepo, erepo, suprepo, setrepo = web.urepo, web.erepo, web.suprepo, web.setrepo
    esvc, psvc, profile = web.esvc, web.psvc, web.profile
    now = time.time()
    day = 86400.0

    # ---------- کاربران ----------
    def member(bale_id: int, name: str, role: str, **kw) -> int:
        u = urepo.get_by_bale(bale_id)
        if u is None:
            u = urepo.create(bale_id, first_name=name, **kw)
        fields = {"full_name": name, "role": role, "status": "approved"}
        fields.update(kw)
        urepo.update(u.id, **fields)
        return u.id

    owner = member(111, "مدیر نورا", "owner", city="تهران", phone="09120000001")
    operator = member(222, "اپراتور خط", "operator", city="تهران",
                      phone="09120000002")
    sara = member(301, "سارا محمدی", "member", city="تهران",
                  phone="09120000003", gender="f")
    ali = member(302, "علی رضایی", "member", city="کرج",
                 phone="09120000004", gender="m")
    maryam = member(303, "مریم احمدی", "member", city="تهران",
                    phone="09120000005", gender="f")

    # ---------- برنامه‌ها ----------
    if not erepo.list_events(("draft", "published", "closed", "finished",
                              "cancelled"), limit=100):
        ev1 = erepo.create_event(
            title="کارگاه آرامش ذهن", kind="workshop",
            desc="تمرین‌های عملی برای کاهش اضطراب روزمره.",
            start_ts=now + 3 * day, reg_end_ts=now + 3 * day,
            capacity=30, is_paid=1, price=250000, status="published",
            loc_type="physical", loc_address="تهران، میدان ونک",
            created_by=owner, organizer="مدیر نورا", created_ts=now - 5 * day)

        ev2 = erepo.create_event(
            title="همایش پاییزی", kind="conference",
            desc="گزارش سالانهٔ خط زندگی.",
            start_ts=now - 20 * day, reg_end_ts=now - 22 * day,
            capacity=100, is_paid=1, price=150000, status="finished",
            loc_type="online", online_link="https://example.live/fall",
            archive_access="paid", archive_price=90000,
            ticket_theme="forest",
            created_by=owner, organizer="مدیر نورا", created_ts=now - 40 * day)

        erepo.create_event(
            title="جلسهٔ آشنایی", kind="meeting",
            start_ts=now + 10 * day, reg_end_ts=now + 10 * day,
            capacity=0, status="draft", loc_type="online",
            created_by=owner, created_ts=now)

        ev4 = erepo.create_event(
            title="نشست تخصصی سوگ", kind="expert",
            start_ts=now + 7 * day, reg_end_ts=now + 7 * day,
            capacity=12, require_approval=1, status="published",
            loc_type="physical", loc_address="تهران، مطهری",
            created_by=owner, organizer="مدیر نورا", created_ts=now - 2 * day)

        ev5 = erepo.create_event(
            title="دورهمی اعضای قدیمی", kind="meeting",
            start_ts=now + 5 * day, reg_end_ts=now + 5 * day,
            capacity=1, status="published", loc_type="online",
            online_link="https://example.live/old",
            created_by=owner, created_ts=now - day)

        # ---------- ثبت‌نام‌ها و پرداخت‌ها ----------
        su, au, mu = urepo.get(sara), urepo.get(ali), urepo.get(maryam)

        # سارا: پرداخت درگاه موفق → تأییدشده با بلیت
        esvc.register(su, ev1)
        ps = psvc.start(su, ev1, "gateway")
        if ps.payment is not None:
            psvc.mark_manual(ps.payment.id)

        # علی: کارت‌به‌کارت در صف تأیید (با عکس رسید دمو)
        esvc.register(au, ev1)
        ps = psvc.start(au, ev1, "card")
        if ps.payment is not None:
            web.payrepo.set_receipt(ps.payment.id, "DEMO-FILE-ID", PAY_WAIT)

        # مریم: ثبت‌نام کرده ولی هنوز پرداخت نکرده
        esvc.register(mu, ev1)
        psvc.start(mu, ev1, "card")

        # نشست تخصصی: هر سه در انتظار تأیید
        for u in (su, au, mu):
            esvc.register(u, ev4)

        # دورهمی ظرفیت ۱: سارا تأییدشده، علی در انتظار
        esvc.register(su, ev5)
        esvc.register(au, ev5)

        # علی: خرید آرشیو همایش پاییزی (پرداخت‌شده)
        ps = psvc.start_archive(au, ev2, "gateway")
        if ps.payment is not None:
            psvc.mark_manual(ps.payment.id)

        # ---------- تأیید پروفایل ----------
        profile.apply(mu, full_name="مریم احمدی‌نژاد")

        # ---------- تیکت‌ها ----------
        tk = suprepo.create(ali, "سلام، پرداخت کارت‌به‌کارت کردم ولی وضعیت عوض نشده.")
        suprepo.add_msg(tk.id, "admin", "سلام؛ رسید را بررسی می‌کنیم و تا ساعتی دیگر تعیین تکلیف می‌شود.")
        tk2 = suprepo.create(sara, "لینک جلسه را گم کردم.")
        suprepo.add_msg(tk2.id, "admin", "لینک دوباره ارسال شد.")
        suprepo.add_msg(tk2.id, "user", "رسید، ممنون.")
        suprepo.close(tk2.id)

    # ---------- تنظیمات ----------
    setrepo.set("pay_methods", "gateway,card,onsite")
    setrepo.set("receipt_auto", "gateway")
    if not setrepo.get("card_number"):
        setrepo.set("card_number", "6219861012345678")

    print("seed ok")
    print("dev login: 111 (owner) | 222 (operator)")
    print("db:", cfg.db_path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""تست API پنل ادمین — احراز هویت، دسترسی‌ها، و آینه‌بودن اقدام‌ها با بات."""
import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import time
from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.events import REG_CONFIRMED, REG_PENDING_APPR
from nora.domain.payments import PAY_WAIT
from nora.web import auth
from nora.web.server import build_api

TOKEN = "test-token"


class FakeBale:
    def __init__(self):
        self.sent = []
        self.files = {}

    def send(self, chat_id, text, markup=None):
        self.sent.append(("text", chat_id, text))
        return {}

    def send_photo_file(self, chat_id, path, caption=""):
        self.sent.append(("photo", chat_id, path))
        return {}

    def download_file(self, file_id):
        return self.files.get(file_id)


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db, fake_clock, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("NORA_WEB_DEV", "1")
    settings = Settings(env="test", bot_token=TOKEN)
    bale = FakeBale()
    api = build_api(settings, db=db, clock=fake_clock, api=bale)
    urepo = api.urepo

    def mk(bale_id, name, role, **kw):
        u = urepo.create(bale_id, first_name=name)
        urepo.update(u.id, role=role, status="approved", full_name=name, **kw)
        return urepo.get(u.id)

    owner = mk(111, "مدیر", "owner")
    organizer = mk(222, "برگزارکننده", "organizer")
    member = mk(333, "عضو", "member")
    return api, bale, owner, organizer, member, urepo, fake_clock


def login(api, bale_id):
    st, payload, _ = api.handle("POST", "/login", {}, {},
                                {"x-dev-login": str(bale_id)})
    assert st == 200, payload
    return {"x-session": payload["session"]}


def call(api, method, path, headers, body=None, query=None):
    return api.handle(method, path, query or {}, body or {}, headers)


# ---------- احراز هویت ----------

def test_init_data_roundtrip():
    user = json.dumps({"id": 111, "first_name": "x"}, ensure_ascii=False)
    now = int(time.time())
    pairs = {"user": user, "auth_date": str(now)}
    check = "\n".join(f"{k}={pairs[k]}" for k in sorted(pairs))
    secret = hmac.new(TOKEN.encode(), b"WebAppData", hashlib.sha256).digest()
    h = hmac.new(secret, check.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    raw = "&".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in pairs.items()) + "&hash=" + h
    assert auth.validate_init_data(raw, TOKEN, now=now)["id"] == 111
    assert auth.validate_init_data(raw.replace(h, "0" * 64), TOKEN,
                                   now=now) is None
    assert auth.validate_init_data(raw, TOKEN, now=now + 99 * 3600) is None


def test_session_expiry():
    secret = auth.session_secret(TOKEN)
    tok = auth.make_session(7, secret, now=1000, ttl=10)
    assert auth.check_session(tok, secret, now=1005) == 7
    assert auth.check_session(tok, secret, now=2000) == 0
    assert auth.check_session(tok + "x", secret, now=1005) == 0


def test_login_init_data_path(env):
    api, _b, owner, _o, _m, _u, clock = env
    user = json.dumps({"id": owner.bale_id}, ensure_ascii=False)
    now = int(clock.ts())
    pairs = {"user": user, "auth_date": str(now)}
    check = "\n".join(f"{k}={pairs[k]}" for k in sorted(pairs))
    secret = hmac.new(TOKEN.encode(), b"WebAppData", hashlib.sha256).digest()
    h = hmac.new(secret, check.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    raw = f"user={user}&auth_date={now}&hash={h}"
    st, payload, _ = call(api, "POST", "/login", {}, {"initData": raw})
    assert st == 200 and payload["role"] == "owner"


def test_login_denied(env):
    api, _b, _ow, _or, member, _u, _c = env
    st, payload, _ = call(api, "POST", "/login", {},
                          {}, )
    assert st == 401 and payload["error"] == "bad_init_data"
    st, payload, _ = api.handle("POST", "/login", {}, {},
                                {"x-dev-login": str(member.bale_id)})
    assert st == 403 and payload["error"] == "forbidden"


def test_unauthed_and_unknown_paths(env):
    api, *_ = env

    assert st == 401
    h = login(api, 111)
    st, payload, _ = call(api, "GET", "/nope", h)

def test_event_create_validate_and_flow(env):
    api, _b, owner, organizer, _m, _u, _c = env
    h = login(api, 111)
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", "/events", h,
                    {"title": "", "date": "1405/06/20"})
    assert st == 400 and d["error"] == "bad_title"
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", "/events", h,
                    {"title": "x", "date": "بدون تاریخ"})
    assert st == 400 and d["error"] == "bad_when"
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", "/events", h,
                    {"title": "کارگاه تست", "date": "1405/06/28",
                     "time": "18:30", "capacity": 5, "price": 100000,
                     "loc_type": "physical", "loc_address": "تهران"})
    assert st == 200
    eid = d["id"]
    st, d, _ = call(api, "GET", f"/events/{eid}", h)
    assert d["event"]["status"] == "draft"
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", f"/events/{eid}", h,
                    {"status": "published"})
    assert d["event"]["status"] == "published"
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", f"/events/{eid}", h, {"status": "nope"})
    assert st == 400
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", f"/events/{eid}", h,
                    {"ticket_theme": "not-a-theme"})
    assert st == 400 and d["error"] == "bad_theme"
    # organizer هم دسترسی دارد (آینهٔ _staff بات)
    ho = login(api, 222)
    st, d, _ = call(api, "GET", "/events", ho, query={"filter": "upcoming"})
    assert any(e["id"] == eid for e in d["items"])

def test_reg_approve_and_reject_notify(env):
    api, bale, _ow, _or, member, _u, _c = env
    h = login(api, 111)
    _st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", "/events", h,
                     {"title": "نشست", "date": "1405/07/02"})
    eid = d["id"]
    call(api, "POST", f"/events/{eid}", h,
         {"status": "published", "require_approval": 1})
    ev = api.erepo.get_event(eid)
    res = api.esvc.register(member, ev)
    assert res.kind == REG_PENDING_APPR
    rid = res.reg.id
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", f"/regs/{rid}", h, {"action": "approve"})
    assert st == 200 and d["kind"] == "confirmed"
    reg = api.erepo.get_reg(rid)
    assert reg.status == REG_CONFIRMED and reg.ticket_code
    assert any(kind == "photo" and chat == member.bale_id
               for kind, chat, _ in bale.sent) or \
        any(kind == "text" and chat == member.bale_id
            for kind, chat, _ in bale.sent)
    # رد کردن
    res2 = api.esvc.register(api.urepo.get_by_bale(222), ev)
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", f"/regs/{res2.reg.id}", h,
                    {"action": "reject"})
    assert d["kind"] == "rejected"
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", f"/regs/{res2.reg.id}", h,
                    {"action": "approve"})
    assert st == 404          # دیگر pending_approval نیست

# ---------- پرداخت ----------

def _waiting_pay(api, member):
    h = login(api, 111)
    _st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", "/events", h,
                     {"title": "کارتی", "date": "1405/07/04",
                      "price": 80000})
    eid = d["id"]
    call(api, "POST", f"/events/{eid}", h, {"status": "published"})
    ev = api.erepo.get_event(eid)
    api.esvc.register(member, ev)
    ps = api.psvc.start(member, ev, "card")
    api.payrepo.set_receipt(ps.payment.id, "F-1", PAY_WAIT)
    return h, eid, ps.payment


def test_pay_queue_approve_reject(env):
    api, bale, _ow, _or, member, _u, _c = env
    h, _eid, pay = _waiting_pay(api, member)
    st, d, _ = call(api, "GET", "/payments", h)
    assert d["items"][0]["id"] == pay.id and d["items"][0]["has_photo"]
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", f"/payments/{pay.id}", h,
                    {"action": "approve"})
    assert st == 200
    assert api.payrepo.get(pay.id).status == "paid"
    assert any(chat == member.bale_id for _k, chat, _ in bale.sent)
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", f"/payments/{pay.id}", h,
                    {"action": "approve"})
    assert st == 409 and d["error"] == "already_paid"


def test_pay_reject_reopens(env):
    api, bale, _ow, _or, member, _u, _c = env
    h, _eid, pay = _waiting_pay(api, member)
    st, _d, _ = call(api, "POST", f"/payments/{pay.id}", h,
                     {"action": "reject"})
    assert st == 200
    assert api.payrepo.get(pay.id).status == "open"
    assert any(kind == "text" and chat == member.bale_id
               for kind, chat, _ in bale.sent)


def test_pay_photo_and_receipt(env, monkeypatch):
    api, bale, _ow, _or, member, _u, _c = env
    h, _eid, pay = _waiting_pay(api, member)
    call(api, "POST", f"/payments/{pay.id}", h, {"action": "approve"})
    st, data, kind = call(api, "GET", f"/payments/{pay.id}/photo", h)
    assert st == 404 and data["error"] == "no_file"
    bale.files["F-1"] = b"jpegdata"
    st, data, kind = call(api, "GET", f"/payments/{pay.id}/photo", h)
    assert st == 200 and data == b"jpegdata" and kind == "bytes:image/jpeg"
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", f"/payments/{pay.id}/receipt", h)
    assert st == 200
    assert any(kind == "photo" and chat == member.bale_id
               for kind, chat, _ in bale.sent)

    api, _bale, _ow, organizer, member, _u, _c = env

    # organizer نبیند/نتواند تنظیمات را عوض کند؟ دیدن آزاد، تغییر ممنوع

    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", "/settings", ho, {"card_number": "1"})

    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", "/settings", h, {"pay_methods": ["hack"]})

def test_approvals_flow(env):
    api, _b, _ow, organizer, member, urepo, _c = env
    api.profile.apply(member, full_name="عضو تازه")
    h = login(api, 111)
    st, d, _ = call(api, "GET", "/approvals", h)
    assert st == 200 and len(d["items"]) == 1
    item = d["items"][0]
    assert item["new"] == "عضو تازه"
    ho = login(api, 222)
    st, d, _ = call(api, "GET", "/approvals", ho)
    assert st == 403          # organizer تأییدکننده نیست (آینهٔ بات)
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", "/approvals", h,
                    {"id": item["id"], "accept": True})
    assert st == 200
    assert urepo.get(member.id).full_name == "عضو تازه"
    st, d, _ = call(api, "POST", "/approvals", h,
                    {"id": item["id"], "accept": True})
    assert st == 404

def test_tickets_reply_close(env):
    api, bale, _ow, _or, member, _u, _c = env
    tk = api.suprepo.create(member.id, "سوال دارم")
    api.suprepo.add_msg(tk.id, "admin", "بفرمایید")
    h = login(api, 111)
    st, d, _ = call(api, "GET", "/tickets", h)

function ic(name) {
  return '<svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="' + P[name] + '"/></svg>';
}
function avatar(name, tone) {
  const ch = String(name || '؟').trim().charAt(0);
  return '<div class="av ' + (tone || '') + '">' + esc(ch) + '</div>';
}

function toast(msg) {
  const el = q('#toast');
  el.textContent = msg;
  el.classList.remove('hidden');
  clearTimeout(el._t);
  el._t = setTimeout(() => el.classList.add('hidden'), 2800);
}
function overlay(html) {
  const el = q('#overlay');
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="sheet"><div class="grabber"></div>' + html + '</div>';
  el.classList.remove('hidden');
  el.onclick = (e) => { if (e.target === el) overlayClose(); };
}
function overlayClose() { q('#overlay').classList.add('hidden'); q('#overlay').innerHTML = ''; }

/* ---------- لایهٔ بله (نسخه‌دار) ---------- */
const WA = (window.Bale && window.Bale.WebApp) || null;
const IN_BALE = !!(WA && WA.initData);

function verGE(v, want) {
  if (!v) return false;
  const a = String(v).split('.').map(Number), b = String(want).split('.').map(Number);
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.max(a.length, b.length); i++) {
    const x = a[i] || 0, y = b[i] || 0;
    if (x > y) return true;
    if (x < y) return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function waReady() { if (WA && verGE(WA.version, '1.0')) { try { WA.ready(); WA.expand(); } catch (e) { /* کلاینت قدیمی */ } } }
function backShow(on) {
  if (!WA || !verGE(WA.version, '1.0') || !WA.BackButton) return;
  try { on ? WA.BackButton.show() : WA.BackButton.hide(); } catch (e) { /* بی‌صدا */ }
}
function applyTheme() {
  let scheme = 'light';
  if (WA && WA.colorScheme) scheme = WA.colorScheme;
  else if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) scheme = 'dark';
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = scheme;
}

/* ---------- API ---------- */
let SESSION = store.get('nora_panel_sess');
let DEVLOGIN = store.get('nora_panel_dev');

async function raw(method, path, body, withSession) {
  const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
  if (withSession && SESSION) headers['x-session'] = SESSION;
  if (DEVLOGIN) headers['x-dev-login'] = DEVLOGIN;
  const resp = await fetch('/api' + path, { method, headers, body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined });
  let data = null;
  try { data = await resp.json(); } catch (e) { data = null; }
  if (!resp.ok || !data || !data.ok) throw { code: (resp.status === 401 ? 'unauthorized' : null) || (data && data.error) || 'generic' };
  return data;
}
const req = (m, p, b) => raw(m, p, b, true);
const errText = (code) => I.err[code] || I.err.generic;

function devPrompt() {
  overlay(
    '<div style="text-align:center;padding:8px 4px 4px">' +
    '<div style="width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:18px;margin:0 auto 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent-line)">' + ic('logout') + '</div>' +
    '<div style="font-weight:800;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:2px">' + esc(I.login.title) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="muted" style="margin-bottom:14px">' + esc(I.login.sub) + '</div>' +
    '<label class="fld" style="text-align:right"><span class="lb">' + esc(I.login.dev) + '</span>' +
    '<input type="text" id="dev-id" inputmode="numeric" value="' + esc(DEVLOGIN) + '"></label>' +
    '<button class="btn primary wide" id="dev-go">' + esc(I.login.go) + '</button>' +
    '</div>'
  );
  q('#dev-go').onclick = async () => {
    const v = (q('#dev-id').value || '').trim();
    if (!v) return;
    DEVLOGIN = v; store.set('nora_panel_dev', v);
    overlayClose();
    await boot(true);
  };
}
