let ME = null;
let QUEUES = { approvals: 0, payments: 0, tickets: 0 };
let EV_FILTER = 'all';
let FIN_DAYS = '30';

const TABS = [
  { key: 'dash', hash: '#/dash', icon: 'home' },
  { key: 'events', hash: '#/events', icon: 'cal' },
  { key: 'pays', hash: '#/pays', icon: 'card' },
  { key: 'tix', hash: '#/tix', icon: 'chat' },
  { key: 'more', hash: '#/more', icon: 'grid' },
];

function tabbar() {
  const h = location.hash;
  const on = (t) => h.startsWith(t.hash) ||
    (t.key === 'pays' && h.startsWith('#/fin')) ||
    (t.key === 'events' && (h.startsWith('#/event') || h.startsWith('#/evnew'))) ||
    (t.key === 'more' && (h.startsWith('#/users') || h.startsWith('#/user') || h.startsWith('#/aprs') || h.startsWith('#/sets') || h.startsWith('#/rep')));
  q('#tabbar').innerHTML = TABS.map((t) => {
    const badge = t.key === 'pays' && QUEUES.payments ? '<span class="badge">' + faNum(QUEUES.payments) + '</span>'
      : t.key === 'tix' && QUEUES.tickets ? '<span class="badge">' + faNum(QUEUES.tickets) + '</span>' : '';
    return '<button class="tab' + (on(t) ? ' on' : '') + '" data-go="' + t.hash + '">' + ic(t.icon) +
      '<span>' + esc(I.tabs[t.key]) + '</span>' + badge + '</button>';
  }).join('');
}

function route() {
  const h = location.hash || '#/dash';
  const parts = h.replace('#/', '').split('/');
  backShow(parts[0] !== 'dash');
  tabbar();
  const map = {
    dash: sDash, events: sEvents, evnew: sEventNew, event: () => sEvent(parts[1]),
    pays: sPays, fin: sFin, tix: () => parts[1] ? sTicket(parts[1]) : sTickets(),
    users: sUsers, user: () => sUser(parts[1]), aprs: sAprs, sets: sSets,
    rep: sReport, more: sMore,
  };
  const fn = map[parts[0]] || sDash;
  fn().catch((e) => {
    if (e && e.code === 'unauthorized') { boot(true); return; }
    setView('<div class="card"><div class="empty">' + ic('bolt') + '<div>' + esc(errText(e && e.code)) + '</div></div>' +
      '<button class="btn wide" data-act="reload">' + ic('refresh') + esc(I.retry) + '</button></div>');
  });
}

function setView(html) { q('#view').innerHTML = html; }
function loading() { setView('<div class="loading"></div>'); }
function head(title, right) {
  return '<div class="section-head"><h2>' + esc(title) + '</h2>' + (right || '') + '</div>';
}
function emptyBox() { return '<div class="empty">' + ic('archive') + '<div>' + esc(I.empty) + '</div></div>'; }

/* ---------- صفحه‌ها ---------- */
async function sDash() {
  loading();
  const d = await req('GET', '/dashboard');
  QUEUES = d.queues;
  tabbar();
  q('#top-title').innerHTML = '<span class="dot"></span>' + esc(I.app);
  const stat = (i, v, k, tone, n) =>
    '<div class="stat ' + (tone || '') + '" style="--i:' + n + '"><div class="ic-chip">' + ic(i) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="v">' + esc(v) + '</div><div class="k">' + esc(k) + '</div></div>';
  const per = Object.keys(d.income_30d.per).map((k) =>
    '<div class="kv"><span class="k">' + ic('wallet') + esc(k) + '</span><span class="v">' +
    esc(d.income_30d.per[k].amount) + ' · ' + esc(d.income_30d.per[k].count) + '</span></div>').join('');
  const qbtn = (go, icon, label, n, tone) =>
    '<button class="btn sm" data-go="' + go + '">' + ic(icon) + esc(label) + ' · ' + faNum(n) + '</button>';
  setView(
    '<div class="grid2">' +
    stat('users', d.users_total, I.dash.users, '', 0) +
    stat('plus', d.users_new_today, I.dash.newToday, 'info', 1) +
    stat('cal', d.events_upcoming, I.dash.upcoming, 'gold', 2) +
    stat('chart', d.income_30d.total, I.dash.income30, '', 3) +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="card" style="--i:4"><div class="card-title">' + ic('clip') + esc(I.dash.queues) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="btnrow">' +
    qbtn('#/aprs', 'users', I.dash.approvals, d.queues.approvals) +
    qbtn('#/pays', 'card', I.dash.payments, d.queues.payments) +
    qbtn('#/tix', 'chat', I.dash.tickets, d.queues.tickets) +
    '</div></div>' +
    (per ? '<div class="card" style="--i:5"><div class="card-title">' + ic('wallet') + esc(I.dash.perMethod) + '</div>' + per + '</div>' : '') +
    (d.next_event ?
      '<div class="card row click" data-go="#/event/' + d.next_event.id + '" style="--i:6;border-bottom:none">' +
      '<div class="av gold">' + ic('cal') + '</div>' +
      '<div class="main"><div class="t1">' + esc(d.next_event.title) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="t2">' + esc(d.next_event.when) + '</div></div>' +
      '<div class="chev">' + ic('chev') + '</div></div>' : '')
  );
}

const EV_FILTERS = ['all', 'upcoming', 'past', 'draft', 'published', 'closed', 'finished', 'cancelled'];
async function sEvents() {
  loading();
  const d = await req('GET', '/events?filter=' + encodeURIComponent(EV_FILTER));
  const chips = EV_FILTERS.map((f) =>
    '<span class="chip tap' + (f === EV_FILTER ? ' accent' : '') + '" data-act="evfilter" data-f="' + f + '">' + esc(I.ev.filters[f]) + '</span>').join('');
  const rows = d.items.map((e, n) =>
    '<div class="row click" data-go="#/event/' + e.id + '">' +
    avatar(e.title, n % 3 === 1 ? 'gold' : n % 3 === 2 ? 'info' : '') +
    '<div class="main"><div class="t1">' + esc(e.title) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="t2">' + esc(e.when) + ' · ' + esc(e.kind_fa) + ' · ' + esc(e.seats) + '/' + esc(e.capacity) + '</div></div>' +
    '<div class="side"><span class="chip ' + statusChip(e.status) + '">' + esc(e.status_fa) + '</span>' +
    '<span class="muted" style="font-size:10.5px">' + esc(e.income) + '</span></div>' +
    '<div class="chev">' + ic('chev') + '</div></div>').join('');
  setView(head(I.ev.title) +
    '<div class="filterbar">' + chips + '</div>' +
    '<div class="card" style="--i:1">' + (rows || emptyBox()) + '</div>' +
    '<button class="fab" data-go="#/evnew">' + ic('plus') + '</button>');
}
function statusChip(st) {
  return { published: 'accent', draft: 'gold', closed: 'info', finished: '', cancelled: 'danger' }[st] || '';
}

async function sEvent(id) {
  loading();
  const d = await req('GET', '/events/' + id);
  const ev = d.event;
  const acts = [];
  if (ev.status === 'draft') acts.push(['publish', 'published', 'primary']);
  if (ev.status === 'published') { acts.push(['close', 'closed', '']); acts.push(['finish', 'finished', 'gold']); }
  if (ev.status === 'closed') acts.push(['reopen', 'published', 'primary']);
  if (ev.status !== 'cancelled' && ev.status !== 'finished') acts.push(['cancel', 'cancelled', 'danger']);
  const actBtns = acts.map((a) => '<button class="btn sm ' + a[2] + '" data-act="evstatus" data-id="' + ev.id + '" data-v="' + a[1] + '">' + esc(I.ev.detail.acts[a[0]]) + '</button>').join('');
  const counts = Object.keys(d.report.counts).map((k) =>
    '<div class="kv"><span class="k">' + esc(k) + '</span><span class="v">' + esc(d.report.counts[k]) + '</span></div>').join('');
  const arcItems = d.archive_items.map((a) =>
    '<div class="row"><div class="av info">' + ic('archive') + '</div>' +
    '<div class="main"><div class="t1">' + esc(a.title) + '</div></div></div>').join('');
  const regs = d.regs.map((r) => {
    let btns = '';
    if (r.status === 'pending_approval') {
      btns = '<button class="btn sm primary" data-act="reg" data-id="' + r.reg_id + '" data-v="approve">' + ic('check') + '</button> ' +
        '<button class="btn sm danger" data-act="reg" data-id="' + r.reg_id + '" data-v="reject">' + ic('x') + '</button>';
    } else if (r.status === 'pending_pay') {
      btns = '<button class="btn sm gold" data-act="reg" data-id="' + r.reg_id + '" data-v="onsite">' + ic('wallet') + esc(I.ev.detail.onsite) + '</button>';
    }
    return '<div class="row">' + avatar(r.name) +
      '<div class="main"><div class="t1">' + esc(r.name) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="t2">' + esc(r.status_fa) + (r.ticket !== '—' ? ' · ' + esc(I.ev.detail.ticket) + ' ' + esc(r.ticket) : '') + ' · ' + esc(r.amount) + '</div></div>' +
      '<div class="side" style="flex-direction:row;align-items:center">' + btns + '</div></div>';
  }).join('');
  setView('<div class="back-line"><button class="btn sm" data-go="#/events">' + ic('back') + esc(I.back) + '</button></div>' +
    '<div class="card" style="--i:0"><div class="section-head" style="margin:0"><h2 style="font-size:17px">' + esc(ev.title) + '</h2>' +
    '<span class="chip ' + statusChip(ev.status) + '">' + esc(ev.status_fa) + '</span></div>' +
    '<div class="muted" style="margin-bottom:8px">' + esc(ev.when) + ' · ' + esc(ev.kind_fa) + '</div>' +
    (ev.desc ? '<div style="margin-bottom:10px;font-size:13px">' + esc(ev.desc) + '</div>' : '') +
    '<div class="kv"><span class="k">' + ic('loc') + esc(I.ev.detail.where) + '</span><span class="v">' + esc(ev.loc_address !== '—' ? ev.loc_address : ev.online_link) + '</span></div>' +
    '<div class="kv"><span class="k">' + ic('users') + esc(I.ev.detail.cap) + '</span><span class="v">' + esc(ev.capacity) + '</span></div>' +
    '<div class="kv"><span class="k">' + ic('wallet') + esc(I.ev.detail.price) + '</span><span class="v">' + esc(ev.price) + '</span></div>' +
    (actBtns ? '<div class="btnrow" style="margin-top:12px">' + actBtns + '</div>' : '') +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="card" style="--i:1"><div class="card-title">' + ic('chart') + esc(I.ev.detail.report) + '</div>' + counts +
    '<div class="kv"><span class="k">' + esc(I.ev.detail.income) + '</span><span class="v">' + esc(d.report.revenue) + '</span></div>' +
    '<div class="kv"><span class="k">' + esc(I.ev.detail.refund) + '</span><span class="v">' + esc(d.report.refund) + '</span></div>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="card" style="--i:2"><div class="card-title">' + ic('palette') + esc(I.ev.detail.theme) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="filterbar">' + ev.themes.map((th) =>
      '<span class="chip tap' + (th === (ev.ticket_theme || 'glass') ? ' accent' : '') + '" data-act="evtheme" data-id="' + ev.id + '" data-v="' + esc(th) + '">' + esc(th) + '</span>').join('') + '</div>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="card" style="--i:3"><div class="card-title">' + ic('archive') + esc(I.ev.detail.archive) + '</div>' +
    '<label class="fld"><span class="lb">' + esc(I.ev.detail.archive) + '</span><select id="a-acc">' +
    ['registered', 'paid', 'open'].map((a) => '<option value="' + a + '"' + (ev.archive_access === a ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(I.ev.detail.acc[a]) + '</option>').join('') +
    '</select></label>' +
    '<label class="fld"><span class="lb">' + esc(I.ev.detail.arcPrice) + '</span><input type="number" id="a-price" value="' + esc(ev.archive_price) + '" min="0"></label>' +
    '<button class="btn sm wide" data-act="evarc" data-id="' + ev.id + '">' + ic('check') + esc(I.save) + '</button>' +
    (arcItems ? '<div style="margin-top:10px"><div class="card-title">' + esc(I.ev.detail.arcItems) + '</div>' + arcItems + '</div>' : '') +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="card" style="--i:4"><div class="card-title">' + ic('mega') + esc(I.ev.detail.notify) + '</div>' +
    '<label class="fld"><textarea id="n-text" placeholder="' + esc(I.ev.detail.notifyPh) + '"></textarea></label>' +
    '<button class="btn sm wide" data-act="evnotify" data-id="' + ev.id + '">' + ic('send') + esc(I.ev.detail.notifySend) + '</button>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="card" style="--i:5"><div class="card-title">' + ic('users') + esc(I.ev.detail.regs) + '</div>' +
    (regs || emptyBox()) + '</div>');
}

async function sUsers() {
  setView(head(I.users.title) +
    '<div class="card" style="--i:0"><div class="search-wrap">' + ic('search') +
    '<input type="text" id="u-q" placeholder="' + esc(I.users.search) + '"></div>' +
    '<div id="u-list"></div></div>');
  const input = q('#u-q');
  let tm = 0;
  input.oninput = () => {
    clearTimeout(tm);
    tm = setTimeout(async () => {
      const v = input.value.trim();
      if (!v) { q('#u-list').innerHTML = ''; return; }
      try {
        const d = await req('GET', '/users?q=' + encodeURIComponent(v));
        q('#u-list').innerHTML = d.items.map((u) =>
          '<div class="row click" data-go="#/user/' + u.id + '">' + avatar(u.name) +
          '<div class="main"><div class="t1">' + esc(u.name) + '</div>' +
          '<div class="t2">' + esc(u.role_fa) + ' · ' + esc(u.city) + '</div></div>' +
          '<span class="chip">' + esc(u.status_fa) + '</span>' +
          '<div class="chev">' + ic('chev') + '</div></div>').join('') || emptyBox();
      } catch (e) { toast(errText(e.code)); }
    }, 350);
  };
}

/* ---------- اکشن‌ها ---------- */
document.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
  const go = e.target.closest('[data-go]');
  if (go) { location.hash = go.dataset.go; return; }
  const act = e.target.closest('[data-act]');
  if (!act) return;
  const a = act.dataset.act, id = act.dataset.id, v = act.dataset.v;
  try {
    if (a === 'reload') { route(); return; }
    if (a === 'histback') { history.back(); return; }
    if (a === 'logout') {
      SESSION = ''; store.set('nora_panel_sess', ''); ME = null;
      boot(true); return;
    }
    if (a === 'devlogin') { devPrompt(); return; }
    if (a === 'evfilter') { EV_FILTER = v; sEvents(); return; }
    if (a === 'findays') { FIN_DAYS = v; sFin(); return; }
    if (a === 'evcreate') {
      const body = {
        title: q('#f-title').value, desc: q('#f-desc').value, kind: q('#f-kind').value,
        date: q('#f-date').value, time: q('#f-time').value,
        capacity: Number(q('#f-cap').value || 0), price: Number(q('#f-price').value || 0),
        loc_type: q('#f-loc').value, loc_address: q('#f-addr').value, online_link: q('#f-link').value,
      };
      const r = await req('POST', '/events', body);
      toast(I.saved);
      location.hash = '#/event/' + r.id;
      return;
    }
    if (a === 'evstatus') { await req('POST', '/events/' + id, { status: v }); toast(I.saved); sEvent(id); return; }
    if (a === 'evtheme') { await req('POST', '/events/' + id, { ticket_theme: v }); toast(I.saved); sEvent(id); return; }
    if (a === 'evarc') {
      await req('POST', '/events/' + id, { archive_access: q('#a-acc').value, archive_price: Number(q('#a-price').value || 0) });
      toast(I.saved); sEvent(id); return;
    }
    if (a === 'evnotify') {
      const text = q('#n-text').value.trim();
      if (!text) return;
      const r = await req('POST', '/events/' + id + '/notify', { text });
      toast('برای ' + r.sent + ' نفر ارسال شد.');
      q('#n-text').value = '';
      return;
    }
    if (a === 'reg') { await req('POST', '/regs/' + id, { action: v }); toast(v === 'reject' ? I.pay.rejected : I.done); route(); return; }
    if (a === 'pay') { await req('POST', '/payments/' + id, { action: v }); toast(v === 'approve' ? I.done : I.pay.rejected); sPays(); return; }
    if (a === 'receipt') { await req('POST', '/payments/' + id + '/receipt'); toast(I.pay.receiptSent); return; }
    if (a === 'photo') {
      const resp = await fetch('/api/payments/' + id + '/photo', { headers: SESSION ? { 'x-session': SESSION } : {} });
      if (!resp.ok) { toast(errText('no_file')); return; }
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(await resp.blob());
      overlay('<img src="' + url + '" alt="receipt"><div style="height:12px"></div>' +
        '<button class="btn wide" data-act="ovclose">' + ic('x') + esc(I.back) + '</button>');
      return;
    }
    if (a === 'ovclose') { overlayClose(); return; }
    if (a === 'apr') { await req('POST', '/approvals', { id: Number(id), accept: v === '1' }); toast(I.done); sAprs(); return; }
    if (a === 'tixreply') {
      const text = q('#t-reply').value.trim();
      if (!text) return;
      await req('POST', '/tickets/' + id, { action: 'reply', text });
      toast(I.tix.sent); sTicket(id); return;
    }
    if (a === 'tixclose') { await req('POST', '/tickets/' + id, { action: 'close' }); toast(I.tix.closed); sTicket(id); return; }
    if (a === 'sw') {
      if (!q('#view').dataset.canEdit) { toast(errText('forbidden')); return; }
      const key = act.dataset.key;
      const cur = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-act="sw"][data-key="' + key + '"]')]
        .filter((el) => el.classList.contains('on')).map((el) => el.dataset.v);
      const next = act.classList.contains('on') ? cur.filter((x) => x !== v) : cur.concat([v]);
      const body = {}; body[key] = next;
      await req('POST', '/settings', body);
      act.classList.toggle('on');
      return;
    }
    if (a === 'card') { await req('POST', '/settings', { card_number: q('#s-card').value }); toast(I.saved); return; }
  } catch (err) {
    if (err && err.code === 'unauthorized') { boot(true); return; }
    toast(errText(err && err.code));
  }
});

/* ---------- راه‌اندازی ---------- */
function loginFail(e) {
  setView('<div class="card"><div class="empty">' + ic('bolt') + '<div>' + esc(errText(e && e.code)) + '</div></div>' +
    '<button class="btn wide" data-act="devlogin">' + ic('logout') + esc(I.login.viaDev) + '</button></div>');
}

async function boot(relogin) {
  applyTheme();
  waReady();
  if (WA && WA.BackButton && verGE(WA.version, '1.0')) {
    try { WA.BackButton.onClick(() => history.back()); } catch (e) { /* بی‌صدا */ }
  }
  if (WA && WA.onEvent) {
    try { WA.onEvent('themeChanged', applyTheme); } catch (e) { /* بی‌صدا */ }
  }
  if (!SESSION || relogin) {
    if (!IN_BALE) { devPrompt(); return; }   // بیرون از بله: حالت توسعه
    loading();
    try {
      const r = await req('POST', '/login', { initData: WA.initData });
      SESSION = r.session; store.set('nora_panel_sess', SESSION);
      ME = { name: r.name, role_fa: r.role_fa };
      q('#top-role').textContent = r.role_fa;
    } catch (e) { loginFail(e); return; }
  }
  if (!ME) {
    try {
      ME = await req('GET', '/me');
      q('#top-role').textContent = ME.role_fa;
    } catch (e) {
      if (e && e.code === 'unauthorized') { SESSION = ''; return boot(true); }
    }
  }
  if (!location.hash) location.hash = '#/dash';
  route();
}

So, what's needed is a major design overhaul of the mockup board:

More authentic iOS 26 Liquid Glass aesthetics. What is iOS 26 Liquid Glass? Announced at WWDC 2025: a translucent material "Liquid Glass" — floating glass layers, lens-like refraction, specular highlights, adaptive tinting, concentric corner radii, pill-shaped/rounded floating controls (tab bar floats as a glass capsule), large rounded corners, depth through blur + refraction, vibrant colors showing through the glass, minimal hairlines. Key visual elements: glass capsule toolbars, controls that look like thick polished glass with bright edge highlights, background content visible through the glass, more "gel"-like rather than flat semi-transparent white cards.
How to achieve a convincing liquid glass in static HTML/CSS:

Layered backgrounds with colorful, soft gradients (photos/gradients behind the glass make the glass stand out. On a flat beige, glass looks flat).
Stronger blur + saturation + brightness adjustments on glass elements.
Specular edge highlights: border-image or multiple box-shadows — bright inner top-left, subtle outer.
Slight tint gradient inside glass elements (linear-gradient at an angle with rgba white stripes).
Floating capsule-shaped tab bar with icons that have a "pill" highlight for the active state.
Concentric rounded corners: larger radius on the outside, smaller on nested elements.
Refraction effect: can be pseudo-reproduced with inset box-shadow + subtle radial highlights.
Headers: iOS 26 style — content scrolls under a transparent/glass bar. Large titles.
Buttons: glass capsules with highlights. Primary = accent-tinted glass (not flat solid green?). iOS 26 Liquid Glass buttons are semi-transparent and tinted.
Also, Persian typography that doesn't feel AI-generated: remove all English words: theme names glass/forest/… → Persian names (شیشه/جنگل/شن/شب/گل‌رز?). Actually, in the product the ticket themes have English keys, but in the mockup we should display Persian labels: «شیشه‌ای», «جنگلی», «شنی», «شب», «صورتی»… And dossier labels: «شناسه», «نام کاربری», «کد ملی». Status chips in Persian.

Countermeasures: realistic Persian microcopy, real data with variation, reduce decoration duplication, tighter hierarchy, human-like details (e.g., a row with a long title that gets truncated with ellipsis, mixed states, actual Jalali calendar dates/times).

python


"""Certificate engine — the third member of the glass family..."""
nora/services/certkit.py:
- A4 landscape 150dpi: W=1754, H=1240 (A4 landscape: 297×210mm → 1754×1240 @150dpi)
- ALPHABET = "23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ" (excluding 0, O, 1, I — nora1 pattern; also include digits? nora1: alphabet excluding O/0/I/1. Let's use digits 2-9 + letters excluding I, O)
- new_code(rng) → 8 characters
- number label: fa_num with separator? Certificate number = per-event serial number displayed as fa
- full_id(number, code) = f"{code}·{number}"? For QR and verification: "nora:c:{code}:{number}". parse_id validates it.
- render(holder, event_title, date_label, number, code, brand, labels, theme, note="", signer="") → Image (default glass A4 design v0)
- cert_path(...) sha1 cache var/certs/
- render_pdf(path) → save image as PDF (PIL: img.save(pdf_path, "PDF", resolution=150)) — A4! 1754px @150dpi = 11.69in = exactly A4 landscape.
- DOCX path:
  - PLACEHOLDERS = {"{نام}": holder, "{برنامه}": event_title, "{تاریخ}": date_label, "{شماره}": number_label, "{کد}": code, "{امضا}": signer, "{یادداشت}": note} — fixed small set (this is the "won't break / don't need to edit 100 times" fix: 7 stable placeholders, documented, unknown ones are left as-is)
  - fill_docx(template, values, out_path): python-docx; paragraphs including tables; replacement across multiple runs (merge runs of a paragraph into the first run's text and replace). QR marker "{کیوآر}" → replace the run with an inline image of the QR (generate QR to a temp png, add_run().add_picture(width=Mm(30))).
  - docx_to_png(docx_path, out_png): search for soffice/libreoffice → subprocess --headless --convert-to png; if not found, raise CertToolError with a Persian-language message.
  - Also a docx_to_pdf variant (convert-to pdf). For when the user needs a PDF from their Word template.
Robust run-merge algorithm:
```python
def _replace_in_paragraph(p, mapping):
    if not p.runs: return
    full = "".join(r.text for r in p.runs)
    hit = any(k in full for k in mapping)
    if not hit: return
    new = full
    for k, v in mapping.items(): new = new.replace(k, v)
    # Keep the formatting of the first non-empty run
    p.runs[0].text = new
    for r in p.runs[1:]: r.text = ""
```_
This merges the formatting of the entire paragraph into the first run — acceptable tradeoff for robustness (template designers style per paragraph; mixed styles within a single paragraph are lost). nora1's fragility came from 72 parameters and per-run acrobatics. Document this in the docstring.

QR paragraph: if full contains "{کیوآر}": delete all runs, add a run with an add_picture(BytesIO(qr_png), width=Mm(28)).

fill_docx never raises on unknown placeholders or missing values (values are pre-filled with "" — mapping is built from data fields; everything is always present).

full_id/parse:

python


def full_id(number: int, code: str) -> str:
    return f"nora:c:{number}:{code}"
def parse_id(payload: str):
    parts = (payload or "").strip().split(":")
    if len(parts) != 3 or parts[0] != "nora:c": return None
    try: number = int(parts[1])
    except ValueError: return None
    code = parts[2].upper()
    if not code or any(ch not in ALPHABET for ch in code): return None
    return number, code
new_code: rng.choice × CODE_LEN.

Uniqueness is handled at issuance time (repo). No problem.

LibreOffice subprocess:

python


def _soffice() -> str:
    for name in ("soffice", "libreoffice"):
        p = shutil.which(name)
        if p: return p
    raise CertToolError("...")
Persian message: «برای تبدیل قالب ورد، LibreOffice روی سرور لازم است (apt install libreoffice-writer). بدون آن، طرح شیشه‌ای پیش‌فرض کار می‌کند.» — user-facing error for admins, but raising in Persian is OK.

fill_docx:

python


def fill_docx(template, values, qr_payload, out):
    tpl = Path(template)
    if not tpl.exists(): raise CertToolError(f"قالب گواهی پیدا نشد: {tpl}")
    try: doc = docx.Document(str(tpl))
    except Exception as exc: raise CertToolError("قالب ورد خوانده نشد؛ فایل .docx سالم آپلود کنید") from exc
    qr_marker = "{کیوآر}"
    def handle_par(p):
        full = "".join(r.text for r in p.runs)
        if not full.strip(): return
        if qr_marker in full:
            for r in p.runs: r.text = ""
            run = p.add_run()
            run.add_picture(io.BytesIO(qr_png_bytes(qr_payload)), width=Mm(30))
            return
        new = full
        for k, v in values.items(): new = new.replace(k, v)
        if new != full:
            p.runs[0].text = new
            for r in p.runs[1:]: r.text = ""
    for p in doc.paragraphs: handle_par(p)
    for t in doc.tables:
        for row in t.rows:
            for cell in row.cells:
                for p in cell.paragraphs: handle_par(p)
    for sec in doc.sections:
        for p in list(sec.header.paragraphs) + list(sec.footer.paragraphs): handle_par(p)
    out = Path(out); out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    doc.save(str(out))
    return out
Note: no bare except (no_silent_except scanner) — except Exception as exc: raise ... from exc is a re-raise, should be fine? The scanner checks for silent excepts (except: pass). Re-raising is not silent.

values are built with str(v) — all strings.

qr_png_bytes: qrcode → BytesIO.

Edge case: p.runs is empty but text exists? If a paragraph has no runs, text is empty — no problem.

"""تست موتور گواهی: رندر شیشه‌ای A4، شناسهٔ دولایه، مسیر قالب ورد."""
import random

import pytest
from docx import Document

from nora.services import certkit as ck

LAB = {"title": "گواهی شرکت", "chip": "صادرشده", "holder": "به نام",
       "event": "برای شرکت در", "number": "شمارهٔ گواهی", "code": "کد گواهی",
       "signer": "امضا"}
BRAND = "خط زندگی"


def _data(**over):
    base = dict(holder="سارا محمدی", event="کارگاه آرامش ذهن",
                date="جمعه ۲۱ شهریور ۱۴۰۵", number=23, code="T4K7M9XZ",
                signer="دکتر رضایی")
    base.update(over)
    return ck.CertData(**base)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- رندر


def test_render_a4_landscape_deterministic():
    a = ck.render(_data(), LAB, BRAND)
    b = ck.render(_data(), LAB, BRAND)
    assert a.size == (ck.W, ck.H) == (1754, 1240)   # A4 افقی @150dpi
    assert a.tobytes() == b.tobytes()


def test_themes_render_distinct():
    a = ck.render(_data(theme="glass"), LAB, BRAND)
    b = ck.render(_data(theme="night"), LAB, BRAND)
    assert a.tobytes() != b.tobytes()


def test_minimal_fields_no_crash():
    img = ck.render(_data(signer="", note="", date=""), LAB, BRAND)
    assert img.size == (1754, 1240)


def test_cert_path_cache(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(ck, "_CACHE", tmp_path)
    p1 = ck.cert_path(_data(), LAB, BRAND)
    p2 = ck.cert_path(_data(), LAB, BRAND)
    assert p1 == p2
    assert len(list(tmp_path.glob("*.png"))) == 1
    p3 = ck.cert_path(_data(code="Z9Y8X7W6"), LAB, BRAND)
    assert p3 != p1


def test_to_pdf_a4(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(ck, "_CACHE", tmp_path)
    png = ck.cert_path(_data(), LAB, BRAND)
    pdf = ck.to_pdf(png)
    assert pdf.endswith(".pdf")
    assert Path_bytes(pdf).startswith(b"%PDF")
    assert ck.to_pdf(png) == pdf    # کش


def Path_bytes(p):
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        return f.read(8)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- شناسه


def test_code_unambiguous_alphabet():
    rng = random.Random(7)
    codes = {ck.new_code(rng) for _ in range(500)}
    assert len(codes) == 500
    for c in codes:
        assert len(c) == ck.CODE_LEN
        assert all(ch in ck.ALPHABET for ch in c)
        assert not (set(c) & set("0O1I"))


def test_full_id_roundtrip():
    pid = ck.full_id(23, "T4K7M9XZ")
    assert ck.parse_id(pid) == (23, "T4K7M9XZ")
    assert ck.parse_id(pid.lower().replace("t4k7m9xz", "t4k7m9xz")) == \
        (23, "T4K7M9XZ")


def test_parse_id_rejects_bad():
    assert ck.parse_id("nora:c:23:T4K7M9X0") is None   # 0 ممنوع
    assert ck.parse_id("nora:c:x:T4K7M9XZ") is None
    assert ck.parse_id("nora:r:23:T4K7M9XZ") is None   # رسید، نه گواهی
    assert ck.parse_id("junk") is None
    assert ck.parse_id("") is None
    assert ck.parse_id("nora:c:23:SHORT") is None


def test_values_for_always_complete():
    v = ck.values_for(_data())
    assert set(v) == {"{نام}", "{برنامه}", "{تاریخ}", "{شماره}", "{کد}",
                      "{امضا}", "{یادداشت}"}
    assert all(isinstance(x, str) for x in v.values())
    assert v["{شماره}"] == "۲۳"
    v2 = ck.values_for(_data(holder="", signer=""), number_label="۱۲/الف")
    assert v2["{نام}"] == "" and v2["{شماره}"] == "۱۲/الف"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- مسیر ورد


def _make_template(path):
    doc = Document()
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    p.add_run("گواهی ")          # نشانگر عمداً بین runها شکسته
    p.add_run("{نا")
    p.add_run("م}")
    doc.add_paragraph("{برنامه} — {تاریخ}")
    doc.add_paragraph("{ناشناخته} بماند")
    doc.add_paragraph("{کیوآر}")
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    t.rows[0].cells[0].paragraphs[0].add_run("{کد}")
    doc.sections[0].header.paragraphs[0].add_run("شماره: {شماره}")
    doc.save(str(path))
    return path


def test_fill_docx_full(tmp_path):
    tpl = _make_template(tmp_path / "tpl.docx")
    out = ck.fill_docx(tpl, _data(), tmp_path / "out.docx")
    doc = Document(str(out))
    texts = [p.text for p in doc.paragraphs]
    assert texts[0] == "گواهی سارا محمدی"           # run شکسته درست شد
    assert "کارگاه آرامش ذهن" in texts[1] and "۲۱ شهریور" in texts[1]
    assert any("{ناشناخته}" in t for t in texts)    # ناشناخته دست‌نخورده
    assert len(doc.inline_shapes) == 1              # کیوآر جای‌گذاری شد
    assert doc.tables[0].rows[0].cells[0].text == "T4K7M9XZ"
    assert "۲۳" in doc.sections[0].header.paragraphs[0].text


def test_fill_docx_missing_template(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(ck.CertToolError):
        ck.fill_docx(tmp_path / "nope.docx", _data(), tmp_path / "o.docx")


def test_word_path_without_soffice(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(ck.shutil, "which", lambda name: None)
    tpl = _make_template(tmp_path / "tpl.docx")
    monkeypatch.setattr(ck, "_CACHE", tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(ck.CertToolError) as ei:
        ck.docx_to_png(tpl)
    assert "LibreOffice" in str(ei.value)
    with pytest.raises(ck.CertToolError):
        ck.word_cert_path(tpl, _data())

values_for(data, extra=None):
python


vals = {
 "{نام}": data.holder or "",
 "{برنامه}": data.event or "",
 "{تاریخ_برنامه}": data.date or "",
 "{تاریخ_صدور}": data.issued or "",
 "{شماره}": fa_num(data.number),
 "{شماره_یکتا}": data.code or "",
 "{کد}": data.code or "",   # alias for word templates
 "{تاریخ}": data.date or "",  # alias
 "{امضا}": data.signer or "",
 "{سمت}": data.signer_role or "",
 "{یادداشت}": data.note or "",
}
for k, v in (extra or {}).items():
    vals[k if k.startswith("{") else "{%s}" % k] = str(v)
return vals
Aliases maintain word-template compatibility ({کد} and {شماره_یکتا}, {تاریخ} and {تاریخ_برنامه}).

"""تست موتور گواهی: چیدمان JSON، رندر A4، شناسهٔ دولایه، مسیر قالب ورد."""
import json
import random

import pytest
from docx import Document
from PIL import Image

from nora.services import certkit as ck


def _data(**over):
    base = dict(holder="سارا محمدی", event="کارگاه آرامش ذهن",
                date="جمعه ۲۱ شهریور ۱۴۰۵", number=23, code="T4K7M9XZ",
                signer="دکتر رضایی", signer_role="مدیر گروه",
                issued="۲۲ شهریور ۱۴۰۵")
    base.update(over)
    return ck.CertData(**base)


def _tiny_png(path, color=(200, 60, 60)):
    Image.new("RGBA", (40, 40), color + (255,)).save(str(path))
    return str(path)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- شناسه


def test_code_unambiguous_alphabet():
    rng = random.Random(7)
    codes = {ck.new_code(rng) for _ in range(500)}
    assert len(codes) == 500
    for c in codes:
        assert len(c) == ck.CODE_LEN
        assert all(ch in ck.ALPHABET for ch in c)
        assert not (set(c) & set("0O1I"))


def test_full_id_roundtrip():
    pid = ck.full_id(23, "T4K7M9XZ")
    assert ck.parse_id(pid) == (23, "T4K7M9XZ")
    assert ck.parse_id("nora:c:23:t4k7m9xz") == (23, "T4K7M9XZ")  # lowercase


def test_parse_id_rejects_bad():
    assert ck.parse_id("nora:c:23:T4K7M9X0") is None   # 0 ممنوع
    assert ck.parse_id("nora:c:x:T4K7M9XZ") is None
    assert ck.parse_id("nora:r:23:T4K7M9XZ") is None   # رسید، نه گواهی
    assert ck.parse_id("junk") is None
    assert ck.parse_id("") is None
    assert ck.parse_id("nora:c:23:SHORT") is None


def test_values_for_complete_and_extra():
    v = ck.values_for(_data())
    for k in ("{نام}", "{برنامه}", "{تاریخ_برنامه}", "{تاریخ}",
              "{تاریخ_صدور}", "{شماره}", "{شماره_یکتا}", "{کد}",
              "{امضا}", "{سمت}", "{یادداشت}"):
        assert isinstance(v[k], str)
    assert v["{شماره}"] == "۲۳"
    v2 = ck.values_for(_data(), extra={"دوره": "پیشرفته", "{ساعت}": "۱۶"})
    assert v2["{دوره}"] == "پیشرفته" and v2["{ساعت}"] == "۱۶"
    v3 = ck.values_for(_data(holder=""), number_label="۱۲/الف")
    assert v3["{نام}"] == "" and v3["{شماره}"] == "۱۲/الف"


def test_fill_text_unknown_stays():
    v = ck.values_for(_data())
    assert ck.fill_text("{نام} و {ناشناخته}", v) == "سارا محمدی و {ناشناخته}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- چیدمان و رندر


def test_render_a4_landscape_deterministic():
    a = ck.render(_data())
    b = ck.render(_data())
    assert a.size == (ck.W, ck.H) == (1754, 1240)   # A4 افقی @150dpi
    assert a.tobytes() == b.tobytes()


def test_theme_override():
    a = ck.render(_data())
    b = ck.render(_data(), theme="night")
    assert a.tobytes() != b.tobytes()


def test_layout_tolerant_of_junk():
    bad = {"عناصر": [
        {"نوع": "متن", "متن": "سلام", "x": "abc", "y": None,
         "اندازه": -5},
        {"نوع": "چیزناشناخته"},
        {"نوع": "تصویر", "مسیر": "nope.png"},
        {"نوع": "لوگوها", "مسیرها": ["nope2.png", 3]},
        {"نوع": "کیوآر", "اندازه": "خیلی"},
        {"نوع": "نشان", "ارتفاع": "x"},
        {"نوع": "پرچم", "عرض": None},
        {"نوع": "خط", "عرض": 999, "رنگ": "#zzzzzz"},
        None,
        {},
    ]}
    img = ck.render(_data(), layout=bad)
    assert img.size == (1754, 1240)


def test_all_element_types_render(tmp_path):
    l1 = _tiny_png(tmp_path / "a.png")
    l2 = _tiny_png(tmp_path / "b.png", (60, 90, 200))
    lay = {"پوسته": "gold", "عناصر": [
        {"نوع": "متن", "متن": "{نام}\n{دوره}", "x": 50, "y": 40,
         "اندازه": 60, "تراز": "وسط", "حداکثر_عرض": 80},
        {"نوع": "تصویر", "مسیر": l1, "ارتفاع": 60, "x": 10, "y": 10},
        {"نوع": "لوگوها", "مسیرها": [l1, l2], "ارتفاع": 50, "x": 90,
         "y": 10, "تراز": "راست"},
        {"نوع": "کیوآر", "اندازه": 140, "x": 90, "y": 70, "تراز": "راست",

def test_load_layout_errors(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(ck.CertToolError):
        ck.load_layout(tmp_path / "nope.json")
    bad = tmp_path / "bad.json"
    bad.write_text("{ نه جی‌سون", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(ck.CertToolError):
        ck.load_layout(bad)
    nokey = tmp_path / "nokey.json"
    nokey.write_text(json.dumps({"چیز": 1}, ensure_ascii=False),
                     encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(ck.CertToolError):
        ck.load_layout(nokey)


def test_override_layout_wins_and_cache_busts(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(ck, "_CACHE", tmp_path / "c")
    override = tmp_path / "custom.json"
    monkeypatch.setattr(ck, "_LAYOUT_OVERRIDE", override)
    lay = json.loads(ck._LAYOUT_DEFAULT.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    override.write_text(json.dumps(lay, ensure_ascii=False),
                        encoding="utf-8")
    assert ck.active_layout_path() == override
    p1 = ck.cert_path(_data())
    assert p1 == ck.cert_path(_data())          # کش
    lay["عناصر"][0]["متن"] = "عوض‌شده {نام}"
    override.write_text(json.dumps(lay, ensure_ascii=False),
                        encoding="utf-8")
    p2 = ck.cert_path(_data())
    assert p2 != p1                              # ویرایش چیدمان = کش تازه


def test_to_pdf_a4(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(ck, "_CACHE", tmp_path)
    png = ck.cert_path(_data())
    pdf = ck.to_pdf(png)
    with open(pdf, "rb") as f:
        assert f.read(5) == b"%PDF-"
    assert ck.to_pdf(png) == pdf

def _make_template(path):
    doc = Document()
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    p.add_run("گواهی ")          # نشانگر عمداً بین runها شکسته
    p.add_run("{نا")
    p.add_run("م}")
    doc.add_paragraph("{برنامه} — {تاریخ} · دوره: {دوره}")
    doc.add_paragraph("{ناشناخته} بماند")
    doc.add_paragraph("{کیوآر}")
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    t.rows[0].cells[0].paragraphs[0].add_run("{کد}")
    doc.sections[0].header.paragraphs[0].add_run("شماره: {شماره}")
    doc.save(str(path))
    return path


def test_fill_docx_full(tmp_path):
    tpl = _make_template(tmp_path / "tpl.docx")
    out = ck.fill_docx(tpl, _data(), tmp_path / "out.docx",
                       extra={"دوره": "پیشرفته"})
    doc = Document(str(out))
    texts = [p.text for p in doc.paragraphs]
    assert texts[0] == "گواهی سارا محمدی"           # run شکسته درست شد
    assert "کارگاه آرامش ذهن" in texts[1]
    assert "دوره: پیشرفته" in texts[1]              # متغیر دلخواه
    assert any("{ناشناخته}" in t for t in texts)    # ناشناخته دست‌نخورده
    assert len(doc.inline_shapes) == 1              # کیوآر جای‌گذاری شد
    assert doc.tables[0].rows[0].cells[0].text == "T4K7M9XZ"
    assert "۲۳" in doc.sections[0].header.paragraphs[0].text

def test_word_path_without_soffice(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

Thought for 5 seconds

The user is asking for a mathematical proof. Proposition: Every graph with n vertices and more than n−1 edges (i.e., at least n edges) contains a cycle. Equivalent proposition: An acyclic graph (forest) has at most n−1 edges. Proof by induction on n, or by contrapositive.

Standard proof: Contrapositive — if G is acyclic (a forest), then |E| ≤ n−1. Induction: An acyclic graph has a vertex of degree at most 1 (a leaf or an isolated vertex). Remove it.

Or a direct proof: Assume G has n vertices and |E| ≥ n. Take a maximal path... or use induction: remove a vertex... Let me craft a clean proof.

Proof (contrapositive, by induction on n): Claim: If G is an acyclic graph (forest) with n vertices, then |E(G)| ≤ n−1.

Base case: n = 1: 0 edges ≤ 0. True.

Inductive step: Let G be an acyclic graph with n ≥ 2 vertices. Lemma: G has a vertex of degree at most 1. Proof: If G has no edges, done (any vertex has degree 0). Otherwise, take a maximal path P = v_0 v_1 ... v_k (k ≥ 1). Since G is acyclic, the neighbors of v_0 are... Claim: deg(v_0) = 1. Suppose v_0 has a neighbor u ≠ v_1. If u is on P, then u = v_i (i ≥ 2), and v_0 v_1 ... v_i v_0 is a cycle, contradiction. If u is not on P, then u v_0 v_1 ... v_k is a longer path, contradicting maximality. Hence deg(v_0) = 1.

Now remove v_0 and its single edge: G' = G − v_0 is an acyclic graph with n−1 vertices, and by the induction hypothesis |E(G')| ≤ (n−1)−1 = n−2. Therefore |E(G)| = |E(G')| + 1 ≤ n−1. ∎

Hence, if G has n vertices and |E| > n−1, then G cannot be acyclic, so G contains a cycle. ∎

Might also mention the converse direction, or note that this bound is tight (a tree has exactly n−1 edges). Could also present a direct proof via DFS, but the induction-based one is cleanest.

Should I use tools? No — this is a pure math question. Answer directly in markdown. Use LaTeX? The harness renders GitHub-style markdown in the terminal — LaTeX might not render. Better to use plain-text math notation with Unicode. Keep it readable: use n, E, etc.

Structure:

Restate the proposition.
Prove the contrapositive by induction, with the lemma about leaves.
Conclude.
Note on tightness.
Concise and rigorous.

Implementation:

python


def _tinted(img, color):
    img = img.convert("RGBA")
    alpha = img.getchannel("A")
    if alpha.getextrema()[1] < 8:      # no alpha → derive from luminance
        alpha = img.convert("L").point(lambda v: 255 - v)
    flat = Image.new("RGBA", img.size, color)
    flat.putalpha(alpha)
    return flat

draw_qr flag-style:

python


def _draw_qr(out, d, el, pal, payload):
    box = int(_num(el, "اندازه", 150))
    pad = 14
    flaggy = bool(el.get("پرچمی", False))
    band = round(box * 0.16) if flaggy else 0
    cw = box + pad*2
    chh = box + pad*2 + band*2
    ... position x,y by anchor (y = top)
    chip = Image.new("RGBA",(cw,chh),(0,0,0,0))
    cd = ImageDraw.Draw(chip)
    cd.rounded_rectangle([0,0,cw-1,chh-1], 24, fill=(255,255,255,255))
    if flaggy:
        mask = Image.new("L",(cw,chh),0); ImageDraw.Draw(mask).rounded_rectangle([0,0,cw-1,chh-1],24,fill=255)
        bands = Image.new("RGBA",(cw,chh),(0,0,0,0))
        bd = ImageDraw.Draw(bands)
        bd.rectangle([0,0,cw,band], fill=_FLAG_GREEN)
        bd.rectangle([0,chh-band,cw,chh], fill=_FLAG_RED)
        bands.putalpha(ImageChops.multiply(bands.getchannel("A"), mask))
        chip = Image.alpha_composite(chip, bands)
    chip.paste(_qr_image(payload, box, fill="#DA0000" if flaggy else "#1E2B27"), (pad, pad+band))
    out.alpha_composite(chip, (x,y))

return issues

def test_scaled_preserves_aspect():
    img = Image.new("RGBA", (80, 40), (10, 10, 10, 255))
    a = ck._scaled(img, {"ارتفاع": 60})
    assert a.size == (120, 60)
    b = ck._scaled(img, {"عرض": 160})
    assert b.size == (160, 80)
    c = ck._scaled(img, {})
    assert c.size == (160, 80)  # default_h 80 → width 160
Default scaled(el={}): h=80 → (160,80) ✓.

python


def test_validate_and_store_layout(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(ck, "_LAYOUT_OVERRIDE", tmp_path / "o.json")
    lay = json.loads(ck._LAYOUT_DEFAULT.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert ck.validate_layout(lay) == []
    bad = {"عناصر": [{"نوع": "متن", "x": "زیاد"}, {"نوع": "غلط"}]}
    issues = ck.validate_layout(bad)
    assert len(issues) == 2
    with pytest.raises(ck.CertToolError):
        ck.store_layout(bad)
    p = ck.store_layout(lay)
    assert p == tmp_path / "o.json"
    assert ck.active_layout_path() == p
Note: store_layout(lay) writes to override → then active_layout_path becomes override — subsequent tests within the same session? monkeypatch is reverted after the test (but the file remains in tmp — no problem).

def test_flaggy_qr_bands():
    img = ck.render(_data()).convert("RGB")
    px = img.load()
    x = int(0.94*ck.W) - (148+28) + 88
    ytop = int(0.70*ck.H) + 10
    ybot = int(0.70*ck.H) + (148+28+48) - 10
    r,g,b = px[x, ytop]; assert g > r and g > b  # green
    r,g,b = px[x, ybot]; assert r > g and r > b  # red
Rounded corner radius 24 — center x is safe.

cert_studio.py
PYTHON
"""استودیو چیدمان گواهی — ویرایشگر زندهٔ طرح برای مدیر.

سرور کوچک stdlib: پیش‌نمایش واقعی موتور (certkit) + کشیدن عنصرها +
آپلود لوگو/امضا + ذخیرهٔ چیدمان در var/cert-layout.json.
همین JSON بعداً دادهٔ ویرایشگر پنل ادمین مینی‌اپ می‌شود.

اجرا:  python3 tools/cert_studio.py   (پورت ۸۰۹۱)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import io
import json
import re
import sys
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from nora.services import certkit as ck  # noqa: E402

ASSETS_USER = ROOT / "var" / "cert-assets"
ASSETS_SYS = ROOT / "nora" / "assets"
UI = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "cert_studio_ui.html"
PORT = 8091

DEMO = ck.CertData(
    holder="سارا محمدی", event="کارگاه آرامش ذهن",
    date="جمعه ۲۱ شهریور ۱۴۰۵", number=23, code="T4K7M9XZ",
    signer="دکتر رضایی", signer_role="مدیر گروه خط زندگی",
    issued="۲۲ شهریور ۱۴۰۵")
DEMO_EXTRA = {"دوره": "پیشرفته"}


def _assets() -> list:
    out = []
    for base in (ASSETS_USER, ASSETS_SYS):
        if base.exists():
            for f in sorted(base.glob("*.png")) + sorted(base.glob("*.jpg")):
                rel = f.relative_to(ROOT)
                out.append(str(rel))
    return out


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "NoraCertStudio/1"

    def log_message(self, *a):
        pass

    def _send(self, code: int, body: bytes, kind: str):
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", kind)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _json(self, obj, code: int = 200):
        self._send(code, json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False).encode(),
                   "application/json; charset=utf-8")

    def _body(self) -> dict:
        n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        try:
            return json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return {}

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/":
            self._send(200, UI.read_bytes(), "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        elif self.path == "/layout":
            try:
                lay = ck.load_layout()
            except ck.CertToolError:
                lay = {"پوسته": "glass", "عناصر": []}
            self._json(lay)
        elif self.path == "/assets":
            self._json({"assets": _assets()})
        else:
            self._send(404, b"not found", "text/plain")

    def do_POST(self):
        data = self._body()
        if self.path == "/render":
            lay = data.get("layout")
            if not isinstance(lay, dict):
                return self._json({"error": "چیدمان نامعتبر"}, 400)
            boxes: list = []
            try:
                img = ck.render(DEMO, DEMO_EXTRA, lay, boxes=boxes)
            except ck.CertToolError as e:
                return self._json({"error": str(e)}, 400)
            buf = io.BytesIO()
            img.save(buf, "PNG", optimize=True)
            self._json({"img": base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode(),
                        "boxes": boxes})
        elif self.path == "/save":
            lay = data.get("layout")
            try:
                p = ck.store_layout(lay)
            except ck.CertToolError as e:
                return self._json({"error": str(e)}, 400)
            self._json({"ok": True, "path": str(p.relative_to(ROOT))})
        elif self.path == "/upload":
            name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]", "", str(data.get("name", "")))
            if not name.lower().endswith((".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg")):
                name = (name or "file") + ".png"
            raw = data.get("data", "")
            if "," in raw:
                raw = raw.split(",", 1)[1]
            try:
                blob = base64.b64decode(raw)
            except Exception:
                return self._json({"error": "فایل خوانده نشد"}, 400)
            ASSETS_USER.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest = ASSETS_USER / name
            dest.write_bytes(blob)
            self._json({"ok": True,
                        "path": str(dest.relative_to(ROOT))})
        else:
            self._send(404, b"not found", "text/plain")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", PORT), Handler)
    print(f"cert studio on :{PORT}")
    httpd.serve_forever()

هر عنصر را با دست می‌کشی هر جای صفحه؛ کادر خط‌چین دورش، جعبهٔ دقیق خودش است
کلیک روی عنصر → پنل کناری: متن، اندازه، وزن، رنگ (پالت یا هگز)، تراز، عرض/ارتفاع، و برای متن هر متغیری ({نام} {برنامه} {تاریخ_صدور} … یا متغیر دلخواه خودت)

امضا: فایل امضا را آپلود کن و هر جای صفحه که دوست داری بگذار — جایش کاملاً دست خودت است

پوسته: شفاف/جنگلی/طلایی/اقیانوسی/شب
دکمهٔ «ذخیرهٔ چیدمان» همان را در var/cert-layout.json می‌نویسد و موتور بایت‌به‌بایت همان را صادر می‌کند — «جا به جا زدن» من برای همیشه تمام شد، چون مختصات از این به بعد مال توست
نشان و پرچم رسمی که فرستادی در فهرست فایل‌های استودیو هستند؛ با یک کلیک به برگه اضافه می‌شوند.

What makes it slow? Each /render does a full glass_canvas render: 1754×1240 with Gaussian blur 150*scale + multiple blur passes — that's the heavy part (~1–2 sec). Plus PNG encoding + base64 transfer (~250KB).

How to make it dramatically faster and smoother:

Then per-change render = composite elements onto cached background (draws only: text, images, QR — fast, ~50–150ms) — still PIL at full resolution.

cert_studio.py
PYTHON
"""استودیو چیدمان گواهی — نسخهٔ ۲: روان و کامل.

سرور stdlib سبک:
- پس‌زمینهٔ شیشه‌ای per پوسته کش می‌شود (certkit.base_canvas)؛ هر رندر
  پیش‌نمایش فقط عنصرها را روی کپی آن می‌کشد و کوچک‌سازی می‌شود → پاسخ در
  ده‌ها میلی‌ثانیه، نه ثانیه‌ها.
- ذخیره/بارگذاری طرح‌های نام‌دار (presets) در var/cert-layouts/
- آپلود/حذف لوگو و امضا در var/cert-assets/
- خروجی PNG تمام‌کیفیت برای دانلود
همین JSON چیدمان، دادهٔ ویرایشگر پنل ادمین مینی‌اپ خواهد بود.

اجرا:  python3 tools/cert_studio.py   (پورت ۸۰۹۱)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import io
import json
import re
import sys
import time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from nora.services import certkit as ck  # noqa: E402

ASSETS_USER = ROOT / "var" / "cert-assets"
ASSETS_SYS = ROOT / "nora" / "assets"
PRESETS = ROOT / "var" / "cert-layouts"
UI = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "cert_studio_ui.html"
PORT = 8091
PREVIEW_SCALE = 0.55

DEMO = ck.CertData(
    holder="سارا محمدی", event="کارگاه آرامش ذهن",
    date="جمعه ۲۱ شهریور ۱۴۰۵", number=23, code="T4K7M9XZ",
    signer="دکتر رضایی", signer_role="مدیر گروه خط زندگی",
    issued="۲۲ شهریور ۱۴۰۵")
DEMO_EXTRA = {"دوره": "پیشرفته"}
DEMO_VALUES = ck.values_for(DEMO, DEMO_EXTRA)
DEMO_PAYLOAD = ck.full_id(DEMO.number, DEMO.code)


def _assets() -> list:
    out = []
    for base in (ASSETS_USER, ASSETS_SYS):
        if base.exists():
            for f in sorted(base.glob("*.png")) + sorted(base.glob("*.jpg")):
                out.append(str(f.relative_to(ROOT)))
    return out


def _png(img, optimize: bool) -> bytes:
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    img.save(buf, "PNG", optimize=optimize)
    return buf.getvalue()


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "NoraCertStudio/2"
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def log_message(self, *a):
        pass

    def _send(self, code: int, body: bytes, kind: str,
              filename: str = ""):
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", kind)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        if filename:
            self.send_header("Content-Disposition",
                             f'attachment; filename="{filename}"')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _json(self, obj, code: int = 200):
        self._send(code, json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False).encode(),
                   "application/json; charset=utf-8")

    def _body(self) -> dict:
        n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        try:
            return json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return {}

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- GET
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/":
            self._send(200, UI.read_bytes(), "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        elif self.path == "/layout":
            try:
                self._json(ck.load_layout())
            except ck.CertToolError:
                self._json({"پوسته": "glass", "عناصر": []})
        elif self.path == "/assets":
            self._json({"assets": _assets()})
        elif self.path == "/presets":
            PRESETS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            self._json({"names": sorted(p.stem for p in
                                         PRESETS.glob("*.json"))})
        else:
            self._send(404, b"not found", "text/plain")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- POST
    def do_POST(self):
        data = self._body()
        lay = data.get("layout")
        if self.path == "/render":
            if not isinstance(lay, dict):
                return self._json({"error": "چیدمان نامعتبر"}, 400)
            t0 = time.monotonic()
            theme = str(lay.get("پوسته", "")) or "glass"
            base, pal = ck.base_canvas(theme)
            boxes: list = []
            out, _d = ck.draw_elements(base.copy(), pal, lay, DEMO_VALUES,
                                       DEMO_PAYLOAD, boxes)
            if data.get("preview", True):
                out = out.convert("RGB").resize(
                    (int(ck.W * PREVIEW_SCALE), int(ck.H * PREVIEW_SCALE)))
            else:
                out = out.convert("RGB")
            ms = round((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000)
            self._json({"img": base64.b64encode(
                _png(out, False)).decode(), "boxes": boxes, "ms": ms})
        elif self.path == "/export":
            if not isinstance(lay, dict):
                return self._json({"error": "چیدمان نامعتبر"}, 400)
            img = ck.render(DEMO, DEMO_EXTRA, lay)
            self._send(200, _png(img, True), "image/png", "certificate.png")
        elif self.path == "/save":
            try:
                p = ck.store_layout(lay)
            except ck.CertToolError as e:
                return self._json({"error": str(e)}, 400)
            self._json({"ok": True, "path": str(p.relative_to(ROOT))})
        elif self.path == "/presets/save":
            name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_؀-ۿ-]", "",
                          str(data.get("name", "")))[:40]
            if not name:
                return self._json({"error": "نام نامعتبر"}, 400)
            PRESETS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (PRESETS / f"{name}.json").write_text(
                json.dumps(lay, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                encoding="utf-8")
            self._json({"ok": True, "name": name})
        elif self.path == "/presets/load":
            p = PRESETS / f"{data.get('name', '')}.json"
            if not p.exists():
                return self._json({"error": "طرح پیدا نشد"}, 404)
            self._json(json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
        elif self.path == "/presets/delete":
            p = PRESETS / f"{data.get('name', '')}.json"
            if p.exists():
                p.unlink()
            self._json({"ok": True})
        elif self.path == "/upload":
            name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]", "", str(data.get("name", "")))
            if not name.lower().endswith((".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg")):
                name = (name or "file") + ".png"
            raw = data.get("data", "")
            if "," in raw:
                raw = raw.split(",", 1)[1]
            try:
                blob = base64.b64decode(raw)
            except Exception:
                return self._json({"error": "فایل خوانده نشد"}, 400)
            ASSETS_USER.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest = ASSETS_USER / name
            dest.write_bytes(blob)
            self._json({"ok": True,
                        "path": str(dest.relative_to(ROOT))})
        elif self.path == "/asset_delete":
            rel = str(data.get("path", ""))
            p = (ROOT / rel).resolve()
            if str(p).startswith(str(ASSETS_USER.resolve())) and p.exists():
                p.unlink()
                self._json({"ok": True})
            else:
                self._json({"error": "مسیر مجاز نیست"}, 400)
        else:
            self._send(404, b"not found", "text/plain")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", PORT), Handler)
    print(f"cert studio v2 on :{PORT}")
    httpd.serve_forever()

certkit addition:

python


VAR_RE = re.compile(r"\{([^{}\n]+)\}")
AUTO_VARS = frozenset({"نام", "برنامه", "تاریخ_برنامه", "تاریخ",
                       "تاریخ_صدور", "شماره", "شماره_یکتا", "کد",
                       "امضا", "سمت", "یادداشت"})
def layout_variables(lay) -> list:
    """نام متغیرهای به‌کاررفته در چیدمان (بدون کروشه)، مرتب."""
    found = set()
    for el in (lay or {}).get("عناصر", []) or []:
        if not isinstance(el, dict):
            continue
        for key in ("متن", "عنوان"):
            found |= set(VAR_RE.findall(str(el.get(key, "") or "")))
    return sorted(found)

Helpers:



function tgX(){const t=[6,50,94,33.33,66.67];
  boxes.forEach((o,i)=>{if(i!==sel){t.push(o.x,o.x+o.w/2,o.x+o.w);}});return t;}
function tgY(){const t=[6.5,50,91.5,33.33,66.67];
  boxes.forEach((o,i)=>{if(i!==sel){t.push(o.y,o.y+o.h/2,o.y+o.h);}});return t;}
function best(cur,tgs){let bp=null;
  for(const c of cur)for(const t of tgs){const d=t-c;
    if(Math.abs(d)<=0.5&&(bp===null||Math.abs(d)<Math.abs(bp.d)))bp={d,p:t};}
  return bp;}

function scanVars(){const out=new Set();
  for(const el of state.عناصر){
    for(const k of ["متن","عنوان"]){
      const m=String(el[k]||"").match(/\{([^{}\n]+)\}/g)||[];
      for(const x of m)out.add(x.slice(1,-1));}}
  return out;}
function vars(){
  const V=$("#vars");V.innerHTML="";
  const manual=state["متغیرها"]||(state["متغیرها"]={});
  const names=[...new Set([...scanVars(),...Object.keys(manual)])].sort();
  if(!names.length){V.innerHTML='<span class="hint">هنوز متغیری در متن‌ها نیست.</span>';return;}
  for(const n of names){
    const row=document.createElement("div");row.className="row";
    const lab=document.createElement("label");lab.textContent="{'+n+'}";  // watch out for the braces
    row.appendChild(lab);
    if(AUTO.has(n)){
      const sp=document.createElement("span");sp.className="hint";
      sp.textContent="خودکار";row.appendChild(sp);
    }else{
      const inp=document.createElement("input");inp.value=manual[n]||"";
      inp.placeholder="amount per certificate";
      inp.addEventListener("input",()=>{manual[n]=inp.value;schedule();});
      row.appendChild(inp);
      const x=document.createElement("button");x.className="dan mini";
      x.textContent="×";x.onclick=()=>{delete manual[n];vars();schedule();};
      row.appendChild(x);
    }
    V.appendChild(row);
  }
}

    number: int
    code: str
    values: dict
    issued_by: int
    issued_ts: float
    revoked: bool

class CertRepo:

cert_service.py
PYTHON
"""سرویس گواهی: صدور با متغیرهای دستیِ هر گواهینامه + استعلام اعتبار.

قاعدهٔ متغیرها: چیدمان فعال هر متغیری غیر از متغیرهای خودکار موتور بخواهد،
«دستی» است و موقع صدور باید مقدار داشته باشد، وگرنه صدور با پیام روشن
رد می‌شود (هیچ گواهی نیمه‌پر صادر نمی‌شود). مقادیر دستی کنار گواهی ذخیره
می‌شوند و رندر همیشه با همان‌هاست — نه چیزی جا به جا می‌شود، نه چیزی کم.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import random

from ..core import log
from ..core.clock import Clock
from ..domain.certs import Cert, CertRepo
from . import certkit as ck

log = log.get_logger("certs")


class CertIssueError(RuntimeError):
    """خطای صدور — پیام فارسی رو به ادمین."""


class CertService:
    def __init__(self, certs: CertRepo, clock: Clock | None = None,
                 rng: random.Random | None = None) -> None:
        self.certs = certs
        self.clock = clock
        self.rng = rng or random

    # ---------------------------------------------------- چیدمان و متغیرها
    def layout(self) -> dict:
        try:
            return ck.load_layout()
        except ck.CertToolError:
            return {"پوسته": ck.gk.DEFAULT, "عناصر": []}

    def manual_vars(self) -> list:
        """متغیرهایی که چیدمان می‌خواهد و موتور خود پر نمی‌کند."""
        return [v for v in ck.layout_variables(self.layout())
                if v not in ck.AUTO_VARS]

    # ---------------------------------------------------- صدور
    def issue(self, event_id: int, user_id: int, values: dict | None,
              by: int) -> Cert:
        values = {k: str(v or "") for k, v in (values or {}).items()}
        missing = [v for v in self.manual_vars() if not values.get(v)]
        if missing:
            raise CertIssueError(
                "مقدار این متغیرها کم است: " + "، ".join(missing))
        old = self.certs.get_for(event_id, user_id)
        if old and not old.revoked:
            return old                     # صدور دوباره = همان گواهی
        for _ in range(25):
            code = ck.new_code(self.rng)
            if not self.certs.code_exists(code):
                break
        else:                               # عملاً ناممکن، ولی نه صامت
            raise CertIssueError("ساخت کد یکتا ناموفق بود")
        cert = self.certs.issue(event_id, user_id, code, values, by)
        log.info("cert issued: event=%s user=%s code=%s",
                 event_id, user_id, code)
        return cert

    # ---------------------------------------------------- رندر و استعلام
    def data_for(self, cert: Cert, holder: str, event_title: str,
                 event_date: str, theme: str = "", signer: str = "",
                 signer_role: str = "", issued: str = "") -> ck.CertData:
        return ck.CertData(holder=holder, event=event_title,
                           date=event_date, number=cert.number,
                           code=cert.code, theme=theme, signer=signer,
                           signer_role=signer_role, issued=issued)

    def cert_path(self, cert: Cert, holder: str, event_title: str,
                  event_date: str, theme: str = "", signer: str = "",
                  signer_role: str = "", issued: str = "") -> str:
        data = self.data_for(cert, holder, event_title, event_date, theme,
                             signer, signer_role, issued)
        return ck.cert_path(data, extra=cert.values, theme=theme)

    def verify(self, payload: str) -> dict | None:
        """استعلام با محتوای کیوآر → وضعیت روشن، یا None برای ناشناخته."""
        parsed = ck.parse_id(payload)
        if not parsed:
            return None
        number, code = parsed
        cert = self.certs.get_by_code(code)
        if cert is None or cert.number != number:
            return None
        return {"cert": cert,
                "valid": not cert.revoked}

"""تست سرویس گواهی: شمارهٔ per رویداد، متغیرهای دستی، استعلام، رندر."""
import json
import random

import pytest

from nora.domain.certs import CertRepo
from nora.services import cert_service as cs
from nora.services import certkit as ck

LAY_MANUAL = {"پوسته": "glass", "عناصر": [
    {"نوع": "متن", "متن": "{نام} — نمره: {نمره} · دوره: {دوره}",
     "x": 50, "y": 50, "اندازه": 40, "تراز": "وسط"}]}


@pytest.fixture()
def repo(db, fake_clock):
    return CertRepo(db, fake_clock)


@pytest.fixture()
def svc(repo, fake_clock):
    return cs.CertService(repo, fake_clock, rng=random.Random(7))


def _override(tmp_path, monkeypatch, lay):
    p = tmp_path / "lay.json"
    p.write_text(json.dumps(lay, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.setattr(ck, "_LAYOUT_OVERRIDE", p)
    return p


def test_issue_sequence_per_event(repo, svc):
    a = svc.issue(1, 10, {}, by=99)
    b = svc.issue(1, 11, {}, by=99)
    c = svc.issue(2, 10, {}, by=99)
    assert (a.number, b.number, c.number) == (1, 2, 1)
    assert len({a.code, b.code, c.code}) == 3


def test_issue_duplicate_returns_same(repo, svc):
    a = svc.issue(1, 10, {}, by=99)
    b = svc.issue(1, 10, {}, by=99)
    assert a.id == b.id


def test_manual_vars_required(repo, svc, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _override(tmp_path, monkeypatch, LAY_MANUAL)
    assert svc.manual_vars() == ["دوره", "نمره"]
    with pytest.raises(cs.CertIssueError) as ei:
        svc.issue(1, 10, {"نمره": "۱۹"}, by=99)
    assert "دوره" in str(ei.value)
    cert = svc.issue(1, 10, {"نمره": "۱۹", "دوره": "پیشرفته"}, by=99)
    assert cert.values == {"نمره": "۱۹", "دوره": "پیشرفته"}


def test_verify_roundtrip(repo, svc):
    cert = svc.issue(1, 10, {}, by=99)
    got = svc.verify(ck.full_id(cert.number, cert.code))
    assert got and got["valid"] is True
    repo.set_revoked(cert.id, True)
    assert svc.verify(ck.full_id(cert.number, cert.code))["valid"] is False
    assert svc.verify(ck.full_id(cert.number + 1, cert.code)) is None
    assert svc.verify("junk") is None


def test_cert_path_renders_manual_values(repo, svc, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _override(tmp_path, monkeypatch, LAY_MANUAL)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ck, "_CACHE", tmp_path / "c")
    cert = svc.issue(1, 10, {"نمره": "۱۹", "دوره": "پیشرفته"}, by=99)
    path = svc.cert_path(cert, "سارا محمدی", "کارگاه آرامش ذهن",
                         "۲۱ شهریور ۱۴۰۵")
    assert Path_exists(path)
    p2 = svc.cert_path(cert, "سارا محمدی", "کارگاه آرامش ذهن",
                       "۲۱ شهریور ۱۴۰۵")
    assert p2 == path                      # کش


def Path_exists(p):
    import os
    return os.path.exists(p)


def test_lists_exclude_revoked(repo, svc):
    a = svc.issue(1, 10, {}, by=99)
    svc.issue(1, 11, {}, by=99)
    repo.set_revoked(a.id, True)
    assert [c.user_id for c in repo.list_event(1)] == [11]
    assert repo.list_user(10) == []
