def register_users_routes(r, urepo: UserRepo, profile: ProfileService,
                          state: StateStore, responder, settings,
                          clock, stats_cmd=None) -> None:
    def _rr(fn, *deps, **kw):
        def handler(ctx, *args):
            return fn(*deps, ctx, *args, **kw) or Reply("")
        return handler

    r.add("adm", _rr(on_panel, urepo, profile), v_int)
    r.add("adma", _rr(on_approvals, profile, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("adms", _rr(on_search_ask, state, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("adml", _rr(on_list, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("usb", _rr(on_block, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("usv", _rr(on_vip, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("usr", _rr(on_role_pick, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("usrr", _rr(on_role_set, urepo), v_int, v_kind)
    r.add("usrd", _rr(on_delete_q, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("usrx", _rr(on_delete, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("setg", _rr(on_settings, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("sysm", _rr(on_sysmenu, urepo), v_int)
    r.add("sysd", _rr(on_doctor, urepo, responder, settings, clock), v_int)
    r.add("sysb", _rr(on_backup, urepo, responder, settings, clock), v_int)
    if stats_cmd is not None:
        r.add("syss", _rr(_stats_wrap, urepo, responder, stats_cmd), v_int)


def _stats_wrap(urepo: UserRepo, responder, stats_cmd, ctx: Ctx) -> Reply:
    if not _can(urepo, ctx, "manage_settings"):
        return Reply(t("no_perm"))
    stats_cmd(responder, ctx)
    return Reply("")

"""ورود/خروج اکسل کاربران.

مسیر: imp:1 → فایل → پیش‌نمایش → [تازه / به‌روز] → نتیجه. exp:1 → فایل.
دادهٔ پیش‌نمایش در state می‌ماند تا مرحلهٔ تأیید از پیش‌نمایش همان فایل باشد.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from ....core.clock import Clock
from ....core.num import fa_num
from ....domain.users import UserRepo
from ....services import import_export, permissions
from ....services.state_store import StateStore
from ..ctx import Ctx
from ..router import Reply, v_int
from ..texts import t
from .. import ui
from .events import _staff

STEP_IMP_FILE = "imp_file"
STEP_IMP_CONFIRM = "imp_confirm"
MAX_STATE_ROWS = 500


def _can(urepo: UserRepo, ctx: Ctx, perm: str) -> bool:
    staff = _staff(urepo, ctx)
    return staff is not None and permissions.can(staff.role, perm)


def on_import_start(urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore, ctx: Ctx,
                    _a: int = 0) -> Reply:
    if not _can(urepo, ctx, "import_users"):
        return Reply(t("no_perm"))
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_IMP_FILE, {})
    return Reply(t("imp_ask"))


def on_export(urepo: UserRepo, var_dir: Path, clock: Clock, responder,
              ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> Reply:
    if not _can(urepo, ctx, "import_users"):
        return Reply(t("no_perm"))
    _users, total = urepo.list_page(page=0, per_page=1)
    if not total:
        return Reply(t("exp_empty"))
    stamp = clock.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M")
    dest = var_dir / "exports" / f"users-{stamp}.xlsx"
    import_export.export_users(urepo, dest)
    responder.send_doc_file(ctx.chat_id, str(dest), "exp_done")
    return Reply("")


def on_document(urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore, responder, var_dir: Path,
                downloader, clock: Clock, ctx: Ctx, file_id: str,
                file_name: str = "") -> bool:
    """True یعنی سند مصرف شد (حالت ورود اکسل فعال بود)."""
    step, _data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_IMP_FILE:
        return False
    if not file_name.lower().endswith((".xlsx", ".xlsm")):
        responder.reply(ctx, "imp_fail")
        return True
    tmp = var_dir / "tmp" / f"imp-{ctx.user_id}.xlsx"
    try:
        downloader(file_id, tmp)
        headers, rows = import_export.read_rows(tmp)
        plan = import_export.plan(urepo, headers, rows)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — فایل خراب/سنگین → پیام خطا، نه کرش
        responder.reply(ctx, "imp_fail")
        return True
    finally:
        tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    if not plan.mapping or not plan.rows:
        responder.reply(ctx, "imp_head_bad")
        return True
    keep = plan.rows[:MAX_STATE_ROWS]
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_IMP_CONFIRM, {"rows": keep}, merge=False)
    body = t("imp_preview", rows=fa_num(str(len(plan.rows))),
             cols=fa_num(str(len(plan.mapping))),
             new=fa_num(str(plan.new_count)),
             dup=fa_num(str(plan.dup_count)))
    rows_kb = [[ui.btn(t("btn_imp_go"), "impg:1"),
                ui.btn(t("btn_imp_upd"), "impu:1")],
               [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "setg:1")]]
    responder.reply(ctx, body, markup=ui.kb(rows_kb))
    return True


def on_confirm(urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore, clock: Clock,
               ctx: Ctx, update_existing: int) -> Reply:
    if not _can(urepo, ctx, "import_users"):
        return Reply(t("no_perm"))
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_IMP_CONFIRM:
        return Reply(t("imp_fail"))
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    result = import_export.run(urepo, data.get("rows") or [],
                               bool(update_existing), clock=clock)
    return Reply(t("imp_done", new=fa_num(str(result.new)),
                   upd=fa_num(str(result.updated)),
                   skip=fa_num(str(result.skipped))))


def register_import_routes(r, urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
                           var_dir: Path, downloader, clock: Clock) -> None:
    def _rr(fn, *deps, **kw):
        def handler(ctx, *args):
            return fn(*deps, ctx, *args, **kw) or Reply("")
        return handler

    r.add("imp", _rr(on_import_start, urepo, state), v_int)
    r.add("impg", _rr(on_confirm, urepo, state, clock), v_int)
    r.add("impu", _rr(on_confirm, urepo, state, clock), v_int)
    r.add("exp", _rr(on_export, urepo, var_dir, clock, responder), v_int)

"""تست بخش ۲: پروفایل گسترده، کاربران، عضویت اجباری، اکسل، منوی خانه."""
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.core.iran_data import match_province
from nora.domain.forcejoin import ForceJoinRepo

from nora.services import import_export, permissions
from nora.services.profile_service import ProfileService


# --------------------------------------------------------------- واحدی
def test_match_province():
    assert match_province("تهران") == "تهران"
    assert match_province("  البرز ") == "البرز"
    assert match_province("خراسان") == ""          # مبهم
    assert match_province("خراسان رضوی") == "خراسان رضوی"
    assert match_province("اصفهان") == "اصفهان"
    assert match_province("ناکجاآباد") == ""


def test_norm_phone():
    assert import_export.norm_phone("۰۹۱۲۱۱۱۰۰۰۰") == "09121110000"
    assert import_export.norm_phone("+989121110000") == "09121110000"
    assert import_export.norm_phone("9121110000") == "09121110000"
    assert import_export.norm_phone("123") == ""


def test_map_headers():
    headers = ["نام و نام خانوادگی", "موبایل", "کد ملی", "ستون ناشناس",
               "نقش"]
    mapping = import_export.map_headers(headers)
    assert mapping[0] == "full_name"
    assert mapping[1] == "phone"
    assert mapping[2] == "national_id"
    assert 3 not in mapping
    assert mapping[4] == "role"


def test_permissions_new():
    assert permissions.can("admin", "manage_users")
    assert permissions.can("owner", "manage_users")
    assert not permissions.can("operator", "manage_users")
    assert permissions.can("admin", "import_users")
    assert not permissions.can("organizer", "import_users")
    assert not permissions.can("admin", "manage_roles")
    assert permissions.can("owner", "manage_roles")


def test_repo_extras(db):
    repo = UserRepo(db)
    u = repo.create(1, first_name="مریم")
    repo.update(u.id, full_name="مریم رادمهر", phone="09121110000",
                status="approved")
    assert repo.search("رادمهر")[0].id == u.id
    assert repo.search("0912")[0].id == u.id
    users, total = repo.list_page(page=0, per_page=10)
    assert total == 1 and users[0].id == u.id
    p1 = repo.next_placeholder_bale_id()
    imp = repo.create(p1, first_name="ورودی")
    repo.update(imp.id, phone="09351110000")
    assert p1 < 0
    claimed = repo.claim_by_phone("09351110000", 4242, first_name="واقعی")
    assert claimed is not None and claimed.bale_id == 4242
    assert repo.claim_by_phone("09351110000", 7) is None   # دوباره نه
    assert repo.delete(imp.id)
    assert repo.get(imp.id) is None


def test_profile_service_config(db):
    repo = UserRepo(db)
    setrepo = SettingsRepo(db)
    svc = ProfileService(repo, setrepo)
    u = repo.create(1, first_name="x")
    repo.update(u.id, status="approved")
    cfg = svc.field_config()
    assert cfg["full_name"] == (1, 1)
    assert cfg["email"] == (1, 0)
    svc.set_field_flag("email", "req", 1)
    assert "email" in svc.missing(repo.get(u.id))
    svc.set_field_flag("email", "on", 0)
    assert "email" not in svc.missing(repo.get(u.id))
    assert "email" not in svc.active_fields()


def test_profile_apply_validators(db):
    from nora.core.errors import ValidationError
    repo = UserRepo(db)
    svc = ProfileService(repo)
    u = repo.create(1, first_name="x")
    repo.update(u.id, status="approved", full_name="مریم رادمهر")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        svc.apply(repo.get(u.id), email="bad")
    svc.apply(repo.get(u.id), email="a@b.co")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        svc.apply(repo.get(u.id), postal_code="123")
    svc.apply(repo.get(u.id), postal_code="1234567890")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        svc.apply(repo.get(u.id), birth_date="2000-01-01")
    svc.apply(repo.get(u.id), birth_date="1375/04/12")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        svc.apply(repo.get(u.id), province="ناکجا")
    svc.apply(repo.get(u.id), province="تهران")
    assert repo.get(u.id).province == "تهران"
    pct = svc.percent(repo.get(u.id))
    assert 0 < pct <= 100


def test_import_run(db):
    repo = UserRepo(db)
    old = repo.create(-9, first_name="قدیمی")
    repo.update(old.id, phone="09121110000")
    headers = ["نام", "موبایل", "نقش"]
    rows = [
        {0: "مریم رادمهر", 1: "۰۹۱۲۱۱۱۰۰۰۰"},           # تکراری
        {0: "علی احدی", 1: "09351112222", 2: "organizer"},  # تازه
        {0: "", 1: ""},                                    # خالی → رد
    ]
    plan = import_export.plan(repo, headers, rows)
    assert plan.new_count == 1 and plan.dup_count == 1
    res = import_export.run(repo, plan.rows, update_existing=False)
    assert res.new == 1 and res.skipped == 1 and res.updated == 0
    u = repo.get_by_phone("09351112222")
    assert u is not None and u.role == "organizer"
    assert u.bale_id < 0
    plan2 = import_export.plan(
        repo, headers, [{0: "مریم تازه", 1: "09121110000"}])
    res2 = import_export.run(repo, plan2.rows, update_existing=True)
    assert res2.updated == 1
    assert repo.get(old.id).full_name == "مریم تازه"


def test_export_users(db, tmp_path):
    repo = UserRepo(db)
    u = repo.create(1, first_name="مریم")
    repo.update(u.id, full_name="مریم رادمهر", phone="09121110000")
    dest = import_export.export_users(repo, tmp_path / "out.xlsx")
    assert dest.exists() and dest.stat().st_size > 0
    headers, rows = import_export.read_rows(dest)
    assert "نام و نام خانوادگی" in [str(h) for h in headers]
    assert any("رادمهر" in str(v) for r in rows for v in r.values())

def step(env, update, uid=999):
    env["clock"].advance_hours(0.01)
    kind = env["bot"].process_update(update)
    env["bot"].outbox.drain()
    return kind


def cb(data, uid=999):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def last(env):
    sent = env["sent"]
    return str(sent[-1].get("text") or sent[-1].get("caption") or "")


def all_text(env, n=3):
    return " ".join(str(p.get("text") or p.get("caption") or "")
                    for p in env["sent"][-n:])

def test_search_and_actions(env):
    urepo = env["urepo"]
    step(env, cb("adms:1"))
    step(env, msg("مریم"))
    assert "dos:" in str(env["sent"][-1].get("reply_markup") or "")
    member = urepo.get_by_phone("") or urepo.search("رادمهر")[0]
    step(env, cb(f"dos:{member.id}"))
    markup = str(env["sent"][-1].get("reply_markup") or "")
    assert f"usb:{member.id}" in markup
    step(env, cb(f"usb:{member.id}"))
    assert urepo.get(member.id).status == "blocked"
    step(env, cb(f"usb:{member.id}"))
    assert urepo.get(member.id).status == "approved"
    step(env, cb(f"usv:{member.id}"))
    assert urepo.get(member.id).is_vip == 1
    step(env, cb(f"usr:{member.id}"))
    step(env, cb(f"usrr:{member.id}:organizer"))
    assert urepo.get(member.id).role == "organizer"
    step(env, cb(f"usrd:{member.id}"))
    step(env, cb(f"usrx:{member.id}"))
    assert urepo.get(member.id) is None

        step(env, cb("pfs:1", uid=10))
    assert "pf_wiz_done" not in str(env["bot"].router.__dict__)  # sanity
    u = urepo.get(user.id)
    assert u.complete_percent > 0

# --- اکسل ---
def _make_xlsx(path: Path):
    import openpyxl
    book = openpyxl.Workbook()
    sheet = book.active
    sheet.append(["نام و نام خانوادگی", "موبایل", "کد ملی", "نقش"])
    sheet.append(["علی احدی", "۰۹۳۵۱۱۱۲۲۲۲", "", ""])
    sheet.append(["سارا سجادی", "09123334444", "", "organizer"])
    book.save(str(path))
    book.close()


def test_import_flow(env):
    tmp = env["tmp"]
    src = tmp / "users.xlsx"
    _make_xlsx(src)

    def downloader(file_id, dest):
        Path(dest).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        Path(dest).write_bytes(src.read_bytes())
        return Path(dest)

    # بات دوم با دانلودر جعلی
    clock = env["clock"]
    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    sent2 = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent2.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    bot2 = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=env["db"], clock=clock,
                               transport=transport, downloader=downloader)
    env["bot"] = bot2
    env["sent"] = sent2
    step(env, cb("imp:1"))
    doc = {"message": {"from": {"id": 999}, "chat": {"id": 999},
                       "document": {"file_id": "f1",
                                    "file_name": "users.xlsx"}}}
    kind = step(env, doc)
    assert kind == "document"
    body = all_text(env, 2)
    assert "۲" in body                       # پیش‌نمایش: ۲ ردیف
    step(env, cb("impu:1"))
    from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
    assert t("imp_done", new="", upd="", skip="")[:5] in last(env) or \
        "وارد شد" in last(env)
    u = env["urepo"].get_by_phone("09351112222")
    assert u is not None and u.full_name == "علی احدی"
    u2 = env["urepo"].get_by_phone("09123334444")
    assert u2 is not None and u2.role == "organizer"
    assert u2.bale_id < 0                    # تا اولین ورود، شناسه منفی

python


    def ensure_column(self, table: str, column: str, decl: str) -> None:
        cols = {r["name"] for r in self.query(f"PRAGMA table_info({table})")}
        if column not in cols:
            self.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {decl}")
            self.commit()

    def answer_about(self, user_id: int, question: str, facts: list[dict]) -> str | None:
        if not self.enabled or not self._allow(user_id):
            return None
        try:
            out = self.provider.answer_about(question, facts)
        except Exception:
            log.exception("ai about failed")
            return None
        if not isinstance(out, str):
            return None
        out = out.strip()
        if not out or len(out) > 400:
            return None
        return out

def _skip_apply(step, fields):
    if step == "price": fields["is_paid"]=0; fields["price"]=0
    elif step == "price_vip": pass  # not set → None
    elif step in ("duration","capacity","wait_cap"): fields[{"duration":"duration_minutes","capacity":"capacity","wait_cap":"waitlist_cap"}[step]]=0
    elif step == "password": fields["password"]=""
    elif step == "aud_age": fields["audience_min_age"]=0; fields["audience_max_age"]=0
    elif step == "aud_city": fields["audience_city"]=""
    elif step == "reg_end": fields["reg_end_ts"]=0
    elif step == "organizer": fields["organizer"]=""
    elif step == "desc": fields["desc"]=""
    elif step == "invite": ... can't skip (if privacy=code then required) — hide skip button on invite step.

Value parsing helpers (shared between wizard & edit):

_AGE_RE = re.compile(r"([0-9]{1,3})\s*-\s*([0-9]{1,3})")
def _parse_int(text: str) -> int | None:
    s = en_num(" ".join(text.split()))
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{1,12}", s.replace(",", "")):
        return None
    return int(s.replace(",", "").replace("٬", ""))

def _wiz_skip_apply(step, fields):
    if step == "desc": fields["desc"] = ""
    elif step == "duration_minutes": fields["duration_minutes"] = 0
    elif step == "capacity": fields["capacity"] = 0
    elif step == "price": fields["is_paid"] = 0; fields["price"] = 0
    elif step == "price_vip": pass
    elif step == "password": fields["password"] = ""
    elif step == "aud_age": fields["audience_min_age"] = 0; fields["audience_max_age"] = 0
    elif step == "audience_city": fields["audience_city"] = ""
    elif step == "waitlist_cap": fields["waitlist_cap"] = 0
    elif step == "reg_end": fields["reg_end_ts"] = 0.0
    elif step == "organizer": fields["organizer"] = ""
    elif step == "poster": pass

deep_link:

def deep_link(repo, svc, urepo, state, responder, ctx, payload: str) -> bool:
    m = re.fullmatch(r"ev([0-9]{1,9})", en_num(payload.strip()))
    if m is None:
        return False
    eid = int(m.group(1))
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None or ev.status not in ("published", "closed", "finished"):
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_dl_bad")
        return True
    on_event_detail(repo, svc, urepo, state, responder, ctx, eid)
    return True

def on_event_detail(repo, svc, urepo, state, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_unavailable")
        return "ev-detail-none"
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    staff = _staff(urepo, ctx)
    reg = repo.reg_of(eid, user.id) if user else None
    if (ev.password_hash and staff is None and reg is None
            and (user is None or not repo.pass_ok(user.id, eid))):
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_EVPASS, {"eid": eid}, merge=False)
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_pass_ask")
        return "ev-detail-pass"
    text = t("ev_detail", ...)
    if ev.desc: text += "\n" + ev.desc
    if ev.duration_minutes: text += "\n" + t("ev_dur_line", n=fa_num(ev.duration_minutes))
    if ev.organizer: text += "\n" + t("ev_org_line", name=ev.organizer)
    text += _audience_lines(ev)
    rows = [] ...(existing)
audience_lines(ev):

python


def _audience_lines(ev) -> str:
    out = ""
    if ev.audience_gender:
        who = t("aud_who_f") if ev.audience_gender == "female" else t("aud_who_m")
        out += "\n" + t("ev_aud_gender", who=who)
    if ev.audience_min_age or ev.audience_max_age:
        rng = f"{fa_num(ev.audience_min_age)}-{fa_num(ev.audience_max_age)}"
        out += "\n" + t("ev_aud_age", range=rng)
    if ev.audience_city:
        out += "\n" + t("ev_aud_city", city=ev.audience_city)
    return out

def _fmt_edit_value(ev, field):
    if field == "password": return "✓" if ev.password_hash else "—"
    if field == "reg_end_ts": return _jal_date(ev.reg_end_ts) if ev.reg_end_ts else "—"
    if field == "aud_age":
        if not (ev.audience_min_age or ev.audience_max_age): return "—"
        return f"{fa_num(ev.audience_min_age)}-{fa_num(ev.audience_max_age)}"
    if field == "price_vip":
        return "—" if ev.price_vip is None else money_label(ev.price_vip)
    if field == "price": return money_label(ev.price) if ev.is_paid else t("btn_ev_free")
    value = getattr(ev, field, "")
    return str(value) if str(value).strip() else "—"
Rows: Text fields in pairs of two: [evset:eid:field] label with t("evf_..."): The label map is inside EDIT_TEXT_FIELDS. Toggle rows in pairs of two: [evtog:eid:col] label + ✓. audg row: 3 buttons evaud:eid:all/f/m with ✓ on current value. priv row: 4 buttons evpriv:eid:X in 2 rows? 4 in 1 row (small labels) → 2×2. export + back row._

            changes[field] = int(d)
            if field == "price": changes["is_paid"] = 1 if int(d) else 0
    elif kindv == "int0":
        if text in ("", "—"): changes["price_vip"] = None
        else: d=_digits; changes["price_vip"]=int(d)
    elif kindv == "pass":

        else:
            if len(text) < 4: prompt again; return
            changes["password_hash"] = hash_password(text)
    elif kindv == "ts":

        else:

    elif kindv == "age":

        else:
            rng = _parse_age_range(text)

            changes = {"audience_min_age": rng[0], "audience_max_age": rng[1]}
    repo.update_event(eid, **changes)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)

jal_date(ts):

python


def _jal_date(ts: float) -> str:
    if not ts: return "—"
    from ....core.jalali import g2j
    d = datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, tz=TEHRAN)
    jy, jm, jd = g2j(d.year, d.month, d.day)
    return fa_num(f"{jy}/{jm:02d}/{jd:02d}")

@pytest.fixture()
def env(db, tmp_path):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")

                              transport=transport)

    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved")
    yield {"bot": bot, "clock": clock, "sent": sent, "urepo": urepo,
           "erepo": erepo, "db": db, "tmp": tmp_path, "settings": settings}
    set_clock(old)


def step(env, update, uid=999):
    env["clock"].advance_hours(0.01)
    kind = env["bot"].process_update(update)
    env["bot"].outbox.drain()
    return kind


def cb(data, uid=999):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def photo(file_id, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "photo": [{"file_id": file_id}]}}


def last(env):
    return str(env["sent"][-1].get("text") or env["sent"][-1].get("caption")
               or "")


def markup(env):
    return str(env["sent"][-1].get("reply_markup") or "")


WIZ_HEAD = [
    ("cb", "newev:1"), ("tx", "کارگاه تست"), ("cb", "evk:workshop"),
    ("tx", "1405-07-01 18:30"), ("cb", "evl:physical"), ("tx", "تهران"),
]


def run_wiz(env, steps):
    for kind, value in steps:
        step(env, cb(value) if kind == "cb" else msg(value))


# ----------------------------------------------------------- ویزارد گسترده
def test_full_wizard_creates_event(env):
    run_wiz(env, WIZ_HEAD)
    run_wiz(env, [
        ("tx", "توضیح برنامه"),            # desc
        ("tx", "۹۰"),                      # duration
        ("tx", "30"),                      # capacity
        ("cb", "evw:paid:1"),              # پولی
        ("tx", "5000"),                    # price
        ("cb", "evw:skip:1"),              # price_vip → بدون
        ("cb", "evw:priv:code"),           # با کد دعوت
        ("tx", "ABC123"),                  # invite
        ("tx", "1234"),                    # password
        ("cb", "evw:audg:f"),              # فقط خواهران
        ("tx", "18-30"),                   # سن
        ("tx", "تهران"),                   # شهر
        ("cb", "evw:wl:1"),                # انتظار روشن
        ("tx", "5"),                       # سقف انتظار
        ("tx", "1405-06-30 12:00"),        # مهلت ثبت‌نام
        ("tx", "خط زندگی"),                # برگزارکننده
        ("cb", "evw:rem:1"),               # یادآور روشن
    ])
    step(env, photo("poster1"))            # پوستر → پایان
    assert t("wiz_done") in last(env)
    ev = env["erepo"].list_events(("draft",))[0]
    assert ev.desc == "توضیح برنامه"
    assert ev.duration_minutes == 90 and ev.capacity == 30
    assert ev.is_paid == 1 and ev.price == 5000 and ev.price_vip is None
    assert ev.privacy == "code" and ev.invite_code == "ABC123"
    assert ev.password_hash == hash_password("1234")
    assert ev.audience_gender == "female"
    assert (ev.audience_min_age, ev.audience_max_age) == (18, 30)
    assert ev.audience_city == "تهران"
    assert ev.allow_waitlist == 1 and ev.waitlist_cap == 5
    assert ev.reg_end_ts > 0 and ev.organizer == "خط زندگی"
    assert ev.notify_reminder == 1 and ev.poster_file_id == "poster1"
    # پیش‌فرض هوشمند نوع: کارگاه → گواهی و حضوروغیاب روشن
    assert ev.has_cert == 1 and ev.has_attendance == 1 and ev.has_ticket == 1


def test_kind_smart_defaults(env):
    run_wiz(env, WIZ_HEAD[:2])
    step(env, cb("evk:meeting"))
    for _ in range(14):
        step(env, cb("evw:skip:1"))
    ev = env["erepo"].list_events(("draft",))[0]
    assert ev.has_cert == 0 and ev.has_attendance == 0 and ev.has_ticket == 0


def test_wizard_skip_all(env):
    run_wiz(env, WIZ_HEAD)
    for _ in range(3):                     # desc/duration/capacity
        step(env, cb("evw:skip:1"))
    step(env, cb("evw:paid:0"))            # رایگان
    step(env, cb("evw:priv:public"))
    for _ in range(3):                     # password/age/city — audg first
        pass
    step(env, cb("evw:skip:1"))            # password
    step(env, cb("evw:audg:all"))
    step(env, cb("evw:skip:1"))            # age
    step(env, cb("evw:skip:1"))            # city
    step(env, cb("evw:wl:0"))              # بدون انتظار
    step(env, cb("evw:skip:1"))            # reg_end
    step(env, cb("evw:skip:1"))            # organizer
    step(env, cb("evw:rem:0"))
    step(env, cb("evw:skip:1"))            # poster
    assert t("wiz_done") in last(env)
    ev = env["erepo"].list_events(("draft",))[0]
    assert ev.is_paid == 0 and ev.privacy == "public"
    assert ev.allow_waitlist == 0 and ev.notify_reminder == 0
    assert ev.password_hash == ""


# ----------------------------------------------------------- مخاطب
def _published(env, **fields):
    erepo = env["erepo"]
    base = dict(title="برنامه", status="published",
                start_ts=env["clock"].ts() + 86400)
    base.update(fields)
    return erepo.create_event(**base)

def test_audience_age_and_city(env):
    urepo = env["urepo"]
    ev = _published(env, audience_min_age=18, audience_max_age=30,
                    audience_city="تهران")
    u = urepo.create(14, first_name="فاطمه")
    urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", full_name="فاطمه احمدی",
                 birth_date="1375/04/12", city="تهران")
    svc = EventService(env["erepo"], env["clock"])
    res = svc.register(urepo.get(u.id), env["erepo"].get_event(ev.id))
    assert res.kind in ("confirmed", "pending_approval")
    # تولد ناقص → نیاز به پروفایل
    u2 = urepo.create(15, first_name="بدون")
    urepo.update(u2.id, status="approved", full_name="بدون تولدی")
    res2 = svc.register(urepo.get(u2.id), env["erepo"].get_event(ev.id))
    assert res2.kind == "aud_need_birth"
    # شهر دیگر
    u3 = urepo.create(16, first_name="شهری")
    urepo.update(u3.id, status="approved", full_name="شهری دیگر",
                 birth_date="1375/04/12", city="شیراز")
    res3 = svc.register(urepo.get(u3.id), env["erepo"].get_event(ev.id))
    assert res3.kind == "aud_city"

def test_event_password_gate(env):
    urepo, erepo = env["urepo"], env["erepo"]
    ev = _published(env, password_hash=hash_password("secret1"))
    u = urepo.create(20, first_name="کاربر")
    urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", full_name="کاربر عادی")
    step(env, cb(f"ev:{ev.id}", uid=20))
    assert t("ev_pass_ask") in last(env)
    step(env, msg("wrong", uid=20))
    assert t("ev_pass_bad") in last(env)
    step(env, msg("secret1", uid=20))
    assert "برنامه" in last(env)             # جزئیات نمایش داده شد
    step(env, cb(f"ev:{ev.id}", uid=20))
    assert t("ev_pass_ask") not in last(env)  # کش عبور
    # ادمین بدون رمز می‌بیند
    step(env, cb(f"ev:{ev.id}"))
    assert t("ev_pass_ask") not in last(env)

def test_waitlist_cap(env):

    r1 = svc.register(urepo.get_by_bale(31), erepo.get_event(ev.id))
    r2 = svc.register(urepo.get_by_bale(32), erepo.get_event(ev.id))

    assert r1.kind == "confirmed"
    assert r2.kind == "waitlist"
    assert r3.kind == "full"

def test_event_reminders(env):
    urepo, erepo = env["urepo"], env["erepo"]
    clock = env["clock"]
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="یادآوری", status="published",
                            start_ts=clock.ts() + 23 * 3600)
    u = urepo.create(40, first_name="ثبت")
    urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", full_name="ثبت نامی")
    svc = EventService(erepo, clock)
    svc.register(urepo.get(u.id), erepo.get_event(ev.id))
    env["bot"].on_tick()
    env["bot"].outbox.drain()
    assert any(t("ev_remind24", title="یادآوری", when="", where="")
               .split("\n")[0] in str(p.get("text") or "")
               for p in env["sent"])
    n = len(env["sent"])
    env["bot"].on_tick()
    env["bot"].outbox.drain()
    assert len(env["sent"]) == n               # تکرار نشد
    # ۲ ساعت قبل
    ev2 = erepo.create_event(title="نزدیک", status="published",
                             start_ts=clock.ts() + 90 * 60)
    svc.register(urepo.get(u.id), erepo.get_event(ev2))
    env["bot"].on_tick()
    env["bot"].outbox.drain()
    assert any("تا ۲ ساعت دیگر" in str(p.get("text") or "")
               for p in env["sent"][n:])
    fresh = erepo.get_event(ev2.id)
    assert fresh.remind1_ts > 0 and fresh.remind2_ts > 0

# ----------------------------------------------------------- تخفیف با سقف
def test_discount_cap(db):
    from nora.domain.payments import PaymentRepo
    from nora.services.pay_service import PayService
    repo = PaymentRepo(db)
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    svc = PayService.__new__(PayService)
    svc.repo = repo
    svc.clock = clock
    repo.add_code("HALF", "pct", 50, cap_amount=1000)
    off, err = svc.discount_for("half", 10000)
    assert err == "" and off == 1000          # سقف اعمال شد
    off2, _ = svc.discount_for("half", 1000)
    assert off2 == 500                        # زیر سقف → درصد کامل
    repo.add_code("FLAT", "fix", 300)
    off3, _ = svc.discount_for("flat", 1000)
    assert off3 == 300                        # مبلغی → بدون سقف

def test_qa_ai_grounded(db, tmp_path):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    class Provider:
        def classify_intent(self, text):
            return {"fallback": True}

        def answer_support(self, question, kb):
            return None

        def answer_about(self, question, facts):
            joined = " ".join(f"{f['k']}={f['v']}" for f in facts)
            return f"پاسخ کوتاه بر پایهٔ {len(facts)} واقعیت"

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=True,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock,
                              provider=Provider(),
                              transport=lambda u, p: (
                                  sent.append(p), {"ok": True, "result": []})[1])
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    u = urepo.create(80, first_name="پرسش")
    urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", full_name="پرسش گر")
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="هوشمند", status="published",
                            start_ts=clock.ts() + 86400)
    try:
        step_x = lambda upd: (clock.advance_hours(0.01),   # noqa: E731
                              bot.process_update(upd), bot.outbox.drain())
        step_x({"callback_query": {"id": "c", "from": {"id": 80},
                                   "message": {"chat": {"id": 80}},
                                   "data": f"evqa:{ev.id}"}})
        step_x({"message": {"from": {"id": 80}, "chat": {"id": 80},
                            "text": "برنامه کی است؟"}})
        body = str(sent[-1].get("text") or "")
        assert "پاسخ کوتاه بر پایهٔ" in body
    finally:
        set_clock(old)

card_art.py
PYTHON
"""کارت بانکی شیشه‌ای — هم‌خانوادهٔ بلیت و رسید.

زمینهٔ مه‌آلود glasskit + بدنهٔ کارت با گرادیان رنگ برند بانک، لبهٔ
specular، لوگوی بانک روی تراشهٔ سفید، شمارهٔ ماسک‌شده و نام دارنده.
اگر لوگو یا رنگ بانک ناشناس بود، کارت با پوستهٔ خنثی شیشه‌ای رندر می‌شود.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter

from ..core import iran_banks as banks
from . import glasskit as gk

_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
_CACHE = _ROOT / "var" / "cards"

W = 1500
H = 980
RAD = 76


def _hex(rgb: str, fallback: tuple) -> tuple:
    s = str(rgb or "").lstrip("#")
    if len(s) != 6:
        return fallback
    try:
        return (int(s[0:2], 16), int(s[2:4], 16), int(s[4:6], 16))
    except ValueError:
        return fallback


def _brand_body(d_img: Image.Image, card, radius: int, c0: tuple,
                c1: tuple) -> None:
    """گرادیان قطری رنگ برند + موج specular روی بدنهٔ کارت."""
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = card
    w, h = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
    grad = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    gd = ImageDraw.Draw(grad)
    for i in range(h):
        t = i / max(h - 1, 1)
        col = gk.blend(c0, c1, t)
        gd.line([(0, i), (w, i)], fill=col + (255,))
    # موج specular — نوار مور سفید کم‌رنگ، مثل شیشهٔ iOS 26
    spec = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
    sd = ImageDraw.Draw(spec)
    sd.polygon([(w * 0.10, 0), (w * 0.42, 0), (w * 0.16, h), (-w * 0.14, h)],
               fill=70)
    spec = spec.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(w * 0.06))
    white = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (255, 255, 255, 0))
    white.putalpha(spec)
    grad = Image.alpha_composite(grad, white)
    m = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(m).rounded_rectangle([0, 0, w - 1, h - 1], radius, fill=255)
    d_img.paste(grad, (x0, y0), m)


def render(card_number: str, holder: str, bank_slug: str = "",
           label: str = "", sheba: str = "", brand: str = "خط زندگی",
           masked: bool = True) -> Image.Image:
    digits = "".join(ch for ch in str(card_number or "") if ch.isdigit())
    slug = bank_slug or banks.detect_bank(digits)
    name, c_hex, l_hex, d_hex = banks.BANKS.get(
        slug, ("", "#5B6B63", "#8A998F", "#3E4A45"))
    c0 = _hex(l_hex, (138, 153, 143))
    c1 = _hex(d_hex, (62, 74, 69))
    accent = _hex(c_hex, (91, 107, 99))

    out, d, pal = gk.glass_canvas(W, H, (60, 90, W - 60, H - 60), RAD)
    CARD = (60, 90, W - 60, H - 60)
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = CARD

    # سایهٔ نرم زیر کارت
    sh = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    ImageDraw.Draw(sh).rounded_rectangle(
        [x0 + 4, y0 + 24, x1 - 4, y1 + 24], RAD, fill=(0, 0, 0, 80))
    out = Image.alpha_composite(out, sh.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(30)))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(out)

    _brand_body(out, CARD, RAD, c0, c1)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(out)

    # لبهٔ شیشه‌ای: حلقهٔ نیمه‌شفاف + لبهٔ روشن بالا
    d.rounded_rectangle(CARD, RAD, outline=(255, 255, 255, 110), width=3)
    d.arc([x0 + 2, y0 + 2, x1 - 2, y0 + 260], 180, 360,
          fill=(255, 255, 255, 90), width=3)

    L, R = x0 + 70, x1 - 70
    ink_on = (255, 255, 255, 255)
    soft = (255, 255, 255, 190)
    faint = (255, 255, 255, 130)

    # تراشهٔ سفید + لوگوی بانک (بالا راست)
    chip = (R - 150, y0 + 60, R, y0 + 210)
    d.rounded_rectangle(chip, 34, fill=(255, 255, 255, 235))
    logo = banks.logo_path(slug)
    if logo is not None:
        try:
            im = Image.open(logo).convert("RGBA")
            im.thumbnail((118, 118))
            out.paste(im, (chip[0] + (150 - im.width) // 2,
                           chip[1] + (150 - im.height) // 2), im)
            d = ImageDraw.Draw(out)
        except OSError:
            pass

    # نام بانک کنار تراشه
    if name:
        f_bank = gk.fit(d, name, [("Bold", 44), ("Bold", 36), ("Bold", 30)],
                        900)
        gk.rtl(d, name, f_bank, (chip[0] - 34, y0 + 112), ink_on, "rm")

    # برند کوچک بالا چپ
    gk.rtl(d, brand, gk.font("Regular", 30), (L + 8, y0 + 100), soft, "ls")
    if label:
        gk.rtl(d, label, gk.font("Medium", 26), (L + 8, y0 + 146), faint,
               "ls")

    # شمارهٔ کارت — ماسک‌شده، چهار گروه چهارتایی (رقم لاتین مثل کارت واقعی)
    shown = banks.mask_card(digits) if masked else _group16(digits)
    f_num = gk.font("Bold", 88)
    d.text((L, y0 + 430), shown, font=f_num, fill=ink_on, anchor="ls")

    # دارنده (راست) + شبا (چپ، کوچک)
    if holder:
        gk.rtl(d, holder, gk.font("Medium", 38), (R, y1 - 92), ink_on, "rs")
    if sheba:
        d.text((L, y1 - 96), sheba, font=gk.font("Regular", 30), fill=soft,
               anchor="ls")

    # نقطهٔ accent امضای خانوادهٔ شیشه‌ای
    d.ellipse([x0 + 44, y1 - 58, x0 + 62, y1 - 40],
              outline=(255, 255, 255, 160), width=3)
    return out


def _group16(digits: str) -> str:
    if len(digits) != 16:
        return digits or "—"
    return " ".join(digits[i:i + 4] for i in range(0, 16, 4))


def card_path(card_number: str, holder: str, bank_slug: str = "",
              label: str = "", sheba: str = "") -> Path | None:
    """رندر با کش اثرانگشتی — مثل بقیهٔ خانواده."""
    try:
        fp = hashlib.sha256(
            f"card|v1|{card_number}|{holder}|{bank_slug}|{label}|{sheba}"
            .encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:20]
        _CACHE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path = _CACHE / f"{fp}.png"
        if not path.exists():
            render(card_number, holder, bank_slug, label, sheba).save(
                path, "PNG")
        return path
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
        return None

PYTHON
"""لایهٔ درگاه‌های شخصی — provider-swappable.

درگاه رسمی بله مسیر اصلی است (precheckout/successful در main). این لایه برای
لینک‌های پرداخت و مواردی است که ادمین درگاه خودش را دارد: زرین‌پال،
پی‌پینگ، آیدی‌پی، نکست‌پی و «دستی» (تأیید ادمین).

هر آداپتر دو کار دارد: ساخت تراکنش (url یا کد) و راستی‌آزمایی.
HTTP تزریق‌شدنی است تا بدون شبکه تست شود؛ در تولید requests واقعی.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class Invoice:
    url: str = ""
    ref: str = ""
    err: str = ""

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.url or self.ref) and not self.err


def _http():
    import requests
    return requests


class Adapter:
    """پایهٔ مشترک — name فارسی برای نمایش، provider برای ذخیره."""

    name = "دستی"
    provider = "custom"
    needs = ("title",)          # فیلدهایی که ادمین باید پر کند

    def __init__(self, merchant: str = "", token: str = "", http=None,
                 sandbox: bool = False) -> None:
        self.merchant = merchant
        self.token = token
        self.http = http
        self.sandbox = sandbox

    def _requests(self):
        return self.http if self.http is not None else _http()

    def create(self, amount_rial: int, title: str, callback: str) -> Invoice:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def verify(self, ref: str, amount_rial: int,
               extra: str = "") -> bool:
        raise NotImplementedError


class ManualAdapter(Adapter):
    """بدون API — لینک/کد را ادمین می‌سازد، تأیید هم دستی است."""

    name = "دستی (تأیید ادمین)"
    provider = "custom"
    needs = ("title",)

    def create(self, amount_rial: int, title: str, callback: str) -> Invoice:
        return Invoice(err="manual")

    def verify(self, ref: str, amount_rial: int, extra: str = "") -> bool:
        return False


class ZarinpalAdapter(Adapter):
    name = "زرین‌پال"
    provider = "zarinpal"
    needs = ("title", "merchant")

    def create(self, amount_rial: int, title: str, callback: str) -> Invoice:
        host = "sandbox" if self.sandbox else "www"
        try:
            r = self._requests().post(
                f"https://{host}.zarinpal.com/pg/rest/WebGate/"
                "PaymentRequest.json",
                json={"MerchantID": self.merchant,
                      "Amount": amount_rial // 10,   # تومان
                      "Description": title[:100] or "پرداخت",
                      "CallbackURL": callback},
                timeout=20)
            data = r.json()
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return Invoice(err="net")
        res = data.get("Status")
        if res == 100:
            return Invoice(ref=str(data.get("Authority", "")))
        return Invoice(err=f"status={res}")

    def verify(self, ref: str, amount_rial: int, extra: str = "") -> bool:
        host = "sandbox" if self.sandbox else "www"
        try:
            r = self._requests().post(
                f"https://{host}.zarinpal.com/pg/rest/WebGate/"
                "PaymentVerification.json",
                json={"MerchantID": self.merchant, "Authority": ref,
                      "Amount": amount_rial // 10},
                timeout=20)
            return r.json().get("Status") == 100
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return False


class PaypingAdapter(Adapter):
    name = "پی‌پینگ"
    provider = "payping"
    needs = ("title", "token")

    def create(self, amount_rial: int, title: str, callback: str) -> Invoice:
        try:
            r = self._requests().post(
                "https://api.payping.ir/v2/pay",
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.token}"},
                json={"amount": amount_rial // 10,   # تومان
                      "description": title[:100] or "پرداخت",
                      "returnUrl": callback},
                timeout=20)
            data = r.json()
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return Invoice(err="net")
        code = data.get("code")
        if code:
            return Invoice(url=f"https://payping.ir/v2/pay/{code}")
        return Invoice(err=str(data.get("error") or "nocode"))

    def verify(self, ref: str, amount_rial: int, extra: str = "") -> bool:
        try:
            r = self._requests().post(
                "https://api.payping.ir/v2/pay/verify",
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.token}"},
                json={"refId": ref, "amount": amount_rial // 10},
                timeout=20)
            return r.status_code == 200
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return False


class IdpayAdapter(Adapter):
    name = "آیدی‌پی"
    provider = "idpay"
    needs = ("title", "token")

    def create(self, amount_rial: int, title: str, callback: str) -> Invoice:
        try:
            r = self._requests().post(
                "https://api.idpay.ir/v1.1/payment",
                headers={"X-API-KEY": self.token, "X-SANDBOX": "1" if
                         self.sandbox else "0"},
                json={"amount": amount_rial, "desc": title[:100] or "پرداخت",
                      "callback": callback},
                timeout=20)
            data = r.json()
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return Invoice(err="net")
        if data.get("id") and data.get("link"):
            return Invoice(url=data["link"], ref=str(data["id"]))
        return Invoice(err=str(data.get("error_message") or "nolink"))

    def verify(self, ref: str, amount_rial: int, extra: str = "") -> bool:
        try:
            r = self._requests().post(
                "https://api.idpay.ir/v1.1/payment/verify",
                headers={"X-API-KEY": self.token},
                json={"id": ref, "order_id": extra or ""},
                timeout=20)
            return r.json().get("status") in (100, 200)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return False


class NextpayAdapter(Adapter):
    name = "نکست‌پی"
    provider = "nextpay"
    needs = ("title", "merchant")

    def create(self, amount_rial: int, title: str, callback: str) -> Invoice:
        try:
            r = self._requests().post(
                "https://nextpay.org/nx/gateway/token",
                data={"api_key": self.merchant, "amount": amount_rial,
                      "currency": "irt", "order_id": str(hash(title) % 10**9),
                      "callback_uri": callback},
                timeout=20)
            data = r.json().get("data", {})
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return Invoice(err="net")
        tid = data.get("trans_id")
        if data.get("code") == -1 and tid:
            return Invoice(
                url=f"https://nextpay.org/nx/gateway/payment/{tid}",
                ref=str(tid))
        return Invoice(err=str(data.get("code")))

    def verify(self, ref: str, amount_rial: int, extra: str = "") -> bool:
        try:
            r = self._requests().post(
                "https://nextpay.org/nx/gateway/verify",
                data={"api_key": self.merchant, "trans_id": ref,
                      "amount": amount_rial, "currency": "irt"},
                timeout=20)
            return r.json().get("data", {}).get("code") == 0
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return False

    "idpay": IdpayAdapter,
    "nextpay": NextpayAdapter,
    "custom": ManualAdapter,

    """از ردیف Gateway دامنه → آداپتر زنده."""
    cls = ADAPTERS.get(getattr(gw, "provider", ""), ManualAdapter)
    return cls(merchant=getattr(gw, "merchant", ""),
               token=getattr(gw, "token", ""))

"""موتور مالی — کارمزد، هزینهٔ خدمات، لینک پرداخت، اقساط، بازپرداخت، داشبورد.

قانون‌ها:
· کارمزد per روش از تنظیمات: on/pct/fix/min/max/label — مبلغ نهایی شفاف است.
· هزینهٔ زیرساخت: مبلغ ثابت کوچک با سقف، فقط وقتی روشن باشد.
· لینک پرداخت (پرداخت غیرمتمرکز): مستقل از رویداد، یک‌بار/چندبارمصرف،
  مبلغ ثابت یا باز، روش‌های مجاز، انقضا، شمارنده‌های مصرف و درآمد.
· اقساط: سه حالت (مساوی/جلسه‌ای/پیش‌پرداخت) · سررسید زمانی · یادآوری ·
  تأخیر با مهلت · بخشودگی · تسویهٔ زودهنگام.
· همه‌چیز با ساعت تزریق‌شده — تستپذیر بدون زمان واقعی.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from ..core.clock import Clock
from ..domain.finance import (INS_PAID, INS_PENDING, INS_WAIVED, INTERVALS,
                              PLAN_INSTALLMENT, PLAN_PREPAY, PLAN_SESSIONS,
                              FinanceRepo, Installment, PayLink, Plan)
from ..domain.payments import METHODS, PAY_PAID, PaymentRepo

# ---------- کارمزد و هزینهٔ خدمات ----------


def _int(setrepo, key: str, default: int = 0) -> int:
    raw = str(setrepo.get(key, "") or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return default
    try:
        return int(float(raw))
    except ValueError:
        return default


@dataclass
class FeeBreakdown:
    base: int
    fee: int
    infra: int
    total: int
    fee_label: str = ""


def fee_for(setrepo, method: str, amount: int) -> tuple[int, str]:
    """کارمزد یک روش: درصد + ثابت، با کف و سقف."""
    if method not in METHODS or _int(setrepo, f"pay_fee_{method}_on") != 1:
        return 0, ""
    pct = _int(setrepo, f"pay_fee_{method}_pct")
    fix = _int(setrepo, f"pay_fee_{method}_fix")
    fee = amount * pct // 100 + fix
    lo = _int(setrepo, f"pay_fee_{method}_min")
    hi = _int(setrepo, f"pay_fee_{method}_max")
    if lo > 0:
        fee = max(fee, lo)
    if hi > 0:
        fee = min(fee, hi)
    fee = max(0, min(fee, amount))
    label = str(setrepo.get(f"pay_fee_{method}_label", "") or "").strip()
    return fee, label


def infra_for(setrepo, amount: int) -> int:
    """هزینهٔ زیرساخت — ثابت با سقف، فقط روی مبلغ مثبت و وقتی روشن است."""
    if _int(setrepo, "infra_on") != 1 or amount <= 0:
        return 0
    val = _int(setrepo, "infra_amount")
    cap = _int(setrepo, "infra_max", 20000)
    if cap > 0:
        val = min(val, cap)
    return max(0, val)


def breakdown(setrepo, method: str, amount: int) -> FeeBreakdown:
    fee, label = fee_for(setrepo, method, amount)
    infra = infra_for(setrepo, amount)
    return FeeBreakdown(base=amount, fee=fee, infra=infra,
                        total=amount + fee + infra, fee_label=label)


# ---------- لینک پرداخت ----------

def link_error(link: PayLink | None, now: float) -> str:
    """کد خطای پرداخت‌پذیری لینک — رشتهٔ خالی یعنی مجاز."""
    if link is None:
        return "pl_missing"
    if not link.is_active:
        return "pl_inactive"
    if link.expires_ts and now > link.expires_ts:
        return "pl_expired"
    if link.usage_type == "once" and link.paid_count >= 1:
        return "pl_exhausted"
    if link.max_uses and link.paid_count >= link.max_uses:
        return "pl_exhausted"
    return ""


def link_methods(link: PayLink) -> list[str]:
    out = [m for m in str(link.methods or "").split(",") if m in METHODS]
    return out or ["card"]


def check_open_amount(link: PayLink, amount: int) -> bool:
    """مبلغ باز: در بازهٔ حداقل/حداکثر باشد."""
    if link.amount_mode != "open":
        return amount == link.amount
    if amount <= 0:
        return False
    if link.min_amount and amount < link.min_amount:
        return False
    if link.max_amount and amount > link.max_amount:
        return False
    return True


# ---------- اقساط ----------

def plan_parts(plan: Plan) -> list[int]:
    """مبلغ هر قسط بر پایهٔ حالت — باقی‌ماندهٔ تقسیم روی قسط اول."""
    if plan.mode == PLAN_SESSIONS:
        n = max(plan.parts, 1)
        return [max(plan.part_amount, 0)] * n
    if plan.mode == PLAN_PREPAY:
        total = max(plan.total_amount, 0)
        pct = min(max(plan.prepay_percent, 0), 100)
        first = total * pct // 100
        return [first, total - first]
    total = max(plan.total_amount, 0)
    n = max(plan.parts, 1)
    base = total // n
    parts = [base] * n
    parts[0] += total - base * n
    return parts


def assign_plan(frepo: FinanceRepo, clock: Clock, plan: Plan, user_id: int,
                event_id: int = 0, reg_id: int = 0,
                start_ts: float | None = None) -> list[int]:
    """برنامهٔ اقساط را برای یک کاربر زمان‌بندی می‌کند."""
    now = clock.ts() if clock else 0.0
    start = start_ts if start_ts is not None else now
    amounts = plan_parts(plan)
    days = INTERVALS.get(plan.interval, 30)
    ids = []
    for i, amt in enumerate(amounts):
        due = 0.0 if days <= 0 else start + days * 86400 * i
        ids.append(frepo.add_installment(
            plan.id, user_id, i + 1, len(amounts), amt, due,
            event_id=event_id, reg_id=reg_id))
    return ids


def remaining(frepo: FinanceRepo, user_id: int, plan_id: int) -> int:
    """جمع قسط‌های باز — برای تسویهٔ زودهنگام."""
    rows = frepo.user_installments(user_id)
    return sum(i.amount for i in rows
               if i.plan_id == plan_id and i.status in (INS_PENDING, "late"))


def settle_early(frepo: FinanceRepo, plan: Plan, user_id: int) -> int:
    """صف تسویهٔ زودهنگام: مبلغ کل باقی‌مانده (۰ یعنی مجاز نیست/چیزی نمانده)."""
    if not plan.allow_early:
        return 0
    return remaining(frepo, user_id, plan.id)


# ---------- تسویهٔ هدف‌های مالی ----------

def settle_payment(frepo: FinanceRepo, pay, clock: Clock) -> bool:
    """پرداخت موفق با هدف لینک/قسط → بستن تراکنش مربوطه."""
    kind = getattr(pay, "target_kind", "")
    tid = int(getattr(pay, "target_id", 0) or 0)
    if kind == "link" and tid:
        frepo.mark_tx_paid(tid, pay.id)
        return True
    if kind == "installment" and tid:
        ins = frepo.installment(tid)
        if ins is not None and ins.status != INS_PAID:
            frepo.set_installment(
                tid, status=INS_PAID, payment_id=pay.id,
                paid_ts=clock.ts() if clock else 0.0)
        return True
    return False


# ---------- داشبورد ----------

def summary(frepo: FinanceRepo, payrepo: PaymentRepo, since: float,
            until: float) -> dict:
    """آمار یک بازه: درآمد به تفکیک روش + لینک‌ها + اقساط + بازپرداخت."""
    rows = payrepo.db.query(
        "SELECT method, COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(amount - discount), 0) "
        "AS s, COALESCE(SUM(discount), 0) AS d FROM payments "
        "WHERE status = ? AND paid_ts >= ? AND paid_ts < ? GROUP BY method",
        (PAY_PAID, since, until))
    by_method = {str(r["method"]): {"n": int(r["n"]), "sum": int(r["s"]),
                                    "discount": int(r["d"])} for r in rows}
    total = sum(v["sum"] for v in by_method.values())
    links = payrepo.db.query_one(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS s FROM link_tx "
        "WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_ts >= ? AND paid_ts < ?",
        (since, until))
    ins = payrepo.db.query_one(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS s "
        "FROM installments WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_ts >= ? "
        "AND paid_ts < ?", (since, until))
    refunds = payrepo.db.query_one(
        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS s FROM refunds "
        "WHERE status = 'done' AND done_ts >= ? AND done_ts < ?",
        (since, until))
    open_ins = frepo.plan_stats()
    pending_rf = frepo.db.query_one(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS s FROM refunds "
        "WHERE status = 'pending'")
    return {
        "total": total,
        "by_method": by_method,
        "links": {"n": int(links["n"]), "sum": int(links["s"])},
        "installments": {"n": int(ins["n"]), "sum": int(ins["s"])},
        "refunds_done": int(refunds["s"]),
        "refunds_pending": {"n": int(pending_rf["n"]),
                            "sum": int(pending_rf["s"])},
        "installments_open": open_ins["open"],
    }


def compare(frepo: FinanceRepo, payrepo: PaymentRepo, clock: Clock,
            days: int = 30) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    """(این دوره، دورهٔ قبل) — برای مقایسهٔ رشد."""
    now = clock.ts() if clock else 0.0
    cur = summary(frepo, payrepo, now - days * 86400, now + 1)
    prev = summary(frepo, payrepo, now - 2 * days * 86400,
                   now - days * 86400)
    return cur, prev

def _notify_finance_target(psvc, urepo, responder, pay) -> bool:
    """Notification for successful payment of link/installment target — returns True if handled."""
    frepo = psvc.frepo
    if frepo is None or pay.target_kind not in ("link", "installment"):
        return False
    user = urepo.get(pay.user_id)
    if user is None:
        return True
    if pay.target_kind == "link":
        tx = frepo.tx(pay.target_id)
        link = frepo.link(tx.link_id) if tx else None
        if link is not None and link.success_text.strip():
            responder.bulk_raw(user.bale_id, link.success_text.strip())
        else:
            responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "pl_paid")
        if link is not None and link.notify_admin:
            for admin_id in cfg.admin_ids: ... — no cfg here. Hmm, on_successful does have cfg. Pass admin_ids as a parameter.
    else:
        ins = frepo.installment(pay.target_id)
        responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "ins_paid", n=fa_num(ins.part_no), total=fa_num(ins.parts_total))
    return True

# ==================== کارت‌های بانکی ====================

def on_cards(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
             _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finc-denied"
    cards = frepo.cards()
    if not cards:
        rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_card_add"), "finka:1")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "fin:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_cards_none", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return "finc-empty"
    lines = [t("fin_cards_head")]
    rows = []
    for c in cards[:7]:
        mark = "★" if c.is_default else ("●" if c.is_active else "○")
        bank = iran_banks.bank_name(c.bank) or t("fin_card_bank_unknown")
        lines.append(t("fin_card_line", mark=mark, bank=bank,
                       num=iran_banks.mask_card(c.card_number),
                       holder=c.holder or "—"))
        rows.append([ui.btn(f"{bank} {iran_banks.mask_card(c.card_number)[-4:]}",
                            f"finkv:{c.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_card_add"), "finka:1"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "fin:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "finc-list"


def on_card_view(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                 cid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finkv-denied"
    c = frepo.card(cid)
    if c is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "finkv-none"
    path = card_art.card_path(c.card_number, c.holder, c.bank,
                              label=c.label, sheba=c.sheba)
    if path is not None:
        responder.send_photo_file(ctx.chat_id, str(path), "")
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_card_default"), f"find:{cid}"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_card_toggle"), f"fint:{cid}")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_sheba"), f"fins:{cid}"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_card_del"), f"finx:{cid}")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finc:1")]]
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_card_preview",
                    bank=iran_banks.bank_name(c.bank) or "—",
                    markup=ui.kb(rows))
    return "finkv"


def on_card_add(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CARD_NUM, {}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_card_ask_num")
    return "finka"


def on_card_default(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                    ctx: Ctx, cid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "find-denied"
    frepo.set_default_card(cid)
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_card_is_default")
    return on_cards(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx)


def on_card_toggle(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                   ctx: Ctx, cid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "fint-denied"
    if frepo.toggle_card(cid) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "fint-none"
    return on_cards(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx)


def on_card_del(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                ctx: Ctx, cid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finx-denied"
    frepo.remove_card(cid)
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_card_deleted")
    return on_cards(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx)

GW_PROVIDERS = ("zarinpal", "payping", "idpay", "nextpay", "custom")
GW_NAMES = {"zarinpal": "زرین‌پال", "payping": "پی‌پینگ", "idpay": "آیدی‌پی",

def on_gateways(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "fing-denied"
    items = frepo.gateways()
    lines = [t("fin_gw_head")] if items else [t("fin_gw_none")]
    rows = []
    for gw in items[:6]:
        state = t("st_on") if gw.is_active else t("st_off")
        lines.append(f"{GW_NAMES.get(gw.provider, gw.provider)} — "
                     f"{gw.title or '—'} ({state})")
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_gw_test"), f"fingw:{gw.id}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_card_toggle"), f"fingt2:{gw.id}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_card_del"), f"gingx:{gw.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_gw_add"), "finga:1"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "fin:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "fing-list"


def on_gw_add(responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    rows = [[ui.btn(GW_NAMES[p], f"fingp:{p}") for p in GW_PROVIDERS[:3]],
            [ui.btn(GW_NAMES[p], f"fingp:{p}") for p in GW_PROVIDERS[3:]],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "fing:1")]]
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_gw_pick", markup=ui.kb(rows))
    return "finga"


def on_gw_test(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
               gid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "fingw-denied"
    gw = frepo.gateway(gid)
    if gw is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "fingw-none"
    ad = gws.adapter_for(gw)
    inv = ad.create(10_000, t("btn_gw_test"), "https://example.local/cb")
    if inv.ok:
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_gw_test_ok")
    else:
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_gw_test_err", err=inv.err or "—")
    return "fingw"

def _fee_int(setrepo: SettingsRepo, key: str, default: int = 0) -> int:
    return fin._int(setrepo, key, default)


def on_fees(psvc: PayService, setrepo: SettingsRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finf-denied"
    lines = [t("fin_fee_head")]
    rows = []
    for m in METHODS:
        on_ = _fee_int(setrepo, f"pay_fee_{m}_on") == 1
        pct = _fee_int(setrepo, f"pay_fee_{m}_pct")
        fix = _fee_int(setrepo, f"pay_fee_{m}_fix")
        cap = _fee_int(setrepo, f"pay_fee_{m}_max")
        lines.append(t("fin_fee_line", method=t("m_" + m),
                       state=t("st_on") if on_ else t("st_off"),
                       pct=fa_num(pct), fix=money_label(fix),
                       max=money_label(cap) if cap else "—"))
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("m_" + m), f"finfe:{m}")])
    infra_on = _fee_int(setrepo, "infra_on") == 1
    lines.append(t("fin_infra_line",
                   state=t("st_on") if infra_on else t("st_off"),
                   amount=money_label(_fee_int(setrepo, "infra_amount",
                                               10000)),
                   max=money_label(_fee_int(setrepo, "infra_max", 20000))))
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("fin_infra_head").split("—")[0].strip(), "fini:1"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "fin:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "finf"


def on_fee_edit(setrepo: SettingsRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                ctx: Ctx, method: str) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finfe-denied"
    if method not in METHODS:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "finfe-bad"
    on_ = _fee_int(setrepo, f"pay_fee_{method}_on") == 1
    lines = [t("fin_fee_edit", method=t("m_" + method)),
             t("fin_fee_line", method=t("m_" + method),
               state=t("st_on") if on_ else t("st_off"),
               pct=fa_num(_fee_int(setrepo, f"pay_fee_{method}_pct")),
               fix=money_label(_fee_int(setrepo, f"pay_fee_{method}_fix")),
               max=money_label(_fee_int(setrepo, f"pay_fee_{method}_max"))
               or "—")]
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_fee_toggle"), f"finfet:{method}")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_fee_pct"), f"finfp:{method}:0"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_fee_fix"), f"finfx:{method}:0"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_fee_max"), f"finfc:{method}:0")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_fee_label"), f"finfl:{method}")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finf:1")]]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "finfe"

# ==================== لینک پرداخت (غیرمتمرکز) ====================

def on_links(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
             page: int = 1) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finl-denied"
    items, total = frepo.links(page=page)
    lines = [t("fin_link_head")] if items else [t("fin_link_none")]
    rows = []
    for lk in items:
        lines.append(t("fin_link_line", title=lk.title or "—", code=lk.code,
                       paid=fa_num(lk.paid_count), used=fa_num(lk.used_count),
                       sum=money_label(lk.total_collected)))
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_link_view"), f"finlv:{lk.id}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_link_share"), f"finlsh:{lk.id}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_link_toggle"), f"finlt:{lk.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_link_add"), "finla:1")])
    if total > 6:
        nav = []
        if page > 1:
            nav.append(ui.btn("‹", f"finl:{page - 1}"))
        if page * 6 < total:
            nav.append(ui.btn("›", f"finl:{page + 1}"))
        if nav:
            rows.append(nav)
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "fin:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "finl"


def on_link_add(responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_link_ask_title")
    return "finla"


def _link_menu(frepo: FinanceRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
               ctx: Ctx) -> None:
    """قدم بعدی ویزارت لینک بر پایهٔ فیلدهای پرشده — همه دکمه‌ای."""
    d = state.get(ctx.user_id)[1] or {}
    if "amount_mode" not in d:
        rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_amount_fixed"), "finls:amount_mode:fixed"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_amount_open"), "finls:amount_mode:open")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finl:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_link_pick_mode", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if "amount" not in d:
        if d.get("amount_mode") == PL_OPEN:
            rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_amount_fixed"), "finls:amount:0")],
                    [ui.btn(t("btn_amt_custom"), "finlsc:amount")],
                    [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finl:1")]]
            responder.reply(ctx, "fin_link_pick_min", markup=ui.kb(rows))
            return
        rows = _money_rows("finlsa")
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_amt_custom"), "finlsc:amount")])
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finl:1")])
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_link_pick_amount", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if "methods" not in d:
        rows = [[ui.btn(t("m_gateway") + " + " + t("m_card"),
                        "finls:methods:gateway,card")],
                [ui.btn(t("m_card"), "finls:methods:card"),
                 ui.btn(t("m_gateway"), "finls:methods:gateway")],
                [ui.btn(t("m_gateway") + " + " + t("m_card") + " + " +
                        t("m_onsite"), "finls:methods:gateway,card,onsite")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finl:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_link_pick_methods", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if "usage_type" not in d:
        rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_usage_unlimited"), "finls:usage_type:multi"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_usage_once"), "finls:usage_type:once")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_usage_capped"), "finls:usage_type:capped")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finl:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_link_pick_usage", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if d.get("usage_type") == "capped" and "max_uses" not in d:
        rows = [[ui.btn(fa_num(u), f"finls:max_uses:{u}")
                 for u in USE_PRESETS],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finl:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_link_pick_cap", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if "expires_ts" not in d:
        rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_expire_none"), "finlse:0"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_expire_week"), "finlse:7"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_expire_month"), "finlse:30")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finl:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_link_pick_expire", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if "asks" not in d:
        marks = d.get("ask_flags") or {}
        rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_ask_name") + (" ✓" if marks.get("name")
                                             else ""), "finlask:name"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_ask_mobile") + (" ✓" if marks.get("mobile")
                                               else ""), "finlask:mobile"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_ask_note") + (" ✓" if marks.get("note")
                                             else ""), "finlask:note")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_continue"), "finls:asks:1")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finl:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_link_pick_ask", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_LINK_SUCCESS, d, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_link_ask_success")


def on_link_set(frepo: FinanceRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
                ctx: Ctx, field: str, value: str) -> str:
    step, d = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step not in (STEP_LINK_TITLE, STEP_LINK_SUCCESS, "fin_link_wiz",
                    STEP_NUM) or not isinstance(d, dict):
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "finls-bad"
    d = dict(d)
    if field == "usage_type" and value == "capped":
        d["usage_type"] = "capped"
    elif field in ("ask_name", "ask_mobile", "ask_note"):
        d[field] = 1 if value == "1" else 0
    else:
        d[field] = value
    state.set(ctx.user_id, "fin_link_wiz", d, merge=False)
    _link_menu(frepo, state, responder, ctx)
    return "finls"


def on_link_view(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                 ctx: Ctx, lid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finlv-denied"
    lk = frepo.link(lid)
    if lk is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "finlv-none"
    open_n = sum(1 for tx in frepo.txs_of(lid, 100) if tx.status != "paid")
    lines = [t("fin_link_stat", title=lk.title or "—",
               paid=fa_num(lk.paid_count),
               sum=money_label(lk.total_collected), open=fa_num(open_n))]
    for tx in frepo.txs_of(lid, 5):
        lines.append(t("fin_link_tx_line", name=tx.payer_name or "—",
                       amount=money_label(tx.total),
                       state=t("pay_approved") if tx.status == "paid"
                       else tx.status))
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_link_share"), f"finlsh:{lid}"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_link_del"), f"finlx:{lid}")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finl:1")]]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "finlv"


def on_link_share(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                  ctx: Ctx, lid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:

def on_link_toggle(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                   ctx: Ctx, lid: int) -> str:

        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")

    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_link_deleted")
    return on_links(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx)


# ---------- کاربر: پرداخت لینک ----------

def deep_link(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, psvc: PayService,
              state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
              payload: str) -> bool:
    """/start plCODE — فرود روی لینک پرداخت."""
    m = re.fullmatch(r"pl([A-HJ-NP-Z2-9]{4,12})",
                     en_num(str(payload).strip()).upper())
    if m is None:
        return False
    lk = frepo.link_by_code(m.group(1))
    err = fin.link_error(lk, psvc.clock.ts() if psvc.clock else 0.0)
    if err:
        responder.reply(ctx, err)
        return True
    _link_landing(frepo, urepo, psvc, state, responder, ctx, lk)
    return True


def _link_landing(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, psvc: PayService,
                  state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, lk) -> None:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    d = {"link_id": lk.id}
    if user is not None and user.full_name:
        d["name"] = user.full_name
    state.set(ctx.user_id, "pl_wiz", d, merge=False)
    if lk.amount_mode == PL_OPEN:
        responder.reply(ctx, "pl_landing_open", title=lk.title or "—",
                        descr=lk.descr or "")
    else:
        responder.reply(ctx, "pl_landing", title=lk.title or "—",
                        descr=lk.descr or "",
                        amount=money_label(lk.amount))
    _link_user_step(frepo, psvc, state, responder, ctx)


def _link_user_step(frepo: FinanceRepo, psvc: PayService,
                    state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx) -> None:
    """قدم‌های دریافت اطلاعات و روش — تا جای ممکن بدون تایپ."""
    step, raw = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    d = dict(raw or {})
    if step != "pl_wiz":
        return
    lk = frepo.link(d.get("link_id", 0))
    if lk is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "pl_missing")
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        return
    if lk.ask_name and not d.get("name"):
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_PL_NAME, d, merge=False)
        responder.reply(ctx, "pl_ask_name")
        return
    if lk.ask_mobile and not d.get("mobile"):
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_PL_MOBILE, d, merge=False)
        responder.reply(ctx, "pl_ask_mobile")
        return
    if lk.ask_note and "note" not in d:
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_PL_NOTE, d, merge=False)
        responder.reply(ctx, "pl_ask_note")
        return
    if lk.amount_mode == PL_OPEN and not d.get("amount"):
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_PL_AMOUNT, d, merge=False)
        rows = _money_rows("plamt")
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_amt_custom"), "plamtc:1")])
        responder.reply(ctx, "pl_ask_amount", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    methods = fin.link_methods(lk)
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("m_" + m), f"plm:{lk.id}:{m}") for m in methods[:3]]]
    state.set(ctx.user_id, "pl_wiz", d, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "pl_pick_method", markup=ui.kb(rows))


def on_link_pay(frepo: FinanceRepo, payrepo: PaymentRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                psvc: PayService, setrepo: SettingsRepo, state: StateStore,
                responder, api, cfg, ctx: Ctx, lid: int, method: str) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    lk = frepo.link(lid)
    err = fin.link_error(lk, psvc.clock.ts() if psvc.clock else 0.0)
    if user is None or err or method not in fin.link_methods(lk):
        responder.reply(ctx, err or "err_generic")
        return "plm-bad"
    step, raw = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    d = dict(raw or {}) if step == "pl_wiz" else {}
    base = lk.amount if lk.amount_mode != PL_OPEN else int(d.get("amount")
                                                           or 0)
    if not fin.check_open_amount(lk, base) if lk.amount_mode == PL_OPEN \
            else base <= 0:
        responder.reply(ctx, "pl_amount_bad")
        return "plm-amount"
    bd = fin.breakdown(setrepo, method, base)
    tx_id = frepo.open_tx_for(lid, user.id)
    if tx_id is None:
        tx_id = frepo.open_tx(lid, user.id, base, bd.fee + bd.infra,
                              bd.total, name=d.get("name", ""),
                              mobile=d.get("mobile", ""),
                              note=d.get("note", ""))
    else:
        frepo.set_tx(tx_id, amount=base, fee=bd.fee + bd.infra,
                     total=bd.total, method=method)
    pay = payrepo.create(user.id, method, base, target_kind="link",
                         target_id=tx_id, fee=bd.fee, infra=bd.infra)
    frepo.set_tx(tx_id, payment_id=pay.id, method=method)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    if method == M_GATEWAY:
        api.call("sendInvoice", chat_id=ctx.chat_id,
                 title=(lk.title or t("btn_fin_links"))[:32],
                 description=(lk.descr or "")[:255], payload=str(pay.id),
                 provider_token=cfg.pay_token,
                 prices=_invoice_prices(payrepo, pay))
        responder.reply(ctx, "pay_invoice_sent")
        return "plm-gateway"
    if method == M_CARD:
        from .pay import STEP_PHOTO
        if not _card_block(psvc, setrepo, responder, ctx, pay):
            for admin_id in cfg.admin_ids:
                responder.bulk(admin_id, "pay_card_unset_alert")
            responder.reply(ctx, "pay_card_unset")
            return "plm-nocard"
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_PHOTO, {"pid": pay.id}, merge=False)
        return "plm-card"
    responder.reply(ctx, "pay_onsite_ok")
    return "plm-onsite"
