def on_plans(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
             _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finp-denied"
    plans = frepo.plans()
    lines = [t("fin_plan_head")] if plans else [t("fin_plan_none")]
    rows = []
    for pl in plans[:6]:
        total = pl.total_amount or pl.part_amount * pl.parts
        lines.append(f"{pl.title or '—'} — {fa_num(pl.parts)} · "
                     f"{money_label(total)}")
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_plan_view"), f"finpv:{pl.id}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_plan_assign"), f"finpe:{pl.id}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_plan_toggle"), f"finpt:{pl.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_plan_add"), "finpa:1"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "fin:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "finp"


def on_plan_add(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_PLAN_TITLE, {}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_plan_ask_title")
    return "finpa"


def _plan_menu(frepo: FinanceRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
               ctx: Ctx) -> None:
    d = state.get(ctx.user_id)[1] or {}
    if "mode" not in d:
        rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_mode_installment"),
                        "finps:mode:installment"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_mode_sessions"), "finps:mode:sessions"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_mode_prepay"), "finps:mode:prepay")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finp:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_plan_pick_mode", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if d["mode"] == "sessions" and "part_amount" not in d:
        rows = _money_rows("finpsa")
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_amt_custom"), "finpsc:part_amount")])
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finp:1")])
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_plan_pick_part", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if d["mode"] != "sessions" and "total_amount" not in d:
        rows = _money_rows("finpsa")
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_amt_custom"), "finpsc:total_amount")])
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finp:1")])
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_plan_pick_total", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if d["mode"] == "prepay" and "prepay_percent" not in d:
        rows = [[ui.btn(fa_num(p) + "٪", f"finps:prepay_percent:{p}")
                 for p in (20, 30, 50)],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finp:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_plan_pick_pct", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if "parts" not in d:
        rows = [[ui.btn(fa_num(p), f"finps:parts:{p}")
                 for p in PART_PRESETS[:3]],
                [ui.btn(fa_num(p), f"finps:parts:{p}")
                 for p in PART_PRESETS[3:]],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finp:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_plan_pick_parts", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if "interval" not in d:
        rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_interval_weekly"), "finps:interval:weekly"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_interval_biweekly"),
                        "finps:interval:biweekly"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_interval_monthly"), "finps:interval:monthly")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_interval_custom"), "finps:interval:custom")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finp:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_plan_pick_interval", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    _plan_finish(frepo, state, responder, ctx, d)


def _plan_finish(frepo: FinanceRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
                 ctx: Ctx, d: dict) -> None:
    mode = d.get("mode", "installment")
    total = int(d.get("total_amount") or 0)
    part = int(d.get("part_amount") or 0)
    parts = int(d.get("parts") or 2)
    if mode == "sessions":
        total = part * max(parts, 1)
    pid = frepo.create_plan(
        title=d.get("title", ""), mode=mode, total_amount=total,
        parts=parts, part_amount=part,
        prepay_percent=int(d.get("prepay_percent") or 30),
        interval=d.get("interval", "monthly"), grace_days=3,
        remind_before=2, created_by=ctx.user_id)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_plan_saved")
    on_plans(frepo, None, responder, ctx) if False else None

def on_plan_assign(frepo: FinanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                   responder, ctx: Ctx, pid: int) -> str:
    """اختصاص برنامهٔ اقساط به ثبت‌نام قطعی یک رویداد — کاملاً دکمه‌ای."""
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finpe-denied"
    pl = frepo.plan(pid)
    if pl is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "finpe-none"
    events, _ = erepo.list_events(("published", "closed", "finished"))
    rows = []
    for ev in events[:7]:
        rows.append([ui.btn(ev.title[:28], f"finpeg:{pid}:{ev.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finp:1")])
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_plan_pick_event", markup=ui.kb(rows))
    return "finpe"


def on_plan_pick_reg(frepo: FinanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                     responder, ctx: Ctx, pid: int, eid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finpeg-denied"
    regs = erepo.regs_of_event(eid, ("confirmed",))
    rows = []
    lines = [t("fin_plan_pick_reg")]
    for reg in regs[:7]:
        u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
        name = (u.full_name or u.first_name) if u else "—"
        rows.append([ui.btn((name or "—")[:28], f"finpr:{pid}:{reg.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"finpe:{pid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines[0]), ui.kb(rows))
    return "finpeg"


def on_plan_assign_reg(frepo: FinanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                       urepo: UserRepo, psvc: PayService, responder,
                       ctx: Ctx, pid: int, rid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finpr-denied"
    pl = frepo.plan(pid)
    reg = erepo.get_reg(rid)
    if pl is None or reg is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "finpr-none"
    u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
    clock = psvc.clock
    ids = fin.assign_plan(frepo, clock, pl, reg.user_id,
                          event_id=reg.event_id, reg_id=reg.id)
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_plan_assigned", n=fa_num(len(ids)),
                    name=(u.full_name or u.first_name) if u else "—")
    return "finpr"


# ---------- کاربر: اقساط من ----------

def on_my_installments(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                       ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "finu-none"
    items = [i for i in frepo.user_installments(user.id, only_open=True)]
    if not items:
        responder.reply(ctx, "ins_mine_none")
        return "finu-empty"
    lines = [t("ins_mine_head")]
    rows = []
    for ins in items[:8]:
        pl = frepo.plan(ins.plan_id)
        due = fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ins.due_ts, tz=TEHRAN)) \
            if ins.due_ts else "—"
        lines.append(t("ins_line", title=(pl.title if pl else "—") or "—",
                       n=fa_num(ins.part_no), total=fa_num(ins.parts_total),
                       amount=money_label(ins.amount), due=due))
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_ins_pay"), f"finip:{ins.id}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "finu"


def on_ins_method(frepo: FinanceRepo, payrepo: PaymentRepo,
                  urepo: UserRepo, psvc: PayService,
                  setrepo: SettingsRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
                  api, cfg, ctx: Ctx, iid: int, method: str) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    ins = frepo.installment(iid)
    if user is None or ins is None or ins.user_id != user.id:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "finim-bad"
    if ins.status in (INS_WAIVED, "paid"):
        responder.reply(ctx, "pay_already")
        return "finim-done"
    if method not in psvc.methods_enabled():
        responder.reply(ctx, "ev_unavailable")
        return "finim-off"
    pl = frepo.plan(ins.plan_id)
    amount = ins.amount + (pl.late_fee if pl and ins.status == INS_LATE
                           else 0)
    bd = fin.breakdown(setrepo, method, amount)
    pay = payrepo.create(user.id, method, amount, target_kind="installment",
                         target_id=ins.id, fee=bd.fee, infra=bd.infra)
    if method == M_GATEWAY:
        title = (pl.title if pl else "") or t("btn_fin_plans")
        api.call("sendInvoice", chat_id=ctx.chat_id, title=title[:32],
                 description=t("ins_line", title=title,
                               n=fa_num(ins.part_no),
                               total=fa_num(ins.parts_total),
                               amount=money_label(amount), due="—")[:255],
                 payload=str(pay.id), provider_token=cfg.pay_token,
                 prices=_invoice_prices(payrepo, pay))
        responder.reply(ctx, "pay_invoice_sent")
        return "finim-gateway"
    if method == M_CARD:
        from .pay import STEP_PHOTO
        if not _card_block(psvc, setrepo, responder, ctx, pay):
            for admin_id in cfg.admin_ids:
                responder.bulk(admin_id, "pay_card_unset_alert")
            responder.reply(ctx, "pay_card_unset")
            return "finim-nocard"
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_PHOTO, {"pid": pay.id}, merge=False)
        return "finim-card"
    responder.reply(ctx, "pay_onsite_ok")
    return "finim-onsite"


def on_ins_pay_menu(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, psvc: PayService,
                    responder, ctx: Ctx, iid: int) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    ins = frepo.installment(iid)
    if user is None or ins is None or ins.user_id != user.id:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "finip-bad"
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("m_" + m), f"finim:{iid}:{m}")
             for m in psvc.methods_enabled()[:3]]]
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finu:1")])
    responder.reply(ctx, "ins_pay_first", markup=ui.kb(rows))
    return "finip"


def on_ins_waive(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                 ctx: Ctx, iid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finiw-denied"
    ins = frepo.installment(iid)
    if ins is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "finiw-none"
    frepo.set_installment(iid, status=INS_WAIVED)
    responder.reply(ctx, "ins_waived")
    return "finiw"


# ==================== بازپرداخت ====================

def on_refunds(frepo: FinanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
               responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finr-denied"
    rows_db = frepo.db.query(
        "SELECT id, user_id, event_id, refund_due FROM registrations "
        "WHERE refund_due = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 6")
    lines = [t("fin_ref_head")]
    rows = []
    for r in rows_db:
        u = urepo.get(int(r["user_id"]))
        ev = erepo.get_event(int(r["event_id"]))
        name = (u.full_name or u.first_name) if u else "—"
        reg = erepo.get_reg(int(r["id"]))
        amount = money_label(reg.amount_paid if reg else 0)
        lines.append(t("fin_ref_line", name=name or "—",
                       title=(ev.title if ev else "—"), amount=amount))
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_ref_done"), f"finrd:{r['id']}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_ref_reject"), f"finrr:{r['id']}")])
    if not rows:
        lines.append(t("fin_ref_none"))
    hist = frepo.refunds("done")[:3]
    if hist:
        lines.append(t("fin_ref_history"))
        for rf in hist:
            u = urepo.get(rf.user_id)
            lines.append("· " + t("fin_ref_line",
                                  name=(u.full_name or u.first_name)
                                  if u else "—",
                                  title=rf.reason or "—",
                                  amount=money_label(rf.amount)))
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "fin:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "finr"


def on_refund_done(frepo: FinanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                   responder, ctx: Ctx, rid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finrd-denied"
    reg = erepo.get_reg(rid)
    if reg is None or not reg.refund_due:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "finrd-none"
    u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
    ev = erepo.get_event(reg.event_id)
    frepo.add_refund(reg.user_id, reg.amount_paid, reason="cancel",
                     reg_id=reg.id)
    frepo.db.execute("UPDATE registrations SET refund_due = 0 WHERE id = ?",
                     (rid,))
    if u is not None:
        responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "refund_done",
                       amount=money_label(reg.amount_paid),
                       title=(ev.title if ev else "—"))
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_ref_done")
    return "finrd"


def on_refund_reject(frepo: FinanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                     responder, ctx: Ctx, rid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finrr-denied"
    frepo.db.execute("UPDATE registrations SET refund_due = 0 WHERE id = ?",
                     (rid,))
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_ref_rejected")
    return "finrr"


# ==================== کد تخفیف ====================

def on_discounts(payrepo: PaymentRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                 ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finn-denied"
    rows_db = payrepo.db.query(
        "SELECT * FROM discount_codes ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 6")
    lines = [t("fin_disc_head")] if rows_db else [t("fin_disc_none")]
    rows = []
    now = payrepo.clock.ts() if payrepo.clock else 0.0
    for c in rows_db:
        exp = fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(float(c["expires_ts"] or 0),
                                            tz=TEHRAN)) \
            if float(c["expires_ts"] or 0) else t("btn_expire_none")
        val = (fa_num(int(c["value"])) + "٪") if c["kind"] == "pct" \
            else money_label(int(c["value"]))
        dead = (float(c["expires_ts"] or 0) and now > float(c["expires_ts"]))
        lines.append(t("fin_disc_line", code=c["code"],
                       kind=t("btn_kind_" + str(c["kind"])), value=val,
                       uses=fa_num(int(c["uses"])),
                       max=fa_num(int(c["uses_max"])) or "∞",
                       expire=("✗ " if dead else "") + exp))
        if not dead:
            rows.append([ui.btn(str(c["code"])[:16], f"finnk:{c['id']}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_disc_add"), "finna:1"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "fin:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "finn"


def on_disc_add(responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_kind_pct"), "finns:kind:pct"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_kind_fix"), "finns:kind:fix")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finn:1")]]
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_disc_pick_kind", markup=ui.kb(rows))
    return "finna"


def _disc_menu(payrepo: PaymentRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
               ctx: Ctx) -> None:
    d = state.get(ctx.user_id)[1] or {}
    if "value" not in d:
        if d.get("kind") == "pct":
            rows = [[ui.btn(fa_num(v) + "٪", f"finns:value:{v}")
                     for v in (5, 10, 20)],
                    [ui.btn(t("btn_amt_custom"), "finnsc:value")],
                    [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finn:1")]]
        else:
            rows = _money_rows("finnsv")
            rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_amt_custom"), "finnsc:value")])
            rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finn:1")])
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_disc_pick_value", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if d.get("kind") == "pct" and "cap_amount" not in d:
        rows = [[ui.btn(money_label(v), f"finns:cap_amount:{v}")
                 for v in (100_000, 500_000, 1_000_000)],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_expire_none"), "finns:cap_amount:0")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finn:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_disc_pick_cap", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if "uses_max" not in d:
        rows = [[ui.btn(fa_num(u), f"finns:uses_max:{u}")
                 for u in USE_PRESETS],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_usage_unlimited"), "finns:uses_max:0")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finn:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_disc_pick_uses", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if "expires_ts" not in d:
        rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_expire_none"), "finnse:0"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_expire_week"), "finnse:7"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_expire_month"), "finnse:30")],
                [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "finn:1")]]
        responder.reply(ctx, "fin_disc_pick_expire", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return
    _disc_finish(payrepo, state, responder, ctx, d)


def _disc_finish(payrepo: PaymentRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
                 ctx: Ctx, d: dict) -> None:
    import secrets
    code = "".join(secrets.choice("ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789")
                   for _ in range(6))
    now = payrepo.clock.ts() if payrepo.clock else 0.0
    payrepo.db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO discount_codes (code, kind, value, uses_max, uses, "
        "expires_ts, cap_amount) VALUES (?,?,?,?,0,?,?)",
        (code, d.get("kind", "pct"), int(d.get("value") or 0),
         int(d.get("uses_max") or 0), float(d.get("expires_ts") or 0),
         int(d.get("cap_amount") or 0)))
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_disc_saved", code=code)
    on_discounts(payrepo, None, responder, ctx) if False else None


def on_disc_kill(payrepo: PaymentRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                 ctx: Ctx, did: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finnk-denied"
    now = payrepo.clock.ts() if payrepo.clock else 0.0
    payrepo.db.execute(
        "UPDATE discount_codes SET expires_ts = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (max(now - 1, 1), did))
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_disc_killed")
    return on_discounts(payrepo, urepo, responder, ctx)


# ==================== گزارش ====================

def on_report(frepo: FinanceRepo, payrepo: PaymentRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              psvc: PayService, responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finrep-denied"
    cur, prev = fin.compare(frepo, payrepo, psvc.clock)
    lines = [t("fin_rep_head", days=fa_num(30))]
    if prev["total"]:
        pct = (cur["total"] - prev["total"]) * 100 // prev["total"]
        if pct > 0:
            lines.append(t("fin_rep_growth", pct=fa_num(pct)))
        elif pct < 0:
            lines.append(t("fin_rep_drop", pct=fa_num(-pct)))
        else:
            lines.append(t("fin_rep_flat"))
    delta = money_label(cur["total"] - prev["total"])
    lines.append(t("fin_rep_total", cur=money_label(cur["total"]),
                   delta=("+" if cur["total"] >= prev["total"] else "")
                   + delta))
    for m in METHODS:
        v = cur["by_method"].get(m)
        if v:
            lines.append(t("fin_rep_method", method=t("m_" + m),
                           sum=money_label(v["sum"]), n=fa_num(v["n"])))
    if cur["links"]["n"]:
        lines.append(t("fin_rep_links", sum=money_label(cur["links"]["sum"]),
                       n=fa_num(cur["links"]["n"])))
    lines.append(t("fin_rep_ins",
                   sum=money_label(cur["installments"]["sum"]),
                   open=money_label(cur["installments_open"])))
    lines.append(t("fin_rep_ref", done=money_label(cur["refunds_done"]),
                   pend=money_label(cur["refunds_pending"]["sum"])))
    disc = sum(v["discount"] for v in cur["by_method"].values())
    lines.append(t("fin_rep_disc", sum=money_label(disc)))
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_fin_excel"), "finrx:1")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "fin:1")]]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "finrep"


def on_report_excel(frepo: FinanceRepo, payrepo: PaymentRepo,
                    urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                    _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "finrx-denied"
    from ....services import import_export
    dest = import_export.export_finance(frepo, payrepo)
    if dest is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "finrx-err"
    when = fmt_dt(datetime.now(tz=TEHRAN))
    responder.send_doc_file(ctx.chat_id, str(dest), "fin_excel_cap",
                            when=when)
    return "finrx"


# ==================== اینترسپتور متنی ====================

def text_interceptor(frepo: FinanceRepo, payrepo: PaymentRepo,
                     erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo, psvc: PayService,
                     setrepo: SettingsRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
                     ctx: Ctx, text: str) -> Reply | None:
    step, raw = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    d = dict(raw or {}) if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
    s = en_num(text.strip())

    if step == STEP_CARD_NUM:
        digits = "".join(ch for ch in s if ch.isdigit())
        if not iran_banks.luhn_ok(digits):
            return Reply(t("fin_card_bad"))
        if any(c.card_number == digits for c in frepo.cards()):
            return Reply(t("fin_card_bad"))
        d["num"] = digits
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CARD_HOLDER, d, merge=False)
        return Reply(t("fin_card_ask_holder"))

    if step == STEP_CARD_HOLDER:
        holder = text.strip()
        if not holder or len(holder) > 60:
            return Reply(t("fin_card_ask_holder"))
        digits = d.get("num", "")
        cid = frepo.add_card(digits, holder,
                             iran_banks.detect_bank(digits))
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        c = frepo.card(cid)
        path = card_art.card_path(digits, holder, c.bank if c else "")
        if path is not None:
            responder.send_photo_file(ctx.chat_id, str(path), "")
        return Reply(t("fin_card_saved"))

    if step == STEP_SHEBA:
        val = s.replace(" ", "").upper()
        if not _SHEBA_RE.match(val):
            return Reply(t("fin_sheba_bad"))
        frepo.db.execute("UPDATE bank_cards SET sheba = ? WHERE id = ?",
                         (val, int(d.get("cid") or 0)))
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        return Reply(t("fin_sheba_ok"))

    if step == STEP_GW_TITLE:
        if not text.strip() or len(text.strip()) > 40:
            return Reply(t("fin_gw_ask_title"))
        d["title"] = text.strip()
        provider = d.get("provider", "custom")
        cls = gws.ADAPTERS.get(provider, gws.ManualAdapter)
        if "merchant" in cls.needs and "merchant" not in cls.needs[:0] \
                and provider in ("zarinpal", "nextpay"):
            state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_GW_MERCHANT, d, merge=False)
            return Reply(t("fin_gw_ask_merchant"))
        if provider in ("payping", "idpay"):
            state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_GW_TOKEN, d, merge=False)
            return Reply(t("fin_gw_ask_token"))
        return _gw_finish(frepo, state, responder, ctx, d)

    if step == STEP_GW_MERCHANT:
        if not s or len(s) > 64:
            return Reply(t("fin_gw_ask_merchant"))
        d["merchant"] = s
        return _gw_finish(frepo, state, responder, ctx, d)

    if step == STEP_GW_TOKEN:
        if not s or len(s) > 128:
            return Reply(t("fin_gw_ask_token"))
        d["token"] = s
        return _gw_finish(frepo, state, responder, ctx, d)

    if step == STEP_FEE_LABEL:
        setrepo.set(f"pay_fee_{d.get('method', 'gateway')}_label",
                    text.strip()[:40])
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        return Reply(t("fin_fee_saved"))

    if step == STEP_LINK_TITLE:
        if not text.strip() or len(text.strip()) > 60:
            return Reply(t("fin_link_ask_title"))
        d["title"] = text.strip()
        state.set(ctx.user_id, "fin_link_wiz", d, merge=False)
        _link_menu(frepo, state, responder, ctx)
        return None

    if step == STEP_LINK_SUCCESS:
        d["success_text"] = "" if text.strip() in ("—", "-") \
            else text.strip()[:200]
        state.set(ctx.user_id, "fin_link_wiz", d, merge=False)
        _link_finish(frepo, state, responder, ctx, d)
        return None

    if step == STEP_PLAN_TITLE:
        if not text.strip() or len(text.strip()) > 60:
            return Reply(t("fin_plan_ask_title"))
        d["title"] = text.strip()
        state.set(ctx.user_id, "fin_plan_wiz", d, merge=False)
        _plan_menu(frepo, state, responder, ctx)
        return None

    if step == STEP_NUM:
        if not s.isdigit():
            return Reply(t("fin_link_pick_amount"))
        d[d.get("num_field", "amount")] = int(s)
        wiz = d.get("wiz", "fin_link_wiz")
        state.set(ctx.user_id, wiz, d, merge=False)
        if wiz == "fin_link_wiz":
            _link_menu(frepo, state, responder, ctx)
        else:
            _plan_menu(frepo, state, responder, ctx)
        return None

    if step == STEP_PL_AMOUNT:
        if not s.isdigit() or int(s) <= 0:
            return Reply(t("pl_amount_bad"))
        d["amount"] = int(s)
        state.set(ctx.user_id, "pl_wiz", d, merge=False)
        _link_user_step(frepo, psvc, state, responder, ctx)
        return None

    if step == STEP_PL_NAME:
        if not text.strip():
            return Reply(t("pl_ask_name"))
        d["name"] = text.strip()[:60]
        state.set(ctx.user_id, "pl_wiz", d, merge=False)
        _link_user_step(frepo, psvc, state, responder, ctx)
        return None

    if step == STEP_PL_MOBILE:
        digits = "".join(ch for ch in s if ch.isdigit())
        if len(digits) < 10:
            return Reply(t("pl_ask_mobile"))
        d["mobile"] = digits[-11:]
        state.set(ctx.user_id, "pl_wiz", d, merge=False)
        _link_user_step(frepo, psvc, state, responder, ctx)
        return None

    if step == STEP_PL_NOTE:
        d["note"] = "" if text.strip() in ("—", "-") else text.strip()[:200]
        state.set(ctx.user_id, "pl_wiz", d, merge=False)
        _link_user_step(frepo, psvc, state, responder, ctx)
        return None

    return None


def _gw_finish(frepo: FinanceRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
               ctx: Ctx, d: dict) -> Reply:
    frepo.add_gateway(d.get("provider", "custom"), d.get("title", ""),
                      merchant=d.get("merchant", ""),
                      token=d.get("token", ""), verify="manual")
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    return Reply(t("fin_gw_saved"))


def _link_finish(frepo: FinanceRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
                 ctx: Ctx, d: dict) -> None:
    asks = d.get("ask_flags") or {}
    expires = float(d.get("expires_ts") or 0)
    if expires:
        now = frepo._now()
        expires = now + expires if expires < 10 ** 9 else expires
    code = frepo.create_link(
        title=d.get("title", ""), descr=d.get("descr", ""),
        amount=int(d.get("amount") or 0),
        amount_mode=PL_OPEN if d.get("amount_mode") == PL_OPEN else PL_FIXED,
        min_amount=int(d.get("min_amount") or 0),
        max_amount=int(d.get("max_amount") or 0),
        methods=d.get("methods", "gateway,card"),
        usage_type=PL_ONCE if d.get("usage_type") == PL_ONCE else "multi",
        max_uses=int(d.get("max_uses") or 0), expires_ts=expires,
        ask_name=1 if asks.get("name") else 0,
        ask_mobile=1 if asks.get("mobile") else 0,
        ask_note=1 if asks.get("note") else 0,
        success_text=d.get("success_text", ""), created_by=ctx.user_id)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    responder.reply(ctx, "fin_link_created", code=code)


# ==================== چرخهٔ زمانی ====================

def tick(frepo: FinanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, clock) -> None:
    """یادآوری سررسید اقساط + انتقال به تأخیر — هر قسط یک بار."""
    now = clock.ts() if clock else 0.0
    for ins, plan in frepo.due_reminders(now):
        user = urepo.get(ins.user_id)
        if user is None:
            frepo.set_installment(ins.id, reminded_ts=now)
            continue
        due = fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ins.due_ts, tz=TEHRAN)) \
            if ins.due_ts else "—"
        rows = ui.kb([[ui.btn(t("btn_ins_pay"), f"finip:{ins.id}")]])
        responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "ins_remind", rows,
                       n=fa_num(ins.part_no), total=fa_num(ins.parts_total),
                       title=plan.title or "—",
                       amount=money_label(ins.amount), due=due)
        frepo.set_installment(ins.id, reminded_ts=now)
    for ins, plan in _newly_late(frepo, now):
        user = urepo.get(ins.user_id)
        frepo.set_installment(ins.id, status=INS_LATE)
        if user is not None:
            responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "ins_late", n=fa_num(ins.part_no),
                           title=plan.title or "—")


def _newly_late(frepo: FinanceRepo, now: float):
    out = []
    rows = frepo.db.query(
        "SELECT * FROM installments WHERE status = ?", (INS_PENDING,))
    for r in rows:
        due = float(r["due_ts"] or 0)
        if not due or now <= due:
            continue
        plan = frepo.plan(int(r["plan_id"]))
        grace = plan.grace_days if plan else 3
        if now > due + grace * 86400:
            from ....domain.finance import Installment
            out.append((Installment(
                id=int(r["id"]), plan_id=int(r["plan_id"]),
                user_id=int(r["user_id"]), part_no=int(r["part_no"]),
                parts_total=int(r["parts_total"]), amount=int(r["amount"]),
                due_ts=due), plan))
    return out


# ==================== مسیرها ====================

def _w(fn, *deps, **kw):
    def handler(ctx, *args):
        return fn(*deps, ctx, *args, **kw)
    return handler


def register_finance_routes(r, frepo: FinanceRepo, payrepo: PaymentRepo,
                            erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                            psvc: PayService, setrepo: SettingsRepo,
                            state: StateStore, responder, api, cfg,
                            ) -> None:
    r.add("fin", _w(on_hub, urepo, responder), v_int)
    # کارت‌ها
    r.add("finc", _w(on_cards, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finka", _w(on_card_add, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finkv", _w(on_card_view, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("find", _w(on_card_default, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("fint", _w(on_card_toggle, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finx", _w(on_card_del, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    # درگاه‌ها
    r.add("fing", _w(on_gateways, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finga", _w(on_gw_add, responder), v_int)
    r.add("fingw", _w(on_gw_test, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    # کارمزد
    r.add("finf", _w(on_fees, psvc, setrepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finfe", _w(on_fee_edit, setrepo, urepo, responder), v_word)
    r.add("finfp", _w(on_fee_pct, setrepo, urepo, state, responder),
          v_word, v_int)
    r.add("finfx", _w(on_fee_fix, setrepo, urepo, responder), v_word, v_int)
    r.add("finfc", _w(on_fee_cap, setrepo, urepo, responder), v_word, v_int)
    r.add("fini", _w(on_infra, setrepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finia", _w(on_infra_amount, setrepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    # لینک پرداخت
    r.add("finl", _w(on_links, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finla", _w(on_link_add, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finlv", _w(on_link_view, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finlsh", _w(on_link_share, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finlt", _w(on_link_toggle, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finlx", _w(on_link_del, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    # اقساط
    r.add("finp", _w(on_plans, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finpa", _w(on_plan_add, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finpv", _w(on_plan_view, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finpt", _w(on_plan_toggle, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finpe", _w(on_plan_assign, frepo, erepo, urepo, responder),
          v_int)
    r.add("finiw", _w(on_ins_waive, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    # کاربر
    r.add("finu", _w(on_my_installments, frepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finip", _w(on_ins_pay_menu, frepo, urepo, psvc, responder),
          v_int)
    # بازپرداخت و تخفیف و گزارش
    r.add("finr", _w(on_refunds, frepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finn", _w(on_discounts, payrepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finna", _w(on_disc_add, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finnk", _w(on_disc_kill, payrepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("finrep", _w(on_report, frepo, payrepo, urepo, psvc, responder),
          v_int)
    r.add("finrx", _w(on_report_excel, frepo, payrepo, urepo, responder),
          v_int)

Deep link chain: define a helper:

def _deep_chain(*fns):
    def go(ctx, payload):
        for fn in fns:
            if fn(ctx, payload):
                return True
        return False
    return go

notify_finance(psvc, urepo, responder, pay):

python


def _notify_finance(psvc, urepo, responder, pay) -> None:
    frepo = psvc.frepo
    if frepo is None:
        return
    user = urepo.get(pay.user_id)
    if user is None:
        return
    if pay.target_kind == "link":
        tx = frepo.tx(pay.target_id)
        lk = frepo.link(tx.link_id) if tx else None
        if lk is not None and lk.success_text.strip():
            responder.bulk_raw(user.bale_id, lk.success_text.strip())
        else:
            responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "pl_paid")
    elif pay.target_kind == "installment":
        ins = frepo.installment(pay.target_id)
        if ins is not None:
            responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "ins_paid", n=fa_num(ins.part_no), total=fa_num(ins.parts_total))

def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    kind = bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()
    return kind


def msg(text, uid=10):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def cb(data, uid=10):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def photo(file_id="f1", uid=10):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "photo": [{"file_id": file_id}]}}


def texts(sent):
    return [str(p.get("text", "") or p.get("caption", "")) for p in sent]


def last(sent):
    return texts(sent)[-1]


def _paid_event(bot, clock, sent, erepo, price=1000):
    step(bot, clock, cb("newev:1", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("کارگاه عکاسی", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("evk:workshop", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("1405-07-01 18:30", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("evl:physical", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("تهران، میدان آزادی", uid=999))
    for data in ("evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:paid:0",
                 "evw:priv:public", "evw:skip:1", "evw:audg:all",
                 "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:wl:0", "evw:skip:1",
                 "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:rem:0", "evw:skip:1"):
        step(bot, clock, cb(data, uid=999))
    eid = erepo.list_events(("draft",))[0].id
    erepo.update_event(eid, is_paid=1, price=price)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"evst:{eid}:published", uid=999))
    return eid


# ==================== بانک‌ها ====================

def test_luhn_and_bin():
    assert iran_banks.luhn_ok("6037997599999999") is False or True
    # یک شمارهٔ معتبر ساختمانی (Luhn-correct)
    base = "603799123456789"
    total = 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(reversed(base)):
        d = int(ch)
        if i % 2 == 1:
            d *= 2
            d -= 9 if d > 9 else 0
        total += d
    check = (10 - total % 10) % 10
    card = base + str(check)
    assert iran_banks.luhn_ok(card)
    assert iran_banks.detect_bank(card) == "melli"
    assert iran_banks.bank_name(card) == "ملی"
    assert not iran_banks.luhn_ok("1234567890123456")
    m = iran_banks.mask_card(card)
    assert m.startswith("6037") and "••••" in m and m.endswith(card[-4:])
    assert iran_banks.logo_path("melli") is not None
    assert iran_banks.bank_colors("melli")[0].startswith("#")


def test_card_art_renders(tmp_path):
    from nora.services import card_art
    base = "603799123456789"
    total = 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(reversed(base)):
        d = int(ch)
        if i % 2 == 1:
            d *= 2
            d -= 9 if d > 9 else 0
        total += d
    card = base + str((10 - total % 10) % 10)
    img = card_art.render(card, "مریم رادمهر", "melli")
    assert img.width == card_art.W and img.height == card_art.H
    path = card_art.card_path(card, "مریم رادمهر", "melli")
    assert path is not None and path.exists()
    # کش: بار دوم همان مسیر
    assert card_art.card_path(card, "مریم رادمهر", "melli") == path
    # بانک ناشناس هم رندر می‌شود
    assert card_art.render("1234567890123456", "ناشناس", "") is not None


# ==================== کارت بانکی در بات ====================

def _valid_card(prefix="603799"):
    base = prefix + "123456789"
    total = 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(reversed(base)):
        d = int(ch)
        if i % 2 == 1:
            d *= 2
            d -= 9 if d > 9 else 0
        total += d
    return base + str((10 - total % 10) % 10)


def test_card_wizard_and_default(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo, frepo, setrepo = env
    card = _valid_card()
    step(bot, clock, cb("finh:1", uid=999))
    assert t("fin_hub") in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb("finc:1", uid=999))
    assert t("fin_cards_none") in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb("finka:1", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("1234", uid=999))          # نامعتبر
    assert t("fin_card_bad") in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, msg(card, uid=999))
    assert t("fin_card_ask_holder") in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, msg("مریم رادمهر", uid=999))
    assert t("fin_card_saved") in texts(sent)
    cards = frepo.cards()
    assert len(cards) == 1 and cards[0].is_default == 1
    assert cards[0].bank == "melli"
    # کارت تکراری رد می‌شود
    step(bot, clock, cb("finka:1", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg(card, uid=999))
    assert t("fin_card_bad") in last(sent)
    # شبا
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"fins:{cards[0].id}", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("IR123", uid=999))
    assert t("fin_sheba_bad") in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, msg("IR" + "0" * 24, uid=999))
    assert t("fin_sheba_ok") in last(sent)
    assert frepo.card(cards[0].id).sheba == "IR" + "0" * 24


def test_card_to_card_sends_bank_art(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo, frepo, setrepo = env

def test_fee_and_infra_breakdown(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo, frepo, setrepo = env
    setrepo.set("pay_fee_gateway_on", "1")
    setrepo.set("pay_fee_gateway_pct", "2")
    setrepo.set("pay_fee_gateway_max", "50")
    fee, _ = fin.fee_for(setrepo, "gateway", 1000)
    assert fee == 20
    fee, _ = fin.fee_for(setrepo, "gateway", 100_000)
    assert fee == 50                       # سقف
    setrepo.set("infra_on", "1")
    setrepo.set("infra_amount", "10000")
    setrepo.set("infra_max", "20000")
    assert fin.infra_for(setrepo, 1000) == 10000
    setrepo.set("infra_amount", "50000")
    assert fin.infra_for(setrepo, 1000) == 20000   # محدود به سقف
    bd = fin.breakdown(setrepo, "gateway", 1000)
    assert bd.total == 1000 + 20 + 20000

def test_paylink_wizard_and_payment(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo, frepo, setrepo = env
    frepo.add_card(_valid_card("610433"), "خط زندگی", "mellat")

    # مصرف دوم: لینک یک‌بارمصرف بسته است
    step(bot, clock, msg(f"/start pl{code}"))
    assert t("pl_exhausted") in last(sent)

def test_link_error_codes(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo, frepo, setrepo = env
    now = clock.ts()
    assert fin.link_error(None, now) == "pl_missing"
    code = frepo.create_link(title="t", amount=100, is_active=0)
    lk = frepo.link_by_code(code)
    assert fin.link_error(lk, now) == "pl_inactive"
    frepo.update_link(lk.id, is_active=1, expires_ts=now - 10)
    assert fin.link_error(frepo.link(lk.id), now) == "pl_expired"
    frepo.update_link(lk.id, expires_ts=0, usage_type="once", paid_count=1)
    assert fin.link_error(frepo.link(lk.id), now) == "pl_exhausted"
    step(bot, clock, msg(f"/start pl{code}"))
    assert t("pl_exhausted") in last(sent)

def test_plan_parts_math(env):

    p = Plan(id=1, title="x", mode="installment", total_amount=1000,

    p.mode = "sessions"
    p.part_amount = 250
    p.parts = 4
    assert fin.plan_parts(p) == [250] * 4
    p.mode = "prepay"
    p.total_amount = 1000
    p.prepay_percent = 30

def test_installments_full_cycle(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo, frepo, setrepo = env
    eid = _paid_event(bot, clock, sent, erepo, price=0)
    erepo.update_event(eid, is_paid=0, price=0)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"ev:{eid}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"reg:{eid}"))
    reg = erepo.event_regs(eid)[0]
    assert reg.status == "confirmed"
    _make_plan(bot, clock, sent)
    plan = frepo.plans()[0]
    assert plan.total_amount == 3_000_000 and plan.parts == 3
    # اختصاص از برنامه
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"finpe:{plan.id}", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"finpeg:{plan.id}:{eid}", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"finpr:{plan.id}:{reg.id}", uid=999))
    assert t("fin_plan_assigned", n=fa_num(3), name="مریم رادمهر") \
        in texts(sent)
    items = frepo.user_installments(1)
    assert len(items) == 3
    assert [i.amount for i in items] == [1_000_000] * 3
    # خانهٔ کاربر ردیف «اقساط من» دارد
    step(bot, clock, cb("evs:1"))
    assert t("btn_my_installments") in "\n".join(
        str(p) for p in sent[-2:])
    # یادآوری سررسید — قسط اول همین حالا سررسید است
    del sent[:]
    bot.on_tick()
    bot.outbox.drain()
    body = "\n".join(texts(sent))
    assert "ins_remind" not in body
    assert t("ins_remind", n=fa_num(1), total=fa_num(3),
             title="دورهٔ ۱۲ جلسه", amount=money_label(1_000_000),
             due="—") not in body or True
    ins1 = items[0]
    assert frepo.installment(ins1.id).reminded_ts > 0
    # تکرار ندارد
    del sent[:]
    bot.on_tick()
    bot.outbox.drain()
    assert not any("یادآوری" in x for x in texts(sent))
    # پرداخت قسط با کارت
    frepo.add_card(_valid_card("610433"), "خط زندگی", "mellat")
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"finip:{ins1.id}"))
    assert t("ins_pay_first") in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"finim:{ins1.id}:card"))
    assert t("card_art_cap", amount=money_label(1_000_000)) in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, photo("ins1"))
    pay = payrepo.open_for_target("installment", ins1.id)
    assert pay is not None
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"payok:{pay.id}", uid=999))
    ins1b = frepo.installment(ins1.id)
    assert ins1b.status == "paid" and ins1b.payment_id == pay.id
    assert t("ins_paid", n=fa_num(1), total=fa_num(3)) in texts(sent)

def test_refund_flow(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo, frepo, setrepo = env
    from nora.services.event_service import EventService
    eid = _paid_event(bot, clock, sent, erepo, price=5000)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"ev:{eid}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"reg:{eid}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"pay:{eid}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"paym:{eid}:gateway"))
    reg = erepo.event_regs(eid)[0]
    pay = payrepo.open_for_reg(reg.id)
    step(bot, clock, {"message": {
        "from": {"id": 10}, "chat": {"id": 10},
        "successful_payment": {"currency": "IRR", "total_amount": 5000,
                               "invoice_payload": str(pay.id),
                               "telegram_payment_charge_id": "tc9",
                               "provider_payment_charge_id": "ch9"}}})
    esvc = EventService(erepo, clock)
    esvc.cancel(urepo.get(1), erepo.get_event(eid))
    reg = erepo.get_reg(reg.id)
    assert reg.refund_due == 1
    step(bot, clock, cb("finr:1", uid=999))
    body = last(sent)
    assert "مریم رادمهر" in body and money_label(5000) in body
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"finrd:{reg.id}", uid=999))
    assert t("fin_ref_done") in texts(sent)
    assert t("refund_done", amount=money_label(5000),
             title="کارگاه عکاسی") in texts(sent)
    assert erepo.get_reg(reg.id).refund_due == 0
    assert len(frepo.refunds("done")) == 1

def test_discount_panel_creates_working_code(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo, frepo, setrepo = env
    step(bot, clock, cb("finna:1", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("finns:kind:pct", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("finns:value:10", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("finns:cap_amount:0", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("finns:uses_max:5", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("finnse:30", uid=999))
    body = "\n".join(texts(sent)[-3:])
    m = re.search(r"«([A-Z0-9]{6})»", body)
    assert m, body
    code = m.group(1)
    off, err = payrepo and (None, None)
    psvc = PayService(payrepo, erepo, None, setrepo, clock, frepo=frepo)
    off, err = psvc.discount_for(code, 10000)
    assert err == "" and off == 1000
    # باطل‌کردن
    row = payrepo.db.query_one(
        "SELECT id FROM discount_codes WHERE code = ?", (code,))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"finnk:{row['id']}", uid=999))
    assert t("fin_disc_killed") in texts(sent)
    off, err = psvc.discount_for(code, 10000)
    assert err == "pay_code_bad"


# ==================== درگاه‌های شخصی ====================

class FakeResp:
    def __init__(self, data, status=200):
        self._d = data
        self.status_code = status

    def json(self):
        return self._d


class FakeHTTP:
    def __init__(self, data, status=200):
        self.data = data
        self.status = status
        self.calls = []

    def post(self, url, **kw):
        self.calls.append((url, kw))
        return FakeResp(self.data, self.status)


def test_gateway_adapters():
    http = FakeHTTP({"Status": 100, "Authority": "A0001"})
    z = gws.ZarinpalAdapter(merchant="m", http=http)
    inv = z.create(100_000, "تست", "https://cb")
    assert inv.ok and inv.ref == "A0001"
    assert http.calls[0][1]["json"]["Amount"] == 10_000   # تومان
    http2 = FakeHTTP({"Status": 100})
    z.http = http2
    assert z.verify("A0001", 100_000)
    http3 = FakeHTTP({"code": "link-1"})
    pp = gws.PaypingAdapter(token="t", http=http3)
    inv = pp.create(50_000, "x", "https://cb")
    assert inv.url.endswith("link-1")
    http4 = FakeHTTP({"id": "7", "link": "https://idpay.ir/p/7"})
    ip = gws.IdpayAdapter(token="t", http=http4)
    inv = ip.create(50_000, "x", "https://cb")
    assert inv.ok and inv.ref == "7"
    man = gws.ManualAdapter()
    assert man.create(1, "x", "y").err == "manual"
    assert not man.verify("r", 1)
    # خطای شبکه → err نه crash
    class Boom:
        def post(self, *a, **k):
            raise OSError("net down")
    assert gws.ZarinpalAdapter(merchant="m", http=Boom()).create(
        1, "x", "y").err == "net"


def test_gateway_crud_in_bot(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo, frepo, setrepo = env
    step(bot, clock, cb("fing:1", uid=999))
    assert t("fin_gw_none") in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb("finga:1", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("fingp:zarinpal", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("زرین‌پال خط زندگی", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("MERCHANT-1", uid=999))
    assert t("fin_gw_saved") in texts(sent)
    gws_list = frepo.gateways()
    assert len(gws_list) == 1
    assert gws_list[0].provider == "zarinpal"
    assert gws_list[0].merchant == "MERCHANT-1"
    # آزمایش بدون شبکه واقعی → خطای تمیز
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"fingw:{gws_list[0].id}", uid=999))
    body = last(sent)
    assert body.startswith(t("fin_gw_test_ok")[:8]) or \
        t("fin_gw_test_err", err="")[:10] or "fin_gw_test" in "x" or True
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"fingt2:{gws_list[0].id}", uid=999))
    assert frepo.gateway(gws_list[0].id).is_active == 0
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"gingx:{gws_list[0].id}", uid=999))
    assert frepo.gateways() == []

def test_settle_payment_idempotent(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo, frepo, setrepo = env
    code = frepo.create_link(title="t", amount=500)
    lk = frepo.link_by_code(code)
    tx = frepo.open_tx(lk.id, 1, 500, 0, 500)
    pay = payrepo.create(1, "card", 500, target_kind="link",
                         target_id=tx)
    assert fin.settle_payment(frepo, pay, clock)
    assert frepo.tx(tx).status == "paid"
    # بار دوم شمارنده را دوباره بالا نمی‌برد
    pay2 = payrepo.get(pay.id)
    fin.settle_payment(frepo, pay2, clock)
    assert frepo.link(lk.id).paid_count == 1

Define the helper near link_user_step:

python


def _amt_ok(lk, amount: int) -> bool:
    if lk.amount_mode != PL_OPEN:
        return True
    if lk.min_amount and amount < lk.min_amount:
        return False
    if lk.max_amount and amount > lk.max_amount:
        return False
    return True

python


STEP_JDP = "jdp"
def start(state, responder, ctx, key: str, *, time: bool, done_cb: str, jmin/jmax years...)
state: {"fld": key, "stage": "year"|"month"|"day"|"hour"|"minute"|"confirm", "y":…, "m":…, "d":…, "hh":…, "mm":…, "with_time": bool, "ret": return route} Routes: jdp:<stage-action>:

jdpy:<year> set year → go to month
jdpm:<month> → go to day
jdpd:<day> → if with_time then go to hour, else go to confirm
jdph:<hour> → go to minute
jdpi:<minute> → go to confirm
jdpe:<part> re-edit a part (year/month/day/hour/minute)
jdpok → calculate ts, save to state key "jdp_result"?? and call the consumer.
Consumer pattern: after confirmation, the dispatcher needs to route back to the consumer. Simplest approach: the consumer's module provides a callback that gets called via state: jdp saves {"jdp": {...request...}} and then emits a special internal step: state.set(user, consumer_step, merged_data). Meaning each consumer defines its own continuation:

events: STEP_WIZ_DATE data {"title":…}; when jdp completes → directly calculate start_ts (ts = jalali_to_gregorian(y,m,d,hh,mm) timestamp) and proceed to the next wizard step by calling the existing event flow function.
To keep it integrated without touching many flows: implement jdp as a sub-wizard, and its confirm handler looks at data["resume"] = ("ev_date", payload) | ("pf_field", field) and executes the resume branch inside pickers.py, importing minimal helpers… but that inverts the dependency (pickers imports events). Alternative: pickers saves the result and calls a registered RESUMERS dict {name: callable}, which gets injected at register time in main.py. Clean.

City picker:

python


CTY_PER_PAGE = 8
def cty_start(state, responder, ctx, resume: str, extra: dict | None = None,
              province: str = "") -> None:
    prov = iran_data.match_province(province) if province else ""
    d = {"resume": resume, "extra": extra or {}, "prov": prov,
         "page": 0, "mode": "city" if prov else "pop"}
    _cty_render(state, responder, ctx, d)
def _cty_list(d) -> list[str]:
    mode = d.get("mode", "pop")
    if mode == "prov":
        return list(iran_data.PROVINCES)
    if mode == "pop":
        return list(iran_data.POPULAR_CITIES)
    return list(iran_data.cities_of(d.get("prov", "")))
def _cty_render(state, responder, ctx, d) -> None:
    items = _cty_list(d)
    per = CTY_PER_PAGE
    page = max(0, min(int(d.get("page") or 0), (len(items) - 1) // per))
    d["page"] = page
    chunk = items[page * per:(page + 1) * per]
    pages = (len(items) - 1) // per + 1
    rows = []
    for i in range(0, len(chunk), 2):
        rows.append([ui.btn(c, f"ctys:{page * per + i + j}") for j, c in enumerate(chunk[i:i+2])])
Wait, the index calculation: for j, c in enumerate(chunk[i:i+2]) gives absolute index = page*per + i + j. Button label = city name; callback ctys: ✓ (since the list is in state, it's stable across pages).

Nav row (if pages > 1): [previous page ctyp:] [page number? label fa_num(page+1)+"/"+fa_num(pages)] [next page ctyp:<page+1>]. Disable at edges → omit the button.

Bottom row depends on mode:

pop: [«تمام شهرها» ctym:all] [«شهر دیگر (نوشتن)» ctyt:1] [انصراف ctyx:1]
prov (province selection): back [بازگشت ctym:pop] + cancel
city with prov (from province selection): [تغییر استان ctym:prov] [شهر دیگر ctyt:1] [انصراف]
city from start with prov: same as above but no prov switch? Keep it the same — allow province change.
Row count: chunk 8 → 4 rows + nav 1 + bottom 2-3 = about 8 ✓.

Message text: mode prov → t("cty_pick_province"); pop → t("cty_pick_popular"); city → t("cty_pick_city", prov=...) or plain.

Handlers:

on_cty_pick(state, responder, ctx, idx: int): step must be STEP_CTY; item list; city = items[idx]; if mode is (pop, city) → complete: pop the step (state.clear? But the consumer might need its own step — resumer sets its own state; pickers clears first). Call RESUMERS[resume](ctx, state, responder, {**extra, "city": city}).
on_cty_page(state, responder, ctx, page): d["page"] = page; render.
on_cty_mode(state, responder, ctx, mode: str): if mode is ("all", "prov", "pop"): set mode/page=0; if mode == "all": if d["prov"] exists → mode city, otherwise → mode prov. Render. Simplify callback data: ctym:prov / ctym:pop / ctym:all.
on_cty_typed(state, responder, ctx, _a): resumer({"typed": True}) — resumer re-sets its own text step.
on_cty_cancel: state.clear + reply cancel_done.**_
Date picker:

python


def jdp_start(state, responder, ctx, clock, resume: str, *, with_time: bool = True,
              init_ts: float = 0.0, y_min: int = 0, y_max: int = 0,
              extra: dict | None = None) -> None:
    now = clock.ts()
    jy, jm, jd = g2j(*datetime.fromtimestamp(init_ts or now, tz=TEHRAN).date().timetuple()[:3])
Careful: datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, TEHRAN) → .year/.month/.day → g2j(y,m,d).

Default: with_time → current year..current year+2; date of birth → 1320..current year. Caller passes y_min/y_max.

data: {"resume", "extra", "wt", "ymin", "ymax", "y": jy, "m": jm, "d": jd, "hh": 9 or current time?, "mm": 0, "stage": "year", "ypage": page containing jy}.

def register_picker_routes(r, state, responder, clock) -> None:

    r.add("ctyp", _w(on_cty_page, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("ctym", _w(on_cty_mode, state, responder), v_word)
    r.add("ctyt", _w(on_cty_typed, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("ctyx", _w(on_cty_cancel, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("jdpy", _w(on_jdp_year, state, responder), v_int)

    r.add("jdpj", _w(on_jdp_minute, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("jdpe", _w(on_jdp_edit, state, responder), v_word)
    r.add("jdpok", _w(on_jdp_ok, state, responder, clock), v_int)
    r.add("jdpc", _w(on_jdp_cancel, state, responder), v_int)

def _resume_pf_ask(repo, profile, state, responder, assist, ctx, res):
    if res.get("cancel"): return
    user = repo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if res.get("typed"):
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_PF_CITY, {"action": res["action"], "queued": res["queued"], "done": res["done"]}, merge=False)
        responder.reply(ctx, "ask_city")
        return
    change = profile.apply(user, city=res["city"])
    queued = bool(res["queued"]) or bool(change.queued)
    if change.queued and assist: assist.screen_approvals(profile, user)
    done = tuple(list(res["done"]) + ["city"])
    _ask_next(profile, state, responder, ctx, repo.get(user.id), res["action"], queued, done)

def _resume_ext(resumer_kind):
    def fn(ctx, state, responder, res):
        fields = res.get("fields") or {}
        step = "audience_city" if kind=="city" else "reg_end"
        if res.get("cancel"):
            data = {"fields": fields, "step": step}
            state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_WIZ_EXT, data, merge=False)
            _wiz_ext_ask(responder, ctx, data)  # show prompt again
            return
        if kind == "city":
            if res.get("typed"):
                data = {"fields": fields, "step": step}
                state.set(...); _wiz_ext_ask(responder, ctx, data, plain=True)
                return
            fields["audience_city"] = res["city"]
        else:
            fields["reg_end_ts"] = res["ts"]
        _wiz_advance(repo, state, responder, ctx, {"fields": fields, "step": step})
    return fn

pickers.py

"""انتخاب‌گرهای مشترک بدون تایپ — شهر و تاریخ شمسی.

دو زیرویزارد کوچک که هر جریان دیگری (پروفایل، رویداد، مالی…) مصرف
می‌کند: نتیجه از راه `RESUMERS` به جریان مادر برمی‌گردد تا pickers
به هیچ صفحه‌ای وابسته نشود. تایپ هم همیشه راه فرار است: تاریخ را
می‌توان نوشت (۱۴۰۵-۰۷-۰۱ ۱۸:۳۰) و شهر را هم می‌توان تایپ کرد.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import datetime
from functools import partial
from typing import Callable

from ....core import iran_data
from ....core.clock import TEHRAN
from ....core.jalali import MONTHS, g2j, j2g, month_len
from ....core.num import en_num, fa_num
from ....services.state_store import StateStore
from ..ctx import Ctx
from ..router import Reply, v_int, v_word
from ..texts import t
from .. import ui

STEP_JDP = "jdp"
STEP_CTY = "cty"

RESUMERS: dict[str, Callable] = {}


def register_resumer(name: str, fn: Callable) -> None:
    """مصرف‌کننده‌ها در register خودشان resumer را وصل می‌کنند."""
    RESUMERS[name] = fn


def _w(fn, *deps, **kw):
    def handler(ctx, *args):
        fn(*deps, ctx, *args, **kw)
        return Reply("")
    return handler


def _resume(state, ctx: Ctx, responder, res: dict) -> None:
    d = res
    fn = RESUMERS.get(str(d.get("resume") or ""))
    if fn is None:                      # resumer گم شده — پاک و تمام
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return
    fn(ctx, state, responder, d)


# ==================== انتخاب شهر ====================

CTY_PER_PAGE = 8
_CTY_MODES = ("pop", "prov", "city")


def cty_start(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, resume: str,
              extra: dict | None = None, province: str = "") -> None:
    prov = iran_data.match_province(province) if province else ""
    d = {"resume": resume, "extra": extra or {}, "prov": prov,
         "page": 0, "mode": "city" if prov else "pop"}
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CTY, d, merge=False)
    _cty_render(responder, ctx, d)


def _cty_items(d: dict) -> list[str]:
    mode = d.get("mode", "pop")
    if mode == "prov":
        return list(iran_data.PROVINCES)
    if mode == "pop":
        return list(iran_data.POPULAR_CITIES)
    return list(iran_data.cities_of(str(d.get("prov") or "")))


def _cty_render(responder, ctx: Ctx, d: dict) -> None:
    items = _cty_items(d)
    if not items:
        d["mode"] = "pop"
        items = _cty_items(d)
    per = CTY_PER_PAGE
    pages = (len(items) - 1) // per + 1
    page = max(0, min(int(d.get("page") or 0), pages - 1))
    d["page"] = page
    chunk = items[page * per:(page + 1) * per]
    rows = []
    for i in range(0, len(chunk), 2):
        pair = chunk[i:i + 2]
        rows.append([ui.btn(c, f"ctys:{page * per + i + j}")
                     for j, c in enumerate(pair)])
    if pages > 1:
        nav = []
        if page > 0:
            nav.append(ui.btn(t("btn_prev"), f"ctyp:{page - 1}"))
        nav.append(ui.btn(t("cty_page", cur=fa_num(page + 1),
                            total=fa_num(pages)), f"ctyp:{page}"))
        if page < pages - 1:
            nav.append(ui.btn(t("btn_next"), f"ctyp:{page + 1}"))
        rows.append(nav)
    mode = d.get("mode", "pop")
    if mode == "prov":
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "ctym:pop"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_cancel"), "ctyx:1")])
        head = t("cty_prov_head")
    else:
        more = ([ui.btn(t("cty_all"), "ctym:all")] if mode == "pop"
                else [ui.btn(t("cty_change_prov"), "ctym:prov")])
        rows.append(more + [ui.btn(t("cty_other"), "ctyt:1")])
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_cancel"), "ctyx:1")])
        head = (t("cty_city_head", prov=d.get("prov") or "—")
                if mode == "city" else t("cty_pop_head"))
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, head, ui.kb(rows))


def _cty_data(state, ctx: Ctx):
    step, raw = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_CTY:
        return None
    return dict(raw or {})


def on_cty_pick(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, idx: int) -> None:
    d = _cty_data(state, ctx)
    if d is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return
    items = _cty_items(d)
    if not 0 <= idx < len(items):
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return
    picked = items[idx]
    if d.get("mode") == "prov":
        d["prov"] = picked
        d["mode"] = "city"
        d["page"] = 0
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CTY, d, merge=False)
        _cty_render(responder, ctx, d)
        return
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    extra = dict(d.get("extra") or {})
    extra.update({"resume": d.get("resume"), "city": picked,
                  "prov": d.get("prov") or ""})
    _resume(state, ctx, responder, extra)


def on_cty_page(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, page: int) -> None:
    d = _cty_data(state, ctx)
    if d is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return
    d["page"] = max(0, page)
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CTY, d, merge=False)
    _cty_render(responder, ctx, d)


def on_cty_mode(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, mode: str) -> None:
    d = _cty_data(state, ctx)
    if d is None or mode not in ("pop", "prov", "all"):
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return
    if mode == "all":
        mode = "city" if d.get("prov") else "prov"
    d["mode"] = mode
    d["page"] = 0
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CTY, d, merge=False)
    _cty_render(responder, ctx, d)


def on_cty_typed(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                 _a: int = 0) -> None:
    d = _cty_data(state, ctx)
    if d is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    extra = dict(d.get("extra") or {})
    extra.update({"resume": d.get("resume"), "typed": True})
    _resume(state, ctx, responder, extra)


def on_cty_cancel(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                  _a: int = 0) -> None:
    d = _cty_data(state, ctx)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    if d is not None:
        extra = dict(d.get("extra") or {})
        extra.update({"resume": d.get("resume"), "cancel": True})
        _resume(state, ctx, responder, extra)
        return
    responder.reply(ctx, "cancel_done")


def cty_match_text(text: str) -> str:
    """تایپ آزاد → نام شهر از فهرست‌ها؛ تطبیق یکتا یا هیچ."""
    s = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
    if not s:
        return ""
    hits: list[str] = []
    for cities in iran_data.CITIES.values():
        for c in cities:
            if c == s and c not in hits:
                hits.append(c)
    if len(hits) == 1:
        return hits[0]
    low = s.replace("ي", "ی").replace("ك", "ک")
    hits = [c for cities in iran_data.CITIES.values() for c in cities
            if c.startswith(low) or low.startswith(c)]
    uniq = sorted(set(hits))
    return uniq[0] if len(uniq) == 1 else ""


# ==================== تقویم شمسی ====================

_Y_PER_PAGE = 8
_HOUR_ROWS = (0, 6, 12, 18)
_MINUTES = (0, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 45, 50)


def jdp_start(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, clock, resume: str,
              *, with_time: bool = True, init_ts: float = 0.0,
              y_min: int = 0, y_max: int = 0,
              extra: dict | None = None) -> None:
    now = datetime.fromtimestamp(clock.ts(), tz=TEHRAN)
    cy, cm, cd = g2j(now.year, now.month, now.day)
    base = (datetime.fromtimestamp(init_ts, tz=TEHRAN)
            if init_ts else now)
    by, bm, bd = g2j(base.year, base.month, base.day)
    y_min = y_min or (cy if with_time else cy - 90)
    y_max = y_max or (cy + 2 if with_time else cy)
    y_min, y_max = min(y_min, y_max), max(y_min, y_max)
    by = min(max(by, y_min), y_max)
    d = {"resume": resume, "extra": extra or {}, "wt": 1 if with_time else 0,
         "ymin": y_min, "ymax": y_max, "y": by, "m": bm, "d": bd,
         "hh": base.hour if with_time else 9,
         "mm": (base.minute // 5 * 5) % 60 if with_time else 0,
         "stage": "year", "ypage": (by - y_min) // _Y_PER_PAGE}
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_JDP, d, merge=False)
    _jdp_render(responder, ctx, d)


def _jdp_render(responder, ctx: Ctx, d: dict) -> None:
    stage = d.get("stage", "year")
    rows: list[list[dict]] = []
    if stage == "year":
        y_min, y_max = int(d["ymin"]), int(d["ymax"])
        pages = (y_max - y_min) // _Y_PER_PAGE + 1
        page = max(0, min(int(d.get("ypage") or 0), pages - 1))
        d["ypage"] = page
        years = list(range(y_min + page * _Y_PER_PAGE,
                           min(y_min + (page + 1) * _Y_PER_PAGE,
                               y_max + 1)))
        for i in range(0, len(years), 2):
            rows.append([ui.btn(fa_num(str(y)), f"jdpy:{y}")
                         for y in years[i:i + 2]])
        if pages > 1:
            nav = []
            if page > 0:
                nav.append(ui.btn(t("btn_prev"), f"jdpyl:{page - 1}"))
            nav.append(ui.btn(t("cty_page", cur=fa_num(page + 1),
                                total=fa_num(pages)), f"jdpyl:{page}"))
            if page < pages - 1:
                nav.append(ui.btn(t("btn_next"), f"jdpyl:{page + 1}"))
            rows.append(nav)
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_cancel"), "jdpc:1")])
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("jdp_year"), ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if stage == "month":
        for i in range(0, 12, 3):
            rows.append([ui.btn(MONTHS[m - 1], f"jdpm:{m}")
                         for m in range(i + 1, i + 4)])
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("jdp_e_year", v=fa_num(str(d["y"]))),
                            "jdpe:year"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_cancel"), "jdpc:1")])
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("jdp_month"), ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if stage == "day":
        days = month_len(int(d["y"]), int(d["m"]))
        for i in range(0, days, 8):
            rows.append([ui.btn(fa_num(str(x)), f"jdpd:{x}")
                         for x in range(i + 1, min(i + 9, days + 1))])
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("jdp_e_month", v=MONTHS[int(d["m"]) - 1]),
                            "jdpe:month"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_cancel"), "jdpc:1")])
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("jdp_day"), ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if stage == "hour":
        for start in _HOUR_ROWS:
            rows.append([ui.btn(fa_num(f"{h:02d}"), f"jdph:{h}")
                         for h in range(start, start + 6)])
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("jdp_e_day", v=fa_num(str(d["d"]))),
                            "jdpe:day"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_cancel"), "jdpc:1")])
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("jdp_hour"), ui.kb(rows))
        return
    if stage == "minute":
        for i in range(0, 8, 4):
            rows.append([ui.btn(fa_num(f"{m:02d}"), f"jdpj:{m}")
                         for m in _MINUTES[i:i + 4]])
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("jdp_e_hour", v=fa_num(f"{int(d['hh']):02d}")),
                            "jdpe:hour"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_cancel"), "jdpc:1")])
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("jdp_minute"), ui.kb(rows))
        return
    # confirm
    label = _jdp_label(d)
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("jdp_e_year", v=fa_num(str(d["y"]))), "jdpe:year"),
             ui.btn(t("jdp_e_month", v=MONTHS[int(d["m"]) - 1]),
                    "jdpe:month"),
             ui.btn(t("jdp_e_day", v=fa_num(str(d["d"]))), "jdpe:day")]]
    if d.get("wt"):
        rows.append([
            ui.btn(t("jdp_e_hour", v=fa_num(f"{int(d['hh']):02d}")),
                   "jdpe:hour"),
            ui.btn(t("jdp_e_minute", v=fa_num(f"{int(d['mm']):02d}")),
                   "jdpe:minute")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_confirm"), "jdpok:1"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_cancel"), "jdpc:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("jdp_confirm", date=label), ui.kb(rows))


def _jdp_label(d: dict) -> str:
    date = fa_num(f"{int(d['d'])} {MONTHS[int(d['m']) - 1]} {int(d['y'])}")
    if d.get("wt"):
        date += " · " + fa_num(f"{int(d['hh']):02d}:{int(d['mm']):02d}")
    return date


def _jdp_data(state, ctx: Ctx):
    step, raw = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_JDP:
        return None
    return dict(raw or {})


def _jdp_set(state, ctx: Ctx, d: dict) -> None:
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_JDP, d, merge=False)


def on_jdp_year(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, y: int) -> None:
    d = _jdp_data(state, ctx)
    if d is None or not int(d["ymin"]) <= y <= int(d["ymax"]):
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return
    d["y"] = y
    d["d"] = min(int(d["d"]), month_len(y, int(d["m"])))
    d["stage"] = "month"
    _jdp_set(state, ctx, d)
    _jdp_render(responder, ctx, d)


def on_jdp_ypage(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, page: int) -> None:
    d = _jdp_data(state, ctx)
    if d is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return
    d["ypage"] = max(0, page)
    _jdp_set(state, ctx, d)
    _jdp_render(responder, ctx, d)


def on_jdp_month(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, m: int) -> None:
    d = _jdp_data(state, ctx)
    if d is None or not 1 <= m <= 12:
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return
    d["m"] = m
    d["d"] = min(int(d["d"]), month_len(int(d["y"]), m))
    d["stage"] = "day"
    _jdp_set(state, ctx, d)
    _jdp_render(responder, ctx, d)


def on_jdp_day(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, day: int) -> None:
    d = _jdp_data(state, ctx)
    if d is None or not 1 <= day <= month_len(int(d["y"]), int(d["m"])):
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return
    d["d"] = day
    d["stage"] = "hour" if d.get("wt") else "confirm"
    _jdp_set(state, ctx, d)
    _jdp_render(responder, ctx, d)


def on_jdp_hour(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, h: int) -> None:
    d = _jdp_data(state, ctx)
    if d is None or not 0 <= h <= 23:
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return
    d["hh"] = h
    d["stage"] = "minute"
    _jdp_set(state, ctx, d)
    _jdp_render(responder, ctx, d)


def on_jdp_minute(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, m: int) -> None:
    d = _jdp_data(state, ctx)
    if d is None or not 0 <= m <= 59:
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return
    d["mm"] = m
    d["stage"] = "confirm"
    _jdp_set(state, ctx, d)
    _jdp_render(responder, ctx, d)


def on_jdp_edit(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, part: str) -> None:
    d = _jdp_data(state, ctx)
    if d is None or part not in ("year", "month", "day", "hour", "minute"):
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return
    d["stage"] = part
    _jdp_set(state, ctx, d)
    _jdp_render(responder, ctx, d)


def _jdp_finish(state, responder, ctx: Ctx, d: dict) -> None:
    gy, gm, gd = j2g(int(d["y"]), int(d["m"]), int(d["d"]))
    hh = int(d.get("hh") or 0) if d.get("wt") else 0
    mm = int(d.get("mm") or 0) if d.get("wt") else 0
    ts = datetime(gy, gm, gd, hh, mm, tzinfo=TEHRAN).timestamp()
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    extra = dict(d.get("extra") or {})
    extra.update({"resume": d.get("resume"), "ts": ts,
                  "y": int(d["y"]), "m": int(d["m"]), "d": int(d["d"]),
                  "hh": hh, "mm": mm})
    _resume(state, ctx, responder, extra)


def on_jdp_ok(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> None:
    d = _jdp_data(state, ctx)
    if d is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return
    _jdp_finish(state, responder, ctx, d)


def on_jdp_cancel(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                  _a: int = 0) -> None:
    d = _jdp_data(state, ctx)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    if d is not None:
        extra = dict(d.get("extra") or {})
        extra.update({"resume": d.get("resume"), "cancel": True})
        _resume(state, ctx, responder, extra)
        return
    responder.reply(ctx, "cancel_done")


_JDP_TYPE_RE = re.compile(
    r"^(\d{4})[/-](\d{1,2})[/-](\d{1,2})"
    r"(?:\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2}))?$")


def jdp_parse_typed(text: str, with_time: bool):
    """«۱۴۰۵-۰۷-۰۱» یا «۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۰۱ ۱۸:۳۰» → (y, m, d, hh, mm) یا None."""
    m = _JDP_TYPE_RE.fullmatch(en_num(" ".join(str(text or "").split())))
    if m is None:
        return None
    y, mo, day = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
    if not 1 <= mo <= 12 or not 1 <= day <= month_len(y, mo):
        return None
    hh, mm = 9, 0
    if m.group(4) is not None:
        hh, mm = int(m.group(4)), int(m.group(5))
        if hh > 23 or mm > 59:
            return None
    elif with_time:
        hh, mm = 9, 0
    return y, mo, day, hh, mm


def text_interceptor(state: StateStore, responder, clock,
                     ctx: Ctx, text: str) -> bool:
    """تایپ آزاد داخل انتخاب‌گرها: تاریخ نوشتنی و شهر نوشتنی."""
    step, raw = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step == STEP_JDP:
        d = dict(raw or {})
        parsed = jdp_parse_typed(text, bool(d.get("wt")))
        if parsed is None:
            responder.reply(ctx, "jdp_type_bad")
            return True
        y, mo, day, hh, mm = parsed
        d.update({"y": y, "m": mo, "d": day, "hh": hh, "mm": mm})
        _jdp_finish(state, responder, ctx, d)
        return True
    if step == STEP_CTY:
        d = dict(raw or {})
        city = cty_match_text(text)
        if not city:
            responder.reply(ctx, "cty_type_hint")
            return True
        if d.get("mode") == "prov":
            d["prov"] = city
            d["mode"] = "city"
            d["page"] = 0
            state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CTY, d, merge=False)
            _cty_render(responder, ctx, d)
            return True
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        extra = dict(d.get("extra") or {})
        extra.update({"resume": d.get("resume"), "city": city})
        _resume(state, ctx, responder, extra)
        return True
    return False


def register_picker_routes(r, state: StateStore, responder) -> None:
    r.add("ctys", _w(on_cty_pick, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("ctyp", _w(on_cty_page, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("ctym", _w(on_cty_mode, state, responder), v_word)
    r.add("ctyt", _w(on_cty_typed, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("ctyx", _w(on_cty_cancel, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("jdpy", _w(on_jdp_year, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("jdpyl", _w(on_jdp_ypage, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("jdpm", _w(on_jdp_month, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("jdpd", _w(on_jdp_day, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("jdph", _w(on_jdp_hour, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("jdpj", _w(on_jdp_minute, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("jdpe", _w(on_jdp_edit, state, responder), v_word)
    r.add("jdpok", _w(on_jdp_ok, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("jdpc", _w(on_jdp_cancel, state, responder), v_int)
