"""تست انتخاب‌گرهای بدون تایپ: تقویم شمسی و شهر (پروفایل + ویزارد رویداد)."""

import json
from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.channels.bale.screens import pickers
from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
from nora.core import iran_data
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock, transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved",
                 full_name="ادمین گروه")
    member = urepo.create(10, first_name="مریم")
    urepo.update(member.id, status="approved", full_name="مریم رادمهر")
    yield bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo
    set_clock(old)


def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    kind = bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()
    return kind


def msg(text, uid=10):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def cb(data, uid=10):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def last_text(sent):
    return str(sent[-1].get("text", ""))


def last_markup(sent):
    raw = sent[-1].get("reply_markup")
    return raw if isinstance(raw, str) else json.dumps(
        raw, ensure_ascii=False) if raw else ""


# ==================== دادهٔ شهرها ====================

def test_cities_cover_all_provinces():
    for prov in iran_data.PROVINCES:
        cities = iran_data.cities_of(prov)
        assert cities, prov
        assert len(cities) >= 4


def test_match_city_unique_or_none():
    assert iran_data.match_city("تهران") == "تهران"
    assert iran_data.match_city("  مشهد ") == "مشهد"
    assert iran_data.match_city("تهرون") == ""
    assert iran_data.match_city("") == ""


def test_jdp_parse_typed():
    assert pickers.jdp_parse_typed("1405-07-01", False) == (1405, 7, 1, 9, 0)
    assert pickers.jdp_parse_typed("۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۰۱ ۱۸:۳۰", True) == (
        1405, 7, 1, 18, 30)
    assert pickers.jdp_parse_typed("1405-13-01", True) is None
    assert pickers.jdp_parse_typed("فردا", True) is None
    assert pickers.jdp_parse_typed("1405-07-32", True) is None


# ==================== پروفایل: تولد و شهر با انتخاب‌گر ====================

def test_profile_wizard_birth_and_city_pickers(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo = env
    step(bot, clock, cb("pfe:1"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("مریم رادمهر"))
    step(bot, clock, cb("pfs:1"))                  # کد ملی → رد
    assert last_text(sent) == t("jdp_year")        # تولد = تقویم
    step(bot, clock, cb("jdpy:1375"))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("jdp_month")
    step(bot, clock, cb("jdpm:4"))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("jdp_day")
    step(bot, clock, cb("jdpd:12"))
    assert "۱۲ مرداد ۱۳۷۵" in last_text(sent)      # تأییدیه
    step(bot, clock, cb("jdpok:1"))
    u = urepo.get_by_bale(10)
    assert urepo.get(u.id).birth_date == "1375-04-12"
    step(bot, clock, cb("pgs:f"))                  # جنسیت
    step(bot, clock, cb("pfs:1"))                  # پدر
    step(bot, clock, cb("pfs:1"))                  # مادر
    assert "pvs:7" in last_markup(sent)            # استان‌ها
    step(bot, clock, cb("pvs:7"))                  # تهران
    assert "ctys:" in last_markup(sent)            # شهرهای تهران
    step(bot, clock, cb("ctys:0"))
    u = urepo.get(urepo.get_by_bale(10).id)
    assert u.province == "تهران" and u.city == "تهران"


def test_profile_wizard_city_typed_fallback(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo = env
    step(bot, clock, cb("pfe:1"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("مریم رادمهر"))

# ==================== ویزارد رویداد: تاریخ با تقویم ====================

def test_event_wizard_date_clicks(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo = env
    step(bot, clock, cb("newev:1", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("کارگاه عکاسی", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("evk:workshop", uid=999))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("jdp_year")
    step(bot, clock, cb("jdpy:1405", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("jdpm:7", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("jdpd:1", uid=999))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("jdp_hour")
    step(bot, clock, cb("jdph:18", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("jdpj:30", uid=999))
    assert "۱ مهر ۱۴۰۵ · ۱۸:۳۰" in last_text(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb("jdpok:1", uid=999))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("wiz_loc")
    step(bot, clock, cb("evl:physical", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("تهران، میدان آزادی", uid=999))
    # زنجیرهٔ فیلدها؛ هر جا انتخاب‌گر شهر آمد، شهر را انتخاب کن
    chain = ["evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:paid:0",
             "evw:priv:public", "evw:skip:1", "evw:audg:all",
             "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:wl:1", "evw:skip:1",
             "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:rem:1", "evw:skip:1"]
    city_picked = False
    for data in chain:
        mk = last_markup(sent)
        if "ctys:0" in mk and not city_picked:
            step(bot, clock, cb("ctys:0", uid=999))
            city_picked = True
            continue
        step(bot, clock, cb(data, uid=999))
    assert last_text(sent) == t("wiz_done")
    ev = erepo.get_event(1)
    assert ev is not None and ev.start_ts > 0
    if city_picked:
        assert ev.audience_city == "تهران"

def test_event_wizard_reg_end_skip_from_picker(env):
    """رد کردن مهلت ثبت‌نام وقتی تقویم باز است."""
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo = env
    step(bot, clock, cb("newev:1", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("دورهٔ تست", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("evk:course" if "evk:course" else "evk:meeting",
                        uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("1405-08-01 10:00", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("evl:online", uid=999))
    chain = ["evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:paid:0",
             "evw:priv:public", "evw:skip:1", "evw:audg:all",
             "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:wl:0", "evw:skip:1",
             "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:rem:0", "evw:skip:1"]
    saw_jdp = False
    for data in chain:
        if "jdpy:" in last_markup(sent):
            saw_jdp = True
        step(bot, clock, cb(data, uid=999))
    assert saw_jdp, "تقویم مهلت ثبت‌نام باید باز شده باشد"
    assert last_text(sent) == t("wiz_done")

"""دامنهٔ حضور و غیاب — جلسه‌ها، ثبت‌ها، توکن لینک، حضور ماندگاری.

منبع: نورا ۱ (0021 + 0158) بازطراحی‌شده برای نورا ۲:
· جلسه = یک رخداد زمانی زیر رویداد با کد/روش/پنجرهٔ باز
· ثبت حضور یکتا (session, user) با روش و وضعیت
· توکن تک‌مصرفهٔ لینک آنلاین با TTL
· ماندگاری (join/leave) برای جلسهٔ آنلاین + بستن خودکار
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import secrets
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from ..core.clock import TEHRAN, Clock, get_clock
from ..core.db import Database
from ..core.jalali import g2j, j2g

# ---------- روش‌های ثبت حضور ----------
A_CODE = "code"        # کد ثابت جلسه
A_ROTATE = "rotate"    # کد پویای چرخان
A_TICKET = "ticket"    # کد بلیت ثبت‌نام
A_LOC = "loc"          # موقعیت مکانی
A_LINK = "link"        # توکن لینک آنلاین
A_ROLL = "roll"        # حاضرباش زنده
A_DWELL = "dwell"      # ماندگاری در جلسهٔ آنلاین
A_MANUAL = "manual"    # ثبت دستی ادمین
METHODS = (A_CODE, A_ROTATE, A_TICKET, A_LOC, A_LINK, A_ROLL, A_DWELL,
           A_MANUAL)

ST_PRESENT = "present"
ST_ABSENT = "absent"
STATUSES = (ST_PRESENT, ST_ABSENT)

_CODE_ALPHABET = "23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ"


def new_session_code(n: int = 5) -> str:
    return "".join(secrets.choice(_CODE_ALPHABET) for _ in range(n))


def new_token(n: int = 10) -> str:
    return secrets.token_urlsafe(n)[:12].upper()


def rotating_code(session_id: int, now: float, window_min: int = 3) -> str:
    """کد پویا: هر پنجرهٔ چنددقیقه‌ای یک کد ۴رقمی متفاوت."""
    idx = int(now // (window_min * 60))
    h = hashlib.sha256(f"att:{session_id}:{idx}".encode()).hexdigest()
    return str(int(h[:8], 16) % 10000).zfill(4)


def haversine_m(lat1: float, lon1: float, lat2: float, lon2: float) -> int:
    from math import asin, cos, radians, sin, sqrt
    p1, p2 = radians(lat1), radians(lat2)
    dp = p2 - p1
    dl = radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a = sin(dp / 2) ** 2 + cos(p1) * cos(p2) * sin(dl / 2) ** 2
    return int(6371000 * 2 * asin(sqrt(a)))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Session:
    id: int
    event_id: int
    no: int
    title: str
    code: str
    method: str
    lat: float
    lon: float
    radius_m: int
    opens_ts: float
    closes_ts: float
    is_open: int
    dwell_min: int
    created_ts: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Record:
    id: int
    session_id: int
    event_id: int
    user_id: int
    method: str
    status: str
    distance_m: int
    note: str
    recorded_by: int
    ts: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Token:
    id: int
    token: str
    session_id: int
    user_id: int
    expires_ts: float
    used_ts: float


class AttendanceRepo:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, clock: Clock | None = None) -> None:
        self.db = db
        self.clock = clock or get_clock()
        self._ensure()

    def _now(self) -> float:
        return self.clock.ts()

    def _ensure(self) -> None:
        with self.db.transaction():
            self.db.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS att_sessions (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                event_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                no INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
                title TEXT DEFAULT '',
                code TEXT DEFAULT '',
                method TEXT DEFAULT 'code',
                lat REAL DEFAULT 0, lon REAL DEFAULT 0,
                radius_m INTEGER DEFAULT 200,
                opens_ts REAL DEFAULT 0, closes_ts REAL DEFAULT 0,
                is_open INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
                dwell_min INTEGER DEFAULT 10,
                created_ts REAL DEFAULT 0)""")
            self.db.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS att_records (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                event_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                method TEXT DEFAULT 'manual',
                status TEXT DEFAULT 'present',
                distance_m INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                note TEXT DEFAULT '',
                recorded_by INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                ts REAL DEFAULT 0,
                UNIQUE(session_id, user_id))""")
            self.db.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS att_presence (
                session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                joined_ts REAL DEFAULT 0,
                left_ts REAL DEFAULT 0,
                seconds INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                PRIMARY KEY (session_id, user_id))""")
            self.db.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS att_tokens (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                token TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                user_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                expires_ts REAL DEFAULT 0,
                used_ts REAL DEFAULT 0)""")
            self.db.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS att_rollcalls (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                opens_ts REAL DEFAULT 0,
                closes_ts REAL DEFAULT 0)""")
            for q in ("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_atts_ev "
                      "ON att_sessions(event_id)",
                      "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attr_s "
                      "ON att_records(session_id)",
                      "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attr_u "
                      "ON att_records(user_id)"):
                self.db.execute(q)

    # ---------- جلسه‌ها ----------
    def add_session(self, event_id: int, no: int = 1, title: str = "",
                    method: str = A_CODE, opens_ts: float = 0.0,
                    closes_ts: float = 0.0, lat: float = 0.0,
                    lon: float = 0.0, radius_m: int = 200,
                    dwell_min: int = 10) -> int:
        with self.db.transaction():
            cur = self.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO att_sessions (event_id, no, title, code, "
                "method, lat, lon, radius_m, opens_ts, closes_ts, is_open, "
                "dwell_min, created_ts) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,1,?,?)",
                (event_id, no, title, new_session_code(), method, lat, lon,
                 radius_m, opens_ts, closes_ts, dwell_min, self._now()))
            return int(cur.lastrowid)

    def session(self, sid: int) -> Session | None:
        row = self.db.query_one("SELECT * FROM att_sessions WHERE id = ?",
                                (sid,))
        return _row_session(row) if row else None

    def session_by_code(self, code: str, event_id: int = 0):
        code = (code or "").strip().upper()
        if not code:
            return None
        q = ("SELECT * FROM att_sessions WHERE code = ?"
             + (" AND event_id = ?" if event_id else ""))
        args = (code, event_id) if event_id else (code,)
        row = self.db.query_one(q, args)
        return _row_session(row) if row else None

    def sessions(self, event_id: int) -> list[Session]:
        rows = self.db.query("SELECT * FROM att_sessions WHERE event_id = ? "
                             "ORDER BY no, id", (event_id,))
        return [_row_session(r) for r in rows]

    def update_session(self, sid: int, **kw) -> None:
        if not kw:
            return
        cols = ", ".join(f"{k} = ?" for k in kw)
        with self.db.transaction():
            self.db.execute(f"UPDATE att_sessions SET {cols} WHERE id = ?",
                            (*kw.values(), sid))

    def delete_session(self, sid: int) -> None:
        with self.db.transaction():
            self.db.execute("DELETE FROM att_records WHERE session_id = ?",
                            (sid,))
            self.db.execute("DELETE FROM att_presence WHERE session_id = ?",
                            (sid,))
            self.db.execute("DELETE FROM att_tokens WHERE session_id = ?",
                            (sid,))
            self.db.execute("DELETE FROM att_sessions WHERE id = ?", (sid,))

    # ---------- ثبت‌ها ----------
    def record(self, session_id: int, user_id: int) -> Record | None:
        row = self.db.query_one("SELECT * FROM att_records WHERE "
                                "session_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
                                (session_id, user_id))
        return _row_record(row) if row else None

    def mark(self, session_id: int, user_id: int, method: str,
             status: str = ST_PRESENT, distance_m: int = 0, note: str = "",
             recorded_by: int = 0) -> Record:
        """ثبت یا به‌روزرسانی (یکتا per جلسه+کاربر)."""
        with self.db.transaction():
            cur = self.db.query_one(
                "SELECT id FROM att_records WHERE session_id = ? AND "
                "user_id = ?", (session_id, user_id))
            sess = self.session(session_id)
            ev = sess.event_id if sess else 0
            if cur is not None:
                self.db.execute(
                    "UPDATE att_records SET method = ?, status = ?, "
                    "distance_m = ?, note = ?, recorded_by = ?, ts = ? "
                    "WHERE id = ?",
                    (method, status, distance_m, note, recorded_by,
                     self._now(), cur["id"]))
                rid = int(cur["id"])
            else:
                c = self.db.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO att_records (session_id, event_id, user_id, "
                    "method, status, distance_m, note, recorded_by, ts) "
                    "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                    (session_id, ev, user_id, method, status, distance_m,
                     note, recorded_by, self._now()))
                rid = int(c.lastrowid)
        return self.record(session_id, user_id)  # type: ignore[return-value]

    def records(self, session_id: int = 0, user_id: int = 0,
                event_id: int = 0) -> list[Record]:
        q, args = "SELECT * FROM att_records WHERE 1=1", []
        if session_id:
            q += " AND session_id = ?"
            args.append(session_id)
        if user_id:
            q += " AND user_id = ?"
            args.append(user_id)
        if event_id:
            q += " AND event_id = ?"
            args.append(event_id)
        return [_row_record(r) for r in self.db.query(q + " ORDER BY id",
                                                      tuple(args))]

    def present_count(self, session_id: int) -> int:
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM att_records WHERE session_id = ? AND "
            "status = 'present'", (session_id,))
        return int(row["c"]) if row else 0

    def user_stats(self, event_id: int, user_id: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
        """(حضور, غیبت) کاربر در رویداد."""
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT SUM(status = 'present') p, SUM(status = 'absent') a "
            "FROM att_records WHERE event_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
            (event_id, user_id))
        return (int(row["p"] or 0), int(row["a"] or 0)) if row else (0, 0)

    # ---------- توکن لینک ----------
    def issue_token(self, session_id: int, ttl_min: int = 30,
                    user_id: int = 0) -> Token:
        with self.db.transaction():
            tok = new_token()
            cur = self.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO att_tokens (token, session_id, user_id, "
                "expires_ts) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                (tok, session_id, user_id,
                 self._now() + ttl_min * 60))
            tid = int(cur.lastrowid)
        row = self.db.query_one("SELECT * FROM att_tokens WHERE id = ?",
                                (tid,))
        return Token(tid, row["token"], row["session_id"], row["user_id"],
                     float(row["expires_ts"]), float(row["used_ts"]))

    def token(self, value: str) -> Token | None:
        row = self.db.query_one("SELECT * FROM att_tokens WHERE token = ?",
                                ((value or "").strip().upper(),))
        if row is None:
            return None
        return Token(row["id"], row["token"], row["session_id"],
                     row["user_id"], float(row["expires_ts"]),
                     float(row["used_ts"]))

    def consume_token(self, tid: int, user_id: int) -> bool:
        with self.db.transaction():
            cur = self.db.execute(
                "UPDATE att_tokens SET used_ts = ?, user_id = ? WHERE "
                "id = ? AND used_ts = 0", (self._now(), user_id, tid))
            return cur.rowcount > 0

    # ---------- حاضرباش ----------
    def open_rollcall(self, session_id: int, window_min: int = 5) -> int:
        with self.db.transaction():
            cur = self.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO att_rollcalls (session_id, opens_ts, "
                "closes_ts) VALUES (?,?,?)",
                (session_id, self._now(), self._now() + window_min * 60))
            return int(cur.lastrowid)

    def live_rollcall(self, session_id: int, now: float):
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT * FROM att_rollcalls WHERE session_id = ? AND "
            "opens_ts <= ? AND closes_ts >= ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1",
            (session_id, now, now))
        return row

    def close_rollcall(self, rid: int) -> None:
        with self.db.transaction():
            self.db.execute("UPDATE att_rollcalls SET closes_ts = ? "
                            "WHERE id = ?", (self._now() - 1, rid))

    # ---------- ماندگاری ----------
    def join(self, session_id: int, user_id: int) -> None:
        with self.db.transaction():
            self.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO att_presence (session_id, user_id, joined_ts) "
                "VALUES (?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(session_id, user_id) DO "
                "UPDATE SET joined_ts = excluded.joined_ts, left_ts = 0",
                (session_id, user_id, self._now()))

    def leave(self, session_id: int, user_id: int) -> int:
        now = self._now()
        with self.db.transaction():
            row = self.db.query_one(
                "SELECT * FROM att_presence WHERE session_id = ? AND "
                "user_id = ?", (session_id, user_id))
            if row is None or not row["joined_ts"]:
                return 0
            secs = int(now - float(row["joined_ts"]))
            self.db.execute(
                "UPDATE att_presence SET left_ts = ?, seconds = seconds + ? "
                "WHERE session_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
                (now, secs, session_id, user_id))
            return secs

    def presence_seconds(self, session_id: int, user_id: int) -> int:
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT seconds FROM att_presence WHERE session_id = ? AND "
            "user_id = ?", (session_id, user_id))
        return int(row["seconds"]) if row else 0

    def open_presences(self, session_id: int) -> list[dict]:
        return self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM att_presence WHERE session_id = ? AND "
            "joined_ts > 0 AND left_ts = 0", (session_id,))

    def close_open_presence(self, session_id: int) -> int:
        """جلسهٔ آنلاین تمام شد: ماندگاری بازها را می‌بندد و ثانیه می‌زند."""
        now = self._now()
        n = 0
        with self.db.transaction():
            for row in self.open_presences(session_id):
                secs = int(now - float(row["joined_ts"]))
                self.db.execute(
                    "UPDATE att_presence SET left_ts = ?, seconds = "
                    "seconds + ? WHERE session_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
                    (now, secs, session_id, row["user_id"]))
                n += 1
        return n


def _row_session(r: dict) -> Session:
    return Session(int(r["id"]), int(r["event_id"]), int(r["no"]),
                   str(r["title"]), str(r["code"]), str(r["method"]),
                   float(r["lat"]), float(r["lon"]), int(r["radius_m"]),
                   float(r["opens_ts"]), float(r["closes_ts"]),
                   int(r["is_open"]), int(r["dwell_min"]),
                   float(r["created_ts"]))


def _row_record(r: dict) -> Record:
    return Record(int(r["id"]), int(r["session_id"]), int(r["event_id"]),
                  int(r["user_id"]), str(r["method"]), str(r["status"]),
                  int(r["distance_m"]), str(r["note"]),
                  int(r["recorded_by"]), float(r["ts"]))


def plan_starts(start_ts: float, count: int, interval_days: int,
                ) -> list[float]:
    """شروع جلسه‌ها: از شروع رویداد هر interval_days روز بعد."""
    out = []
    base = datetime.fromtimestamp(start_ts, tz=TEHRAN)
    for i in range(max(1, count)):
        d = base + timedelta(days=i * max(1, interval_days))
        out.append(d.timestamp())
    return out

"""سرویس حضور و غیاب — موتور ثبت حضور و گزارش‌ها.

شش راه ثبت حضور مثل نورا ۱ (کد جلسه، کد پویا، کد بلیت، موقعیت، لینک
توکنی، حاضرباش/ماندگاری) + دستی ادمین. جلسه‌ها خودکار از شروع رویداد
پlan می‌شوند و با روشن‌شدن قابلیت حضور سینک می‌گردند.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from ..core.clock import Clock, get_clock
from ..domain.attendance import (A_CODE, A_DWELL, A_LINK, A_LOC, A_MANUAL,
                                 A_ROTATE, A_TICKET, ST_ABSENT, ST_PRESENT,
                                 AttendanceRepo, Session, haversine_m,
                                 plan_starts, rotating_code)
from ..domain.events import EventRepo, REG_CONFIRMED
from ..domain.users import UserRepo

ROTATE_WINDOW_MIN = 3


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CheckResult:
    ok: bool
    err: str = ""
    record=None  # Record | None
    distance: int = 0


def _methods_of(ev) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    raw = str(getattr(ev, "att_methods", "") or "code,ticket,loc")
    return tuple(m for m in raw.split(",") if m.strip())


def ensure_sessions(repo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, ev,
                    force: bool = False) -> int:
    """جلسه‌های خودکار: از شروع رویداد هر att_interval روز یکی."""
    if not getattr(ev, "has_attendance", 0):
        return 0
    have = repo.sessions(ev.id)
    if have and not force:
        return 0
    count = max(1, int(getattr(ev, "att_session_count", 1) or 1))
    interval = max(1, int(getattr(ev, "att_interval", 7) or 7))
    starts = plan_starts(ev.start_ts, count, interval)
    made = 0
    for i, ts in enumerate(starts, start=1):
        if any(s.no == i for s in have):
            continue
        repo.add_session(ev.id, no=i,
                         title=f"جلسهٔ {i}",
                         opens_ts=ts - 3600,
                         closes_ts=ts + 2 * 3600)
        made += 1
    return made


def session_window_ok(sess: Session, now: float) -> str:
    """'' یعنی مجاز؛ وگرنه کلید خطا."""
    if not sess.is_open:
        return "att_closed"
    if sess.opens_ts and now < sess.opens_ts:
        return "att_not_started"
    if sess.closes_ts and now > sess.closes_ts:
        return "att_ended"
    return ""


def check_in(repo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
             sess: Session, user_id: int, method: str, *,
             code: str = "", ticket_code: str = "", lat: float = 0.0,
             lon: float = 0.0, token: str = "", now: float = 0.0,
             by_admin: int = 0) -> CheckResult:
    """اعتبارسنجی روش + ثبت حضور یکتا."""
    now = now or (repo.clock.ts() if repo.clock else 0.0)
    ev = erepo.get_event(sess.event_id)
    allowed = _methods_of(ev) if ev is not None else ("code",)
    if method == A_MANUAL:
        allowed = allowed + (A_MANUAL,)
    if method not in allowed and method not in (A_MANUAL, A_DWELL, A_ROTATE):
        return CheckResult(False, "att_method_off")
    if method not in (A_MANUAL,):
        err = session_window_ok(sess, now)
        if err and method != A_LINK:
            return CheckResult(False, err)
    reg = erepo.reg_of(sess.event_id, user_id)
    if reg is None or reg.status not in (REG_CONFIRMED,):
        return CheckResult(False, "att_not_registered")
    distance = 0
    if method in (A_CODE,):
        if not code or code.strip().upper() != sess.code:
            return CheckResult(False, "att_code_bad")
    elif method == A_ROTATE:
        want = rotating_code(sess.id, now, ROTATE_WINDOW_MIN)
        prev = rotating_code(sess.id, now - ROTATE_WINDOW_MIN * 60,
                             ROTATE_WINDOW_MIN)
        if code.strip() not in (want, prev):
            return CheckResult(False, "att_code_bad")
    elif method == A_TICKET:
        if not ticket_code or ticket_code.strip().upper() != \
                (reg.ticket_code or "").upper():
            return CheckResult(False, "att_ticket_bad")
    elif method == A_LOC:
        if not sess.lat or not sess.lon:
            return CheckResult(False, "att_no_loc")
        distance = haversine_m(lat, lon, sess.lat, sess.lon)
        radius = int(getattr(ev, "att_radius", 200) or 200) \
            if ev is not None else 200
        if distance > radius:
            return CheckResult(False, "att_far", distance=distance)
    elif method == A_LINK:
        tok = repo.token(token)
        if tok is None or tok.session_id != sess.id:
            return CheckResult(False, "att_token_bad")
        if tok.expires_ts and now > tok.expires_ts:
            return CheckResult(False, "att_token_exp")
        if tok.used_ts:
            return CheckResult(False, "att_token_used")
        if not repo.consume_token(tok.id, user_id):
            return CheckResult(False, "att_token_used")
    elif method == A_ROLL:
        live = repo.live_rollcall(sess.id, now)
        if live is None:
            return CheckResult(False, "att_roll_closed")
    elif method == A_MANUAL:
        pass
    else:
        return CheckResult(False, "att_method_off")
    rec = repo.mark(sess.id, user_id, method, ST_PRESENT,
                    distance_m=distance, recorded_by=by_admin)
    return CheckResult(True, record=rec, distance=distance)


def mark_absents(repo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                 sess: Session) -> int:
    """بستن جلسه: تأییدشده‌های بدون ثبت = غایب."""
    n = 0
    for reg in erepo.event_regs(sess.event_id, statuses=(REG_CONFIRMED,)):
        if repo.record(sess.id, reg.user_id) is None:
            repo.mark(sess.id, reg.user_id, A_MANUAL, ST_ABSENT,
                      note="auto")
            n += 1
    return n


def close_session(repo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                  sess: Session) -> int:
    """بستن جلسه: حاضرباش باز + ماندگاری باز + غایب‌ها."""
    live = repo.live_rollcall(sess.id, 1e18)
    if live is not None:
        repo.close_rollcall(int(live["id"]))
    repo.close_open_presence(sess.id)
    repo.update_session(sess.id, is_open=0)
    return mark_absents(repo, erepo, sess)


def dwell_settle(repo: AttendanceRepo, sess: Session,
                 user_id: int) -> CheckResult:
    """ماندگاری بسته شد: اگر به حد نرسید غایب، وگرنه حاضر."""
    secs = repo.presence_seconds(sess.id, user_id)
    need = max(1, sess.dwell_min) * 60
    if secs >= need:
        rec = repo.mark(sess.id, user_id, A_DWELL, ST_PRESENT,
                        note=f"{secs // 60}m")
        return CheckResult(True, record=rec)
    rec = repo.mark(sess.id, user_id, A_DWELL, ST_ABSENT,
                    note=f"{secs // 60}m")
    return CheckResult(False, "att_dwell_short", record=rec)


def event_summary(repo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                  event_id: int) -> dict:
    sessions = repo.sessions(event_id)
    regs = erepo.event_regs(event_id, statuses=(REG_CONFIRMED,))
    out = {"sessions": len(sessions), "confirmed": len(regs),
           "present": 0, "absent": 0, "rate": 0}
    for s in sessions:
        for r in repo.records(session_id=s.id):
            if r.status == ST_PRESENT:
                out["present"] += 1
            else:
                out["absent"] += 1
    total = out["present"] + out["absent"]
    out["rate"] = (out["present"] * 100 // total) if total else 0
    return out


def user_report(repo: AttendanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                user_id: int) -> list[dict]:
    """کارنامهٔ کاربر: per رویداد حضور/غیبت/جلسه‌ها."""
    rows: dict[int, dict] = {}
    for r in repo.records(user_id=user_id):
        d = rows.setdefault(r.event_id, {"present": 0, "absent": 0})
        d["present" if r.status == ST_PRESENT else "absent"] += 1
    return [{"event_id": k, **v} for k, v in rows.items()]


def export_attendance(repo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                      urepo: UserRepo, clock: Clock, event_id: int,
                      path) -> str:
    """اکسل دو شیتی: جلسه‌ها + ثبت‌ها."""
    from datetime import datetime

    from openpyxl import Workbook
    from ..core.clock import TEHRAN
    from ..core.jalali import fmt_dt
    from ..core.num import fa_num

    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "جلسه‌ها"
    ws.append(["شماره", "عنوان", "روش", "کد", "باز", "حاضر", "غایب"])
    for s in repo.sessions(event_id):
        pres = sum(1 for r in repo.records(session_id=s.id)
                   if r.status == ST_PRESENT)
        absn = sum(1 for r in repo.records(session_id=s.id)
                   if r.status == ST_ABSENT)
        ws.append([s.no, s.title, s.method, s.code,
                   "بله" if s.is_open else "خیر", pres, absn])
    ws2 = wb.create_sheet("ثبت‌ها")
    ws2.append(["جلسه", "نام", "روش", "وضعیت", "فاصله (متر)", "تاریخ"])
    for s in repo.sessions(event_id):
        for r in repo.records(session_id=s.id):
            u = urepo.get(r.user_id)
            name = (u.full_name or u.first_name) if u else fa_num(r.user_id)
            when = fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(r.ts, tz=TEHRAN)) \
                if r.ts else ""
            ws2.append([s.no, name, r.method,
                        "حاضر" if r.status == ST_PRESENT else "غایب",
                        r.distance_m or "", when])
    wb.save(str(path))
    return str(path)

"""حضور و غیاب: جلسه‌ها و روش‌های ثبت برای مدیر، ثبت حضور و کارنامه برای کاربر.

ورودی مدیر از منوی برنامه («حضور و غیاب») و ورودی کاربر از جزئیات برنامهٔ
ثبت‌نام‌شده. ثبت حضور با کمترین تایپ: کد بلیت تک‌ضربه، موقعیت با دکمهٔ
ارسال لوکیشن، لینک با /start atTOKEN. بستن خودکار جلسه‌های گذشته‌در tick.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import datetime

from ....core.clock import TEHRAN
from ....core.events import bus
from ....core.jalali import fmt_dt
from ....core.num import en_num, fa_num
from ....domain.attendance import (A_CODE, A_DWELL, A_LINK, A_LOC, A_MANUAL,
                                   A_ROLL, A_ROTATE, A_TICKET, ST_ABSENT,
                                   ST_PRESENT, AttendanceRepo,
                                   rotating_code)
from ....domain.events import EventRepo, REG_CONFIRMED
from ....domain.users import UserRepo
from ....services import attendance_service as att
from ....services.state_store import StateStore
from .. import ui
from ..ctx import Ctx
from ..router import v_int, v_word
from ..texts import t
from .events import _short, _staff
from .support import _w

STEP_CODE = "at_code"
STEP_SET = "at_set"
STEP_LOC = "at_loc"

PICK_METHODS = (A_CODE, A_ROTATE, A_TICKET, A_LOC, A_LINK, A_ROLL, A_DWELL)
SET_FIELDS = {"count": ("att_session_count", 1, 60),
              "interval": ("att_interval", 1, 90),
              "radius": ("att_radius", 50, 5000),
              "maxabsent": ("att_max_absent", 0, 30)}
LINK_TTL_MIN = 120
ROLL_WINDOW_MIN = 5
_AT_RE = re.compile(r"AT([A-Z0-9_-]{6,16})")


def _name(urepo: UserRepo, user_id: int) -> str:
    user = urepo.get(user_id)
    if user is None:
        return t("name_fallback")
    return user.full_name or user.first_name or t("name_fallback")


def _win(sess) -> str:
    def f(ts: float) -> str:
        return fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, tz=TEHRAN)) if ts else "—"
    return f"{f(sess.opens_ts)} → {f(sess.closes_ts)}"


def _state(sess, now: float) -> str:
    if not sess.is_open:
        return t("att_state_closed")
    if sess.opens_ts and now < sess.opens_ts:
        return t("att_state_closed")
    return t("att_state_open")


def _counts(arepo: AttendanceRepo, sid: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
    p = a = 0
    for r in arepo.records(session_id=sid):
        if r.status == ST_PRESENT:
            p += 1
        else:
            a += 1
    return p, a


def _user_of(urepo: UserRepo, ctx: Ctx):
    return urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)


def _res_reply(arepo: AttendanceRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
               res, sess, user_id: int) -> None:
    """پاسخ نتیجهٔ ثبت حضور + رویداد باس برای باشگاه/آمار (S7)."""
    if res.ok:
        bus.emit("att.present", user_id=user_id, event_id=sess.event_id,
                 session_id=sess.id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "att_ok", no=fa_num(sess.no), markup=ui.kb(
            [[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"atu:{sess.event_id}")]]))
        return
    if res.err == "att_far":
        ev_radius = 200
        responder.reply(ctx, "att_far", d=fa_num(res.distance),
                        r=fa_num(ev_radius), markup=ui.kb(
                            [[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"atck:{sess.id}")]]))
        return
    responder.reply(ctx, res.err or "err_generic", markup=ui.kb(
        [[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"atck:{sess.id}")]]))


# ---------------------------------------------------------- مدیر


def on_menu(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "atm-denied"
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "atm-none"
    if not ev.has_attendance:
        responder.reply(ctx, "att_disabled", markup=ui.kb(
            [[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"evm:{eid}")]]))
        return "atm-off"
    made = att.ensure_sessions(arepo, erepo, ev)
    if made:
        ev = erepo.get_event(eid) or ev
    sm = att.event_summary(arepo, erepo, eid)
    lines = [t("att_menu", title=ev.title, sessions=fa_num(sm["sessions"]),
               present=fa_num(sm["present"]), absent=fa_num(sm["absent"]),
               rate=fa_num(sm["rate"]))]
    if made:
        lines.append(t("att_plan_done", n=fa_num(made)))
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_att_sessions"), f"ats:{eid}"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_att_plan"), f"atp:{eid}")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_att_settings"), f"atst:{eid}"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_att_excel"), f"atx:{eid}")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"evm:{eid}")]]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "atm"


def on_plan(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "atp-denied"
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "atp-none"
    made = att.ensure_sessions(arepo, erepo, ev)
    responder.reply(ctx, "att_plan_done" if made else "att_plan_none",
                    n=fa_num(made))
    return on_menu(arepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, eid)


def on_sessions(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "ats-denied"
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "ats-none"
    att.ensure_sessions(arepo, erepo, ev)
    ss = arepo.sessions(eid)
    if not ss:
        responder.reply(ctx, "att_sessions_none")
        return "ats-empty"
    now = float(arepo.clock.ts() if arepo.clock else 0)
    lines, rows = [], []
    for s in ss[:7]:
        p, _a = _counts(arepo, s.id)
        lines.append(t("att_sess_line", no=fa_num(s.no),
                       state=_state(s, now), p=fa_num(p)))
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_att_sessions")[:0] or
                            f"{s.title[:20]}", f"atsd:{s.id}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_att_close") if s.is_open
                            else t("btn_att_open"), f"attog:{s.id}:"
                            + ("0" if s.is_open else "1"))])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"atm:{eid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "ats"


def _detail(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int, extra: str = "") -> str:
    sess = arepo.session(sid)
    if sess is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "atsd-none"
    ev = erepo.get_event(sess.event_id)
    p, a = _counts(arepo, sid)
    methods = str(getattr(ev, "att_methods", "") or "")
    lines = [t("att_detail", no=fa_num(sess.no), title=sess.title or "—",
               code=sess.code, method=t("att_m_" + (sess.method or "code")),
               win=_win(sess), p=fa_num(p), a=fa_num(a))]
    if extra:
        lines.append(extra)
    rows = []
    if "rotate" in methods:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_att_rotate"), f"atro:{sid}")])
    live = arepo.live_rollcall(sid, float(arepo.clock.ts()))
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_att_roll_stop") if live is not None
                        else t("btn_att_roll"),
                        f"atrx:{sid}" if live is not None else f"atrr:{sid}"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_att_manual"), f"atmn:{sid}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_att_link"), f"atln:{sid}"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_att_close") if sess.is_open
                        else t("btn_att_open"),
                        f"attog:{sid}:" + ("0" if sess.is_open else "1"))])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"ats:{sess.event_id}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "atsd"


def on_detail(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "atsd-denied"
    return _detail(arepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, sid)


def on_rotate(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "atro-denied"
    code = rotating_code(sid, float(arepo.clock.ts()), att.ROTATE_WINDOW_MIN)
    extra = t("att_rotate_now", code=code,
              m=fa_num(att.ROTATE_WINDOW_MIN))
    return _detail(arepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, sid, extra)


def on_roll_start(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                  responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "atrr-denied"
    arepo.open_rollcall(sid, ROLL_WINDOW_MIN)
    bus.emit("att.rollcall", session_id=sid)
    extra = t("att_roll_started", m=fa_num(ROLL_WINDOW_MIN))
    return _detail(arepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, sid, extra)


def on_roll_stop(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                 responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "atrx-denied"
    live = arepo.live_rollcall(sid, 1e18)
    extra = t("att_roll_stopped") if live is not None else t("att_roll_closed")
    if live is not None:
        arepo.close_rollcall(int(live["id"]))
    return _detail(arepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, sid, extra)


def on_manual(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int, extra: str = "") -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "atmn-denied"
    sess = arepo.session(sid)
    if sess is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "atmn-none"
    regs = erepo.event_regs(sess.event_id, statuses=(REG_CONFIRMED,))
    lines = [extra] if extra else []
    lines.append(t("att_manual_head"))
    rows = []
    for reg in regs[:6]:
        rec = arepo.record(sid, reg.user_id)
        if rec is None:
            st = "—"
        else:
            st = t("btn_present") if rec.status == ST_PRESENT \
                else t("btn_absent")
        lines.append(t("att_manual_line",
                       name=_name(urepo, reg.user_id), state=st))
        rows.append([ui.btn(_short(_name(urepo, reg.user_id))[:14],
                            f"atmk:{sid}:{reg.user_id}:1"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_absent"), f"atmk:{sid}:{reg.user_id}:0")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"atsd:{sid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "atmn"


def on_mark(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int, uid: int, ok: int) -> str:
    staff = _staff(urepo, ctx)
    if staff is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "atmk-denied"
    sess = arepo.session(sid)
    if sess is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "atmk-none"
    arepo.mark(sid, uid, A_MANUAL,
               ST_PRESENT if ok else ST_ABSENT, recorded_by=staff.id)
    bus.emit("att.manual", user_id=uid, event_id=sess.event_id,
             present=1 if ok else 0)
    extra = t("att_manual_done", name=_name(urepo, uid))
    return on_manual(arepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, sid, extra)


def on_link_token(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                  responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "atln-denied"
    tok = arepo.issue_token(sid, ttl_min=LINK_TTL_MIN)
    extra = t("att_link_admin", m=fa_num(LINK_TTL_MIN), token=tok.token)
    return _detail(arepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, sid, extra)


def on_toggle_open(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                   responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int, val: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "attog-denied"
    sess = arepo.session(sid)
    if sess is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "attog-none"
    extra = ""
    if val:
        now = float(arepo.clock.ts())
        kw = {"is_open": 1}
        if sess.closes_ts and sess.closes_ts < now:
            kw["closes_ts"] = now + 2 * 3600
        arepo.update_session(sid, **kw)
    else:
        n = att.close_session(arepo, erepo, sess)
        bus.emit("att.closed", event_id=sess.event_id, session_id=sid)
        extra = t("att_closed_done", n=fa_num(n))
    return _detail(arepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, sid, extra)


def on_settings(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:

             t("att_set_count", n=fa_num(ev.att_session_count)),
             t("att_set_interval", n=fa_num(ev.att_interval)),
             t("att_set_radius", n=fa_num(ev.att_radius)),
             t("att_set_absent", n=fa_num(ev.att_max_absent))]
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_att_count"), f"atsq:{eid}:count"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_att_interval"), f"atsq:{eid}:interval")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_att_radius"), f"atsq:{eid}:radius"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_att_absent"), f"atsq:{eid}:maxabsent")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_att_methods"), f"atme:{eid}")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"atm:{eid}")]]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "atst"


def on_ask_set(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
               state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int,
               field: str) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None or field not in SET_FIELDS:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "atsq-denied"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_SET, {"eid": eid, "field": field},
              merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "att_ask_" + field)
    return "atsq"


def on_methods(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
               responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "atme-denied"
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "atme-none"
    on_set = set(str(ev.att_methods or "").split(","))
    rows = []
    for a, b in zip(PICK_METHODS[0::2], PICK_METHODS[1::2] + (None,)):
        row = [ui.btn(t("att_m_" + a) + (" ✓" if a in on_set else ""),
                      f"atmet:{eid}:{a}")]
        if b is not None:
            row.append(ui.btn(t("att_m_" + b) + (" ✓" if b in on_set else ""),
                              f"atmet:{eid}:{b}"))
        rows.append(row)
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"atst:{eid}")])
    responder.reply(ctx, "att_methods_head", markup=ui.kb(rows))
    return "atme"


def on_toggle_method(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                     urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int,
                     m: str) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None or m not in PICK_METHODS:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "atmet-denied"
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "atmet-none"
    cur = [x for x in str(ev.att_methods or "").split(",") if x]
    if m in cur:
        cur.remove(m)
    else:
        cur.append(m)
    erepo.update_event(eid, att_methods=",".join(cur))
    return on_methods(arepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, eid)


def on_excel(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
             responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int, var_dir=None) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "atx-denied"
    from pathlib import Path
    dest = Path(var_dir or "var") / f"att-{eid}.xlsx"
    att.export_attendance(arepo, erepo, urepo, arepo.clock, eid, dest)
    when = fmt_dt(datetime.now(tz=TEHRAN))
    responder.send_doc_file(ctx.chat_id, str(dest), "att_excel_cap",
                            when=when)
    return "atx"


# ---------------------------------------------------------- کاربر


def on_user_sessions(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                     urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                     eid: int) -> str:
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    user = _user_of(urepo, ctx)
    if ev is None or not ev.has_attendance or user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "att_rep_none")
        return "atu-none"
    ss = arepo.sessions(eid)
    now = float(arepo.clock.ts())
    lines = [t("att_user_head", title=ev.title)]
    rows = []
    for s in ss[:7]:
        rec = arepo.record(s.id, user.id)
        if rec is not None:
            st = t("btn_present") if rec.status == ST_PRESENT \
                else t("btn_absent")
        else:
            st = _state(s, now)
        lines.append(t("att_user_sess", no=fa_num(s.no), state=st))
        if rec is None and s.is_open:
            rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_att_checkin") + f" — {fa_num(s.no)}",
                                f"atck:{s.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_my_report"), "atrep:1"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"ev:{eid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "atu"


def _hub(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
         responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int, extra: str = "") -> str:
    sess = arepo.session(sid)
    user = _user_of(urepo, ctx)
    if sess is None or user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "atck-none"
    ev = erepo.get_event(sess.event_id)
    allowed = [m for m in str(getattr(ev, "att_methods", "") or "").split(",")
               if m]
    now = float(arepo.clock.ts())
    lines = [extra] if extra else []
    lines.append(t("att_checkin_head"))
    rows = []
    row: list = []
    if A_CODE in allowed:
        row.append(ui.btn(t("btn_att_code"), f"atcd:{sid}:code"))
    if A_ROTATE in allowed:
        row.append(ui.btn(t("btn_att_rot"), f"atcd:{sid}:rotate"))
    if row:
        rows.append(row)
        row = []
    reg = erepo.reg_of(sess.event_id, user.id) if ev else None
    if A_TICKET in allowed and reg is not None and reg.ticket_code:
        row.append(ui.btn(t("btn_att_ticket"), f"attk:{sid}"))
    if A_LOC in allowed:
        row.append(ui.btn(t("btn_att_loc"), f"atlc:{sid}"))
    if row:
        rows.append(row)
        row = []
    if A_DWELL in allowed:
        pres = arepo.db.query_one(
            "SELECT joined_ts, left_ts FROM att_presence WHERE "
            "session_id = ? AND user_id = ?", (sid, user.id))
        joined = pres is not None and float(pres["joined_ts"] or 0) > 0 \
            and float(pres["left_ts"] or 0) == 0
        row.append(ui.btn(t("btn_att_leave") if joined
                          else t("btn_att_join"),
                          f"atle:{sid}" if joined else f"atjo:{sid}"))
    if A_LINK in allowed:
        row.append(ui.btn(t("att_m_link"), f"atli:{sid}"))
    if row:
        rows.append(row)
    if arepo.live_rollcall(sid, now) is not None:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_att_here"), f"athr:{sid}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"atu:{sess.event_id}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "atck"


def on_checkin_hub(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                   responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int) -> str:
    return _hub(arepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, sid)


def on_code_step(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                 state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int,
                 method: str) -> str:
    if method not in (A_CODE, A_ROTATE):
        responder.reply(ctx, "cb_bad")
        return "atcd-bad"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CODE, {"sid": sid, "method": method},
              merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "att_ask_code" if method == A_CODE
                    else "att_ask_rot")
    return "atcd"


def _do_check(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int, method: str, **kw) -> str:
    sess = arepo.session(sid)
    user = _user_of(urepo, ctx)
    if sess is None or user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "atck-none"
    res = att.check_in(arepo, erepo, urepo, sess, user.id, method,
                       now=float(arepo.clock.ts()), **kw)
    if res.ok and method == A_LOC:
        kw_radius = 200
        ev = erepo.get_event(sess.event_id)
        kw_radius = int(getattr(ev, "att_radius", 200) or 200) if ev else 200
        if res.distance:
            res = type(res)(True, "", res.record, res.distance)
        _res_reply(arepo, urepo, responder, ctx, res, sess, user.id)
        return "atck-ok"
    _res_reply(arepo, urepo, responder, ctx, res, sess, user.id)
    return "atck-ok" if res.ok else "atck-err"


def on_ticket_check(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                    urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int) -> str:
    sess = arepo.session(sid)
    user = _user_of(urepo, ctx)
    if sess is None or user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "attk-none"
    reg = erepo.reg_of(sess.event_id, user.id)
    code = reg.ticket_code if reg is not None else ""
    res = att.check_in(arepo, erepo, urepo, sess, user.id, A_TICKET,
                       ticket_code=code, now=float(arepo.clock.ts()))
    _res_reply(arepo, urepo, responder, ctx, res, sess, user.id)
    return "attk"


def on_loc_request(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                   state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                   sid: int) -> str:
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_LOC, {"sid": sid}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "att_loc_ask", markup={
        "keyboard": [[{"text": t("btn_send_loc"),
                       "request_location": True}]],
        "resize_keyboard": True, "one_time_keyboard": True})
    return "atlc"


def on_location(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, loc: dict) -> None:
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_LOC:
        return
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    sess = arepo.session(int(data.get("sid") or 0))
    user = _user_of(urepo, ctx)
    if sess is None or user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic",
                        markup={"remove_keyboard": True})
        return
    res = att.check_in(arepo, erepo, urepo, sess, user.id, A_LOC,
                       lat=float(loc.get("latitude") or 0),
                       lon=float(loc.get("longitude") or 0),
                       now=float(arepo.clock.ts()))
    if res.ok:
        bus.emit("att.present", user_id=user.id, event_id=sess.event_id,
                 session_id=sess.id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "att_ok", no=fa_num(sess.no),
                        markup={"remove_keyboard": True})
        return
    if res.err == "att_far":
        ev = erepo.get_event(sess.event_id)
        radius = int(getattr(ev, "att_radius", 200) or 200) if ev else 200
        responder.reply(ctx, "att_far", d=fa_num(res.distance),
                        r=fa_num(radius), markup={"remove_keyboard": True})
        return
    responder.reply(ctx, res.err or "err_generic",
                    markup={"remove_keyboard": True})


def on_join(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int) -> str:
    user = _user_of(urepo, ctx)
    if user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "atjo-none"
    arepo.join(sid, user.id)
    return _hub(arepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, sid, t("att_joined"))


def on_leave(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
             responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int) -> str:
    user = _user_of(urepo, ctx)
    sess = arepo.session(sid)
    if user is None or sess is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "atle-none"
    secs = arepo.leave(sid, user.id)
    res = att.dwell_settle(arepo, sess, user.id)
    lines = [t("att_left", m=fa_num(secs // 60)),
             t("att_dwell_ok") if res.ok else t("att_dwell_short")]
    if res.ok:
        bus.emit("att.present", user_id=user.id, event_id=sess.event_id,
                 session_id=sess.id)
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(
        [[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"atu:{sess.event_id}")]]))
    return "atle"


def on_here(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int) -> str:
    return _do_check(arepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, sid, A_ROLL)


def on_link_hint(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                 responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int) -> str:
    sess = arepo.session(sid)
    responder.reply(ctx, "att_link_hint", markup=ui.kb(
        [[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"atck:{sid}")]]) if sess else None)
    return "atli"


def on_report(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    user = _user_of(urepo, ctx)
    if user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "att_rep_none")
        return "atrep-none"
    rep = att.user_report(arepo, urepo, user.id)
    if not rep:
        responder.reply(ctx, "att_rep_none", markup=ui.kb(
            [[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "nav:home")]]))
        return "atrep-empty"
    lines = [t("att_rep_head")]
    for d in rep:
        ev = erepo.get_event(int(d["event_id"]))
        title = ev.title if ev is not None else fa_num(d["event_id"])
        lines.append(t("att_rep_line", title=title, p=fa_num(d["present"]),
                       a=fa_num(d["absent"])))
        if ev is not None and d["absent"] > int(ev.att_max_absent or 0):
            lines.append(t("att_rep_warn", title=title,
                           a=fa_num(d["absent"]),
                           m=fa_num(ev.att_max_absent)))
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(
        [[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "nav:home")]]))
    return "atrep"


def home_report_row(arepo: AttendanceRepo | None, user) -> list:
    """ردیف «کارنامهٔ من» برای خانه — فقط وقتی ثبت حضوری دارد."""
    if arepo is None or user is None:
        return []
    if not arepo.records(user_id=user.id):
        return []
    return [[ui.btn(t("btn_my_report"), "atrep:1")]]


# ---------------------------------------------------------- دیپ‌لینک


def deep_link(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, payload: str) -> bool:
    """/start atTOKEN — فرود روی لینک ثبت حضور."""
    m = _AT_RE.fullmatch(en_num(str(payload).strip()).upper())
    if m is None:
        return False
    tok = arepo.token(m.group(1))
    user = _user_of(urepo, ctx)
    if tok is None or user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "att_token_bad")
        return True
    sess = arepo.session(tok.session_id)
    if sess is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "att_token_bad")
        return True
    res = att.check_in(arepo, erepo, urepo, sess, user.id, A_LINK,
                       token=tok.token, now=float(arepo.clock.ts()))
    _res_reply(arepo, urepo, responder, ctx, res, sess, user.id)
    return True


# ---------------------------------------------------------- متن/tick


def text_interceptor(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                     urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
                     ctx: Ctx, text: str) -> bool:
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step == STEP_CODE:
        sid = int(data.get("sid") or 0)
        method = str(data.get("method") or A_CODE)
        sess = arepo.session(sid)
        user = _user_of(urepo, ctx)
        if sess is None or user is None:
            state.clear(ctx.user_id)
            responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
            return True
        res = att.check_in(arepo, erepo, urepo, sess, user.id, method,
                           code=text.strip(), now=float(arepo.clock.ts()))
        if res.ok:
            state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        _res_reply(arepo, urepo, responder, ctx, res, sess, user.id)
        return True
    if step == STEP_SET:
        spec = SET_FIELDS.get(str(data.get("field") or ""))
        if spec is None:
            state.clear(ctx.user_id)
            return True
        col, lo, hi = spec
        try:
            value = int(en_num(text.strip()))
        except ValueError:
            responder.reply(ctx, "att_set_bad")
            return True
        if not lo <= value <= hi:
            responder.reply(ctx, "att_set_bad")
            return True
        eid = int(data.get("eid") or 0)
        erepo.update_event(eid, **{col: value})
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        on_settings(arepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, eid)
        return True
    return False


def tick(arepo: AttendanceRepo, erepo: EventRepo, responder, clock) -> None:
    """بستن خودکار جلسه‌هایی که پنجره‌شان گذشته است."""
    now = float(clock.ts())
    for sess in arepo.open_sessions(now):
        att.close_session(arepo, erepo, sess)
        bus.emit("att.closed", event_id=sess.event_id, session_id=sess.id)

"""تست صفحه‌های حضور و غیاب: منوی مدیر، ثبت حضور کاربر، لینک، حاضرباش، اکسل."""
import re
from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.attendance import AttendanceRepo
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.event_service import EventService


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db, tmp_path):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock,
                              transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    arepo = AttendanceRepo(db, clock)
    esvc = EventService(erepo, clock)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved")
    u1 = urepo.create(10, first_name="مریم")
    urepo.update(u1.id, status="approved", full_name="مریم رادمهر")
    u2 = urepo.create(11, first_name="علی")
    urepo.update(u2.id, status="approved", full_name="علی رضایی")
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه عکاسی", kind="workshop",
                            start_ts=clock.ts() + 86400, status="published",
                            require_profile=0, has_attendance=1,
                            att_session_count=2, att_interval=7)
    for u in (u1, u2):
        assert esvc.register(u, ev).reg is not None
    with db.transaction():
        db.execute("UPDATE registrations SET status = 'confirmed', "
                   "ticket_code = 'TK' || user_id")
    yield (bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, ev,
           {"admin": 999, "u1": 10, "u2": 11,
            "uid1": u1.id, "uid2": u2.id})
    set_clock(old)


def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    kind = bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()
    return kind


def cb(data, uid=999):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def locmsg(lat, lon, uid=10):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "location": {"latitude": lat, "longitude": lon}}}


def last(sent):
    return str(sent[-1].get("text") or sent[-1].get("caption") or "")


def _open_all(env):
    """همهٔ جلسه‌ها را همین حالا باز می‌کند و اولی را برمی‌گرداند."""
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, ev, ids = env
    for s in arepo.sessions(ev.id):
        arepo.update_session(s.id, opens_ts=clock.ts() - 600,
                             closes_ts=clock.ts() + 3600)
    return arepo.sessions(ev.id)[0]


def test_admin_menu_plans_sessions(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, ev, ids = env
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atm:{ev.id}"))
    assert "حضور و غیاب" in last(sent)
    assert len(arepo.sessions(ev.id)) == 2


def test_user_code_checkin(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, ev, ids = env
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atm:{ev.id}"))
    s = _open_all(env)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atu:{ev.id}", ids["u1"]))
    assert "جلسهٔ" in last(sent) or "جلسه‌های" in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atcd:{s.id}:code", ids["u1"]))
    step(bot, clock, msg(s.code, ids["u1"]))
    assert "حضورتان ثبت شد" in last(sent)
    assert arepo.record(s.id, ids["uid1"]).status == "present"


def test_ticket_one_tap(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, ev, ids = env
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atm:{ev.id}"))
    s = _open_all(env)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"attk:{s.id}", ids["u1"]))
    assert "حضورتان ثبت شد" in last(sent)
    rec = arepo.record(s.id, ids["uid1"])
    assert rec.method == "ticket"


def test_deeplink_token_once(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, ev, ids = env
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atm:{ev.id}"))
    s = _open_all(env)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atln:{s.id}"))
    m = re.search(r"at([A-Z0-9_-]{6,16})", last(sent))
    assert m is not None
    step(bot, clock, msg("/start at" + m.group(1), ids["u1"]))
    assert "حضورتان ثبت شد" in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, msg("/start at" + m.group(1), ids["u2"]))
    assert "یک‌بار مصرف" in last(sent)


def test_rollcall_flow(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, ev, ids = env
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atm:{ev.id}"))
    s = _open_all(env)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atrr:{s.id}"))
    assert "حاضرباش" in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"athr:{s.id}", ids["u1"]))
    assert "حضورتان ثبت شد" in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atrx:{s.id}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"athr:{s.id}", ids["u2"]))
    assert "حاضرباش باز نیست" in last(sent)


def test_manual_mark_and_close(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, ev, ids = env
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atm:{ev.id}"))
    s = _open_all(env)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atmk:{s.id}:{ids['uid1']}:1"))
    assert arepo.record(s.id, ids["uid1"]).status == "present"
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"attog:{s.id}:0"))
    assert "خودکار غایب" in last(sent)
    assert arepo.record(s.id, ids["uid2"]).status == "absent"
    assert arepo.session(s.id).is_open == 0


def test_location_flow(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, ev, ids = env
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atm:{ev.id}"))
    s = _open_all(env)
    arepo.update_session(s.id, lat=35.70, lon=51.40)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atlc:{s.id}", ids["u1"]))

    step(bot, clock, locmsg(36.0, 52.0, ids["u1"]))
    assert "متر است" in last(sent)            # دور است
    step(bot, clock, locmsg(35.7001, 51.4001, ids["u1"]))
    assert "حضورتان ثبت شد" in last(sent)

parse_geo:



def _parse_geo(text: str):
    parts = re.split(r"[,\s،]+", en_num(" ".join(str(text or "").split())))
    parts = [p for p in parts if p]
    if len(parts) != 2:
        return None
    try:
        lat, lon = float(parts[0]), float(parts[1])
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if not -90 <= lat <= 90 or not -180 <= lon <= 180:
        return None
    return lat, lon

"""تست جزئیات کامل ثبت برنامه (دور ۳): فیلدهای تازه، صفحه‌بندی ویرایش،
شروع ثبت‌نام، ارث‌بری مختصات به حضور و غیاب، محرمانگی یادداشت داخلی."""
from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.attendance import AttendanceRepo
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.event_service import EventService


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db, tmp_path):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(dict(params, _url=url))
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock,
                              transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    arepo = AttendanceRepo(db, clock)
    esvc = EventService(erepo, clock)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved")
    u1 = urepo.create(10, first_name="مریم")
    urepo.update(u1.id, status="approved", full_name="مریم رادمهر")
    yield bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, esvc, u1
    set_clock(old)


def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    kind = bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()
    return kind


def cb(data, uid=999):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def last(sent):
    return str(sent[-1].get("text") or sent[-1].get("caption") or "")


def _ev(erepo, clock, **kw):
    base = dict(title="کارگاه عکاسی", kind="workshop", status="published",
                start_ts=clock.ts() + 86400, require_profile=0)
    base.update(kw)
    return erepo.create_event(**base)


def test_new_columns_roundtrip(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, esvc, u1 = env
    ev = _ev(erepo, clock, end_ts=clock.ts() + 200000,
             reg_start_ts=clock.ts() + 100, loc_lat=35.7, loc_lon=51.4,
             points_reward=15, contact_info="021-88776655",
             notes="یادداشت محرمانه", has_survey=1)
    got = erepo.get_event(ev.id)
    assert got.end_ts == ev.end_ts and got.reg_start_ts == ev.reg_start_ts
    assert abs(got.loc_lat - 35.7) < 1e-9 and abs(got.loc_lon - 51.4) < 1e-9
    assert got.points_reward == 15 and got.contact_info == "021-88776655"
    assert got.notes == "یادداشت محرمانه" and got.has_survey == 1


def test_reg_start_guard(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, esvc, u1 = env
    ev = _ev(erepo, clock, reg_start_ts=clock.ts() + 7200)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"reg:{ev.id}", 10))
    assert t("ev_reg_not_started") in last(sent)
    erepo.update_event(ev.id, reg_start_ts=clock.ts() - 10)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"reg:{ev.id}", 10))
    assert esvc is not None
    reg = erepo.reg_of(ev.id, u1.id)
    assert reg is not None and reg.status == "confirmed"


def test_attendance_inherits_event_geo(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, esvc, u1 = env
    ev = _ev(erepo, clock, loc_lat=35.70, loc_lon=51.40, att_radius=150,
             has_attendance=1)
    esvc.register(u1, ev)
    erepo.update_reg_status(ev.id, u1.id, "confirmed") \
        if hasattr(erepo, "update_reg_status") else None
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atm:{ev.id}"))
    ss = arepo.sessions(ev.id)
    assert ss and abs(ss[0].lat - 35.70) < 1e-9
    assert abs(ss[0].lon - 51.40) < 1e-9 and ss[0].radius_m == 150


def test_edit_menu_paging_and_new_fields(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, esvc, u1 = env
    ev = _ev(erepo, clock)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"eved:{ev.id}"))
    body = last(sent)
    assert t("evf_title") in body and t("evf_geo") not in body
    assert f"evedp:{ev.id}:page:1" in str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"evedp:{ev.id}:page:2"))
    body = last(sent)
    assert t("evf_geo") in body or t("evf_notes") in body
    # امتیاز شرکت در صفحهٔ ۲
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"evsetp:{ev.id}:points_reward:2"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("۱۵"))
    assert erepo.get_event(ev.id).points_reward == 15
    # redraw روی همان صفحهٔ ۲
    assert t("evf_points") in last(sent)
    # مختصات
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"evsetp:{ev.id}:loc_geo:2"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("۳۵.۷, ۵۱.۴"))
    got = erepo.get_event(ev.id)
    assert abs(got.loc_lat - 35.7) < 1e-6 and abs(got.loc_lon - 51.4) < 1e-6


def test_detail_lines_and_private_notes(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo, esvc, u1 = env
    ev = _ev(erepo, clock, end_ts=clock.ts() + 200000,
             contact_info="021-88776655", points_reward=15,
             notes="فقط-مدیر-۹۹۹")
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"ev:{ev.id}", 10))
    body = last(sent)
    assert t("ev_contact_line", info="021-88776655") in body
    assert t("ev_points_line", n="۱۵") in body
    assert "پایان:" in body
    assert "فقط-مدیر-۹۹۹" not in body
    # ادمین در ویرایش می‌بیند
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"eved:{ev.id}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"evedp:{ev.id}:page:2"))
    assert "فقط-مدیر-۹۹۹" in last(sent)

bulk_confirm:



def _bulk_confirm(state, responder, ctx, eid, vals, n):
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_BULK, {"eid": eid, "vals": vals}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "cert_bulk_q", n=fa_num(n), markup=ui.kb([
        [ui.btn(t("cert_btn_confirm"), f"certbk:{eid}"),
         ui.btn(t("cert_btn_cancel"), "certx:1")]]))
    return "certb-confirm"
Edge case: n==0 → the certb handler already replied with cert_bulk_none before entering vars. But it could change between steps — on_bulk re-checks.

on_bulk:



def on_bulk(certs, csvc, erepo, urepo, attrepo, state, responder, ctx, eid):
    admin = _top(urepo, ctx)
    if admin is None: no_perm
    _step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    vals = data.get("vals", {}) if data else {}
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None: cert_ev_none
    users = csvc.eligible_users(erepo, attrepo, ev) if attrepo is not None else []
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    n = 0
    for uid in users:
        try:
            cert = csvc.issue(eid, uid, vals, by=admin.id)
        except CertIssueError:
            continue
        n += 1
        holder = _name(urepo, uid)
        bus.emit("cert.issue", user_id=uid, holder=holder, title=ev.title,
                 number=cert.number, code=cert.code)
        path = csvc.cert_path(cert, holder, ev.title,
                              fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ev.start_ts, tz=TEHRAN)) if ev.start_ts else "",
                              theme=ev.ticket_theme)
        bale = _bale(urepo, uid)
        if bale:
            responder.send_photo_file(bale, path, "cert_cap_user", n=fa_num(cert.number))
    responder.reply(ctx, "cert_bulk_done", n=fa_num(n))
    return "certbk"
on_hub:



def on_hub(certs, csvc, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, eid):
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None: no_perm → "certe-denied"
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None: cert_ev_none → "certe-none"
    cond = str(ev.cert_condition or "none")
    if cond not in CONDITIONS: cond = "none"
    cname = t("cert_c_" + cond, n=fa_num(max(1, ev.cert_min_sessions or 1)), p=fa_num(max(1, ev.cert_min_percent or 70)))
    head = "\n".join([t("cert_hub", title=ev.title), t("cert_hub_line", cond=cname)])
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("cert_btn_single"), f"certu:{eid}"), ui.btn(t("cert_btn_bulk"), f"certb:{eid}")],
            [ui.btn(t("cert_btn_cond"), f"certc:{eid}"), ui.btn(t("cert_btn_test"), "certt:1")],
            [ui.btn(t("cert_btn_docno"), f"evsetp:{eid}:cert_doc_no:1"), ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "certi:1")]]
