"""پشتیبانی کامل: تیکت (دسته/اولویت/امتیاز/پاسخ‌دهنده)، صندوق دریافت،
پیام ناشناس، سوالات متداول با رسانه، پاسخ با ویس/عکس/فایل، تنظیمات.

قاعدهٔ هویت: کاربر همیشه می‌فهمد با کی حرف می‌زند — «پشتیبان · خانم/آقای
{فامیلی}». در پیام ناشناس، نام فرستنده حتی به مدیر هم نشان داده نمی‌شود.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from ....core.events import bus
from ....core.num import fa_num, en_num
from ....domain.support import (INBOX_ANON, INBOX_DIRECT, SUP_CLOSED,
                                SUP_OPEN, SupportRepo)
from ....domain.users import UserRepo
from ....services.permissions import can
from ....services.state_store import StateStore
from ..ctx import Ctx
from ..router import Reply, v_int
from ..texts import t
from .. import ui
from .events import _staff

STEP_NEW = "sup_new"
STEP_SOS = "sup_sos"
STEP_ANON = "sup_anon"
STEP_DIRECT = "sup_direct"
STEP_REP = "sup_rep"
STEP_IREP = "sup_irep"
STEP_FAQ_Q = "sup_faq_q"
STEP_FAQ_A = "sup_faq_a"
STEP_FAQ_PH = "sup_faq_ph"
STEP_SET = "sup_set"

_M_TAG = {"photo": "sup_m_photo", "voice": "sup_m_voice",
          "video": "sup_m_video", "audio": "sup_m_audio",
          "document": "sup_m_doc"}


# ------------------------------------------------------------ پایه


def _name(urepo: UserRepo, user_id: int, by_bale: bool = False) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(user_id) if by_bale else urepo.get(user_id)
    if user is None:
        return t("name_fallback")
    return user.full_name or user.first_name or t("name_fallback")


def _agent(urepo: UserRepo, bale_id: int) -> str:
    """برچسب پاسخ‌دهنده برای کاربر: «خانم/آقای فامیلی» — فقط فامیلی."""
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(bale_id)
    if user is None:
        return ""
    full = (user.full_name or "").strip()
    fam = full.split()[-1] if full else (user.first_name or "")
    title = ""
    if user.gender == "female":
        title = t("agent_f")
    elif user.gender == "male":
        title = t("agent_m")
    return (title + " " + fam).strip() or fam


def _kv(setrepo, key: str, default: str) -> str:
    if setrepo is None:
        return default
    val = str(setrepo.get(key, default) or "")
    return val if val != "" else default


def _cats(setrepo) -> list[str]:
    raw = _kv(setrepo, "sup_cats", t("sup_cats_default"))
    return [c.strip() for c in raw.split(",") if c.strip()]


def _max_open(setrepo) -> int:
    try:
        n = int(en_num(_kv(setrepo, "sup_max_open", "2")))
    except ValueError:
        return 2
    return max(1, min(10, n))


def _anon_on(setrepo) -> bool:
    return _kv(setrepo, "sup_anon", "1") == "1"


def _msg_line(m) -> str:
    who = "sup_line_u" if m.sender == "user" else "sup_line_a"
    text = m.text or ""
    if getattr(m, "media_kind", ""):
        text = (text + " " if text else "") + t(_M_TAG[m.media_kind])
    return t(who, text=text)


def _deliver(responder, urepo: UserRepo, user_id: int, text: str,
             agent_bale: int = 0, anon: bool = False) -> None:
    head = t("sup_anon_reply_head") if anon else \\
        t("sup_agent_head", agent=_agent(urepo, agent_bale) or "—")
    responder.bulk_raw(user_id, head + "\n" + text)


def _deliver_media(responder, urepo: UserRepo, bale_id: int, kind: str,
                   file_id: str, agent_bale: int = 0,
                   anon: bool = False) -> bool:
    head = t("sup_anon_reply_head") if anon else \\
        t("sup_agent_head", agent=_agent(urepo, agent_bale) or "—")
    return responder.send_media_raw(bale_id, kind, file_id, head)


# ------------------------------------------------------------ کاربر


def on_support_start(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, cfg, state,
                     responder, ctx: Ctx, setrepo=None, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    uid = user.id if user is not None else 0
    ticket = suprepo.open_for(uid)
    lines = [t("sup_menu")]
    if ticket is not None:
        lines.append(t("sup_menu_open", id=fa_num(ticket.id),
                       cat=ticket.category or t("sup_st_open")))
    contact = _kv(setrepo, "sup_contact", "")
    if contact:
        lines.append(t("sup_contact_line", id=contact))
    rows = [
        [ui.btn(t("btn_sup_new"), "supn:1"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_sup_my"), "supmy:1")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_sup_faq"), "supf:1"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_sup_direct"), "supd:1")],
    ]
    if _anon_on(setrepo):
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_sup_anon"), "supa:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "sup"


def on_new_ticket(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
                  ctx: Ctx, setrepo=None, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    uid = user.id if user is not None else 0
    if suprepo.open_count_for(uid) >= _max_open(setrepo):
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_max_err",
                        n=fa_num(_max_open(setrepo)))
        return "supn-max"
    cats = _cats(setrepo)
    rows = [[ui.btn(c[:30], f"supcat:{i}")] for i, c in enumerate(cats[:9])]
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_cat_pick", markup=ui.kb(rows))
    return "supn"


def on_pick_cat(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
                ctx: Ctx, idx: int, setrepo=None) -> str:
    cats = _cats(setrepo)
    if not 0 <= idx < len(cats):
        return on_new_ticket(suprepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, setrepo)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    uid = user.id if user is not None else 0
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_NEW,
              {"stage": "text", "uid": uid, "cat": cats[idx],
               "priority": 0}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_ask_cat", cat=cats[idx])
    return "supcat"


def on_sos(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
           ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    uid = user.id if user is not None else 0
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_SOS, {"uid": uid}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_sos_ask")
    return "sos"


def on_my_tickets(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                  ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_my_none")
        return "supmy-none"
    items = suprepo.list_user(user.id)
    if not items:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_my_none")
        return "supmy-none"
    lines = [t("sup_my_title")]
    rows = []
    for tk in items:
        st = t("sup_st_open") if tk.status == SUP_OPEN else \\
            t("sup_st_closed")
        cat = (" · " + tk.category) if tk.category else ""
        lines.append(t("sup_my_row", id=fa_num(tk.id), status=st) + cat)
        rows.append([ui.btn(f"{fa_num(tk.id)} · {st}", f"supuv:{tk.id}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "supmy"


def on_user_view(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                 ctx: Ctx, tid: int) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    tk = suprepo.get(tid)
    if user is None or tk is None or tk.user_id != user.id:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supuv-denied"
    lines = [t("sup_user_view", id=fa_num(tk.id))]
    for m in suprepo.msgs(tid):
        lines.append(_msg_line(m))
    rows = []
    if tk.status == SUP_CLOSED and not tk.rating:
        lines.append(t("sup_rate_ask"))
        rows.append([ui.btn(fa_num(i), f"suprate:{tid}:{i}")
                     for i in range(1, 6)])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "supmy:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "supuv"


def on_rate(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
            tid: int, stars: int) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    tk = suprepo.get(tid)
    if user is None or tk is None or tk.user_id != user.id:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "suprate-denied"
    suprepo.rate(tid, stars)
    bus.emit("sup.rate", user_id=user.id, ticket_id=tid, stars=stars)
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_rate_done")
    return "suprate"


def on_faq_user(suprepo: SupportRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                _a: int = 0) -> str:
    items = suprepo.faq_list(enabled_only=True)
    if not items:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_faq_user_none",
                        markup=ui.kb([[ui.btn(t("btn_support"), "sup:1")]]))
        return "supf-none"
    rows = [[ui.btn(f.q[:30], f"supfv:{f.id}")] for f in items[:9]]
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "sup:1")])
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_faq_title", markup=ui.kb(rows))
    return "supf"


def on_faq_view(suprepo: SupportRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    item = suprepo.faq_get(fid)
    if item is None or not item.enabled:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_faq_user_none")
        return "supfv-none"
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, item.q + "\n\n" + item.a,
                        ui.kb([[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "supf:1")]]))
    if item.media_file_id:
        responder.send_media_raw(ctx.user_id, item.media_kind or "photo",
                                 item.media_file_id)
    return "supfv"


def on_anon_start(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
                  ctx: Ctx, setrepo=None, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if not _anon_on(setrepo):
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_anon_off")
        return "supa-off"
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    uid = user.id if user is not None else 0
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_ANON, {"uid": uid}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_anon_ask")
    return "supa"


def on_direct_start(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
                    ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    uid = user.id if user is not None else 0
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_DIRECT, {"uid": uid}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_direct_ask")
    return "supd"


# ------------------------------------------------------------ مدیر


def _mgr(urepo: UserRepo, ctx: Ctx):
    """مدیریت پشتیبانی (FAQ/تنظیمات): فقط admin/owner."""
    user = _staff(urepo, ctx)
    if user is None or not can(user.role, "manage_support"):
        return None
    return user


def on_admin_menu(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                  ctx: Ctx, setrepo=None, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supm-denied"
    open_n = len(suprepo.list_open())
    unseen = suprepo.inbox_unseen()
    lines = [t("supm_menu"),
             t("supm_counts", tickets=fa_num(open_n),
               inbox=fa_num(unseen))]
    rows = [
        [ui.btn(t("btn_sup_tickets", n=fa_num(open_n)), "supl:1"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_sup_inbox", n=fa_num(unseen)), "supi:1")],
    ]
    if _mgr(urepo, ctx) is not None:
        rows.append(
            [ui.btn(t("btn_sup_faqm"), "supfa:1"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_sup_sets"), "sups:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "supm"


def on_list(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
            page: int = 1) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supl-denied"
    items = suprepo.list_open() if page == 1 else suprepo.list_closed()
    key = "sup_list_title" if page == 1 else "sup_list_closed_title"
    if not items:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_list_none" if page == 1 else key,
                        n=fa_num(0))
        return "supl-none"
    lines = [t(key, n=fa_num(len(items)))]
    rows = []
    for tk in items[:8]:
        pri = t("sup_row_urgent") if tk.priority else ""
        who = _name(urepo, tk.user_id)
        lines.append(f"{fa_num(tk.id)} — {who}{pri}"
                     + (f" · {tk.category}" if tk.category else ""))
        rows.append([ui.btn(who[:24] + pri, f"supv:{tk.id}")])
    other = [ui.btn(t("btn_sup_closed"), "supl:2")] if page == 1 else \
        [ui.btn(t("btn_sup_open"), "supl:1")]
    rows.append(other + [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "supm:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "supl"


def on_view(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
            tid: int, note: str = "") -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supv-denied"
    tk = suprepo.get(tid)
    if tk is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_list_none", n=fa_num(0))
        return "supv-none"
    lines = ([note] if note else []) + \
        [t("sup_view_title", id=fa_num(tk.id), name=_name(urepo, tk.user_id))]
    if tk.agent_id:
        agent = urepo.get(tk.agent_id)
        if agent is not None:
            fam = (agent.full_name or agent.first_name or "").split()
            lines.append(t("sup_view_agent", agent=fam[-1] if fam else "—"))
    if tk.rating:
        lines.append(t("sup_view_rating", n=fa_num(tk.rating)))
    for m in suprepo.msgs(tid):
        lines.append(_msg_line(m))
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_sup_reply"), f"supr:{tid}"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_sup_pri"), f"suppri:{tid}")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_sup_close"), f"supc:{tid}"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "supl:1")]]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "supv"


def on_priority(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                tid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "suppri-denied"
    tk = suprepo.get(tid)
    if tk is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_list_none", n=fa_num(0))
        return "suppri-none"
    suprepo.set_priority(tid, 0 if tk.priority else 1)
    note = t("sup_pri_off") if tk.priority else t("sup_pri_on")
    return on_view(suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx, tid, note=note)


def on_reply_start(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
                   ctx: Ctx, tid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supr-denied"
    tk = suprepo.get(tid)
    if tk is None or tk.status != SUP_OPEN:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_closed_err")
        return "supr-closed"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_REP, {"tid": tid}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_rep_hint")
    return "supr"


def on_close(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
             tid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supc-denied"
    tk = suprepo.get(tid)
    if tk is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_list_none", n=fa_num(0))
        return "supc-none"
    suprepo.close(tid)
    bus.emit("sup.close", actor_id=ctx.user_id, ticket_id=tid)
    user = urepo.get(tk.user_id)
    if user is not None:
        responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "sup_closed_user", id=fa_num(tid),
                       markup=ui.kb(
                           [[ui.btn(t("btn_sup_rate"), f"supuv:{tid}")]]))
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_closed")
    return "supc"


# ------------------------------------------------------- صندوق دریافت


def on_inbox_list(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                  ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supi-denied"
    items = suprepo.inbox_list(limit=10)
    if not items:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_inbox_none",
                        markup=ui.kb([[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "supm:1")]]))
        return "supi-none"
    lines = [t("sup_inbox_title")]
    rows = []
    for it in items:
        if it.kind == INBOX_ANON:
            who = t("sup_inbox_anon")
        else:
            who = _name(urepo, it.user_id)
        new = "" if it.seen else " · " + t("sup_inbox_new")
        lines.append(f"{fa_num(it.id)} — {who}{new}")
        rows.append([ui.btn((who + new)[:30], f"supiv:{it.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "supm:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "supi"


def on_inbox_view(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                  ctx: Ctx, iid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supiv-denied"
    it = suprepo.inbox_get(iid)
    if it is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_inbox_none")
        return "supiv-none"
    suprepo.inbox_seen(iid)
    if it.kind == INBOX_ANON:
        lines = [t("sup_inbox_view_anon")]
    else:
        lines = [t("sup_inbox_view", name=_name(urepo, it.user_id))]
    body = it.text or ""
    if it.media_kind:
        body = (body + " " if body else "") + t(_M_TAG[it.media_kind])
    lines.append(body or "—")
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_sup_reply"), f"supir:{iid}"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "supi:1")]]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    if it.media_file_id and it.media_kind != "photo":
        responder.send_media_raw(ctx.user_id, it.media_kind,
                                 it.media_file_id)
    elif it.media_file_id:
        responder.send_photo(ctx.user_id, it.media_file_id)
    return "supiv"


def on_inbox_reply(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
                   ctx: Ctx, iid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supir-denied"
    it = suprepo.inbox_get(iid)
    if it is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_inbox_none")
        return "supir-none"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_IREP, {"iid": iid}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_rep_hint")
    return "supir"


# ------------------------------------------------------ سوالات متداول


def on_faq_admin(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                 ctx: Ctx, note: str = "") -> str:
    if _mgr(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supfa-denied"
    items = suprepo.faq_list()
    lines = ([note] if note else []) + [t("sup_faqm_title")]
    rows = []
    for f in items[:9]:
        off = "" if f.enabled else " " + t("sup_faq_off_marker")
        lines.append(f"· {f.q[:36]}{off}")
        rows.append([ui.btn(f.q[:24] + off, f"supfe:{f.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_sup_faq_add"), "supfn:1"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "supm:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "supfa"


def on_faq_edit(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    if _mgr(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supfe-denied"
    item = suprepo.faq_get(fid)
    if item is None:
        return on_faq_admin(suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx)
    body = item.q + "\n\n" + item.a
    if item.media_kind:
        body += "\n" + t(_M_TAG[item.media_kind])
    tog = "sup_faq_toggled_on" if not item.enabled else "sup_faq_toggled_off"
    rows = [
        [ui.btn(t("btn_sup_faq_del"), f"supfd:{fid}"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_sup_faq_toggle"), f"supft:{fid}")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_sup_faq_up"), f"supfu:{fid}"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_sup_faq_down"), f"supfw:{fid}")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "supfa:1")],
    ]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, body, ui.kb(rows))
    del tog
    return "supfe"


def on_faq_new(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
               ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _mgr(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supfn-denied"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FAQ_Q, {}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_faq_q_ask")
    return "supfn"


def on_faq_del(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
               fid: int) -> str:
    if _mgr(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supfd-denied"
    suprepo.faq_delete(fid)
    return on_faq_admin(suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx,
                        note=t("sup_faq_deleted"))


def on_faq_toggle(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                  ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    if _mgr(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supft-denied"
    item = suprepo.faq_get(fid)
    if item is None:
        return on_faq_admin(suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx)
    suprepo.faq_update(fid, enabled=0 if item.enabled else 1)
    note = t("sup_faq_toggled_off") if item.enabled else \\
        t("sup_faq_toggled_on")
    return on_faq_admin(suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx, note=note)


def _faq_move(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
              fid: int, up: bool) -> str:
    if _mgr(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supfu-denied"
    suprepo.faq_move(fid, up)
    return on_faq_admin(suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx,
                        note=t("sup_faq_moved"))


def on_faq_up(suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    return _faq_move(suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid, True)


def on_faq_down(suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    return _faq_move(suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid, False)


def on_faq_skip(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
                ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    _save_faq(suprepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, "", "")
    return "supfskip"


def _save_faq(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
              ctx: Ctx, media_file_id: str, media_kind: str) -> None:
    _step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    suprepo.faq_add(data.get("q", ""), data.get("a", ""),
                    media_file_id, media_kind)
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_faq_saved")


# --------------------------------------------------------- تنظیمات


def on_settings(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                ctx: Ctx, setrepo=None, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _mgr(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "sups-denied"
    contact = _kv(setrepo, "sup_contact", "") or "—"
    head = t("sup_sets_menu", contact=contact,
             maxn=fa_num(_max_open(setrepo)),
             anon=t("sup_anon_state_on") if _anon_on(setrepo)
             else t("sup_anon_state_off"))
    rows = [
        [ui.btn(t("btn_sup_set_contact"), "supst:1"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_sup_set_cats"), "supst:2")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_sup_set_max"), "supst:3"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_sup_set_anon"), "supsg:1")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "supm:1")],
    ]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, head, ui.kb(rows))
    return "sups"


def on_set_start(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
                 ctx: Ctx, field: int, setrepo=None) -> str:
    if _mgr(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supst-denied"
    asks = {1: "sup_set_contact_ask", 2: "sup_set_cats_ask",
            3: "sup_set_max_ask"}
    key = asks.get(field)
    if key is None:
        return on_settings(suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx, setrepo)
    names = {1: "sup_contact", 2: "sup_cats", 3: "sup_max_open"}
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_SET, {"field": names[field]}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, key)
    return "supst"


def on_anon_toggle(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                   ctx: Ctx, setrepo=None, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _mgr(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "supsg-denied"
    if setrepo is not None:
        setrepo.set("sup_anon", "0" if _anon_on(setrepo) else "1")
    return on_settings(suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx, setrepo,
                       _a=0)


# ------------------------------------------------- رهگیر متن و رسانه


def _notify_admins(cfg, responder, key: str, **ph) -> None:
    for admin_id in cfg.admin_ids:
        responder.bulk(admin_id, key, **ph)


def support_text_interceptor(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, cfg,
                             state, responder, ctx: Ctx, text: str,
                             setrepo=None) -> bool:
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step == STEP_NEW:
        user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
        uid = int(data.get("uid") or 0)
        old = suprepo.open_for(uid)
        if old is not None:
            suprepo.add_msg(old.id, "user", text)
            state.clear(ctx.user_id)
            responder.reply(ctx, "sup_added")
            return True
        ticket = suprepo.create(uid, text, category=data.get("cat", ""))
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        bus.emit("sup.open", user_id=uid, name=_name(urepo, uid))
        _notify_admins(cfg, responder, "sup_alert",
                       name=_name(urepo, ctx.user_id, by_bale=True),
                       cat=ticket.category or "—")
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_done")
        return True
    if step == STEP_SOS:
        uid = int(data.get("uid") or 0)
        cats = _cats(setrepo)
        ticket = suprepo.create(uid, text,
                                category=cats[-1] if cats else "",
                                priority=1)
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        _notify_admins(cfg, responder, "sos_alert",
                       name=_name(urepo, ctx.user_id, by_bale=True),
                       id=fa_num(ctx.user_id))
        bus.emit("sup.open", user_id=uid, ticket_id=ticket.id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_done")
        return True
    if step in (STEP_ANON, STEP_DIRECT):
        uid = int(data.get("uid") or 0)
        kind = INBOX_ANON if step == STEP_ANON else INBOX_DIRECT
        suprepo.inbox_add(uid, kind, text=text)
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        if kind == INBOX_DIRECT:
            _notify_admins(cfg, responder, "sup_inbox_alert",
                           name=_name(urepo, ctx.user_id, by_bale=True))
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_anon_done" if kind == INBOX_ANON
                        else "sup_direct_done")
        return True
    if step == STEP_REP:
        return _reply_text(suprepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, text)
    if step == STEP_IREP:
        return _ireply_text(suprepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, text)
    if step == STEP_FAQ_Q:
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FAQ_A, {"q": text.strip()}, merge=False)
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_faq_a_ask")
        return True
    if step == STEP_FAQ_A:
        data["a"] = text.strip()
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FAQ_PH, data, merge=False)
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_faq_photo_ask", markup=ui.kb(
            [[ui.btn(t("btn_sup_nophoto"), "supfskip:1")]]))
        return True
    if step == STEP_SET:
        field = data.get("field", "")
        val = text.strip()
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        if setrepo is not None:
            if field == "sup_max_open":
                try:
                    n = max(1, min(10, int(en_num(val))))
                except ValueError:
                    n = 2
                val = str(n)
            setrepo.set(field, val)
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_set_saved")
        return True
    if step == "":
        user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
        ticket = suprepo.open_for(user.id) if user is not None else None
        if ticket is not None:
            suprepo.add_msg(ticket.id, "user", text)
            responder.reply(ctx, "sup_added")
            return True
    return False


def _reply_text(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
                ctx: Ctx, text: str) -> bool:
    tid = 0
    _step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    tid = int(data.get("tid") or 0)
    tk = suprepo.get(tid)
    if tk is None or tk.status != SUP_OPEN:
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_closed_err")
        return True
    me = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    suprepo.add_msg(tid, "admin", text, agent_id=me.id if me else 0)
    suprepo.set_agent(tid, me.id if me else 0)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    user = urepo.get(tk.user_id)
    if user is not None:
        _deliver(responder, urepo, user.bale_id, text,
                 agent_bale=ctx.user_id)
    bus.emit("sup.reply", actor_id=ctx.user_id, ticket_id=tid)
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_reply_sent")
    return True


def _ireply_text(suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
                 ctx: Ctx, text: str) -> bool:
    _step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    iid = int(data.get("iid") or 0)
    it = suprepo.inbox_get(iid)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    if it is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_inbox_none")
        return True
    user = urepo.get(it.user_id)
    if user is not None:
        _deliver(responder, urepo, user.bale_id, text,
                 agent_bale=ctx.user_id, anon=it.kind == INBOX_ANON)
    suprepo.inbox_answered(iid)
    responder.reply(ctx, "sup_reply_sent")
    return True


def _media_step(state, ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    step, _data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    return step if step in (STEP_REP, STEP_IREP, STEP_FAQ_PH, STEP_NEW,
                            STEP_ANON, STEP_DIRECT) else ""


def media_dispatch(state, suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                   ctx: Ctx, kind: str, file_id: str) -> bool:
    """ویس/ویدیو/صوت — فقط در گام‌های پشتیبانی مصرف می‌شود."""
    return _handle_media(state, suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx, kind,
                         file_id)


def photo_dispatch(state, suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                   nxt, ctx: Ctx, file_id: str) -> bool:
    if _media_step(state, ctx):
        return _handle_media(state, suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx,
                             "photo", file_id)
    return bool(nxt(ctx, file_id)) if nxt else False


def doc_dispatch(state, suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                 nxt, ctx: Ctx, file_id: str,
                 file_name: str = "") -> bool:
    if _media_step(state, ctx):
        return _handle_media(state, suprepo, urepo, responder, ctx,
                             "document", file_id)
    return bool(nxt(ctx, file_id, file_name)) if nxt else False


def _handle_media(state, suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                  ctx: Ctx, kind: str, file_id: str) -> bool:
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step == STEP_REP:
        tid = int(data.get("tid") or 0)
        tk = suprepo.get(tid)
        if tk is None or tk.status != SUP_OPEN:
            state.clear(ctx.user_id)
            responder.reply(ctx, "sup_closed_err")
            return True
        me = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
        suprepo.add_msg(tid, "admin", "", media_file_id=file_id,
                        media_kind=kind, agent_id=me.id if me else 0)
        suprepo.set_agent(tid, me.id if me else 0)
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        user = urepo.get(tk.user_id)
        if user is not None:
            _deliver_media(responder, urepo, user.bale_id, kind, file_id,
                           agent_bale=ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_reply_sent")
        return True
    if step == STEP_IREP:
        iid = int(data.get("iid") or 0)
        it = suprepo.inbox_get(iid)
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        if it is None:
            responder.reply(ctx, "sup_inbox_none")
            return True
        user = urepo.get(it.user_id)
        if user is not None:
            _deliver_media(responder, urepo, user.bale_id, kind, file_id,
                           agent_bale=ctx.user_id,
                           anon=it.kind == INBOX_ANON)
        suprepo.inbox_answered(iid)
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_reply_sent")
        return True
    if step == STEP_FAQ_PH:
        _save_faq(suprepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, file_id, kind)
        return True
    if step in (STEP_ANON, STEP_DIRECT):
        uid = int(data.get("uid") or 0)
        inbox_kind = INBOX_ANON if step == STEP_ANON else INBOX_DIRECT
        suprepo.inbox_add(uid, inbox_kind, media_file_id=file_id,
                          media_kind=kind)
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "sup_anon_done" if step == STEP_ANON
                        else "sup_direct_done")
        return True
    if step == STEP_NEW:
        uid = int(data.get("uid") or 0)
        old = suprepo.open_for(uid)
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        if old is not None:
            suprepo.add_msg(old.id, "user", "", media_file_id=file_id,
                            media_kind=kind)
            responder.reply(ctx, "sup_added")
        else:
            responder.reply(ctx, "sup_media_need_text")
        return True
    return False


def open_count(suprepo: SupportRepo):
    def _count() -> int:
        return len(suprepo.list_open())
    return _count


# ------------------------------------------------------------ مسیرها


def register_support_routes(r, suprepo: SupportRepo, urepo: UserRepo, cfg,
                            state: StateStore, responder,
                            setrepo=None) -> None:
    r.add("sup", _w(on_support_start, suprepo, urepo, cfg, state, responder,
                    setrepo=setrepo), v_int)
    r.add("supn", _w(on_new_ticket, suprepo, urepo, state, responder,
                     setrepo=setrepo), v_int)
    r.add("supcat", _w(on_pick_cat, suprepo, urepo, state, responder,
                       setrepo=setrepo), v_int)
    r.add("sos", _w(on_sos, suprepo, urepo, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("supmy", _w(on_my_tickets, suprepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("supuv", _w(on_user_view, suprepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("suprate", _w(on_rate, suprepo, urepo, responder), v_int, v_int)
    r.add("supf", _w(on_faq_user, suprepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("supfv", _w(on_faq_view, suprepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("supa", _w(on_anon_start, suprepo, urepo, state, responder,
                     setrepo=setrepo), v_int)
    r.add("supd", _w(on_direct_start, suprepo, urepo, state, responder),
          v_int)
    r.add("supm", _w(on_admin_menu, suprepo, urepo, responder,
                     setrepo=setrepo), v_int)
    r.add("supl", _w(on_list, suprepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("supv", _w(on_view, suprepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("suppri", _w(on_priority, suprepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("supr", _w(on_reply_start, suprepo, urepo, state, responder),
          v_int)
    r.add("supc", _w(on_close, suprepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("supi", _w(on_inbox_list, suprepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("supiv", _w(on_inbox_view, suprepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("supir", _w(on_inbox_reply, suprepo, urepo, state, responder),
          v_int)
    r.add("supfa", _w(on_faq_admin, suprepo, urepo, responder), v_int)

                      setrepo=setrepo), v_int)
    r.add("supsg", _w(on_anon_toggle, suprepo, urepo, responder,
                      setrepo=setrepo), v_int)


def _w(fn, *deps, **kw):
    def handler(ctx, *args):
        fn(*deps, ctx, *args, **kw)
        return Reply("")
    return handler

def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    kind = bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()
    return kind


def cb(data, uid=999):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def voice(file_id, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "voice": {"file_id": file_id}}}


def photo(file_id, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "photo": [{"file_id": file_id}]}}


def texts(sent):
    return [str(p.get("text") or p.get("caption") or "") for p in sent]


def last(sent):
    return texts(sent)[-1]


def _ticket(env, cat_idx=0, text="سوال درباره ثبت‌نام"):
    bot, clock, sent = env[0], env[2], env[3]
    step(bot, clock, cb("supn:1", uid=10))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"supcat:{cat_idx}", uid=10))
    step(bot, clock, msg(text, uid=10))
    return SupportRepo(env[1])


def test_ticket_with_category_and_alert(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, setrepo = env
    step(bot, clock, cb("sup:1", uid=10))
    assert "پشتیبانی" in last(sent)
    sup = _ticket(env)
    tk = sup.list_open()[0]
    assert tk.category == "ثبت‌نام" and tk.priority == 0
    assert any("تیکت جدید" in x and "مریم رادمهر" in x for x in texts(sent))


def test_reply_shows_agent_family_only(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, setrepo = env
    sup = _ticket(env)
    tk = sup.list_open()[0]
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"supr:{tk.id}"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("سلام، بررسی شد"))
    user_msgs = [p for p in sent if p.get("chat_id") == 10]
    assert any("پشتیبان · خانم کریمی" in str(p.get("text") or "")
               and "سلام، بررسی شد" in str(p.get("text") or "")
               for p in user_msgs)
    assert sup.get(tk.id).agent_id == 1
    sent.clear()
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"supv:{tk.id}"))
    assert "پاسخ‌دهنده" in last(sent) and "کریمی" in last(sent)


def test_voice_reply_to_user(env):

    sup = _ticket(env)

def test_anonymous_message_hides_sender(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, setrepo = env
    step(bot, clock, cb("supa:1", uid=10))
    step(bot, clock, msg("پیشنهاد می‌کنم ساعت برنامه عوض شود", uid=10))

               for p in user_msgs)

def test_faq_crud_with_photo_and_user_view(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, setrepo = env
    step(bot, clock, cb("supfn:1"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("شرایط گواهی چیست؟"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("گواهی ۲۴ ماه اعتبار دارد."))
    assert "عکس" in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, photo("ph-1"))
    sup = SupportRepo(db)
    faq = sup.faq_list()[0]
    assert faq.q.startswith("شرایط") and faq.media_file_id == "ph-1"
    # کاربر: فهرست و مشاهده با عکس
    sent.clear()
    step(bot, clock, cb("supf:1", uid=10))
    assert "شرایط گواهی" in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"supfv:{faq.id}", uid=10))
    joined = " ".join(texts(sent))
    assert "۲۴ ماه" in joined
    assert any(p.get("photo") == "ph-1" and p.get("chat_id") == 10
               for p in sent)
    # خاموش کردن → از دید کاربر می‌افتد
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"supft:{faq.id}"))
    assert sup.faq_get(faq.id).enabled == 0
    sent.clear()
    step(bot, clock, cb("supf:1", uid=10))
    assert "شرایط گواهی" not in last(sent)
    # حذف
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"supfd:{faq.id}"))
    assert sup.faq_list() == []


def test_faq_reorder(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, setrepo = env
    sup = SupportRepo(db)
    a = sup.faq_add("سوال الف", "جواب الف")

    step(bot, clock, cb(f"supfu:{b.id}"))
    items = sup.faq_list()
    assert items[0].id == b.id and items[1].id == a.id

Python sqlite3's default isolation_level="" automatically starts a transaction on the first INSERT (faq_add executes INSERT without an explicit transaction → sqlite3's implicit BEGIN). آیدی ارتباط مستقیم — از تنظیمات پشتیبانی ثبت می‌شود و در منوی پشتیبانی کاربر نمایش داده می‌شود.
سوالات متداول با رسانه — سوال+جواب+عکس اختیاری، با افزودن/حذف/روشن-خاموش/جابجایی ترتیب. کاربر فهرست را می‌بیند و جواب را با عکس دریافت می‌کند.
پاسخ ادمین با ویس و رسانه — ویس، عکس، ویدیو، صوت و فایل. زیرساختش را از ته ساختم (هوک تازهٔ رسانه در بات + ارسال مدیا در API) چون قبلاً بات فقط عکس و فایل را می‌شناخت.
هویت پاسخ‌دهنده — هر پاسخ با «پشتیبان · خانم کریمی» یا «پشتیبان · آقای شریفی» می‌رود — فقط فامیلی، از نام کامل و جنسیت پروفایل مدیر. در تیکت هم «پاسخ‌دهنده» ثبت و نمایش داده می‌شود.
همراهش کامل شد: دسته‌بندی تیکت (۶ دستهٔ پیش‌فرض، قابل ویرایش)، اولویت فوری، امتیاز رضایت ۱ تا ۵ بعد از بستن، سقف تیکت باز — و همه‌چیز طبق سطح دسترسی: دیدن/پاسخ تیکت = کارکنان، مدیریت سوال‌ها و تنظیمات = فقط ادمین/مالک.
جدول‌ها با مهاجرت امن نوشته شدند — روی دیتابیس زندهٔ VPS تیکت‌های فعلی نمی‌پرند.
صف اجرای بقیهٔ خواسته‌هایت (به همین ترتیب، تیکه‌تیکه):

② مرکز اطلاع‌رسانی و یادآوری کامل ادمین (بخش‌بندی مخاطبان، زمان‌بندی، رسانه، آمار ارسال) — چون گفتی «عالی بود ولی کامل نبود»
③ نظرسنجی بعد برنامه (فعال‌سازی per رویداد + ارسال خودکار بعد از پایان + گزارش)
④ گواهی پولی (کارگاه رایگان، گواهی با پرداخت — با وصل شدن به همان درگاه/کارت‌به‌کارت بخش ۴)
⑤ پروندهٔ کاربر کامل (عکس، پرداخت‌ها، رسیدها، تیکت‌ها، پیام‌ها، لاگ فعالیت)
⑥ ویترین برگزارشده‌ها (پرداخت/رایگان/دسترسی رایگان) + روان‌سازی حضور و غیاب

بعد از این شش‌تاکه تمام شد، جمع‌بندی یکپارچگی نهایی (منوها، متن‌ها، دسترسی‌ها، اسکن لحن فارسی ایرانی) را یک دور کامل می‌زنم. بگو «ادامه بده» تا از ② شروع کنم — یا اگر ترتیب دیگری در نظرت است بگو.

"""لایهٔ دادهٔ اطلاع‌رسانی: اعلان دسته‌جمعی با مخاطب بخش‌بندی‌شده.

یک اعلان = متن + رسانهٔ اختیاری + مخاطب (همه/تأییدشده‌ها/VIP/شرکت‌کنندگان
یک رویداد). ارسال per کاربر در `broadcast_sends` ثبت می‌شود تا ارسال
ناتمام/تکراری قابل تشخیص و از سرگیری باشد (idempotent).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from ..core.clock import Clock
from ..core.db import Database
from .events import REG_CONFIRMED

BC_QUEUED = "queued"
BC_DONE = "done"

AUD_ALL = "all"
AUD_APPROVED = "approved"
AUD_VIP = "vip"
AUD_EVENT = "event"
AUDIENCES = (AUD_ALL, AUD_APPROVED, AUD_VIP, AUD_EVENT)


@dataclass
class Broadcast:
    id: int
    author_id: int
    audience: str
    audience_arg: int
    text: str
    created_ts: float
    media_file_id: str = ""
    media_kind: str = ""
    status: str = BC_QUEUED
    sent_ts: float = 0.0
    total: int = 0
    sent: int = 0


def _row(row) -> Broadcast:
    return Broadcast(row["id"], int(row["author_id"] or 0),
                     row["audience"] or AUD_ALL, int(row["audience_arg"] or 0),
                     row["text"] or "", float(row["created_ts"] or 0),
                     row["media_file_id"] or "", row["media_kind"] or "",
                     row["status"] or BC_QUEUED, float(row["sent_ts"] or 0),
                     int(row["total"] or 0), int(row["sent"] or 0))


class BroadcastRepo:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, clock: Clock | None = None) -> None:
        self.db = db
        self.clock = clock
        self._ensure()

    def _ensure(self) -> None:
        db = self.db
        db.ensure_table("broadcasts", [
            ("author_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("audience", f"TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{AUD_ALL}'"),
            ("audience_arg", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("text", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''"),
            ("created_ts", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("media_file_id", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''"),
            ("media_kind", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''"),
            ("status", f"TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{BC_QUEUED}'"),
            ("sent_ts", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("total", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("sent", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),
        ])
        db.ensure_table("broadcast_sends", [
            ("bc_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("user_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("ts", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),
        ])
        db.ensure_index("ux_bc_sends", "broadcast_sends",
                        ["bc_id", "user_id"], unique=True)

    def _now(self) -> float:
        return self.clock.ts() if self.clock else 0.0

    def create(self, author_id: int, audience: str, text: str,
               audience_arg: int = 0, media_file_id: str = "",
               media_kind: str = "") -> Broadcast:
        now = self._now()
        with self.db.transaction():
            cur = self.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO broadcasts (author_id, audience, audience_arg, "
                "text, created_ts, media_file_id, media_kind) "
                "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (author_id, audience, audience_arg, text, now,
                 media_file_id, media_kind))
            bid = int(cur.lastrowid)
        return self.get(bid)  # type: ignore[return-value]

    def get(self, bc_id: int) -> Broadcast | None:
        row = self.db.query_one("SELECT * FROM broadcasts WHERE id = ?",
                                (bc_id,))
        return _row(row) if row else None

    def list(self, limit: int = 10) -> list[Broadcast]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM broadcasts ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,))
        return [_row(r) for r in rows]

    def set_done(self, bc_id: int, total: int, sent: int) -> None:
        with self.db.transaction():
            self.db.execute(
                "UPDATE broadcasts SET status = ?, sent_ts = ?, total = ?, "
                "sent = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (BC_DONE, self._now(), total, sent, bc_id))

    def mark_send(self, bc_id: int, user_id: int) -> None:
        with self.db.transaction():
            self.db.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO broadcast_sends (bc_id, user_id, ts) "
                "VALUES (?,?,?)", (bc_id, user_id, self._now()))

    def sent_count(self, bc_id: int) -> int:
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM broadcast_sends WHERE bc_id = ?",
            (bc_id,))
        return int(row["c"]) if row else 0

    def sent_ids(self, bc_id: int) -> set[int]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT user_id FROM broadcast_sends WHERE bc_id = ?", (bc_id,))
        return {int(r["user_id"]) for r in rows}

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- مخاطبان
    def audience_users(self, audience: str, arg: int = 0) -> list[tuple]:
        """[(user_id, bale_id)] — مسدودها هیچ‌جا حساب نمی‌شوند."""
        if audience == AUD_EVENT:
            rows = self.db.query(
                "SELECT u.id, u.bale_id FROM users u JOIN registrations r "
                "ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.event_id = ? AND r.status = ? "
                "AND u.status != 'blocked' ORDER BY u.id",
                (arg, REG_CONFIRMED))
        elif audience == AUD_VIP:
            rows = self.db.query(
                "SELECT id, bale_id FROM users WHERE is_vip = 1 "
                "AND status != 'blocked' ORDER BY id")
        elif audience == AUD_APPROVED:
            rows = self.db.query(
                "SELECT id, bale_id FROM users WHERE status = 'approved' "
                "ORDER BY id")
        else:
            rows = self.db.query(
                "SELECT id, bale_id FROM users WHERE status != 'blocked' "
                "ORDER BY id")
        return [(int(r["id"]), int(r["bale_id"])) for r in rows]

PYTHON
"""مرکز اطلاع‌رسانی: اعلان دسته‌جمعی با مخاطب بخش‌بندی‌شده + یادآوری انقضای گواهی.

جریان ساخت اعلان: مخاطب → متن → رسانهٔ اختیاری → پیش‌نمایش با شمار
گیرندگان → «ارسال آزمایشی به خودم» یا «ارسال». هر ارسال per کاربر ثبت
می‌شود؛ «ارسال به جامانده‌ها» همان اعلان را idempotent کامل می‌کند.
دسترسی: send_bulk (اپراتور/ادمین/مالک).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from ....core.clock import TEHRAN
from ....core.events import bus
from ....core.jalali import fmt_dt
from ....core.num import fa_num
from ....domain.broadcasts import (AUD_APPROVED, AUD_EVENT, AUD_VIP,
                                   BroadcastRepo)
from ....domain.certs import CertRepo
from ....domain.events import EventRepo
from ....domain.users import UserRepo
from ....services.permissions import can
from ....services.state_store import StateStore
from ..ctx import Ctx
from ..router import Reply, v_int, v_word
from ..texts import t
from .. import ui
from .events import _staff
from .support import _w

STEP_TEXT = "bc_text"
STEP_MEDIA = "bc_media"

_AUD_KEY = {"all": "bc_aud_all", "approved": "bc_aud_approved",
            "vip": "bc_aud_vip", "event": "bc_aud_event"}


def _ok(urepo: UserRepo, ctx: Ctx):
    """کارکنان با دسترسی send_bulk."""
    user = _staff(urepo, ctx)
    if user is None or not can(user.role, "send_bulk"):
        return None
    return user


def _aud_label(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo, bc) -> str:
    key = _AUD_KEY.get(bc.audience, "bc_aud_all")
    if bc.audience == AUD_EVENT:
        ev = erepo.get_event(bc.audience_arg)
        return t(key, title=ev.title if ev else "—")
    return t(key)


def _send_bc(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo, responder, bc) -> int:
    """ارسال idempotent — فقط به کسانی که هنوز نگرفته‌اند."""
    done = bcrepo.sent_ids(bc.id)
    users = bcrepo.audience_users(bc.audience, bc.audience_arg)
    n = 0
    for uid, bale in users:
        if uid in done or not bale:
            continue
        if bc.media_file_id:
            responder.bulk_media_raw(bale, bc.media_kind or "photo",
                                     bc.media_file_id, bc.text)
        else:
            responder.bulk_raw(bale, bc.text)
        bcrepo.mark_send(bc.id, uid)
        n += 1
    total = len(users)
    bcrepo.set_done(bc.id, total, bcrepo.sent_count(bc.id))
    return n


# ------------------------------------------------------------ هاب و ساخت


def on_hub(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
           _a: int = 0) -> str:
    me = _ok(urepo, ctx)
    if me is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "bcast-denied"
    items = bcrepo.list(limit=1)
    last_line = ""
    if items:
        bc = items[0]
        last_line = "\n" + t("bc_last", n=fa_num(bc.sent),
                             when=fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(
                                 bc.created_ts, tz=TEHRAN)))
    responder.reply(ctx, "bc_menu", markup=ui.kb([
        [ui.btn(t("btn_bc_new"), "bcn:1"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_bc_list"), "bcl:1")]])) if not last_line else \\
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("bc_menu") + last_line, ui.kb([
            [ui.btn(t("btn_bc_new"), "bcn:1"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_bc_list"), "bcl:1")]]))
    return "bcast"


def on_new(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
           _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _ok(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "bcn-denied"
    responder.reply(ctx, "bc_pick_aud", markup=ui.kb([
        [ui.btn(t("bc_aud_all"), "bcau:all"),
         ui.btn(t("bc_aud_approved"), "bcau:approved")],
        [ui.btn(t("bc_aud_vip"), "bcau:vip"),
         ui.btn(t("bc_aud_event"), "bcev:1")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "bcast:1")]]))
    return "bcn"


def on_pick_aud(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state, responder,
                ctx: Ctx, kind: str) -> str:
    if _ok(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "bcau-denied"
    if kind not in ("all", "approved", "vip"):
        return on_new(bcrepo, urepo, responder, ctx)
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_TEXT, {"aud": kind, "arg": 0}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "bc_ask_text")
    return "bcau"


def on_events(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _ok(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "bcev-denied"
    rows = []
    for ev in erepo.list_events(
            ("published", "closed", "finished"), limit=9):
        rows.append([ui.btn(_short_title(ev.title), f"bcae:{ev.id}")])
    if not rows:
        responder.reply(ctx, "bc_ev_none")
        return "bcev-none"
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "bcn:1")])
    responder.reply(ctx, "bc_ev_pick", markup=ui.kb(rows))
    return "bcev"


def _short_title(title: str) -> str:
    return (title or "")[:30] or "—"


def on_pick_event(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                  urepo: UserRepo, state, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                  eid: int) -> str:
    if _ok(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "bcae-denied"
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "bc_ev_none")
        return "bcae-none"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_TEXT, {"aud": AUD_EVENT, "arg": eid},
              merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "bc_ask_text")
    return "bcae"


def _create_and_preview(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo,
                        state, responder, ctx: Ctx, me, text: str,
                        media_file_id: str = "",
                        media_kind: str = "") -> str:
    _step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    bc = bcrepo.create(me.id, data.get("aud", "all"), text,
                       audience_arg=int(data.get("arg") or 0),
                       media_file_id=media_file_id,
                       media_kind=media_kind)
    return on_preview(bcrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, bc.id)


def on_preview(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
               responder, ctx: Ctx, bid: int, note: str = "") -> str:
    me = _ok(urepo, ctx)
    if me is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "bcpv-denied"
    bc = bcrepo.get(bid)
    if bc is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "bc_none")
        return "bcpv-none"
    n = len(bcrepo.audience_users(bc.audience, bc.audience_arg))
    media = ("\n" + t("bc_has_media")) if bc.media_file_id else ""
    head = "\n".join(
        ([note] if note else []) +
        [t("bc_preview", aud=_aud_label(bcrepo, erepo, bc), n=fa_num(n)),
         bc.text[:300] + media])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, head, ui.kb([
        [ui.btn(t("btn_bc_send"), f"bcok:{bid}"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_bc_test"), f"bcts:{bid}")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_bc_cancel"), "bcx:1")]]))
    return "bcpv"


def on_send(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, bid: int) -> str:
    me = _ok(urepo, ctx)
    if me is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "bcok-denied"
    bc = bcrepo.get(bid)
    if bc is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "bc_none")
        return "bcok-none"
    n = _send_bc(bcrepo, erepo, responder, bc)
    bus.emit("bc.sent", actor_id=ctx.user_id, audience=bc.audience, n=n)
    responder.reply(ctx, "bc_done", n=fa_num(n))
    return "bcok"


def on_test(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, bid: int) -> str:
    me = _ok(urepo, ctx)
    if me is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "bcts-denied"
    bc = bcrepo.get(bid)
    if bc is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "bc_none")
        return "bcts-none"
    if bc.media_file_id:
        responder.send_media_raw(ctx.user_id, bc.media_kind or "photo",
                                 bc.media_file_id, bc.text)
    else:
        responder.bulk_raw(ctx.user_id, bc.text)
    return on_preview(bcrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, bid,
                      note=t("bc_test_sent"))


def on_cancel(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    responder.reply(ctx, "bc_canceled")
    return "bcx"


# ------------------------------------------------------------- تاریخچه


def on_list(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _ok(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "bcl-denied"
    items = bcrepo.list(limit=8)
    if not items:
        responder.reply(ctx, "bc_list_none", markup=ui.kb(
            [[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "bcast:1")]]))
        return "bcl-none"
    lines = [t("bc_list_title")]
    rows = []
    for bc in items:
        when = fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(bc.created_ts, tz=TEHRAN))
        lines.append(t("bc_list_row",
                       aud=_aud_label(bcrepo, erepo, bc),
                       n=fa_num(bc.sent), when=when))
        rows.append([ui.btn(when + " · " + _short_title(
            _aud_label(bcrepo, erepo, bc)), f"bcvw:{bc.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "bcast:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "bcl"


def on_view(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, bid: int, note: str = "") -> str:
    if _ok(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "bcvw-denied"
    bc = bcrepo.get(bid)
    if bc is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "bc_none")
        return "bcvw-none"
    body = "\n".join(
        ([note] if note else []) +
        [t("bc_view_head", aud=_aud_label(bcrepo, erepo, bc),
           sent=fa_num(bcrepo.sent_count(bid)), total=fa_num(bc.total)),
         bc.text[:600]])
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_bc_resend"), f"bcre:{bid}"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "bcl:1")]]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, body, ui.kb(rows))
    return "bcvw"


def on_resend(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, bid: int) -> str:
    me = _ok(urepo, ctx)
    if me is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "bcre-denied"
    bc = bcrepo.get(bid)
    if bc is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "bc_none")
        return "bcre-none"
    n = _send_bc(bcrepo, erepo, responder, bc)
    return on_view(bcrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, bid,
                   note=t("bc_resent", n=fa_num(n)))


# --------------------------------------------- رهگیر متن و رسانهٔ اعلان


def text_interceptor(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                     urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
                     ctx: Ctx, text: str) -> bool:
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_TEXT:
        return False
    me = _ok(urepo, ctx)
    if me is None:
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return True
    body = text.strip()
    if not body:
        responder.reply(ctx, "bc_empty_text")
        return True
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_MEDIA, dict(data, text=body), merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "bc_ask_media", markup=ui.kb(
        [[ui.btn(t("btn_bc_nomedia"), "bcnm:1")]]))
    return True


def on_no_media(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                state, responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    me = _ok(urepo, ctx)
    if me is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "bcnm-denied"
    _step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    return _create_and_preview(bcrepo, erepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx,
                               me, data.get("text", ""))


def _media(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
           state, responder, ctx: Ctx, kind: str, file_id: str) -> bool:
    step, _data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_MEDIA:
        return False
    me = _ok(urepo, ctx)
    if me is None:
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return True
    _step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    _create_and_preview(bcrepo, erepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, me,
                        data.get("text", ""), file_id, kind)
    return True


def media_dispatch(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                   urepo: UserRepo, state, responder, nxt, ctx: Ctx,
                   kind: str, file_id: str) -> bool:
    if _media(bcrepo, erepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, kind, file_id):
        return True
    return bool(nxt(ctx, kind, file_id)) if nxt else False


def photo_dispatch(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                   urepo: UserRepo, state, responder, nxt, ctx: Ctx,
                   file_id: str) -> bool:
    if _media(bcrepo, erepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, "photo",
              file_id):
        return True
    return bool(nxt(ctx, file_id)) if nxt else False


def doc_dispatch(bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                 urepo: UserRepo, state, responder, nxt, ctx: Ctx,
                 file_id: str, file_name: str = "") -> bool:
    if _media(bcrepo, erepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, "document",
              file_id):
        return True
    return bool(nxt(ctx, file_id, file_name)) if nxt else False


# ------------------------------------------------ یادآوری انقضای گواهی


def cert_remind_tick(certrepo: CertRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                     clock) -> None:
    """هر چرخه: گواهی‌های نزدیک انقضا، یک بار یادآوری می‌گیرند."""
    now = clock.ts() if clock else 0.0
    for cid, uid, expire in certrepo.due_reminders(now):
        certrepo.mark_reminded(cid)
        user = urepo.get(uid)
        if user is None or not user.bale_id:
            continue
        until = fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(expire, tz=TEHRAN)) \\
            if expire else ""
        responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "cert_remind", until=until)

def register_notify_routes(r, bcrepo: BroadcastRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                           urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore,
                           responder) -> None:
    r.add("bcast", _w(on_hub, bcrepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("bcn", _w(on_new, bcrepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("bcau", _w(on_pick_aud, bcrepo, urepo, state, responder), v_word)
    r.add("bcev", _w(on_events, bcrepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("bcae", _w(on_pick_event, bcrepo, erepo, urepo, state, responder),
          v_int)
    r.add("bcpv", _w(on_preview, bcrepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("bcok", _w(on_send, bcrepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("bcts", _w(on_test, bcrepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("bcnm", _w(on_no_media, bcrepo, erepo, urepo, state, responder),
          v_int)
    r.add("bcx", _w(on_cancel, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("bcl", _w(on_list, bcrepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("bcvw", _w(on_view, bcrepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("bcre", _w(on_resend, bcrepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)

    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 12, 10, 0, 0))

        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    o = urepo.create(11, first_name="رضا")
    urepo.update(o.id, role="organizer", status="approved",
                 full_name="رضا شریفی")
    yield bot, db, clock, sent, urepo
    set_clock(old)


def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()


def cb(data, uid=999):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def photo(file_id, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "photo": [{"file_id": file_id}]}}


def texts(sent):
    return [str(p.get("text") or p.get("caption") or "") for p in sent]


def last(sent):
    return texts(sent)[-1]


def _flow_text(bot, clock, sent, aud_cb, text="اعلان عمومی"):
    step(bot, clock, cb("bcn:1"))
    step(bot, clock, aud_cb)
    step(bot, clock, msg(text))
    step(bot, clock, cb("bcnm:1"))
    return BroadcastRepo_last(sent)


def BroadcastRepo_last(sent):
    return last(sent)


def test_member_denied(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo = env
    step(bot, clock, cb("bcast:1", uid=10))
    assert "دسترسی" in last(sent)


def test_send_to_all(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo = env
    step(bot, clock, cb("bcast:1"))
    assert "اطلاع‌رسانی" in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb("bcn:1"))
    assert "برای چه کسانی" in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb("bcau:all"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("جلسهٔ این هفته پنجشنبه است"))
    assert "رسانه" in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb("bcnm:1"))
    assert "۳ نفر" in last(sent)
    sent.clear()
    step(bot, clock, cb("bcok:1"))
    assert "۳ نفر دریافت کردند" in last(sent)
    got = {p.get("chat_id") for p in sent
           if "پنجشنبه" in str(p.get("text") or "")}
    assert got == {999, 10, 11}
    bc = BroadcastRepo(db).get(1)
    assert bc.status == "done" and bc.sent == 3

def test_idempotent_resend(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo = env
    step(bot, clock, cb("bcn:1"))
    step(bot, clock, cb("bcau:approved"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("یادآوری همایش"))
    step(bot, clock, cb("bcnm:1"))
    step(bot, clock, cb("bcok:1"))
    first = len([p for p in sent if "همایش" in str(p.get("text") or "")])
    sent.clear()
    step(bot, clock, cb("bcre:1"))
    again = len([p for p in sent if "همایش" in str(p.get("text") or "")])
    assert first == 3 and again == 0
    assert "۰ نفر دیگر" in last(sent)

def test_cert_expire_reminder_once(env):

    now = clock.ts()

               (now - 10, cert.id))

    class R:
        def __init__(self):
            self.got = []

        def bulk(self, chat_id, key, markup=None, **kw):
            self.got.append((chat_id, key, kw))

    r = R()
    notify_screen.cert_remind_tick(certs, urepo, r, clock)
    assert (10, "cert_remind") == (r.got[0][0], r.got[0][1])
    assert r.got[0][2]["until"]
    # بار دوم تکرار نمی‌شود
    r2 = R()
    notify_screen.cert_remind_tick(certs, urepo, r2, clock)
    assert r2.got == []

Wait — actually, why does the raw execute leave a transaction open? Python's sqlite3 legacy isolation: INSERT/UPDATE automatically starts a transaction, and it stays open until commit. Database.execute doesn't commit. The transaction() context does BEGIN IMMEDIATE, and presumably commits at the end. So any raw execute outside a transaction dirties the connection. All repository methods wrap their writes ✓. The test was doing a raw db.execute — wrap it in the test.
