"""نظرسنجی بعد از برنامه: ساخت سوال توسط مدیر، پاسخ دکمه‌ای کاربر،
ارسال خودکار دعوت‌نامه پس از پایان برنامه، گزارش جمع.

طوری ساخته شده که کاربر هیچ چیزی تایپ نکند مگر سوالِ پاسخ آزاد؛
بقیهٔ جواب‌ها با یک ضربه ثبت می‌شوند.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from ....core.clock import TEHRAN
from ....core.events import bus
from ....core.jalali import fmt_dt
from ....core.num import fa_num
from ....domain.events import REG_CONFIRMED, EventRepo
from ....domain.surveys import Q_CHOICE, Q_RATING, Q_TEXT, SurveyRepo
from ....domain.users import UserRepo
from ....services.state_store import StateStore
from ..ctx import Ctx
from ..router import Reply, v_int, v_word
from ..texts import t
from .. import ui
from .events import _staff
from .support import _w

STEP_Q = "sv_q"
STEP_OPTS = "sv_opts"
STEP_RUN = "sv_run"


def _fa_dec(value: float) -> str:
    return fa_num(f"{value:.1f}".replace(".", "\u066b".replace("\u066b", "٫")))


# ------------------------------------------------------------ کاربر


def on_user_start(surrepo: SurveyRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                  state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    sv = surrepo.for_event(eid)
    if user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sv_need_login")
        return "sv-nologin"
    if ev is None or sv is None or not sv.enabled:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sv_none")
        return "sv-none"
    reg = erepo.reg_of(eid, user.id)
    if reg is None or reg.status != REG_CONFIRMED:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sv_not_reg")
        return "sv-notreg"
    if surrepo.has_answered(sv.id, user.id):
        responder.reply(ctx, "sv_already")
        return "sv-already"
    qs = surrepo.questions(sv.id)
    if not qs:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sv_empty")
        return "sv-empty"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_RUN,
              {"eid": eid, "sid": sv.id, "qs": [q.id for q in qs],
               "i": 0, "answers": {}}, merge=False)
    return _ask(surrepo, state, responder, ctx)


def _ask(surrepo: SurveyRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
         ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    _step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    qs = data.get("qs") or []
    i = int(data.get("i") or 0)
    q = surrepo.question(qs[i])
    lines = [t("sv_progress", i=fa_num(i + 1), n=fa_num(len(qs))), q.q]
    rows = []
    if q.kind == Q_CHOICE:
        for opt in q.options[:9]:
            rows.append([ui.btn(opt.label[:30], f"svo:{q.id}:{opt.id}")])
    elif q.kind == Q_RATING:
        rows.append([ui.btn(fa_num(n), f"svn:{q.id}:{n}")
                     for n in range(1, 6)])
    else:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_sv_skip"), f"svs:{q.id}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "sv-run"


def _current(surrepo: SurveyRepo, state: StateStore, ctx: Ctx, qid: int):
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_RUN:
        return None, None
    qs = data.get("qs") or []
    i = int(data.get("i") or 0)
    if i >= len(qs) or int(qs[i]) != qid:
        return None, data
    return surrepo.question(qid), data


def on_choice(surrepo: SurveyRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, qid: int, oid: int) -> str:
    q, data = _current(surrepo, state, ctx, qid)
    if q is None:
        return _stale(surrepo, state, responder, ctx, data)
    return _advance(surrepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx,
                    {"option_id": oid})


def on_rating(surrepo: SurveyRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, qid: int, n: int) -> str:
    q, data = _current(surrepo, state, ctx, qid)
    if q is None:
        return _stale(surrepo, state, responder, ctx, data)
    return _advance(surrepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx,
                    {"rating": max(1, min(5, n))})


def on_skip(surrepo: SurveyRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, qid: int) -> str:
    q, data = _current(surrepo, state, ctx, qid)
    if q is None:
        return _stale(surrepo, state, responder, ctx, data)
    return _advance(surrepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, None)


def _stale(surrepo: SurveyRepo, state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
           data) -> str:
    eid = int((data or {}).get("eid") or 0)
    responder.reply(ctx, "sv_stale", markup=ui.kb(
        [[ui.btn(t("btn_sv_open"), f"sv:{eid}")]] if eid else None))
    return "sv-stale"


def _advance(surrepo: SurveyRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore,
             responder, ctx: Ctx, answer) -> str:
    _step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    qid = int(data["qs"][int(data["i"])])
    answers = dict(data.get("answers") or {})
    if answer is not None:
        answers[str(qid)] = answer
    data["answers"] = answers
    data["i"] = int(data["i"]) + 1
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_RUN, data)
    if data["i"] < len(data["qs"]):
        return _ask(surrepo, state, responder, ctx)
    return _finish(surrepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, data)


def _finish(surrepo: SurveyRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, data: dict) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    sid = int(data.get("sid") or 0)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    if user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sv_need_login")
        return "sv-finish-nologin"
    for qid_str, ans in (data.get("answers") or {}).items():
        surrepo.save_answer(sid, user.id, int(qid_str),
                            option_id=int(ans.get("option_id") or 0),
                            value=str(ans.get("value") or ""),
                            rating=int(ans.get("rating") or 0))
    bus.emit("sv.done", user_id=user.id, event_id=int(data.get("eid") or 0))
    responder.reply(ctx, "sv_thanks")
    return "sv-done"


# ------------------------------------------------------------- مدیر


def on_admin_hub(surrepo: SurveyRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                 responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int, note: str = "") -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "svm-denied"
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "svm-none"
    sv = surrepo.ensure_for_event(eid)
    qs = surrepo.questions(sv.id)
    lines = ([note] if note else []) + [
        t("sv_hub", title=ev.title),
        t("sv_hub_stats", q=fa_num(len(qs)),
          n=fa_num(surrepo.respondents(sv.id))),
    ]
    if not sv.enabled:
        lines.append(t("sv_off_note"))
    elif sv.sent_ts:
        lines.append(t("sv_sent_yes", when=fmt_dt(
            datetime.fromtimestamp(sv.sent_ts, tz=TEHRAN))))
    else:
        lines.append(t("sv_sent_no"))
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_sv_addq"), f"sva:{eid}"),
             ui.btn(t("btn_sv_res"), f"svres:{eid}")]]
    if sv.enabled and not sv.sent_ts:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_sv_snd"), f"svsnd:{eid}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_sv_tog") if sv.enabled
                        else t("btn_sv_tog_on"), f"svtog:{eid}"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"evm:{eid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "svm"


def on_add_kind(surrepo: SurveyRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "sva-denied"
    responder.reply(ctx, "sv_pick_kind", markup=ui.kb([
        [ui.btn(t("btn_sv_choice"), f"svt:{eid}:{Q_CHOICE}"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_sv_rating"), f"svt:{eid}:{Q_RATING}")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_sv_text"), f"svt:{eid}:{Q_TEXT}"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"svm:{eid}")]]))
    return "sva"


def on_q_start(surrepo: SurveyRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
               state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int,
               kind: str) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "svt-denied"
    if kind not in (Q_CHOICE, Q_RATING, Q_TEXT):
        return on_add_kind(surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, eid)
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_Q, {"eid": eid, "kind": kind}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "sv_q_ask")
    return "svt"


def on_q_delete(surrepo: SurveyRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                responder, ctx: Ctx, qid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "svd-denied"
    q = surrepo.question(qid)
    if q is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sv_empty")
        return "svd-none"
    sv = surrepo.get(q.survey_id)
    surrepo.delete_question(qid)
    if sv is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sv_q_deleted")
        return "svd-orphan"
    return on_admin_hub(surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, sv.event_id,
                        note=t("sv_q_deleted"))


def on_report(surrepo: SurveyRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "svres-denied"
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    sv = surrepo.for_event(eid)
    if ev is None or sv is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sv_none")
        return "svres-none"
    qs = surrepo.questions(sv.id)
    if not qs:
        responder.reply(ctx, "sv_empty")
        return "svres-empty"
    lines = [t("sv_res_head", title=ev.title,
               n=fa_num(surrepo.respondents(sv.id)))]
    for idx, q in enumerate(qs, start=1):
        lines.append(f"{fa_num(idx)}) {q.q}")
        if q.kind == Q_CHOICE:
            counts = surrepo.option_counts(q.id)
            for opt in q.options:
                lines.append("· " + opt.label + " — "
                             + fa_num(counts.get(opt.id, 0)))
        elif q.kind == Q_RATING:
            avg, cnt = surrepo.rating_stats(q.id)
            lines.append(t("sv_res_rating", avg=_fa_dec(avg),
                           n=fa_num(cnt)) if cnt else t("sv_res_none"))
        else:
            vals = surrepo.text_answers(q.id)
            if not vals:
                lines.append(t("sv_res_none"))
            for v in vals:
                lines.append("· " + v[:80])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(
        [[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"svm:{eid}")]]))
    return "svres"


def on_send_now(surrepo: SurveyRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "svsnd-denied"
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    sv = surrepo.for_event(eid)
    if ev is None or sv is None or not surrepo.questions(sv.id):
        responder.reply(ctx, "sv_empty")
        return "svsnd-empty"
    n = _send_invites(surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, sv.id, eid)
    return on_admin_hub(surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, eid,
                        note=t("sv_snd_done", n=fa_num(n)))


def on_toggle(surrepo: SurveyRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "svtog-denied"
    sv = surrepo.ensure_for_event(eid)
    surrepo.set_enabled(sv.id, 0 if sv.enabled else 1)
    note = t("sv_tog_off") if sv.enabled else t("sv_tog_on")
    return on_admin_hub(surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, eid,
                        note=note)


def _send_invites(surrepo: SurveyRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                  responder, sid: int, eid: int) -> int:
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        return 0
    n = 0
    for reg in erepo.event_regs(eid, statuses=(REG_CONFIRMED,)):
        u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
        if u is None or not u.bale_id:
            continue
        responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "sv_invite", title=ev.title,
                       markup=ui.kb(
                           [[ui.btn(t("btn_sv_open"), f"sv:{eid}")]]))
        n += 1
    surrepo.mark_sent(sid)
    bus.emit("sv.sent", event_id=eid, n=n)
    return n


# ---------------------------------------------- رهگیر متن نظرسنجی


def surveys_text_interceptor(surrepo: SurveyRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                             urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
                             ctx: Ctx, text: str) -> bool:
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step == STEP_Q:
        q = text.strip()
        if not q:
            responder.reply(ctx, "sv_q_ask")
            return True
        if data.get("kind") == Q_CHOICE:
            state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_OPTS, dict(data, q=q), merge=False)
            responder.reply(ctx, "sv_opts_ask")
            return True
        sv = surrepo.ensure_for_event(int(data.get("eid") or 0))
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        surrepo.add_question(sv.id, q, data.get("kind") or Q_TEXT)
        return _hub_note(surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx,
                         int(data.get("eid") or 0), "sv_q_saved")
    if step == STEP_OPTS:
        opts = [ln.strip() for ln in text.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
        if len(opts) < 2:
            responder.reply(ctx, "sv_opts_min")
            return True
        eid = int(data.get("eid") or 0)
        sv = surrepo.ensure_for_event(eid)
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        surrepo.add_question(sv.id, data.get("q", ""), Q_CHOICE, opts[:9])
        return _hub_note(surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, eid,
                         "sv_q_saved")
    if step == STEP_RUN:
        qs = data.get("qs") or []
        i = int(data.get("i") or 0)
        if i >= len(qs):
            return False
        q = surrepo.question(int(qs[i]))
        if q is None or q.kind != Q_TEXT:
            return False
        return _advance(surrepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx,
                        {"value": text.strip()[:500]}) == "sv-done" or True
    return False


def _hub_note(surrepo: SurveyRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int, key: str) -> bool:
    on_admin_hub(surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, eid, note=t(key))
    return True


# ---------------------------------------------------- ارسال خودکار


def survey_tick(surrepo: SurveyRepo, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                responder, clock) -> None:
    """پس از پایان برنامه، دعوت‌نامه یک‌بار خودکار می‌رود."""
    now = clock.ts() if clock else 0.0
    for sid, eid in surrepo.due_for_send(now):
        if not surrepo.questions(sid):
            continue                     # پرسشنامهٔ خالی دعوت نمی‌گیرد
        _send_invites(surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, sid, eid)


# ------------------------------------------------------------ مسیرها


def register_survey_routes(r, surrepo: SurveyRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                           urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore,
                           responder) -> None:
    r.add("sv", _w(on_user_start, surrepo, erepo, urepo, state, responder),
          v_int)
    r.add("svo", _w(on_choice, surrepo, urepo, state, responder),
          v_int, v_int)
    r.add("svn", _w(on_rating, surrepo, urepo, state, responder),
          v_int, v_int)
    r.add("svs", _w(on_skip, surrepo, urepo, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("svm", _w(on_admin_hub, surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("sva", _w(on_add_kind, surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("svt", _w(on_q_start, surrepo, erepo, urepo, state, responder),
          v_int, v_word)
    r.add("svd", _w(on_q_delete, surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("svres", _w(on_report, surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("svsnd", _w(on_send_now, surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("svtog", _w(on_toggle, surrepo, erepo, urepo, responder), v_int)

پاسخ دکمه‌ای کاربر، گزارش، حذف سوال، خاموش/روشن، دسترسی‌ها."""
from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.surveys import SurveyRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.event_service import EventService


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 12, 10, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock,
                              transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)

    yield bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo
    set_clock(old)


def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()


def cb(data, uid=999):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def texts(sent):
    return [str(p.get("text") or p.get("caption") or "") for p in sent]


def last(sent):
    return texts(sent)[-1]


def _event_with_survey(env, status="finished"):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo = env
    esvc = EventService(erepo, clock)
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه عکاسی", status="published",
                            has_survey=1)
    esvc.register(urepo.get_by_bale(10), ev)
    erepo.update_event(ev.id, status=status)
    return ev


def _build_survey(env, ev):
    """سه سوال: چندگزینه‌ای + امتیاز + آزاد."""
    bot, clock, sent = env[0], env[2], env[3]
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"svm:{ev.id}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"sva:{ev.id}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"svt:{ev.id}:choice"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("برنامه چطور بود؟"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("عالی\nخوب\nضعیف"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"sva:{ev.id}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"svt:{ev.id}:rating"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("به سازماندهی چند می‌دهی؟"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"sva:{ev.id}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"svt:{ev.id}:text"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("پیشنهادت چیست؟"))
    return SurveyRepo(env[1]).for_event(ev.id)


def test_member_denied(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo = env
    ev = _event_with_survey(env)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"svm:{ev.id}", uid=10))
    assert "دسترسی" in last(sent)


def test_admin_builds_survey(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo = env
    ev = _event_with_survey(env)
    sv = _build_survey(env, ev)
    surrepo = SurveyRepo(db)
    qs = surrepo.questions(sv.id)
    assert [q.kind for q in qs] == ["choice", "rating", "text"]
    assert [o.label for o in qs[0].options] == ["عالی", "خوب", "ضعیف"]
    assert "۳ سوال" in last(sent)


def test_auto_send_once_after_finish(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo = env
    ev = _event_with_survey(env)
    sv = _build_survey(env, ev)
    sent.clear()
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    bot.on_tick()
    bot.outbox.drain()
    invites = [p for p in sent if p.get("chat_id") == 10
               and "پرسشنامهٔ «کارگاه عکاسی»" in str(p.get("text") or "")]
    assert invites
    assert SurveyRepo(db).get(sv.id).sent_ts > 0
    # بار دوم تکرار نمی‌شود
    sent.clear()
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    bot.on_tick()
    bot.outbox.drain()
    assert not [p for p in sent if p.get("chat_id") == 10
                and "پرسشنامه" in str(p.get("text") or "")]

Chunk ③ complete. Should I continue with Chunk ④ (paid certificates) in this turn? The user said "continue (ادامه بده)," and I should keep progressing through the queue as much as possible. The turn is long, but Chunk ④ is an important item: paid certificates.

Chunk ④ Design — Paid Certificates (گواهی پولی):

Per event: cert_price INT DEFAULT 0 (0 = free). New column in events.
User-side certificate flow: Currently users can view certificates via mycert (already issued ones). Paid flow: if event has has_cert and cert_price>0: user requests a certificate → a pending payment is created (reusing the payment infrastructure!) → after payment, admin issues it / or auto-issue?
How do certificates currently reach users? Admin issues them (individually/bulk). def _cert_event(env, price=500, title="کارگاه آرامش ذهن"):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    ev = erepo.create_event(title=title, status="published")
    erepo.update_event(ev.id, has_cert=1, cert_price=price)
    esvc = EventService(erepo, clock)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(10)
    res = esvc.register(user, ev)
    return ev, user, res.reg

def test_cert_gateway_flow(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    ev, user, reg = _cert_event(env)
    step(bot, clock, cb("mycerte:1", uid=10))
    assert t("cert_user_buy", amount=money_label(500)) in texts(sent)[-1]
    step(bot, clock, cb("certbuy:1", uid=10))
    assert t("cert_pay_choose", amount=money_label(500)) in texts(sent)[-1]
    step(bot, clock, cb("payc:1:gateway", uid=10))
    inv = [p for p in sent if "sendInvoice" in p.get("_url", "")]
    assert json.loads(inv[-1]["prices"])[0]["amount"] == 500
    pay = payrepo.open_for_target_user("cert", 1, user.id)
    step(bot, clock, {"message": {"from": {"id": 10}, "chat": {"id": 10},
        "successful_payment": {"currency": "IRR", "total_amount": 500,
            "invoice_payload": str(pay.id),
            "telegram_payment_charge_id": "tc1",
            "provider_payment_charge_id": "ch1"}}})
    assert t("cert_paid") in texts(sent)
    assert any(t("cert_paid_admin", name="مریم رادمهر", title=ev.title) in x for x in texts(sent))
    assert payrepo.has_paid_target(user.id, "cert", 1)
    step(bot, clock, cb("mycerte:1", uid=10))
    assert t("cert_user_paid") in texts(sent)[-1]

"""تست گواهی پولی: کارگاه رایگان، صدور گواهی منوط به پرداخت هزینه."""
import json
from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.core.money import money_label
from nora.domain.certs import CertRepo
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.payments import PaymentRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services import certkit as ck
from nora.services.event_service import EventService

LAY_MANUAL = {"پوسته": "glass", "عناصر": [
    {"نوع": "متن", "متن": "{نام} · نمره: {نمره}", "x": 50, "y": 50,
     "اندازه": 40, "تراز": "وسط"}]}


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    override = tmp_path / "lay.json"
    override.write_text(json.dumps(LAY_MANUAL, ensure_ascii=False),
                        encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.setattr(ck, "_LAYOUT_OVERRIDE", override)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ck, "_CACHE", tmp_path / "c")
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(dict(params, _url=url))
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock,
                              transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db, clock)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved",
                 full_name="ادمین گروه")
    for uid, name in ((10, "مریم رادمهر"), (12, "سارا محمدی")):
        u = urepo.create(uid, first_name=name.split()[0])
        urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", full_name=name)
    yield bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo
    set_clock(old)


def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    kind = bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()
    return kind


def msg(text, uid=10):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def cb(data, uid=10):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def photo(file_id, uid=10):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "photo": [{"file_id": file_id}]}}


def ok_pay(uid, payload, amount):
    return {"message": {
        "from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
        "successful_payment": {
            "currency": "IRR", "total_amount": amount,
            "invoice_payload": str(payload),
            "telegram_payment_charge_id": f"tc{payload}",
            "provider_payment_charge_id": f"ch{payload}"}}}


def texts(sent):
    return [str(p.get("text", "") or p.get("caption", "")) for p in sent]


def markup(sent):
    return json.dumps(sent[-1].get("reply_markup") or "", ensure_ascii=False)


def _cert_event(env, price=500, title="کارگاه آرامش ذهن"):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    ev = erepo.create_event(title=title, status="published")
    erepo.update_event(ev.id, has_cert=1, cert_price=price)
    esvc = EventService(erepo, clock)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(10)
    res = esvc.register(user, ev)
    assert res.reg is not None and res.reg.status == "confirmed"
    return ev, user


def _pay_gateway(env, ev, user, uid=10):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"certbuy:{ev.id}", uid=uid))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"payc:{ev.id}:gateway", uid=uid))
    pay = payrepo.open_for_target_user("cert", ev.id, user.id)
    assert pay is not None
    step(bot, clock, ok_pay(uid, pay.id, int(pay.amount)))
    return pay


def test_user_page_and_gateway_flow(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    ev, user = _cert_event(env)
    # صفحهٔ کاربر: هزینه + دکمهٔ پرداخت
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"mycerte:{ev.id}"))
    assert t("cert_user_buy", amount=money_label(500)) in texts(sent)[-1]
    assert f"certbuy:{ev.id}" in markup(sent)
    # انتخاب روش
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"certbuy:{ev.id}"))
    assert t("cert_pay_choose", amount=money_label(500)) in texts(sent)[-1]
    # فاکتور درگاه با مبلغ گواهی
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"payc:{ev.id}:gateway"))
    inv = [p for p in sent if "sendInvoice" in p.get("_url", "")]
    assert json.loads(inv[-1]["prices"])[0]["amount"] == 500
    assert t("cert_invoice_desc", title=ev.title)[:60] in inv[-1]["description"]
    pay = payrepo.open_for_target_user("cert", ev.id, user.id)
    step(bot, clock, ok_pay(10, pay.id, 500))
    assert t("cert_paid") in texts(sent)
    assert t("cert_paid_admin", name="مریم رادمهر",
             title=ev.title) in texts(sent)
    assert payrepo.has_paid_target(user.id, "cert", ev.id)
    # صفحهٔ کاربر: پرداخت‌شده
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"mycerte:{ev.id}"))
    assert t("cert_user_paid") in texts(sent)[-1]


def test_unpaid_blocks_issue_then_unlocks(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    ev, user = _cert_event(env)
    certs = CertRepo(db)
    # بدون پرداخت: صدور رد می‌شود
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"certp:{ev.id}:{user.id}", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("۱۹", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"certok:{ev.id}:{user.id}", uid=999))
    assert t("cert_cond_paid") in texts(sent)
    assert certs.get_for(ev.id, user.id) is None
    # بعد از پرداخت: صدور انجام می‌شود
    _pay_gateway(env, ev, user)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"certp:{ev.id}:{user.id}", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("۱۹", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"certok:{ev.id}:{user.id}", uid=999))
    assert certs.get_for(ev.id, user.id) is not None
    # صفحهٔ کاربر: گواهی صادرشده با شماره
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"mycerte:{ev.id}"))
    assert t("cert_user_issued",
             n=certs.get_for(ev.id, user.id).number) in texts(sent)[-1]


def test_free_cert_page_has_no_buy(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    ev, user = _cert_event(env, price=0)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"mycerte:{ev.id}"))
    assert t("cert_user_free") in texts(sent)[-1]
    assert "certbuy" not in markup(sent)


def test_payment_of_other_user_does_not_unlock(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    ev, user = _cert_event(env)
    other = urepo.get_by_bale(12)
    EventService(erepo, clock).register(other, ev)
    # سارا پرداخت می‌کند؛ مریم هنوز بدهکار است
    _pay_gateway(env, ev, other, uid=12)
    assert payrepo.has_paid_target(other.id, "cert", ev.id)
    assert not payrepo.has_paid_target(user.id, "cert", ev.id)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"mycerte:{ev.id}"))
    assert t("cert_user_buy", amount=money_label(500)) in texts(sent)[-1]


def test_card_flow_then_admin_approve(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    ev, user = _cert_event(env)
    # ادمین شماره کارت می‌گذارد
    step(bot, clock, cb("paycard:1", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("6037991234567890", uid=999))
    assert t("payset_card_set") in texts(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"certbuy:{ev.id}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"payc:{ev.id}:card"))
    assert "6037991234567890" in texts(sent)[-1]

    pay = payrepo.open_for_target_user("cert", ev.id, user.id)
    assert pay is not None and pay.status == "waiting_approval"
    assert not payrepo.has_paid_target(user.id, "cert", ev.id)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"payok:{pay.id}", uid=999))
    assert t("cert_paid") in texts(sent)
    assert payrepo.has_paid_target(user.id, "cert", ev.id)

class RealAttendance:
    def __init__(self, attrepo, erepo): ...
    def summary(self, user_id):
        present = absent = 0; last = None
        for reg in self.erepo.user_regs(user_id, 100):
            ev = self.erepo.get_event(reg.event_id)
            if ev is None or not ev.has_attendance: continue
            p, a = self.attrepo.user_stats(ev.id, user_id)
            present += p; absent += a
        return {"present": present, "absent": absent, "last_ts": last}
class RealCerts:
    def __init__(self, certrepo): ...
    def rows(self, user_id):
        out = []
        for c in self.certrepo.list_user(user_id):
            out.append({"serial": c.code, "status": "revoked" if c.revoked else "valid"})
        return out

python


def on_dossier(kit, urepo, responder, ctx, uid, note_key="", **fmt):
    if not _can(urepo, ctx, "view_dossier"): return Reply(t("no_perm"))
    user = urepo.get(uid)
    if user is None: return Reply(t("usr_none"))
    head = _hub_head(user, kit)
    if note_key: head = t(note_key, **fmt) + "\n\n" + head
    if user.photo_file_id:
        responder.send_media_raw(ctx.chat_id, "photo", user.photo_file_id)
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, head, ui.kb(_hub_rows(urepo, ctx, user)))
    return Reply("")

python


def _counts(user, kit) -> dict:
    regs = kit.erepo.user_regs(user.id, 50) if kit.erepo else []
    pays = [p for p in kit.payrepo.list_of_user(user.id, 200)] if kit.payrepo else []
    paid = [p for p in pays if p.status == "paid"]
    total = sum(kit.payrepo.total_of(p) for p in paid) if kit.payrepo else 0
    certs = kit.certrepo.list_user(user.id) if kit.certrepo else []
    tickets = kit.suprepo.open_count_for(user.id) if kit.suprepo else 0
    return dict(regs=len(regs), pays=len(paid), total=total, certs=len(certs), tickets=tickets)
total_of for paid: total includes fee+infra; amount is net. For "مجموع پرداخت" use total_of.

class RealPayments:
    """Connect PaymentRepo to the PaymentsRepo protocol — only successful payments."""
    def __init__(self, repo) -> None:
        self.repo = repo
    def summary(self, user_id: int) -> dict:
        pays = [p for p in self.repo.list_of_user(user_id, 100)
                if p.status == "paid"]
        total = sum(self.repo.total_of(p) for p in pays)
        last = max((p.paid_ts for p in pays), default=None)
        return {"count": len(pays), "total_rial": total, "last_ts": last}
class RealAttendance:
    def __init__(self, attrepo, erepo) -> None: ...
    def summary(self, user_id):
        present = absent = 0
        for reg in self.erepo.user_regs(user_id, 100):
            ev = self.erepo.get_event(reg.event_id)
            if ev is None or not getattr(ev, "has_attendance", 0):
                continue
            p, a = self.attrepo.user_stats(ev.id, user_id)
            present += int(p); absent += int(a)
        return {"present": present, "absent": absent, "last_ts": None}
class RealCerts:
    def __init__(self, certrepo) -> None: ...
    def rows(self, user_id):
        out = []
        for c in self.certrepo.list_user(user_id):
            out.append({"serial": c.code,
                        "status": "revoked" if c.revoked else "ready"})
        return out

"""تست پروندهٔ کامل کاربر (تیکهٔ ⑤): هاب + هفت بخش + دسترسی‌ها."""
import json
from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.core.money import money_label
from nora.core.num import fa_num
from nora.domain.attendance import AttendanceRepo
from nora.domain.certs import CertRepo
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.payments import PaymentRepo
from nora.domain.support import SupportRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.event_service import EventService


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(dict(params, _url=url))
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock,
                              transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db, clock)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved",
                 full_name="ادمین گروه")
    member = urepo.create(10, first_name="مریم")
    urepo.update(member.id, status="approved", full_name="مریم رادمهر",
                 phone="09121234567", city="تهران")
    yield bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo
    set_clock(old)


def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    kind = bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()
    return kind


def cb(data, uid=999):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def texts(sent):
    return [str(p.get("text", "") or p.get("caption", "")) for p in sent]


def _seed(env):
    """یک کاربر با همهٔ جور داده: برنامه، پرداخت، حضور، گواهی، تیکت، پیام."""
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه عکاسی", status="published")
    erepo.update_event(ev.id, has_attendance=1, has_cert=1)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(10)
    res = EventService(erepo, clock).register(user, ev)
    assert res.reg is not None
    pay = payrepo.create(user.id, "gateway", 500, reg_id=res.reg.id,
                         target_kind="event", target_id=ev.id)
    payrepo.mark_paid(pay.id, "ch-dos")
    attrepo = AttendanceRepo(db, clock)
    sid = attrepo.add_session(ev.id, no=1)
    attrepo.mark(sid, user.id, "manual")
    certrepo = CertRepo(db, clock)
    cert = certrepo.issue(ev.id, user.id, "DOS12345", {}, by=1,
                          expire_ts=clock.ts() + 86400 * 400)
    suprepo = SupportRepo(db, clock)
    tk = suprepo.create(user.id, "سوال داشتم", category="فنی", priority=1)
    suprepo.add_msg(tk.id, "user", "سلام")
    suprepo.inbox_add(user.id, "direct", text="پیام مستقیم من")
    suprepo.inbox_add(user.id, "anon", text="متن_ناشناس_لو_نرود")
    return ev, user, pay, cert


def test_hub_counts_and_recent(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    ev, user, pay, cert = _seed(env)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"dos:{user.id}"))
    head = texts(sent)[-1]
    assert t("dos_title", name="مریم رادمهر") in head
    assert t("dos_counts", regs=fa_num(1), pays=fa_num(1),
             total=money_label(500), certs=fa_num(1),
             tickets=fa_num(1)) in head
    assert "کارگاه عکاسی" in head and t("evst_reg") in head
    markup = json.dumps(sent[-1].get("reply_markup") or "")
    for route in (f"dose:{user.id}", f"dosf:{user.id}", f"dosc:{user.id}",
                  f"dosat:{user.id}", f"dost:{user.id}", f"dosm:{user.id}",
                  f"dosa:{user.id}"):
        assert route in markup


def test_sections_show_real_data(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    ev, user, pay, cert = _seed(env)
    uid = user.id
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"dose:{uid}"))
    assert "کارگاه عکاسی" in texts(sent)[-1]
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"dosf:{uid}"))
    body = texts(sent)[-1]
    assert money_label(500) in body and t("pay_st_paid") in body
    assert f"dosr:{pay.id}" in json.dumps(sent[-1].get("reply_markup") or "")
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"dosr:{pay.id}"))
    assert [p for p in sent if "receipts" in str(p.get("photo_file", ""))]
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"dosc:{uid}"))
    assert "DOS12345" in texts(sent)[-1]
    assert t("dos_cert_until", until="—") not in texts(sent)[-1]
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"dosat:{uid}"))
    assert t("dos_att_total", p=fa_num(1), a=fa_num(0)) in texts(sent)[-1]
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"dost:{uid}"))
    body = texts(sent)[-1]
    assert "فنی" in body and t("dos_tk_open") in body
    assert t("dos_tk_urgent") in body
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"dosm:{uid}"))
    body = texts(sent)[-1]
    assert "پیام مستقیم من" in body
    assert "متن_ناشناس_لو_نرود" not in body     # ناشناس، ناشناس می‌ماند
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"dosa:{uid}"))
    assert "ثبت‌نام کرد" in texts(sent)[-1]


def test_member_denied_everywhere(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    ev, user, pay, cert = _seed(env)
    other = urepo.create(12, first_name="سارا")
    urepo.update(other.id, status="approved", role="member")
    for route in (f"dos:{user.id}", f"dose:{user.id}", f"dosf:{user.id}",
                  f"dosr:{pay.id}", f"dosc:{user.id}", f"dosat:{user.id}",
                  f"dost:{user.id}", f"dosm:{user.id}", f"dosa:{user.id}"):
        step(bot, clock, cb(route, uid=12))
        assert texts(sent)[-1] == t("no_perm"), route


def test_receipt_needs_finance_perm(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo = env
    ev, user, pay, cert = _seed(env)
    op = urepo.create(998, first_name="اپراتور")
    urepo.update(op.id, role="operator", status="approved")
    # اپراتور پرونده را می‌بیند (view_dossier) ولی رسید را نه (view_finance)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"dose:{user.id}", uid=998))
    assert "کارگاه عکاسی" in texts(sent)[-1]
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"dosr:{pay.id}", uid=998))
    assert texts(sent)[-1] == t("no_perm")

تا ۳ ردیف «آخرین برنامه‌ها» با وضعیت و تاریخ (همان قرارداد قدیمی پرونده).

    kb.append(nav)

    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(kb))

"""تست تیکهٔ ⑥: ویترین برگزارشده‌ها + حضوروغیاب روان‌تر."""
import json
from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.core.money import money_label
from nora.core.num import fa_num
from nora.domain.attendance import AttendanceRepo
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services import attendance as att
from nora.services.event_service import EventService


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(dict(params, _url=url))
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock,
                              transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    arepo = AttendanceRepo(db, clock)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved")
    yield bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo
    set_clock(old)


def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    kind = bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()
    return kind


def cb(data, uid=999):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def texts(sent):
    return [str(p.get("text", "") or p.get("caption", "")) for p in sent]


def markup(sent):
    return json.dumps(sent[-1].get("reply_markup") or "")


# ------------------------------------------------------------ ویترین
def _finished(env, title, start_ts, archive=0, access="registered",
              price=0):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo = env
    ev = erepo.create_event(title=title, status="finished",
                            start_ts=start_ts)
    if archive:
        for i in range(archive):
            erepo.add_archive(ev.id, f"f{i}", title=f"آیتم {i}")
    erepo.update_event(ev.id, archive_access=access, archive_price=price)
    return ev


def test_showcase_pages_and_badges(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo = env
    base = clock.ts() - 86400 * 10
    evs = []
    evs.append(_finished(env, "همایش فروشی", base + 1, archive=2,
                         access="paid", price=500))
    evs.append(_finished(env, "کارگاه شرکت‌کنندگان", base + 2, archive=1))
    for i in range(5):
        evs.append(_finished(env, f"برنامهٔ سادهٔ {i}", base + 10 + i))
    step(bot, clock, cb("evsd:1"))
    body = texts(sent)[-1]
    assert t("ev_done_title") in body
    assert t("ev_badge_arc_paid", amount=money_label(500)) in body
    assert t("ev_badge_arc_reg") in body
    assert t("ev_done_page", cur=fa_num(1), pages=fa_num(2)) in body
    mk = markup(sent)
    assert f"ev:{evs[0].id}" in mk and "evsd:2" in mk
    assert "evsd:0" not in mk              # صفحهٔ صفر بی‌معنی است
    step(bot, clock, cb("evsd:2"))
    body = texts(sent)[-1]
    assert t("ev_done_page", cur=fa_num(2), pages=fa_num(2)) in body
    assert "evsd:1" in markup(sent) and "evsd:3" not in markup(sent)
    # دکمهٔ هر برنامه به جزئیاتش می‌برد
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"ev:{evs[0].id}", uid=999))
    assert "همایش فروشی" in texts(sent)[-1]


def test_showcase_hidden_not_listed(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo = env
    ev = _finished(env, "برنامهٔ مخفی", clock.ts() - 86400)
    erepo.update_event(ev.id, privacy="hidden")
    _finished(env, "برنامهٔ پیدا", clock.ts() - 86400 + 5)
    step(bot, clock, cb("evsd:1"))
    body = texts(sent)[-1]
    assert "برنامهٔ پیدا" in body
    assert "برنامهٔ مخفی" not in body


# ---------------------------------------------------- حضور و غیاب روان
def _session_with_users(env, n=7):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo = env
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه آرامش", status="published",
                            start_ts=clock.ts() + 86400,
                            require_profile=0, has_attendance=1,
                            att_session_count=1, att_interval=7)
    esvc = EventService(erepo, clock)
    users = []
    for i in range(n):
        u = urepo.create(10 + i, first_name=f"کاربر{i}")
        urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", full_name=f"کاربر {i} رادمهر")
        assert esvc.register(u, ev).reg is not None
        users.append(u)
    with db.transaction():
        db.execute("UPDATE registrations SET status = 'confirmed'")
    att.ensure_sessions(arepo, erepo, ev)
    sess = arepo.sessions(ev.id)[0]
    return ev, users, sess


def test_manual_paging_unmarked_first(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo = env
    ev, users, sess = _session_with_users(env, 7)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atmn:{sess.id}:0"))
    body = texts(sent)[-1]
    assert t("att_manual_counts", un=fa_num(7), all=fa_num(7)) in body
    assert t("att_manual_page", cur=fa_num(1), pages=fa_num(2)) in body
    mk = markup(sent)
    assert f"atall:{sess.id}" in mk and f"atmn:{sess.id}:1" in mk
    # یک نفر غایب می‌شود؛ صفحهٔ اول باید ثبت‌نشده‌ها را نگه دارد
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atmk:{sess.id}:{users[0].id}:0"))
    assert t("att_manual_done", name="کاربر ۰ رادمهر") in texts(sent)[-1]
    body = texts(sent)[-1]
    assert t("att_manual_counts", un=fa_num(6), all=fa_num(7)) in body
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atmn:{sess.id}:1"))
    assert t("att_manual_page", cur=fa_num(2), pages=fa_num(2)) in \
        texts(sent)[-1]


def test_mark_all_remaining(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo = env
    ev, users, sess = _session_with_users(env, 7)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atmk:{sess.id}:{users[6].id}:0"))   # یک غایب
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atall:{sess.id}"))
    assert t("att_all_q", n=fa_num(6)) in texts(sent)[-1]
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atallok:{sess.id}"))
    assert t("att_all_done", n=fa_num(6)) in texts(sent)[-1]
    for u in users[:6]:
        p, a = arepo.user_stats(ev.id, u.id)
        assert (p, a) == (1, 0)
    p, a = arepo.user_stats(ev.id, users[6].id)
    assert (p, a) == (0, 1)          # غایبِ دستی، دست‌نخورده ماند
    # دیگر «باقی‌مانده» نیست
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atmn:{sess.id}:0"))
    assert f"atall:{sess.id}" not in markup(sent)
    assert t("att_manual_counts", un=fa_num(0), all=fa_num(7)) in \
        texts(sent)[-1]


def test_attendance_denied_for_member(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, arepo = env
    ev, users, sess = _session_with_users(env, 2)
    for route in (f"atmn:{sess.id}:0", f"atall:{sess.id}",
                  f"atallok:{sess.id}"):
        step(bot, clock, cb(route, uid=10))
        assert texts(sent)[-1] == t("no_perm"), route

tools/key_audit.py:

python


"""Text key audit: missing keys · unfilled placeholders · unused keys · duplicate keys."""
import ast, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
TEXTS = ROOT / "nora/channels/bale/texts.py"
PH = re.compile(r"{(\w+)}")
def load_texts():
    tree = ast.parse(TEXTS.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    keys = {}  # key -> (template, lineno)
    dups = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(getattr(x,'id',None)=="_TEXTS" for x in node.targets) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Dict):
            for k, v in zip(node.value.keys, node.value.values):
                if isinstance(k, ast.Constant) and isinstance(v, ast.Constant):
                    if k.value in keys: dups.append((k.value, k.lineno))
                    keys[k.value] = (v.value, k.lineno)
    return keys, dups

func is Name 't' → arg0 is Constant str → usage site; kwargs names → placeholders. If there's a **kwargs expansion, skip the check.
func is Attribute with attr in {"reply"} → args[1] is Constant (args[0]=ctx)
attr in {"bulk","bulk_raw"}? bulk(chat_id, key, markup?) — the key for bulk is arg1 as Constant.
attr "reply_raw": arg1 is a pre-formatted text, not a key — skip.
Dynamic prefixes: BinOp Add with left as Constant str ending in '' → prefix; JoinedStr where the first part is a constant → prefix (t(f"cert_c{...}")). Collect prefixes.
Additionally, raw string constants returned as keys (cerr = "cert_cond_paid", "no_perm", etc.) are later passed to reply(variable). To reduce false positives for UNUSED, treat all string constants in screens/services matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$ that exist in the _TEXTS key set as "usage sites." This is powerful: any literal equal to a key counts as a usage. (e.g., "cert_cond_paid")
MISSING check: literal keys in t()/reply()/bulk() calls that don't exist in _TEXTS → violation. Additionally, string constants that look like keys in contexts returned as cerr? Too ambiguous; limit missing checks to call sites only.
PLACEHOLDER check for t() literal calls: required = PH(template); passed = kwargs names; if ** is present → skip; missing = required - passed → violation (unless there are defaults?). Additional passed arguments are OK. For reply(ctx,"key",**ph): ph comes from the caller — check similarly: kwargs of the reply call. nora2/tools/route_audit.py

route_audit.py
PYTHON
"""ممیزی مسیرهای دکمه — هیچ دکمهٔ مرده، هیچ مسیر تکراری.

۱) DUP:  پیشوندی که دو بار r.add/router.add شده (دومی بی‌صدا اولی را می‌بلعد).
۲) DEAD: پیشوندی که در کد به‌شکل «xxx:…» ارجاع شده ولی ثبت نشده — دکمهٔ مرده
   یعنی cb_bad برای کاربر.
۳) INFO: مسیر ثبت‌شده‌ای که هیچ ارجاعی ندارد (دیپ‌لینک/تست — تخلف نیست).

اجرا: python tools/route_audit.py  →  ۰ تخلف یعنی سبز.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
BALE = ROOT / "nora" / "channels" / "bale"

ADD_RE = re.compile(r"\.add\(\s*[\"']([a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,19})[\"']")
REF_RE = re.compile(r"[\"']([a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,19}):")
WHITELIST = {"https", "http", "select"}          # رشته‌هایی که مسیر نیستند


def main() -> int:
    reg: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    refs: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for f in sorted(BALE.rglob("*.py")):
        rel = str(f.relative_to(ROOT))
        src = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for m in ADD_RE.finditer(src):
            reg.setdefault(m.group(1), []).append(f"{rel}:{src[:m.start()].count(chr(10)) + 1}")
        for m in REF_RE.finditer(src):
            p = m.group(1)
            if p in WHITELIST:
                continue
            refs.setdefault(p, []).append(
                f"{rel}:{src[:m.start()].count(chr(10)) + 1}")

    bad = 0
    for p, sites in sorted(reg.items()):
        if len(sites) > 1:
            print(f"DUP   «{p}» در {len(sites)} جا ثبت شده: {sites}")
            bad += 1
    for p, sites in sorted(refs.items()):
        if p not in reg:
            print(f"DEAD  «{p}:…» ارجاع شده ولی ثبت نشده — نخستین: {sites[0]}")
            bad += 1
    orphan = sorted(p for p in reg if p not in refs)
    for p in orphan:
        print(f"INFO  «{p}» ثبت شده ولی ارجاع کدی ندارد (دیپ‌لینک/تست؟)")
    print(f"route_audit: {len(reg)} مسیر ثبت‌شده · {len(refs)} پیشوند ارجاعی ·"
          f" {bad} تخلف")
    return 1 if bad else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def _finv(urepo, ctx):   # خزانه‌دار و بالاتر — دیدن و کارهای پولی روزمره (treasurer and above — viewing and day-to-day monetary operations)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if user is None or not can(user.role, "view_finance"):
        return None
    return user
def _fins(urepo, ctx):   # فقط ادمین/مالک — تنظیمات مالی (admin/owner only — financial settings)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if user is None or not can(user.role, "manage_settings"):
        return None
    return user

"""Integration test for clause 7: access based on a single source PERMS + health audit."""
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
@pytest.fixture()
def env(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []
    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(dict(params, _url=url))
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}
    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock, transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    roles = {999: "admin", 900: "owner", 20: "treasurer", 21: "organizer",
             22: "operator", 10: "member"}
    for uid, role in roles.items():
        u = urepo.create(uid, first_name=f"کاربر{uid}")
        urepo.update(u.id, role=role, status="approved")
    yield bot, clock, sent, urepo
    set_clock(old)
def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    kind = bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()
    return kind
def cb(data, uid):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}
def last_text(sent):
    p = sent[-1]
    return str(p.get("text", "") or p.get("caption", ""))
def denied(bot, clock, sent, data, uid):
    step(bot, clock, cb(data, uid))
    assert t("no_perm") in last_text(sent)
def allowed(bot, clock, sent, data, uid):
    step(bot, clock, cb(data, uid))
    assert t("no_perm") not in last_text(sent)

"""تست یکپارچه‌سازی بند ۷ — دسترسی‌ها از منبع یکتای PERMS + سالمی ممیزی‌ها."""
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

OWNER, ADMIN, TREAS, ORGA, OPER, MEMB = 900, 999, 20, 21, 22, 10


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(dict(params, _url=url))
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock, transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    for uid, role in ((OWNER, "owner"), (ADMIN, "admin"), (TREAS, "treasurer"),
                      (ORGA, "organizer"), (OPER, "operator"),
                      (MEMB, "member")):
        u = urepo.create(uid, first_name=f"کاربر{uid}")
        urepo.update(u.id, role=role, status="approved")
    yield bot, clock, sent, urepo
    set_clock(old)


def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    kind = bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()
    return kind


def cb(data, uid):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def last(sent):
    p = sent[-1]
    return str(p.get("text", "") or p.get("caption", "")), \
        str(p.get("reply_markup") or "")


def denied(env, data, uid):
    bot, clock, sent, _ = env
    step(bot, clock, cb(data, uid))
    assert t("no_perm") in last(sent)[0], f"{data} برای {uid} رد نشد"


def allowed(env, data, uid):
    bot, clock, sent, _ = env
    step(bot, clock, cb(data, uid))
    assert t("no_perm") not in last(sent)[0], f"{data} برای {uid} بسته شد"

                       capture_output=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""اسکنر ۹ — نظم بصری متن‌ها (بند ۹: یوآی تمیز و یکپارچه).

قانون‌ها (روی مقدارهای texts.py):
  ۱. ایموجی ممنوع — فقط نشان‌های تایپوگرافیک: · — «» ✓ ٪
  ۲. جداکننده‌ها با فاصلهٔ درست: «·» و «—» همیشه یک فاصله دو طرف
  ۳. فاصلهٔ دوتایی ممنوع
  ۴. گلولهٔ ردیف فقط «· » — نه «-» نه «*» نه «•»
  ۵. «» جفت باشد
  ۶. عنوان/سربرگ (_title/_head/_menu) با نقطه تمام نشود
  ۷. خط چپ‌به‌راستِ لاتین در متن فارسی با فاصله از فارسی جدا شود
استثنا: `# noqa: ui` روی خط کلید.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

TEXTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / \
    "nora/channels/bale/texts.py"

EMOJI = re.compile(
    "[\U0001F000-\U0001FAFF\U00002700-\U000027BF\U00002600-\U000026FF"
    "\U00002B00-\U00002BFF\U0000FE00-\U0000FE0F\U0001F1E6-\U0001F1FF"
    "\U00002190-\U000021FF\U0000203C-\U00003299]")
ALLOWED_MARKS = "·—«»✓٪…"
DOUBLE_SP = re.compile(r"[^\n]  [^\n]")
BULLET_BAD = re.compile(r"^\s*[-*•]\s")
SEP_SP = re.compile(r"(\S·|·\S|\S—|—\S)")


def _dict_pairs(tree):
    """(key, value_node) برای هر جفت _TEXTS."""
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.AnnAssign) and \
                getattr(node.target, "id", "") == "_TEXTS":
            for k, v in zip(node.value.keys, node.value.values):
                yield k.value, v


def main() -> int:
    src = TEXTS.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    lines = src.splitlines()
    tree = ast.parse(src)
    bad = []
    seen = 0
    for key, vnode in _dict_pairs(tree):
        if not isinstance(vnode, ast.Constant):
            continue
        s = vnode.value
        seen += 1
        if "noqa: ui" in lines[vnode.lineno - 1]:
            continue
        loc = f"line {vnode.lineno} «{key}»"
        for ch in s:
            if EMOJI.match(ch) and ch not in ALLOWED_MARKS:
                bad.append((loc, f"ایموجی/نشان نامجاز: {ch!r}"))
                break
        if DOUBLE_SP.search(s):
            bad.append((loc, "فاصلهٔ دوتایی"))
        if BULLET_BAD.search(s):
            bad.append((loc, "گلولهٔ غیر «·»"))
        for part in s.split("\n"):
            m = SEP_SP.search(part)
            if m and "…" not in m.group(0):
                bad.append((loc, f"جداکنندهٔ بی‌فاصله: {m.group(0)!r}"))
        if s.count("«") != s.count("»"):
            bad.append((loc, "«» جفت نیست"))
        if (key.endswith(("_title", "_head", "_menu"))
                and s.rstrip().endswith(".")):
            bad.append((loc, "عنوان با نقطه تمام شده"))
    print(f"ui_audit: {seen} کلید · {len(bad)} تخلف")
    for loc, why in bad:
        print(f"  ❌ {loc}  {why}")
    return 1 if bad else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def test_full_journey(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo = env
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db, clock)
    arepo = AttendanceRepo(db, clock)

                       att_session_count=1, has_cert=1, cert_price=500)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"evst:{eid}:published", uid=999))

    step(bot, clock, cb(f"reg:{eid}"))         # Registration
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"pay:{eid}"))         # Pay

    reg = erepo.event_regs(eid)[0]
    pay = payrepo.open_for_reg(reg.id)

    reg = erepo.get_reg(reg.id)
    assert reg.status == "confirmed" and reg.ticket_code
    assert t("pay_approved") in texts_(sent)

def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    kind = bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()
    return kind


def msg(text, uid=10):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def cb(data, uid=10):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def photo(file_id, uid=10):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "photo": [{"file_id": file_id}]}}


def ok_pay(uid, payload, amount):
    return {"message": {
        "from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
        "successful_payment": {
            "currency": "IRR", "total_amount": amount,
            "invoice_payload": str(payload),
            "telegram_payment_charge_id": f"tc{payload}",
            "provider_payment_charge_id": f"ch{payload}"}}}


def txts(sent):
    return [str(p.get("text", "") or p.get("caption", "")) for p in sent]


def markup(sent):
    return json.dumps(sent[-1].get("reply_markup") or "", ensure_ascii=False)


def _journey_event(bot, clock, sent, db):
    """رویداد پولی با حضوروغیاب و گواهی پولی — همه از راه ویزارد واقعی."""
    assert step(bot, clock, cb("newev:1", uid=999)) == "cb"
    step(bot, clock, msg(TITLE, uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("evk:workshop", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("1405-07-01 18:30", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("evl:physical", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("تهران، میدان آزادی", uid=999))
    for data in ("evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:paid:0",
                 "evw:priv:public", "evw:skip:1", "evw:audg:all",
                 "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:wl:1", "evw:skip:1",
                 "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1",
                 "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:skip:1", "evw:rem:1",
                 "evw:skip:1"):
        step(bot, clock, cb(data, uid=999))
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    eid = erepo.list_events()[0].id
    erepo.update_event(eid, is_paid=1, price=1000, has_attendance=1,
                       att_session_count=1, has_cert=1, cert_price=500)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"evst:{eid}:published", uid=999))
    return eid


def test_journey_happy_path(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo = env
    eid = _journey_event(bot, clock, sent, db)
    erepo, payrepo = EventRepo(db), PaymentRepo(db, clock)
    arepo, certrepo = AttendanceRepo(db, clock), CertRepo(db, clock)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(10)

    # ۱) ادمین کارت مقصد را می‌گذارد
    step(bot, clock, cb("paycard:1", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("6037991234567890", uid=999))
    assert t("payset_card_set") in txts(sent)

    # ۲) کاربر ثبت‌نام و کارت‌به‌کارت می‌کند
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"ev:{eid}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"reg:{eid}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"pay:{eid}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"paym:{eid}:card"))
    assert "6037991234567890" in txts(sent)[-1]
    step(bot, clock, photo("rc1"))
    reg = erepo.event_regs(eid)[0]
    pay = payrepo.open_for_reg(reg.id)
    assert pay is not None and pay.status == "waiting_approval"

    # ۳) ادمین رسید را تأیید می‌کند → بلیت + رسید شیشه‌ای
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"payok:{pay.id}", uid=999))
    reg = erepo.get_reg(reg.id)
    assert reg.status == "confirmed" and reg.ticket_code
    assert t("pay_approved") in txts(sent)
    assert any(str(p.get("photo_file", "")).endswith(".png") for p in sent)

    # ۴) حضوروغیاب: جلسه با کد
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atm:{eid}", uid=999))
    sess = arepo.sessions(eid)[0]
    arepo.update_session(sess.id, opens_ts=clock.ts() - 600,
                         closes_ts=clock.ts() + 3600)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atu:{eid}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"atcd:{sess.id}:code"))
    step(bot, clock, msg(sess.code))
    assert "حضورت ثبت شد" in txts(sent)[-1]
    assert arepo.record(sess.id, user.id).status == "present"

    # ۵) گواهی پولی: خرید با درگاه، صدور توسط ادمین
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"mycerte:{eid}"))
    assert f"certbuy:{eid}" in markup(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"certbuy:{eid}"))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"payc:{eid}:gateway"))
    pay2 = payrepo.open_for_target_user("cert", eid, user.id)
    assert pay2 is not None
    step(bot, clock, ok_pay(10, pay2.id, 500))
    assert t("cert_paid") in txts(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"certp:{eid}:{user.id}", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("۱۹", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"certok:{eid}:{user.id}", uid=999))
    cert = certrepo.get_for(eid, user.id)
    assert cert is not None
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"mycerte:{eid}"))
    assert t("cert_user_issued", n=fa_num(cert.number)) in txts(sent)[-1]

    # ۶) رسیدهای کاربر و گزارش مالی ادمین، هر دو پر است
    step(bot, clock, cb("rec:1"))
    body = txts(sent)[-1]
    assert money_label(1000) in body and money_label(500) in body
    step(bot, clock, cb("finrep:all", uid=999))
    body = txts(sent)[-1]
    assert money_label(1500) in body


def test_journey_refund(env):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo = env
    eid = _journey_event(bot, clock, sent, db)
    erepo, payrepo = EventRepo(db), PaymentRepo(db, clock)
    frepo = FinanceRepo(db, clock)
    ali = urepo.get_by_bale(11)

    # ثبت‌نام و پرداخت درگاه
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"ev:{eid}", uid=11))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"reg:{eid}", uid=11))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"pay:{eid}", uid=11))
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"paym:{eid}:gateway", uid=11))
    reg = erepo.event_regs(eid)[0]
    pay = payrepo.open_for_reg(reg.id)
    step(bot, clock, ok_pay(11, pay.id, 1000))
    assert erepo.get_reg(reg.id).status == "confirmed"

    # لغو توسط کاربر → صف بازپرداخت
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"creg:{eid}", uid=11))
    assert t("ev_cancel_refund") in txts(sent)
    assert any("برگشت پول" in s for s in txts(sent))
    reg = erepo.get_reg(reg.id)
    assert reg.refund_due == 1

    # ادمین بازپرداخت را ثبت می‌کند
    step(bot, clock, cb("finr:1", uid=999))
    assert "علی رضایی" in txts(sent)[-1]
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"finrd:{reg.id}", uid=999))
    assert t("fin_ref_done") in txts(sent)
    assert t("refund_done", amount=money_label(1000),
             title=TITLE) in txts(sent)
    assert erepo.get_reg(reg.id).refund_due == 0
    assert len(frepo.refunds("done")) == 1
    assert ali.id  # کاربر هنوز سر جایش است؛ فقط ثبت‌نام لغو شد

Persian numeral function:

python

def fa(n): return "".join(FA[int(d)] for d in str(n))

initData validation (Telegram-style, Bale probably follows it):

python


def validate_init_data(raw: str, bot_token: str, max_age: int = 86400) -> dict:
    params = dict(parse_qsl(raw))
    received_hash = params.pop("hash", None)
    if not received_hash: raise WebAppAuthError("hash is missing")
    data_check = "\n".join(f"{k}={params[k]}" for k in sorted(params))
    secret = hmac.new(bot_token.encode(), b"WebAppData", hashlib.sha256).digest()
    calc = hmac.new(secret, data_check.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(calc, received_hash): raise WebAppAuthError("hash mismatch")
    auth_date = int(params.get("auth_date", 0)); check elapsed time.
    user = json.loads(params.get("user", "{}"))
    return user

webapp.py:

python


"""Bale mini-app — initData validation (HMAC-SHA256).
Protocol: parameters are sorted and joined with \n in k=v format, secret key is
HMAC(bot_token, "WebAppData"), hash is HMAC(secret, data_check_string).
No Persian text — error codes are English, conversion is done at the presentation layer.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
import hmac
import json
from urllib.parse import parse_qsl
from ...core.errors import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
class InitDataError(PermissionDenied):
    """Invalid or expired initData — code is in args[0]."""
def validate_init_data(raw: str, bot_token: str, now: float,
                       max_age: int = 86400) -> dict:
    if not raw or not bot_token:
        raise InitDataError("missing")
    params = dict(parse_qsl(raw, keep_blank_values=True))
    received = params.pop("hash", "")
    if not received:
        raise InitDataError("missing_hash")
    check = "\n".join(f"{k}={params[k]}" for k in sorted(params))
    secret = hmac.new(bot_token.encode(), b"WebAppData", hashlib.sha256).digest()
    calc = hmac.new(secret, check.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(calc, received):
        raise InitDataError("bad_hash")
    try:
        auth_date = int(params.get("auth_date", "0"))
    except ValueError as e:
        raise InitDataError("bad_auth_date") from e
    if auth_date <= 0 or now - auth_date > max_age:
        raise InitDataError("expired")
    try:
        user = json.loads(params.get("user", "") or "{}")
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        raise InitDataError("bad_user") from e
    if not isinstance(user, dict) or not user.get("id"):
        raise InitDataError("bad_user")
    return {"user": user, "auth_date": auth_date,
            "start_param": params.get("tgWebAppStartParam", "")}

"""Web panel home — real data aggregation per access level."""
from __future__ import annotations
from ..domain.payments import M_CARD, M_GATEWAY, M_ONSITE
from ..services.permissions import can  # same package — use relative .permissions
DAY = 86400.0
def home_data(*, now, urepo, erepo, payrepo, suprepo, profsvc, role) -> dict:
    out = {"role": role}
    if can(role, "view_users"):
        out["users_total"] = urepo.count()
        out["users_new_day"] = urepo.count_since(now - DAY)
        out["queue_profiles"] = len(profsvc.open_approvals())
    if can(role, "view_finance"):
        out["queue_payments"] = payrepo.count_unsettled()
        paid = payrepo.paid_since(now - 30 * DAY)
        out["income_30d"] = sum(payrepo.total_of(p) for p in paid)
        by = {}
        for p in paid:
            e = by.setdefault(p.method, {"sum": 0, "count": 0})
            e["sum"] += payrepo.total_of(p); e["count"] += 1
        out["income_by_method"] = by
    if can(role, "manage_support"):
        out["queue_tickets"] = len(suprepo.list_open())
    if can(role, "manage_events"):
        evs = erepo.upcoming_published(now, 14 * DAY)
        out["next_events"] = [
            {"id": e.id, "title": e.title, "start_ts": e.start_ts,
             "kind": e.kind, "place": e.loc_address or e.online_link or ""}
            for e in evs[:3]]
    return out

    uid = request.app["urepo"].user_of_session(tok)
    return request.app["urepo"].get(uid) if uid else None

webapp.py
PYTHON
"""Bale Mini App — initData validation (HMAC-SHA256).

Protocol (same as Telegram WebApp):
- data_check_string = sorted params (without ``hash``) joined by ``\\n`` as ``k=v``.
- secret = HMAC_SHA256(key=bot_token, msg="WebAppData")
- hash   = HMAC_SHA256(key=secret, msg=data_check_string) hexdigest

Error codes are neutral strings (args[0]); the presentation layer maps them
to human text. No Persian literals live in this module.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
from urllib.parse import parse_qsl

from ...core.errors import PermissionDenied


class InitDataError(PermissionDenied):
    """Invalid or stale initData — args[0] carries the code."""


def _secret(bot_token: str) -> bytes:
    return hmac.new(bot_token.encode(), b"WebAppData", hashlib.sha256).digest()


def sign_init_data(params: dict, bot_token: str) -> str:
    """Build a signed initData query string (used by tests and dev tools)."""
    check = "\n".join(f"{k}={params[k]}" for k in sorted(params))
    digest = hmac.new(_secret(bot_token), check.encode(),
                      hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    pairs = [f"{k}={params[k]}" for k in sorted(params)]
    return "&".join(pairs + [f"hash={digest}"])


def validate_init_data(raw: str, bot_token: str, now: float,
                       max_age: int = 86400) -> dict:
    """Validate raw initData; returns {"user", "auth_date", "start_param"}.

    Raises InitDataError with a code on any problem — never trusts the
    payload without a matching HMAC.
    """
    if not raw or not bot_token:
        raise InitDataError("missing")
    params = dict(parse_qsl(raw, keep_blank_values=True))
    received = params.pop("hash", "")
    if not received:
        raise InitDataError("missing_hash")
    check = "\n".join(f"{k}={params[k]}" for k in sorted(params))
    calc = hmac.new(_secret(bot_token), check.encode(),
                    hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(calc, received):
        raise InitDataError("bad_hash")
    try:
        auth_date = int(params.get("auth_date", "0"))
    except ValueError as e:
        raise InitDataError("bad_auth_date") from e
    if auth_date <= 0 or now - auth_date > max_age:
        raise InitDataError("expired")
    try:
        user = json.loads(params.get("user", "") or "{}")
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        raise InitDataError("bad_user") from e
    if not isinstance(user, dict) or not isinstance(user.get("id"), int):
        raise InitDataError("bad_user")
    return {"user": user, "auth_date": auth_date,
            "start_param": str(params.get("tgWebAppStartParam", ""))}

"""Home of the web panel — aggregated live numbers, filtered by role.

Every block is computed only when the role holds its permission, so the
payload itself never leaks data across access levels. No literals here;
all human text is formatted by jalali helpers or rendered client-side.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from ..core.jalali import fmt_dt
from .permissions import can

DAY = 86400.0
NEXT_WINDOW = 14 * DAY
INCOME_WINDOW = 30 * DAY


def home_data(*, now: float, role: str, urepo, erepo, payrepo, suprepo,
              profsvc) -> dict:
    """Return the home payload for ``role`` — keys appear per permission."""
    out: dict = {"role": role}
    if can(role, "view_users"):
        out["users_total"] = urepo.count()
        out["users_new_day"] = urepo.count_since(now - DAY)
        out["queue_profiles"] = len(profsvc.open_approvals())
    if can(role, "view_finance"):
        out["queue_payments"] = payrepo.count_unsettled()
        paid = payrepo.paid_since(now - INCOME_WINDOW)
        out["income_30d"] = sum(payrepo.total_of(p) for p in paid)
        by: dict[str, dict] = {}
        for p in paid:
            entry = by.setdefault(p.method, {"sum": 0, "count": 0})
            entry["sum"] += payrepo.total_of(p)
            entry["count"] += 1
        out["income_by_method"] = by
    if can(role, "manage_support"):
        out["queue_tickets"] = len(suprepo.list_open())
    if can(role, "manage_events"):
        events = erepo.upcoming_published(now, NEXT_WINDOW)
        out["next_events"] = [
            {"id": e.id, "title": e.title, "kind": e.kind,
             "start_ts": e.start_ts,
             "when": fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(e.start_ts)),
             "place": (e.loc_address or e.online_link or "")}
            for e in events[:3]]
    return out
