"""مینی‌اپ وب نورا — سرور aiohttp.

سه کار:
۱) سرو کردن فایل‌های ایستای مینی‌اپ (web/miniapp + فونت‌های nora/assets/fonts)
۲) اعتبارسنجی initData بله و صدور نشست (همان مکانیزم ۳۰ روزهٔ بات)
۳) API نقش‌محور — هر خروجی بر پایهٔ PERMS فیلتر می‌شود

WEB_DEV_BALE_ID فقط وقتی env != prod است اثر دارد (میان‌بر پیش‌نمایش).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

from aiohttp import web

from nora.channels.bale.webapp import InitDataError, validate_init_data
from nora.core.clock import get_clock
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.payments import PaymentRepo
from nora.domain.settings import SettingsRepo
from nora.domain.support import SupportRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.permissions import PERMS, OWNER, can
from nora.services.profile_service import ProfileService
from nora.services.web_home import home_data

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
FONTS = BASE.parent / "nora" / "assets" / "fonts"

# دسترسی‌هایی که ورود به پنل را باز می‌کنند (view_public عمداً نیست)
PANEL_PERMS = (
    "manage_events", "send_bulk", "view_users", "manage_users",
    "import_users", "view_dossier", "view_finance", "export_excel",
    "issue_certs", "manage_forms", "manage_settings", "manage_support",
)


def panel_ok(role: str) -> bool:
    return any(can(role, p) for p in PANEL_PERMS)


def perms_of(role: str) -> list:
    return [p for p in sorted(PERMS) if can(role, p)]


def _json(payload: dict, status: int = 200) -> web.Response:
    body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)
    return web.Response(text=body, status=status,
                        content_type="application/json", charset="utf-8")


def _err(status: int, code: str) -> web.Response:
    return _json({"ok": False, "error": code}, status)


def _user_payload(user) -> dict:
    return {"id": user.id, "name": user.full_name or user.first_name,
            "role": user.role}


def create_app(settings, db, *, dev_bale_id: int = 0) -> web.Application:
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db)
    suprepo = SupportRepo(db)
    setrepo = SettingsRepo(db)
    profsvc = ProfileService(urepo, setrepo)

    app = web.Application()
    app["settings"] = settings
    app["urepo"] = urepo
    app["erepo"] = erepo
    app["payrepo"] = payrepo
    app["suprepo"] = suprepo
    app["profsvc"] = profsvc
    # میان‌بر توسعه در prod هرگز فعال نمی‌شود
    app["dev_bale_id"] = 0 if settings.is_prod else int(dev_bale_id or 0)

    app.router.add_get("/healthz", h_health)
    app.router.add_post("/api/auth", h_auth)
    app.router.add_get("/api/me", h_me)
    app.router.add_get("/api/home", h_home)
    app.router.add_get("/", h_index)
    app.router.add_static("/static/", BASE / "miniapp")
    if FONTS.exists():
        app.router.add_static("/assets/fonts/", FONTS)
    return app


# ---------- هندلرها ----------

async def h_health(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
    return _json({"ok": True})


async def _authed(request: web.Request):
    header = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
    token = header[7:].strip() if header.startswith("Bearer ") else ""
    if not token:
        return None
    urepo = request.app["urepo"]
    user_id = urepo.user_of_session(token)
    return urepo.get(user_id) if user_id else None


async def h_auth(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
    try:
        body = await request.json()
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
        return _err(400, "bad_body")
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        return _err(400, "bad_body")
    settings = request.app["settings"]
    urepo = request.app["urepo"]
    dev_id = request.app["dev_bale_id"]

    bale_id = 0
    if dev_id and body.get("dev"):
        bale_id = dev_id
    else:
        try:
            info = validate_init_data(str(body.get("init_data", "")),
                                      settings.bot_token, get_clock().ts())
        except InitDataError as e:
            return _err(403, str(e.args[0] if e.args else "bad_init"))
        bale_id = int(info["user"]["id"])

    user = urepo.get_by_bale(bale_id)
    if user is None and dev_id and bale_id == dev_id:
        # فقط در حالت توسعه: کاربر نمونه با نقش مالک ساخته می‌شود
        user = urepo.create(bale_id, first_name="مدیر نورا")
        urepo.update(user.id, role=OWNER)
        user = urepo.get(user.id)
    if user is None:
        return _err(403, "no_user")
    if user.status == "blocked":
        return _err(403, "blocked")
    if not panel_ok(user.role):
        return _err(403, "no_panel")

    token = urepo.new_session(user.id)
    return _json({"ok": True, "token": token, "user": _user_payload(user),
                  "perms": perms_of(user.role)})


async def h_me(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
    user = await _authed(request)
    if user is None:
        return _err(401, "no_session")
    return _json({"ok": True, "user": _user_payload(user),
                  "perms": perms_of(user.role)})


async def h_home(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
    user = await _authed(request)
    if user is None:
        return _err(401, "no_session")
    if not panel_ok(user.role):
        return _err(403, "no_panel")
    app = request.app
    data = home_data(now=get_clock().ts(), role=user.role,
                     urepo=app["urepo"], erepo=app["erepo"],
                     payrepo=app["payrepo"], suprepo=app["suprepo"],
                     profsvc=app["profsvc"])
    return _json({"ok": True, "home": data})


async def h_index(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
    index = BASE / "miniapp" / "index.html"
    return web.Response(text=index.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
                        content_type="text/html", charset="utf-8")

// نورا — مینی‌اپ وب · بوت، پل بله، روتر، خانهٔ نقش‌محور
import { svg } from "./icons.js";

const BP = (window.Bale && window.Bale.WebApp) ? window.Bale.WebApp : null;
const TOKEN_KEY = "nora.token";

const ROLE_FA = {
  guest: "مهمان", member: "عضو", verified: "تأییدشده",
  organizer: "برگزارکننده", operator: "گرداننده",
  treasurer: "خزانه‌دار", admin: "ادمین", owner: "مالک",
};
const METHOD_FA = {
  gateway: "درگاه رسمی بله", card: "کارت‌به‌کارت", onsite: "حضوری",
};

const state = {
  token: localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY) || "",
  user: null, perms: [], home: null, tab: "home", error: "",
};

// ---------- ابزار ----------

const FA_DIGITS = "۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹";
function faNum(n) {
  return String(Math.round(Number(n) || 0))
    .replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, "٬")
    .replace(/\d/g, (d) => FA_DIGITS[+d]);
}
function has(perm) { return state.perms.includes(perm); }

async function api(path, opts = {}) {
  const headers = { "Content-Type": "application/json", ...(opts.headers || {}) };
  if (state.token) headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + state.token;
  const res = await fetch(path, { ...opts, headers });
  const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!res.ok || data.ok === false) {
    throw new Error(data.error || ("http_" + res.status));
  }
  return data;
}

// ---------- تم ----------

function applyTheme() {
  let dark = false;
  if (BP && BP.themeParams && BP.themeParams.bg_color) {
    const bg = BP.themeParams.bg_color.replace("#", "");
    const lum = (parseInt(bg.slice(0, 2), 16) * 299 +
                 parseInt(bg.slice(2, 4), 16) * 587 +
                 parseInt(bg.slice(4, 6), 16) * 114) / 1000;
    dark = lum < 110;
  } else if (BP && BP.colorScheme) {
    dark = BP.colorScheme === "dark";
  } else {
    dark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
  }
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = dark ? "dark" : "light";
}

// ---------- ورود ----------

async function login() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  if (BP && BP.initData) {
    return api("/api/auth", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ init_data: BP.initData }),
    });
  }
  if (params.get("dev") === "1") {
    return api("/api/auth", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ dev: true }) });
  }
  throw new Error("no_entry");
}

async function boot() {
  applyTheme();
  if (BP) {
    try { BP.ready(); BP.expandViewport(); } catch (e) { /* ناسازگار = بی‌اثر */ }
  }
  try {
    if (state.token) {
      const me = await api("/api/me").catch(async (e) => {
        state.token = ""; localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
        return login();
      });
      state.user = me.user; state.perms = me.perms || [];
    } else {
      const auth = await login();
      state.token = auth.token; localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, auth.token);
      state.user = auth.user; state.perms = auth.perms || [];
    }
    const home = await api("/api/home");
    state.home = home.home;
    state.error = "";
  } catch (e) {
    state.error = e.message || "unknown";
  }
  render();
}

// ---------- رندر ----------

const ERR_FA = {
  no_entry: "این صفحه را از دکمهٔ پنل در بات بله باز کنید",
  no_panel: "نقش شما دسترسی پنل ندارد — با مدیر هماهنگ کنید",
  no_user: "کاربر شما در نورا ثبت نشده — اول در بات /start بزنید",
  blocked: "حساب شما مسدود است",
  no_session: "نشست تمام شد — صفحه را از بات باز کنید",
};

function tabs() {
  const items = [
    { id: "home", icon: "i-home", label: "خانه" },
    { id: "events", icon: "i-cal", label: "برنامه‌ها" },
    { id: "pay", icon: "i-card", label: "پرداخت" },
    { id: "support", icon: "i-chat", label: "پشتیبانی" },
    { id: "more", icon: "i-grid", label: "بیشتر" },
  ];
  const q = state.home || {};
  const badge = (q.queue_tickets || 0);
  return `<nav class="tabbar">${items.map((t) => `
    <button class="tab ${state.tab === t.id ? "on" : ""}" data-tab="${t.id}">
      ${svg(t.icon)}<span>${t.label}</span>
      ${t.id === "support" && badge ? `<span class="badge">${faNum(badge)}</span>` : ""}
    </button>`).join("")}</nav>`;
}

function head() {
  const role = ROLE_FA[state.user.role] || state.user.role;
  return `<header class="mm-head">
    <div class="mm-title"><span class="dot"></span>پنل نورا</div>
    <span class="role-chip">${role}</span>
  </header>`;
}

function homeView() {
  const h = state.home || {};
  const parts = [];
  parts.push(`<div class="h2">سلام، ${state.user.name || "مدیر"}</div>`);

  const stats = [];
  if (h.users_total != null) {
    stats.push(`<div class="stat"><div class="num">${faNum(h.users_total)}</div><div class="lbl">کاربران · نو امروز ${faNum(h.users_new_day)}</div></div>`);
  }
  if (h.income_30d != null) {
    stats.push(`<div class="stat gold"><div class="num">${faNum(h.income_30d)}</div><div class="lbl">درآمد ۳۰ روز · ریال</div></div>`);
  }
  if (stats.length) parts.push(`<div class="stats">${stats.join("")}</div>`);

  const queues = [];
  if (h.queue_profiles != null) queues.push(["i-id", "صف پروفایل", h.queue_profiles]);
  if (h.queue_payments != null) queues.push(["i-card", "صف پرداخت", h.queue_payments]);
  if (h.queue_tickets != null) queues.push(["i-chat", "تیکت باز", h.queue_tickets]);
  if (queues.length) {
    parts.push(`<div class="h2">صف‌های کاری</div><div class="card g">${queues.map(([ic, label, n]) => `
      <div class="row"><div class="av ${n ? "warn" : ""}">${svg(ic)}</div>
      <div class="main"><div class="t1">${label}</div></div>
      <span class="chip ${n ? "danger" : "acc"}">${faNum(n)}</span></div>`).join("")}</div>`);
  }

  if (h.next_events && h.next_events.length) {
    parts.push(`<div class="h2">برنامهٔ بعدی</div><div class="card g">${h.next_events.map((e) => `
      <div class="row"><div class="av info">${svg("i-cal")}</div>
      <div class="main"><div class="t1">${e.title}</div>
      <div class="t2">${e.when}${e.place ? " · " + e.place : ""}</div></div></div>`).join("")}</div>`);
  }

  const by = h.income_by_method || {};
  const methods = Object.keys(by);
  if (methods.length) {
    parts.push(`<div class="h2">درآمد به تفکیک روش</div><div class="card g">${methods.map((m) => `
      <div class="row"><div class="av gold">${svg("i-wallet")}</div>
      <div class="main"><div class="t1">${METHOD_FA[m] || m}</div>
      <div class="t2">${faNum(by[m].count)} تراکنش</div></div>
      <div class="side"><div class="t1">${faNum(by[m].sum)}</div></div></div>`).join("")}</div>`);
  }
  return parts.join("");
}

function soonView(title) {
  return `<div class="h2">${title}</div>
  <div class="card g"><div class="empty">
    ${svg("i-bolt")}
    <div class="t1">این بخش در به‌روزرسانی بعدی مینی‌اپ می‌آید</div>
    <div class="t2">همهٔ کارها فعلاً از بات بله انجام می‌شود</div>
  </div></div>`;
}

function errorView() {
  const msg = ERR_FA[state.error] || "خطا در ورود — دوباره تلاش کنید";
  return `<div class="splash"><div class="card g" style="max-width:340px;text-align:center">
    <div style="color:var(--danger);margin-bottom:6px">${svg("i-x", "ic")}</div>
    <div class="t1" style="font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:4px">${msg}</div>
    <div class="t2" style="margin-bottom:12px">کد: ${state.error}</div>
    <button class="btn pri wide" id="retry">تلاش دوباره</button>
  </div></div>`;
}

function render() {
  const app = document.getElementById("app");
  if (state.error) {
    app.innerHTML = errorView();
    document.getElementById("retry").onclick = () => location.reload();
    return;
  }
  const views = {
    home: homeView,
    events: () => soonView("برنامه‌ها"),
    pay: () => soonView("پرداخت"),
    support: () => soonView("پشتیبانی"),
    more: () => soonView("بیشتر"),
  };
  app.innerHTML = `${head()}<main id="view">${(views[state.tab] || homeView)()}</main>${tabs()}`;
  app.querySelectorAll("[data-tab]").forEach((btn) => {
    btn.onclick = () => {
      state.tab = btn.dataset.tab;
      render();
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    };
  });
}

boot();

import json, time
import pytest
from nora.channels.bale.webapp import InitDataError, sign_init_data, validate_init_data
TOKEN = "123456:TEST-TOKEN"
def _params(uid=42, name="مدیر", auth_date=None, start=""):
    user = {"id": uid, "first_name": name}
    p = {"user": json.dumps(user, ensure_ascii=False), "auth_date": str(int(auth_date or time.time()))}
    if start: p["tgWebAppStartParam"] = start
    return p
test_ok: raw = sign_init_data(_params(), TOKEN); info = validate_init_data(raw, TOKEN, time.time()); assert info["user"]["id"]==42
test_bad_token: validate with a different token → InitDataError bad_hash
test_tamper: sign it, then replace name in the raw → bad_hash
test_expired: auth_date is old → expired
test_missing_hash → missing_hash
test_start_param passes through
test_bad_user: signed without the user key → bad_user
Note: json.dumps of user containing Persian characters — what about url encoding? sign_init_data concatenates raw values without URL-encoding. parse_qsl decodes %xx and + → if the value contains & or = or + or %, the round-trip will break. The user JSON contains {"id": 42...} — characters: { } " : , spaces. parse_qsl with keep_blank_values: spaces are OK, but + in the value would become a space! JSON has no +. & would cause splitting — JSON has no &. = would break k=v parsing — JSON's ":" is no problem, no =. However for actual Bale initData: the values are URL-encoded on the client side, and parse_qsl decodes them. My sign_init_data doesn't encode — for tests with Persian first_name, the raw utf-8 characters pass through parse_qsl fine (since there are no special characters). To make it more realistic: use quote in sign? Keep it simple, but use ensure_ascii=True in the tests (JSON escapes to \uXXXX — includes backslash and u… no URL special characters). Actually \u0645 has backslash+u — parse_qsl doesn't care. OK.

But in production, actual initData comes URL-encoded from Bale (user=%7B%22id%22...). parse_qsl decodes → matches my verification (Bale calculates the hash against the decoded values). Correct per the Telegram protocol: data_check_string uses decoded values. ✓.

Clock: validate uses the now parameter that's passed in. ✓

"""اعتبارسنجی initData مینی‌اپ بله — HMAC-SHA256."""

import json
import time

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale.webapp import (InitDataError, sign_init_data,
                                       validate_init_data)

TOKEN = "123456:TEST-TOKEN"


def _params(uid=42, name="Modir", auth_date=None, start=""):
    user = {"id": uid, "first_name": name}
    p = {"user": json.dumps(user),
         "auth_date": str(int(auth_date or time.time()))}
    if start:
        p["tgWebAppStartParam"] = start
    return p


def test_valid_init_data():
    raw = sign_init_data(_params(), TOKEN)
    info = validate_init_data(raw, TOKEN, time.time())
    assert info["user"]["id"] == 42
    assert info["auth_date"] > 0


def test_start_param_passes_through():
    raw = sign_init_data(_params(start="ev12"), TOKEN)
    info = validate_init_data(raw, TOKEN, time.time())
    assert info["start_param"] == "ev12"


def test_wrong_token_rejected():
    raw = sign_init_data(_params(), TOKEN)
    with pytest.raises(InitDataError) as e:
        validate_init_data(raw, "999:OTHER", time.time())
    assert e.value.args[0] == "bad_hash"


def test_tampered_payload_rejected():
    raw = sign_init_data(_params(name="Ali"), TOKEN)
    tampered = raw.replace("Ali", "Bob")
    with pytest.raises(InitDataError) as e:
        validate_init_data(tampered, TOKEN, time.time())
    assert e.value.args[0] == "bad_hash"


def test_expired_rejected():
    old = time.time() - 90000
    raw = sign_init_data(_params(auth_date=old), TOKEN)
    with pytest.raises(InitDataError) as e:
        validate_init_data(raw, TOKEN, time.time())
    assert e.value.args[0] == "expired"


def test_missing_hash_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(InitDataError) as e:
        validate_init_data("user=%7B%22id%22%3A1%7D&auth_date=1",
                           TOKEN, time.time())
    assert e.value.args[0] == "missing_hash"


def test_empty_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(InitDataError):
        validate_init_data("", TOKEN, time.time())


def test_bad_user_json_rejected():
    raw = sign_init_data({"user": "not-json",
                          "auth_date": str(int(time.time()))}, TOKEN)
    with pytest.raises(InitDataError) as e:
        validate_init_data(raw, TOKEN, time.time())
    assert e.value.args[0] == "bad_user"


def test_user_without_int_id_rejected():
    raw = sign_init_data({"user": json.dumps({"id": "42"}),
                          "auth_date": str(int(time.time()))}, TOKEN)
    with pytest.raises(InitDataError):
        validate_init_data(raw, TOKEN, time.time())

async def _client(db, *, env="dev", dev_id=0, token="123:T"):
    settings = Settings(env=env, bot_token=token)
    app = create_app(settings, db, dev_bale_id=dev_id)
    client = TestClient(TestServer(app))
    await client.start_server()

"""دادهٔ نمایشی برای پیش‌نمایش وب — فقط dev، هرگز روی دیتابیس واقعی.

اجرا: python -m web.demo_seed [var/web-preview.db]
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from nora.core.db import Database
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.payments import M_CARD, M_GATEWAY, M_ONSITE, PaymentRepo
from nora.domain.settings import SettingsRepo
from nora.domain.support import SupportRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.profile_service import ProfileService

DAY = 86400.0
NAMES = ["علی رضایی", "نگار موسوی", "سارا محمدی", "رضا کاویانی",
         "مریم رادمهر", "حسین شریفی", "زهرا احمدی", "امیر تهرانی",
         "فاطمه کریمی", "محمد حسینی", "لیلا نوری", "سعید مرادی"]


def seed(db_path: str) -> None:
    db = Database(Path(db_path))
    now = time.time()
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db)
    suprepo = SupportRepo(db)
    profsvc = ProfileService(urepo, SettingsRepo(db))

    owner = urepo.create(12345, first_name="مدیر نورا")
    urepo.update(owner.id, role="owner", status="approved",
                 full_name="مدیر نورا")
    users = []
    for i, name in enumerate(NAMES):
        u = urepo.create(1000 + i, first_name=name.split()[0])
        urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", role="member", full_name=name,
                     phone="0912100%04d" % i)
        users.append(u)

    # برنامه‌های پیش‌رو
    erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه آرامش ذهن", status="published",
                       kind="workshop", start_ts=now + 2 * DAY,
                       loc_type="physical", loc_address="میدان ونک، خیابان ملاصدرا",
                       capacity=30, price=2500000)
    erepo.create_event(title="نشست تخصصی سوگ", status="published",
                       kind="meeting", start_ts=now + 5 * DAY,
                       loc_type="physical", loc_address="مطهری، سالون اندیشه",
                       capacity=50, price=0)
    erepo.create_event(title="وبینار سبک‌زندگی دیجیتال", status="published",
                       kind="webinar", start_ts=now + 9 * DAY,
                       online_link="https://meet.example/abc",
                       capacity=200, price=900000)

    # پرداخت‌های موفق ۳۰ روز اخیر (تفکیک روش‌ها)
    plan = [(M_GATEWAY, 2500000, 3), (M_CARD, 1430000, 2),
            (M_ONSITE, 900000, 1), (M_GATEWAY, 900000, 2)]
    for method, amount, count in plan:
        for j in range(count):
            u = users[(j + count) % len(users)]
            p = payrepo.create(u.id, method, amount)
            payrepo.mark_paid(p.id)
            payrepo.db.execute(
                "UPDATE payments SET paid_ts = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (now - (j + 1) * 3 * DAY, p.id))

    # صف تأیید پرداخت (کارت‌به‌کارت)
    for u in users[:3]:
        payrepo.create(u.id, M_CARD, 2500000)

    # تیکت‌های باز
    suprepo.create(users[0].id, "سوال درباره ثبت‌نام کارگاه", category="ثبت‌نام")
    suprepo.create(users[4].id, "رسید پرداخت را فرستادم", category="مالی",
                   priority=1)
    suprepo.create(users[7].id, "درخواست گواهی", category="گواهی")

    # صف تأیید پروفایل (تغییر نام حساس است)
    profsvc.apply(users[1], full_name="نگار سادات موسوی")
    profsvc.apply(users[5], full_name="حسین شریفی‌راد")

    db.close()

Robust approach: dynamically load the SDK with a timeout in app.js:

js


function loadSDK() {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const s = document.createElement("script");
    s.src = "https://tapi.bale.ai/miniapp.js?3";
    s.onload = () => resolve(true);
    s.onerror = () => resolve(false);
    document.head.appendChild(s);
    setTimeout(() => resolve(false), 3000);
  });
}
Then read window.Bale. This way the app never gets blocked even in preview.

"""Programs on the web panel — list, details, registrations — filtered by role."""
from datetime import datetime
from ..core.jalali import fmt_dt
from ..domain.events import (EVENT_STATUSES, REG_CONFIRMED, REG_PENDING_APPR,
                             REG_PENDING_PAY, REG_WAITLIST, REG_CANCELLED, REG_EXPIRED)
from .permissions import can
PAGE = 20
def _when(ts): return fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)) if ts else ""
def events_list(*, now, erepo):
    out = []
    for ev in erepo.list_events(EVENT_STATUSES, limit=100):
        out.append({
            "id": ev.id, "title": ev.title, "kind": ev.kind,
            "status": ev.status, "start_ts": ev.start_ts,
            "when": _when(ev.start_ts),
            "place": ev.loc_address or ev.online_link or "",
            "capacity": ev.capacity, "taken": erepo.seat_count(ev.id),
            "is_paid": ev.is_paid, "price": ev.price,
        })
    return {"events": out}
Ordering: list_events is ASC by start_ts — finished ones come first. The frontend handles the filter; the default filter is "all". No problem — or should the server sort published first? Keep it raw and let the client sort/filter.

python


def event_detail(*, role, erepo, eid):
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None: return None
    counts = {s: erepo.status_count(eid, s) for s in (REG_CONFIRMED, REG_PENDING_PAY, REG_PENDING_APPR, REG_WAITLIST, REG_CANCELLED)}
    d = {"id": ev.id, "title": ev.title, "desc": ev.desc, "kind": ev.kind,
         "status": ev.status, "when": _when(ev.start_ts), "start_ts": ev.start_ts,
         "place": ..., "capacity": ev.capacity, "taken": seat_count,
         "is_paid": ev.is_paid, "price": ev.price, "counts": counts,
         "reg_end": _when(ev.reg_end_ts), "duration": ev.duration_minutes}
    if can(role, "view_finance"):
        ok, back = erepo.revenue(eid)
        d["income"] = ok; d["refund_pending"] = back
    return d
def event_regs(*, role, erepo, urepo, eid, page=0):
    regs = erepo.event_regs(eid)   # ascending by id, limit 200
    regs = sorted(regs, key=lambda r: r.id, reverse=True)  # newest first
    total = len(regs)
    pages = max(1, (total + PAGE - 1) // PAGE)
    page = max(0, min(page, pages - 1))
    rows = []
    show_money = can(role, "view_finance")
    for r in regs[page*PAGE:(page+1)*PAGE]:
        u = urepo.get(r.user_id)
        rows.append({"id": r.id, "name": (u.full_name or u.first_name) if u else "",
                     "status": r.status,
                     "amount": r.amount_paid if show_money else None,
                     "when": _when(r.created_ts)})
    return {"rows": rows, "page": page, "pages": pages, "total": total}

"""برنامه‌ها در پنل وب — فهرست، جزئیات و ثبت‌نام‌ها.

لایهٔ خدمات: فقط دادهٔ خالص و فیلتر نقش. متن انسانی سمت کلاینت ساخته
می‌شود؛ تاریخ شمسی همین‌جا با fmt_dt آماده می‌شود (منبع یکتا سمت سرور).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from ..core.jalali import fmt_dt
from ..domain.events import (EVENT_STATUSES, REG_CANCELLED, REG_CONFIRMED,
                             REG_PENDING_APPR, REG_PENDING_PAY, REG_WAITLIST)
from .permissions import can

PAGE = 20
REG_STATUSES = (REG_CONFIRMED, REG_PENDING_PAY, REG_PENDING_APPR,
                REG_WAITLIST, REG_CANCELLED)


def _when(ts: float) -> str:
    return fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)) if ts else ""


def events_list(*, erepo) -> dict:
    """همهٔ برنامه‌ها در پنج وضعیت — کلاینت فیلتر/مرتب می‌کند."""
    events = []
    for ev in erepo.list_events(EVENT_STATUSES, limit=100):
        events.append({
            "id": ev.id, "title": ev.title, "kind": ev.kind,
            "status": ev.status, "start_ts": ev.start_ts,
            "when": _when(ev.start_ts),
            "place": (ev.loc_address or ev.online_link or ""),
            "capacity": ev.capacity, "taken": erepo.seat_count(ev.id),
            "is_paid": ev.is_paid, "price": ev.price,
        })
    return {"events": events}


def event_detail(*, role: str, erepo, event_id: int):
    """جزئیات یک برنامه + شمار وضعیت‌ها؛ درآمد فقط با view_finance."""
    ev = erepo.get_event(event_id)
    if ev is None:
        return None
    data = {
        "id": ev.id, "title": ev.title, "desc": ev.desc, "kind": ev.kind,
        "status": ev.status, "start_ts": ev.start_ts,
        "when": _when(ev.start_ts),
        "place": (ev.loc_address or ev.online_link or ""),
        "capacity": ev.capacity, "taken": erepo.seat_count(ev.id),
        "is_paid": ev.is_paid, "price": ev.price,
        "duration": ev.duration_minutes,
        "reg_end": _when(ev.reg_end_ts),
        "counts": {s: erepo.status_count(event_id, s) for s in REG_STATUSES},
    }
    if can(role, "view_finance"):
        ok, back = erepo.revenue(event_id)
        data["income"] = ok
        data["refund_pending"] = back
    return data


def event_regs(*, role: str, erepo, urepo, event_id: int,
               page: int = 0) -> dict:
    """ثبت‌نام‌ها صفحه‌بندی‌شده، تازه‌ترین اول؛ مبلغ فقط با view_finance."""
    regs = sorted(erepo.event_regs(event_id), key=lambda r: r.id,
                  reverse=True)
    total = len(regs)
    pages = max(1, (total + PAGE - 1) // PAGE)
    page = max(0, min(int(page or 0), pages - 1))
    money = can(role, "view_finance")
    rows = []
    for r in regs[page * PAGE:(page + 1) * PAGE]:
        u = urepo.get(r.user_id)
        rows.append({
            "id": r.id,
            "name": ((u.full_name or u.first_name) if u else ""),
            "status": r.status,
            "amount": r.amount_paid if money else None,
            "when": _when(r.created_ts),
        })
    return {"rows": rows, "page": page, "pages": pages, "total": total}

js


async function loadEvents() {
  const d = await api("/api/events");
  state.events = d.events;
}
async function openEvent(id) {
  state.evId = id;
  const [d, r] = await Promise.all([api(`/api/events/${id}`), api(`/api/events/${id}/regs?page=0`)]);
  state.evDetail = d.event; state.evRegs = r.regs;
  if (BP && BP.BackButton) { try { BP.BackButton.show(); } catch(e){} }
  render();
}
function closeEvent() {
  state.evId = null; state.evDetail = null; state.evRegs = null;
  if (BP && BP.BackButton) { try { BP.BackButton.hide(); } catch(e){} }
  render();
}
async function loadMoreRegs() {
  if (!state.evRegs || state.evRegs.page + 1 >= state.evRegs.pages) return;
  const r = await api(`/api/events/${state.evId}/regs?page=${state.evRegs.page + 1}`);
  state.evRegs = { ...r.regs, rows: state.evRegs.rows.concat(r.regs.rows) };
  render();
}

"""برنامه‌ها در پنل وب — سرویس و API."""
from __future__ import annotations
import pytest
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.web_events import event_detail, event_regs, events_list
from web.server import create_app
def _seed(db, fake_clock):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    now = fake_clock.ts()
    u1 = urepo.create(201, first_name="علی")
    urepo.update(u1.id, full_name="علی رضایی", status="approved")
    u2 = urepo.create(202, first_name="نگار")
    e_pub = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه", status="published", kind="workshop",
                               start_ts=now + 86400, capacity=30, is_paid=1, price=1500)
    e_fin = erepo.create_event(title="همایش", status="finished", start_ts=now - 86400)
    e_dr = erepo.create_event(title="پیش‌نویس", status="draft", start_ts=now + 3 * 86400)
    def reg(eid, uid, status, amount=0):
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO registrations (event_id, user_id, status, amount_paid, created_ts, updated_ts) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", (eid, uid, status, amount, now, now))

"""برنامه‌ها در پنل وب — سرویس نقش‌محور + API سرور."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer

from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.web_events import event_detail, event_regs, events_list
from web.server import create_app


def _reg(db, eid, uid, status, amount=0, now=0.0):
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO registrations (event_id, user_id, status, amount_paid, "
        "created_ts, updated_ts) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (eid, uid, status, amount, now, now))
    db.commit()


def _seed(db, fake_clock):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    now = fake_clock.ts()
    u1 = urepo.create(201, first_name="علی")
    urepo.update(u1.id, full_name="علی رضایی", status="approved")
    u2 = urepo.create(202, first_name="نگار")
    u3 = urepo.create(203, first_name="سارا")
    e_pub = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه آرامش ذهن", status="published",
                               kind="workshop", start_ts=now + 86400,
                               capacity=30, is_paid=1, price=1500)
    e_fin = erepo.create_event(title="همایش پاییزی", status="finished",
                               start_ts=now - 86400)
    e_dr = erepo.create_event(title="پیش‌نویس", status="draft",
                              start_ts=now + 3 * 86400)
    _reg(db, e_pub.id, u1.id, "confirmed", 1500, now)
    _reg(db, e_pub.id, u2.id, "pending_pay", 0, now)
    _reg(db, e_pub.id, u3.id, "waitlist", 0, now)
    _reg(db, e_fin.id, u1.id, "confirmed", 0, now)
    return urepo, erepo, u1, e_pub, e_fin, e_dr


# ---------- سرویس ----------

def test_events_list_all_statuses(db, fake_clock):
    urepo, erepo, u1, e_pub, e_fin, e_dr = _seed(db, fake_clock)
    d = events_list(erepo=erepo)
    assert len(d["events"]) == 3
    pub = next(e for e in d["events"] if e["id"] == e_pub.id)
    assert pub["taken"] == 2          # confirmed + pending_pay؛ waitlist نه
    assert pub["capacity"] == 30
    assert pub["when"]                # تاریخ شمسی سمت سرور
    assert pub["price"] == 1500


def test_detail_owner_vs_organizer(db, fake_clock):
    urepo, erepo, u1, e_pub, e_fin, e_dr = _seed(db, fake_clock)
    own = event_detail(role="owner", erepo=erepo, event_id=e_pub.id)
    assert own["counts"]["confirmed"] == 1
    assert own["counts"]["pending_pay"] == 1
    assert own["counts"]["waitlist"] == 1
    assert own["income"] == 1500
    org = event_detail(role="organizer", erepo=erepo, event_id=e_pub.id)
    assert "income" not in org        # مالی برای برگزارکننده نیست
    assert org["counts"] == own["counts"]


def test_detail_missing_event(db, fake_clock):
    urepo, erepo, u1, e_pub, e_fin, e_dr = _seed(db, fake_clock)
    assert event_detail(role="owner", erepo=erepo, event_id=9999) is None


def test_regs_paging_newest_first(db, fake_clock):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    now = fake_clock.ts()
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="شلوغ", status="published",
                            start_ts=now + 86400)
    for i in range(25):
        u = urepo.create(500 + i, first_name=f"کاربر{i}")
        _reg(db, ev.id, u.id, "confirmed", 1000, now + i)
    d = event_regs(role="owner", erepo=erepo, urepo=urepo, event_id=ev.id)
    assert d["total"] == 25 and d["pages"] == 2
    assert len(d["rows"]) == 20
    assert d["rows"][0]["name"] == "کاربر۲۴".replace("۲۴", "24")
    assert d["rows"][0]["amount"] == 1000
    p2 = event_regs(role="owner", erepo=erepo, urepo=urepo, event_id=ev.id,
                    page=1)
    assert len(p2["rows"]) == 5


def test_regs_money_hidden_for_organizer(db, fake_clock):
    urepo, erepo, u1, e_pub, e_fin, e_dr = _seed(db, fake_clock)
    d = event_regs(role="organizer", erepo=erepo, urepo=urepo,
                   event_id=e_pub.id)
    assert all(r["amount"] is None for r in d["rows"])


# ---------- سرور ----------

async def _client(db, *, dev_id=999, env="dev"):
    settings = Settings(env=env, bot_token="123:T")
    app = create_app(settings, db, dev_bale_id=dev_id)
    client = TestClient(TestServer(app))
    await client.start_server()
    r = await client.post("/api/auth", json={"dev": True})
    tok = (await r.json())["token"]
    return client, {"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok}


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_server_events_flow(db, fake_clock):
    urepo, erepo, u1, e_pub, e_fin, e_dr = _seed(db, fake_clock)
    urepo.create(999, first_name="مدیر")
    urepo.update(urepo.get_by_bale(999).id, role="owner")
    client, hdr = await _client(db)
    r = await client.get("/api/events", headers=hdr)
    assert r.status == 200
    assert len((await r.json())["events"]) == 3
    r = await client.get(f"/api/events/{e_pub.id}", headers=hdr)
    assert r.status == 200
    assert (await r.json())["event"]["income"] == 1500
    r = await client.get(f"/api/events/{e_pub.id}/regs?page=0", headers=hdr)
    assert r.status == 200
    assert (await r.json())["regs"]["total"] == 3
    r = await client.get("/api/events/999999", headers=hdr)
    assert r.status == 404
    await client.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_treasurer_blocked_from_events(db, fake_clock):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    u = urepo.create(999, first_name="خزانه")
    urepo.update(u.id, role="treasurer")
    client, hdr = await _client(db)
    r = await client.get("/api/events", headers=hdr)
    assert r.status == 403
    assert (await r.json())["error"] == "no_perm"
    await client.close()

"""Finance on the web panel — hub, approval queue, approve/reject.
Approve/reject is an exact mirror of the bot's `on_approve`: same PayService.mark_manual,
same per-target notifications — so both channels behave identically.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from ..core.jalali import ago_fa
from .permissions import can
def finance_ok(role: str) -> bool:
    return can(role, "view_finance")
def hub(*, psvc, payrepo, now: float, days: int = 30) -> dict:
    since = 0.0 if days <= 0 else now - days * 86400.0
    summary = psvc.finance(since)
    return {"days": days, "waiting": len(payrepo.waiting_approval()),
            "summary": {"count": summary["count"], "total": summary["total"],
                        "refund": summary["refund"],
                        "per": {m: {"count": v[0], "sum": v[1]}
                                for m, v in summary["per"].items()}}}
def queue_rows(*, payrepo, urepo, erepo, now: float) -> list:
    rows = []
    for pay in payrepo.waiting_approval():
        user = urepo.get(pay.user_id)
        ev = erepo.get_event(pay.target_id)
        rows.append({
            "id": pay.id,
            "name": (user.full_name or user.first_name) if user else "",
            "title": ev.title if ev else "",
            "target": pay.target_kind,
            "method": pay.method,
            "amount": payrepo.total_of(pay),
            "ago": ago_fa(pay.created_ts, now),
            "has_receipt": bool(pay.receipt_file),
        })
    return rows
def decide(*, psvc, payrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, cfg, notify,
           pay_id: int, ok: bool) -> str:
    """Result codes: paid | dup | rejected | missing — mirror of bot on_approve."""
    pay = payrepo.get(pay_id)
    if pay is None:
        return "missing"
    if pay.status == "paid":
        return "dup"
    if ok:
        res = psvc.mark_manual(pay_id)
        notify(pay, res)
        return "paid"
    payrepo.set_status(pay_id, "open")
    user = urepo.get(pay.user_id)
    if user is not None:
        responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "pay_rejected")
    return "rejected"

from nora.channels.bale.screens.pay import (notify_paid, _notify_archive, _notify_cert, _notify_finance)
def _make_notify(psvc, payrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, settings):
    def notify(pay, res):
        if pay.target_kind == "archive":
            _notify_archive(psvc, payrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, pay)
        elif pay.target_kind == "cert":
            _notify_cert(psvc, payrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, settings, pay)
        elif res.reg is not None:
            notify_paid(psvc, payrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, res.reg, pay)
        else:
            _notify_finance(psvc, urepo, responder, pay, settings)
    return notify

PYTHON
"""مالی در پنل وب — هاب، صف تأیید و تصمیم.

تصمیم (تأیید/رد) آینهٔ دقیق `on_approve` در بات است: همان
`PayService.mark_manual` و همان صف وضعیت‌ها. شاخهٔ اطلاع‌رسانی per هدف
را لایهٔ ارائه (وب/بات) می‌سازد و به `decide` تزریق می‌کند تا این ماژول
به کانال‌ها وابسته نشود.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..core.jalali import ago_fa

DAY = 86400.0


def hub(*, psvc, payrepo, now: float, days: int = 30) -> dict:
    """خلاصهٔ مالی یک دوره + شمار صف تأیید — از psvc.finance (منبع یکتا)."""
    since = 0.0 if days <= 0 else now - days * DAY
    summary = psvc.finance(since)
    return {
        "days": days,
        "waiting": len(payrepo.waiting_approval()),
        "summary": {
            "count": summary["count"],
            "total": summary["total"],
            "refund": summary["refund"],
            "per": {m: {"count": v[0], "sum": v[1]}
                    for m, v in summary["per"].items()},
        },
    }


def queue_rows(*, payrepo, urepo, erepo, now: float) -> list:
    """صف تأیید پرداخت — غنی‌تر از صف بات: عنوان هدف و زمان نسبی هم دارد."""
    rows = []
    for pay in payrepo.waiting_approval():
        user = urepo.get(pay.user_id)
        ev = erepo.get_event(pay.target_id)
        rows.append({
            "id": pay.id,
            "name": ((user.full_name or user.first_name) if user else ""),
            "title": (ev.title if ev else ""),
            "target": pay.target_kind,
            "method": pay.method,
            "amount": payrepo.total_of(pay),
            "ago": ago_fa(pay.created_ts, now),
            "has_receipt": bool(pay.receipt_file),
        })
    return rows


def decide(*, psvc, payrepo, urepo, responder, notify, pay_id: int,
           ok: bool) -> str:
    """تصمیم روی یک پرداخت صف.

    کدها: paid | dup | rejected | missing — همان ترتیب on_approve بات:
    تأیید = mark_manual + اطلاع‌رسانی per هدف؛ رد = بازگشت به open +
    پیام pay_rejected به کاربر.
    """
    pay = payrepo.get(pay_id)
    if pay is None:
        return "missing"
    if pay.status == "paid":
        return "dup"
    if ok:
        res = psvc.mark_manual(pay_id)
        notify(pay, res)
        return "paid"
    payrepo.set_status(pay_id, "open")
    user = urepo.get(pay.user_id)
    if user is not None and responder is not None:
        responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "pay_rejected")
    return "rejected"

                            start_ts=now + 86400, capacity=10, is_paid=1,

"""مالی وب — صف تأیید، تصمیم با آینهٔ بات، رسید، گیت دسترسی."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer

from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.payments import M_CARD, PAY_WAIT, PaymentRepo
from nora.domain.settings import SettingsRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.event_service import EventService
from web.server import create_app


class FakeResponder:
    """همان قرارداد responder بات — کلیدها را ضبط می‌کند."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.sent = []

    @property
    def keys(self):
        return [item[2] for item in self.sent if item[0] == "bulk"]

    def bulk(self, chat_id, key, markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("bulk", chat_id, key))

    def bulk_raw(self, chat_id, text, markup=None):
        self.sent.append(("raw", chat_id, text))

    def send_photo_file(self, chat_id, path, key="", **kw):
        self.sent.append(("photo_file", chat_id, path))
        return False            # بدون transport → فراallback متنی

    def send_photo(self, chat_id, file_id, key="", markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("photo", chat_id, file_id))

    def send_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        return False

    def bulk_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        return False


def _scene(db, fake_clock):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db, fake_clock)
    now = fake_clock.ts()
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه آرامش ذهن", status="published",
                            kind="workshop", start_ts=now + 86400,
                            capacity=10, is_paid=1, price=1500,
                            require_profile=0)
    u = urepo.create(301, first_name="علی")
    urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", role="member")
    esvc = EventService(erepo, fake_clock)
    res = esvc.register(u, ev)
    assert res.kind == "pending_pay" and res.reg is not None
    pay = payrepo.create(u.id, M_CARD, 1500, reg_id=res.reg.id,
                         target_kind="event", target_id=ev.id)
    payrepo.set_receipt(pay.id, "FILE-1", PAY_WAIT)
    SettingsRepo(db)
    return urepo, erepo, payrepo, u, ev, pay, res.reg


async def _client(db, fake_clock, *, responder=None, downloader=None,
                  role="owner"):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="مدیر")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role=role, status="approved")
    settings = Settings(env="dev", bot_token="123:T", admin_ids=(999,))
    app = create_app(settings, db, dev_bale_id=999, responder=responder,
                     downloader=downloader, clock=fake_clock)
    client = TestClient(TestServer(app))
    await client.start_server()
    r = await client.post("/api/auth", json={"dev": True})
    tok = (await r.json())["token"]
    return client, {"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok}


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_queue_and_hub(db, fake_clock):
    urepo, erepo, payrepo, u, ev, pay, reg = _scene(db, fake_clock)
    client, hdr = await _client(db, fake_clock, responder=FakeResponder())
    q = (await (await client.get("/api/finance/queue", headers=hdr)).json())["queue"]
    assert len(q) == 1
    row = q[0]
    assert row["name"] == "علی" and row["title"] == "کارگاه آرامش ذهن"
    assert row["method"] == "card" and row["amount"] == 1500
    assert row["has_receipt"] is True and row["target"] == "event"
    assert row["ago"]                              # «لحظاتی پیش» و مانند آن
    h = (await (await client.get("/api/finance/hub?days=30",
                                 headers=hdr)).json())["hub"]
    assert h["waiting"] == 1
    assert h["summary"]["total"] == 0              # هنوز تأیید نشده
    await client.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_approve_parity_with_bot(db, fake_clock):
    urepo, erepo, payrepo, u, ev, pay, reg = _scene(db, fake_clock)
    fake = FakeResponder()
    client, hdr = await _client(db, fake_clock, responder=fake)
    r = await client.post(f"/api/finance/queue/{pay.id}/decide",
                          headers=hdr, json={"ok": True})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "paid"
    assert payrepo.get(pay.id).status == "paid"
    fresh = erepo.get_reg(reg.id)
    assert fresh.status == "confirmed" and fresh.ticket_code
    # آینهٔ بات: تلاش بلیت + fallback متنی ev_reg_ok
    assert "photo_file" in [item[0] for item in fake.sent] or \
        "ev_reg_ok" in fake.keys
    h = (await (await client.get("/api/finance/hub?days=30",
                                 headers=hdr)).json())["hub"]
    assert h["waiting"] == 0
    assert h["summary"]["total"] == 1500 and h["summary"]["count"] == 1
    assert h["summary"]["per"]["card"] == {"count": 1, "sum": 1500}
    await client.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_reject_returns_to_open_and_tells_user(db, fake_clock):
    urepo, erepo, payrepo, u, ev, pay, reg = _scene(db, fake_clock)
    fake = FakeResponder()
    client, hdr = await _client(db, fake_clock, responder=fake)
    r = await client.post(f"/api/finance/queue/{pay.id}/decide",
                          headers=hdr, json={"ok": False})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "rejected"
    assert payrepo.get(pay.id).status == "open"
    assert "pay_rejected" in fake.keys
    await client.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_decide_dup_and_missing(db, fake_clock):
    urepo, erepo, payrepo, u, ev, pay, reg = _scene(db, fake_clock)
    fake = FakeResponder()
    client, hdr = await _client(db, fake_clock, responder=fake)
    await client.post(f"/api/finance/queue/{pay.id}/decide",
                      headers=hdr, json={"ok": True})
    r = await client.post(f"/api/finance/queue/{pay.id}/decide",
                          headers=hdr, json={"ok": True})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "dup"
    r = await client.post("/api/finance/queue/99999/decide",
                          headers=hdr, json={"ok": True})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "missing"
    await client.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_organizer_blocked(db, fake_clock):
    urepo, erepo, payrepo, u, ev, pay, reg = _scene(db, fake_clock)
    client, hdr = await _client(db, fake_clock, responder=FakeResponder(),
                                role="organizer")
    assert (await client.get("/api/finance/hub", headers=hdr)).status == 403
    assert (await client.get("/api/finance/queue", headers=hdr)).status == 403
    r = await client.post(f"/api/finance/queue/{pay.id}/decide",
                          headers=hdr, json={"ok": True})
    assert r.status == 403
    await client.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_receipt_proxy(db, fake_clock):
    urepo, erepo, payrepo, u, ev, pay, reg = _scene(db, fake_clock)
    fake = FakeResponder()
    client, hdr = await _client(db, fake_clock, responder=fake,
                                downloader=lambda fid: b"JPEGDATA")
    r = await client.get(f"/api/finance/queue/{pay.id}/receipt", headers=hdr)
    assert r.status == 200
    assert await r.read() == b"JPEGDATA"
    assert r.headers["Content-Type"].startswith("image/jpeg")
    r = await client.get("/api/finance/queue/99999/receipt", headers=hdr)
    assert r.status == 404
    await client.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_receipt_without_transport(db, fake_clock):
    urepo, erepo, payrepo, u, ev, pay, reg = _scene(db, fake_clock)
    client, hdr = await _client(db, fake_clock, responder=FakeResponder())
    r = await client.get(f"/api/finance/queue/{pay.id}/receipt", headers=hdr)
    assert r.status == 404
    assert (await r.json())["error"] == "no_transport"
    await client.close()

def refund_rows(frepo, erepo, urepo, limit: int = 20) -> dict:
    rows_db = frepo.db.query(
        "SELECT id FROM registrations WHERE refund_due = 1 "
        "ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,))
    queue = []
    for r in rows_db:
        reg = erepo.get_reg(int(r["id"]))
        if reg is None:
            continue
        u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
        ev = erepo.get_event(reg.event_id)
        queue.append({
            "reg_id": reg.id,
            "name": ((u.full_name or u.first_name) if u else "") or "—",
            "title": (ev.title if ev else "") or "—",
            "amount": int(reg.amount_paid or 0),
        })
    hist = []
    for rf in frepo.refunds("done")[:5]:
        u = urepo.get(rf.user_id)
        hist.append({
            "name": ((u.full_name or u.first_name) if u else "") or "—",
            "amount": int(rf.amount),
            "reason": str(rf.reason or ""),
            "done": ago_fa(rf.done_ts) if rf.done_ts else "",
        })
    return {"queue": queue, "history": hist}
"—" is U+2014, which is not in the Persian block. text_audit only scans channels. OK.

def refund_decide(frepo, erepo, urepo, responder, reg_id: int, ok: bool) -> str:
    reg = erepo.get_reg(int(reg_id))
    if ok:
        if reg is None or not reg.refund_due:
            return "none"
        u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
        ev = erepo.get_event(reg.event_id)
        frepo.add_refund(reg.user_id, reg.amount_paid, reason="cancel",
                         reg_id=reg.id, status=RF_DONE)
        with frepo.db.transaction():
            frepo.db.execute(
                "UPDATE registrations SET refund_due = 0 WHERE id = ?",
                (reg.id,))
        if responder is not None and u is not None:
            responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "refund_done",
                           amount=money_label(reg.amount_paid),
                           title=(ev.title if ev else "—"))
        return "done"
    if reg is None:
        return "none"
    with frepo.db.transaction():
        frepo.db.execute(
            "UPDATE registrations SET refund_due = 0 WHERE id = ?", (reg.id,))
    return "rejected"
Wait — the bot's reject doesn't check for reg being None (it just executes the UPDATE). Reflecting that while adding a None guard for the response = harmless improvement. Keep the guard.

def cards_view(frepo) -> dict:

def card_action(frepo, card_id: int, act: str) -> str:
    c = frepo.card(int(card_id))
    if c is None:
        return "none"
    if act == "default":
        frepo.set_default_card(c.id)
        return "default"
    if act == "toggle":
        frepo.toggle_card(c.id)
        return "toggled"
    if act == "remove":
        frepo.remove_card(c.id)
        return "removed"
    return "bad"
python


def discounts_view(payrepo) -> dict:
    rows = payrepo.db.query(
        "SELECT id, code, kind, value, uses_max, uses, expires_ts, cap_amount FROM discount_codes ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30")
    now = payrepo.clock.ts() if payrepo.clock else 0.0
    out = []
    for c in rows:
        exp = float(c["expires_ts"] or 0)
        out.append({
            "id": int(c["id"]), "code": str(c["code"]), "kind": str(c["kind"]),
            "value": int(c["value"]), "uses": int(c["uses"]),
            "uses_max": int(c["uses_max"]), "cap": int(c["cap_amount"] or 0),
            "expires": fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(exp, tz=TEHRAN)) if exp else "",
            "expired": bool(exp and exp < now),
        })
    return {"codes": out}

def report(frepo, payrepo, clock, days: int = 30) -> dict:
    cur, prev = fin.compare(frepo, payrepo, clock, days=days)
    pct = None
    if prev["total"]:
        pct = (cur["total"] - prev["total"]) * 100 // prev["total"]
    return {"days": days, "cur": cur, "prev_total": prev["total"], "pct": pct}
The cur dictionary is all ints — JSON safe ✓.

def refund_rows(*, frepo, erepo, urepo, limit: int = 20) -> dict:
    """Refund queue (registration with refund_due) + recent history — mirror of bot's on_refunds."""
    queue = []
    for r in frepo.db.query(
            "SELECT id FROM registrations WHERE refund_due = 1 "
            "ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)):
        reg = erepo.get_reg(int(r["id"]))
        if reg is None:
            continue
        u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
        ev = erepo.get_event(reg.event_id)
        queue.append({
            "reg_id": reg.id,
            "name": ((u.full_name or u.first_name) if u else ""),
            "title": (ev.title if ev else ""),
            "amount": int(reg.amount_paid or 0),

def refund_decide(*, frepo, erepo, urepo, responder, reg_id: int,
                  ok: bool) -> str:
    """done | rejected | none — mirror of bot's finrd/finrr."""
    reg = erepo.get_reg(reg_id)
    if reg is None:
        return "none"
    if ok:
        if not reg.refund_due:
            return "none"
        u = urepo.get(reg.user_id)
        ev = erepo.get_event(reg.event_id)
        frepo.add_refund(reg.user_id, reg.amount_paid, reason="cancel",
                         reg_id=reg.id, status=RF_DONE)
        _clear_due(frepo, reg.id)
        if responder is not None and u is not None:
            responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "refund_done",
                           amount=money_label(reg.amount_paid),
                           title=(ev.title if ev else ""))
        return "done"
    _clear_due(frepo, reg.id)
    return "rejected"
def _clear_due(frepo, reg_id: int) -> None:

def discounts_view(*, payrepo) -> dict:
    now = payrepo.clock.ts() if payrepo.clock else 0.0
    codes = []
    for c in payrepo.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM discount_codes ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30"):
        exp = float(c["expires_ts"] or 0)
        codes.append({
            "id": int(c["id"]), "code": str(c["code"]),
            "kind": str(c["kind"]), "value": int(c["value"]),
            "uses": int(c["uses"]), "uses_max": int(c["uses_max"]),
            "cap": int(c["cap_amount"] or 0),
            "expires": (fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(exp, tz=TEHRAN))
                        if exp else ""),
            "expired": bool(exp and now > exp),
        })
    return {"codes": codes}
def discount_add(*, payrepo, code: str, kind: str, value: int,
                 uses_max: int = 0, days: int = 0) -> str:
    """created | bad — same as bot's creation wizard: add_code."""
    code = str(code or "").strip().upper()
    kind = "pct" if kind == "pct" else "fix"
    value = int(value or 0)
    if not code or value <= 0 or (kind == "pct" and value > 100):
        return "bad"
    if payrepo.get_code(code) is not None:
        return "dup"
    now = payrepo.clock.ts() if payrepo.clock else 0.0
    exp = now + int(days) * DAY if days > 0 else 0.0
    try:
        payrepo.add_code(code, kind, value, uses_max=max(0, int(uses_max)),
                         expires_ts=exp)
    except Exception:  # simultaneous INSERT / constraint
        return "dup"
    return "created"

def report(*, frepo, payrepo, clock, days: int = 30) -> dict:
    cur, prev = fin_svc.compare(frepo, payrepo, clock, days=days)
    pct = None
    if prev["total"]:
        pct = (cur["total"] - prev["total"]) * 100 // prev["total"]
    disc = sum(v["discount"] for v in cur["by_method"].values())
    return {"days": days, "pct": pct, "discount": disc,
            "prev_total": prev["total"], "cur": cur}

async def _set_user(request: web.Request):
    """Financial settings — admin/owner only (manage_settings), mirroring the bot's _fins."""
    user = await _authed(request)
    if user is None:
        return None, _err(401, "no_session")
    if not can(user.role, "manage_settings"):
        return None, _err(403, "no_perm")
    return user, None
def _int_of(request: web.Request, key: str) -> int:
    try:
        return int(request.match_info[key])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0
async def h_fin_refunds(request):
    user, err = await _fin_user(request)
    if err is not None:
        return err
    data = fin_ref_rows(frepo=request.app[K_FREPO],
                        erepo=request.app[K_EREPO],
                        urepo=request.app[K_UREPO])
    return _json({"ok": True, "data": data})
async def h_fin_refund_decide(request):
    user, err = await _fin_user(request)
    if err is not None:
        return err
    try:
        body = await request.json()
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
        return _err(400, "bad_body")
    ok = bool(body.get("ok")) if isinstance(body, dict) else False
    result = fin_ref_decide(frepo=request.app[K_FREPO],
                            erepo=request.app[K_EREPO],
                            urepo=request.app[K_UREPO],
                            responder=request.app[K_RESP],
                            reg_id=_int_of(request, "rid"), ok=ok)
    outbox = request.app[K_OUTBOX]
    if outbox is not None:
        await asyncio.to_thread(outbox.drain, time.sleep)
    return _json({"ok": True, "result": result})
async def h_fin_cards(request):
    user, err = await _set_user(request)
    if err is not None:
        return err
    return _json({"ok": True, "data": fin_cards_view(frepo=request.app[K_FREPO])})
async def h_fin_card_action(request):
    user, err = await _set_user(request)
    if err is not None:
        return err
    try:
        body = await request.json()
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
        return _err(400, "bad_body")
    act = str(body.get("act", "")) if isinstance(body, dict) else ""
    result = fin_card_act(frepo=request.app[K_FREPO],
                          card_id=_int_of(request, "cid"), act=act)
    return _json({"ok": True, "result": result})

    if err is not None:
        return err
    return _json({"ok": True, "data": fin_disc_view(payrepo=request.app[K_PAYREPO])})
async def h_fin_discount_add(request):
    user, err = await _set_user(request)
    if err is not None:
        return err
    try:
        body = await request.json()
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
        return _err(400, "bad_body")
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        return _err(400, "bad_body")
    result = fin_disc_add(payrepo=request.app[K_PAYREPO],
                          code=str(body.get("code", "")),
                          kind=str(body.get("kind", "pct")),
                          value=int(body.get("value", 0) or 0),
                          uses_max=int(body.get("uses_max", 0) or 0),
                          days=int(body.get("days", 0) or 0))
    if result == "bad":
        return _err(400, "bad_code")
    return _json({"ok": True, "result": result})
async def h_fin_report(request):
    user, err = await _fin_user(request)
    if err is not None:
        return err
    raw = request.query.get("days", "30")
    days = int(raw) if raw.isdigit() and int(raw) in (7, 30, 90) else 30
    data = fin_report(frepo=request.app[K_FREPO],
                      payrepo=request.app[K_PAYREPO],
                      clock=get_clock(), days=days)
    return _json({"ok": True, "report": data})
async def h_fin_excel(request):
    user = await _authed(request)
    if user is None:
        return _err(401, "no_session")
    if not can(user.role, "export_excel"):
        return _err(403, "no_perm")
    dest = await asyncio.to_thread(
        import_export.export_finance,
        request.app[K_FREPO], request.app[K_PAYREPO])
    if dest is None:
        return _err(500, "export_failed")
    return web.FileResponse(
        dest, headers={"Content-Disposition":
                       f'attachment; filename="{Path(dest).name}"'})

function finOpen(v) {
  state.fin.view = v;
  if (BP && BP.BackButton) { try { BP.BackButton.show(); } catch (e) {} }
  if (v === "queue") { render(); window.scrollTo(0,0); return; }
  if (!state.fin[v]) {
    loadFinSub(v).then(() => render()).catch((e) => { state.error = e.message; render(); });
  }
  render();
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}
async function loadFinSub(v) {
  if (v === "refunds") state.fin.refunds = (await api("/api/finance/refunds")).data;
  else if (v === "cards") state.fin.cards = (await api("/api/finance/cards")).data;
  else if (v === "discounts") state.fin.discounts = (await api("/api/finance/discounts")).data;
  else if (v === "report") state.fin.report = (await api(`/api/finance/report?days=${state.fin.repDays}`)).report;
}

function cardNum(n) {
  const d = String(n || "").replace(/\D/g, "");
  return d.replace(/(\d{4})(?=\d)/g, "$1 ").replace(/\d/g, (x) => FA_DIGITS[+x]);
}
function finCardsView() {
  const d = state.fin.cards;
  if (!d) return loadingCard();
  const cards = (d.cards || []).map((c) => {
    const del = state.fin.confirmKey === "c" + c.id;
    const logo = c.bank ? `<img class="banklogo" src="/assets/banks/${c.bank}.png" alt="" onerror="this.remove()">` : "";
    return `<div class="cardart ${c.active ? "" : "off"}">
      <div class="catop">${logo}<span class="catitle">${c.bank_fa || "کارت بانکی"}</span>
        ${c.default ? `<span class="chip gold">پیش‌فرض</span>` : ""}
        ${!c.active ? `<span class="chip">غیرفعال</span>` : ""}</div>
      <div class="cnum">${cardNum(c.number)}</div>
      <div class="cfoot"><span>${c.holder || ""}</span>${c.label ? `<span class="t2">${c.label}</span>` : ""}</div>
      ${c.sheba ? `<div class="cfoot"><span class="t2">شبا: ${cardNum(c.sheba)}</span></div>` : ""}
      <div class="btnrow">
        ${c.default ? "" : `<span class="btn" data-cdef="${c.id}">پیش‌فرض</span>`}
        <span class="btn" data-ctog="${c.id}">${c.active ? "غیرفعال" : "فعال"}</span>
        <span class="btn dan" data-crm="${c.id}">${del ? "مطمئنی؟" : "حذف"}</span>
      </div></div>`;
  }).join("");
  const gws = (d.gateways || []).map((g) => `<div class="row">
      <div class="av info">${svg("i-wallet")}</div>
      <div class="main"><div class="t1">${g.title || PROVIDER_FA[g.provider] || g.provider}</div>
        <div class="t2">${PROVIDER_FA[g.provider] || g.provider} · ${VERIFY_FA[g.verify] || g.verify}</div></div>
      <span class="chip ${g.active ? "acc" : ""}">${g.active ? "فعال" : "خاموش"}</span></div>`).join("");
  return `<span class="backbtn" id="finback">${svg("i-back")}مالی</span>
  <div class="h2">کارت‌ها و درگاه‌ها</div>
  ${cards || `<div class="card g"><div class="empty">${svg("i-card")}<div class="t1">کارتی ثبت نشده</div><div class="t2">از بات نورا کارت اضافه کنید</div></div></div>`}
  ${gws ? `<div class="card g"><div class="card-t">${svg("i-shield")}درگاه‌ها</div>${gws}</div>` : ""}`;
}

function finDiscountsView() {

    const max = c.uses_max ? faNum(c.uses_max) : "∞";

        <div class="t2">${faNum(c.uses)} از ${max} بار · ${c.expired ? "منقضی" : (c.expires || "بدون انقضا")}</div></div>
      ${c.expired ? `<span class="chip danger">منقضی</span>` : `<span class="chip acc">فعال</span>`}</div>`;
  }).join("");

function finReportView() {
  const r = state.fin.report;
  if (!r) return loadingCard();
  const c = r.cur;
  const periods = REP_PERIODS.map(([d, label]) =>
    `<button class="chip ${r.days === d ? "on" : ""}" data-rd="${d}">${label}</button>`).join("");
  let growth = "";
  if (r.pct != null) {
    const cls = r.pct > 0 ? "acc" : (r.pct < 0 ? "danger" : "info");
    const word = r.pct > 0 ? "رشد" : (r.pct < 0 ? "افت" : "بدون تغییر");
    growth = `<span class="chip ${cls}">${r.pct ? word + " " + faNum(Math.abs(r.pct)) + "٪" : word}</span>`;
  }
  const methods = Object.keys(c.by_method || {});
  const mrows = methods.map((m) => {
    const v = c.by_method[m];
    return `<div class="row"><div class="av gold">${svg("i-wallet")}</div>
      <div class="main"><div class="t1">${METHOD_FA[m] || m}</div>
      <div class="t2">${faNum(v.n)} تراکنش${v.discount ? " · تخفیف " + faNum(v.discount) : ""}</div></div>
      <div class="side"><div class="t1">${faNum(v.sum)}</div></div></div>`;
  }).join("");
  const extras = [];
  if (c.links && c.links.n) extras.push(["لینک پرداخت", `${faNum(c.links.n)} تراکنش`, c.links.sum]);
  if (c.installments && c.installments.n) extras.push(["قسط پرداخت‌شده", `${faNum(c.installments.n)} قسط`, c.installments.sum]);
  if (c.installments_open) extras.push(["اقساط باز", "", c.installments_open]);
  if (c.refunds_done) extras.push(["بازپرداخت انجام‌شده", "", c.refunds_done]);
  if (c.refunds_pending && c.refunds_pending.n) extras.push(["بازپرداخت در انتظار", faNum(c.refunds_pending.n) + " مورد", c.refunds_pending.sum]);
  const erows = extras.map(([t1, t2, v]) => `<div class="row">
      <div class="av info">${svg("i-chart")}</div>
      <div class="main"><div class="t1">${t1}</div>${t2 ? `<div class="t2">${t2}</div>` : ""}</div>
      <div class="side"><div class="t1">${faNum(v)}</div></div></div>`).join("");
  return `<span class="backbtn" id="finback">${svg("i-back")}مالی</span>
  <div class="h2">گزارش مالی</div>
  <div class="filters">${periods}</div>
  <div class="stats"><div class="stat gold"><div class="num">${faNum(c.total)}</div>
    <div class="lbl">درآمد ${faNum(r.days)} روز · ریال ${growth}</div></div></div>
  ${mrows ? `<div class="card g"><div class="card-t">${svg("i-chart")}تفکیک روش</div>${mrows}</div>` : ""}
  ${erows ? `<div class="card g">${erows}</div>` : ""}
  <button class="btn wide" id="finx">${svg("i-clip","ic")}خروجی اکسل</button>`;
}

async function finRefundDecide(rid, ok) {
  if (state.fin.busy) return;
  state.fin.busy = true;
  try {
    await api(`/api/finance/refunds/${rid}/decide`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ ok }) });
    await Promise.all([loadFin(), loadFinSub("refunds")]);
  } catch (e) { state.error = e.message; }
  state.fin.busy = false;
  render();
}

async function finDiscAdd() {
  const code = document.getElementById("dcode").value.trim();
  const value = Number(document.getElementById("dval").value || 0);
  const max = Number(document.getElementById("dmax").value || 0);
  if (!code || value <= 0) { state.fin.discMsg = "کد و مقدار لازم است"; render(); return; }
  if (state.fin.busy) return;
  state.fin.busy = true;
  try {
    await api("/api/finance/discounts", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ code, kind: state.fin.discKind, value,
                             uses_max: max, days: state.fin.discDays }),
    });
    state.fin.discOpen = false; state.fin.discMsg = "";
    await loadFinSub("discounts");
  } catch (e) {
    state.fin.discMsg = e.message === "dup_code" ? "..." : ...
  }
  state.fin.busy = false;
  render();
}

But render() is at the end — set values after render for the dup case. Let's do this: in the dup case, after state.fin.busy=false; render();, re-set the 3 inputs. Structure:

js


async function finDiscAdd() {
  if (state.fin.busy) return;
  const codeEl = document.getElementById("dcode");
  const valEl = document.getElementById("dval");
  const maxEl = document.getElementById("dmax");
  const code = (codeEl ? codeEl.value : "").trim();
  const value = Number(valEl ? valEl.value : 0) || 0;
  const max = Number(maxEl ? maxEl.value : 0) || 0;
  if (!code || value <= 0) {
    state.fin.discMsg = "کد و مقدار درست لازم است";
    render(); refillDisc(code, value, max); return;
  }
  state.fin.busy = true;
  try {
    const r = await api("/api/finance/discounts", { method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ code, kind: state.fin.discKind, value,
                             uses_max: max, days: state.fin.discDays }) });
    if (r.result === "dup") {
      state.fin.discMsg = "این کد تکراری است";
      state.fin.busy = false; render(); refillDisc(code, value, max); return;
    }
    state.fin.discOpen = false; state.fin.discMsg = "";
    await loadFinSub("discounts");
  } catch (e) {
    state.fin.discMsg = "مقدار نامعتبر است";
    render(); refillDisc(code, value, max);
  }
  state.fin.busy = false;
  render();
}
function refillDisc(code, value, max) {
  const c = document.getElementById("dcode"); if (c) c.value = code;
  const v = document.getElementById("dval"); if (v && value) v.value = value;
  const m = document.getElementById("dmax"); if (m && max) m.value = max;
}
finExcel:

js


async function finExcel() {
  if (state.fin.busy) return;
  state.fin.busy = true;
  const btn = document.getElementById("finx");
  try {
    const res = await fetch("/api/finance/excel", { method: "POST",
      headers: { "Authorization": "Bearer " + state.token } });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("export_failed");
    const blob = await res.blob();
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = "nora-finance.xlsx";
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 4000);
  } catch (e) { state.error = e.message; }
  state.fin.busy = false;
  render();
}

function tint(hex, a) {
  if (!hex) return "";
  const h = hex.replace("#", "");
  const r = parseInt(h.slice(0,2),16), g = parseInt(h.slice(2,4),16), b = parseInt(h.slice(4,6),16);
  return `background:linear-gradient(148deg,rgba(${r},${g},${b},${a}),rgba(${r},${g},${b},${a*0.3}) 55%,transparent),var(--glassfill);`;
}
Hmm, the CSS var(--glassfill) inside the inline style does work ✓.

def _paid_scene(db, fake_clock):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db, fake_clock)
    frepo = FinanceRepo(db, fake_clock)
    setrepo = SettingsRepo(db)
    now = fake_clock.ts()
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="Autumn Course", status="published",
                            kind="meeting", start_ts=now + 86400,
                            capacity=10, is_paid=1, price=2000,
                            require_profile=0)
    u = urepo.create(301, first_name="Ali")
    urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", role="member")
    esvc = EventService(erepo, fake_clock)
    res = esvc.register(u, ev)
    pay = payrepo.create(u.id, M_CARD, 2000, reg_id=res.reg.id,
                         target_kind="event", target_id=ev.id)
    payrepo.set_receipt(pay.id, "FILE-1", PAY_WAIT)
    psvc = PayService(payrepo, erepo, EventService(erepo, fake_clock),
                      setrepo, fake_clock, frepo=frepo)
    psvc.mark_manual(pay.id)
    db.execute("UPDATE registrations SET refund_due = 1 WHERE id = ?",
               (res.reg.id,))
    db.commit()
    return urepo, erepo, payrepo, frepo, u, ev, res.reg

"""مالی وب W3b — بازپرداخت، کارت‌ها، کد تخفیف، گزارش و اکسل."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer

from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.finance import FinanceRepo
from nora.domain.payments import M_CARD, PAY_WAIT, PaymentRepo
from nora.domain.settings import SettingsRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo

from nora.services.pay_service import PayService
from web.server import create_app

CARD_MELLI = "6037991123456745"
CARD_SAMAN = "6219861034567890"


class FakeResponder:
    """همان قرارداد responder بات — کلیدها را ضبط می‌کند."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.sent = []

    @property
    def keys(self):
        return [item[2] for item in self.sent if item[0] == "bulk"]

    def bulk(self, chat_id, key, markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("bulk", chat_id, key))

    def bulk_raw(self, chat_id, text, markup=None):
        self.sent.append(("raw", chat_id, text))

    def send_photo_file(self, chat_id, path, key="", **kw):
        self.sent.append(("photo_file", chat_id, path))
        return False

    def send_photo(self, chat_id, file_id, key="", markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("photo", chat_id, file_id))

    def send_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        return False

    def bulk_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        return False


def _paid_scene(db, fake_clock, *, refund_due: bool = True):
    """ثبت‌نام پرداخت‌شده (آینهٔ مسیر بات) + پرچم بازپرداخت."""
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db, fake_clock)
    frepo = FinanceRepo(db, fake_clock)
    setrepo = SettingsRepo(db)
    now = fake_clock.ts()
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="دورهٔ پاییزی", status="published",
                            kind="meeting", start_ts=now + 86400,
                            capacity=10, is_paid=1, price=2000,
                            require_profile=0)
    u = urepo.create(301, first_name="علی")
    urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", role="member")
    esvc = EventService(erepo, fake_clock)
    res = esvc.register(u, ev)
    pay = payrepo.create(u.id, M_CARD, 2000, reg_id=res.reg.id,
                         target_kind="event", target_id=ev.id)
    payrepo.set_receipt(pay.id, "FILE-1", PAY_WAIT)
    psvc = PayService(payrepo, erepo, EventService(erepo, fake_clock),
                      setrepo, fake_clock, frepo=frepo)
    psvc.mark_manual(pay.id)
    if refund_due:
        db.execute("UPDATE registrations SET refund_due = 1 WHERE id = ?",
                   (res.reg.id,))
        db.commit()
    return urepo, erepo, payrepo, frepo, u, ev, res.reg


async def _client(db, fake_clock, *, responder=None, role="owner"):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="مدیر")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role=role, status="approved")
    settings = Settings(env="dev", bot_token="123:T", admin_ids=(999,))
    app = create_app(settings, db, dev_bale_id=999, responder=responder,
                     clock=fake_clock)
    client = TestClient(TestServer(app))
    await client.start_server()
    r = await client.post("/api/auth", json={"dev": True})
    tok = (await r.json())["token"]
    return client, {"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok}


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_refund_queue_and_done(db, fake_clock):
    _paid_scene(db, fake_clock)
    fake = FakeResponder()
    client, hdr = await _client(db, fake_clock, responder=fake)
    d = (await (await client.get("/api/finance/refunds",
                                 headers=hdr)).json())["data"]
    assert len(d["queue"]) == 1
    row = d["queue"][0]
    assert row["name"] == "علی" and row["title"] == "دورهٔ پاییزی"
    assert row["amount"] == 2000

    r = await client.post(f"/api/finance/refunds/{row['reg_id']}/decide",
                          headers=hdr, json={"ok": True})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "done"
    assert "refund_done" in fake.keys          # اطلاع به کاربر — آینهٔ بات

    frepo = FinanceRepo(db, fake_clock)
    done = frepo.refunds("done")
    assert len(done) == 1 and done[0].amount == 2000
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    assert erepo.get_reg(row["reg_id"]).refund_due == 0

    # دوباره → none (صف خالی)
    r = await client.post(f"/api/finance/refunds/{row['reg_id']}/decide",
                          headers=hdr, json={"ok": True})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "none"
    d = (await (await client.get("/api/finance/refunds",
                                 headers=hdr)).json())["data"]
    assert d["queue"] == [] and len(d["history"]) == 1
    assert d["history"][0]["reason"] == "cancel"
    await client.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_refund_reject(db, fake_clock):

    # reg_id ناموجود
    r = await client.post("/api/finance/refunds/9999/decide",
                          headers=hdr, json={"ok": True})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "none"
    await client.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_cards_view_and_actions(db, fake_clock):
    frepo = FinanceRepo(db, fake_clock)
    c1 = frepo.add_card(CARD_MELLI, "مریم رضایی", "meli")
    c2 = frepo.add_card(CARD_SAMAN, "مریم رضایی", "saman", sheba="IR0621986")
    frepo.add_gateway("zarinpal", "زرین‌پال خط زندگی", merchant="M-1",
                      verify="auto")
    client, hdr = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    d = (await (await client.get("/api/finance/cards",
                                 headers=hdr)).json())["data"]
    assert len(d["cards"]) == 2 and len(d["gateways"]) == 1
    first = d["cards"][0]                       # مرتب‌سازی: پیش‌فرض اول
    assert first["id"] == c1 and first["default"] is True
    assert first["bank"] == "meli" and first["bank_fa"] == "ملی"
    assert first["color"].startswith("#")
    assert d["gateways"][0]["verify"] == "auto"

    r = await client.post(f"/api/finance/cards/{c2}/action",
                          headers=hdr, json={"act": "default"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "default"
    d = (await (await client.get("/api/finance/cards",
                                 headers=hdr)).json())["data"]
    assert d["cards"][0]["id"] == c2 and d["cards"][0]["default"] is True

    r = await client.post(f"/api/finance/cards/{c2}/action",
                          headers=hdr, json={"act": "toggle"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "toggled"
    assert FinanceRepo(db, fake_clock).card(c2).is_active == 0

    r = await client.post(f"/api/finance/cards/{c2}/action",
                          headers=hdr, json={"act": "remove"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "removed"
    assert FinanceRepo(db, fake_clock).card(c2) is None
    r = await client.post("/api/finance/cards/9999/action",
                          headers=hdr, json={"act": "toggle"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "none"
    await client.close()

                          json={"code": "", "kind": "fix", "value": 500})
    assert r.status == 400
