                                 headers=hdr)).json())["data"]
    assert len(d["codes"]) == 1
    c = d["codes"][0]
    assert c["code"] == "MEHR1404" and c["kind"] == "pct"
    assert c["value"] == 20 and c["uses_max"] == 5 and c["uses"] == 0
    assert c["expired"] is False and c["expires"]   # تاریخ شمسی پر شده
    await client.close()

Implementation of (1):

js


async function api(path, opts = {}) {
  const res = await doFetch(path, opts);
  const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (res.status === 401 && data.error === "no_session" && !opts._retried) {
    // نشست کهنه (ری‌استارت/بذرپاشی مجدد سرور) — یک بار خودکار تازه کن
    try {
      state.token = ""; store.drop();
      const auth = await login();
      state.token = auth.token; store.set(auth.token);
      state.user = auth.user; state.perms = auth.perms || [];
      return api(path, { ...opts, _retried: true });
    } catch (e) { throw new Error(data.error); }
  }
  if (!res.ok || data.ok === false) throw new Error(data.error || ("http_" + res.status));
  return data;
}
Note: opts has body/headers — reuse them. _retried is an internal flag; fetch just passes it through as-is (harmless extra property in the fetch init — unknown keys are ignored so fetch ignores it ✓). But headers: doFetch builds headers with token every time — on retry it uses the new state.token ✓._

Note: login() throws no_entry if not in dev and no initData — inside Bale on phone with initData ✓; in preview dev ✓.

Edge case: /api/auth itself returning 401? It returns 403 errors so no retry loop.

Should I also add a friendly reload to ERR_FA's no_session message? With auto re-login, no_session surfacing should be rare.

async function fetchWithAuth(path, opts = {}) {
  const go = () => fetch(path, { ...opts, headers: { ...(opts.headers||{}), "Authorization": "Bearer " + state.token } });

# ==================== W3c: Payment Links ====================
def links_view(*, frepo, page: int = 0, per_page: int = 10) -> dict:
    """Link list — same frepo.links as the bot (1-based pages)."""
    items, total = frepo.links(page=max(1, page + 1), per_page=per_page)
    links = [_link_dict(lk) for lk in items]
    return {"links": links, "total": total, "page": page,
            "has_more": (page + 1) * per_page < total}
def _link_dict(lk) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": lk.id, "code": lk.code, "title": lk.title,
        "amount_mode": lk.amount_mode, "amount": lk.amount,
        "min_amount": lk.min_amount, "max_amount": lk.max_amount,
        "methods": lk.methods, "usage_type": lk.usage_type,
        "max_uses": lk.max_uses, "used_count": lk.used_count,
        "paid_count": lk.paid_count, "total_collected": lk.total_collected,
        "expires": (fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(lk.expires_ts, tz=TEHRAN))
                    if lk.expires_ts else ""),
        "active": bool(lk.is_active),
        "asks": {"name": bool(lk.ask_name), "mobile": bool(lk.ask_mobile),
                 "note": bool(lk.ask_note)},
        "start_param": "pl" + lk.code,
    }
def link_detail(*, frepo, link_id: int) -> dict | None:
    """Link details + recent transactions — mirror of on_link_view."""
    lk = frepo.link(link_id)
    if lk is None:
        return None
    txs = frepo.txs_of(link_id, 100)
    return {
        "link": _link_dict(lk),
        "open": sum(1 for tx in txs if tx.status != "paid"),
        "txs": [{"name": tx.payer_name, "total": tx.total,
                 "status": tx.status, "method": tx.method}
                for tx in txs[:5]],
    }

def link_action(*, frepo, link_id: int, act: str) -> str:
    """toggled | removed | none — finlt/finlx."""
    lk = frepo.link(link_id)
    if lk is None:
        return "none"
    if act == "toggle":
        frepo.update_link(link_id, is_active=0 if lk.is_active else 1)
        return "toggled"
    if act == "remove":
        frepo.remove_link(link_id)
        return "removed"
    return "bad"

python


PLAN_MODES_OK = ("installment", "sessions", "prepay")
def plans_view(*, frepo) -> dict:
    plans = frepo.plans()
    return {"plans": [_plan_dict(pl) for pl in plans]}
def _plan_dict(pl) -> dict:
    total = pl.total_amount or pl.part_amount * pl.parts
    return {
        "id": pl.id, "title": pl.title, "mode": pl.mode,
        "parts": pl.parts, "total": total, "part_amount": pl.part_amount,
        "prepay_percent": pl.prepay_percent, "interval": pl.interval,
        "late_fee": pl.late_fee, "active": bool(pl.is_active),
    }
def plan_detail(*, frepo, urepo, plan_id: int) -> dict | None:
    """Plan + installments per user — installment rows similar to frame 29."""
    pl = frepo.plan(plan_id)
    if pl is None:
        return None
    rows = frepo.db.query(
        "SELECT * FROM installments WHERE plan_id = ? ORDER BY user_id, part_no", (plan_id,))
    ins = []
    for r in rows:
        u = urepo.get(int(r["user_id"]))
        ins.append({
            "id": int(r["id"]),
            "name": ((u.full_name or u.first_name) if u else ""),
            "part_no": int(r["part_no"]), "parts_total": int(r["parts_total"]),
            "amount": int(r["amount"]),
            "status": str(r["status"]),
            "due": (fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(float(r["due_ts"]), tz=TEHRAN)) if float(r["due_ts"] or 0) else ""),
        })
    return {"plan": _plan_dict(pl), "installments": ins}
def plan_create(*, frepo, created_by: int, title: str, mode: str = "installment",
                total_amount: int = 0, part_amount: int = 0, parts: int = 2,
                prepay_percent: int = 30, interval: str = "monthly") -> str:
    """created | bad — same create_plan as _plan_finish (sessions calculation included)."""
    title = str(title or "").strip()[:60]
    if not title or mode not in PLAN_MODES_OK:
        return "bad"
    parts = int(parts or 0)
    if parts < 1 or parts > 60:
        return "bad"
    total = max(0, int(total_amount or 0))
    part = max(0, int(part_amount or 0))
    if mode == "sessions":
        if part <= 0:
            return "bad"
        total = part * parts
    elif total <= 0:
        return "bad"
    if interval not in ("weekly", "biweekly", "monthly"):
        interval = "monthly"
    frepo.create_plan(
        title=title, mode=mode, total_amount=total, parts=parts,
        part_amount=part, prepay_percent=int(prepay_percent or 30),
        interval=interval, grace_days=3, remind_before=2,
        created_by=created_by)
    return "created"
def plan_action(*, frepo, plan_id: int) -> str:
    pl = frepo.plan(plan_id)
    if pl is None:
        return "none"
    frepo.update_plan(plan_id, is_active=0 if pl.is_active else 1)
    return "toggled"
def assign_options(*, frepo, erepo, urepo, plan_id: int) -> dict | None:
    """Events + confirmed registrations for each — two-level picker, finpe/finpeg."""
    pl = frepo.plan(plan_id)
    if pl is None:
        return None
    events = []
    for ev in erepo.list_events(("published", "closed", "finished"))[:20]:
        regs = [{"reg_id": r.id,
                 "name": ...} for r in erepo.regs_of_event(ev.id, ("confirmed",))[:20]]
        events.append({"id": ev.id, "title": ev.title, "regs": regs})
    return {"events": events}
def plan_assign(*, frepo, erepo, clock, plan_id: int, reg_id: int) -> int:
    """Number of created installments | -1 none — mirror of finpr (assign_plan)."""
    pl = frepo.plan(plan_id)
    reg = erepo.get_reg(reg_id)
    if pl is None or reg is None:
        return -1
    ids = fin_svc.assign_plan(frepo, clock, pl, reg.user_id,
                              event_id=reg.event_id, reg_id=reg.id)
    return len(ids)
def ins_waive(*, frepo, ins_id: int) -> str:
    if frepo.installment(ins_id) is None:
        return "none"
    frepo.set_installment(ins_id, status=INS_WAIVED)
    return "waived"
def discount_kill(*, payrepo, code_id: int) -> str:
    """Code expiration — finnk mirror (expiration instead of deletion)."""
    row = payrepo.db.query_one("SELECT id FROM discount_codes WHERE id = ?", (code_id,))
    if row is None:
        return "none"
    now = payrepo.clock.ts() if payrepo.clock else 0.0
    with payrepo.db.transaction():
        payrepo.db.execute("UPDATE discount_codes SET expires_ts = ? WHERE id = ?", (max(now - 1, 1), code_id))
    return "killed"

function finLinksView() {

  if (!d) return loadingCard();

  const cards = links.map((lk) => finLinkCard(lk)).join("");

  ${state.fin.linkForm ? linkForm() : `<button class="btn wide" id="lnew">${svg("i-plus","ic")}لینک تازه — بدون تایپ</button>`}
  ${cards || emptyState}
  ${d.has_more ? `<button class="btn wide" id="lmore">لینک‌های بیشتر</button>` : ""}`;
}
finLinkCard(lk):

js


function finLinkCard(lk) {
  const del = state.fin.confirmKey === "l" + lk.id;
  const det = state.fin.linkDet && state.fin.linkDet.id === lk.id;
  const money = lk.amount_mode === "open"
    ? `بازهٔ باز${lk.min_amount ? " از " + faNum(lk.min_amount) : ""}${lk.max_amount ? " تا " + faNum(lk.max_amount) : ""}`
    : faNum(lk.amount) + " ریال";
  const usage = lk.usage_type === "once" ? "یک‌بار مصرف"
    : (lk.max_uses ? `تا ${faNum(lk.max_uses)} بار` : "چندبار مصرف");
  const methods = String(lk.methods || "").split(",").map((m) => METHOD_SHORT_FA[m] || m).filter(Boolean).join(" + ");
  const asks = [lk.asks.name && "نام", lk.asks.mobile && "موبایل", lk.asks.note && "یادداشت"].filter(Boolean);
  const avg = lk.paid_count ? Math.round(lk.total_collected / lk.paid_count) : 0;
  const chip = !lk.active ? `<span class="chip">خاموش</span>` : (lk.expires && expired? — server doesn't send link's expired flag! Hmm. PayLink's expires_ts — active chip vs expired: add "expired" to _link_dict? Don't have `now` on hand… skip: display expires text only; chip = active state only.)
  const txs = det ? detRows : "";
  return `<div class="card g">
    <div class="card-t">${svg("i-send")}${lk.title || "بی‌عنوان"}
      <span style="margin-inline-start:auto">${lk.active ? `<span class="chip acc">فعال</span>` : `<span class="chip">خاموش</span>`}</span></div>
    <div class="row" style="padding-top:0"><div class="main">
      <div class="t1 ltrline">/start ${lk.start_param}</div>
      <div class="t2">${money} · ${usage}</div></div>
      <span class="btn" data-copy="${lk.start_param}">کپی</span></div>
    <div class="row"><div class="main"><div class="t1">روش‌ها: ${methods || "—"}</div>
      <div class="t2">${lk.expires ? "انقضا: " + lk.expires : "بدون انقضا"}${asks.length ? " · پرسش: " + asks.join("، ") : ""}</div></div></div>
    <div class="row"><div class="main"><div class="t1">آمار</div>
      <div class="t2">${faNum(lk.paid_count)} پرداخت · ${faNum(lk.total_collected)} ریال${avg ? " · میانگین " + faNum(avg) : ""}</div></div>
      <span class="chip ${lk.used_count ? "info" : ""}">${faNum(lk.used_count)} استفاده</span></div>
    ${txs}
    <div class="btnrow">
      <span class="btn" data-ldet="${lk.id}">${det ? "بستن جزئیات" : "جزئیات"}</span>
      <span class="btn" data-ltog="${lk.id}">${lk.active ? "غیرفعال" : "فعال"}</span>
      <span class="btn dan" data-ldel="${lk.id}">${del ? "مطمئنی؟" : "حذف"}</span>
    </div></div>`;
}

Note — chip("amount", 500000...) → dataset "amount:500000" → draft.amount = "500000" string. On submit parse with Number.

Mode chips: fixed/open. If fixed: amount presets + custom input (ltr, number, placeholder "مبلغ دلخواه (ریال)"). If open: min presets (0 → "بدون حداقل", 500000, 1000000) + max presets (0, 5000000, 10000000). methods chips: both/card/gateway/all → labels "درگاه + کارت" / "کارت" / "درگاه" / "هر سه". usage chips: multi/once/capped + if capped → max_uses presets 5/10/50 chips + custom? Bot uses presets only. Use presets. expiry chips: 0/7/30 (labels هیچ/یک هفته/یک ماه). asks chips (toggle): ask_name/ask_mobile/ask_note. Submit button id ladd.

Mapping "both" → "gateway,card", "all" → "gateway,card,onsite" is done in submit:

js


const methods = {both:"gateway,card", card:"card", gateway:"gateway", all:"gateway,card,onsite"}[d.methods] || "gateway,card";
usage capped → usage_type "multi" + max_uses; once → "once"; multi → "multi", 0.

Submit body: title, amount_mode: d.mode, amount: Number(d.amount)||0 (only if fixed) — server only validates amount>0 if fixed; open → min/max. Also custom input: if filled → overrides preset (amount = custom ? Number(custom) : d.amount).

function finCopy(text) {
  const done = () => showToast("Copied to clipboard: /start " + text);
  if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(() => fallback());
  } else fallback();
  function fallback() {
    const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
    ta.value = text; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
    try { document.execCommand("copy"); done(); }
    catch (e) { showToast("Select and copy manually: " + text); }
    ta.remove();
  }
}
Hmm, the toast text: keep it as "Copied: /start plCODE".

Actions:

js


async function finLinkAct(id, act) {
  if (state.fin.busy) return;
  state.fin.busy = true;
  try {
    await api(`/api/finance/links/${id}/action`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ act }) });
    await Promise.all([loadFinSub("links"), loadFinHubOnly?]) — reload hub too? The hub's entry subtitle uses state.fin.links — loadFinSub("links") updates that ✓
  } catch (e) { state.error = e.message; }
  state.fin.busy = false; state.fin.confirmKey = ""; render();
}
However, if view=="links" and we reload links, the hub isn't displayed; the hub is displayed when you go back — since state.fin.links is already updated, finEntries will use it ✓.

finLinkDetail(id): toggle the expansion and lazy-fetch:

js


async function finLinkDetail(id) {
  if (state.fin.linkDet && state.fin.linkDet.id === id) { state.fin.linkDet = null; render(); return; }
  state.fin.linkDet = { id, data: null }; render();
  try {
    const d = await api(`/api/finance/links/${id}`);
    state.fin.linkDet = { id, data: d.data };
  } catch (e) { state.fin.linkDet = null; }
  render();
}
finLinkCreate():

js


async function finLinkCreate() {
  if (state.fin.busy) return;
  syncLinkForm();
  const d = state.fin.linkDraft;
  const custom = Number(String(d.custom || "").replace(/[^\d]/g, "")) || 0;
  const body = {
    title: d.title,
    amount_mode: d.mode,
    amount: d.mode === "fixed" ? (custom || Number(d.amount) || 0) : 0,
    min_amount: d.mode === "open" ? Number(d.min) || 0 : 0,
    max_amount: d.mode === "open" ? Number(d.max) || 0 : 0,
    methods: LINK_METHODS[d.methods] || "gateway,card",
    usage_type: d.usage === "once" ? "once" : "multi",
    max_uses: d.usage === "capped" ? Number(d.maxUses) || 0 : 0,
    days: Number(d.days) || 0,
    ask_name: d.ask_name, ask_mobile: d.ask_mobile, ask_note: d.ask_note,
  };
  if (!body.title.trim() || (body.amount_mode === "fixed" && body.amount <= 0)) {
    showToast("Title and amount are required"); return;
  }
  state.fin.busy = true;
  try {
    const r = await api("/api/finance/links", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    state.fin.linkForm = false;
    state.fin.linkDraft.custom = "";
    await loadFinSub("links");
    showToast("Link created · /start pl" + r.code);
  } catch (e) {
    showToast("Link was not created — check the values");
  }
  state.fin.busy = false; render();
}

js


async function finLinksMore() {
  const d = state.fin.links;
  if (!d || !d.has_more || state.fin.busy) return;
  state.fin.busy = true;
  try {
    const nd = (await api(`/api/finance/links?page=${d.page + 1}`)).data;
    state.fin.links = { ...nd, links: d.links.concat(nd.links) };
  } catch (e) { /* stay on the same page */ }
  state.fin.busy = false; render();
}

function linkForm() {
  const d = state.fin.linkDraft;
  const chip = (f, v, label, on) =>
    `<button class="chip ${on ? "on" : ""}" data-lchip="${f}:${v}">${label}</button>`;
  const money = d.mode === "fixed"
    ? `<div class="filters">${AMOUNT_PRESETS.map(([v, l]) => chip("amount", v, l, !d.custom && String(d.amount) === String(v))).join("")}</div>
       <input class="finp" id="lcustom" type="number" min="0" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="Custom amount (Rials)" value="${d.custom}">`
    : `<div class="t2" style="padding:0 4px">Minimum</div>
       <div class="filters">${chip("min", 0, "No minimum", d.min === "0")}${chip("min", 500000, "50k Toman", d.min === "500000")}${chip("min", 1000000, "100k Toman", d.min === "1000000")}</div>
       <div class="t2" style="padding:0 4px">Maximum</div>
       <div class="filters">${chip("max", 0, "No maximum", d.max === "0")}${chip("max", 5000000, "500k Toman", d.max === "5000000")}${chip("max", 10000000, "1M Toman", d.max === "10000000")}</div>`;
  const usage = d.usage === "capped"
    ? `<div class="filters">${[5, 10, 50].map((n) => chip("maxUses", n, faNum(n) + " times", String(d.maxUses) === String(n))).join("")}</div>` : "";
  const askChip = (f, label) => `<button class="chip ${d[f] ? "on" : ""}" data-lchip="${f}:1">${label}</button>`;
  return `<div class="card g">
    <div class="card-t">${svg("i-plus")}New Link</div>
    <input class="finp" id="ltitle" placeholder="Title — e.g.: Autumn Campaign Support" maxlength="60" autocomplete="off" value="${d.title}">
    <div class="filters">${chip("mode", "fixed", "Fixed amount", d.mode === "fixed")}${chip("mode", "open", "Open range", d.mode === "open")}</div>
    ${money}
    <div class="filters">${chip("methods", "both", "Gateway + Card", d.methods === "both")}${chip("methods", "card", "Card", d.methods === "card")}${chip("methods", "gateway", "Gateway", d.methods === "gateway")}${chip("methods", "all", "All three", d.methods === "all")}</div>
    <div class="filters">${chip("usage", "multi", "Unlimited", d.usage === "multi")}${chip("usage", "once", "One-time", d.usage === "once")}${chip("usage", "capped", "With limit", d.usage === "capped")}</div>
    ${usage}
    <div class="filters">${chip("days", 0, "No expiration", d.days === "0")}${chip("days", 7, "One week", d.days === "7")}${chip("days", 30, "One month", d.days === "30")}</div>
    <div class="filters">${askChip("ask_name", "Ask name")}${askChip("ask_mobile", "Ask mobile")}${askChip("ask_note", "Ask note")}</div>
    <button class="btn pri wide" id="ladd">Create Link</button>
  </div>`;
}

finLinkCard(lk): as drafted, with det expansion:

function finLinkCard(lk) {
  const del = state.fin.confirmKey === "l" + lk.id;
  const detOpen = state.fin.linkDet && state.fin.linkDet.id === lk.id;
  const money = lk.amount_mode === "open"
    ? `Open range${lk.min_amount ? " from " + faNum(lk.min_amount) : ""}${lk.max_amount ? " to " + faNum(lk.max_amount) : ""} · Rials`
    : faNum(lk.amount) + " Rials";
  const usage = lk.usage_type === "once" ? "One-time" : (lk.max_uses ? `Up to ${faNum(lk.max_uses)} times` : "Unlimited");
  const methods = String(lk.methods || "").split(",").map((m) => METHOD_SHORT_FA[m.trim()] || m).filter(Boolean).join(" + ");
  const asks = [lk.asks.name && "Name", lk.asks.mobile && "Mobile", lk.asks.note && "Note"].filter(Boolean);
  const avg = lk.paid_count ? Math.round(lk.total_collected / lk.paid_count) : 0;
  let det = "";
  if (detOpen) {
    det = state.fin.linkDet.data
      ? `<div class="kv"><span class="k">Open transactions</span><span class="v">${faNum(state.fin.linkDet.data.open)}</span></div>` +
        (state.fin.linkDet.data.txs.map((tx) => `<div class="row">
          <div class="av ${tx.status === "paid" ? "" : "warn"}">${svg(tx.status === "paid" ? "i-check" : "i-clock")}</div>
          <div class="main"><div class="t1">${tx.name || "Payer"}</div>
            <div class="t2">${TX_FA[tx.status] || tx.status}${tx.method ? " · " + (METHOD_SHORT_FA[tx.method] || tx.method) : ""}</div></div>
          <div class="side"><div class="t1">${faNum(tx.total)}</div></div></div>`).join("") || `<div class="t2" style="padding:6px 2px">No transactions yet</div>`)
      : `<div class="spin" style="margin:10px 0"></div>`;
  }
  return `<div class="card g">
    <div class="card-t">${svg("i-send")}${lk.title || "Untitled"}
      <span class="tchip">${lk.active ? `<span class="chip acc">Active</span>` : `<span class="chip">Disabled</span>`}</span></div>
    <div class="row" style="padding-top:0"><div class="main">
        <div class="t1 ltrline">/start ${lk.start_param}</div>
        <div class="t2">${money} · ${usage}</div></div>
      <span class="btn" data-copy="${lk.start_param}">Copy</span></div>
    <div class="row"><div class="main"><div class="t1">Methods: ${methods || "—"}</div>
      <div class="t2">${lk.expires ? "Expires: " + lk.expires : "No expiration"}${asks.length ? " · Asks: " + asks.join(", ") : ""}</div></div></div>
    <div class="row"><div class="main"><div class="t1">Stats</div>
      <div class="t2">${faNum(lk.paid_count)} payments · ${faNum(lk.total_collected)} Rials${avg ? " · avg " + faNum(avg) : ""}</div></div>
      <span class="chip ${lk.used_count ? "info" : ""}">${faNum(lk.used_count)} uses</span></div>
    ${det}
    <div class="btnrow">
      <span class="btn" data-ldet="${lk.id}">${detOpen ? "Close details" : "Details"}</span>
      <span class="btn" data-ltog="${lk.id}">${lk.active ? "Disable" : "Enable"}</span>
      <span class="btn dan" data-ldel="${lk.id}">${del ? "Are you sure?" : "Delete"}</span>
    </div></div>`;
}

function finPlansView() {
  const d = state.fin.plans;
  if (!d) return loadingCard();
  const cards = (d.plans || []).map(finPlanCard).join("");
  return `<span class="backbtn" id="finback">${svg("i-back")}Finance</span>
  <div class="h2">Installment Plans</div>
  ${state.fin.planForm ? planForm() : `<button class="btn wide" id="pnew">${svg("i-plus", "ic")}New Plan</button>`}
  ${cards || `<div class="card g"><div class="empty">${svg("i-clock")}<div class="t1">No plans yet</div><div class="t2">Create an installment or per-session plan</div></div></div>`}`;
}
function finPlanCard(pl) {
  const detOpen = state.fin.planDet && state.fin.planDet.id === pl.id;
  const asgOpen = state.fin.assignPid === pl.id;
  const totalLine = pl.mode === "sessions"
    ? `Per session ${faNum(pl.part_amount)} Rials · ${faNum(pl.parts)} sessions`
    : `${faNum(pl.parts)} installments · total ${faNum(pl.total)} Rials`;
  let det = "";
  if (detOpen) {
    det = state.fin.planDet.data ? planInsRows(state.fin.planDet.data) : `<div class="spin" style="margin:10px 0"></div>`;
  }
  let asg = "";
  if (asgOpen) {
    asg = state.fin.assignOpts ? assignPicker(pl) : `<div class="spin" style="margin:10px 0"></div>`;
  }
  return `<div class="card g">
    <div class="card-t">${svg("i-clock")}${pl.title || "Untitled"}
      <span class="tchip">${pl.active ? `<span class="chip acc">Active</span>` : `<span class="chip">Disabled</span>`}</span></div>
    <div class="row" style="padding-top:0"><div class="main">
      <div class="t1">${MODE_FA[pl.mode] || pl.mode} · ${INTERVAL_FA[pl.interval] || pl.interval}</div>
      <div class="t2">${totalLine}${pl.mode === "prepay" ? ` · prepay ${faNum(pl.prepay_percent)}%` : ""}</div></div></div>
    ${det}${asg}
    <div class="btnrow">
      <span class="btn" data-pdet="${pl.id}">${detOpen ? "Close installments" : "Installments"}</span>
      <span class="btn" data-pasg="${pl.id}">${asgOpen ? "Cancel" : "Assign"}</span>
      <span class="btn" data-ptog="${pl.id}">${pl.active ? "Disable" : "Enable"}</span>
    </div></div>`;
}
function planInsRows(d) {
  const ins = d.installments || [];
  if (!ins.length) return `<div class="t2" style="padding:6px 2px">No installments scheduled yet</div>`;
  return ins.map((i) => {
    const canWaive = i.status === "pending" || i.status === "late";
    const waiving = state.fin.confirmKey === "w" + i.id;
    return `<div class="row">
      <div class="av ${i.status === "paid" ? "" : (i.status === "late" ? "danger" : (i.status === "waived" ? "info" : "warn"))}">${svg(i.status === "paid" ? "i-check" : (i.status === "late" ? "i-x" : "i-clock"))}</div>
      <div class="main"><div class="t1">${i.name || "User"} · installment ${faNum(i.part_no)}/${faNum(i.parts_total)}</div>
        <div class="t2">${i.due || "—"} · ${faNum(i.amount)} Rials</div></div>
      <span class="chip ${INS_CHIP[i.status] || ""}">${INS_FA[i.status] || i.status}</span>
      ${canWaive ? `<span class="btn dan" data-iwaive="${i.id}" style="padding:5px 10px">${waiving ? "Sure?" : "Waive"}</span>` : ""}
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}
function assignPicker(pl) {
  const evs = state.fin.assignOpts.events || [];
  if (!evs.length) return `<div class="t2" style="padding:6px 2px">No confirmed registration found</div>`;
  if (!state.fin.assignEvent) {
    return `<div class="t2" style="padding:6px 2px">Select an event:</div>` + evs.map((ev) =>
      `<div class="row go" data-asev="${ev.id}"><div class="av info">${svg("i-cal")}</div>
        <div class="main"><div class="t1">${ev.title}</div>
        <div class="t2">${faNum(ev.regs.length)} confirmed registrations</div></div>
        <span class="chev">${svg("i-chev")}</span></div>`).join("");
  }
  const ev = evs.find((e) => e.id === state.fin.assignEvent);
  if (!ev) return "";
  return `<div class="t2" style="padding:6px 2px">${ev.title} — select participant:</div>` +
    ev.regs.map((r) => `<div class="row go" data-asreg="${r.reg_id}" data-asname="${esc(r.name)}">
      <div class="av">${(r.name || "?").slice(0, 1)}</div>
      <div class="main"><div class="t1">${r.name}</div></div>
      <span class="chip acc">Assign</span></div>`).join("") +
    `<span class="backbtn" id="asgback" style="margin-top:8px">${svg("i-back")}Event list</span>`;
}

finAssignDo:

js


async function finAssignDo(pid, regId, name) {
  if (state.fin.busy) return;
  state.fin.busy = true;
  try {
    const r = await api(`/api/finance/plans/${pid}/assign`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ reg_id: regId }) });
    state.fin.assignPid = 0; state.fin.assignOpts = null; state.fin.assignEvent = 0;
    await loadFinSub("plans");
    const d = await api(`/api/finance/plans/${pid}`);
    state.fin.planDet = { id: pid, data: d.data };
    showToast(`${faNum(r.count)} installments were scheduled for ${name}`);
  } catch (e) { showToast("Assignment was not completed"); }
  state.fin.busy = false; render();
}

def test_plan_assign_via_bot(env):
    """finpe→finpeg→finpr — full assignment (regression test for event_regs fix)."""
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, payrepo, frepo, setrepo = env
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="Photography Workshop", status="published",
                            kind="workshop", start_ts=clock.ts() + 86400,
                            capacity=10, is_paid=0, price=0,
                            require_profile=0)
    u = urepo.get_by_bale(10)
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO registrations (event_id, user_id, status, created_ts, "
        "updated_ts) VALUES (?, ?, 'confirmed', ?, ?)",
        (ev.id, u.id, clock.ts(), clock.ts()))
    db.commit()
    reg = db.query_one("SELECT id FROM registrations WHERE event_id = ?",
                       (ev.id,))
    pid = frepo.create_plan(title="Four Installments", mode="installment",
                            total_amount=2000000, parts=4,
                            interval="monthly", created_by=999)
    n = len(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"finpe:{pid}", uid=999))
    assert any("Photography Workshop" in x for x in texts(sent)[n:])
    n = len(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"finpeg:{pid}:{ev.id}", uid=999))
    assert any("Maryam Radmehr" in x for x in texts(sent)[n:])
    n = len(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"finpr:{pid}:{reg['id']}", uid=999))
    assert any(t("fin_plan_assigned", n=fa_num(4), name="Maryam Radmehr") in x
               for x in texts(sent)[n:])
    assert len(frepo.user_installments(u.id)) == 4

def user_line(u) -> dict:  # Summary row
    return {"id": u.id, "name": (u.full_name or u.first_name or u.username or str(u.bale_id)),
            "role": u.role, "status": u.status, "phone": u.phone or "",
            "city": u.city or "", "vip": bool(u.is_vip)}
def users_search(*, urepo, q: str) -> dict:
    """Search + latest members — adms/interceptor + adml mirror."""
    q = str(q or "").strip()
    results = [user_line(u) for u in urepo.search(q, 12)] if q else []
    if q.isdigit() and len(q) >= 5:  # bale_id? search doesn't match on bale_id
        u = urepo.get_by_bale(int(q))
        if u and not any(r["id"] == u.id for r in results):
            results.insert(0, user_line(u))
    latest = [user_line(u) for u, _ in ...]

def users_list(*, urepo, page: int = 0, per_page: int = 20):
    users, total = urepo.list_page(page=page, per_page=per_page)
    return {"users": [user_line(u) for u in users], "total": total, "page": page,
            "has_more": (page+1)*per_page < total}

def approval_decide(*, profsvc, approval_id: int, ok: bool) -> str:
    try:
        profsvc.decide(approval_id, ok)
        return "done"
    except Exception:  # ValidationError — no open request
        return "none"
The specific import would be ValidationError from core.errors? profile_service raises ValidationError — from ..core.errors import ValidationError? Check the import in profile_service: probably from ..core.errors import ValidationError. Use that.

python


def user_action(*, urepo, actor, target_id: int, act: str, role: str = "") -> str:
    """block|unblock same result codes: blocked/unblocked, vip_on/vip_off, role_set, deleted, protected, none, bad"""
    u = urepo.get(target_id)
    if u is None: return "none"
    if act == "block":
        new = "approved" if u.status == "blocked" else "blocked"
        urepo.update(u.id, status=new)
        return "blocked" if new == "blocked" else "unblocked"
    if act == "vip":
        urepo.update(u.id, is_vip="0" if u.is_vip else "1")
        return "vip_off" if u.is_vip else "vip_on"
    if act == "role":
        if role not in ROLES: return "bad"
        if u.role == "owner": return "protected"
        if actor is not None and u.id == actor.id and role not in ("admin", "owner"):
            return "protected"
        urepo.update(u.id, role=role)
        return "role_set"
    if act == "delete":
        if u.role == "owner": return "protected"
        if actor is not None and u.id == actor.id: return "protected"
        return "deleted" if urepo.delete(target_id) else "none"
    return "bad"

"""کاربران و پرونده در پنل وب — آینهٔ صفحه‌های adm/users بات.

جست‌وجو، فهرست، پروندهٔ گسترده (۱۷ فیلد + ثبت‌نام‌ها + پرداخت‌ها)،
صف تأیید پروفایل و کنش‌های مدیریتی. داده‌ها خام (کد نقش/وضعیت/فیلد)
می‌روند و فارسی‌سازی در لایهٔ نمایش وب — بدون لیترال فارسی اینجا.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from ..core.clock import TEHRAN
from ..core.errors import ValidationError
from ..core.jalali import ago_fa, fmt_dt
from ..domain.users import UserRepo
from .permissions import ROLES
from .profile_service import GROUPS, ProfileService

# فیلدهای پروفایل که در پروندهٔ گسترده نشان داده می‌شوند (ترتیب GROUPS بات)
_PROFILE_FIELDS = tuple(f for _g, fields in GROUPS for f in fields)


def _name(u) -> str:
    return u.full_name or u.first_name or u.username or str(u.bale_id)


def _created_map(urepo: UserRepo, ids: list) -> dict:
    """created_ts در dataclass کاربر نیست — یک پرس‌وجوی سبک از همان جدول."""
    ids = [int(i) for i in ids if i]
    if not ids:
        return {}
    marks = ",".join("?" for _ in ids)
    rows = urepo.db.query(
        f"SELECT id, created_ts FROM users WHERE id IN ({marks})",
        tuple(ids))
    return {int(r["id"]): float(r["created_ts"] or 0) for r in rows}


def user_line(u, now: float = 0.0, created: float = 0.0) -> dict:
    """ردیف فهرست/جست‌وجو — همان ستون‌های usr_line بات + وضعیت احراز."""
    return {
        "id": u.id,
        "name": _name(u),
        "role": u.role,
        "status": u.status,
        "vip": bool(u.is_vip),
        "phone": u.phone or "",
        "city": u.city or "",
        "ago": ago_fa(created, now) if created else "",
    }


def users_search(*, urepo: UserRepo, q: str, now: float) -> dict:
    """جست‌وجو (نام/شماره/کد ملی/یوزرنیم) + تازه‌ترین عضوها — adms بات.

    شناسهٔ بله در LIKE بات نیست؛ اینجا علاوه بر جست‌وجوی بات، شناسهٔ
    عددی را مستقیم هم نگاه می‌کنیم.
    """
    q = str(q or "").strip()
    found = []
    if q:
        found = urepo.search(q, 12)
        if q.isdigit() and len(q) >= 5:
            u = urepo.get_by_bale(int(q))
            if u is not None and not any(x.id == u.id for x in found):
                found.insert(0, u)
    latest, total = urepo.list_page(page=0, per_page=8)
    cm = _created_map(urepo, [u.id for u in found] +
                      [u.id for u in latest])
    return {"results": [user_line(u, now, cm.get(u.id, 0.0))
                        for u in found],
            "total": total,
            "latest": [user_line(u, now, cm.get(u.id, 0.0))
                       for u in latest]}


def users_list(*, urepo: UserRepo, page: int = 0, per_page: int = 20,
               now: float) -> dict:
    """فهرست صفحه‌بندی‌شده — adml بات."""
    users, total = urepo.list_page(page=max(0, int(page)),
                                   per_page=per_page)
    cm = _created_map(urepo, [u.id for u in users])
    return {"users": [user_line(u, now, cm.get(u.id, 0.0))
                      for u in users], "total": total,
            "page": max(0, int(page)),
            "has_more": (max(0, int(page)) + 1) * per_page < total}


def user_dossier(*, urepo: UserRepo, erepo, payrepo, suprepo,
                 user_id: int, now: float) -> dict | None:
    """پروندهٔ گسترده — فریم ۲۰ (فیلدها/درصد) + فریم ۳ (ثبت‌نام/پرداخت)."""
    u = urepo.get(user_id)
    if u is None:
        return None
    profile = {f: str(getattr(u, f, "") or "") for f in _PROFILE_FIELDS}
    profile["percent"] = int(u.complete_percent or 0)
    created = _created_map(urepo, [u.id]).get(u.id, 0.0)
    profile["member_since"] = (fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(
        created, tz=TEHRAN)) if created else "")
    profile["joined_ago"] = ago_fa(created, now) if created else ""

    regs = []
    paid_n = paid_sum = 0
    for reg in (erepo.user_regs(u.id, 20) if erepo is not None else []):
        ev = erepo.get_event(reg.event_id)
        regs.append({
            "title": (ev.title if ev else "") or "?",
            "status": reg.status,
            "ticket": reg.ticket_code or "",
            "amount": int(reg.amount_paid or 0),
            "when": (fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ev.start_ts, tz=TEHRAN))
                     if ev and ev.start_ts else ""),
        })
    pays = []
    for p in (payrepo.list_of_user(u.id, 30) if payrepo is not None
              else []):
        if p.status == "paid":
            paid_n += 1
            paid_sum += payrepo.total_of(p)
        pays.append({
            "amount": payrepo.total_of(p),
            "method": p.method,
            "target": p.target_kind,
            "status": p.status,
            "when": (fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(p.paid_ts, tz=TEHRAN))
                     if p.paid_ts else ""),
        })
    tickets = (suprepo.open_count_for(u.id) if suprepo is not None else 0)
    return {
        "user": {
            "id": u.id, "bale_id": u.bale_id, "name": _name(u),
            "role": u.role, "status": u.status, "vip": bool(u.is_vip),
            "username": u.username or "",
            "has_photo": bool(u.photo_file_id),
        },
        "profile": profile,
        "regs": regs,
        "pays": pays,
        "counts": {"regs": len(regs), "pays": paid_n, "total": paid_sum,
                   "tickets": int(tickets)},
    }


def approvals_queue(*, profsvc: ProfileService, now: float) -> list:
    """صف تأیید تغییرات هویتی — adma بات + زمان درخواست (فریم ۴)."""
    rows = profsvc.repo.db.query(
        "SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.field, a.old, a.new, a.created_ts, "
        "u.full_name FROM approvals a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id "
        "WHERE a.status = 'open' ORDER BY a.created_ts")
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        out.append({
            "id": int(r["id"]),
            "user_id": int(r["user_id"]),
            "name": str(r["full_name"] or ""),
            "field": str(r["field"]),
            "old": str(r["old"] or ""),
            "new": str(r["new"] or ""),
            "ago": ago_fa(float(r["created_ts"] or 0), now)
            if float(r["created_ts"] or 0) else "",
        })
    return out


def approval_decide(*, profsvc: ProfileService, approval_id: int,
                    ok: bool) -> str:
    """done | none — دقیقاً apr_decide بات (profile.decide)."""
    try:
        profsvc.decide(int(approval_id), bool(ok))
        return "done"
    except ValidationError:
        return "none"


def user_action(*, urepo: UserRepo, actor, target_id: int, act: str,
                role: str = "") -> str:
    """کنش‌های مدیریتی — آینهٔ usb/usv/usrr/usrx بات با همان حفاظت‌ها.

    کدها: blocked/unblocked · vip_on/vip_off · role_set · deleted ·
    protected (مالک/خود) · none · bad
    """
    u = urepo.get(target_id)
    if u is None:
        return "none"
    if act == "block":
        new = "approved" if u.status == "blocked" else "blocked"
        urepo.update(u.id, status=new)
        return "blocked" if new == "blocked" else "unblocked"
    if act == "vip":
        urepo.update(u.id, is_vip="0" if u.is_vip else "1")
        return "vip_off" if u.is_vip else "vip_on"
    if act == "role":
        if role not in ROLES:
            return "bad"
        if u.role == "owner":
            return "protected"          # نقش مالک از ربات/وب تغییر نمی‌کند
        if actor is not None and u.id == actor.id and \
                role not in ("admin", "owner"):
            return "protected"          # خود-تنزل مدیر مجاز نیست
        urepo.update(u.id, role=role)
        return "role_set"
    if act == "delete":
        if u.role == "owner":
            return "protected"
        if actor is not None and u.id == actor.id:
            return "protected"
        return "deleted" if urepo.delete(target_id) else "none"
    return "bad"

async function usrAct(id, act, role) {
  if (state.usr.busy) return;
  state.usr.busy = true;
  try {
    const r = await api(`/api/users/${id}/action`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ act, role: role || "" }) });
    showToast(UACT_FA[r.result] || r.result);
    state.usr.dos = null;
    if (r.result === "deleted") { state.usr.view = "search"; state.usr.search = null; ... }
    else state.usr.dos = (await api("/api/users/" + id)).data;
  } catch (e) { showToast("خطا: " + e.message); }
  state.usr.busy = false; state.usr.confirmKey = "";
  render();
}

js


function usrBindSearch() {
  const q = document.getElementById("usrQ");
  if (!q) return;
  q.oninput = () => {
    state.usr.q = q.value.trim();
    clearTimeout(state.usr.debounce);
    state.usr.debounce = setTimeout(async () => {
      try { await usrLoadSearch(state.usr.q); } catch (e) { return; }
      const res = document.getElementById("usrRes");
      if (res && state.usr.view === "search") {
        res.innerHTML = state.usr.search ? usrResHtml(state.usr.search) : "";
        usrBindRows(res);
      }
    }, 350);
  };
}
function usrBindRows(scope) {
  scope.querySelectorAll("[data-udos]").forEach((row) => {
    row.onclick = () => usrOpenDos(Number(row.dataset.udos));
  });
}

function usrResHtml(s) {

    ? `<div class="h2">Results · ${faNum(s.results.length)}</div>`

}

usrDecide:

js


async function usrDecide(aid, ok) {
  if (state.usr.busy) return;
  state.usr.busy = true;
  try {
    const r = await api(`/api/users/approvals/${aid}/decide`, {
      method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ ok }),
    });
    if (r.result === "none") showToast("This request was already decided on");
    state.usr.approvals = (await api("/api/users/approvals")).approvals;
  } catch (e) { showToast("Failed — " + e.message); }
  state.usr.busy = false; state.usr.confirmKey = "";
  render();
}

"""کاربران وب W4 — جست‌وجو، پرونده، صف تأیید، کنش‌های مدیریتی، گیت نقش."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer

from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.payments import M_CARD, PaymentRepo
from nora.domain.settings import SettingsRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.event_service import EventService
from nora.services.profile_service import ProfileService
from web.server import create_app


class FakeResponder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.sent = []

    def bulk(self, chat_id, key, markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("bulk", chat_id, key))

    def bulk_raw(self, chat_id, text, markup=None):
        self.sent.append(("raw", chat_id, text))

    def send_photo_file(self, chat_id, path, key="", **kw):
        return False

    def send_photo(self, chat_id, file_id, key="", markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("photo", chat_id, file_id))

    def send_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        return False

    def bulk_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        return False


async def _client(db, fake_clock, *, role="owner"):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="مدیر")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role=role, status="approved",
                 full_name="مدیر نورا")
    settings = Settings(env="dev", bot_token="123:T", admin_ids=(999,))
    app = create_app(settings, db, dev_bale_id=999,
                     responder=FakeResponder(), clock=fake_clock)
    client = TestClient(TestServer(app))
    await client.start_server()
    r = await client.post("/api/auth", json={"dev": True})
    tok = (await r.json())["token"]
    return client, {"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok}, admin


def _member(db, fake_clock, bale_id, name, **extra):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    u = urepo.create(bale_id, first_name=name.split()[0])
    urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", role="member", full_name=name,
                 phone="0912111%04d" % (bale_id % 10000), **extra)
    return u


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_users_search_and_latest(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, _ = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    _member(db, fake_clock, 5001, "علی رضایی", city="تهران")
    _member(db, fake_clock, 5002, "نگار موسوی", city="کرج")
    u3 = _member(db, fake_clock, 12345678, "سارا محمدی",
                 national_id="0012345678")

    r = await client.get("/api/users", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["total"] >= 4            # سه عضو + خود مدیر
    assert d["latest"] and d["latest"][0]["name"]

    r = await client.get("/api/users?q=نگار", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert [x["name"] for x in d["results"]] == ["نگار موسوی"]

    # شناسهٔ بله در LIKE بات نیست — fallback عددی وب آن را می‌گیرد
    r = await client.get("/api/users?q=12345678", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["results"][0]["id"] == u3.id

    # جست‌وجوی بی‌نتیجه
    r = await client.get("/api/users?q=نادیده", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["results"] == []


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_user_dossier(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, _ = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    u = _member(db, fake_clock, 6001, "رضا کاویانی",
                gender="male", province="تهران", city="تهران",
                birth_date="1370/03/12", complete_percent=60)
    urepo, erepo = UserRepo(db), EventRepo(db)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db, fake_clock)
    now = fake_clock.ts()
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه آرامش", status="published",
                            kind="workshop", start_ts=now + 86400,
                            capacity=10, is_paid=1, price=2000,
                            require_profile=0)
    esvc = EventService(erepo, fake_clock)
    res = esvc.register(u, ev)
    pay = payrepo.create(u.id, M_CARD, 2000, reg_id=res.reg.id,
                         target_kind="event", target_id=ev.id)
    payrepo.mark_paid(pay.id)

    r = await client.get(f"/api/users/{u.id}", headers=hdr)
    assert r.status == 200
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["user"]["name"] == "رضا کاویانی"
    assert d["user"]["role"] == "member"
    assert d["profile"]["percent"] == 60
    assert d["profile"]["gender"] == "male"
    assert d["profile"]["city"] == "تهران"
    assert d["counts"]["regs"] == 1
    assert d["counts"]["pays"] == 1
    assert d["counts"]["total"] == 2000
    assert d["regs"][0]["title"] == "کارگاه آرامش"
    assert d["pays"][0]["method"] == "card"
    assert d["pays"][0]["status"] == "paid"

    r = await client.get("/api/users/77777", headers=hdr)
    assert r.status == 404


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_approvals_queue_and_decide(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, _ = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    u = _member(db, fake_clock, 7001, "مریم رادمهر")
    profsvc = ProfileService(UserRepo(db), SettingsRepo(db))
    ch = profsvc.apply(u, full_name="مریم سادات رادمهر")
    assert "full_name" in ch.queued

    r = await client.get("/api/users/approvals", headers=hdr)
    rows = (await r.json())["approvals"]
    assert len(rows) == 1
    a = rows[0]
    assert a["user_id"] == u.id
    assert a["field"] == "full_name"
    assert a["old"] == "مریم رادمهر"
    assert a["new"] == "مریم سادات رادمهر"
    assert a["name"] == "مریم رادمهر"

    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/approvals/{a['id']}/decide",
                          headers=hdr, json={"ok": True})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "done"
    assert UserRepo(db).get(u.id).full_name == "مریم سادات رادمهر"

    # تصمیم دوباره روی درخواست بسته — مثل بات «none»
    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/approvals/{a['id']}/decide",
                          headers=hdr, json={"ok": False})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "none"
    r = await client.get("/api/users/approvals", headers=hdr)
    assert (await r.json())["approvals"] == []


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_user_actions(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, admin = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    u = _member(db, fake_clock, 8001, "امیر تهرانی")
    owner = _member(db, fake_clock, 8002, "مالک سیستم")
    UserRepo(db).update(owner.id, role="owner")
    urepo = UserRepo(db)

    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/{u.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "block"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "blocked"
    assert urepo.get(u.id).status == "blocked"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/{u.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "block"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "unblocked"

    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/{u.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "vip"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "vip_on"
    assert urepo.get(u.id).is_vip == 1
    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/{u.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "vip"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "vip_off"

    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/{u.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "role", "role": "operator"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "role_set"
    assert urepo.get(u.id).role == "operator"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/{u.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "role", "role": "nope"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "bad"

    # حفاظت‌ها: مالک، خود، و کاربر ناموجود
    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/{owner.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "role", "role": "member"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "protected"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/{owner.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "delete"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "protected"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/{admin.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "delete"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "protected"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/{admin.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "role", "role": "member"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "protected"

    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/{u.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "delete"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "deleted"
    assert urepo.get(u.id) is None
    r = await client.post(f"/api/users/{u.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "delete"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "none"

                           json={"act": "block"})
    assert r.status == 403

web_support.py
PYTHON
"""پشتیبانی در پنل وب — آینهٔ صفحهٔ support بات.

تیکت‌ها (فهرست/رشته/پاسخ/بستن/اولویت)، صندوق دریافت (پیام ناشناس و
مستقیم)، سوالات متداول و تنظیمات. گیت‌ها دقیقاً مثل بات: کارکنان =
manage_events، مدیریت (FAQ/تنظیمات) = manage_support. ارسال پیام به
کاربر با callable تزریق‌شده (لایهٔ وب همان _deliver بات را می‌بندد) —
بدون لیترال فارسی و بدون واردکردن channels.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from ..core.clock import TEHRAN
from ..core.events import bus
from ..core.jalali import ago_fa, fmt_dt
from ..domain.support import INBOX_ANON

SET_KEYS = ("sup_contact", "sup_cats", "sup_max_open", "sup_anon")


def _name(urepo, user_id: int) -> str:
    u = urepo.get(user_id)
    if u is None:
        return ""
    return u.full_name or u.first_name or u.username or str(u.bale_id)


def _family(urepo, user_id: int) -> str:
    """فامیلی پاسخ‌دهنده — همان _agent بات بدون پیشوند (داده، نه متن)."""
    u = urepo.get(user_id)
    if u is None:
        return ""
    full = (u.full_name or "").strip()
    return full.split()[-1] if full else (u.first_name or "")


def _when(ts: float, now: float) -> str:
    return ago_fa(ts, now) if ts else ""


def _dt(ts: float) -> str:
    return fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, tz=TEHRAN)) if ts else ""


# ------------------------------------------------------------ تیکت‌ها

def tickets_view(*, suprepo, urepo, which: str = "open",
                 now: float) -> dict:
    """فهرست تیکت‌ها — supl بات + آخرین پیام/زمان (فریم ۱۵)."""
    items = (suprepo.list_closed(limit=10) if which == "closed"
             else suprepo.list_open())
    rows = []
    for tk in items[:8]:                  # سقف بات: ۸ ردیف
        msgs = suprepo.msgs(tk.id)
        last = msgs[-1] if msgs else None
        rows.append({
            "id": tk.id,
            "name": _name(urepo, tk.user_id),
            "category": tk.category,
            "priority": int(tk.priority),
            "rating": int(tk.rating),
            "status": tk.status,
            "last_text": (last.text if last else "") or "",
            "last_sender": (last.sender if last else "") or "",
            "ago": _when(tk.last_ts or tk.created_ts, now),
        })
    return {"tickets": rows, "which": which,
            "open_n": len(suprepo.list_open()),
            "inbox_unseen": suprepo.inbox_unseen()}


def ticket_view(*, suprepo, urepo, tid: int, now: float) -> dict | None:
    """رشتهٔ تیکت — supv بات (حباب‌ها + پاسخ‌دهنده + امتیاز)."""
    tk = suprepo.get(tid)
    if tk is None:
        return None
    msgs = []
    for m in suprepo.msgs(tid):
        msgs.append({
            "sender": m.sender,
            "text": m.text,
            "when": _dt(m.ts),
            "media": m.media_kind or "",
            "agent": (_family(urepo, m.agent_id) if m.agent_id else ""),
        })
    return {
        "id": tk.id,
        "name": _name(urepo, tk.user_id),
        "category": tk.category,
        "priority": int(tk.priority),
        "rating": int(tk.rating),
        "status": tk.status,
        "agent": (_family(urepo, tk.agent_id) if tk.agent_id else ""),
        "created": _dt(tk.created_ts),
        "msgs": msgs,
    }


def ticket_reply(*, suprepo, urepo, actor, tid: int, text: str,
                 deliver) -> str:
    """sent | closed | none | empty — دقیقاً _reply_text بات."""
    text = str(text or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return "empty"
    tk = suprepo.get(tid)
    if tk is None:
        return "none"
    if tk.status != "open":
        return "closed"
    suprepo.add_msg(tid, "admin", text, agent_id=actor.id if actor else 0)
    suprepo.set_agent(tid, actor.id if actor else 0)
    user = urepo.get(tk.user_id)
    if user is not None and deliver is not None:
        deliver(user.bale_id, text, actor.bale_id if actor else 0, False)
    bus.emit("sup.reply", actor_id=actor.bale_id if actor else 0,
             ticket_id=tid)
    return "sent"


def ticket_close(*, suprepo, urepo, actor, tid: int, notify_close) -> str:
    """closed | none — on_close بات: close + bus + اعلان به کاربر."""
    tk = suprepo.get(tid)
    if tk is None:
        return "none"
    suprepo.close(tid)
    bus.emit("sup.close", actor_id=actor.bale_id if actor else 0,
             ticket_id=tid)
    user = urepo.get(tk.user_id)
    if user is not None and notify_close is not None:
        notify_close(user.bale_id, tid)
    return "closed"


def ticket_priority(*, suprepo, tid: int) -> str:
    """pri_on | pri_off | none — suppri بات (تاگل)."""
    tk = suprepo.get(tid)
    if tk is None:
        return "none"
    suprepo.set_priority(tid, 0 if tk.priority else 1)
    return "pri_off" if tk.priority else "pri_on"


# ---------------------------------------------------- صندوق دریافت

def inbox_view(*, suprepo, urepo, now: float) -> dict:
    """صندوق دریافت — supi بات؛ پیام ناشناس بی‌هویت می‌ماند."""
    rows = []
    for it in suprepo.inbox_list(limit=10):
        rows.append({
            "id": it.id,
            "kind": it.kind,
            "name": ("" if it.kind == INBOX_ANON
                     else _name(urepo, it.user_id)),
            "text": it.text,
            "ago": _when(it.ts, now),
            "seen": bool(it.seen),
            "answered": bool(it.answered),
            "media": it.media_kind or "",
        })
    return {"items": rows, "unseen": suprepo.inbox_unseen()}


def inbox_item(*, suprepo, urepo, iid: int, now: float) -> dict | None:
    """دیدن پیام = seen — supiv بات."""
    it = suprepo.inbox_get(iid)
    if it is None:
        return None
    suprepo.inbox_seen(iid)
    return {
        "id": it.id,
        "kind": it.kind,
        "name": ("" if it.kind == INBOX_ANON else _name(urepo, it.user_id)),
        "text": it.text,
        "when": _dt(it.ts),
        "media": it.media_kind or "",
        "answered": bool(it.answered),
    }


def inbox_reply(*, suprepo, urepo, actor, iid: int, text: str,
                deliver) -> str:
    """sent | none | empty — _ireply_text بات (ناشناس: بی‌هویت)."""
    text = str(text or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return "empty"
    it = suprepo.inbox_get(iid)
    if it is None:
        return "none"
    user = urepo.get(it.user_id)
    if user is not None and deliver is not None:
        deliver(user.bale_id, text, actor.bale_id if actor else 0,
                it.kind == INBOX_ANON)
    suprepo.inbox_answered(iid)
    return "sent"


# -------------------------------------------------- سوالات متداول

def faq_view(*, suprepo) -> list:
    """supfa بات — فهرست با وضعیت و ترتیب."""
    return [{"id": f.id, "q": f.q, "a": f.a, "pos": f.pos,
             "enabled": bool(f.enabled), "media": f.media_kind or ""}
            for f in suprepo.faq_list()]


def faq_add(*, suprepo, q: str, a: str) -> str:
    """added | empty — supfn→_save_faq بات (بی‌عکس = supfskip)."""
    q = str(q or "").strip()
    a = str(a or "").strip()
    if not q or not a:
        return "empty"
    suprepo.faq_add(q, a)
    return "added"


def faq_action(*, suprepo, fid: int, act: str) -> str:
    """toggle/del/up/down — supft/supfd/supfu/supfw بات."""
    item = suprepo.faq_get(fid)
    if item is None:
        return "none"
    if act == "toggle":
        suprepo.faq_update(fid, enabled=0 if item.enabled else 1)
        return "off" if item.enabled else "on"
    if act == "del":
        suprepo.faq_delete(fid)
        return "deleted"
    if act in ("up", "down"):
        suprepo.faq_move(fid, act == "up")
        return "moved"
    return "bad"


# -------------------------------------------------------- تنظیمات

def settings_view(*, setrepo, cats_default: str) -> dict:
    """sups بات — تماس، دسته‌ها، سقف تیکت باز، ناشناس."""
    contact = _kv(setrepo, "sup_contact", "")
    cats_raw = _kv(setrepo, "sup_cats", cats_default)
    return {
        "contact": contact,
        "cats": [c.strip() for c in cats_raw.split(",") if c.strip()],
        "max_open": _max_open(setrepo),
        "anon": _kv(setrepo, "sup_anon", "1") == "1",
    }


def setting_set(*, setrepo, key: str, value: str,
                cats_default: str) -> str:
    """saved | bad — STEP_SET بات با همان clamp‌ها."""
    if key not in SET_KEYS:
        return "bad"
    val = str(value or "").strip()
    if key == "sup_max_open":
        try:
            n = max(1, min(10, int(val)))
        except ValueError:
            n = 2
        val = str(n)
    elif key == "sup_cats" and not val:
        val = cats_default
    setrepo.set(key, val)
    return "saved"


def anon_toggle(*, setrepo) -> str:
    """supsg بات."""
    on = _kv(setrepo, "sup_anon", "1") == "1"
    setrepo.set("sup_anon", "0" if on else "1")
    return "off" if on else "on"


def _kv(setrepo, key: str, default: str) -> str:
    val = str(setrepo.get(key, default) or "")
    return val if val != "" else default


def _max_open(setrepo) -> int:
    try:
        n = int(_kv(setrepo, "sup_max_open", "2"))
    except ValueError:
        return 2
    return max(1, min(10, n))

"""مرکز اطلاع‌رسانی در پنل وب — آینهٔ صفحهٔ notify بات.

مخاطب چهارگانه (همه/تأییدشده/وی‌آی‌پی/ثبت‌نام‌های یک برنامه)، ساخت
پیش‌نویس با شمار گیرندگان، تاریخچه و «جامانده‌ها». ارسال واقعی با
callable تزریق‌شده (لایهٔ وب همان _send_bc بات را می‌بندد).
گیت: send_bulk — بدون لیترال فارسی.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from ..core.clock import TEHRAN
from ..core.events import bus
from ..core.jalali import ago_fa, fmt_dt

AUDIENCES = ("all", "approved", "vip", "event")


def _when(ts: float, now: float) -> str:
    return ago_fa(ts, now) if ts else ""


def _dt(ts: float) -> str:
    return fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, tz=TEHRAN)) if ts else ""


def _ev_title(erepo, eid: int) -> str:
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid) if eid else None
    return (ev.title if ev else "") or ""


def _bc_row(bcrepo, erepo, bc, now: float) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": bc.id,
        "audience": bc.audience,
        "arg": int(bc.audience_arg or 0),
        "title": _ev_title(erepo, int(bc.audience_arg or 0)),
        "text": bc.text,
        "has_media": bool(bc.media_file_id),
        "status": bc.status,
        "sent": int(bc.sent or 0),
        "total": int(bc.total or 0),
        "when": _dt(bc.created_ts),
        "ago": _when(bc.created_ts, now),
    }


def notify_view(*, bcrepo, erepo, now: float) -> dict:
    """هاب + مخاطب‌ها با شمار + رویدادهای قابل انتخاب + تاریخچه."""
    auds = [{"id": a, "n": len(bcrepo.audience_users(a))}
            for a in ("all", "approved", "vip")]
    events = [{"id": ev.id, "title": ev.title,
               "n": len(bcrepo.audience_users("event", ev.id))}
              for ev in erepo.list_events(
                  ("published", "closed", "finished"), limit=9)]
    history = [_bc_row(bcrepo, erepo, bc, now)
               for bc in bcrepo.list(limit=8)]
    return {"audiences": auds, "events": events, "history": history,
            "last": history[0] if history else None}


def notify_create(*, bcrepo, erepo, actor, audience: str, arg: int,
                  text: str, now: float) -> dict | str:
    """پیش‌نویس + پیش‌نمایش با شمار گیرندگان — bcn/bcau/bcev/bc_text بات."""
    text = str(text or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return "empty"
    if audience not in AUDIENCES:
        return "bad"
    arg = int(arg or 0)
    if audience == "event":
        if not arg or erepo.get_event(arg) is None:
            return "bad"
    else:
        arg = 0
    bc = bcrepo.create(actor.id if actor else 0, audience, text,
                       audience_arg=arg)
    return notify_preview(bcrepo=bcrepo, erepo=erepo, bid=bc.id, now=now)


def notify_preview(*, bcrepo, erepo, bid: int, now: float) -> dict | None:
    """bcpv بات — شمار مخاطب زنده."""
    bc = bcrepo.get(bid)
    if bc is None:
        return None
    row = _bc_row(bcrepo, erepo, bc, now)
    row["recipients"] = len(bcrepo.audience_users(bc.audience,
                                                  int(bc.audience_arg or 0)))
    return row


def notify_send(*, bcrepo, erepo, actor, bid: int, send_fn) -> dict:
    """bcok/bcre بات — send_fn همان _send_bc است؛ idempotent."""
    bc = bcrepo.get(bid)
    if bc is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    n = int(send_fn(bc) or 0)
    bus.emit("bc.sent", actor_id=actor.bale_id if actor else 0,
             audience=bc.audience, n=n)
    return {"result": "sent", "n": n}

"""نظرسنجی بعد برنامه در پنل وب — آینهٔ صفحهٔ surveys بات.

هاب per رویداد، سه نوع سوال (گزینه‌ای/امتیاز/متن)، حذف، گزارش جمع
(شمار گزینه‌ها، میانگین امتیاز خام با اعشار، نمونهٔ پاسخ متنی)،
تاگل فعال و «ارسال همین حالا». ارسال دعوت‌نامه‌ها در لایهٔ وب با
همان _send_invites بات انجام می‌شود. گیت: manage_forms.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from ..core.clock import TEHRAN
from ..core.jalali import fmt_dt
from ..domain.surveys import Q_CHOICE, Q_KINDS, Q_RATING, Q_TEXT


def _dt(ts: float) -> str:
    return fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, tz=TEHRAN)) if ts else ""


def survey_events(*, erepo, surrepo) -> list:
    """رویدادهای دارای منوی نظرسنجی — ورودی svm از evm بات."""
    rows = []
    for ev in erepo.list_events(("published", "closed", "finished"),
                                limit=12):
        sv = surrepo.for_event(ev.id)
        rows.append({
            "id": ev.id,
            "title": ev.title,
            "status": ev.status,
            "has": sv is not None,
            "qs": len(surrepo.questions(sv.id)) if sv else 0,
            "respondents": surrepo.respondents(sv.id) if sv else 0,
            "enabled": bool(sv.enabled) if sv else False,
            "sent": bool(sv.sent_ts) if sv else False,
        })
    return rows


def survey_hub(*, surrepo, erepo, eid: int) -> dict | None:
    """svm بات — سوال‌ها، آمار، وضعیت فعال/ارسال."""
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        return None
    sv = surrepo.ensure_for_event(eid)
    qs = surrepo.questions(sv.id)
    return {
        "event": {"id": ev.id, "title": ev.title, "status": ev.status},
        "survey": {"id": sv.id, "enabled": bool(sv.enabled),
                   "sent_when": _dt(sv.sent_ts)},
        "questions": [{"id": q.id, "pos": q.pos, "q": q.q, "kind": q.kind,
                       "options": [{"id": o.id, "label": o.label}
                                   for o in q.options]}
                      for q in qs],
        "respondents": surrepo.respondents(sv.id),
    }


def survey_add_q(*, surrepo, eid: int, kind: str, q: str,
                 options) -> str:
    """saved | empty | bad — svq/svo بات (گزینه‌ای ≥۲ گزینه، سقف ۹)."""
    q = str(q or "").strip()
    if not q:
        return "empty"
    if kind not in Q_KINDS:
        return "bad"
    opts = []
    if kind == Q_CHOICE:
        for item in (options or []):
            item = str(item or "").strip()
            if item:
                opts.append(item)
        if len(opts) < 2:
            return "opts"
        opts = opts[:9]
    sv = surrepo.ensure_for_event(eid)
    surrepo.add_question(sv.id, q, kind, opts or None)
    return "saved"


def survey_del_q(*, surrepo, qid: int) -> str:
    """deleted | none — svd بات."""
    q = surrepo.question(qid)
    if q is None:
        return "none"
    surrepo.delete_question(qid)
    return "deleted"


def survey_report(*, surrepo, erepo, eid: int) -> dict | None:
    """svres بات — شمار گزینه‌ها، میانگین خام، ۵ پاسخ متنی."""
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    sv = surrepo.for_event(eid)
    if ev is None or sv is None:
        return None
    qs = surrepo.questions(sv.id)
    out = []
    for idx, q in enumerate(qs, start=1):
        row = {"idx": idx, "q": q.q, "kind": q.kind}
        if q.kind == Q_CHOICE:
            counts = surrepo.option_counts(q.id)
            row["options"] = [{"label": o.label,
                               "n": int(counts.get(o.id, 0))}
                              for o in q.options]
        elif q.kind == Q_RATING:
            avg, cnt = surrepo.rating_stats(q.id)
            row["avg"] = round(float(avg), 1)
            row["n"] = int(cnt)
        else:
            row["answers"] = [str(v)[:80]
                              for v in surrepo.text_answers(q.id)]
        out.append(row)
    return {"event": {"id": ev.id, "title": ev.title},
            "respondents": surrepo.respondents(sv.id),
            "questions": out}


def survey_toggle(*, surrepo, eid: int) -> str:
    """svtog بات."""
    sv = surrepo.ensure_for_event(eid)
    surrepo.set_enabled(sv.id, 0 if sv.enabled else 1)
    return "off" if sv.enabled else "on"
