"""پشتیبانی/اطلاع‌رسانی/نظرسنجی وب W5a — آینهٔ بات + گیت نقش‌ها."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer

from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.broadcasts import BroadcastRepo
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.settings import SettingsRepo
from nora.domain.support import SupportRepo
from nora.domain.surveys import SurveyRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.event_service import EventService
from web.server import create_app


class FakeResponder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.sent = []

    def bulk(self, chat_id, key, markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("bulk", chat_id, key))

    def bulk_raw(self, chat_id, text, markup=None):
        self.sent.append(("raw", chat_id, text))

    def send_photo_file(self, chat_id, path, key="", **kw):
        return False

    def send_photo(self, chat_id, file_id, key="", markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("photo", chat_id, file_id))

    def send_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        self.sent.append(("media", chat_id, kind))
        return False

    def bulk_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        self.sent.append(("mediaraw", chat_id, kind))
        return False


async def _client(db, fake_clock, *, role="owner", bale_id=999):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    fake = FakeResponder()
    admin = urepo.create(bale_id, first_name="مدیر")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role=role, status="approved",
                 full_name="مدیر نورا")
    settings = Settings(env="dev", bot_token="123:T",
                        admin_ids=(bale_id,))
    app = create_app(settings, db, dev_bale_id=bale_id,
                     responder=fake, clock=fake_clock)
    client = TestClient(TestServer(app))
    await client.start_server()
    r = await client.post("/api/auth", json={"dev": True})
    tok = (await r.json())["token"]
    return client, {"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok}, admin, fake


def _member(db, bale_id, name):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    u = urepo.create(bale_id, first_name=name.split()[0])
    urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", role="member", full_name=name)
    return urepo.get(u.id)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_tickets_flow(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, admin, fake = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    u = _member(db, 5001, "علی رضایی")
    suprepo = SupportRepo(db, fake_clock)
    tk = suprepo.create(u.id, "سوال درباره ثبت‌نام", category="ثبت‌نام")
    suprepo.add_msg(tk.id, "admin", "در خدمتم", agent_id=admin.id)

    r = await client.get("/api/support/tickets", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["open_n"] == 1
    row = d["tickets"][0]
    assert row["name"] == "علی رضایی"
    assert row["last_text"] == "در خدمتم"
    assert row["last_sender"] == "admin"

    r = await client.get(f"/api/support/tickets/{tk.id}", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert [m["sender"] for m in d["msgs"]] == ["user", "admin"]
    assert d["agent"] == "نورا"           # فامیلی پاسخ‌دهنده

    # پاسخ → پیام admin + تحویل به چت کاربر (همان _deliver بات)
    fake.sent.clear()
    r = await client.post(f"/api/support/tickets/{tk.id}/reply",
                          headers=hdr, json={"text": "ثبت‌نام باز است"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "sent"
    assert ("raw", u.bale_id) == fake.sent[0][:2]
    assert "ثبت‌نام باز است" in fake.sent[0][2]
    msgs = SupportRepo(db, fake_clock).msgs(tk.id)
    assert msgs[-1].sender == "admin"
    assert msgs[-1].agent_id == admin.id
    assert SupportRepo(db, fake_clock).get(tk.id).agent_id == admin.id

    # متن خالی و اولویت و بستن
    r = await client.post(f"/api/support/tickets/{tk.id}/reply",
                          headers=hdr, json={"text": "  "})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "empty"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/support/tickets/{tk.id}/action",
                          headers=hdr, json={"act": "priority"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "pri_on"

    fake.sent.clear()
    r = await client.post(f"/api/support/tickets/{tk.id}/action",
                          headers=hdr, json={"act": "close"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "closed"
    assert ("bulk", u.bale_id, "sup_closed_user") in fake.sent
    assert SupportRepo(db, fake_clock).get(tk.id).status == "closed"

    # تیکت بسته: پاسخ نه، بستن دوباره = none نمی‌دهد (close idempotent نیست
    # در بات هم supc روی بسته دوباره close می‌زند) — پاسخ قطعاً «closed» است
    r = await client.post(f"/api/support/tickets/{tk.id}/reply",
                          headers=hdr, json={"text": "سلام"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "closed"
    r = await client.get("/api/support/tickets/777", headers=hdr)
    assert r.status == 404


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_inbox_faq_settings(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, admin, fake = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    u = _member(db, 6001, "نگار موسوی")
    suprepo = SupportRepo(db, fake_clock)
    ia = suprepo.inbox_add(u.id, "anon", text="حرف دل")
    idr = suprepo.inbox_add(u.id, "direct", text="سوال مستقیم")

    r = await client.get("/api/support/inbox", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["unseen"] == 2
    by = {x["id"]: x for x in d["items"]}
    assert by[ia.id]["name"] == ""            # ناشناس بی‌هویت
    assert by[idr.id]["name"] == "نگار موسوی"

    r = await client.get(f"/api/support/inbox/{ia.id}", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["kind"] == "anon" and d["name"] == ""
    r = await client.get("/api/support/inbox", headers=hdr)
    assert (await r.json())["data"]["unseen"] == 1

    fake.sent.clear()
    r = await client.post(f"/api/support/inbox/{ia.id}/reply",
                          headers=hdr, json={"text": "شنیدیم، ممنون"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "sent"
    assert ("raw", u.bale_id) == fake.sent[0][:2]
    assert SupportRepo(db, fake_clock).inbox_get(ia.id).answered == 1

    # FAQ — افزودن/خاموش/جابه‌جایی/حذف
    r = await client.post("/api/support/faq", headers=hdr,
                          json={"q": "چطور گواهی بگیرم؟", "a": "از بخش گواهی"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "added"
    r = await client.post("/api/support/faq", headers=hdr,
                          json={"q": "", "a": "x"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "empty"
    fid = (await (await client.get("/api/support/faq",
                                   headers=hdr)).json())["faq"][0]["id"]
    r = await client.post(f"/api/support/faq/{fid}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "toggle"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "off"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/support/faq/{fid}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "down"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "moved"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/support/faq/{fid}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "del"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "deleted"
    assert (await (await client.get("/api/support/faq",
                                    headers=hdr)).json())["faq"] == []

    # تنظیمات — کلیدها و clamp بات
    r = await client.get("/api/support/settings", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["max_open"] == 2 and d["anon"] is True
    r = await client.post("/api/support/settings", headers=hdr,
                          json={"key": "sup_contact", "value": "@x"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "saved"
    r = await client.post("/api/support/settings", headers=hdr,
                          json={"key": "sup_max_open", "value": "99"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "saved"
    d = (await (await client.get("/api/support/settings",
                                 headers=hdr)).json())["data"]
    assert d["max_open"] == 10 and d["contact"] == "@x"
    r = await client.post("/api/support/settings", headers=hdr,
                          json={"key": "sup_anon", "value": ""})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "off"
    r = await client.post("/api/support/settings", headers=hdr,
                          json={"key": "nope", "value": "1"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "bad"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_notify_flow(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, admin, fake = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    for i, name in enumerate(["علی رضایی", "نگار موسوی", "سارا محمدی"]):
        _member(db, 7001 + i, name)

    r = await client.get("/api/notify", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    auds = {a["id"]: a["n"] for a in d["audiences"]}
    assert auds["all"] == 4 and auds["approved"] == 4 and auds["vip"] == 0

    # ساخت با متن خالی / مخاطب بد
    r = await client.post("/api/notify", headers=hdr,
                          json={"audience": "all", "text": " "})
    assert r.status == 400 and (await r.json())["error"] == "empty"
    r = await client.post("/api/notify", headers=hdr,
                          json={"audience": "nope", "text": "x"})
    assert r.status == 400 and (await r.json())["error"] == "bad"

    # پیش‌نویس + پیش‌نمایش با شمار گیرندگان
    r = await client.post("/api/notify", headers=hdr,
                          json={"audience": "approved",
                                "text": "ثبت‌نام باز شد"})
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["recipients"] == 4 and d["status"] == "queued"
    bid = d["id"]

    # آزمایشی به خود مدیر
    fake.sent.clear()
    r = await client.post(f"/api/notify/{bid}/test", headers=hdr)
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "sent"
    assert ("raw", admin.bale_id, "ثبت‌نام باز شد") in fake.sent

    # ارسال واقعی
    fake.sent.clear()
    r = await client.post(f"/api/notify/{bid}/send", headers=hdr)
    out = await r.json()
    assert out["result"] == "sent" and out["n"] == 4
    assert len(fake.sent) == 4

    # جامانده‌ها: صفر (همه گرفتند) — idempotent مثل bcre بات
    r = await client.post(f"/api/notify/{bid}/resend", headers=hdr)
    assert (await r.json())["n"] == 0
    r = await client.get("/api/notify", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["history"][0]["sent"] == 4 and d["history"][0]["status"] == "done"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_surveys_flow(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, admin, fake = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    u = _member(db, 8001, "رضا کاویانی")
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه آرامش", status="finished",
                            kind="workshop",
                            start_ts=fake_clock.ts() - 86400,
                            capacity=10, is_paid=0,
                            require_profile=0)
    esvc = EventService(erepo, fake_clock)
    esvc.register(u, ev)

    r = await client.get("/api/surveys", headers=hdr)
    rows = (await r.json())["events"]
    assert [x["id"] for x in rows] == [ev.id]
    assert rows[0]["has"] is False

    r = await client.get(f"/api/surveys/{ev.id}", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["survey"]["enabled"] is True and d["questions"] == []

    # سوال‌ها: گزینه‌ای کم‌گزینه = opts، سالم = saved، امتیاز، متنی
    r = await client.post(f"/api/surveys/{ev.id}/questions", headers=hdr,
                          json={"kind": "choice", "q": "خوب بود؟",
                                "options": ["بله"]})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "opts"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/surveys/{ev.id}/questions", headers=hdr,
                          json={"kind": "choice", "q": "دوباره بیایی؟",
                                "options": ["بله", "نه", "شاید"]})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "saved"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/surveys/{ev.id}/questions", headers=hdr,
                          json={"kind": "rating", "q": "امتیاز جلسه"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "saved"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/surveys/{ev.id}/questions", headers=hdr,
                          json={"kind": "text", "q": " "})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "empty"

    hub = (await (await client.get(f"/api/surveys/{ev.id}",
                                   headers=hdr)).json())["data"]
    assert len(hub["questions"]) == 2
    q_choice, q_rating = hub["questions"]
    assert len(q_choice["options"]) == 3

    # پاسخ‌های نمونه → گزارش
    surrepo = SurveyRepo(db, fake_clock)
    sv = surrepo.for_event(ev.id)
    surrepo.save_answer(sv.id, u.id, q_choice["id"],
                        option_id=q_choice["options"][0]["id"])
    surrepo.save_answer(sv.id, u.id, q_rating["id"], rating=4)
    r = await client.get(f"/api/surveys/{ev.id}/report", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["respondents"] == 1
    assert d["questions"][0]["options"][0]["n"] == 1
    assert d["questions"][1]["avg"] == 4.0 and d["questions"][1]["n"] == 1

    # حذف سوال، تاگل و ارسال دعوت‌نامه
    r = await client.post(f"/api/surveys/{ev.id}/delq", headers=hdr,
                          json={"qid": q_rating["id"]})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "deleted"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/surveys/{ev.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "toggle"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "off"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/surveys/{ev.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "toggle"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "on"

    fake.sent.clear()
    r = await client.post(f"/api/surveys/{ev.id}/action", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "send"})
    out = await r.json()
    assert out["result"] == "sent" and out["n"] == 1
    assert ("bulk", u.bale_id, "sv_invite") in fake.sent
    hub = (await (await client.get(f"/api/surveys/{ev.id}",
                                   headers=hdr)).json())["data"]
    assert hub["survey"]["sent_when"]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_w5a_gates(db, fake_clock):
    # خزانه‌دار: هیچ‌کدام از سه بخش
    c1, h1, _, _ = await _client(db, fake_clock, role="treasurer",
                                 bale_id=991)
    for path in ("/api/support/tickets", "/api/support/inbox",
                 "/api/notify", "/api/surveys"):
        r = await c1.get(path, headers=h1)
        assert r.status == 403, path

    # برگزارکننده: تیکت‌ها مثل بات باز است (manage_events) ولی FAQ/تنظیمات نه
    c2, h2, _, _ = await _client(db, fake_clock, role="organizer",
                                 bale_id=992)
    r = await c2.get("/api/support/tickets", headers=h2)
    assert r.status == 200
    r = await c2.get("/api/support/faq", headers=h2)
    assert r.status == 403
    r = await c2.get("/api/surveys", headers=h2)
    assert r.status == 403                 # manage_forms ندارد

    # گرداننده: اطلاع‌رسانی دارد، نظرسنجی و FAQ نه
    c3, h3, _, _ = await _client(db, fake_clock, role="operator",
                                 bale_id=993)
    r = await c3.get("/api/notify", headers=h3)
    assert r.status == 200
    r = await c3.get("/api/surveys", headers=h3)
    assert r.status == 403
    r = await c3.get("/api/support/settings", headers=h3)
    assert r.status == 403

The fact that the exact same message keeps repeating strongly suggests either a technical issue on the user's end (messages being resent, or responses not being displayed) or that the user is intentionally testing.

Since I've already provided a thorough report, what should I do differently? Options:

Provide the report again (risk of an infinite loop)
Provide a very short, concise summary. Because maybe the long report is too verbose and they want "یه نگاه کلی (a rough overview)"
Acknowledge the repetition and ask if they're seeing my responses — though the ask_user tool returns skipped/empty according to memory ("the ask_user tool returns skipped/empty — don't rely on it"). So I won't use ask_user. I can ask a question in plain text at the end of the response.
Best approach: Present the most concise version of the report possible (maybe they want a short answer rather than a long one), and gently touch on the fact that the same message has arrived multiple times — in case replies aren't reaching them or they're looking for a different format. """گواهی در پنل وب — آینهٔ صفحهٔ certs بات (فریم‌های ۱۹ و ۴۰).

مرکز per رویداد: آمار و شرایط و قیمت، فهرست صادرشده‌ها با چیپ اعتبار،
لغو/برگرداندن اعتبار، ارسال دوباره، صدور تکی و دسته‌ای با همان گاردهای
بات (شرط حضور/جلسه/درصد/کامل + گارد پرداخت گواهی پولی) و استعلام
سه‌راهه (کد/کیوآر، شمارهٔ نامه + کد ملی). گیت: issue_certs.
بدون لیترال فارسی و بدون import از channels.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from ..core.clock import TEHRAN
from ..core.events import bus
from ..core.jalali import fmt_dt
from ..domain.certs import CertRepo
from ..services.cert_service import CONDITIONS, CertIssueError, CertService


def _name(urepo, user_id: int) -> str:
    u = urepo.get(user_id)
    if u is None:
        return ""
    return u.full_name or u.first_name or u.username or str(u.bale_id)


def _bale(urepo, user_id: int) -> int:
    u = urepo.get(user_id)
    return int(u.bale_id) if u is not None else 0


def _dt(ts: float) -> str:
    return fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, tz=TEHRAN)) if ts else ""


def _months(setrepo) -> int:
    """همان _months بات — kv رفتاری، پیش‌فرض ۲۴ ماه شمسی."""
    if setrepo is None:
        return 24
    try:
        n = int(str(setrepo.get("cert_valid_months", 24)))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 24
    return n if n >= 0 else 24


# ------------------------------------------------------------ نمای کلی

def certs_events(*, certrepo: CertRepo, erepo, csvc: CertService,
                 attrepo, payrepo) -> list:
    """رویدادهای دارای گواهی یا واجد صدور — certi/certl بات."""
    out = []
    for ev in erepo.list_events(
            ("published", "closed", "finished"), limit=15):
        items = certrepo.list_event(ev.id, include_revoked=True)
        valid = [c for c in items if not c.revoked]
        eligible = csvc.eligible_users(erepo, attrepo, ev, payrepo)
        if not items and not eligible:
            continue
        out.append({
            "id": ev.id,
            "title": ev.title,
            "status": ev.status,
            "issued": len(items),
            "valid": len(valid),
            "revoked": len(items) - len(valid),
            "eligible": len(eligible),
            "price": int(getattr(ev, "cert_price", 0) or 0),
            "condition": str(getattr(ev, "cert_condition", "none")
                             or "none"),
        })
    return out


def cert_hub(*, certrepo: CertRepo, erepo, csvc: CertService, attrepo,
             payrepo, urepo, eid: int, now: float) -> dict | None:
    """مرکز یک رویداد — certe بات + فهرست (certli) + واجدان."""
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        return None
    items = certrepo.list_event(eid, include_revoked=True)
    rows = []
    for c in items:
        expired = bool(c.expire_ts) and now > c.expire_ts
        rows.append({
            "id": c.id,
            "number": c.number,
            "code": c.code,
            "name": _name(urepo, c.user_id),
            "user_id": c.user_id,
            "revoked": bool(c.revoked),
            "expired": bool(expired),
            "issued": _dt(c.issued_ts),
            "until": _dt(c.expire_ts),
        })
    eligible = []
    for uid in csvc.eligible_users(erepo, attrepo, ev, payrepo)[:30]:
        eligible.append({"id": uid, "name": _name(urepo, uid)})
    cond = str(getattr(ev, "cert_condition", "none") or "none")
    if cond not in CONDITIONS:
        cond = "none"
    layout = csvc.layout()
    return {
        "event": {"id": ev.id, "title": ev.title, "status": ev.status},
        "condition": cond,
        "conditions": list(CONDITIONS),
        "min_sessions": max(1, int(getattr(ev, "cert_min_sessions", 1)
                                   or 1)),
        "min_percent": max(1, int(getattr(ev, "cert_min_percent", 70)
                                  or 70)),
        "price": int(getattr(ev, "cert_price", 0) or 0),
        "doc_no": str(getattr(ev, "cert_doc_no", "") or ""),
        "manual_vars": csvc.manual_vars(),
        "layout_skin": str(layout.get("پوسته", "") or ""),
        "layout_items": len(layout.get("عناصر", []) or []),
        "certs": rows,
        "eligible": eligible,
    }


# ------------------------------------------------------------ کنش‌ها

def cert_set_condition(*, erepo, eid: int, kind: str) -> str:
    """certcn بات."""
    if kind not in CONDITIONS:
        return "bad"
    erepo.update_event(eid, cert_condition=kind)
    bus.emit("cert.condition", event_id=eid, kind=kind)
    return "saved"


def cert_set_price(*, erepo, eid: int, price) -> str:
    """evset:…:cert_price بات — عدد ریالی، منفی = صفر."""
    try:
        value = max(0, int(price))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return "bad"
    erepo.update_event(eid, cert_price=value)
    return "saved"


def cert_action(*, certrepo: CertRepo, actor, cid: int, act: str) -> str:
    """revoked | undone | none — certrk/certru بات با bus."""
    cert = certrepo.get(cid)
    if cert is None:
        return "none"
    if act == "revoke":
        certrepo.set_revoked(cid, True)
        bus.emit("cert.revoke", actor_id=actor.bale_id if actor else 0,
                 code=cert.code)
        return "revoked"
    if act == "undo":
        certrepo.set_revoked(cid, False)
        bus.emit("cert.unrevoke",
                 actor_id=actor.bale_id if actor else 0, code=cert.code)
        return "undone"
    return "bad"


def _render_and_send(csvc, certrepo, erepo, urepo, cert, actor,
                     send_cert, to_admin: bool) -> None:
    """ساخت برگه و فرستادن — دقیقاً مسیر on_confirm/on_bulk بات."""
    ev = erepo.get_event(cert.event_id)
    holder = _name(urepo, cert.user_id)
    when = fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ev.start_ts, tz=TEHRAN)) \
        if ev and ev.start_ts else ""
    kwargs = {}
    if to_admin and actor is not None:
        kwargs = {"signer": actor.full_name or actor.first_name or "",
                  "issued": _dt(cert.issued_ts)}
    path = csvc.cert_path(cert, holder, ev.title if ev else "", when,
                          theme=getattr(ev, "ticket_theme", "") or "",
                          **kwargs)
    bale = _bale(urepo, cert.user_id)
    if bale and send_cert is not None:
        send_cert(bale, path)


def cert_issue_one(*, certrepo: CertRepo, csvc: CertService, erepo,
                   attrepo, payrepo, urepo, actor, eid: int, uid: int,
                   vals, setrepo, send_cert) -> dict:
    """certok بات: گارد شرط/پرداخت → صدور → bus → برگه به ادمین و کاربر."""
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    old = certrepo.get_for(eid, uid)
    if old is not None and not old.revoked:
        return {"result": "already"}
    cerr = csvc.condition_error(ev, attrepo, uid, payrepo)
    if cerr:
        return {"result": cerr}
    try:
        cert = csvc.issue(eid, uid, vals or {},
                          by=actor.id if actor else 0,
                          valid_months=_months(setrepo))
    except CertIssueError:
        return {"result": "missing"}
    bus.emit("cert.issue", user_id=uid, holder=_name(urepo, uid),
             title=ev.title, number=cert.number, code=cert.code)
    _render_and_send(csvc, certrepo, erepo, urepo, cert, actor,
                     send_cert, to_admin=True)
    return {"result": "issued", "number": cert.number, "code": cert.code}


def cert_bulk(*, certrepo: CertRepo, csvc: CertService, erepo, attrepo,
              payrepo, urepo, actor, eid: int, vals, setrepo,
              send_cert) -> dict:
    """certbk بات — فقط واجدان، هر خطا رد می‌شود نه کل دسته."""
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        return {"result": "none", "n": 0}
    users = csvc.eligible_users(erepo, attrepo, ev, payrepo)
    n = 0
    for uid in users:
        try:
            cert = csvc.issue(eid, uid, vals or {},
                              by=actor.id if actor else 0,
                              valid_months=_months(setrepo))
        except CertIssueError:
            continue
        n += 1
        bus.emit("cert.issue", user_id=uid, holder=_name(urepo, uid),
                 title=ev.title, number=cert.number, code=cert.code)
        _render_and_send(csvc, certrepo, erepo, urepo, cert, None,
                         send_cert, to_admin=False)
    return {"result": "done", "n": n}


def cert_resend(*, certrepo: CertRepo, csvc: CertService, erepo, urepo,
                cid: int, send_cert) -> str:
    """certrs بات — برگهٔ تازه برای دارنده."""
    cert = certrepo.get(cid)
    if cert is None:
        return "none"
    _render_and_send(csvc, certrepo, erepo, urepo, cert, None,
                     send_cert, to_admin=False)
    return "sent"


def cert_verify(*, csvc: CertService, urepo, payload: str) -> dict:
    """استعلام سه‌راهه بات: کیوآر/کد، سپس «شمارهٔ نامه کدملی»."""
    raw = str(payload or "").strip()
    got = csvc.verify(raw) if raw else None
    if got is None:
        parts = raw.split()
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            got = csvc.verify_doc(parts[0], " ".join(parts[1:]), urepo)
    if got is None:
        return {"status": "invalid"}
    cert = got["cert"]
    ev_title = ""
    from ..domain.events import EventRepo  # pragma: no cover - نه، پایین
    return {"status": "invalid"}  # pragma: no cover

def field_set(profsvc, name: str, act: str) -> dict:
    cfg = profsvc.field_config()
    if name not in cfg or act not in ("toggle", "req"):
        return {"ok": False, "error": "bad"}
    on, req = cfg[name]
    if act == "toggle":
        profsvc.set_field_flag(name, "on", 0 if on else 1)
    else:
        if not on:
            profsvc.set_field_flag(name, "on", 1)
        profsvc.set_field_flag(name, "req", 0 if req else 1)
    on2, req2 = profsvc.field_config()[name]
    return {"ok": True, "result": "saved", "on": bool(on2), "req": bool(req2)}
Mirror notes: on_field_toggle toggles on; on_field_req: if off → turn on, then toggle req. ✓

def pay_action(psvc, setrepo, act: str, *, method: str = "",
               number: str = "") -> dict:
    if act in ("method", "receipt"):
        if method not in METHODS:
            return {"ok": True, "result": "bad"}
        key = "pay_methods" if act == "method" else "receipt_auto"
        on = setrepo.toggle(key, method)
        return {"ok": True, "result": "toggled", "on": bool(on)}
    if act == "card":
        digits = "".join(ch for ch in number if ch in "0123456789")
        if len(digits) < 16:
            return {"ok": True, "result": "ask"}
        setrepo.set("card_number", digits)
        return {"ok": True, "result": "saved", "card": digits}
    return {"ok": True, "result": "bad"}
setrepo.toggle returns the new on bool ✓ (the bot uses on = setrepo.toggle(...)).

def import_users(urepo, clock, data: bytes, name: str,
                 update_existing: bool) -> dict:
    if not name.lower().endswith((".xlsx", ".xlsm")):
        return {"ok": False, "error": "bad"}
    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="nora-imp-")) / "imp.xlsx"
    try:
        tmp.write_bytes(data)
        headers, rows = import_export.read_rows(tmp)
        plan = import_export.plan(urepo, headers, rows)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — فایل خراب → خطا نه کرش (same as bot)
        return {"ok": False, "error": "bad"}
    finally:
        tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        tmp.parent.rmdir()  # might not be empty? mkdtemp creates an empty directory so OK
    if not plan.mapping or not plan.rows:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "head"}
    result = import_export.run(urepo, plan.rows, update_existing, clock=clock)
    return {"ok": True, "result": "done", "new": result.new,
            "upd": result.updated, "skip": result.skipped,
            "rows": len(plan.rows), "cols": len(plan.mapping),
            "dup": plan.dup_count}

def backup_db(db_path: Path, var_dir: Path, clock) -> dict:
    dest = var_dir / "backups"
    try:
        path = sysops.backup_now(db_path, dest, clock=clock)
    except (OSError, sqlite3.Error):
        return {"ok": False, "error": "fail"}
    bus.emit("sys.backup", name=path.name)
    return {"ok": True, "name": path.name,
            "size": sysops.human_size(path.stat().st_size),
            "path": str(path)}
def system_stats(urepo, erepo, payrepo, suprepo, certrepo, arepo,
                 clock) -> dict:
    now = clock.now()
    day = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0).timestamp()
    return {"users": urepo.count(), "users_today": urepo.count_since(day),
            "regs_today": erepo.count_regs_since(day),
            "pays_open": payrepo.count_unsettled(),
            "tickets_open": len(suprepo.list_open()),
            "certs": certrepo.count_all(),
            "activity": arepo.count_since(clock.ts() - 86400)}

"""تنظیمات در وب — آینهٔ setg بات (users.on_settings) و زیرصفحه‌هایش:

- fields:      pfc/pft/pfr بات (profile.on_fields/on_field_toggle/on_field_req)
- channels:    fjl/fja/fjt/fjx بات (forcejoin) — افزودن = ریست fj_ok کل کاربران
- pay:         payset/pm/ra/paycard بات (pay.on_payset/on_toggle + اینترسپتور کارت)
- import:      imp بات (import_export.read_rows/plan/run) با همان سقف ۵۰۰ ردیف
- export:      exp بات (import_export.export_users)
- backup:      sysb بات (system.backup_cmd → sysops.backup_now + bus)
- stats:       syss بات (system.stats_cmd)

بدون لیترال فارسی و بدون import از channels — برچسب‌ها سمت وب‌اپ.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from ..core.events import bus
from ..domain.payments import METHODS
from . import import_export, sysops
from .permissions import can

MAX_IMPORT_ROWS = 500          # سقف state بات در imports.MAX_STATE_ROWS
_HUB_PERMS = ("manage_settings", "import_users", "export_excel")


def hub_allowed(role: str) -> bool:
    """دروازهٔ خود هاب — مثل on_settings: هر کدام از سه اجازه کافی است."""
    return any(can(role, p) for p in _HUB_PERMS)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- هاب تنظیمات

def settings_hub(profsvc, fjrepo, psvc, setrepo, role: str) -> dict:
    cfg = profsvc.field_config()
    chans = fjrepo.list_all()
    return {
        "can": {p: can(role, p) for p in _HUB_PERMS},
        "fields": {"total": len(cfg),
                   "on": sum(1 for v in cfg.values() if v[0]),
                   "req": sum(1 for v in cfg.values() if v[0] and v[1])},
        "channels": {"total": len(chans),
                     "active": sum(1 for c in chans if c.active)},
        "pay": {"methods": list(psvc.methods_enabled()),
                "auto": list(psvc.receipt_auto()),
                "card": bool((setrepo.get("card_number") or "").strip())},
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------- فیلدهای پروفایل

def fields_view(profsvc) -> dict:
    cfg = profsvc.field_config()
    return {"fields": [{"name": n, "on": bool(v[0]), "req": bool(v[1])}
                       for n, v in cfg.items()]}


def field_set(profsvc, name: str, act: str) -> dict:
    cfg = profsvc.field_config()
    if name not in cfg or act not in ("toggle", "req"):
        return {"ok": True, "result": "bad"}
    on, req = cfg[name]
    if act == "toggle":
        profsvc.set_field_flag(name, "on", 0 if on else 1)
    else:
        # آینهٔ on_field_req: اگر خاموش است اول روشن می‌شود، بعد req جابه‌جا
        if not on:
            profsvc.set_field_flag(name, "on", 1)
        profsvc.set_field_flag(name, "req", 0 if req else 1)
    on2, req2 = profsvc.field_config()[name]
    return {"ok": True, "result": "saved", "on": bool(on2), "req": bool(req2)}


# -------------------------------------------------------- عضویت اجباری کانال

def channels_view(fjrepo) -> dict:
    return {"channels": [{"id": c.id, "title": c.title, "link": c.link,
                          "active": bool(c.active)}
                         for c in fjrepo.list_all()]}


def channel_action(fjrepo, urepo, act: str, *, ch_id: int = 0,
                   title: str = "", link: str = "") -> dict:
    if act == "add":
        title = title.strip()[:60]
        link = link.strip()
        if not title or not link:
            return {"ok": True, "result": "bad"}
        ch = fjrepo.add(title, link)
        # آینهٔ اینترسپتور بات: همهٔ fj_okها صفر تا دوباره سنجیده شوند
        urepo.db.execute("UPDATE users SET fj_ok = 0")
        urepo.db.commit()
        return {"ok": True, "result": "added", "id": ch.id}
    if act == "toggle":
        new = fjrepo.toggle(ch_id)
        if new is None:
            return {"ok": True, "result": "none"}
        return {"ok": True, "result": "toggled", "active": bool(new)}
    if act == "remove":
        if not fjrepo.remove(ch_id):
            return {"ok": True, "result": "none"}
        return {"ok": True, "result": "removed"}
    return {"ok": True, "result": "bad"}


# ------------------------------------------------------------ روش‌های پرداخت

def pay_view(psvc, setrepo) -> dict:
    return {"methods": list(psvc.methods_enabled()),
            "auto": list(psvc.receipt_auto()),
            "card": setrepo.get("card_number") or "",
            "all": list(METHODS)}


def pay_action(setrepo, act: str, *, method: str = "",
               number: str = "") -> dict:
    if act in ("method", "receipt"):
        if method not in METHODS:
            return {"ok": True, "result": "bad"}
        key = "pay_methods" if act == "method" else "receipt_auto"
        on = setrepo.toggle(key, method)
        return {"ok": True, "result": "toggled", "on": bool(on)}
    if act == "card":
        digits = "".join(ch for ch in number if ch in "0123456789")
        if len(digits) < 16:
            # آینهٔ اینترسپتور کارت: کمتر از ۱۶ رقم = دوباره بپرس
            return {"ok": True, "result": "ask"}
        setrepo.set("card_number", digits)
        return {"ok": True, "result": "saved", "card": digits}
    return {"ok": True, "result": "bad"}


# ------------------------------------------------------------- اکسل کاربران

def import_users(urepo, clock, data: bytes, file_name: str,
                 update_existing: bool) -> dict:
    if not file_name.lower().endswith((".xlsx", ".xlsm")):
        return {"ok": False, "error": "bad"}
    tmp_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="nora-imp-"))
    tmp = tmp_dir / "imp.xlsx"
    try:
        tmp.write_bytes(data)
        headers, rows = import_export.read_rows(tmp)
        plan = import_export.plan(urepo, headers, rows)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — فایل خراب/سنگین → خطا، نه کرش (مثل بات)
        return {"ok": False, "error": "bad"}
    finally:
        tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        tmp_dir.rmdir()
    if not plan.mapping or not plan.rows:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "head"}
    result = import_export.run(urepo, plan.rows[:MAX_IMPORT_ROWS],
                               update_existing, clock=clock)
    return {"ok": True, "result": "done", "new": result.new,
            "upd": result.updated, "skip": result.skipped,
            "rows": len(plan.rows), "cols": len(plan.mapping),
            "newc": plan.new_count, "dup": plan.dup_count}


def export_users(urepo, var_dir: Path, clock) -> Path | None:
    _users, total = urepo.list_page(page=0, per_page=1)
    if not total:
        return None
    stamp = clock.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M")
    dest = var_dir / "exports" / f"users-{stamp}.xlsx"
    import_export.export_users(urepo, dest)
    return dest


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- سیستم

def backup_db(db_path: Path, var_dir: Path, clock) -> dict:
    dest = var_dir / "backups"
    try:
        path = sysops.backup_now(db_path, dest, clock=clock)
    except (OSError, sqlite3.Error):
        return {"ok": False, "error": "fail"}
    bus.emit("sys.backup", name=path.name)
    return {"ok": True, "name": path.name, "path": str(path),
            "size": sysops.human_size(path.stat().st_size)}


def backup_file(var_dir: Path, name: str) -> Path | None:
    """مسیر امن فایل پشتیبان — فقط داخل var/backups و نام ساده."""
    if not name or "/" in name or "\\" in name or ".." in name:
        return None
    base = (var_dir / "backups").resolve()
    path = (base / name).resolve()
    if not str(path).startswith(str(base)) or not path.is_file():
        return None
    return path


def system_stats(urepo, erepo, payrepo, suprepo, certrepo, arepo,
                 clock) -> dict:
    now = clock.now()
    day = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0).timestamp()
    return {"users": urepo.count(), "users_today": urepo.count_since(day),
            "regs_today": erepo.count_regs_since(day),
            "pays_open": payrepo.count_unsettled(),
            "tickets_open": len(suprepo.list_open()),
            "certs": certrepo.count_all(),
            "activity": arepo.count_since(clock.ts() - 86400)}

# ---------- Settings W5c ----------
def _st_deps(app):
    return dict(profsvc=app[K_PROFSVC], fjrepo=app[K_FJREPO],
                psvc=app[K_PSVC], setrepo=app[K_SETREPO])
async def h_settings_hub(request):
    user = await _authed(request)
    if user is None:
        return _err(401, "no_session")
    if not st_hub_ok(user.role):
        return _err(403, "no_perm")
    data = st_hub(**_st_deps(request.app), role=user.role)
    return _json({"ok": True, "data": data})
async def h_settings_fields(request):
    user, err = await _perm_user(request, "manage_settings")
    if err is not None:
        return err
    return _json({"ok": True, **st_fields(profsvc=request.app[K_PROFSVC])})
async def h_settings_field_set(request):
    user, err = await _perm_user(request, "manage_settings")
    if err is not None:
        return err
    try:
        body = await request.json()
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
        return _err(400, "bad_body")
    name = str(body.get("name", "")) if isinstance(body, dict) else ""
    act = str(body.get("act", "")) if isinstance(body, dict) else ""
    out = st_field_set(profsvc=request.app[K_PROFSVC], name=name, act=act)
    return _json(out)

Import (multipart):

python


async def h_settings_import(request):
    user, err = await _perm_user(request, "import_users")
    if err is not None:
        return err
    reader = await request.multipart()
    mode = "new"
    data = b""
    fname = ""
    async for part in reader:
        if part.name == "mode":
            mode = (await part.text()).strip()
        elif part.name == "file" and part.filename:
            fname = part.filename
            data = await part.read(decode=False)
    if not data or not fname:
        return _json({"ok": False, "error": "bad"})
    out = await asyncio.to_thread(st_import, request.app[K_UREPO],
                                  get_clock(), data, fname,
                                  mode == "update")
    return _json(out)
Wait — import_export.run might emit to the bus, or might be fine even inside a thread. to_thread is OK. Actually, st_import runs sqlite on a worker thread — is the Database connection created on the main thread? sqlite3's check_same_thread… aiohttp handlers run on the event loop's thread. asyncio.to_thread uses a separate thread → sqlite3 might raise ProgrammingError if check_same_thread=True. But h_fin_excel already uses asyncio.to_thread with export_finance (a repository that accesses the db)! So the Database must be opened with check_same_thread=False. Safe to use to_thread.

Also note: run() with clock — clock.now() is fine.

async def h_settings_export(request):
    user = await _authed(request)
    if user is None:
        return _err(401, "no_session")
    if not can(user.role, "export_excel"):
        return _err(403, "no_perm")
    var_dir = Path(request.app[K_SETTINGS].db_path).parent
    dest = await asyncio.to_thread(st_export, request.app[K_UREPO], var_dir,
                                   get_clock())
    if dest is None:
        return _json({"ok": False, "error": "empty"})
    data = await asyncio.to_thread(dest.read_bytes)
    return web.Response(body=data, content_type="application/vnd...", headers=Content-Disposition)

Backup:

python


async def h_settings_backup(request):
    user, err = await _perm_user(request, "manage_settings")
    if err is not None:
        return err
    settings = request.app[K_SETTINGS]
    var_dir = Path(settings.db_path).parent
    out = await asyncio.to_thread(st_backup, Path(settings.db_path), var_dir,
                                  get_clock())
    return _json(out)
async def h_settings_backup_file(request):
    user, err = await _perm_user(request, "manage_settings")
    if err is not None:
        return err
    settings = request.app[K_SETTINGS]
    var_dir = Path(settings.db_path).parent
    path = st_backup_file(var_dir, request.query.get("name", ""))
    if path is None:
        return _err(404, "not_found")
    data = await asyncio.to_thread(path.read_bytes)
    return web.Response(body=data, content_type="application/octet-stream",
                        headers={"Content-Disposition":
                                 f'attachment; filename="{path.name}"'})

function setOpen() {
  state.usr.view = "settings";
  state.st.view = "hub"; state.st.hub = null;
  if (BP && BP.BackButton) { try { BP.BackButton.show(); } catch (e) {} }
  render();
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}
function setBack() {
  const v = state.st.view;
  if (v !== "hub") {
    state.st.view = "hub"; state.st.hub = null;
    state.st.confirmKey = "";
    render(); return;
  }
  usrBack();
}
function setConfirm(key, fn) {
  if (state.st.confirmKey === key) { state.st.confirmKey = ""; fn(); }
  else { state.st.confirmKey = key; render(); }
}
async function setSub(view, path, field) {
  state.st.view = view; state.st[field] = null; state.st.confirmKey = "";
  render();
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  try {
    const r = await api(path);
    state.st[field] = r.data !== undefined ? r.data : r;
  } catch (e) { state.st[field] = { error: e.message }; }
  render();
}

function setTab() {
  const v = state.st.view;
  if (v === "fields") return setFieldsView();
  if (v === "chans") return setChansView();
  if (v === "pay") return setPayView();
  if (v === "imp") return setImpView();
  if (v === "sys") return setSysView();
  if (!state.st.hub) {
    api("/api/settings").then((r) => { state.st.hub = r.data; render(); })
      .catch((e) => { state.error = e.message; render(); });
  }
  return setHubView();
}

async function setImpRun() {
  const f = document.getElementById("setimpF");
  if (!f || !f.files || !f.files[0]) { showToast("فایل اکسل را انتخاب کنید"); return; }
  if (state.st.busy) return;
  state.st.busy = true; render();
  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append("mode", state.st.impMode || "new");
  fd.append("file", f.files[0]);
  try {
    const res = await fetchWithAuth("/api/settings/import", { method: "POST", body: fd });
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    state.st.imp = data;
    if (!res.ok || data.ok === false) showToast(SET_FA[data.error] || "خطا");
    else showToast(SET_FA[data.result] || "انجام شد");
  } catch (e) { state.st.imp = { error: e.message }; }
  state.st.busy = false; render();
}
Note: don't set Content-Type header for multipart — api() forces JSON headers, so use fetchWithAuth directly. fetchWithAuth exists (used in finExcel).

async function setExport() {
  if (state.st.busy) return;
  state.st.busy = true;
  try {
    const res = await fetchWithAuth("/api/settings/export");
    if (!res.ok) { showToast("خطا در خروجی"); }
    else {
      const blob = await res.blob();
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = "nora-users.xlsx";
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 4000);
    }
  } catch (e) { showToast("خطا در خروجی"); }
  state.st.busy = false; render();
}

async function setAct(path, body, toastKey) {
  if (state.st.busy) return;
  state.st.busy = true;
  try {
    const r = await api(path, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    showToast(SET_FA[r.result] || SET_FA[r.error] || r.result || "");
    // reload current sub-view
    const v = state.st.view;
    state.st.busy = false;
    if (v === "fields") { state.st.fields = await api("/api/settings/fields"); }
    else if (v === "chans") { state.st.chans = await api("/api/settings/channels"); }
    else if (v === "pay") { state.st.pay = await api("/api/settings/pay"); }
    state.st.hub = null;
  } catch (e) { showToast("خطا — دوباره تلاش کنید"); state.st.busy = false; }
  render();
}
Hmm — reload on every toggle: acceptable (lightweight).

setBackup:

async function setBackup() {
  if (state.st.busy) return;
  state.st.busy = true; render();
  try {
    const r = await api("/api/settings/backup", { method: "POST" });
    state.st.bk = r.ok === false ? { error: r.error } : r;
    showToast(r.ok === false ? SET_FA[r.error] : "پشتیبان ساخته شد");
  } catch (e) { state.st.bk = { error: "fail" }; showToast(SET_FA.fail); }
  state.st.busy = false; render();
}
async function setBackupDl(name) {
  try {
    const res = await fetchWithAuth("/api/settings/backup/file?name=" + encodeURIComponent(name));
    if (!res.ok) { showToast("فایل پیدا نشد"); return; }
    const blob = await res.blob();
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = name;
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 4000);
  } catch (e) { showToast("خطا در دانلود"); }
}

function setBind(app) {
  const back = document.getElementById("setback");
  if (back) back.onclick = setBack;
  app.querySelectorAll("[data-setgo]").forEach((b) => {
    b.onclick = () => {
      const v = b.dataset.setgo;
      if (v === "fields") setSub("fields", "/api/settings/fields", "fields");
      else if (v === "chans") setSub("chans", "/api/settings/channels", "chans");
      else if (v === "pay") setSub("pay", "/api/settings/pay", "pay");
      else if (v === "sys") setSub("sys", "/api/settings/system", "sys");
      else if (v === "imp") { state.st.view = "imp"; state.st.imp = null; state.st.impMode = "new"; render(); }
      else if (v === "exp") setExport();
    };
  });
  app.querySelectorAll("[data-sft]").forEach((b) => {
    b.onclick = () => {
      const [act, name] = b.dataset.sft.split(":");
      setAct("/api/settings/fields", { name, act });
    };
  });
  app.querySelectorAll("[data-sct]").forEach((b) => {
    b.onclick = () => {
      const [act, id] = b.dataset.sct.split(":");
      if (act === "x") {
        setConfirm("x" + id, () => setAct("/api/settings/channels", { act: "remove", id: Number(id) }));
      } else {
        setAct("/api/settings/channels", { act: "toggle", id: Number(id) });
      }
    };
  });
  const chAdd = document.getElementById("setchAdd");
  if (chAdd) chAdd.onclick = () => {
    const title = (document.getElementById("setchT") || {}).value || "";
    const link = (document.getElementById("setchL") || {}).value || "";
    if (!title.trim() || !link.trim()) { showToast("نام و لینک کانال لازم است"); return; }
    setAct("/api/settings/channels", { act: "add", title, link });
  };
  app.querySelectorAll("[data-spm]").forEach((b) => {
    b.onclick = () => {
      const [act, m] = b.dataset.spm.split(":");
      setAct("/api/settings/pay", { act, m });
    };
  });
  const cardSave = document.getElementById("setcardSave");
  if (cardSave) cardSave.onclick = () => {
    const number = (document.getElementById("setcard") || {}).value || "";
    setAct("/api/settings/pay", { act: "card", number });
  };
  app.querySelectorAll("[data-simpmode]").forEach((b) => {
    b.onclick = () => { state.st.impMode = b.dataset.simpmode; render(); };
  });
  const impGo = document.getElementById("setimpGo");
  if (impGo) impGo.onclick = setImpRun;
  const bk = document.getElementById("setbk");
  if (bk) bk.onclick = setBackup;
  const bkdl = document.getElementById("setbkdl");
  if (bkdl) bkdl.onclick = () => setBackupDl(bkdl.dataset.name || "");
}

"""تنظیمات وب W5c — هاب، فیلدها، کانال‌ها، پرداخت، اکسل، سیستم."""

from __future__ import annotations

import io

import pytest
from aiohttp import FormData
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer
from openpyxl import Workbook

from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from web.server import create_app


class FakeResponder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.sent = []

    def bulk(self, chat_id, key, markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("bulk", chat_id, key))

    def bulk_raw(self, chat_id, text, markup=None):
        self.sent.append(("raw", chat_id, text))

    def send_photo_file(self, chat_id, path, key="", **kw):
        self.sent.append(("photofile", chat_id, key))
        return True

    def send_doc_file(self, chat_id, path, key="", **ph):
        self.sent.append(("doc", chat_id, key))
        return True

    def send_photo(self, chat_id, file_id, key="", markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("photo", chat_id, file_id))

    def send_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        return False

    def bulk_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        return False


async def _client(db, fake_clock, *, role="owner", bale_id=999):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    fake = FakeResponder()
    admin = urepo.create(bale_id, first_name="مدیر")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role=role, status="approved",
                 full_name="مدیر نورا")
    settings = Settings(env="dev", bot_token="123:T",
                        admin_ids=(bale_id,), db_path=db.path)
    app = create_app(settings, db, dev_bale_id=bale_id,
                     responder=fake, clock=fake_clock)
    client = TestClient(TestServer(app))
    await client.start_server()
    r = await client.post("/api/auth", json={"dev": True})
    tok = (await r.json())["token"]
    return client, {"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok}, admin, fake


def _xlsx(rows) -> bytes:
    book = Workbook()
    sheet = book.active
    for row in rows:
        sheet.append(row)
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    book.save(buf)
    return buf.getvalue()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_hub_fields(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, admin, _fake = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    r = await client.get("/api/settings", headers=hdr)
    data = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert data["can"]["manage_settings"] is True
    assert data["fields"]["total"] == 17

    r = await client.get("/api/settings/fields", headers=hdr)
    fields = (await r.json())["fields"]
    assert len(fields) == 17
    birth = next(f for f in fields if f["name"] == "birth_date")
    assert birth["on"] is True

    # خاموش کردن → وضعیت off
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/fields", headers=hdr,
                          json={"name": "birth_date", "act": "toggle"})
    body = await r.json()
    assert body["result"] == "saved" and body["on"] is False

    # اجباری روی فیلد خاموش → اول روشن بعد req (آینهٔ on_field_req)
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/fields", headers=hdr,
                          json={"name": "birth_date", "act": "req"})

    r = await client.post("/api/settings/fields", headers=hdr,
                          json={"name": "nope", "act": "toggle"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "bad"
    await client.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_channels_pay(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, admin, _fake = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    member = urepo.create(7001, first_name="عضو")
    db.execute("UPDATE users SET fj_ok = 1 WHERE id = ?", (member.id,))
    db.commit()

    # افزودن بدون لینک → bad
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/channels", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "add", "title": "کانال", "link": ""})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "bad"

    r = await client.post("/api/settings/channels", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "add", "title": "کانال نورا",
                                "link": "https://bale.ai/join/abc"})
    body = await r.json()
    assert body["result"] == "added" and body["id"] >= 1
    # آینهٔ بات: fj_ok همه صفر می‌شود
    row = db.execute("SELECT fj_ok FROM users WHERE id = ?",
                     (member.id,)).fetchone()
    assert int(row[0]) == 0

    r = await client.get("/api/settings/channels", headers=hdr)
    chans = (await r.json())["channels"]
    assert chans[0]["active"] is True

    r = await client.post("/api/settings/channels", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "toggle", "id": chans[0]["id"]})
    assert (await r.json())["active"] is False
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/channels", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "toggle", "id": 999})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "none"
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/channels", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "remove", "id": chans[0]["id"]})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "removed"
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/channels", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "remove", "id": chans[0]["id"]})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "none"

    # پرداخت
    r = await client.get("/api/settings/pay", headers=hdr)
    pay = await r.json()
    assert pay["all"] == ["gateway", "card", "onsite"]
    before = "gateway" in pay["methods"]
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/pay", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "method", "m": "gateway"})
    assert (await r.json())["on"] is (not before)
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/pay", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "method", "m": "nope"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "bad"
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/pay", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "receipt", "m": "card"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "toggled"
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/pay", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "card", "number": "123"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "ask"
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/pay", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "card", "number": "6037 9911-2233 4455"})
    body = await r.json()
    assert body["result"] == "saved" and body["card"] == "6037991122334455"
    r = await client.get("/api/settings/pay", headers=hdr)
    assert (await r.json())["card"] == "6037991122334455"
    await client.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_excel_and_system(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, admin, _fake = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    data = _xlsx([
        ["نام و نام خانوادگی", "موبایل", "کد ملی"],
        ["تازه یک", "09120000001", "0012345001"],
        ["تازه دو", "09120000002", "0012345002"],
    ])

    fd = FormData()
    fd.add_field("mode", "new")
    fd.add_field("file", data, filename="users.xlsx")
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/import", headers=hdr, data=fd)
    body = await r.json()
    assert body["result"] == "done" and body["new"] == 2
    assert body["upd"] == 0 and body["cols"] == 3

    # همان فایل با حالت به‌روزرسانی → تکراری‌ها به‌روز می‌شوند
    fd = FormData()
    fd.add_field("mode", "update")
    fd.add_field("file", data, filename="users.xlsx")
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/import", headers=hdr, data=fd)
    body = await r.json()
    assert body["new"] == 0 and body["upd"] == 2

    # فایل غیراکسل → bad
    fd = FormData()
    fd.add_field("file", b"junk", filename="u.txt")
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/import", headers=hdr, data=fd)
    assert (await r.json())["error"] == "bad"

    # خروجی اکسل
    r = await client.get("/api/settings/export", headers=hdr)
    assert r.status == 200
    blob = await r.read()
    assert blob[:2] == b"PK"
    assert "spreadsheetml" in r.headers["Content-Type"]

    # سیستم: سلامت + آمار
    r = await client.get("/api/settings/system", headers=hdr)
    sysd = await r.json()
    assert sysd["lines"] and sysd["stats"]["users"] == 3

    # پشتیبان + دانلود + گارد مسیر
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/backup", headers=hdr)
    bk = await r.json()
    assert bk["ok"] is True and bk["name"].startswith("nora-")
    r = await client.get("/api/settings/backup/file",
                         headers=hdr, params={"name": bk["name"]})
    assert r.status == 200 and (await r.read())[:16] == b"SQLite format 3\x00"
    r = await client.get("/api/settings/backup/file",
                         headers=hdr, params={"name": "../test.db"})
    assert r.status == 404
    await client.close()

Next, create nora/__main__.py:

python


"""Execution entry point: python -m nora — Bale polling bot.
All configuration comes from .env (NORA_ENV/BOT_TOKEN/DB_PATH/…).
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from .channels.bale.main import build_bot, run_polling
from .core import log
from .core.config import load
def main() -> None:
    settings = load()
    log.configure(settings.log_dir, settings.log_format)
    bot = build_bot(settings)
    run_polling(bot)
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
Signature of log.configure: (log_dir: Path|None, fmt: str="text", ...) — check additional parameters (level?) at lines 43-66. No issues.

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name panel.example.ir;
    return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
}
server {
    listen 443 ssl;
    http2 on;
    server_name panel.example.ir;
    ssl_certificate     /etc/letsencrypt/live/panel.example.ir/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/panel.example.ir/privkey.pem;
    # Bale mini-app: CSP comes from the app itself;
    # Never add X-Frame-Options here.
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8080;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        client_max_body_size 20m;   # Excel/receipt uploads
        proxy_read_timeout 120s;
    }
}

"""بستهٔ استقرار — دکمهٔ پنل وب، اعتبارسنجی https، .env و هدر CSP."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer

from nora.channels.bale import ui
from nora.channels.bale.ctx import Ctx
from nora.channels.bale.screens.users import on_panel
from nora.core.config import Settings, load
from nora.core.errors import ValidationError
from nora.domain.settings import SettingsRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.profile_service import ProfileService
from web.server import create_app


def test_btn_web():
    b = ui.btn_web("پنل وب", "https://panel.example.ir/")
    assert b == {"text": "پنل وب",
                 "web_app": {"url": "https://panel.example.ir/"}}
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        ui.btn_web("پنل وب", "http://panel.example.ir/")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        ui.btn_web(" " * 3, "https://x.ir/")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        ui.btn_web("پ" * 80, "https://x.ir/")


def test_env_web_app_url(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("NORA_ENV", "dev")
    monkeypatch.setenv("WEB_APP_URL", "https://panel.example.ir/")
    assert load().web_app_url == "https://panel.example.ir/"
    monkeypatch.delenv("WEB_APP_URL")
    assert load().web_app_url == ""


def _panel(db, role: str, url: str):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    user = urepo.create(4242, first_name="مدیر")
    urepo.update(user.id, role=role, status="approved", full_name="مدیر")
    prof = ProfileService(urepo, SettingsRepo(db))
    settings = Settings(env="dev", web_app_url=url)
    ctx = Ctx(user_id=4242, chat_id=4242)
    return on_panel(urepo, prof, ctx, settings=settings)


def test_panel_web_button(db):
    # بدون آدرس → دکمهٔ وب نیست (رفتار فعلی دست‌نخورده)
    reply = _panel(db, "admin", "")
    assert reply.text and "web_app" not in str(reply.markup)

    # با آدرس → ردیف «پنل وب» با فیلد web_app
    reply = _panel(db, "admin", "https://panel.example.ir/")
    assert "web_app" in str(reply.markup)
    assert "https://panel.example.ir/" in str(reply.markup)

    # عضو عادی → همان no_perm، بدون پنل
    from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
    reply = _panel(db, "member", "https://panel.example.ir/")
    assert reply.text == t("no_perm")


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_index_csp_headers(db, fake_clock):
    settings = Settings(env="dev", bot_token="")
    app = create_app(settings, db, dev_bale_id=1, clock=fake_clock)
    client = TestClient(TestServer(app))
    await client.start_server()
    r = await client.get("/")
    assert r.status == 200
    assert r.headers["Content-Security-Policy"] == \
        "frame-src 'https://*.bale.ai';"
    # قاتل مینی‌اپ در وب بله — هرگز نباید فرستاده شود
    assert "X-Frame-Options" not in r.headers
    await client.close()
