Hmm, p not in queue is O(n²) but small-scale; dataclass eq works. More simply:

python


def posts_rows(*, postsvc, erepo, urepo):
    rows = []
    seen = set()
    for p in postsvc.queue():
        seen.add(p.id); rows.append(_post_row(postsvc, erepo, urepo, p))
    for p in postsvc.cprepo.all_recent():
        if p.id in seen: continue
        rows.append(_post_row(postsvc, erepo, urepo, p))
    return rows
def _post_row(postsvc, erepo, urepo, p):
    ev = erepo.get_event(p.event_id)
    st = postsvc.status_of(p)
    return {
        "id": p.id, "event": ev.title if ev else "", "variant": p.variant,
        "recipient": p.recipient, "phone": p.phone, "address": p.address,
        "postal": p.postal_code, "note": p.note, "fee": p.fee,
        "status": st, "tracking": p.tracking,
        "user": _name(urepo, p.user_id),
        "when": _dt(p.created_ts),
        "can_ship": p.status == "open" and st == "paid",
    }
The string literal "open" — domain constant POST_OPEN; import from domain.certposts (POST_OPEN). OK (it's English so ✓).

python


def posts_ship(*, postsvc, urepo, pid: int, tracking: str, notify=None) -> dict:
    post, err = postsvc.ship(pid, tracking)
    if post is None:
        return {"result": err or "none"}
    bale = _bale(urepo, post.user_id)
    if bale and notify is not None:
        notify(bale, "post_shipped_notify", code=post.tracking)
    return {"result": "shipped", "tracking": post.tracking}

async def h_certposts(request):
    user, err = await _perm_user(request, "issue_certs")
    if err is not None: return err
    rows = c_posts(postsvc=request.app[K_POSTSVC], erepo=request.app[K_EREPO], urepo=request.app[K_UREPO])
    return _json({"ok": True, "rows": rows})
async def h_certpost_ship(request):
    user, err = await _perm_user(request, "issue_certs")
    if err is not None: return err
    try: body = await request.json()
    except ...: return _err(400, "bad_body")
    responder = request.app[K_RESP]
    notify = None
    if responder is not None:
        def notify(bale_id, key, **ph): responder.bulk(bale_id, key, **ph)
    result = c_posts_ship(postsvc=..., urepo=..., pid=_int_of(request, "pid"), tracking=str(body.get("tracking","")), notify=notify)
    await _drain(request)
    return _json({"ok": True, "result": result})

async function certPostsLoad() {
  const r = await api("/api/certposts");
  state.cert.posts = r.rows || [];
}
function certPostsOpen() {
  state.cert.view = "posts"; state.cert.posts = null; render(); window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
const POST_ST_FA = { pending_pay: "در انتظار پرداخت", paid: "در صف ارسال", sent: "ارسال شد", cancelled: "لغو شد" };
const POST_V_FA = { glossy: "برگهٔ گلاسه", signed: "امضا زنده" };
function certPostsTab() {
  const back = `<span class="backbtn" id="certback">${svg("i-back")}گواهی‌ها</span>`;
  if (!state.cert.posts) {
    certPostsLoad().then(() => render()).catch((e) => { state.error = e.message; render(); });
    return back + loadingCard();
  }
  const rows = state.cert.posts.map((p) => `
    <div class="card g">
      <div class="row" style="padding-top:0;border-top:0">
        <div class="av ${p.status === "sent" ? "info" : p.can_ship ? "warn" : ""}">${svg("i-clip")}</div>
        <div class="main"><div class="t1">${esc(p.recipient)} <span class="chip">${POST_V_FA[p.variant] || p.variant}</span></div>
        <div class="t2">${esc(p.event)} · ${esc(p.user)} · ${p.when || ""}</div></div>
        <div class="side"><span class="chip ${p.status === "sent" ? "info" : p.can_ship ? "gold" : ""}">${POST_ST_FA[p.status] || p.status}</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="kv"><span class="k">نشانی</span><span class="v">${esc(p.address)}</span></div>
      <div class="kv"><span class="k">تلفن</span><span class="v">${faNum(p.phone)}</span></div>
      ${p.postal ? `<div class="kv"><span class="k">کد پستی</span><span class="v">${faNum(p.postal)}</span></div>` : ""}
      ${p.note ? `<div class="kv"><span class="k">توضیح</span><span class="v">${esc(p.note)}</span></div>` : ""}
      ${p.fee ? `<div class="kv"><span class="k">هزینهٔ ارسال</span><span class="v">${faNum(p.fee)} ریال</span></div>` : ""}
      ${p.tracking ? `<div class="kv"><span class="k">کد رهگیری</span><span class="v">${esc(p.tracking)}</span></div>` : ""}
      ${p.can_ship ? `<div class="btnrow" style="margin-top:8px">
        <input class="finp" id="trk${p.id}" placeholder="کد رهگیری پست" />
        <button class="btn pri" data-cship="${p.id}">ثبت و اعلام به کاربر</button></div>` : ""}
    </div>`).join("");
  return back + `<div class="h2">درخواست‌های پستی</div>
    ${rows || `<div class="card g"><div class="empty">${svg("i-clip")}<div class="t1">درخواست پستی نیست</div></div></div>`}`;
}
async function certPostShip(pid) {
  const el = document.getElementById("trk" + pid);
  const code = el ? String(el.value || "").trim() : "";
  if (code.length < 5) { showToast("کد رهگیری کوتاه است"); return; }
  if (state.cert.busy) return;
  state.cert.busy = true;
  try {
    const r = await api(`/api/certposts/${pid}/ship`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ tracking: code }) });
    showToast(r.result && r.result.result === "shipped" ? "ارسال ثبت شد" : "ناموفق");
    await certPostsLoad? -> state.cert.posts = null
  } catch (e) { w5err(e); }
  state.cert.busy = false;
  state.cert.posts = null; render();
}

"""تست فاز ۳۱: ارسال پستی گواهینامه — خدمت، پرداخت، بات، وب."""

from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.certposts import POST_CANCELLED, POST_OPEN, POST_SENT, CertPostRepo
from nora.domain.certs import CertRepo
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.payments import PaymentRepo
from nora.domain.settings import SettingsRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.event_service import EventService
from nora.services.pay_service import PayService
from nora.services.post_service import STATUS_PAID, STATUS_PENDING_PAY, PostService


@pytest.fixture()
def clock():
    fc = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(fc)
    yield fc
    set_clock(old)


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db, clock):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    certs = CertRepo(db, clock)
    cprepo = CertPostRepo(db, clock)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db, clock)
    setrepo = SettingsRepo(db)
    postsvc = PostService(cprepo, erepo, payrepo, clock)
    esvc = EventService(erepo, clock)
    psvc = PayService(payrepo, erepo, esvc, setrepo, clock)
    return urepo, erepo, certs, cprepo, payrepo, postsvc, psvc


def mk_user(urepo, bale, phone=""):
    u = urepo.create(bale)
    kw = {"status": "approved"}
    if phone:
        kw["phone"] = phone
    urepo.update(u.id, **kw)
    return urepo.get(u.id)


def mk_ev(erepo, **kw):
    fields = {"title": "کارگاه امداد", "kind": "workshop",
              "start_ts": 1789000000.0, "status": "finished",
              "has_cert": 1, "cert_post": 1}
    fields.update(kw)
    return erepo.create_event(**fields)


def mk_cert(certs, ev, user_id, code="A1B2C3"):
    return certs.issue(ev.id, user_id, code, {}, 0)


# ---------- خدمت ----------

def test_post_enabled_and_variants(env):
    _, erepo, _, _, _, postsvc, _ = env
    ev = mk_ev(erepo)
    assert postsvc.post_enabled(ev)
    assert postsvc.variants_for(ev) == ("glossy", "signed")
    ev2 = mk_ev(erepo, title="بدون پست", cert_post=0)
    assert not postsvc.post_enabled(ev2)
    ev3 = mk_ev(erepo, title="فقط گلاسه", cert_post_opts="glossy")
    assert postsvc.variants_for(ev3) == ("glossy",)


def test_request_validation(env):
    urepo, erepo, certs, _, _, postsvc, _ = env
    u = mk_user(urepo, 1)
    ev = mk_ev(erepo, cert_post_fee=5000)
    cert = mk_cert(certs, ev, u.id)
    ok = dict(variant="glossy", recipient="مریم رادمهر",
              phone="09121234567",
              address="تهران، خیابان آزادی، کوچه گل، پلاک ۱۲، واحد ۳",
              postal_code="1234567890", note="زنگ نزنید")
    assert postsvc.request(u.id, cert, "signed", **{**ok, "variant": "signed"})[1] == ""
    cert2 = mk_cert(certs, ev, u.id, code="B2C3D4")  # گواهی دوم همان رویداد
    bad = [
        ({**ok, "variant": "wood"}, "post_bad_variant"),
        ({**ok, "recipient": "مر"}, "post_bad_name"),
        ({**ok, "phone": "12"}, "post_bad_phone"),
        ({**ok, "address": "تهران"}, "post_bad_addr"),
        ({**ok, "postal_code": "123"}, "post_bad_postal"),
    ]
    for kw, err in bad:
        post, e = postsvc.request(u.id, cert2, **kw)
        assert post is None and e == err, kw
    # درخواست تکراری برای گواهی اول — قبول نمی‌شود
    post, e = postsvc.request(u.id, cert, **ok)
    assert post is None and e == "post_exists"


def test_status_ship_cancel(env):
    urepo, erepo, certs, cprepo, _, postsvc, _ = env
    u = mk_user(urepo, 1)
    ev = mk_ev(erepo, cert_post_fee=5000)
    cert = mk_cert(certs, ev, u.id)
    post, err = postsvc.request(u.id, cert, "glossy", "مریم رادمهر",
                                "09121234567",
                                "تهران، خیابان آزادی، پلاک ۱۲، واحد ۳",
                                "1234567890", "")
    assert err == "" and post.fee == 5000
    assert postsvc.status_of(post) == STATUS_PENDING_PAY
    # ارسال پیش از پرداخت — رد
    assert postsvc.ship(post.id, "TRK123456")[1] == "post_not_paid"
    # لغو پیش از پرداخت — آزاد
    post2, _ = postsvc.request(u.id, mk_cert(certs, ev, u.id, "C3D4E5"),
                               "signed", "مریم رادمهر", "09121234567",
                               "تهران، خیابان آزادی، پلاک ۱۲، واحد ۳",
                               "", "")
    assert postsvc.cancel(u.id, post2.id) == ""
    assert cprepo.get(post2.id).status == POST_CANCELLED
    # لغوِ پرداخت‌نشدهٔ اول هم مجاز است — ولی اول صف را بررسی می‌کنیم
    q = postsvc.queue()
    assert [p.id for p in q] == [post.id, post2.id]  # بازها، لغوشده نیست


def test_ship_after_pay(env):
    urepo, erepo, certs, cprepo, payrepo, postsvc, psvc = env
    u = mk_user(urepo, 1)
    ev = mk_ev(erepo, cert_post_fee=3000)
    cert = mk_cert(certs, ev, u.id)
    post, err = postsvc.request(u.id, cert, "glossy", "مریم رادمهر",
                                "09121234567",
                                "تهران، خیابان آزادی، پلاک ۱۲، واحد ۳",
                                "", "")
    assert err == ""
    st = psvc.start_cert_post(u, post, "card")
    assert st.payment is not None and st.payment.target_kind == "cert_post"
    assert st.payment.target_id == post.id
    # idempotent — پرداخت باز دوم ساخته نمی‌شود
    st2 = psvc.start_cert_post(u, post, "card")
    assert st2.payment.id == st.payment.id
    payrepo.set_receipt(st.payment.id, "file1", "wait")
    assert postsvc.status_of(post) == STATUS_PENDING_PAY
    res = psvc.mark_manual(st.payment.id)
    assert res.kind == "paid"
    assert postsvc.status_of(cprepo.get(post.id)) == STATUS_PAID
    # لغو پس از پرداخت — فقط پشتیبانی
    assert postsvc.cancel(u.id, post.id) == "post_paid_support"
    # کد رهگیری کوتاه — رد
    assert postsvc.ship(post.id, "12")[1] == "post_bad_track"
    sent, e2 = postsvc.ship(post.id, "TRK-98765")
    assert e2 == "" and sent.status == POST_SENT and sent.tracking == "TRK-98765"
    # ارسال دوباره — رد
    assert postsvc.ship(post.id, "TRK-00000")[1] == "post_not_open"
    # صف: ارسال‌شده در queue نمی‌ماند
    assert post.id not in [p.id for p in postsvc.queue()]


def test_free_post_goes_straight_to_queue(env):
    urepo, erepo, certs, _, _, postsvc, _ = env
    u = mk_user(urepo, 1)
    ev = mk_ev(erepo, cert_post_fee=0)
    cert = mk_cert(certs, ev, u.id)
    post, err = postsvc.request(u.id, cert, "signed", "مریم رادمهر",
                                "09121234567",
                                "تهران، خیابان آزادی، پلاک ۱۲، واحد ۳",
                                "", "")
    assert err == "" and postsvc.status_of(post) == STATUS_PAID
    assert [p.id for p in postsvc.queue()] == [post.id]

@pytest.fixture()
def botenv(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock, transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    certs = CertRepo(db, clock)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved",
                 full_name="ادمین گروه")
    member = urepo.create(10, first_name="مریم")
    urepo.update(member.id, status="approved", full_name="مریم رادمهر",
                 phone="09121234567")
    yield bot, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, certs, member
    set_clock(old)


def cb(data, uid=10):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}}, "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=10):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()


def last_text(sent):
    return str(sent[-1].get("text", ""))


def all_text(sent):
    return "\n".join(str(p.get("text", "")) for p in sent)


def _scene(botenv, fee=0):
    bot, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, certs, member = botenv
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه امداد", kind="workshop",
                            start_ts=1789000000.0, status="finished",
                            has_cert=1, cert_post=1, cert_post_fee=fee)
    cert = certs.issue(ev.id, member.id, "A1B2C3", {}, 0)
    return ev, cert


def test_bot_post_flow_free(botenv):
    bot, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, certs, member = botenv
    ev, cert = _scene(botenv, fee=0)
    # دکمهٔ پست در صفحهٔ گواهیِ کاربر
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"mycerte:{ev.id}"))
    assert f"cpost:{cert.id}" in str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", ""))
    # شروع
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"cpost:{cert.id}"))
    txt = last_text(sent)
    assert "برگهٔ گلاسه" in txt and "امضا زنده" in txt
    assert f"cpostv:{cert.id}:glossy" in str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", ""))
    # گونه
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"cpostv:{cert.id}:glossy"))
    assert "گیرنده" in last_text(sent)
    # نام → تلفن (با دکمهٔ شمارهٔ پروفایل)
    step(bot, clock, msg("مریم رادمهر"))
    assert "تلفن" in last_text(sent)
    assert "cpostuse:1" in str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", ""))
    step(bot, clock, cb("cpostuse:1"))
    assert "نشانی" in last_text(sent)
    # نشانی → کد پستی
    step(bot, clock, msg("تهران، خیابان آزادی، کوچه گل، پلاک ۱۲، واحد ۳"))
    assert "کد پستی" in last_text(sent)
    assert "cpostskip:1" in str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", ""))
    step(bot, clock, cb("cpostskip:1"))
    assert "توضیحی برای ارسال" in last_text(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb("cpostskip:1"))
    # مرور
    assert "مرور" in last_text(sent)
    assert "09121234567" in last_text(sent) or "۰۹۱۲۱۲۳۴۵۶۷" in last_text(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb("cpostok:1"))
    assert "درخواست پستی ثبت شد" in last_text(sent)
    assert "myposts:1" in str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", ""))
    # فهرست من
    step(bot, clock, cb("myposts:1"))
    assert "در صف ارسال" in last_text(sent)
    # مدیر: صف + ثبت کد رهگیری
    step(bot, clock, cb("postq:1"))
    assert "مریم رادمهر" in last_text(sent)
    assert "postship:" in str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", ""))
    pid = str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", "")).split("postship:")[1].split(":")[0]
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"postship:{pid}", uid=999))
    assert "کد رهگیری" in last_text(sent)
    step(bot, clock, msg("TRK123456", uid=999))
    assert "ارسال ثبت شد" in last_text(sent)
    # خبر به کاربر با کد رهگیری
    assert "TRK123456" in all_text(sent)
    # کاربر: پیگیری
    step(bot, clock, cb("myposts:1"))
    assert "ارسال شد" in last_text(sent)


def test_bot_post_flow_paid(botenv):
    bot, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, certs, member = botenv
    ev, cert = _scene(botenv, fee=5000)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"cpost:{cert.id}"))
    assert "۵٬۰۰۰" in last_text(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"cpostv:{cert.id}:signed"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("مریم رادمهر"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("۰۹۱۲۱۲۳۴۵۶۷"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("تهران، خیابان آزادی، کوچه گل، پلاک ۱۲، واحد ۳"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹۰"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("—"))
    assert "۵٬۰۰۰" in last_text(sent)          # مرور با هزینه
    step(bot, clock, cb("cpostok:1"))
    txt = last_text(sent)
    assert "درخواست پستی ثبت شد" in txt and "۵٬۰۰۰" in txt
    assert "postpay:" in str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", ""))
    pid = str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", "")).split("postpay:")[1].split("\\")[0].split('"')[0]
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"postpay:{pid}"))
    assert "پرداخت هزینهٔ ارسال" in last_text(sent)
    assert "postpaym:" in str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", ""))
    # صف مدیر: پیش از پرداخت، دکمهٔ ارسال ندارد
    step(bot, clock, cb("postq:1", uid=999))
    assert "در انتظار پرداخت" in last_text(sent)
    assert "postship:" not in str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", ""))


def test_bot_post_guards(botenv):
    bot, clock, sent, urepo, erepo, certs, member = botenv
    ev, cert = _scene(botenv, fee=0)
    # کاربر دیگر نمی‌تواند درخواستِ او را ببیند
    other = urepo.create(77)
    urepo.update(other.id, status="approved")
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"cpost:{cert.id}", uid=77))
    assert "پیدا نشد" in last_text(sent)
    # غیرادمین به صف نمی‌رسد
    step(bot, clock, cb("postq:1", uid=10))
    assert last_text(sent)
    # رویداد بدون پست — دکمه‌ای در صفحهٔ گواهی نیست
    ev2 = erepo.create_event(title="بدون پست", kind="meeting",
                             start_ts=1789000000.0, status="finished",
                             has_cert=1, cert_post=0)
    cert2 = certs.issue(ev2.id, member.id, "D4E5F6", {}, 0)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"cpost:{cert2.id}"))
    assert "ارسال پستی ندارد" in last_text(sent)

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_web_posts(db, fake_clock):
    from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer
    from web.server import create_app
    from tests.test_web_certs import FakeResponder

    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    certs = CertRepo(db, fake_clock)
    cprepo = CertPostRepo(db, fake_clock)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db, fake_clock)
    postsvc = PostService(cprepo, erepo, payrepo, fake_clock)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="مدیر")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="owner", status="approved")
    member = urepo.create(10, first_name="مریم")
    urepo.update(member.id, status="approved", full_name="مریم رادمهر")
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه امداد", kind="workshop",
                            start_ts=1789000000.0, status="finished",
                            has_cert=1, cert_post=1, cert_post_fee=0)
    cert = certs.issue(ev.id, member.id, "A1B2C3", {}, 0)
    post, err = postsvc.request(member.id, cert, "glossy", "مریم رادمهر",
                                "09121234567",
                                "تهران، خیابان آزادی، پلاک ۱۲، واحد ۳",
                                "1234567890", "")
    assert err == "" and post is not None

    fake = FakeResponder()
    settings = Settings(env="dev", bot_token="123:T", admin_ids=(999,))
    app = create_app(settings, db, dev_bale_id=999, responder=fake,
                     clock=fake_clock)
    client = TestClient(TestServer(app))
    await client.start_server()
    try:
        r = await client.post("/api/auth", json={"dev": True})
        hdr = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + (await r.json())["token"]}
        r = await client.get("/api/certposts", headers=hdr)
        assert r.status == 200
        rows = (await r.json())["rows"]
        assert rows and rows[0]["id"] == post.id and rows[0]["can_ship"]
        assert rows[0]["postal"] == "1234567890"
        # کد رهگیری کوتاه — رد
        r = await client.post(f"/api/certposts/{post.id}/ship", headers=hdr,
                              json={"tracking": "1"})
        assert (await r.json())["result"]["result"] == "post_bad_track"
        # ثبت درست + خبر به کاربر
        r = await client.post(f"/api/certposts/{post.id}/ship", headers=hdr,
                              json={"tracking": "TRK-555"})
        body = await r.json()
        assert body["result"]["result"] == "shipped"
        assert ("bulk", 10, "post_shipped_notify") in fake.sent
        rows = (await (await client.get("/api/certposts",
                                        headers=hdr)).json())["rows"]
        row = next(x for x in rows if x["id"] == post.id)
        assert row["status"] == "sent" and row["tracking"] == "TRK-555"
        assert not row["can_ship"]
        # نقش بدون مجوز — ۴۰۳
        r2 = await client.post("/api/auth", json={"dev": True})  # همان owner
        assert r2.status == 200
    finally:
        await client.close()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_web_posts_gate(db, fake_clock):
    from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer
    from web.server import create_app
    from tests.test_web_certs import FakeResponder

    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    op = urepo.create(991, first_name="اپراتور")
    urepo.update(op.id, role="operator", status="approved")
    settings = Settings(env="dev", bot_token="123:T", admin_ids=(991,))
    app = create_app(settings, db, dev_bale_id=991,
                     responder=FakeResponder(), clock=fake_clock)
    client = TestClient(TestServer(app))
    await client.start_server()
    try:
        r = await client.post("/api/auth", json={"dev": True})
        hdr = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + (await r.json())["token"]}
        r = await client.get("/api/certposts", headers=hdr)
        assert r.status == 403
    finally:
        await client.close()

"""دادهٔ نمونهٔ فاز ۳۱ برای پیش‌نمایش وب — idempotent.

python tools/seed_certpost_preview.py [db_path]
پیش‌فرض: var/web-preview.db
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from nora.core.db import Database  # noqa: E402
from nora.domain.certposts import CertPostRepo  # noqa: E402
from nora.domain.certs import CertRepo  # noqa: E402
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo  # noqa: E402
from nora.domain.payments import PaymentRepo  # noqa: E402
from nora.domain.settings import SettingsRepo  # noqa: E402
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo  # noqa: E402
from nora.services.event_service import EventService  # noqa: E402
from nora.services.pay_service import PayService  # noqa: E402
from nora.services.post_service import PostService  # noqa: E402

ADDR = ("تهران، خیابان انقلاب، نبش کوچهٔ مهر، پلاک ۲۴، واحد ۵")


def main() -> None:
    path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "var/web-preview.db"
    db = Database(path)
    urepo, erepo = UserRepo(db), EventRepo(db)
    clock = None
    certs = CertRepo(db, clock)
    cprepo = CertPostRepo(db, clock)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db, clock)
    setrepo = SettingsRepo(db)
    esvc = EventService(erepo, clock)
    psvc = PayService(payrepo, erepo, esvc, setrepo, clock)
    postsvc = PostService(cprepo, erepo, payrepo, clock)

    rows = db.query("SELECT id, event_id, user_id, code FROM certs "
                    "ORDER BY id LIMIT 4")
    if not rows:
        print("گواهی‌ای در db نیست — اول demo_seed را اجرا کنید.")
        return
    ev = erepo.get_event(rows[0]["event_id"])
    erepo.update_event(ev.id, cert_post=1, cert_post_fee=15000,
                       cert_post_opts="glossy|signed")
    print(f"رویداد «{ev.title}» → cert_post=1 fee=15000")

    made = 0
    for r in rows[:2]:
        cert = certs.get(r["id"])
        if cprepo.active_for_cert(cert.id) is not None:
            continue
        u = urepo.get(cert.user_id)
        name = u.full_name or f"کاربر {u.bale_id}"
        post, err = postsvc.request(
            u.id, cert, "glossy", name, u.phone or "09121234567",
            ADDR, "1357924680", "")
        if post is None:
            print("خطا:", err)
            continue
        made += 1
        if made == 2:
            st = psvc.start_cert_post(u, post, "card")
            if st.payment is not None:
                payrepo.set_receipt(st.payment.id, "seed", "wait")
                psvc.mark_manual(st.payment.id)
                print(f"  درخواست {post.id} ({name}) → پرداخت‌شده، در صف ارسال")
        else:
            print(f"  درخواست {post.id} ({name}) → در انتظار پرداخت")
    print(f"پایان — {made} درخواست نو. کل بازها: {len(cprepo.by_status('open'))}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Wait — is_repeat_text does both the check and the recording in one go:

python


    def _is_repeat_text(self, ctx: Ctx, text: str) -> bool:
        norm = " ".join(text.split())
        prev = self._last_text.get(ctx.user_id, "")
        self._last_text[ctx.user_id] = norm
        if prev != norm or len(norm) < 2 or self.assist is None:
            return False
        self.assist.record(ctx.user_id, "repeat_text")
        self._maybe_suggest(ctx)
        return True
Only call this for text that's neither a command nor /start — the if text: block is after command/start handling ✓ (the escape/doctor/start branches return earlier).

_note_tap:_
python


    TAP_WINDOW_SEC = 180
    def _note_tap(self, ctx: Ctx) -> None:
        if self.assist is None or not ctx.data:
            return
        uid = ctx.user_id
        now = self.clock.ts()
        hist = [e for e in self._tap_hist.get(uid, ())
                if now - e[1] <= 180]
        hist.append((ctx.data, now))
        self._tap_hist[uid] = hist
        same = sum(1 for d, _ in hist if d == ctx.data)
        if same >= 3:
            self.assist.record(uid, "repeat_tap")

"""تست فاز ۳۲: شناسایی کاربر گیج → پیشنهاد راهنما/ثبت درخواست پشتیبانی."""

from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo


@pytest.fixture()
def botenv(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock, transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    member = urepo.create(10, first_name="مریم")
    urepo.update(member.id, status="approved", full_name="مریم رادمهر")
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved")
    yield bot, clock, sent, db
    set_clock(old)


def cb(data, uid=10):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}}, "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=10):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.005)   # ۱۸ ثانیه — زیر پنجرهٔ تپ، بالای کول‌دان ۱.۲s
    bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()


def all_text(sent):
    return "\n".join(str(p.get("text", "")) for p in sent)


def all_markup(sent):
    return "\n".join(str(p.get("reply_markup", "")) for p in sent)


def count_offer(sent):
    return all_text(sent).count("به نتیجه نرسید")


def test_repeat_tap_triggers_offer(botenv):
    bot, clock, sent, db = botenv
    for _ in range(4):
        step(bot, clock, cb("help:no_route"))
        assert count_offer(sent) == 0          # هنوز آستانه پر نشده
    step(bot, clock, cb("help:no_route"))      # تپ پنجم → سومین سیگنال
    assert count_offer(sent) == 1
    assert "sosk:repeat_tap" in all_markup(sent)
    assert "درخواست پشتیبانی" in all_text(sent) or \
        "درخواست پشتیبانی" in all_markup(sent)
    # تپ بعدی — پیشنهاد تکرار نمی‌شود (کول‌دان یک ساعته)
    step(bot, clock, cb("help:no_route"))
    assert count_offer(sent) == 1


def test_repeat_text_triggers_offer(botenv):
    bot, clock, sent, db = botenv
    step(bot, clock, msg("سلام، کسی نیست؟"))
    assert count_offer(sent) == 0
    kind = bot.process_update(msg("سلام، کسی نیست؟"))
    bot.outbox.drain()
    # متن تکراری = repeat_text + no_route دوم → آستانهٔ ۳ پر می‌شود
    assert count_offer(sent) == 1
    assert "sosk:no_route" in all_markup(sent)   # پرتکرارترین نوع


def test_sosk_creates_ticket_with_context(botenv):
    bot, clock, sent, db = botenv
    # سه سیگنال گیجی با متن بی‌مسیر
    step(bot, clock, msg("دنبال بخش گواهی‌ها می‌گردم"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("کجای رباته اینا"))
    kind = bot.process_update(msg("پیداش نمی‌کنم"))
    bot.outbox.drain()
    assert kind == "help-offered"
    assert "sosk:no_route" in all_markup(sent)
    # ثبت درخواست پشتیبانی از همان پیشنهاد
    step(bot, clock, cb("sosk:no_route"))
    assert "موضوع فوری را بنویس" in all_text(sent)
    step(bot, clock, msg("هرچی می‌گردم بخش گواهی رو پیدا نمی‌کنم"))
    assert "رسید؛ به‌زودی پاسخ می‌دهیم" in all_text(sent)
    assert "کمک خواست" in all_text(sent)          # خبر به ادمین
    # تیکت با ردیف زمینهٔ گیر
    row = db.query_one("SELECT text FROM support_msgs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1")
    assert row is not None
    body = str(row["text"])
    assert "هرچی می‌گردم" in body
    assert "آخرین گیر" in body and "پیدا نکردن بخش مورد نظر" in body
    # تیکت فوری با اولویت بالا ثبت شده
    trow = db.query_one("SELECT priority FROM support_tickets ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1")
    assert int(trow["priority"]) == 1


def test_normal_use_no_offer(botenv):
    bot, clock, sent, db = botenv
    # استفادهٔ عادی: دکمه‌های مختلف، متن‌های مختلف — پیشنهادی نمی‌آید
    step(bot, clock, cb("help:no_route"))
    step(bot, clock, cb("help:bad_input"))
    step(bot, clock, cb("help:no_route"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("سلام"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("ممنون"))
    assert count_offer(sent) == 0


def test_mixed_signals(botenv):
    bot, clock, sent, db = botenv
    step(bot, clock, msg("چطوری ثبت‌نام کنم"))       # no_route ×1
    step(bot, clock, cb("help:no_route"))              # تپ ۱
    step(bot, clock, cb("help:no_route"))              # تپ ۲
    step(bot, clock, cb("help:no_route"))              # تپ ۳ → repeat_tap ×1
    assert count_offer(sent) == 0                      # جمعاً ۲ سیگنال
    step(bot, clock, msg("چطوری ثبت‌نام کنم"))        # repeat_text + no_route
    assert count_offer(sent) == 1                      # ۴ سیگنال ≥ ۳

تشخیص — مرکزی در Bot (بدون AI هم کار می‌کند)
سیگنال‌های گیجی (help_events):

سیگنال	منبع	معنا
no_route	متن بی‌مسیر (fallback)	دنبال چیزی است که پیدا نمی‌کند
otp_wrong	ورود کد تأیید	در ورود مانده
repeat_tap	نو — _note_tap: ≥۳ تپ روی یک دکمه در ۱۸۰ ثانیه	دکمه را الکی می‌کوبد / راه را گم کرده
repeat_text	نو — _note_repeat_text: همان پیام دو بار پشت‌هم	جواب نگرفته، دوباره می‌گوید
هر دو هوک مرکزی در Bot._route هستند — هیچ صفحه‌ای دست‌نخورده ماند.
آستانه: ۳ رویداد در پنجرهٔ ۱۰ دقیقه → پیشنهاد؛ کول‌دان یک ساعته هر کاربر.
AI خاموش (AI_ENABLED=0) هم تشخیص کار می‌کند: DisabledProvider → fallback →

Phase 33 scope (from the plan):

G1 Club: point ledger (triggers: attendance, survey, registration, profile completion, friend referral), 4 levels + 13 badges + progress bar, atomic reward shop with return-on-rejection, 4 ranking tables (anonymous), point payment, conditional points (8 triggers)

This is very large. Let's think about how to structure it realistically:

Domain:

nora/domain/club.py:
club_ledger table: id, user_id, delta, reason (trigger key), ref (e.g.: reg_id/att_id), ts, note?
ClubRepo: add(user_id, delta, reason, ref), balance(user_id), history(user_id, limit), top(limit, since?), count of users with points, unique reasons.
Deduplication: unique(user_id, reason, ref) to prevent double-awarding — UNIQUE index where ref != ''.
club_redeems table (reward shop orders): id, user_id, item_key, cost, status (pending/approved/rejected/delivered), created_ts, handled_ts, by.
Badge tracking: derived from ledger + stats (no table) or club_badges? nora1 had 13 badges / 4 levels. Derived calculation is cleaner: badge = condition on balance/history count. Level is a threshold on balance (or earned total). Use lifetime earned (sum of positive deltas) for levels — standard.
Point settings via SettingsRepo kv (similar to other features): club_enabled, club_rate_* (points per trigger), club_levels (thresholds), club_rewards (item list key/label/cost), etc. nora1 had per-trigger settings with 8 triggers / 6 rules. Keep: per-trigger amounts configurable via kv with defaults.
nora/domain/lottery.py: lotteries table: id, title, event_id (optional), prize(s), method, status (draft/open/drawn/cancelled), participants? nora1: 6 selection methods (from event registrants, from club members, from all users, manual list, ticket-based?), 3 execution timings (immediate, scheduled, on-demand?). Keep: participants table lottery_entries (lottery_id, user_id, tickets count, ts). Draw with SystemRandom, atomic lock (status transition drawn), multiple prizes (N winners).*_
Service:

nora/services/club_service.py: award(user, trigger, ref) — reads rates from setrepo, deduplicates, updates ledger, checks level-up/badge unlocks → returns events for notification; balance; levels; badge calculation; ranking (4 boards: overall, monthly, event-based?, anonymous mode); shop redeem (atomic: balance check + insertion of redeem holding points? nora1: atomic deduction, VIP/discount delivery, return on rejection). Design: redeem creates a hold (negative ledger entry with reason=redeem, ref=redeem_id); admin approves → delivered; rejects → reversal entry (return).
Point payment (P13: پرداخت با امتیاز): a payment method where cost is covered by points at some conversion rate (setrepo: points_per_rial?). Integration into pay_service methods… this is big. Simplify: at the registration wizard, if user has enough points and club_points_pay is enabled → offer "پرداخت با امتیاز" (Pay with points) option → atomic deduction + mark registration as paid with method="points". Hmm — integration with pay_service/payrepo: create a Payment with method "points" status paid directly? payrepo probably has create with target_kind… The cleanest approach: ClubService.pay_with_points(user, reg/amount) → verify, atomically deduct, record payment in payrepo (method="points", status=paid) so financial reports stay consistent.
nora/services/lottery_service.py: create, entry (auto from event registrants / manual / club), draw (6 methods), atomic.
Bot screens:

screens/club.py: User: "باشگاه من" (My Club) (balance, level + progress, badges, history, ranking, shop, referral code + share), Admin: rate settings, rewards, lottery (create/draw). Referral: deep link /start ref_{code} — main.py has on_deeplink chain; add ref payload handler → award both parties.
Lottery admin: "قرعه‌کشی" (Lottery) create → select target audience → draw → announce winners; user: my lotteries / results.
NPS question type in surveys (add type "nps" to screens/surveys.py → 0-10 selection)._
Web:

nora/domain/club.py (new):

python


CLUB_TRIGGERS = ("register","attend","survey","profile","referral","referee","payment","welcome")  # 8 triggers
LEDGER reasons: trigger key or "redeem:{item}" / "refund:{redeem_id}" / "spend:pay" / "adjust"
ClubRepo(db, clock):
  Tables:
  - club_ledger: id, user_id, delta INT, reason TEXT, ref TEXT DEFAULT '', ts REAL, note TEXT DEFAULT ''
    UNIQUE index on (user_id, reason, ref) when ref != ''? SQLite's unique index works with '' too — (user_id,reason,ref) unique prevents duplicates; use ref='' for adjustments… multiple adjustments would collide. Make ref optional and deduplicate by checking: award_if_absent(user_id, reason, ref) → SELECT 1 WHERE user_id,reason,ref → INSERT. No unique index (simpler, and transactions are handled on the service side).
  - club_redeems: id, user_id, item TEXT, cost INT, status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' (pending/delivered/rejected), created_ts, handled_ts, admin_id
  - Referral: users table — is there a ref code column? Probably not. Store in club_referrals table: code TEXT UNIQUE, user_id, invited_count. Or compute code from user ID: f"ref_{bale_id}" — simple, no table needed! Deep link payload "ref_{bale_id}" → referee registration → award to both parties, deduplication: ledger reason="referee" ref=str(inviter_bale) for the invitee side (only once per invitee), reason="referral" ref=str(invitee_user_id) for the inviter side (only once per invited user). Store in ledger only.
  Methods:
  - add(user_id, delta, reason, ref="", note="") -> int (entry ID)
  - has(user_id, reason, ref) -> bool
  - balance(user_id) -> int  (SELECT SUM(delta))
  - earned_total(user_id) -> int (SUM of delta>0) — for levels
  - history(user_id, limit=10)
  - top(limit=10, since_ts=0.0) -> list[(user_id, total)] (delta>0, group by user, order desc; monthly = since start of month)
  - spend(user_id, amount, reason, ref) -> bool atomic: within transaction: if balance >= amount → INSERT negative row.
  - Redeem CRUD: redeem_create(user_id,item,cost) (spend first), redeem_list(status), redeem_get, redeem_set_status(id,status,admin_id) + refund (add positive with reason refund ref=redeem:{id})

class LotteryService:
  def __init__(lotrepo, erepo, attrepo?, clubrepo, urepo, clock)
  create(title, method, event_id, prize, winners_n, manual_ids, by)
  eligible(lot) -> list[user_id]:
    event_regs: erepo regs confirmed for event (need a regs list method — erepo.regs_for_event? check existing: event repo has regs… need to grep)
    event_attendees: attrepo.present_user_ids(event_id)? check method
    club_members: users with balance>0 → clubrepo.users_with_points()
    all_users: urepo.all_approved_ids()
    manual: parsed ids
    point_holders: clubrepo.users_with_points(min_balance?) — overlaps with club_members… replace the 6th with "survey respondents"? Keep: event_regs, event_attendees, club_members, all_users, manual, payers (users with paid payments → payrepo.paid_user_ids?) — check what's feasible with existing repo methods. If needed, implement helper SQL directly in lottery service via repos (service can query via repos; adding small methods to repos is OK).
  draw(lot, rng=None) -> (winners, err): atomic status open→drawn (UPDATE ... WHERE status='open' check rowcount), collect eligible, SystemRandom.sample, prizes are indexed, add_winner rows, return winners.

"""باشگاه امتیاز — دامنه (فاز ۳۳).

دفتر کل امتیاز (ledger) با دلیل و مرجع برای ضدتکرار، درخواست‌های فروشگاه
پاداش، و کدهای دعوت. منطق سطح/نشان/رتبه در ClubService است نه اینجا.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from ..core.clock import Clock, get_clock
from ..core.db import Database

# هشت تریگر امتیاز (مطابق نورا۱) — کلید تنظیمات: club_rate_<trigger>
TRIGGERS = ("welcome", "register", "attend", "survey", "profile",
            "payment", "referral", "referee")

REDEEM_PENDING = "pending"
REDEEM_DELIVERED = "delivered"
REDEEM_REJECTED = "rejected"


@dataclass
class LedgerRow:
    id: int
    user_id: int
    delta: int
    reason: str
    ref: str
    ts: float


@dataclass
class Redeem:
    id: int
    user_id: int
    item_key: str
    item_label: str
    cost: int
    status: str
    created_ts: float
    handled_ts: float
    admin_id: int


def _row_ledger(r) -> LedgerRow:
    return LedgerRow(int(r["id"]), int(r["user_id"]), int(r["delta"]),
                     str(r["reason"]), str(r["ref"] or ""), float(r["ts"]))


def _row_redeem(r) -> Redeem:
    return Redeem(int(r["id"]), int(r["user_id"]), str(r["item_key"]),
                  str(r["item_label"] or ""), int(r["cost"]),
                  str(r["status"]), float(r["created_ts"]),
                  float(r["handled_ts"] or 0), int(r["admin_id"] or 0))


class ClubRepo:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, clock: Clock | None = None) -> None:
        self.db = db
        self.clock = clock or get_clock()
        db.ensure_table("club_ledger", [
            ("user_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("delta", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("reason", "TEXT NOT NULL"),
            ("ref", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ])
        db.ensure_index("ix_club_user", "club_ledger", ["user_id", "ts"])
        db.ensure_table("club_redeems", [
            ("user_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("item_key", "TEXT NOT NULL"),
            ("item_label", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("cost", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("status", f"TEXT DEFAULT '{REDEEM_PENDING}'"),
            ("created_ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("handled_ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("admin_id", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ])
        db.ensure_table("club_refs", [
            ("invitee_bale", "INTEGER UNIQUE NOT NULL"),
            ("inviter_bale", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ])

    def _now(self) -> float:
        return self.clock.ts()

    # ---------- ledger ----------

    def add(self, user_id: int, delta: int, reason: str,
            ref: str = "") -> int:
        with self.db.transaction():
            cur = self.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO club_ledger (user_id, delta, reason, ref, ts) "
                "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
                (user_id, int(delta), reason, ref, self._now()))
            return int(cur.lastrowid or 0)

    def has(self, user_id: int, reason: str, ref: str) -> bool:
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT id FROM club_ledger WHERE user_id = ? AND reason = ? "
            "AND ref = ? LIMIT 1", (user_id, reason, ref))
        return row is not None

    def balance(self, user_id: int) -> int:
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(delta), 0) AS s FROM club_ledger "
            "WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
        return int(row["s"]) if row else 0

    def earned_total(self, user_id: int) -> int:
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(delta), 0) AS s FROM club_ledger "
            "WHERE user_id = ? AND delta > 0", (user_id,))
        return int(row["s"]) if row else 0

    def count_reason(self, user_id: int, reason: str) -> int:
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM club_ledger "
            "WHERE user_id = ? AND reason = ? AND delta > 0",
            (user_id, reason))
        return int(row["n"]) if row else 0

    def history(self, user_id: int, limit: int = 12) -> list[LedgerRow]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM club_ledger WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY ts DESC, "
            "id DESC LIMIT ?", (user_id, int(limit)))
        return [_row_ledger(r) for r in rows]

    def spend(self, user_id: int, amount: int, reason: str,
              ref: str = "") -> bool:
        """کسر اتمی — فقط اگر موجودی کافی باشد."""
        amount = int(amount)
        if amount <= 0:
            return False
        with self.db.transaction():
            if self.balance(user_id) < amount:
                return False
            self.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO club_ledger (user_id, delta, reason, ref, ts) "
                "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
                (user_id, -amount, reason, ref, self._now()))
        return True

    def top(self, limit: int = 5, since_ts: float = 0.0,
            reason: str = "") -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
        sql = ("SELECT user_id, SUM(delta) AS s FROM club_ledger "
               "WHERE delta > 0")
        args: list = []
        if since_ts:
            sql += " AND ts >= ?"
            args.append(float(since_ts))
        if reason:
            sql += " AND reason = ?"
            args.append(reason)
        sql += " GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT ?"
        args.append(int(limit))
        return [(int(r["user_id"]), int(r["s"]))
                for r in self.db.query(sql, tuple(args))]

    def member_count(self) -> int:
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS n FROM club_ledger "
            "WHERE delta > 0")
        return int(row["n"]) if row else 0

    def point_sum(self) -> int:
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(delta), 0) AS s FROM club_ledger")
        return int(row["s"]) if row else 0

    def users_with_points(self, min_balance: int = 1) -> list[int]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT user_id, SUM(delta) AS s FROM club_ledger GROUP BY user_id")
        return [int(r["user_id"]) for r in rows
                if int(r["s"]) >= int(min_balance)]

    # ---------- فروشگاه پاداش ----------

    def redeem_create(self, user_id: int, item_key: str, item_label: str,
                      cost: int) -> int:
        with self.db.transaction():
            cur = self.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO club_redeems (user_id, item_key, item_label, "
                "cost, status, created_ts) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (user_id, item_key, item_label, int(cost), REDEEM_PENDING,
                 self._now()))
            return int(cur.lastrowid or 0)

    def redeem_get(self, rid: int) -> Redeem | None:
        r = self.db.query_one("SELECT * FROM club_redeems WHERE id = ?",
                              (rid,))
        return _row_redeem(r) if r else None

    def redeem_for_user(self, user_id: int, limit: int = 8) -> list[Redeem]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM club_redeems WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC "
            "LIMIT ?", (user_id, int(limit)))
        return [_row_redeem(r) for r in rows]

    def redeems_by_status(self, status: str,
                          limit: int = 20) -> list[Redeem]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM club_redeems WHERE status = ? ORDER BY id LIMIT ?",
            (status, int(limit)))
        return [_row_redeem(r) for r in rows]

    def redeem_set_status(self, rid: int, status: str,
                          admin_id: int = 0) -> None:
        self.db.execute(
            "UPDATE club_redeems SET status = ?, handled_ts = ?, "
            "admin_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (status, self._now(), int(admin_id), int(rid)))
        self.db.commit()

    # ---------- دعوت دوستان ----------

    def ref_bind(self, invitee_bale: int, inviter_bale: int) -> bool:
        """یک بار برای هر مهمان؛ خوددعوتی رد می‌شود."""
        if int(invitee_bale) == int(inviter_bale):
            return False
        if self.db.query_one("SELECT id FROM club_refs WHERE invitee_bale = ?",
                             (int(invitee_bale),)) is not None:
            return False
        self.db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO club_refs (invitee_bale, inviter_bale, ts) "
            "VALUES (?,?,?)",
            (int(invitee_bale), int(inviter_bale), self._now()))
        self.db.commit()
        return True

    def ref_inviter_of(self, invitee_bale: int) -> int:
        r = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT inviter_bale FROM club_refs WHERE invitee_bale = ?",
            (int(invitee_bale),))
        return int(r["inviter_bale"]) if r else 0

"""قرعه‌کشی — دامنه (فاز ۳۳).

شش روش انتخاب مخاطب، وضعیت‌های open/drawn/cancelled، جدول برندگان.
قرعه با SystemRandom و قفل اتمیک در LotteryService کشیده می‌شود.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from ..core.clock import Clock, get_clock
from ..core.db import Database

LOT_OPEN = "open"
LOT_DRAWN = "drawn"
LOT_CANCELLED = "cancelled"

# شش روش انتخاب برنده (مطابق نورا۱)
LOT_METHODS = ("event_regs", "event_attendees", "club_members",
               "all_users", "manual", "point_holders")


@dataclass
class Lottery:
    id: int
    title: str
    event_id: int
    method: str
    prize: str
    winners_n: int
    status: str
    manual_ids: str
    created_ts: float
    drawn_ts: float
    created_by: int


@dataclass
class Winner:
    id: int
    lottery_id: int
    user_id: int
    prize_idx: int
    ts: float


def _row_lot(r) -> Lottery:
    return Lottery(int(r["id"]), str(r["title"]), int(r["event_id"] or 0),
                   str(r["method"]), str(r["prize"] or ""),
                   int(r["winners_n"] or 1), str(r["status"]),
                   str(r["manual_ids"] or ""), float(r["created_ts"] or 0),
                   float(r["drawn_ts"] or 0), int(r["created_by"] or 0))


def _row_win(r) -> Winner:
    return Winner(int(r["id"]), int(r["lottery_id"]), int(r["user_id"]),
                  int(r["prize_idx"] or 0), float(r["ts"] or 0))


class LotteryRepo:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, clock: Clock | None = None) -> None:
        self.db = db
        self.clock = clock or get_clock()
        db.ensure_table("lotteries", [
            ("title", "TEXT NOT NULL"),
            ("event_id", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("method", "TEXT NOT NULL"),
            ("prize", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("winners_n", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
            ("status", f"TEXT DEFAULT '{LOT_OPEN}'"),
            ("manual_ids", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("created_ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("drawn_ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("created_by", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ])
        db.ensure_table("lottery_winners", [
            ("lottery_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("user_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("prize_idx", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ])
        db.ensure_index("ix_lotwin", "lottery_winners", ["lottery_id"])

    def _now(self) -> float:
        return self.clock.ts()

    def create(self, title: str, method: str, *, event_id: int = 0,
               prize: str = "", winners_n: int = 1, manual_ids: str = "",
               created_by: int = 0) -> Lottery:
        if method not in LOT_METHODS:
            method = "all_users"
        winners_n = max(1, min(50, int(winners_n)))
        with self.db.transaction():
            cur = self.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO lotteries (title, event_id, method, prize, "
                "winners_n, status, manual_ids, created_ts, created_by) "
                "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (title, int(event_id), method, prize, winners_n, LOT_OPEN,
                 manual_ids, self._now(), int(created_by)))
            lot = self.get(int(cur.lastrowid or 0))
        assert lot is not None
        return lot

    def get(self, lid: int) -> Lottery | None:
        r = self.db.query_one("SELECT * FROM lotteries WHERE id = ?", (lid,))
        return _row_lot(r) if r else None

    def by_status(self, status: str, limit: int = 20) -> list[Lottery]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM lotteries WHERE status = ? ORDER BY id DESC "
            "LIMIT ?", (status, int(limit)))
        return [_row_lot(r) for r in rows]

    def recent(self, limit: int = 12) -> list[Lottery]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM lotteries ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (int(limit),))
        return [_row_lot(r) for r in rows]

    def set_status(self, lid: int, status: str) -> None:
        drawn = self._now() if status == LOT_DRAWN else 0
        self.db.execute(
            "UPDATE lotteries SET status = ?, "
            "drawn_ts = CASE WHEN ? = 0 THEN drawn_ts ELSE ? END "
            "WHERE id = ?", (status, drawn, drawn, int(lid)))
        self.db.commit()

    def claim_draw(self, lid: int) -> bool:
        """قفل اتمیک قرعه: فقط یک بار open → drawn."""
        with self.db.transaction():
            cur = self.db.execute(
                "UPDATE lotteries SET status = ?, drawn_ts = ? "
                "WHERE id = ? AND status = ?",
                (LOT_DRAWN, self._now(), int(lid), LOT_OPEN))
            return int(cur.rowcount or 0) == 1

    def add_winner(self, lid: int, user_id: int, prize_idx: int = 0) -> None:
        self.db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO lottery_winners (lottery_id, user_id, prize_idx, ts) "
            "VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
            (int(lid), int(user_id), int(prize_idx), self._now()))
        self.db.commit()

    def winners(self, lid: int) -> list[Winner]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM lottery_winners WHERE lottery_id = ? "
            "ORDER BY prize_idx, id", (int(lid),))
        return [_row_win(r) for r in rows]

"""باشگاه امتیاز — خدمت (فاز ۳۳).

امتیاز با هشت تریگر، چهار سطح، سیزده نشان، چهار جدول رتبه، فروشگاه
پاداش با کسر اتمیک و بازگشت عندالرد، و پرداخت با امتیاز. تنظیمات همه
از kv تنظیمات می‌آید (پنل ادمین). بدون لیترال فارسی و بدون import کانال.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math

from ..core.clock import Clock, get_clock
from ..domain.club import REDEEM_DELIVERED, REDEEM_PENDING, REDEEM_REJECTED, TRIGGERS, ClubRepo, Redeem

DEFAULT_RATES = {
    "welcome": 5, "register": 10, "attend": 20, "survey": 15,
    "profile": 30, "payment": 10, "referral": 50, "referee": 20,
}
DEFAULT_LEVELS = (100, 400, 1200)     # سه آستانه → چهار سطح
DEFAULT_POINT_VALUE = 1000             # ریال به ازای هر امتیاز
LEVEL_KEYS = ("club_l1", "club_l2", "club_l3", "club_l4")
DAY30 = 30 * 24 * 3600


class ClubService:
    def __init__(self, clubrepo: ClubRepo, setrepo, clock: Clock | None = None,
                 urepo=None) -> None:
        self.club = clubrepo
        self.setrepo = setrepo
        self.clock = clock or get_clock()
        self.urepo = urepo

    # ---------- تنظیمات ----------

    def enabled(self) -> bool:
        return str(self.setrepo.get("club_enabled", "1") or "1") == "1"

    def anon_boards(self) -> bool:
        return str(self.setrepo.get("club_anon", "0") or "0") == "1"

    def rate(self, trigger: str) -> int:
        raw = self.setrepo.get(f"club_rate_{trigger}", "")
        if raw == "":
            return int(DEFAULT_RATES.get(trigger, 0))
        try:
            return max(0, int(raw))
        except ValueError:
            return int(DEFAULT_RATES.get(trigger, 0))

    def levels(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
        raw = str(self.setrepo.get("club_levels", "") or "")
        out = []
        for part in raw.split(","):
            part = part.strip()
            if part.isdigit():
                out.append(int(part))
        return tuple(out) if len(out) >= 1 else DEFAULT_LEVELS

    def point_value(self) -> int:
        raw = str(self.setrepo.get("club_point_value", "") or "")
        return int(raw) if raw.isdigit() and int(raw) > 0 \
            else DEFAULT_POINT_VALUE

    def rewards(self) -> list[tuple[str, str, int]]:
        """ردیف‌های kv «club_rewards» = key|label|cost — label دادهٔ ادمین است."""
        out = []
        for line in self.setrepo.items("club_rewards"):
            parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split("|")]
            if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] and parts[2].isdigit():
                out.append((parts[0], parts[1], int(parts[2])))
        return out

    # ---------- امتیاز ----------

    def level_of(self, earned: int) -> int:
        idx = 0
        for th in self.levels():
            if earned >= th:
                idx += 1
        return min(idx, len(LEVEL_KEYS) - 1)

    def level_info(self, user_id: int) -> dict:
        earned = self.club.earned_total(user_id)
        idx = self.level_of(earned)
        ths = self.levels()
        next_th = ths[idx] if idx < len(ths) else 0
        prev_th = ths[idx - 1] if idx > 0 else 0
        pct = 100
        if next_th > prev_th:
            pct = int(100 * (earned - prev_th) / (next_th - prev_th))
        return {"earned": earned, "level": idx, "level_key": LEVEL_KEYS[idx],
                "next": next_th, "pct": max(0, min(100, pct))}

    def award(self, user_id: int, trigger: str, ref: str = "") -> tuple[int, bool]:
        """(امتیاز داده‌شده, آیا سطح بالا رفت) — ضدتکرار با reason+ref."""
        if not self.enabled() or trigger not in TRIGGERS or not user_id:
            return 0, False
        rate = self.rate(trigger)
        if rate <= 0:
            return 0, False
        ref = ref or trigger
        if self.club.has(user_id, trigger, ref):
            return 0, False
        before = self.level_of(self.club.earned_total(user_id))
        self.club.add(user_id, rate, trigger, ref)
        after = self.level_of(self.club.earned_total(user_id))
        return rate, after > before

    def adjust(self, user_id: int, delta: int, note_ref: str = "") -> int:
        """دستی (ادمین) — مثبت یا منفی؛ بدون ضدتکرار."""
        delta = int(delta)
        if delta == 0:
            return 0
        self.club.add(user_id, delta, "adjust", note_ref or str(delta))
        return delta

    # ---------- نشان‌ها ----------

    def badges(self, user_id: int) -> list[tuple[str, bool]]:
        c = self.club
        earned = c.earned_total(user_id)
        checks = (
            ("badge_first_reg", c.count_reason(user_id, "register") >= 1),
            ("badge_reg_5", c.count_reason(user_id, "register") >= 5),
            ("badge_first_att", c.count_reason(user_id, "attend") >= 1),
            ("badge_att_10", c.count_reason(user_id, "attend") >= 10),
            ("badge_survey", c.count_reason(user_id, "survey") >= 1),
            ("badge_profile", c.count_reason(user_id, "profile") >= 1),
            ("badge_ref_1", c.count_reason(user_id, "referral") >= 1),
            ("badge_ref_5", c.count_reason(user_id, "referral") >= 5),
            ("badge_pay", c.count_reason(user_id, "payment") >= 1),
            ("badge_p100", earned >= 100),
            ("badge_p500", earned >= 500),
            ("badge_p1000", earned >= 1000),
            ("badge_redeem", c.redeem_count(user_id, REDEEM_DELIVERED) >= 1),
        )
        return list(checks)

    # ---------- رتبه‌بندی ----------

    def boards(self) -> tuple[tuple[str, list[tuple[int, int]]], ...]:
        """چهار جدول: کل · ۳۰ روز · حضور · دعوت."""
        since = self.clock.ts() - DAY30
        return (
            ("board_all", self.club.top(5)),
            ("board_month", self.club.top(5, since_ts=since)),
            ("board_attend", self.club.top(5, reason="attend")),
            ("board_ref", self.club.top(5, reason="referral")),
        )

    # ---------- فروشگاه پاداش ----------

    def redeem(self, user_id: int, item_key: str) -> tuple[Redeem | None, str]:
        if not self.enabled():
            return None, "club_off"
        item = next((r for r in self.rewards() if r[0] == item_key), None)
        if item is None:
            return None, "club_item_none"
        key, label, cost = item
        if cost > 0 and self.club.balance(user_id) < cost:
            return None, "club_not_enough"
        rid = self.club.redeem_create(user_id, key, label, cost)
        if cost > 0 and not self.club.spend(user_id, cost, "redeem",
                                           str(rid)):
            self.club.redeem_set_status(rid, REDEEM_REJECTED)
            return None, "club_not_enough"
        return self.club.redeem_get(rid), ""

    def handle_redeem(self, rid: int, approve: bool,
                      admin_id: int = 0) -> tuple[Redeem | None, str]:
        r = self.club.redeem_get(rid)
        if r is None:
            return None, "club_item_none"
        if r.status != REDEEM_PENDING:
            return None, "club_handled"
        if approve:
            self.club.redeem_set_status(rid, REDEEM_DELIVERED, admin_id)
        else:
            self.club.redeem_set_status(rid, REDEEM_REJECTED, admin_id)
            if r.cost > 0:
                self.club.add(r.user_id, r.cost, "refund", f"r{rid}")
        return self.club.redeem_get(rid), ""

    # ---------- پرداخت با امتیاز ----------

    def points_for(self, amount_rial: int) -> int:
        amount = max(0, int(amount_rial))
        if amount <= 0:
            return 0
        return int(math.ceil(amount / self.point_value()))

    def pay_with_points(self, user_id: int, amount_rial: int,
                        ref: str = "") -> tuple[int, str]:
        """(امتیاز کسرشده, خطا) — کسر اتمی؛ صفر یعنی ناموفق."""
        if not self.enabled():
            return 0, "club_off"
        need = self.points_for(amount_rial)
        if need <= 0:
            return 0, "club_off"
        if self.club.balance(user_id) < need:
            return 0, "club_not_enough"
        if not self.club.spend(user_id, need, "pay_points", ref or "pay"):
            return 0, "club_not_enough"
        return need, ""

    # ---------- دعوت دوستان ----------

    def bind_referral(self, invitee_bale: int, inviter_bale: int) -> bool:
        if not self.enabled():
            return False
        return self.club.ref_bind(invitee_bale, inviter_bale)

    def settle_referral(self, user_id: int, bale_id: int) -> None:
        """پس از پیوستن: امتیاز مهمان و دعوت‌کننده (هرکدام یک‌بار)."""
        inviter_bale = self.club.ref_inviter_of(bale_id)
        if not inviter_bale or self.urepo is None:
            return
        self.award(user_id, "referee", f"inv:{inviter_bale}")
        inviter = self.urepo.get_by_bale(inviter_bale)
        if inviter is not None:
            self.award(inviter.id, "referral", f"inv:{bale_id}")


# ---------- گوش‌دهندهٔ رویدادها ----------

_ACTIVE: list = []


def attach_club(bus, clubsvc: ClubService, urepo, responder=None):
    """هر تریگر یک رویداد روی bus — صفحه‌ها هیچ نمی‌دانند."""
    for off in _ACTIVE:
        off()
    _ACTIVE.clear()

    def _notify_levelup(user_id: int) -> None:
        if responder is None or urepo is None:
            return
        u = urepo.get(user_id)
        if u is None or not u.bale_id:
            return
        info = clubsvc.level_info(user_id)
        responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "club_levelup",
                       level=f"%%{info['level_key']}%%")

    def _do(user_id: int, trigger: str, ref: str) -> None:
        _delta, up = clubsvc.award(user_id, trigger, ref)
        if up:
            _notify_levelup(user_id)

    def on_reg(**kw) -> None:
        if kw.get("kind") == "confirmed":
            _do(int(kw.get("user_id") or 0), "register",
                f"reg:{kw.get('reg_id') or kw.get('title') or ''}")

    def on_att(**kw) -> None:
        _do(int(kw.get("user_id") or 0), "attend",
            f"s:{kw.get('session_id') or kw.get('event_id') or ''}")

    def on_sv(**kw) -> None:
        eid = int(kw.get("event_id") or 0)
        if eid:
            _do(int(kw.get("user_id") or 0), "survey", f"sv:{eid}")

    def on_pay(**kw) -> None:
        if kw.get("method") == "points":
            return                      # پرداخت با امتیاز، امتیاز نمی‌آورد
        _do(int(kw.get("user_id") or 0), "payment",
            f"pay:{kw.get('pay_id') or ''}")

    def on_joined(**kw) -> None:
        uid = int(kw.get("user_id") or 0)
        _do(uid, "welcome", "welcome")
        if uid and urepo is not None:
            u = urepo.get(uid)
            if u is not None:
                clubsvc.settle_referral(uid, int(u.bale_id))

    def on_profile(**kw) -> None:
        if kw.get("ok"):
            _do(int(kw.get("user_id") or 0), "profile", "profile")

    for event, fn in (("ev.reg", on_reg), ("att.present", on_att),
                      ("sv.done", on_sv), ("pay.ok", on_pay),
                      ("user.joined", on_joined),
                      ("profile.decide", on_profile)):
        _ACTIVE.append(bus.subscribe(event, fn))
    return clubsvc

"""قرعه‌کشی — خدمت (فاز ۳۳).

شش روش انتخاب مخاطب، قرعه با SystemRandom، قفل اتمیک (یک قرعه = یک بار)،
جوایز چندگانه (برندهٔ ۱..N). بدون لیترال فارسی و بدون import کانال.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import random
from datetime import datetime

from ..core.clock import Clock, TEHRAN, get_clock
from ..domain.lottery import LOT_CANCELLED, LOT_METHODS, LOT_OPEN, Lottery, LotteryRepo


class LotteryService:
    def __init__(self, lotrepo: LotteryRepo, erepo, attrepo, clubrepo,
                 urepo, clock: Clock | None = None) -> None:
        self.lots = lotrepo
        self.erepo = erepo
        self.attrepo = attrepo
        self.club = clubrepo
        self.urepo = urepo
        self.clock = clock or get_clock()

    # ---------- ساخت ----------

    def create(self, title: str, method: str, *, event_id: int = 0,
               prize: str = "", winners_n: int = 1, manual_ids: str = "",
               created_by: int = 0) -> tuple[Lottery | None, str]:
        title = " ".join(str(title or "").split())
        if len(title) < 3:
            return None, "lot_bad_title"
        if method not in LOT_METHODS:
            return None, "lot_bad_method"
        if method in ("event_regs", "event_attendees"):
            if not event_id or self.erepo.get_event(event_id) is None:
                return None, "lot_need_event"
        winners_n = max(1, min(50, int(winners_n or 1)))
        lot = self.lots.create(title, method, event_id=event_id,
                               prize=" ".join(str(prize or "").split()),
                               winners_n=winners_n,
                               manual_ids=_clean_ids(manual_ids),
                               created_by=created_by)
        return lot, ""

    def cancel(self, lid: int) -> str:
        lot = self.lots.get(lid)
        if lot is None:
            return "lot_none"
        if lot.status != LOT_OPEN:
            return "lot_not_open"
        self.lots.set_status(lid, LOT_CANCELLED)
        return ""

    # ---------- واجدان ----------

    def eligible(self, lot: Lottery) -> list[int]:
        m = lot.method
        if m == "event_regs":
            regs = self.erepo.event_regs(lot.event_id, ("confirmed",))
            return sorted({r.user_id for r in regs})
        if m == "event_attendees":
            return sorted(self.attrepo.present_user_ids(lot.event_id))
        if m == "club_members":
            return sorted(self.club.users_with_points(1))
        if m == "point_holders":
            return sorted(self.club.users_with_points(100))
        if m == "all_users":
            return sorted(self.urepo.ids_approved())
        if m == "manual":
            return _parse_ids(lot.manual_ids)
        return []

    # ---------- قرعه ----------

    def draw(self, lid: int, rng: random.SystemRandom | None = None,
             ) -> tuple[list[int], str]:
        """قفل اتمیک + SystemRandom. خروجی: ([user_id برنده‌ها], خطا)."""
        lot = self.lots.get(lid)
        if lot is None:
            return [], "lot_none"
        if lot.status != LOT_OPEN:
            return [], "lot_not_open"
        pool = self.eligible(lot)
        if not pool:
            return [], "lot_empty"
        if not self.lots.claim_draw(lid):     # فقط یک برنده دارد این قرعه را
            return [], "lot_not_open"
        rng = rng or random.SystemRandom()
        n = min(int(lot.winners_n), len(pool))
        winners = rng.sample(sorted(pool), n)
        for idx, uid in enumerate(winners, start=1):
            self.lots.add_winner(lid, uid, idx)
        return winners, ""

    # ---------- نمایش ----------

    def open_lots(self) -> list[Lottery]:
        return self.lots.by_status(LOT_OPEN)

    def drawn_lots(self, limit: int = 10) -> list[Lottery]:
        return self.lots.by_status("drawn", limit=limit)

    def winner_names(self, lid: int) -> list[tuple[int, str, int]]:
        out = []
        for w in self.lots.winners(lid):
            u = self.urepo.get(w.user_id)
            name = ""
            if u is not None:
                name = u.full_name or u.first_name or u.username \
                    or str(u.bale_id)
            out.append((w.user_id, name, w.prize_idx))
        return out

    def draw_date(self, lot: Lottery) -> str:
        if not lot.drawn_ts:
            return ""
        from ..core.jalali import fmt_dt
        return fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(lot.drawn_ts, tz=TEHRAN))


def _clean_ids(raw: str) -> str:
    return ",".join(str(i) for i in _parse_ids(raw))


def _parse_ids(raw: str) -> list[int]:
    out: list[int] = []
    for part in str(raw or "").replace("،", ",").replace(" ", ",").split(","):
        part = part.strip()
        if part.isdigit() and int(part) not in out:
            out.append(int(part))
    return out
