"""آینهٔ مدیریت مناسبت‌ها برای وب (فاز ۳۴).

بدون کانال و بدون لیترال فارسی — برچسب مناسبت‌های آماده در app.js است
(کلیدها در texts بات). اجرای دستی/آزمایشی با callable تزریق‌شده از لایهٔ
وب (همان توابع ارسال بات). گیت: send_bulk.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..domain.occasions import GFILTERS

MAX_POINTS = 100000


def _row(orepo, occ) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": occ.id,
        "key": occ.key,
        "title": occ.title or "",       # سفارشی‌ها؛ آماده‌ها کلید دارند
        "month": occ.month,
        "day": occ.day,
        "points": occ.points,
        "gender": occ.gender,
        "enabled": bool(occ.enabled),
        "builtin": bool(occ.builtin),
        "custom_msg": bool((occ.msg or "").strip()),
        "sent": orepo.send_count(occ.id),
    }


def occ_view(*, orepo) -> dict:
    rows = [_row(orepo, o) for o in orepo.list_all()]
    hist = orepo.history(10)
    return {"rows": rows,
            "history": [{"occ_id": h["occ_id"], "key": h["key"],
                         "title": h["title"], "n": h["n"], "ts": h["ts"]}
                        for h in hist]}


def occ_update(*, orepo, occ_id: int, month=None, day=None, points=None,
               gender=None, enabled=None, msg=None) -> dict:
    occ = orepo.get(occ_id)
    if occ is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    fields = {}
    if month is not None and day is not None:
        m, d = int(month), int(day)
        if m == 0 and d == 0:
            fields.update(month=0, day=0)
        elif 1 <= m <= 12 and 1 <= d <= 31:
            fields.update(month=m, day=d)
            if not occ.enabled:
                fields["enabled"] = 1
        else:
            return {"result": "bad_date"}
    if points is not None:
        p = int(points)
        if not 0 <= p <= MAX_POINTS:
            return {"result": "bad_points"}
        fields["points"] = p
    if gender is not None:
        g = str(gender)
        if g not in GFILTERS:
            return {"result": "bad_gender"}
        fields["gender"] = g
    if enabled is not None:
        fields["enabled"] = 1 if enabled else 0
    if msg is not None:
        clean = str(msg).strip()
        fields["msg"] = "" if clean == "-" else clean[:400]
    orepo.update(occ_id, **fields)
    return {"result": "saved", "row": _row(orepo, orepo.get(occ_id))}


def occ_add(*, orepo, title: str, month, day, points=0,
            gender: str = "all") -> dict:
    title = str(title or "").strip()
    if not title or len(title) < 3:
        return {"result": "bad_title"}
    m, d = int(month or 0), int(day or 0)
    if not (1 <= m <= 12 and 1 <= d <= 31):
        return {"result": "bad_date"}
    p = max(0, min(MAX_POINTS, int(points or 0)))
    g = gender if gender in GFILTERS else "all"
    from ..core.clock import get_clock
    key = f"cust{int(get_clock().ts())}"
    oid = orepo.add_custom(key, title[:60], m, d, p, g)
    return {"result": "added", "id": oid}


def occ_delete(*, orepo, occ_id: int) -> dict:
    return {"result": "deleted" if orepo.delete(occ_id) else "builtin"}


def occ_run(*, run_fn) -> dict:
    """run_fn تزریق‌شده از سرور: همان send_due بات — شمار ارسال."""
    n = int(run_fn() or 0)
    return {"result": "done", "sent": n}


def occ_test(*, test_fn) -> dict:
    """test_fn تزریق‌شده: ارسال نمونه به خود مدیر."""
    ok = bool(test_fn())
    return {"result": "sent" if ok else "none"}

"""آینهٔ مدیریت کمپین‌ها برای وب (فاز ۳۴).

بدون کانال و بدون لیترال فارسی — برچسب نوع/مخاطب/زمان/وضعیت در app.js.
ارسال با callable تزریق‌شده (همان bot_sender بات). گیت: send_bulk.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..domain.campaigns import (C_DONE, C_DRAFT, C_PAUSED, C_RUNNING,
                                C_SCHEDULED, KINDS, S_AT, SCHEDULES,
                                TARGETS)


def _ev_title(erepo, eid: int) -> str:
    ev = erepo.get_event(eid) if eid else None
    return (ev.title if ev else "") or ""


def _row(cmp, svc) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": cmp.id,
        "title": cmp.title,
        "kind": cmp.kind,
        "target": cmp.target,
        "schedule": cmp.schedule,
        "run_at_ts": cmp.run_at_ts,
        "status": cmp.status,
        "sent": cmp.sent_a + cmp.sent_b,
        "clicks": cmp.click_a + cmp.click_b,
        "has_b": bool((cmp.body_b or "").strip()),
    }


def cmp_view(*, cmpsvc, erepo, now: float) -> dict:
    cmps = cmpsvc.crepo.list(40)
    tot_sent = sum(c.sent_a + c.sent_b for c in cmps)
    tot_click = sum(c.click_a + c.click_b for c in cmps)
    return {
        "rows": [_row(c, cmpsvc) for c in cmps],
        "totals": {"n": len(cmps),
                   "active": sum(1 for c in cmps
                                 if c.status in (C_RUNNING, C_SCHEDULED)),
                   "sent": tot_sent, "clicks": tot_click,
                   "ctr": cmpsvc.ctr(tot_sent, tot_click)},
        "optout": cmpsvc.nrepo.optout_count(),
        "quiet": cmpsvc.server_quiet(now),
    }


def cmp_get(*, cmpsvc, erepo, cmp_id: int) -> dict:
    cmp = cmpsvc.crepo.get(cmp_id)
    if cmp is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    data = _row(cmp, cmpsvc)
    data.update({
        "result": "ok",
        "body_a": cmp.body_a,
        "body_b": cmp.body_b,
        "event_id": cmp.event_id,
        "event_title": _ev_title(erepo, cmp.event_id),
        "discount_code": cmp.discount_code,
        "btn_text": cmp.btn_text,
        "btn_url": cmp.btn_url,
        "points_reward": cmp.points_reward,
        "respect_quiet": bool(cmp.respect_quiet),
        "rate": cmp.rate,
        "stats": cmpsvc.stats(cmp_id),
    })
    return data


def cmp_events(*, erepo) -> list:
    return [{"id": ev.id, "title": ev.title}
            for ev in erepo.list_events(("published", "closed", "finished"),
                                        limit=30)]


def cmp_create(*, cmpsvc, author_id: int, title: str, kind: str,
               body_a: str, body_b: str = "", target: str = "all",
               event_id: int = 0, discount_code: str = "",
               btn_text: str = "", btn_url: str = "",
               schedule: str = "now", run_at: str = "",
               rate: int = 20, points_reward: int = 0) -> dict:
    kind = kind if kind in KINDS else "promo"
    target = target if target in TARGETS else "all"
    schedule = schedule if schedule in SCHEDULES else "now"
    body_a = str(body_a or "").strip()
    if not str(title or "").strip():
        return {"result": "bad_title"}
    if len(body_a) < 3:
        return {"result": "bad_body"}
    run_at_ts = 0.0
    if schedule != "now":
        if schedule == S_AT:
            run_at_ts = cmpsvc.parse_when(run_at)
            if not run_at_ts:
                return {"result": "bad_when"}
    cid = cmpsvc.crepo.create(
        title=str(title).strip()[:80], kind=kind, body_a=body_a[:2000],
        body_b=str(body_b or "").strip()[:2000], target=target,
        target_arg=int(event_id or 0) if target == "event" else 0,
        event_id=int(event_id or 0),
        discount_code=str(discount_code or "")[:40],
        btn_text=str(btn_text or "")[:40],
        btn_url=str(btn_url or "")[:300], schedule=schedule,
        run_at_ts=run_at_ts if schedule == S_AT else 0.0,
        rate=max(1, min(60, int(rate or 20))),
        points_reward=max(0, min(100000, int(points_reward or 0))),
        created_by=int(author_id or 0))
    if schedule != "now" and schedule == S_AT and run_at_ts:
        cmpsvc.crepo.set_status(cid, C_SCHEDULED)
    return {"result": "created", "id": cid}


def cmp_action(*, cmpsvc, urepo, cmp_id: int, action: str,
               sender=None) -> dict:
    cmp = cmpsvc.crepo.get(cmp_id)
    if cmp is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    if action == "start":
        res = cmpsvc.start(cmp_id)
        if res != "started":
            return {"result": res}
        n = 0
        if sender is not None:
            n = cmpsvc.send_pass(cmp_id, sender)
        return {"result": "started", "sent": n}
    if action == "pause":
        cmpsvc.pause(cmp_id)
        return {"result": "paused"}
    if action == "copy":
        nid = cmpsvc.crepo.duplicate(cmp_id)
        return {"result": "copied", "id": nid}
    if action == "delete":
        cmpsvc.crepo.delete(cmp_id)
        return {"result": "deleted"}
    return {"result": "bad_action"}


def cmp_click(*, cmpsvc, user_id: int, cmp_id: int) -> dict:
    if cmpsvc.crepo.get(cmp_id) is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    variant = cmpsvc.register_click(cmp_id, user_id)
    return {"result": "ok", "variant": variant}

@pytest.fixture()
def env(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 12, 10, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    setrepo = SettingsRepo(db)
    clubrepo = ClubRepo(db, clock)
    clubsvc = ClubService(clubrepo, setrepo, clock, urepo=urepo)
    occrepo = OccasionRepo(db, clock)
    nrepo = NotifRepo(db, clock)
    abrepo = AboutRepo(db, clock)
    cmprepo = CampaignRepo(db, clock)
    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    occsvc = OccasionService(occrepo, urepo, nrepo, clock,
                             clubrepo=clubrepo, clubsvc=clubsvc,
                             settings=settings)
    cmpsvc = CampaignService(cmprepo, nrepo, clock, settings=settings,
                             setrepo=setrepo, clubrepo=clubrepo,
                             clubsvc=clubsvc)
    yield (db, clock, urepo, erepo, setrepo, clubrepo, clubsvc, occrepo,
           occsvc, nrepo, abrepo, cmprepo, cmpsvc, settings)
    set_clock(old)


def mk_user(urepo, bale, name="", role="member", gender="", birth=""):
    u = urepo.create(bale, first_name=name or f"کاربر{bale}")
    urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", role=role, gender=gender,
                 birth_date=birth,
                 full_name=name or f"کاربر {bale}")
    return urepo.get(u.id)


# ---------- دامنه و سرویس مناسبت‌ها ----------

def test_occasions_seed_and_custom(env):
    (_db, _clock, _urepo, _erepo, _setrepo, _clubrepo, _clubsvc,
     occrepo, *_rest) = env
    occs = occrepo.list_all()
    assert len(occs) == 15                      # ۱۴ مناسبت + تولد
    keys = {o.key for o in occs}
    assert "birthday" in keys and "nowruz" in keys and "yalda" in keys
    bday = occrepo.by_key("birthday")
    assert bday.enabled and bday.points == 50
    mother = occrepo.by_key("mother")
    assert not mother.enabled and (mother.month, mother.day) == (0, 0)
    # سفارشی
    oid = occrepo.add_custom("cust1", "روز کتاب", 8, 24, 20)
    occ = occrepo.get(oid)
    assert occ.title == "روز کتاب" and occ.points == 20 and not occ.builtin
    # آماده‌ها پاک نمی‌شوند؛ سفارشی چرا
    assert not occrepo.delete(bday.id)
    assert occrepo.delete(oid)


def test_occasions_recipients_filters(env):
    (_db, clock, urepo, _erepo, _setrepo, _clubrepo, _clubsvc,
     occrepo, occsvc, nrepo, *_rest) = env
    jy, jm, jd = occsvc.jalali_today()
    bd = f"1375/{jm:02d}/{jd:02d}"
    u1 = mk_user(urepo, 11, "مریم", gender="female", birth=bd)
    u2 = mk_user(urepo, 12, "علی", gender="male", birth=bd)
    # مناسبت سفارشی امروز، فقط خانم‌ها
    oid = occrepo.add_custom("cust1", "روز测试".replace("测试", "زن"),
                             jm, jd, 5, "female")
    u3 = mk_user(urepo, 13, "زهرا", gender="female",
                 birth=f"1370/{jm:02d}/{jd:02d}")
    recips = occsvc.recipients()
    pairs = {(o.key, u.id) for o, u in recips}
    assert ("cust1", u1.id) in pairs and ("cust1", u3.id) in pairs
    assert ("cust1", u2.id) not in pairs         # فیلتر جنسیت
    assert ("birthday", u1.id) in pairs and ("birthday", u2.id) in pairs
    # کلید مناسبت‌های u2 خاموش
    nrepo.set(u2.id, occasions_on=0)
    pairs = {(o.key, u.id) for o, u in occsvc.recipients()}
    assert ("birthday", u2.id) not in pairs
    # ثبت سالانه — تکرار نمی‌رود
    bday = occrepo.by_key("birthday")
    assert occsvc.commit(bday, u1.id)
    assert not occsvc.commit(bday, u1.id)
    pairs = {(o.key, u.id) for o, u in occsvc.recipients()}
    assert ("birthday", u1.id) not in pairs
    assert occrepo.send_count(bday.id) == 1
    del oid


def test_occasions_points_award(env):
    (_db, clock, urepo, _erepo, setrepo, clubrepo, clubsvc,
     occrepo, occsvc, _nrepo, *_rest) = env
    u = mk_user(urepo, 14, "سارا", gender="female")
    bday = occrepo.by_key("birthday")
    jy = occsvc.jalali_today()[0]
    assert occsvc.award(bday, u.id, jy) == 50
    assert clubrepo.balance(u.id) == 50
    assert occsvc.award(bday, u.id, jy) == 0     # ضدتکرار
    # باشگاه خاموش — امتیازی نیست
    setrepo.set("club_enabled", "0")
    u2 = mk_user(urepo, 15, "رضا", gender="male")
    assert occsvc.award(bday, u2.id, jy) == 0
    setrepo.set("club_enabled", "1")
    assert clubsvc.enabled()


# ---------- سرویس کمپین ----------

def test_campaign_targets_inactive(env):
    (_db, clock, urepo, _erepo, _setrepo, _clubrepo, _clubsvc, _occrepo,
     _occsvc, nrepo, _abrepo, cmprepo, cmpsvc, _settings) = env
    fresh = mk_user(urepo, 21)
    stale = mk_user(urepo, 22)
    urepo.touch(fresh.bale_id, clock.ts())
    urepo.touch(stale.bale_id, clock.ts() - 40 * 86400)
    cid = cmprepo.create(title="بازگشت", kind="reengage", body_a="دلمون تنگ شده",
                         target="inactive", created_by=1)
    got = []
    cmpsvc.start(cid)
    cmpsvc.send_pass(cid, lambda uid, bale, c, v, b: got.append(bale) or True,
                     max_n=50)
    assert got == [stale.bale_id]
    # لغو اشتراک = معاف دائم؛ کمپین تمام می‌شود
    cid2 = cmprepo.create(title="عمومی", body_a="سلام", target="all",
                          created_by=1)
    nrepo.set(fresh.id, ads_on=0)
    got2 = []
    cmpsvc.start(cid2)
    cmpsvc.send_pass(cid2, lambda uid, bale, c, v, b: got2.append(uid) or True,
                     max_n=50)
    assert fresh.id not in got2 and stale.id in got2
    assert cmprepo.get(cid2).status == C_DONE


def test_campaign_ab_winner_and_click(env):
    (_db, clock, urepo, _erepo, _setrepo, _clubrepo, _clubsvc, _occrepo,
     _occsvc, _nrepo, _abrepo, cmprepo, cmpsvc, _settings) = env
    for i in range(4):
        mk_user(urepo, 30 + i)
    cid = cmprepo.create(title="ab", body_a="نسخه آ", body_b="نسخه ب",
                         target="all", created_by=1)
    c = cmprepo.get(cid)
    assert cmpsvc.variant_for(c, 2) == "a" and cmpsvc.variant_for(c, 3) == "b"
    assert cmpsvc.body_for(c, "b") == "نسخه ب"
    sent = []
    cmpsvc.start(cid)
    cmpsvc.send_pass(cid,
                     lambda uid, bale, cc, v, b: sent.append((uid, v)) or True,
                     max_n=50)
    assert len(sent) == 4
    variants = {v for _u, v in sent}
    assert variants == {"a", "b"}
    # کلیک‌ها
    uid_a = next(u for u, v in sent if v == "a")
    assert cmpsvc.register_click(cid, uid_a) == "a"
    st = cmpsvc.stats(cid)
    assert st["clicks"] == 1 and st["click_a"] == 1
    # برنده وقتی هیچ نسخه‌ای کامل نیست — فعلاً خالی/مساوی
    assert st["winner"] in ("", "tie")


def test_campaign_quiet_and_cap(env):
    (_db, clock, urepo, _erepo, setrepo, _clubrepo, _clubsvc, _occrepo,
     _occsvc, nrepo, _abrepo, cmprepo, cmpsvc, _settings) = env
    mk_user(urepo, 41)
    mk_user(urepo, 42)
    # سکوت سرور: ساعت ۲۳:۳۰
    clock2 = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 12, 23, 30, 0))
    cmpsvc.clock = clock2
    cid = cmprepo.create(title="شبانه", body_a="شب بخیر", target="all",
                         created_by=1)
    cmpsvc.start(cid)
    assert cmpsvc.send_pass(cid, lambda *a: True, max_n=50) == 0
    assert cmprepo.get(cid).status == C_RUNNING   # تعویق، نه لغو
    # برگشت به روز + سقف روزانه یک پیام
    cmpsvc.clock = clock
    setrepo.set("cmp_daily_cap", "1")
    sent = []
    n = cmpsvc.send_pass(cid, lambda uid, *a: sent.append(uid) or True,
                         max_n=50)
    assert n == 1 and len(sent) == 1
    # سکوت شخصی کاربر دوم
    u2 = urepo.get_by_bale(42)
    nrepo.set(u2.id, quiet_start=9, quiet_end=11)   # ساعت ۱۰ = سکوت
    cid2 = cmprepo.create(title="دوم", body_a="سلام", target="all",
                          created_by=1)
    setrepo.set("cmp_daily_cap", "0")
    cmpsvc.start(cid2)
    sent2 = []
    cmpsvc.send_pass(cid2, lambda uid, *a: sent2.append(uid) or True,
                     max_n=50)
    assert u2.id not in sent2
    assert urepo.get_by_bale(41).id in sent2
    setrepo.set("cmp_daily_cap", "2")


def test_campaign_schedule_and_repeat(env):
    (_db, clock, _urepo, _erepo, _setrepo, _clubrepo, _clubsvc, _occrepo,
     _occsvc, _nrepo, _abrepo, cmprepo, cmpsvc, _settings) = env
    ts = cmpsvc.parse_when("1405/06/22 18:30")
    assert ts > clock.ts()
    # زمان‌بندی at — قبل از موعد nothing، بعد از موعد اجرا
    cid = cmprepo.create(title="فردا", body_a="سلام", target="all",
                         schedule="at", run_at_ts=ts, created_by=1)
    cmprepo.set_status(cid, C_SCHEDULED)
    sent = []
    sender = lambda uid, bale, c, v, b: sent.append(uid) or True  # noqa: E731
    assert cmpsvc.tick(sender) == 0
    clock.advance_hours(40)                      # از ۱۸:۳۰ فردا جلوتر
    cmpsvc.tick(sender)
    assert cmprepo.get(cid).status in (C_DONE, C_RUNNING)
    # تکرار روزانه — چرخهٔ بعد زمان می‌گیرد و لاگ‌ها پاک می‌شود
    cid2 = cmprepo.create(title="روزانه", body_a="سلام صبح", target="all",
                          schedule="daily", created_by=1)
    cmpsvc.start(cid2)
    cmpsvc.send_pass(cid2, sender, max_n=50)
    c2 = cmprepo.get(cid2)
    assert c2.status == C_SCHEDULED
    assert c2.run_at_ts > clock.ts()
    assert cmprepo.sent_count(cid2) == 0          # لاگ‌ها برای چرخهٔ بعد پاک
    assert c2.sent_a > 0                          # آمار تجمعی سر جایش


# ---------- بات ----------

@pytest.fixture()
def botenv(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 12, 10, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock,
                              transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    setrepo = SettingsRepo(db)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved",
                 full_name="ادمین گروه")
    member = urepo.create(10, first_name="مریم")
    urepo.update(member.id, status="approved", full_name="مریم رادمهر",
                 phone="09121234567", gender="female")
    member = urepo.get(member.id)
    yield bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, setrepo, member
    set_clock(old)


def step(bot, clock, update):
    clock.advance_hours(0.01)
    bot.process_update(update)
    bot.outbox.drain()


def cb(data, uid=10):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}}, "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=10):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def last(sent):
    return str(sent[-1].get("text", ""))


def all_text(sent):
    return "\n".join(str(p.get("text", "")) for p in sent)


def test_bot_occasions_admin_flow(botenv):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, setrepo, member = botenv
    occrepo = OccasionRepo(db, clock)
    # عضو عادی — راه ندارد
    step(bot, clock, cb("occ:1"))
    assert "اجازه" in last(sent)
    # هاب ادمین
    step(bot, clock, cb("occ:1", uid=999))
    txt = last(sent)
    assert "مناسبت‌ها" in txt and "نوروز" in txt
    yalda = occrepo.by_key("yalda")
    # روشن/خاموش
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"occe:{yalda.id}", uid=999))
    assert occrepo.get(yalda.id).enabled == 0
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"occe:{yalda.id}", uid=999))
    assert occrepo.get(yalda.id).enabled == 1
    # تغییر امتیاز
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"occp:{yalda.id}", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("۳۰", uid=999))
    assert occrepo.get(yalda.id).points == 30
    # تاریخ مناسبت قمری
    mother = occrepo.by_key("mother")
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"occd:{mother.id}", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("1405/12/20", uid=999))
    m = occrepo.get(mother.id)
    assert (m.month, m.day) == (12, 20) and m.enabled == 1
    # متن سفارشی
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"occm:{yalda.id}", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("یلدای [name] مبارک", uid=999))
    assert occrepo.get(yalda.id).msg == "یلدای [name] مبارک"
    # سفارشی نو در یک خط
    step(bot, clock, cb("occn:1", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("روز کتاب | ۸/۲۴ | ۲۰", uid=999))
    assert "روز کتاب" in last(sent)
    custom = [o for o in occrepo.list_all() if o.title == "روز کتاب"]
    assert custom and custom[0].points == 20
    # تاریخچه (خالی)
    step(bot, clock, cb("occh:1", uid=999))
    assert "تاریخچه" in last(sent)


def test_bot_birthday_run(botenv):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, setrepo, member = botenv
    occrepo = OccasionRepo(db, clock)
    clubrepo = ClubRepo(db, clock)
    jy, jm, jd = OccasionService(occrepo, urepo, NotifRepo(db, clock),
                                 clock).jalali_today()
    urepo.update(member.id, birth_date=f"1375/{jm:02d}/{jd:02d}")
    step(bot, clock, cb("occr:1", uid=999))
    txt = all_text(sent)
    assert "مریم خانم" in txt and "زادروزت مبارک" in txt
    assert "۵۰ امتیاز" in txt                    # امتیاز تولد
    assert clubrepo.balance(member.id) == 50
    assert "اجرا شد" in last(sent)
    # اجرای دوباره همان روز — تکرار نمی‌رود
    before = len(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb("occr:1", uid=999))
    assert "نیست" in last(sent)
    # تاریخچه پر شد
    step(bot, clock, cb("occh:1", uid=999))
    assert "۱ نفر" in last(sent)
    del before, jy


def test_bot_campaign_wizard_send_optout(botenv):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, setrepo, member = botenv
    cmprepo = CampaignRepo(db, clock)
    nrepo = NotifRepo(db, clock)
    # عضو عادی راه ندارد
    step(bot, clock, cb("cmp:1"))
    assert "اجازه" in last(sent)
    # ویزارد کامل
    step(bot, clock, cb("cmp:1", uid=999))
    assert "کمپین" in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb("cmpn:1", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("cmpk:promo", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("معرفی پاییزه", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("{first} جان، برنامه‌های پاییز رسید.", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("-", uid=999))          # بی‌نسخهٔ ب
    step(bot, clock, cb("cmpt:all", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("cmps:now", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("-", uid=999))          # بی‌دکمه
    txt = last(sent)
    assert "مرور کمپین" in txt
    step(bot, clock, cb("cmpok:1", uid=999))
    assert "ساخته شد" in all_text(sent)
    cid = cmprepo.list(1)[0].id
    # ارسال
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"cmpgo:{cid}", uid=999))
    body = all_text(sent)
    assert "مریم جان، برنامه‌های پاییز رسید." in body
    assert "دیگر نفرست" in str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", "")) or \
        "nsetoff" in str(sent)
    assert cmprepo.get(cid).status == C_DONE
    # کاربر لغو اشتراک می‌کند
    step(bot, clock, cb("nsetoff:1"))
    assert not nrepo.ads_ok(member.id)
    # کمپین دوم — به او نمی‌رود
    cid2 = cmprepo.create(title="دوم", body_a="سلام دوباره", target="all",
                          created_by=1)
    before = len(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"cmpgo:{cid2}", uid=999))
    assert "سلام دوباره" not in "\n".join(
        str(p.get("text", "")) for p in sent[before:])
    assert cmprepo.get(cid2).status == C_DONE     # معاف دائم = تمام


def test_bot_campaign_click_counts(botenv):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, setrepo, member = botenv
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    cmprepo = CampaignRepo(db, clock)
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه پاییزه", status="published",
                            start_ts=1789000000.0)
    cid = cmprepo.create(title="معرفی", kind="event",
                         body_a="کارگاه رسید", event_id=ev.id,
                         btn_text="دیدن کارگاه", target="all", created_by=1)
    cmpsvc = CampaignService(cmprepo, NotifRepo(db, clock), clock)
    cmpsvc.start(cid)
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"cmpgo:{cid}", uid=999))
    markup = str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", ""))
    assert f"cmpclk:{cid}" in markup
    # کاربر کلیک می‌کند → صفحهٔ رویداد + شمارش
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"cmpclk:{cid}"))
    assert "کارگاه پاییزه" in all_text(sent)
    st = cmpsvc.stats(cid)
    assert st["clicks"] == 1
    step(bot, clock, cb(f"cmpv:{cid}", uid=999))
    assert "۱ کلیک" in all_text(sent)


def test_bot_about_and_notif(botenv):
    bot, db, clock, sent, urepo, setrepo, member = botenv
    abrepo = AboutRepo(db, clock)
    # هاب پشتیبانی ردیف درباره/اعلان دارد
    step(bot, clock, cb("sup:1"))
    markup = str(sent[-1].get("reply_markup", ""))
    assert "ab:1" in markup and "nset:1" in markup
    # دربارهٔ کاربر — معرفی پیش‌فرض
    step(bot, clock, cb("ab:1"))
    assert "خط زندگی" in all_text(sent)
    # تنظیمات اعلان
    step(bot, clock, cb("nset:1"))
    assert "تنظیمات اعلان" in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb("nsad:1"))
    nrepo = NotifRepo(db, clock)
    assert not nrepo.ads_ok(member.id)
    step(bot, clock, cb("nsq:1"))
    step(bot, clock, msg("۲۳-۸"))
    p = nrepo.get(member.id)
    assert (p.quiet_start, p.quiet_end) == (23, 8)
    assert nrepo.in_personal_quiet(member.id, 23)
    assert not nrepo.in_personal_quiet(member.id, 12)
    # مدیر: خاموش کردن معرفی + ویرایش متن
    step(bot, clock, cb("abm:1", uid=999))
    assert "مدیریت دربارهٔ ما" in last(sent)
    step(bot, clock, cb("abmt:intro", uid=999))
    assert setrepo.get("ab_on_intro") == "0"
    step(bot, clock, cb("abme:mission", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("هدف ما ساختن حال خوب است.", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("ab:1"))
    assert "هدف ما ساختن حال خوب است." in all_text(sent)
    # تیم: افزودن عضو
    step(bot, clock, cb("abmp:1", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, cb("abmpn:1", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("سارا احمدی", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("مدرس", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("-", uid=999))
    step(bot, clock, msg("-", uid=999))
    assert abrepo.people() and abrepo.people()[0].name == "سارا احمدی"

async function engAct(url, body, after) {
  if (state.eng.busy) return;
  state.eng.busy = true;
  try {
    const r = await api(url, body ? { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) } : undefined);
    const res = (r && r.result && r.result.result) || "";
    showToast(ENG_RES_FA[res] || "انجام شد");
    if (after) await after(r);
  } catch (e) { w5err(e); }
  state.eng.busy = false;
  render();
}

  state.usr.view = "occ";
  state.eng.occView = "list"; state.eng.occAdd = false;

function occDateFa(r) {
  if (!r.month && !r.day) return r.key === "birthday" ? "هر روز — تولدها" : "تاریخ نخورده";
  return `${faNum(r.month)}/${faNum(r.day)}`;
}
function engOccListView() {
  const d = state.eng.occ;
  const back = `<span class="backbtn" id="engback">${svg("i-back")}بیشتر</span>`;
  if (!d) return back + loadingCard();
  const JM_FA = ["", "فروردین", ...];
  const rows = d.rows.map((r) => `
    <div class="card g">
      <div class="row" style="padding-top:0;border-top:0">
        <div class="av ${r.enabled ? "info" : ""}">${svg("i-cal")}</div>
        <div class="main"><div class="t1">${esc(r.title || OCC_FA[r.key] || r.key)}</div>
          <div class="t2">${occDateFa(r)} · ${faNum(r.points)} امتیاز · ${OCC_G_FA[r.gender] || ""}${r.sent ? " · " + faNum(r.sent) + " ارسال" : ""}</div></div>
        <div class="side"><span class="chip ${r.enabled ? "acc" : ""}">${r.enabled ? "روشن" : "خاموش"}</span></div>
      </div>

        <input class="finp" id="ocm_${r.id}" inputmode="numeric" value="${r.month}" placeholder="ماه" style="max-width:64px" />
        <input class="finp" id="ocd_${r.id}" inputmode="numeric" value="${r.day}" placeholder="روز" style="max-width:64px" />

  </div>${rows}
  ${hist ? `<div class="h2">آخرین ارسال‌ها</div><div class="card g">${hist}</div>` : ""}`;
}

async function engAct(url, body, toast, reloadFn) {
  if (state.eng.busy) return null;
  state.eng.busy = true;
  let r = null;
  try {

function faWhen(ts) {
  if (!ts) return "";
  try { return new Date(ts * 1000).toLocaleString("fa-IR", { month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }); }
  catch (e) { return ""; }
}
function engConfirm(key, fn) {
  if (state.eng.confirmKey === key) { state.eng.confirmKey = ""; fn(); }
  else { state.eng.confirmKey = key; render(); }
}
async function engAct(url, body, opts = {}) {
  if (state.eng.busy) return null;
  state.eng.busy = true;
  let r = null;
  try {
    r = await api(url, body ? { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) } : undefined);
    const res = (r && r.result && r.result.result) || "";
    showToast(opts.toast ? opts.toast(r, res) : (ENG_RES_FA[res] || "انجام شد"));
    if (opts.reload) await opts.reload();
  } catch (e) { w5err(e); }
  state.eng.busy = false;
  render();
  return r;
}

    def due_event_reminders(self) -> list[tuple[Event, int]]:
        """(event, stage) — stage 1 = 24 hours before, 2 = 2 hours before."""
        now = self.clock.ts()
        out: list[tuple[Event, int]] = []
        for ev in self.repo.upcoming_published(now, 24 * 3600 + 60):
            if not ev.notify_reminder:
                continue
            if ev.start_ts - now <= 2 * 3600 and not ev.remind2_ts:
                out.append((ev, 2))
            elif ev.start_ts - now <= 24 * 3600 and not ev.remind1_ts:
                out.append((ev, 1))
        return out
    def mark_reminder(self, event_id: int, stage: int) -> None:
        col = "remind1_ts" if stage == 1 else "remind2_ts"
        self.repo.update_event(event_id, **{col: self.clock.ts()})
New version:

python


    @staticmethod
    def remind_offsets(ev) -> list[int]:
        """List of event reminder offsets (in hours) — normalized, descending order."""
        raw = str(ev.remind_hours or "").replace("،", ",").split(",")
        out = []
        for part in raw:
            part = digits_only(part)  # Is Persian numeral support needed? The admin UI uses buttons. But keep it robust
            if part == "":
                continue
            h = int(part)
            if 0 <= h <= 720 and h not in out:
                out.append(h)
        return sorted(out, reverse=True) or [24, 2]
    @staticmethod
    def _remind_done(ev, h: int) -> bool:
        sent = {digits_only(x) for x in str(ev.remind_sent or "").split(",") if x}
        if str(h) in sent:
            return True
        if h == 24 and ev.remind1_ts:   # Compatibility with old columns
            return True
        return bool(h == 2 and ev.remind2_ts)
    def due_event_reminders(self) -> list[tuple[Event, int]]:
        """(event, offset in hours) — one reminder per offset, one time each."""
        now = self.clock.ts()
        out: list[tuple[Event, int]] = []
        for ev in self.repo.upcoming_published(now, 720 * 3600 + 60):
            if not ev.notify_reminder:
                continue
            for h in self.remind_offsets(ev):
                if self._remind_done(ev, h):
                    continue
                if h == 0:
                    if now >= ev.start_ts - 60:
                        out.append((ev, 0))
                elif ev.start_ts - now <= h * 3600:
                    out.append((ev, h))
        return out
    def mark_reminder(self, event_id: int, hours: int) -> None:
        ev = self.repo.get_event(event_id)
        if ev is None:
            return
        sent = [x for x in str(ev.remind_sent or "").split(",") if x]
        if str(hours) not in sent:
            sent.append(str(hours))
        fields = {"remind_sent": ",".join(sent)}
        if hours == 24 and not ev.remind1_ts:   # Old columns are kept up to date too
            fields["remind1_ts"] = self.clock.ts()
        if hours == 2 and not ev.remind2_ts:
            fields["remind2_ts"] = self.clock.ts()
        self.repo.update_event(event_id, **fields)

But the h=0 case: upcoming_published probably requires start_ts > now → an event at exactly the start time might already be "in progress" (is start_ts >= now still within the window? def on_edit_remind(repo, responder, urepo, ctx: Ctx, eid: int,
                   _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "evrh-denied"
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "evrh-none"
    sel = {int(x) for x in str(ev.remind_hours or "").split(",")
           if x.strip().isdigit()}
    rows = []
    presets = list(REMIND_PRESETS)
    for a, b in zip(presets[0::2], presets[1::2] + (None,)):
        row = [ui.btn(t(f"btn_rh_{a}") + (" ✓" if a in sel else ""),
                      f"evrht:{eid}:{a}")]
        if b is not None:
            row.append(ui.btn(t(f"btn_rh_{b}") + (" ✓" if b in sel else ""),
                             f"evrht:{eid}:{b}"))
        rows.append(row)
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"eved:{eid}")])
    responder.reply(ctx, "ev_rh_head" if ev.notify_reminder else "ev_rh_off",
                    markup=ui.kb(rows))
    return "evrh"
def on_edit_remind_tog(repo, responder, urepo, ctx: Ctx, eid: int,
                       hours: int) -> str:
    if _staff(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "evrht-denied"
    ev = repo.get_event(eid)
    if ev is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "evrht-none"
    cur = {int(x) for x in str(ev.remind_hours or "").split(",")
           if x.strip().isdigit() and 0 <= int(x) <= 720}
    h = int(hours)
    if 0 <= h <= 720:
        if h in cur:
            cur.discard(h)
        else:
            cur.add(h)
    repo.update_event(eid, remind_hours=",".join(
        str(x) for x in sorted(cur, reverse=True)))
    return on_edit_remind(repo, responder, urepo, ctx, eid)

          v_int, v_int)

"""تست فاز ۳۵a: یادآور چندزمانه، پیگیری غایبین، اسپانسر و نقشه."""
from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.attendance import AttendanceRepo
from nora.domain.events import REMIND_PRESETS, EventRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.event_service import EventService


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock,
                              transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    attrepo = AttendanceRepo(db, clock)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved",
                 full_name="ادمین گروه")
    yield {"bot": bot, "clock": clock, "sent": sent, "urepo": urepo,
           "erepo": erepo, "attrepo": attrepo, "db": db}
    set_clock(old)


def step(env, update, uid=999):
    env["clock"].advance_hours(0.01)
    env["bot"].process_update(update)
    env["bot"].outbox.drain()


def tick(env):
    env["clock"].advance_hours(0.01)
    env["bot"].on_tick()
    env["bot"].outbox.drain()


def cb(data, uid=999):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def last(env):
    return str(env["sent"][-1].get("text") or "")


def all_text(env):
    return "\n".join(str(p.get("text") or "") for p in env["sent"])


def mk_member(env, bale, name="کاربر"):
    u = env["urepo"].create(bale, first_name=name)
    env["urepo"].update(u.id, status="approved", full_name=f"{name} کامل")
    return env["urepo"].get(u.id)


def reg(env, user, ev):
    svc = EventService(env["erepo"], env["clock"])
    return svc.register(user, env["erepo"].get_event(ev.id))


# --------------------------------------------------------- یادآور چندزمانه

def test_remind_multi_offsets_catchup(env):
    erepo, clock = env["erepo"], env["clock"]
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="همایش", status="published",
                            start_ts=clock.ts() + 20 * 3600,
                            remind_hours="168,24,2")
    u = mk_member(env, 40, "ثبت")
    reg(env, u, ev)
    tick(env)
    # ۱۶۸ و ۲۴ هر دو واجدند — فقط نزدیک‌ترین (۲۴) پیام می‌گیرد
    assert "تا شروع «همایش» ۲۴ ساعت مانده" in all_text(env)
    fresh = erepo.get_event(ev.id)
    sent_off = {x for x in fresh.remind_sent.split(",") if x}
    assert sent_off == {"168", "24"}          # ۱۶۸ جبرانی علامت خورد
    n = len(env["sent"])
    tick(env)
    assert len(env["sent"]) == n              # تکرار نمی‌رود
    # دو ساعت پیش از شروع — پیام دوم
    clock.advance_hours(18.5)
    tick(env)
    assert "تا شروع «همایش» دو ساعت مانده" in all_text(env)
    fresh = erepo.get_event(ev.id)
    assert set(fresh.remind_sent.split(",")) == {"168", "24", "2"}


def test_remind_legacy_columns_respected(env):

    # ردیف قدیمی: remind1_ts پر است، remind_sent خالی

    fresh = erepo.get_event(ev.id)
    assert fresh.remind2_ts > 0                        # ستون قدیم به‌روز

def test_absent_reminder(env):
    erepo, clock, attrepo = env["erepo"], env["clock"], env["attrepo"]
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه", status="published",
                            start_ts=clock.ts() - 3 * 3600,
                            has_attendance=1, remind_absent=1)
    present = mk_member(env, 50, "حاضر")
    absent = mk_member(env, 51, "غایب")
    reg(env, present, ev)
    reg(env, absent, ev)
    sid = attrepo.add_session(ev.id)
    attrepo.mark(sid, present.id, "code")
    tick(env)
    txts = [str(p.get("text") or "") for p in env["sent"]]
    assert any("جای تو در «کارگاه» خالی بود" in x for x in txts)
    absent_msgs = [p for p in env["sent"]
                   if "جای تو" in str(p.get("text") or "")]
    assert len(absent_msgs) == 1                       # فقط غایب
    assert absent_msgs[0]["chat_id"] == 51
    assert erepo.get_event(ev.id).absent_sent_ts > 0
    n = len(env["sent"])
    tick(env)
    assert len(env["sent"]) == n                       # یک بار بیشتر نه


def test_absent_window_guard(env):
    erepo, clock = env["erepo"], env["clock"]
    # تازه تمام شده (یک ساعت پیش) — هنوز نه
    erepo.create_event(title="زودهنگام", status="finished",
                       start_ts=clock.ts() - 3600, remind_absent=1)
    u = mk_member(env, 52, "کاربر")
    tick(env)
    assert "جای تو" not in all_text(env)
    # سه ساعت پیش — حالا می‌رود
    clock.advance_hours(2.5)
    tick(env)
    assert "جای تو" not in all_text(env)   # ثبت‌نام ندارد — پیامی نیست
    ev2 = erepo.create_event(title="دیروز", status="finished",
                             start_ts=clock.ts() - 3 * 3600,
                             remind_absent=1)
    reg(env, u, ev2)
    tick(env)
    assert "جای تو در «دیروز» خالی بود" in all_text(env)

def test_sponsors_edit_keeps_lines(env):
    erepo = env["erepo"]
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="ویرایش", status="published",
                            start_ts=env["clock"].ts() + 86400)
    step(env, cb(f"eved:{ev.id}"))
    # اسپانسرها آخرین فیلد = صفحهٔ ۳ (ایندکس ۲۳ از ۲۴ فیلد)
    step(env, cb(f"evsetp:{ev.id}:sponsors:2"))

    # «—» یعنی پاک کن
    step(env, cb(f"evsetp:{ev.id}:sponsors:2"))
    step(env, msg("—"))
    assert erepo.get_event(ev.id).sponsors == ""

@dataclass
class CertShare:
    id, issue_id, user_id, vals (dict per person), token (str unique), status (reserved|claimed), cert_id, created_ts, claimed_ts
UNIQUE(issue_id, user_id).

Repo methods: create_issue(**fields) → CertIssue; get_issue; list_issues(limit); update_issue(id, **fields); set_status; delete_issue (cascade shares too); add_shares(issue_id, rows:[(user_id, vals)]) → count added (skip existing); shares(issue_id, status=None, limit); share_by_token(token); share_of(issue_id,user_id); mark_claimed(share_id, cert_id); counts(issue_id) → {total, claimed}; delete_share.

PYTHON
"""مرکز صدور مستقل — دامنه (فاز ۳۵).

دو مفهوم، همان درس نورا۱:
«طرح» (issue)  = قالب پرشده: عنوان + مقادیر مشترک + مخاطب‌ها + تنظیمات.
«سهم» (share)  = یک ردیف به ازای هر گیرنده. فایل ساخته نمی‌شود — فقط
رزرو می‌شود؛ کاربر هر وقت خواست، همان لحظه می‌سازد و می‌گیرد. ساخت
۵۰۰ گواهی یعنی ۵۰۰ بار رندر؛ با این روش بار روی زمان پخش می‌شود.

گواهی ساخته‌شده با event_id منفی در همان جدول certs می‌نشیند:
event_id = -issue_id — یکتایی per (طرح، کاربر) رایگان می‌آید و
شمارهٔ نامه هم per طرح بالا می‌رود.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import secrets
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from ..core.clock import Clock, get_clock
from ..core.db import Database

A_EVENT = "event"        # ثبت‌نام‌های تأییدشدهٔ یک رویداد
A_SEGMENT = "segment"    # دسته: all|female|male|vip
A_MANUAL = "manual"      # فهرست دستی user_id
AUDIENCES = (A_EVENT, A_SEGMENT, A_MANUAL)
SEGMENTS = ("all", "female", "male", "vip")

I_DRAFT = "draft"
I_PUBLISHED = "published"

S_RESERVED = "reserved"
S_CLAIMED = "claimed"


def new_share_token() -> str:
    return secrets.token_urlsafe(12)


@dataclass
class CertIssue:
    id: int
    title: str
    shared_vals: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    audience: str = A_EVENT
    audience_ref: str = ""
    theme: str = ""
    valid_months: int = 24
    notify_text: str = ""
    status: str = I_DRAFT
    created_by: int = 0
    created_ts: float = 0.0
    published_ts: float = 0.0


@dataclass
class CertShare:
    id: int
    issue_id: int
    user_id: int
    vals: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    token: str = ""
    status: str = S_RESERVED
    cert_id: int = 0
    created_ts: float = 0.0
    claimed_ts: float = 0.0


def _row_issue(r) -> CertIssue:
    return CertIssue(
        int(r["id"]), str(r["title"] or ""),
        json.loads(r["shared_vals"] or "{}"),
        str(r["audience"] or A_EVENT), str(r["audience_ref"] or ""),
        str(r["theme"] or ""), int(r["valid_months"] or 24),
        str(r["notify_text"] or ""), str(r["status"] or I_DRAFT),
        int(r["created_by"] or 0), float(r["created_ts"] or 0),
        float(r["published_ts"] or 0))


def _row_share(r) -> CertShare:
    return CertShare(
        int(r["id"]), int(r["issue_id"]), int(r["user_id"]),
        json.loads(r["vals"] or "{}"), str(r["token"] or ""),
        str(r["status"] or S_RESERVED), int(r["cert_id"] or 0),
        float(r["created_ts"] or 0), float(r["claimed_ts"] or 0))


class CertCenterRepo:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, clock: Clock | None = None) -> None:
        self.db = db
        self.clock = clock or get_clock()
        db.ensure_table("cert_issues", [
            ("title", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''"),
            ("shared_vals", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'"),
            ("audience", "TEXT DEFAULT 'event'"),
            ("audience_ref", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("theme", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("valid_months", "INTEGER DEFAULT 24"),
            ("notify_text", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("status", "TEXT DEFAULT 'draft'"),
            ("created_by", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("created_ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("published_ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ])
        db.ensure_table("cert_shares", [
            ("issue_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("user_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("vals", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'"),
            ("token", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''"),
            ("status", "TEXT DEFAULT 'reserved'"),
            ("cert_id", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("created_ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("claimed_ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ])
        db.ensure_index("ux_cert_shares_issue_user", "cert_shares",
                        ["issue_id", "user_id"], unique=True)
        db.ensure_index("ix_cert_shares_token", "cert_shares", ["token"])

    def _now(self) -> float:
        return self.clock.ts() if self.clock else 0.0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- طرح‌ها
    def create_issue(self, **fields) -> CertIssue:
        allowed = {"title", "shared_vals", "audience", "audience_ref",
                   "theme", "valid_months", "notify_text", "status",
                   "created_by"}
        row = {k: v for k, v in fields.items() if k in allowed}
        if isinstance(row.get("shared_vals"), dict):
            row["shared_vals"] = json.dumps(row["shared_vals"],
                                            ensure_ascii=False)
        row["created_ts"] = self._now()
        keys = list(row)
        marks = ", ".join("?" for _ in keys)
        cur = self.db.execute(
            f"INSERT INTO cert_issues ({', '.join(keys)}) VALUES ({marks})",
            tuple(row[k] for k in keys))
        self.db.commit()
        return self.get_issue(int(cur.lastrowid))  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def get_issue(self, issue_id: int) -> CertIssue | None:
        r = self.db.query_one("SELECT * FROM cert_issues WHERE id = ?",
                              (issue_id,))
        return _row_issue(r) if r else None

    def list_issues(self, limit: int = 30) -> list[CertIssue]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM cert_issues ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,))
        return [_row_issue(r) for r in rows]

    def update_issue(self, issue_id: int, **fields) -> None:
        allowed = {"title", "shared_vals", "audience", "audience_ref",
                   "theme", "valid_months", "notify_text", "status",
                   "published_ts"}
        if isinstance(fields.get("shared_vals"), dict):
            fields["shared_vals"] = json.dumps(fields["shared_vals"],
                                               ensure_ascii=False)
        fields = {k: v for k, v in fields.items() if k in allowed}
        if not fields:
            return
        keys = ", ".join(f"{k} = ?" for k in fields)
        self.db.execute(f"UPDATE cert_issues SET {keys} WHERE id = ?",
                        (*fields.values(), issue_id))
        self.db.commit()

    def delete_issue(self, issue_id: int) -> None:
        """طرح و سهم‌هایش می‌روند؛ گواهی‌های ساخته‌شده می‌مانند."""
        self.db.execute("DELETE FROM cert_shares WHERE issue_id = ?",
                        (issue_id,))
        self.db.execute("DELETE FROM cert_issues WHERE id = ?", (issue_id,))
        self.db.commit()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- سهم‌ها
    def add_shares(self, issue_id: int, rows: list[tuple]) -> int:
        """[(user_id, vals)] — تکراری‌ها رد می‌شوند؛ شمار افزوده‌ها."""
        added = 0
        now = self._now()
        for user_id, vals in rows:
            exists = self.db.query_one(
                "SELECT 1 AS x FROM cert_shares WHERE issue_id = ? "
                "AND user_id = ?", (issue_id, int(user_id)))
            if exists is not None:
                continue
            self.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO cert_shares (issue_id, user_id, vals, token,"
                " created_ts) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
                (issue_id, int(user_id),
                 json.dumps(vals or {}, ensure_ascii=False),
                 new_share_token(), now))
            added += 1
        self.db.commit()
        return added

    def get_share(self, share_id: int) -> CertShare | None:
        r = self.db.query_one("SELECT * FROM cert_shares WHERE id = ?",
                              (share_id,))
        return _row_share(r) if r else None

    def share_by_token(self, token: str) -> CertShare | None:
        token = (token or "").strip()
        if not token:
            return None
        r = self.db.query_one("SELECT * FROM cert_shares WHERE token = ?",
                              (token,))
        return _row_share(r) if r else None

    def share_of(self, issue_id: int, user_id: int) -> CertShare | None:
        r = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT * FROM cert_shares WHERE issue_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
            (issue_id, user_id))
        return _row_share(r) if r else None

    def shares_for_user(self, user_id: int,
                        status: str = "") -> list[CertShare]:
        sql = "SELECT * FROM cert_shares WHERE user_id = ?"
        args: tuple = (user_id,)
        if status:
            sql += " AND status = ?"
            args += (status,)
        rows = self.db.query(sql + " ORDER BY id DESC", args)
        return [_row_share(r) for r in rows]

    def shares(self, issue_id: int, status: str = "",
               limit: int = 50) -> list[CertShare]:
        sql = "SELECT * FROM cert_shares WHERE issue_id = ?"
        args: tuple = (issue_id,)
        if status:
            sql += " AND status = ?"
            args += (status,)
        rows = self.db.query(sql + " ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?",
                             args + (limit,))
        return [_row_share(r) for r in rows]

    def counts(self, issue_id: int) -> dict:
        r = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(status = 'claimed') AS c "
            "FROM cert_shares WHERE issue_id = ?", (issue_id,))
        return {"total": int(r["n"] or 0),
                "claimed": int(r["c"] or 0)} if r else {"total": 0,
                                                        "claimed": 0}

    def mark_claimed(self, share_id: int, cert_id: int) -> bool:
        """اتمی: فقط سهم رزروشده claim می‌شود — دوبار ساخت نداریم."""
        with self.db.transaction():
            r = self.db.query_one(
                "SELECT id FROM cert_shares WHERE id = ? AND status = ?",
                (share_id, S_RESERVED))
            if r is None:
                return False
            self.db.execute(
                "UPDATE cert_shares SET status = ?, cert_id = ?, "
                "claimed_ts = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (S_CLAIMED, int(cert_id), self._now(), share_id))
        return True

    def update_share_vals(self, share_id: int, vals: dict) -> None:
        self.db.execute(
            "UPDATE cert_shares SET vals = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (json.dumps(vals or {}, ensure_ascii=False), share_id))
        self.db.commit()

    def delete_share(self, share_id: int) -> None:
        self.db.execute("DELETE FROM cert_shares WHERE id = ?", (share_id,))
        self.db.commit()

"""سرویس مرکز صدور — مخاطب‌یابی، انتشار، ساخت تنبل هنگام دریافت.

بدون کانال: پیام‌ها و فایل‌ها در لایهٔ صفحه/وب فرستاده می‌شوند.
گواهی مرکز با event_id = -issue_id در جدول certs می‌نشیند؛ ساخت فایل
فقط موقع claim انجام می‌شود (cert_path خودش کش اثرانگشتی دارد).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from ..core.clock import Clock
from ..domain.certcenter import (A_EVENT, A_MANUAL, A_SEGMENT, I_PUBLISHED,
                                 SEGMENTS, CertIssue, CertShare,
                                 CertCenterRepo)
from ..domain.events import REG_CONFIRMED
from .cert_service import CertIssueError, CertService


class CertCenterService:
    def __init__(self, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, csvc: CertService,
                 urepo, erepo, clock: Clock | None = None,
                 clubrepo=None) -> None:
        self.repo = cctrepo
        self.csvc = csvc
        self.urepo = urepo
        self.erepo = erepo
        self.clock = clock
        self.clubrepo = clubrepo

    # -------------------------------------------------------- مخاطب‌یابی
    def audience_users(self, issue: CertIssue) -> list:
        """[user_id] واجدان طرح — فقط کاربران فعال و تأییدشده."""
        ref = str(issue.audience_ref or "").strip()
        if issue.audience == A_EVENT:
            eid = int(ref) if ref.isdigit() else 0
            if not eid:
                return []
            out = []
            for reg in self.erepo.event_regs(eid, statuses=(REG_CONFIRMED,)):
                out.append(reg.user_id)
            return out
        if issue.audience == A_SEGMENT:
            seg = ref if ref in SEGMENTS else "all"
            if seg == "all":
                return [u.id for u in self.urepo.all_active()]
            if seg == "vip":
                return [u.id for u in self.urepo.all_active()
                        if getattr(u, "is_vip", 0)]
            rows = self.urepo.all_active()
            return [u.id for u in rows if (u.gender or "") == seg]
        if issue.audience == A_MANUAL:
            ids = []
            for part in ref.replace("،", ",").replace(" ", ",").split(","):
                part = "".join(ch for ch in part
                               if ch.isdigit() or ch.isascii() is False)
                part = _digits(part)
                if part:
                    uid = int(part)
                    if uid not in ids:
                        ids.append(uid)
            return ids
        return []

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ انتشار
    def preview_audience(self, issue: CertIssue) -> int:
        return len(self.audience_users(issue))

    def publish(self, issue_id: int) -> dict:
        """سهم‌ها را رزرو کن و طرح را منتشر کن — فایل ساخته نمی‌شود."""
        issue = self.repo.get_issue(issue_id)
        if issue is None:
            return {"result": "none"}
        if not str(issue.title or "").strip():
            return {"result": "bad_title"}
        users = self.audience_users(issue)
        if not users:
            return {"result": "empty_audience"}
        added = self.repo.add_shares(
            issue_id, [(uid, {}) for uid in users])
        self.repo.update_issue(issue_id, status=I_PUBLISHED,
                               published_ts=self._now())
        counts = self.repo.counts(issue_id)
        return {"result": "published", "added": added,
                "total": counts["total"]}

    def _now(self) -> float:
        return self.clock.ts() if self.clock else 0.0

    # --------------------------------------------------------- دریافت
    def merged_vals(self, issue: CertIssue, share: CertShare) -> dict:
        vals = {k: str(v or "") for k, v in (issue.shared_vals or {}).items()}
        for k, v in (share.vals or {}).items():
            if str(v or "").strip():
                vals[k] = str(v)
        return vals

    def claim(self, share_id: int, by: int = 0) -> dict:
        """ساخت گواهی برای یک سهم — همان لحظه که کاربر می‌خواهد."""
        share = self.repo.get_share(share_id)
        if share is None:
            return {"result": "none"}
        if share.status != "reserved":
            return {"result": "claimed", "cert_id": share.cert_id}
        issue = self.repo.get_issue(share.issue_id)
        if issue is None:
            return {"result": "none"}
        user = self.urepo.get(share.user_id)
        if user is None:
            return {"result": "no_user"}
        vals = self.merged_vals(issue, share)
        try:
            cert = self.csvc.issue(-issue.id, share.user_id, vals,
                                   by or issue.created_by,
                                   valid_months=int(issue.valid_months
                                                    or 24))
        except CertIssueError as exc:
            return {"result": "vars_missing", "error": str(exc)}
        if not self.repo.mark_claimed(share_id, cert.id):
            # رقیب زودتر ساخت — همان گواهی را برگردان
            fresh = self.repo.get_share(share_id)
            return {"result": "claimed",
                    "cert_id": fresh.cert_id if fresh else cert.id}
        return {"result": "ok", "cert_id": cert.id}

    def claim_by_token(self, token: str, user_id: int) -> dict:
        share = self.repo.share_by_token(token)
        if share is None:
            return {"result": "none"}
        if share.user_id != user_id:
            return {"result": "not_yours"}
        return self.claim(share.id)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- آمار
    def stats(self, issue_id: int) -> dict:
        counts = self.repo.counts(issue_id)
        counts["result"] = "ok"
        return counts

def on_ok(cctsvc, cctrepo, csvc, urepo, state, responder, ctx, _a=0):
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None: no_perm
    staff = _top(...)
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_CCTN or not data.get("title"): → cct_none
    issue = cctrepo.create_issue(title=..., shared_vals=data.get("vals", {}),
        audience=data.get("aud", "event"), audience_ref=str(data.get("ref","")),
        theme="", valid_months=..., notify_text="", created_by=staff.id)
    out = cctsvc.publish(issue.id)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    if out["result"] != "published":
        cctrepo.delete_issue(issue.id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_" + out["result"])  # keys: cct_empty_audience...
        return on_hub(...)
    n = _notify(cctsvc, cctrepo, urepo, responder, issue.id)
    responder.reply(ctx, "cct_published", n=fa_num(out["total"]), m=fa_num(n))
    return on_view(... issue.id)

def _cert_event_label(erepo, cert) -> str:
    ev = erepo.get_event(cert.event_id)
    if ev is not None:
        return ev.title
    if cert.event_id < 0 and CCT_REPO is not None:
        iss = CCT_REPO.get_issue(-cert.event_id)
        if iss is not None:
            return iss.title
    return ""

"""مرکز صدور مستقل — صفحهٔ بات (فاز ۳۵).

طرح = قالب پرشده (عنوان + مقادیر مشترک + مخاطب‌ها)؛ سهم = رزرو برای هر
گیرنده. موقع انتشار هیچ فایلی ساخته نمی‌شود — فقط اعلان می‌رود و کاربر
هر وقت خواست، همان لحظه گواهی‌اش ساخته و تحویل داده می‌شود. گیت:
issue_certs. گواهیِ طرح با event_id منفی در همان دفتر certs می‌نشیند.
"""

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- هاب

def on_hub(cctsvc: CertCenterService, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo,
           urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "cct-denied"
    issues = cctrepo.list_issues(8)
    lines = [t("cct_list_head")]
    rows = []
    if not issues:
        lines.append(t("cct_none_line"))
    for iss in issues:
        c = cctrepo.counts(iss.id)
        lines.append(t("cct_line", title=iss.title,
                       claimed=fa_num(c["claimed"]),
                       total=fa_num(c["total"])))
        rows.append([ui.btn(_label(iss.title, 30), f"cctv:{iss.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_cct_new"), "cctn:1"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "certm:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "cct"


def _label(text: str, n: int) -> str:
    text = (text or "").strip()
    return text if len(text) <= n else text[:n - 1] + "…"


# ------------------------------------------------------------ نمای طرح

def _aud_label(cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
               iss: CertIssue) -> str:
    ref = str(iss.audience_ref or "")
    if iss.audience == A_EVENT:
        ev = erepo.get_event(int(ref)) if ref.isdigit() else None
        return t("cct_aud_event_of", title=ev.title if ev else "—")
    if iss.audience == A_SEGMENT:
        return t("cct_seg_" + (ref if ref in SEGMENTS else "all"))
    n = len([x for x in ref.split(",") if x.strip()])
    return t("cct_aud_manual_n", n=fa_num(n))


def on_view(cctsvc: CertCenterService, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo,
            erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
            iid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "cctv-denied"
    iss = cctrepo.get_issue(iid)
    if iss is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_none")
        return "cctv-none"
    c = cctrepo.counts(iid)
    lines = [t("cct_view_head", title=iss.title),
             t("cct_view_line", aud=_aud_label(cctrepo, erepo, iss),
               total=fa_num(c["total"]), claimed=fa_num(c["claimed"])),
             t("cct_status_pub" if iss.status == I_PUBLISHED
               else "cct_status_draft")]
    rows = []
    if iss.status != I_PUBLISHED:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_cct_pub"), f"cctpub:{iid}")])
    else:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_cct_ntf"), f"cctntf:{iid}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_cct_prev"), f"cctprev:{iid}"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_cct_del"), f"cctdel:{iid}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "cct:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "cctv"


def on_publish(cctsvc: CertCenterService, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo,
               urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, iid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "cctpub-denied"
    out = cctsvc.publish(iid)
    if out["result"] != "published":
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_" + out["result"])
        return on_view(cctsvc, cctrepo, _erepo_of(cctsvc), urepo,
                       responder, ctx, iid)
    n = notify_pending(cctrepo, urepo, responder, iid)
    responder.reply(ctx, "cct_published", n=fa_num(out["total"]),
                    m=fa_num(n))
    return on_view(cctsvc, cctrepo, _erepo_of(cctsvc), urepo, responder,
                   ctx, iid)


def _erepo_of(cctsvc: CertCenterService) -> EventRepo:
    return cctsvc.erepo


def notify_pending(cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                   iid: int) -> int:
    """اعلان به سهم‌های رزروشده — همان متن برای همه، با دکمهٔ دریافت."""
    iss = cctrepo.get_issue(iid)
    if iss is None:
        return 0
    markup = ui.kb([[ui.btn(t("btn_cct_get"), "mycert:1")]])
    n = 0
    for share in cctrepo.shares(iid, status=S_RESERVED, limit=100000):
        u = urepo.get(share.user_id)
        if u is None or not u.bale_id:
            continue
        responder.bulk(u.bale_id, "cct_notify", markup=markup,
                       title=iss.title)
        n += 1
    return n


def on_notify_again(cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
                    ctx: Ctx, iid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "cctntf-denied"
    n = notify_pending(cctrepo, urepo, responder, iid)
    responder.reply(ctx, "cct_ntf_done", n=fa_num(n))
    return "cctntf"


def on_preview(cctsvc: CertCenterService, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo,
               csvc: CertService, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
               iid: int) -> str:
    """پیش‌نمایش تصادفی — یک سهم را بردار و همان را رندر کن."""
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "cctprev-denied"
    iss = cctrepo.get_issue(iid)
    if iss is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_none")
        return "cctprev-none"
    shares = cctrepo.shares(iid, limit=500)
    share = random.choice(shares) if shares else None
    if share is not None:
        holder_id = share.user_id
        vals = cctsvc.merged_vals(iss, share)
    else:
        staff = _top(urepo, ctx)
        holder_id = staff.id if staff else 0
        vals = dict(iss.shared_vals or {})
    holder = _name(urepo, holder_id)
    date = fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(iss.published_ts, tz=TEHRAN)) \
        if iss.published_ts else ""
    sample = Cert(id=0, event_id=0, user_id=holder_id, number=1,
                  code="PREVIEW", values=vals, issued_by=0,
                  issued_ts=0.0, revoked=False)
    path = csvc.cert_path(sample, holder, iss.title, date,
                          theme=iss.theme)
    responder.send_photo_file(ctx.user_id, path, "cct_prev_cap",
                              name=holder)
    return "cctprev"


def on_delete_q(cctsvc: CertCenterService, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo,
                erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                iid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "cctdel-denied"
    responder.reply(ctx, "cct_del_q", markup=ui.kb([
        [ui.btn(t("btn_cct_delx"), f"cctdelx:{iid}")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"cctv:{iid}")]]))
    return "cctdel"


def on_delete(cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder,
              ctx: Ctx, iid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "cctdelx-denied"
    cctrepo.delete_issue(iid)
    responder.reply(ctx, "cct_deleted")
    return on_hub(None, cctrepo, urepo, responder, ctx)


# ---------------------------------------------------------- ویزارد ساخت

def on_new(cctsvc: CertCenterService, urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore,
           responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "cctn-denied"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CCTN, {"step": "title"}, merge=False)
    responder.reply(ctx, "cct_ask_title")
    return "cctn"


def _aud_menu(responder, ctx: Ctx) -> None:
    responder.reply(ctx, "cct_aud_head", markup=ui.kb([
        [ui.btn(t("cct_aud_event"), "cctaud:event"),
         ui.btn(t("cct_aud_segment"), "cctaud:segment"),
         ui.btn(t("cct_aud_manual"), "cctaud:manual")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_cct_x"), "cctx:1")]]))


def on_aud(cctsvc: CertCenterService, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
           state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, kind: str) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "cctaud-denied"
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_CCTN or kind not in (A_EVENT, A_SEGMENT, A_MANUAL):
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_none")
        return "cctaud-none"
    data["aud"] = kind
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CCTN, data)
    if kind == A_EVENT:
        evs = erepo.list_events(("published", "closed", "finished"),
                                limit=9)
        rows = [[ui.btn(_label(ev.title, 30), f"cctref:{ev.id}")]
                for ev in evs]
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "cctn:1")])
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_pick_event", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return "cctaud-event"
    if kind == A_SEGMENT:
        rows = [[ui.btn(t("cct_seg_" + s), f"cctseg:{s}")]
                for s in SEGMENTS]
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "cctn:1")])
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_pick_seg", markup=ui.kb(rows))
        return "cctaud-segment"
    data["step"] = "manual"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CCTN, data)
    responder.reply(ctx, "cct_ask_manual")
    return "cctaud-manual"


def on_ref(cctsvc: CertCenterService, urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore,
           responder, ctx: Ctx, eid: int) -> str:
    return _set_ref(cctsvc, urepo, state, responder, ctx, str(eid))


def on_seg(cctsvc: CertCenterService, urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore,
           responder, ctx: Ctx, seg: str) -> str:
    if seg not in SEGMENTS:
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_none")
        return "cctseg-bad"
    return _set_ref(cctsvc, urepo, state, responder, ctx, seg)


def _set_ref(cctsvc: CertCenterService, urepo: UserRepo,
             state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, ref: str) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "cctref-denied"
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_CCTN:
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_none")
        return "cctref-none"
    data["ref"] = ref
    return _vars_step(cctsvc, urepo, state, responder, ctx, data)


def _vars_step(cctsvc: CertCenterService, urepo: UserRepo,
               state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
               data: dict) -> str:
    """مقادیر مشترک متغیرهای دستی چیدمان — یکی‌یکی."""
    names = list(cctsvc.csvc.manual_vars())
    data["vars"] = names
    data["vals"] = {}
    data["i"] = 0
    if names:
        data["step"] = "var"
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CCTN, data)
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_var_ask", name=names[0])
        return "cct-vars"
    return _confirm(cctsvc, urepo, state, responder, ctx, data)


def _confirm(cctsvc: CertCenterService, urepo: UserRepo,
             state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, data: dict) -> str:
    data["step"] = "confirm"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CCTN, data)
    draft = CertIssue(id=0, title=str(data.get("title") or ""),
                      audience=str(data.get("aud") or A_EVENT),
                      audience_ref=str(data.get("ref") or ""))
    n = cctsvc.preview_audience(draft)
    lines = [t("cct_cf_title", v=draft.title),
             t("cct_cf_aud", v=_aud_label(None, cctsvc.erepo, draft)),
             t("cct_cf_n", n=fa_num(n)),
             t("cct_cf_vars", n=fa_num(len(data.get("vals") or {})))]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb([
        [ui.btn(t("btn_cct_ok"), "cctok:1")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_cct_x"), "cctx:1")]]))
    return "cct-confirm"


def on_ok(cctsvc: CertCenterService, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo,
          csvc: CertService, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
          setrepo, state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
          _a: int = 0) -> str:
    staff = _top(urepo, ctx)
    if staff is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "cctok-denied"
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_CCTN or not str(data.get("title") or "").strip():
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_none")
        return "cctok-none"
    iss = cctrepo.create_issue(
        title=str(data["title"]).strip()[:80],
        shared_vals=data.get("vals") or {},
        audience=str(data.get("aud") or A_EVENT),
        audience_ref=str(data.get("ref") or ""),
        valid_months=_months(setrepo), created_by=staff.id)
    out = cctsvc.publish(iss.id)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    if out["result"] != "published":
        cctrepo.delete_issue(iss.id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_" + out["result"])
        return on_hub(cctsvc, cctrepo, urepo, responder, ctx)
    n = notify_pending(cctrepo, urepo, responder, iss.id)
    responder.reply(ctx, "cct_published", n=fa_num(out["total"]),
                    m=fa_num(n))
    return on_view(cctsvc, cctrepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, iss.id)


def on_cancel(state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    responder.reply(ctx, "cct_cancelled")
    return "cctx"


# ------------------------------------------------- دریافت (سمت کاربر)

def on_claim(cctsvc: CertCenterService, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo,
             certs: CertRepo, csvc: CertService, erepo: EventRepo,
             urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, sid: int) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    share = cctrepo.get_share(sid)
    if user is None or share is None or share.user_id != user.id:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "cctget-denied"
    out = cctsvc.claim(sid)
    res = out.get("result")
    if res in ("ok", "claimed") and out.get("cert_id"):
        from .certs import on_view as cert_view
        return cert_view(certs, csvc, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx,
                         int(out["cert_id"]))
    if res == "vars_missing":
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("cct_claim_err",
                                   err=str(out.get("error") or "")))
        return "cctget-vars"
    if res == "not_yours":
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_not_yours")
        return "cctget-notyours"
    responder.reply(ctx, "cct_none")
    return "cctget-none"


def deep_link(cctsvc: CertCenterService, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo,
              certs: CertRepo, csvc: CertService, erepo: EventRepo,
              urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
              payload: str) -> bool:
    payload = (payload or "").strip()
    if not payload.startswith("cct"):
        return False
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if user is None:
        return True
    out = cctsvc.claim_by_token(payload[3:], user.id)
    res = out.get("result")
    if res in ("ok", "claimed") and out.get("cert_id"):
        from .certs import on_view as cert_view
        cert_view(certs, csvc, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx,
                  int(out["cert_id"]))
        return True
    if res == "not_yours":
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_not_yours")
    elif res == "none":
        responder.reply(ctx, "cct_link_none")
    else:
        responder.reply(ctx, "cert_mine_title")
    return True


# ------------------------------------------------------ ورودی متنی

def cct_text_interceptor(cctsvc: CertCenterService, urepo: UserRepo,
                         state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                         text: str) -> bool:
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_CCTN:
        return False
    sub = str(data.get("step") or "")
    if sub == "title":
        title = " ".join(text.split())
        if len(title) < 3:
            responder.reply(ctx, "cct_title_bad")
            return True
        data["title"] = title[:80]
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CCTN, data)
        _aud_menu(responder, ctx)
        return True
    if sub == "manual":
        ids: list[str] = []
        raw = text
        for sep in (chr(0x060C), " ", "\n", ";"):
            raw = raw.replace(sep, ",")
        for part in raw.split(","):
            d = digits_only(part)
            if d and d not in ids:
                ids.append(d)
        if not ids:
            responder.reply(ctx, "cct_manual_bad")
            return True
        data["ref"] = ",".join(ids)
        return _vars_step(cctsvc, urepo, state, responder, ctx, data) == ""
    if sub == "var":
        names = list(data.get("vars") or [])
        i = int(data.get("i") or 0)
        val = " ".join(text.split())
        if val not in ("-", "—") and i < len(names):
            data.setdefault("vals", {})[names[i]] = val[:200]
        i += 1
        data["i"] = i
        if i < len(names):
            state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_CCTN, data)
            responder.reply(ctx, "cct_var_ask", name=names[i])
            return True
        _confirm(cctsvc, urepo, state, responder, ctx, data)
        return True
    return False


# ------------------------------------------------------------ مسیرها

def register_certcenter_routes(r, cctsvc: CertCenterService,
                               cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, certs: CertRepo,
                               csvc: CertService, erepo: EventRepo,
                               urepo: UserRepo, setrepo,
                               state: StateStore, responder) -> None:
    r.add("cct", _w(on_hub, cctsvc, cctrepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("cctv", _w(on_view, cctsvc, cctrepo, erepo, urepo, responder),
          v_int)
    r.add("cctn", _w(on_new, cctsvc, urepo, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("cctaud", _w(on_aud, cctsvc, erepo, urepo, state, responder),
          v_word)
    r.add("cctref", _w(on_ref, cctsvc, urepo, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("cctseg", _w(on_seg, cctsvc, urepo, state, responder), v_word)
    r.add("cctok", _w(on_ok, cctsvc, cctrepo, csvc, erepo, urepo, setrepo,
                      state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("cctx", _w(on_cancel, state, responder), v_int)
    r.add("cctpub", _w(on_publish, cctsvc, cctrepo, urepo, responder),
          v_int)
    r.add("cctntf", _w(on_notify_again, cctrepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("cctprev", _w(on_preview, cctsvc, cctrepo, csvc, urepo,
                        responder), v_int)
    r.add("cctdel", _w(on_delete_q, cctsvc, cctrepo, erepo, urepo,
                       responder), v_int)
    r.add("cctdelx", _w(on_delete, cctrepo, urepo, responder), v_int)
    r.add("cctget", _w(on_claim, cctsvc, cctrepo, certs, csvc, erepo,
                       urepo, responder), v_int)
