"""تست فاز ۳۵b: مرکز صدور مستقل — طرح، سهم، انتشار، دریافت تنبل."""
from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.certcenter import CertCenterRepo
from nora.domain.certs import CertRepo
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.cert_service import CertService
from nora.services.certcenter_service import CertCenterService
from nora.services.event_service import EventService


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock,
                              transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    cctrepo = CertCenterRepo(db, clock)
    certrepo = CertRepo(db, clock)
    csvc = CertService(certrepo, clock)
    cctsvc = CertCenterService(cctrepo, csvc, urepo, erepo, clock)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved",
                 full_name="ادمین گروه")
    yield {"bot": bot, "clock": clock, "sent": sent, "urepo": urepo,
           "erepo": erepo, "db": db, "cctrepo": cctrepo,
           "cctsvc": cctsvc, "certrepo": certrepo, "csvc": csvc}
    set_clock(old)


def step(env, update, uid=999):
    env["clock"].advance_hours(0.01)
    env["bot"].process_update(update)
    env["bot"].outbox.drain()


def cb(data, uid=999):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def last(env):
    return str(env["sent"][-1].get("text") or "")


def all_text(env):
    return "\n".join(str(p.get("text") or "") for p in env["sent"])


def all_markup(env):
    return "\n".join(str(p.get("reply_markup") or "") for p in env["sent"])


def photos(env):
    return [p for p in env["sent"]
            if str(p.get("photo_file", "")).endswith(".png")]


def mk_member(env, bale, name="کاربر", **kw):
    u = env["urepo"].create(bale, first_name=name)
    env["urepo"].update(u.id, status="approved", full_name=f"{name} کامل",
                        **kw)
    return env["urepo"].get(u.id)


def wizard_female(env):
    """ویزارد کامل از بات: عنوان → دستهٔ زنان → تأیید → ساخت."""
    step(env, cb("cctn:1"))
    assert t("cct_ask_title") in last(env)
    step(env, msg("گواهی دورهٔ پاییز"))
    assert "cctaud:segment" in all_markup(env)
    step(env, cb("cctaud:segment"))
    assert "cctseg:female" in all_markup(env)
    step(env, cb("cctseg:female"))
    assert t("cct_cf_n", n="۱") in last(env)
    step(env, cb("cctok:1"))


def mk_issue(env, **kw):
    fields = {"title": "طرح", "audience": "manual", "audience_ref": "40",
              "created_by": 1}
    fields.update(kw)
    iss = env["cctrepo"].create_issue(**fields)
    env["cctsvc"].publish(iss.id)
    return env["cctrepo"].get_issue(iss.id)


# ------------------------------------------------------------ ویزارد

def test_wizard_publish_notifies(env):
    f = mk_member(env, 40, "زن", gender="female")
    m = mk_member(env, 41, "مرد", gender="male")
    wizard_female(env)
    assert "منتشر شد" in all_text(env)
    assert t("cct_notify", title="گواهی دورهٔ پاییز") in all_text(env)
    # فقط زن اعلان گرفته — مرد نه
    got = [p for p in env["sent"] if p.get("chat_id") == 40]
    assert any("cctget:" in str(p.get("reply_markup") or "") for p in got)
    assert not [p for p in env["sent"]
                if p.get("chat_id") == 41 and "رزرو شد"
                in str(p.get("text") or "")]
    iss = env["cctrepo"].list_issues(5)[0]
    assert iss.status == "published" and iss.audience_ref == "female"
    c = env["cctrepo"].counts(iss.id)
    assert c == {"total": 1, "claimed": 0}
    share = env["cctrepo"].shares(iss.id)[0]
    assert share.user_id == f.id and share.token


def test_wizard_gate_and_title(env):
    mk_member(env, 40, "زن")
    step(env, cb("cct:1", uid=40))
    assert t("no_perm") in last(env)
    step(env, cb("cctn:1"))
    step(env, msg("ab"))                    # کوتاه
    assert t("cct_title_bad") in last(env)
    step(env, msg("لغو"))                   # هنوز در ویزارد — عنوان شد

def test_manual_ids_parsed(env):

def test_claim_makes_cert_lazily(env):
    u = mk_member(env, 40, "گیرنده")
    iss = mk_issue(env, audience_ref=str(u.id))
    share = env["cctrepo"].shares(iss.id)[0]
    assert not photos(env)                  # انتشار فایلی نساخت
    step(env, cb(f"cctget:{share.id}", uid=40))
    assert len(photos(env)) == 1            # موقع دریافت ساخته شد
    fresh = env["cctrepo"].get_share(share.id)
    assert fresh.status == "claimed" and fresh.cert_id
    cert = env["certrepo"].get_for(-iss.id, u.id)
    assert cert is not None and cert.id == fresh.cert_id
    # دریافت دوباره = همان گواهی، بی‌ساخت تازه
    n = len(photos(env))
    step(env, cb(f"cctget:{share.id}", uid=40))
    assert len(photos(env)) == n + 1        # فقط دوباره ارسال شد
    assert env["certrepo"].get_for(-iss.id, u.id).id == cert.id

def test_event_audience_confirmed_only(env):

def test_vars_missing_then_shared_fix(env, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(CertService, "manual_vars",
                        lambda self: ["درجه"])
    u = mk_member(env, 40, "گیرنده")
    iss = env["cctrepo"].create_issue(title="با متغیر",
                                      audience="manual",
                                      audience_ref=str(u.id),
                                      created_by=1)
    env["cctsvc"].publish(iss.id)
    share = env["cctrepo"].shares(iss.id)[0]
    out = env["cctsvc"].claim(share.id)
    assert out["result"] == "vars_missing" and "درجه" in out["error"]
    assert env["cctrepo"].get_share(share.id).status == "reserved"
    env["cctrepo"].update_issue(iss.id, shared_vals={"درجه": "عالی"})
    out = env["cctsvc"].claim(share.id)
    assert out["result"] == "ok" and out["cert_id"]
    cert = env["certrepo"].get(out["cert_id"])
    assert cert.values.get("درجه") == "عالی"


def test_merged_vals_override(env):
    u = mk_member(env, 40, "گیرنده")
    iss = env["cctrepo"].create_issue(
        title="ترکیب", audience="manual", audience_ref=str(u.id),
        shared_vals={"درجه": "خوب", "دوره": "پاییز"})
    env["cctsvc"].publish(iss.id)
    share = env["cctrepo"].shares(iss.id)[0]
    env["cctrepo"].update_share_vals(share.id, {"درجه": "عالی"})
    fresh = env["cctrepo"].get_share(share.id)
    vals = env["cctsvc"].merged_vals(iss, fresh)
    assert vals == {"درجه": "عالی", "دوره": "پاییز"}

"""مرکز صدور در پنل وب — آینهٔ صفحهٔ certcenter بات.

طرح‌ها (issue) با شمار سهم‌ها، ساخت/ویرایش/انتشار/حذف، فهرست سهم‌ها با
وضعیت و توکن، مقدار per-person، افزودن دستی شناسه و اعلان دوباره.
گیت: issue_certs. بدون لیترال فارسی و بدون import از channels.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from ..core.clock import TEHRAN
from ..core.jalali import fmt_dt
from ..core.num import digits_only
from ..domain.certcenter import (A_EVENT, A_MANUAL, A_SEGMENT, I_PUBLISHED,
                                 SEGMENTS, CertCenterRepo)
from ..services.certcenter_service import CertCenterService
from ..services.cert_service import CertService

_FA_SEPS = (chr(0x060C), " ", "\n", ";")


def _dt(ts: float) -> str:
    return fmt_dt(datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, tz=TEHRAN)) if ts else ""


def _name(urepo, user_id: int) -> str:
    u = urepo.get(user_id)
    if u is None:
        return ""
    return u.full_name or u.first_name or u.username or str(u.bale_id)


def parse_ids(text: str) -> list[int]:
    """فهرست دستی شناسه‌ها — همان قاعدهٔ بات: جداکننده‌ها + dedupe."""
    raw = str(text or "")
    for sep in _FA_SEPS:
        raw = raw.replace(sep, ",")
    out: list[int] = []
    for part in raw.split(","):
        d = digits_only(part)
        if d and int(d) not in out:
            out.append(int(d))
    return out


def audience_label(cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, erepo, iss) -> str:
    """برچسب مخاطب برای پنل — عنوان رویداد یا نام دسته یا شمار دستی."""
    ref = str(iss.audience_ref or "")
    if iss.audience == A_EVENT and ref.isdigit():
        ev = erepo.get_event(int(ref))
        return ev.title if ev is not None else ref
    if iss.audience == A_SEGMENT:
        return ref if ref in SEGMENTS else "all"
    return str(len(parse_ids(ref)))


# ------------------------------------------------------------- فهرست‌ها

def cct_list(*, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, erepo) -> list:
    out = []
    for iss in cctrepo.list_issues(60):
        c = cctrepo.counts(iss.id)
        out.append({
            "id": iss.id, "title": iss.title, "status": iss.status,
            "audience": iss.audience,
            "audience_label": audience_label(cctrepo, erepo, iss),
            "total": c["total"], "claimed": c["claimed"],
            "created": _dt(iss.created_ts), "published": _dt(iss.published_ts),
        })
    return out


def cct_meta(*, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, csvc: CertService, erepo) -> dict:
    """خوراک فرم ساخت: رویدادها، دسته‌ها، متغیرهای دستی چیدمان."""
    events = [{"id": ev.id, "title": ev.title}
              for ev in erepo.list_events(
                  ("published", "closed", "finished"), limit=40)]
    return {"events": events, "segments": list(SEGMENTS),
            "vars": list(csvc.manual_vars())}


def cct_detail(*, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, csvc: CertService, erepo,
               iid: int) -> dict | None:
    iss = cctrepo.get_issue(iid)
    if iss is None:
        return None
    c = cctrepo.counts(iid)
    return {
        "id": iss.id, "title": iss.title, "status": iss.status,
        "audience": iss.audience,
        "audience_ref": iss.audience_ref,
        "audience_label": audience_label(cctrepo, erepo, iss),
        "theme": iss.theme, "valid_months": iss.valid_months,
        "notify_text": iss.notify_text,
        "shared_vals": iss.shared_vals or {},
        "created": _dt(iss.created_ts), "published": _dt(iss.published_ts),
        "total": c["total"], "claimed": c["claimed"],
        "vars": list(csvc.manual_vars()),
    }


def cct_shares(*, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, urepo, iid: int,
               status: str = "", offset: int = 0,
               limit: int = 200) -> dict | None:
    if cctrepo.get_issue(iid) is None:
        return None
    rows = cctrepo.shares(iid, status=status, limit=100000)
    page = rows[offset:offset + limit]
    items = [{
        "id": sh.id, "user_id": sh.user_id,
        "name": _name(urepo, sh.user_id), "status": sh.status,
        "token": sh.token, "vals": sh.vals or {},
        "created": _dt(sh.created_ts), "claimed": _dt(sh.claimed_ts),
    } for sh in page]
    return {"items": items, "total": len(rows), "offset": offset}


# --------------------------------------------------------------- نوشتن

_EDITABLE = ("title", "theme", "valid_months", "notify_text",
             "audience", "audience_ref")


def cct_create(*, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, actor, body: dict) -> dict:
    title = " ".join(str(body.get("title") or "").split())
    if len(title) < 3:
        return {"result": "bad_title"}
    audience = str(body.get("audience") or A_EVENT)
    if audience not in (A_EVENT, A_SEGMENT, A_MANUAL):
        return {"result": "bad_audience"}
    ref = str(body.get("audience_ref") or "")
    if audience == A_MANUAL:
        ref = ",".join(str(i) for i in parse_ids(ref))
    vals = body.get("shared_vals")
    iss = cctrepo.create_issue(
        title=title[:80],
        shared_vals=vals if isinstance(vals, dict) else {},
        audience=audience, audience_ref=ref,
        theme=str(body.get("theme") or "")[:20],
        valid_months=int(body.get("valid_months") or 24),
        notify_text=str(body.get("notify_text") or "")[:500],
        created_by=int(getattr(actor, "id", 0) or 0))
    return {"result": "ok", "id": iss.id}


def cct_update(*, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, iid: int,
               body: dict) -> dict:
    iss = cctrepo.get_issue(iid)
    if iss is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    fields: dict = {}
    for key in _EDITABLE:
        if key in body:
            fields[key] = str(body.get(key) or "")
    if "title" in fields:
        fields["title"] = " ".join(fields["title"].split())[:80]
        if len(fields["title"]) < 3:
            return {"result": "bad_title"}
    if "valid_months" in body:
        try:
            fields["valid_months"] = int(body.get("valid_months") or 24)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            fields["valid_months"] = 24
    vals = body.get("shared_vals")
    if isinstance(vals, dict):
        fields["shared_vals"] = vals
    if not fields:
        return {"result": "ok"}
    if iss.status == I_PUBLISHED and ("audience" in fields
                                      or "audience_ref" in fields):
        return {"result": "locked"}   # مخاطبِ طرحِ منتشرشده دست‌نخوردنی
    cctrepo.update_issue(iid, **fields)
    return {"result": "ok"}


def cct_publish(*, cctsvc: CertCenterService, iid: int) -> dict:
    return cctsvc.publish(iid)


def cct_delete(*, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, iid: int) -> dict:
    if cctrepo.get_issue(iid) is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    cctrepo.delete_issue(iid)
    return {"result": "ok"}


def cct_add(*, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, iid: int, body: dict) -> dict:
    """افزودن دستی شناسه به طرح موجود — تکراری‌ها رد می‌شوند."""
    iss = cctrepo.get_issue(iid)
    if iss is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    ids = parse_ids(body.get("ids") or "")
    if not ids:
        return {"result": "empty"}
    added = cctrepo.add_shares(iid, [(uid, {}) for uid in ids])
    counts = cctrepo.counts(iid)
    return {"result": "ok", "added": added, "total": counts["total"]}


def cct_share_vals(*, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, sid: int,
                   body: dict) -> dict:
    share = cctrepo.get_share(sid)
    if share is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    vals = body.get("vals")
    if not isinstance(vals, dict):
        return {"result": "bad_body"}
    cctrepo.update_share_vals(sid, {str(k): str(v or "")[:200]
                                    for k, v in vals.items()})
    return {"result": "ok"}


def cct_share_delete(*, cctrepo: CertCenterRepo, sid: int) -> dict:
    share = cctrepo.get_share(sid)
    if share is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    cctrepo.delete_share(sid)
    return {"result": "ok"}

async function cctPublish() {
  const c = state.cert.cct; if (c.busy || !c.detail) return;
  c.busy = true;

async function cctSaveMain() {
  const c = state.cert.cct; if (c.busy || !c.detail) return;
  const titleEl = document.getElementById("cctTitle");
  const vmEl = document.getElementById("cctMonths");
  const body = {
    title: titleEl ? titleEl.value.trim() : c.detail.title,
    valid_months: vmEl ? Number(vmEl.value || 24) : c.detail.valid_months,
    shared_vals: cctValsFromForm("ccvar"),
  };
  c.busy = true;
  try {
    const r = await api(`/api/certcenter/${c.detail.id}/update`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    showToast(CCT_RES_FA[r.result] || r.result);
    await cctReloadDetail();
  } catch (e) { w5err(e); }
  c.busy = false; render();
}

async function cctCreate() {
  const c = state.cert.cct; if (c.busy) return;
  const tEl = document.getElementById("cctNewTitle");
  const title = tEl ? tEl.value.trim() : "";
  let ref = c.ref;
  if (c.aud === "manual") {
    const el = document.getElementById("cctNewIds");
    ref = el ? el.value.trim() : "";
  }
  const vals = cctValsFromForm("ccnvar");
  const mEl = document.getElementById("cctNewMonths");
  c.busy = true;
  try {
    const r = await api("/api/certcenter/issue", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({
      title, audience: c.aud, audience_ref: ref, shared_vals: vals,
      valid_months: mEl ? Number(mEl.value || 24) : 24,
    })});
    if (r.ok) { showToast("Plan created"); await cctOpenDetail(r.id); }
    else showToast(CCT_RES_FA[r.result] || r.result);
  } catch (e) { w5err(e); }
  c.busy = false; render();
}

function cctNewView() {
  const back = `<span class="backbtn" id="certback">${svg("i-back")}Issuance Center</span>`;
  const c = state.cert.cct;
  const m = c ? c.meta : null;
  if (!m) return back + loadingCard();
  const auds = ["event", "segment", "manual"].map((a) =>
    `<button class="chip ${c.aud === a ? "on" : ""}" data-ccaud="${a}">${CCT_AUD_FA[a]}</button>`).join("");
  let refPick = "";
  if (c.aud === "event") {
    refPick = `<div class="card g">${m.events.map((ev) =>
      `<div class="row evrow" data-ccref="${ev.id}">
        <div class="main"><div class="t1">${esc(ev.title)}</div></div>
        <div class="side">${String(c.ref) === String(ev.id) ? `<span class="chip acc">Selected</span>` : ""}</div>
      </div>`).join("") || `<div class="empty"><div class="t1">No events</div></div>`}</div>`;
  } else if (c.aud === "segment") {
    refPick = `<div class="btnrow">${m.segments.map((s) =>
      `<button class="chip ${c.ref === s ? "on" : ""}" data-ccseg="${s}">${CCT_SEG_FA[s]}</button>`).join("")}</div>`;
  } else {
    refPick = `<div class="card g"><div class="col">
      <div class="t2">User IDs — separated by commas or spaces</div>
      <textarea class="finp" id="cctNewIds" rows="3"></textarea></div></div>`;
  }
  const varsForm = m.vars.map((v) =>
    `<input class="finp" data-ccnvar="${esc(v)}" placeholder="${esc(v)} — shared value" autocomplete="off">`).join("");
  return back + `<div class="h2">New Plan</div>
  <div class="card g"><div class="col">
    <input class="finp" id="cctNewTitle" placeholder="Plan title — e.g.: Fall Course Certificate" autocomplete="off">
    <div class="t2">Who should receive it?</div>
    <div class="btnrow">${auds}</div>
    ${varsForm ? `<div class="t2">Layout shared values</div>${varsForm}` : ""}
    <div class="t2">Validity period (months)</div>
    <input class="finp" id="cctNewMonths" type="number" min="0" value="24">
    <div class="btnrow"><button class="btn wide" id="cctCreateBtn">Create Plan</button></div>
  </div></div>
  ${refPick}`;
}

"""مرکز صدور وب — فاز ۳۵c: طرح‌ها، انتشار، سهم‌ها، اعلان، گیت‌ها."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer

from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.certcenter import CertCenterRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from web.server import create_app


class FakeResponder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.sent = []

    def bulk(self, chat_id, key, markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("bulk", chat_id, key))

    def bulk_raw(self, chat_id, text, markup=None):
        self.sent.append(("raw", chat_id, text))

    def send_photo_file(self, chat_id, path, key="", **kw):
        self.sent.append(("photofile", chat_id, key))
        return True

    def send_photo(self, chat_id, file_id, key="", markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("photo", chat_id, file_id))

    def send_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        return False

    def bulk_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        return False


async def _client(db, fake_clock, *, role="owner", bale_id=999):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    fake = FakeResponder()
    admin = urepo.create(bale_id, first_name="مدیر")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role=role, status="approved",
                 full_name="مدیر نورا")
    settings = Settings(env="dev", bot_token="123:T",
                        admin_ids=(bale_id,))
    app = create_app(settings, db, dev_bale_id=bale_id,
                     responder=fake, clock=fake_clock)
    client = TestClient(TestServer(app))
    await client.start_server()
    r = await client.post("/api/auth", json={"dev": True})
    tok = (await r.json())["token"]
    return client, {"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok}, admin, fake


def _members(db, n=2, bale0=5001):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        u = urepo.create(bale0 + i, first_name="کاربر")
        urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", role="member",
                     full_name=f"کاربر {i}")
        out.append(urepo.get(u.id))
    return out


async def _mk(client, hdr, **kw):
    body = {"title": "گواهی دوره", "audience": "manual",
            "audience_ref": "1"}
    body.update(kw)
    r = await client.post("/api/certcenter/issue", headers=hdr, json=body)
    return await r.json()


# ------------------------------------------------------------- فهرست و ساخت

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_create_list_detail(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, admin, _ = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    m = _members(db, 2)
    out = await _mk(client, hdr, audience_ref=f"{m[0].id}، {m[1].id}")
    assert out["ok"] and out["id"]
    iid = out["id"]

    r = await client.get("/api/certcenter", headers=hdr)
    items = (await r.json())["items"]
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["title"] == "گواهی دوره"
    assert items[0]["status"] == "draft" and items[0]["total"] == 0

    r = await client.get(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["audience_label"] == "2"        # شمار دستی
    assert d["valid_months"] == 24

    r = await client.get("/api/certcenter/999", headers=hdr)
    assert r.status == 404


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_create_bad_title(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, _, _ = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    out = await _mk(client, hdr, title="ab")
    assert not out["ok"] and out["result"] == "bad_title"
    out = await _mk(client, hdr, audience="nope")
    assert out["result"] == "bad_audience"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_publish_notify_shares(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, admin, fake = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    m = _members(db, 2)
    iid = (await _mk(client, hdr,
                     audience_ref=f"{m[0].id},{m[1].id}"))["id"]

    r = await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/publish", headers=hdr,
                          json={})
    out = await r.json()
    assert out["ok"] and out["result"] == "published" and out["total"] == 2

    fake.sent.clear()
    r = await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/notify", headers=hdr,
                          json={})
    assert (await r.json())["sent"] == 2
    assert len([s for s in fake.sent if s[0] == "bulk"]) == 2

    r = await client.get(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/shares", headers=hdr)
    data = await r.json()
    assert data["total"] == 2 and len(data["items"]) == 2
    names = {x["name"] for x in data["items"]}
    assert names == {"کاربر 0", "کاربر 1"}
    sid = data["items"][0]["id"]
    assert data["items"][0]["token"]

    # مقدار per-person و حذف سهم
    r = await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/shares/{sid}/vals",
                          headers=hdr, json={"vals": {"درجه": "عالی"}})
    assert (await r.json())["ok"]
    r = await client.get(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/shares", headers=hdr)
    got = {x["id"]: x for x in (await r.json())["items"]}
    assert got[sid]["vals"] == {"درجه": "عالی"}

    other = [x for x in got.values() if x["id"] != sid][0]["id"]
    r = await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/shares/{other}/delete",
                          headers=hdr, json={})
    assert (await r.json())["ok"]
    r = await client.get(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/shares", headers=hdr)
    assert (await r.json())["total"] == 1

    # اعلان دوباره فقط به باقی‌مانده
    fake.sent.clear()
    r = await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/notify", headers=hdr,
                          json={})
    assert (await r.json())["sent"] == 1


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_update_and_lock(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, _, _ = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    m = _members(db, 1)
    iid = (await _mk(client, hdr, audience_ref=str(m[0].id)))["id"]

    r = await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/update", headers=hdr,
                          json={"title": "عنوان تازه", "valid_months": 12,
                                "shared_vals": {"درجه": "خوب"}})
    assert (await r.json())["ok"]
    r = await client.get(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}", headers=hdr)
    d = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert d["title"] == "عنوان تازه" and d["valid_months"] == 12
    assert d["shared_vals"] == {"درجه": "خوب"}

    r = await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/update", headers=hdr,
                          json={"title": "x"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "bad_title"

    await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/publish", headers=hdr,
                      json={})
    r = await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/update", headers=hdr,
                          json={"audience": "segment"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "locked"
    r = await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/update", headers=hdr,
                          json={"theme": "gold"})
    assert (await r.json())["ok"]            # بقیهٔ فیلدها آزاد


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_add_ids_and_delete(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, _, _ = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    m = _members(db, 2)
    iid = (await _mk(client, hdr, audience_ref=str(m[0].id)))["id"]
    await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/publish", headers=hdr,
                      json={})

    r = await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/add", headers=hdr,
                          json={"ids": f"{m[1].id}؛ {m[0].id} abc"})
    out = await r.json()
    assert out["ok"] and out["added"] == 1 and out["total"] == 2
    r = await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/add", headers=hdr,
                          json={"ids": "abc"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "empty"

    r = await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/delete", headers=hdr,
                          json={})
    assert (await r.json())["ok"]
    repo = CertCenterRepo(db, fake_clock)
    assert repo.get_issue(iid) is None
    assert repo.shares(iid) == []
    r = await client.post(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}/delete", headers=hdr,
                          json={})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "none"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_meta_and_event_audience(db, fake_clock):
    from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
    client, hdr, _, _ = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="همایش بهار", status="published",
                            start_ts=fake_clock.ts() + 86400)
    r = await client.get("/api/certcenter/meta", headers=hdr)
    data = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert [x["id"] for x in data["events"]] == [ev.id]
    assert data["segments"] == ["all", "female", "male", "vip"]

    iid = (await _mk(client, hdr, audience="event",
                     audience_ref=str(ev.id)))["id"]
    r = await client.get(f"/api/certcenter/{iid}", headers=hdr)
    assert (await r.json())["data"]["audience_label"] == "همایش بهار"

home_prefs.py
PYTHON
"""ترجیحات نمای خانه — چیدمان منوی کاربر و کاتالوگ آمار (فاز ۳۵).

G10: سه چیدمان compact/grouped/full برای خانهٔ بات (شمار رویدادها و
دکمهٔ «درباره ما» در full) + خاموش/روشن بخش‌ها با فهرست پنهان‌ها.
G11: کاتالوگ آیتم‌های آمار — همان فهرست، هم آمار بات (stats) و هم
کارت‌های خانهٔ وب را فیلتر می‌کند.

kvها: user_layout (نام چیدمان)، user_sections (CSV پنهان‌ها)،
stat_items (CSV پنهان‌ها). بدون کانال و بدون لیترال فارسی.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

LAYOUTS = ("compact", "grouped", "full")
LAYOUT_EVENTS = {"compact": 3, "grouped": 6, "full": 10}

SECTIONS = ("profile", "myev", "mycert", "rec", "done", "sup",
            "fin", "att", "club", "about")

STAT_ITEMS = ("users", "regs", "pays", "income", "tickets", "certs",
              "activity")


def _csv(setrepo, key: str) -> list[str]:
    if setrepo is None:
        return []
    raw = str(setrepo.get(key, "") or "")
    return [x for x in (p.strip() for p in raw.split(",")) if x]


def _set_csv(setrepo, key: str, items) -> None:
    if setrepo is None:
        return
    setrepo.set(key, ",".join(items))


def layout_of(setrepo) -> str:
    name = str((setrepo.get("user_layout", "") if setrepo else "") or "")
    return name if name in LAYOUTS else "grouped"


def set_layout(setrepo, name: str) -> bool:
    if name not in LAYOUTS or setrepo is None:
        return False
    setrepo.set("user_layout", name)
    return True


def events_limit(setrepo) -> int:
    return LAYOUT_EVENTS.get(layout_of(setrepo), 6)


def hidden_sections(setrepo) -> set:
    return {s for s in _csv(setrepo, "user_sections") if s in SECTIONS}


def sections_view(setrepo) -> list:
    """[(key, on)] — ترتیب کاتالوگ."""
    hidden = hidden_sections(setrepo)
    return [(s, s not in hidden) for s in SECTIONS]


def toggle_section(setrepo, key: str) -> bool:
    if key not in SECTIONS or setrepo is None:
        return False
    hidden = [s for s in _csv(setrepo, "user_sections") if s in SECTIONS]
    if key in hidden:
        hidden.remove(key)
    else:
        hidden.append(key)
    _set_csv(setrepo, "user_sections", hidden)
    return True


def stat_view(setrepo) -> list:
    """[(key, on)] — آیتم‌های آمار در فهرست سفید."""
    hidden = {s for s in _csv(setrepo, "stat_items") if s in STAT_ITEMS}
    return [(k, k not in hidden) for k in STAT_ITEMS]


def stats_visible(setrepo) -> tuple:
    hidden = {s for s in _csv(setrepo, "stat_items") if s in STAT_ITEMS}
    return tuple(k for k in STAT_ITEMS if k not in hidden)


def toggle_stat(setrepo, key: str) -> bool:
    if key not in STAT_ITEMS or setrepo is None:
        return False
    hidden = [s for s in _csv(setrepo, "stat_items") if s in STAT_ITEMS]
    if key in hidden:
        hidden.remove(key)
    else:
        hidden.append(key)
    _set_csv(setrepo, "stat_items", hidden)
    return True

def home_view(setrepo) -> dict:
    from .home_prefs import SECTIONS, STAT_ITEMS, layout_of, sections_view, stat_view
    return {"layout": layout_of(setrepo), "layouts": list(LAYOUTS),
            "sections": [{"key": k, "on": on} for k, on in sections_view(setrepo)],
            "stats": [{"key": k, "on": on} for k, on in stat_view(setrepo)]}
def home_action(setrepo, act: str, key: str = "", value: str = "") -> dict:
    if act == "layout": ok = set_layout(setrepo, value)
    elif act == "section": ok = toggle_section(setrepo, key)
    elif act == "stat": ok = toggle_stat(setrepo, key)
    else: return {"ok": True, "result": "bad"}
    return {"ok": True, "result": "saved" if ok else "bad", "data": home_view(setrepo)}

def public_verify(*, csvc, urepo, erepo, cctrepo=None, payload: str) -> dict:
    got = csvc.verify(str(payload or "").strip())
    if got is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    cert = got["cert"]
    ev = erepo.get_event(cert.event_id)
    title = ev.title if ev is not None else ""
    if not title and cert.event_id < 0 and cctrepo is not None:
        iss = cctrepo.get_issue(-cert.event_id)
        title = iss.title if iss else ""
    status = "revoked" if got["revoked"] else ("expired" if got["expired"] else "valid")
    return {"result": status, "name": _name(urepo, cert.user_id),
            "title": title, "number": cert.number,
            "until": got["until"] or ""}

setHomeAct:

js


async function setHomeAct(body) {
  if (state.st.busy) return;
  state.st.busy = true;
  try {
    const r = await api("/api/settings/home", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    showToast(SET_FA[r.result] || "");
    if (r.data && state.st.hub) state.st.hub.home = r.data;
  } catch (e) { showToast("Error — please try again"); }
  state.st.busy = false;
  render();
}

setHomeView:

js


const LAYOUT_FA = { compact: "Compact", grouped: "Grouped", full: "Full" };
const SEC_FA = { profile: "Profile", myev: "My Events", mycert: "My Certificates", rec: "Receipts", done: "Past Events", sup: "Support", fin: "Installments", att: "Attendance Report", club: "Club", about: "About Us" };
const STI_FA = { users: "Users", regs: "Today's Registrations", pays: "Payment Queue", income: "Income", tickets: "Tickets", certs: "Certificates", activity: "Activity" };
function setHomeView() {
  const back = `<span class="backbtn" id="setback">${svg("i-back")}Settings</span>`;
  const d = state.st.hub && state.st.hub.home;
  if (!d) return back + loadingCard();
  const lays = d.layouts.map((k) =>
    `<button class="chip ${d.layout === k ? "on" : ""}" data-hlay="${k}">${LAYOUT_FA[k] || k}</button>`).join("");
  const secRows = d.sections.map((s) => `
    <div class="row">
      <div class="main"><div class="t1">${SEC_FA[s.key] || s.key}</div></div>
      <span class="chip ${s.on ? "acc" : ""}">${s.on ? "On" : "Off"}</span>
      <span class="btn" data-hsec="${s.key}">${s.on ? "Turn off" : "Turn on"}</span>
    </div>`).join("");
  const statRows = d.stats.map((s) => `
    <div class="row">
      <div class="main"><div class="t1">${STI_FA[s.key] || s.key}</div></div>
      <span class="chip ${s.on ? "acc" : ""}">${s.on ? "On" : "Off"}</span>
      <span class="btn" data-hstat="${s.key}">${s.on ? "Turn off" : "Turn on"}</span>
    </div>`).join("");
  return back + `<div class="h2">Home View</div>
  <div class="card g">
    <div class="t2" style="padding:2px 2px 8px">Bot user home layout — number of events and buttons</div>
    <div class="btnrow">${lays}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="h2">Menu Sections</div>
  <div class="card g">${secRows}</div>
  <div class="h2">Stats Items</div>
  <div class="card g">${statRows}</div>
  <div class="t2" style="padding:6px 4px">Stats changes apply to both bot stats and web home cards</div>`;
}

"""تست فاز ۳۵c: چیدمان خانه (G10)، آیتم‌های آمار (G11)، استعلام عمومی (G9)."""
from datetime import datetime

import pytest
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.certs import CertRepo
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.settings import SettingsRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.cert_service import CertService
from web.server import create_app

@pytest.fixture()
def env(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock,
                              transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    setrepo = SettingsRepo(db)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved",
                 full_name="ادمین گروه")
    yield {"bot": bot, "clock": clock, "sent": sent, "urepo": urepo,
           "erepo": erepo, "setrepo": setrepo, "db": db}
    set_clock(old)


def step(env, update, uid=999):
    env["clock"].advance_hours(0.01)
    env["bot"].process_update(update)
    env["bot"].outbox.drain()


def cb(data, uid=999):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def last(env):
    return str(env["sent"][-1].get("text") or "")


def last_markup(env):
    return str(env["sent"][-1].get("reply_markup") or "")


def all_text(env):
    return "\n".join(str(p.get("text") or "") for p in env["sent"])


def mk_events(env, n):
    for i in range(n):
        env["erepo"].create_event(
            title=f"برنامه {i}", status="published",
            start_ts=env["clock"].ts() + 86400 + i * 3600)


def ev_btn_count(env):
    return last_markup(env).count('\\"ev\\u003a') + last_markup(env).count('"ev:')


def test_home_layout_budget(env):
    mk_events(env, 12)
    step(env, cb("evs:1"))
    # چیدمان پیش‌فرض دسته‌بندی: ۶ برنامه (ادمین: ۳ ردیف منو + ۱ ادمین)
    assert last_markup(env).count("ev:") == 6
    env["setrepo"].set("user_layout", "compact")
    step(env, cb("evs:1"))
    assert last_markup(env).count("ev:") == 3
    env["setrepo"].set("user_layout", "full")
    step(env, cb("evs:1"))
    # کامل: ۴ ردیف منو + ادمین = ۵ → بودجهٔ برنامه‌ها ۵
    assert last_markup(env).count("ev:") == 5
    assert "ab:1" in last_markup(env)


def test_home_section_toggle(env):
    mk_events(env, 3)
    env["setrepo"].set("user_sections", "mycert,rec")
    step(env, cb("evs:1"))
    assert "mycert:1" not in last_markup(env)
    assert "prof:1" in last_markup(env)
    # خاموش‌کردن همه‌چیز — خانه خالی نمی‌ماند
    env["setrepo"].set("user_sections",
                       "profile,myev,mycert,rec,done,sup,fin,att,club")
    u = env["urepo"].create(40, first_name="کاربر")
    env["urepo"].update(u.id, status="approved")
    step(env, cb("evs:1", uid=40))
    assert "sup:1" in last_markup(env)


def test_home_prefs_screens(env):
    step(env, cb("setg:1"))
    assert "ulay:1" in last_markup(env)
    step(env, cb("ulay:1"))
    assert t("ulay_line", v=t("lay_grouped")) in last(env)
    step(env, cb("ulayl:compact"))
    assert t("ulay_line", v=t("lay_compact")) in last(env)
    assert env["setrepo"].get("user_layout") == "compact"
    step(env, cb("ulays:1"))
    assert "ulayst:profile" in last_markup(env)
    step(env, cb("ulayst:sup"))
    assert t("sec_sup", st=t("set_off")) in last(env)
    assert env["setrepo"].get("user_sections") == "sup"
    step(env, cb("ulayt:1"))
    assert "ulaytt:certs" in last_markup(env)
    step(env, cb("ulaytt:certs"))
    assert t("sti_certs", st=t("set_off")) in last(env)
    assert env["setrepo"].get("stat_items") == "certs"


def test_stats_cmd_filter(env):
    step(env, msg("/stats"))
    assert t("st_certs", n="۰") in last(env)
    assert t("st_activity", n="۰") in last(env)
    env["setrepo"].set("stat_items", "certs,activity")
    step(env, msg("/stats"))
    assert t("st_certs", n="۰") not in last(env)
    assert t("st_activity", n="۰") not in last(env)
    assert t("st_users", n="۱", d="۰") in last(env)
    env["setrepo"].set("stat_items", "users,regs,pays,income,tickets,certs,"
                                     "activity")
    step(env, msg("/stats"))
    assert t("st_none") in last(env)

class FakeResponder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.sent = []

    def bulk(self, chat_id, key, markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("bulk", chat_id, key))

    def bulk_raw(self, chat_id, text, markup=None):
        self.sent.append(("raw", chat_id, text))

    def send_photo_file(self, chat_id, path, key="", **kw):
        self.sent.append(("photofile", chat_id, key))
        return True

    def send_photo(self, chat_id, file_id, key="", markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("photo", chat_id, file_id))

    def send_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        return False

    def bulk_media_raw(self, chat_id, kind, file_id, caption=""):
        return False


async def _client(db, fake_clock, *, role="owner", bale_id=999):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    fake = FakeResponder()
    admin = urepo.create(bale_id, first_name="مدیر")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role=role, status="approved",
                 full_name="مدیر نورا")
    settings = Settings(env="dev", bot_token="123:T",
                        admin_ids=(bale_id,))
    app = create_app(settings, db, dev_bale_id=bale_id,
                     responder=fake, clock=fake_clock)
    client = TestClient(TestServer(app))
    await client.start_server()
    r = await client.post("/api/auth", json={"dev": True})
    tok = (await r.json())["token"]
    return client, {"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok}, admin, fake


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_public_verify(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, admin, _ = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    u = urepo.create(5001, first_name="گیرنده")
    urepo.update(u.id, status="approved", full_name="گیرنده کامل")
    certrepo = CertRepo(db, fake_clock)
    csvc = CertService(certrepo, fake_clock)
    cert = csvc.issue(7, u.id, {}, admin.id)

    r = await client.get(f"/api/public/verify/{cert.code}")
    out = await r.json()
    assert out["result"] == "valid" and out["name"] == "گیرنده کامل"
    assert out["number"] == cert.number

    r = await client.get("/api/public/verify/NOTACODE")
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "none"

    r = await client.get(f"/verify/{cert.code}")
    assert r.status == 200
    body = await r.text()
    assert "استعلام اصالت گواهی" in body


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_home_stats_and_settings(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, admin, _ = await _client(db, fake_clock)

    r = await client.get("/api/home", headers=hdr)
    h = (await r.json())["home"]
    assert "users_total" in h and "income_30d" in h
    assert "regs_today" in h and "certs_total" in h and "activity_24h" in h

    r = await client.get("/api/settings", headers=hdr)
    hub = (await r.json())["data"]
    assert hub["home"]["layout"] == "grouped"
    assert {s["key"] for s in hub["home"]["sections"]} >= {"profile", "club"}

    r = await client.post("/api/settings/home", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "layout", "value": "full"})
    out = await r.json()
    assert out["result"] == "saved" and out["data"]["layout"] == "full"
    r = await client.post("/api/settings/home", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "layout", "value": "nope"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "bad"

    r = await client.post("/api/settings/home", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "section", "key": "mycert"})
    secs = {s["key"]: s["on"] for s in (await r.json())["data"]["sections"]}
    assert secs["mycert"] is False and secs["profile"] is True

    r = await client.post("/api/settings/home", headers=hdr,
                          json={"act": "stat", "key": "income"})
    r = await client.get("/api/home", headers=hdr)
    h = (await r.json())["home"]
    assert "income_30d" not in h and "users_total" in h
    assert SettingsRepo(db).get("stat_items") == "income"

"""فرم‌ساز — دامنه (فاز ۳۶).

چهار ظرف: فرم (forms)، فیلد (form_fields)، پاسخنامه (form_responses)،
پاسخ (form_answers). همان الگوی نورا۱ ولی با انواع جمع‌وجورتر و
بدون ایموجی؛ شرط نمایش روی هر فیلد (ref + op + value).

انواع فرم: عمومی/نظرسنجی/آزمون/سفارش. دسترسی: public (فهرست)،
link (فقط لینک)، event (گیتِ ثبت‌نام یک رویداد)، private (فقط ادمین).
فرم پولی روی همان لایهٔ پرداخت می‌نشیند: target_kind="form".
گواهی فرم با event_id = -(FORM_CERT_BASE + form_id) در جدول certs.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass, field as dc_field

from ..core.clock import Clock, get_clock
from ..core.db import Database

K_GENERAL = "general"
K_SURVEY = "survey"
K_QUIZ = "quiz"
K_ORDER = "order"
KINDS = (K_GENERAL, K_SURVEY, K_QUIZ, K_ORDER)

A_PUBLIC = "public"
A_LINK = "link"
A_EVENT = "event"
A_PRIVATE = "private"
ACCESS = (A_PUBLIC, A_LINK, A_EVENT, A_PRIVATE)

F_DRAFT = "draft"
F_PUBLISHED = "published"
F_PAUSED = "paused"

R_DRAFT = "draft"
R_SUBMITTED = "submitted"

# گواهی فرم در جدول certs — فضای منفی جدا از مرکز صدور (-issue_id)
FORM_CERT_BASE = 1_000_000

# عملگرهای شرط نمایش — همان هشت‌گانهٔ نورا۱
COND_OPS = ("eq", "ne", "contains", "ncontains", "gt", "lt",
            "empty", "nempty")

# کاتالوگ انواع فیلد: cat = دستهٔ menu، kind = رفتار ورودی
FIELD_TYPES: dict[str, dict] = {
    "text":     {"cat": "text",   "kind": "text"},
    "textarea": {"cat": "text",   "kind": "multiline"},
    "mobile":   {"cat": "text",   "kind": "digits"},
    "email":    {"cat": "text",   "kind": "email"},
    "url":      {"cat": "text",   "kind": "url"},
    "number":   {"cat": "number", "kind": "number"},
    "rating":   {"cat": "number", "kind": "rating", "min": 1, "max": 5},
    "one":      {"cat": "choice", "kind": "one"},
    "multi":    {"cat": "choice", "kind": "multi"},
    "yesno":    {"cat": "choice", "kind": "yesno"},
    "prov":     {"cat": "place",  "kind": "prov"},
    "city":     {"cat": "place",  "kind": "city"},
    "date":     {"cat": "place",  "kind": "date"},
    "photo":    {"cat": "media",  "kind": "photo", "max": 3},
    "video":    {"cat": "media",  "kind": "video", "max": 1},
    "voice":    {"cat": "media",  "kind": "voice", "max": 1},
    "file":     {"cat": "media",  "kind": "file", "max": 1},
    "quiz":     {"cat": "quiz",   "kind": "quiz", "score": 1},
}
FIELD_CATS = ("text", "number", "choice", "place", "media", "quiz")
MEDIA_KINDS = ("photo", "video", "voice", "file")


def default_label(ftype: str) -> str:
    """برچسب پیش‌فرض = کلید متن ft_{type} — لایهٔ صفحه t() می‌کند."""
    return "ft_" + ftype


@dataclass
class Form:
    id: int
    title: str
    kind: str = K_GENERAL
    access: str = A_PUBLIC
    event_id: int = 0
    intro: str = ""
    price: int = 0
    gives_cert: int = 0
    gives_ticket: int = 0
    status: str = F_DRAFT
    created_by: int = 0
    created_ts: float = 0.0
    published_ts: float = 0.0


@dataclass
class FormField:
    id: int
    form_id: int
    ord: int
    type: str
    label: str = ""
    help: str = ""
    options: list = dc_field(default_factory=list)
    required: int = 0
    min_val: int = 0
    max_val: int = 0
    max_files: int = 1
    cond_field: int = 0
    cond_op: str = ""
    cond_value: str = ""
    score: int = 0
    correct: int = -1          # اندیس گزینهٔ درست در آزمون


@dataclass
class FormResponse:
    id: int
    form_id: int
    user_id: int
    status: str = R_DRAFT
    started_ts: float = 0.0
    submitted_ts: float = 0.0
    pay_id: int = 0
    score: int = 0
    ticket_code: str = ""


@dataclass
class FormAnswer:
    id: int
    response_id: int
    field_id: int
    value_text: str = ""
    value_number: int = 0
    value_options: list = dc_field(default_factory=list)
    file_id: str = ""
    file_kind: str = ""
    is_correct: int = -1       # -1 = بی‌معنا، 0/1 برای آزمون


def _row_form(r) -> Form:
    return Form(
        int(r["id"]), str(r["title"] or ""), str(r["kind"] or K_GENERAL),
        str(r["access"] or A_PUBLIC), int(r["event_id"] or 0),
        str(r["intro"] or ""), int(r["price"] or 0),
        int(r["gives_cert"] or 0), int(r["gives_ticket"] or 0),
        str(r["status"] or F_DRAFT), int(r["created_by"] or 0),
        float(r["created_ts"] or 0), float(r["published_ts"] or 0))


def _row_field(r) -> FormField:
    return FormField(
        int(r["id"]), int(r["form_id"]), int(r["ord"] or 0),
        str(r["type"] or "text"), str(r["label"] or ""),
        str(r["help"] or ""), json.loads(r["options"] or "[]"),
        int(r["required"] or 0), int(r["min_val"] or 0),
        int(r["max_val"] or 0), int(r["max_files"] or 1),
        int(r["cond_field"] or 0), str(r["cond_op"] or ""),
        str(r["cond_value"] or ""), int(r["score"] or 0),
        int(r["correct"] if r["correct"] is not None else -1))


def _row_resp(r) -> FormResponse:
    return FormResponse(
        int(r["id"]), int(r["form_id"]), int(r["user_id"]),
        str(r["status"] or R_DRAFT), float(r["started_ts"] or 0),
        float(r["submitted_ts"] or 0), int(r["pay_id"] or 0),
        int(r["score"] or 0), str(r["ticket_code"] or ""))


def _row_ans(r) -> FormAnswer:
    return FormAnswer(
        int(r["id"]), int(r["response_id"]), int(r["field_id"]),
        str(r["value_text"] or ""), int(r["value_number"] or 0),
        json.loads(r["value_options"] or "[]"), str(r["file_id"] or ""),
        str(r["file_kind"] or ""),
        int(r["is_correct"] if r["is_correct"] is not None else -1))


class FormRepo:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, clock: Clock | None = None) -> None:
        self.db = db
        self.clock = clock or get_clock()
        db.ensure_table("forms", [
            ("title", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''"),
            ("kind", "TEXT DEFAULT 'general'"),
            ("access", "TEXT DEFAULT 'public'"),
            ("event_id", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("intro", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("price", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("gives_cert", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("gives_ticket", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("status", "TEXT DEFAULT 'draft'"),
            ("created_by", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("created_ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("published_ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ])
        db.ensure_table("form_fields", [
            ("form_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("ord", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("type", "TEXT DEFAULT 'text'"),
            ("label", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("help", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("options", "TEXT DEFAULT '[]'"),
            ("required", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("min_val", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("max_val", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("max_files", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
            ("cond_field", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("cond_op", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("cond_value", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("score", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("correct", "INTEGER DEFAULT -1"),
        ])
        db.ensure_table("form_responses", [
            ("form_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("user_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("status", "TEXT DEFAULT 'draft'"),
            ("started_ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("submitted_ts", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
            ("pay_id", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("score", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("ticket_code", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ])
        db.ensure_index("ux_form_resp", "form_responses",
                        ["form_id", "user_id"], unique=True)
        db.ensure_table("form_answers", [
            ("response_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("field_id", "INTEGER NOT NULL"),
            ("value_text", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("value_number", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
            ("value_options", "TEXT DEFAULT '[]'"),
            ("file_id", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("file_kind", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
            ("is_correct", "INTEGER DEFAULT -1"),
        ])
        db.ensure_index("ix_form_ans_resp", "form_answers",
                        ["response_id"])

    def _now(self) -> float:
        return self.clock.ts() if self.clock else 0.0

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- فرم‌ها
    def create_form(self, **fields) -> Form:
        allowed = {"title", "kind", "access", "event_id", "intro", "price",
                   "gives_cert", "gives_ticket", "status", "created_by"}
        row = {k: v for k, v in fields.items() if k in allowed}
        row["created_ts"] = self._now()
        keys = list(row)
        marks = ", ".join("?" for _ in keys)
        cur = self.db.execute(
            f"INSERT INTO forms ({', '.join(keys)}) VALUES ({marks})",
            tuple(row[k] for k in keys))
        self.db.commit()
        return self.get_form(int(cur.lastrowid))  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def get_form(self, form_id: int) -> Form | None:
        r = self.db.query_one("SELECT * FROM forms WHERE id = ?", (form_id,))
        return _row_form(r) if r else None

    def list_forms(self, statuses: tuple | None = None,
                   limit: int = 30) -> list[Form]:
        if statuses:
            marks = ", ".join("?" for _ in statuses)
            rows = self.db.query(
                f"SELECT * FROM forms WHERE status IN ({marks}) "
                "ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (*statuses, limit))
        else:
            rows = self.db.query(
                "SELECT * FROM forms ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,))
        return [_row_form(r) for r in rows]

    def event_gate_form(self, event_id: int) -> Form | None:
        """فرمِ گیتِ یک رویداد — دسترسی event و منتشرشده."""
        r = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT * FROM forms WHERE event_id = ? AND access = 'event' "
            "AND status = 'published' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1", (event_id,))
        return _row_form(r) if r else None

    def update_form(self, form_id: int, **fields) -> None:
        allowed = {"title", "kind", "access", "event_id", "intro", "price",
                   "gives_cert", "gives_ticket", "status", "published_ts"}
        fields = {k: v for k, v in fields.items() if k in allowed}
        if not fields:
            return
        keys = ", ".join(f"{k} = ?" for k in fields)
        self.db.execute(f"UPDATE forms SET {keys} WHERE id = ?",
                        (*fields.values(), form_id))
        self.db.commit()

    def delete_form(self, form_id: int) -> None:
        """فرم با فیلدها و پاسخنامه‌ها می‌رود؛ گواهی/بلیت issued می‌ماند."""
        ids = [int(r["id"]) for r in self.db.query(
            "SELECT id FROM form_responses WHERE form_id = ?", (form_id,))]
        for rid in ids:
            self.db.execute("DELETE FROM form_answers WHERE response_id = ?",
                            (rid,))
        self.db.execute("DELETE FROM form_responses WHERE form_id = ?",
                        (form_id,))
        self.db.execute("DELETE FROM form_fields WHERE form_id = ?",
                        (form_id,))
        self.db.execute("DELETE FROM forms WHERE id = ?", (form_id,))
        self.db.commit()

    # --------------------------------------------------------- فیلدها
    def fields(self, form_id: int) -> list[FormField]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM form_fields WHERE form_id = ? ORDER BY ord, id",
            (form_id,))
        return [_row_field(r) for r in rows]

    def get_field(self, field_id: int) -> FormField | None:
        r = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT * FROM form_fields WHERE id = ?", (field_id,))
        return _row_field(r) if r else None

    def add_field(self, form_id: int, ftype: str) -> FormField:
        meta = FIELD_TYPES.get(ftype) or FIELD_TYPES["text"]
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ord), 0) AS m FROM form_fields "
            "WHERE form_id = ?", (form_id,))
        nxt = int(row["m"] if row else 0) + 1
        opts = ["\u06af\u0632\u06cc\u0646\u0647 \u06f1",
                "\u06af\u0632\u06cc\u0646\u0647 \u06f2"] \
            if meta["kind"] in ("one", "multi", "quiz") else []
        cur = self.db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO form_fields (form_id, ord, type, label, options, "
            "required, max_files, score, correct) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (form_id, nxt, ftype, "", json.dumps(opts, ensure_ascii=False),
             1 if meta["kind"] == "yesno" else 0,
             int(meta.get("max") or 1), int(meta.get("score") or 0), -1))
        self.db.commit()
        return self.get_field(int(cur.lastrowid))  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    _FIELD_EDIT = {"label", "help", "options", "required", "min_val",
                   "max_val", "max_files", "cond_field", "cond_op",
                   "cond_value", "score", "correct", "ord"}

    def update_field(self, field_id: int, **fields) -> None:
        if "options" in fields and isinstance(fields["options"], list):
            fields["options"] = json.dumps(fields["options"],
                                           ensure_ascii=False)
        fields = {k: v for k, v in fields.items() if k in self._FIELD_EDIT}
        if not fields:
            return
        keys = ", ".join(f"{k} = ?" for k in fields)
        self.db.execute(f"UPDATE form_fields SET {keys} WHERE id = ?",
                        (*fields.values(), field_id))
        self.db.commit()

    def move_field(self, field_id: int, up: bool) -> None:
        f = self.get_field(field_id)
        if f is None:
            return
        others = self.fields(f.form_id)
        idx = next((i for i, x in enumerate(others) if x.id == f.id), -1)
        j = idx - 1 if up else idx + 1
        if idx < 0 or j < 0 or j >= len(others):
            return
        with self.db.transaction():
            self.db.execute("UPDATE form_fields SET ord = ? WHERE id = ?",
                            (others[j].ord, f.id))
            self.db.execute("UPDATE form_fields SET ord = ? WHERE id = ?",
                            (f.ord, others[j].id))
        self.db.commit()

    def copy_field(self, field_id: int) -> FormField | None:
        f = self.get_field(field_id)
        if f is None:
            return None
        row = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ord), 0) AS m FROM form_fields "
            "WHERE form_id = ?", (f.form_id,))
        nxt = int(row["m"] if row else 0) + 1
        cur = self.db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO form_fields (form_id, ord, type, label, help, "
            "options, required, min_val, max_val, max_files, score, correct)"
            " VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (f.form_id, nxt, f.type, f.label, f.help,
             json.dumps(f.options, ensure_ascii=False), f.required,
             f.min_val, f.max_val, f.max_files, f.score, f.correct))
        self.db.commit()
        return self.get_field(int(cur.lastrowid))  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def delete_field(self, field_id: int) -> None:
        f = self.get_field(field_id)
        if f is None:
            return
        # شرطِ فیلدهای دیگر که به این فیلد اشاره دارند پاک می‌شود
        self.db.execute(
            "UPDATE form_fields SET cond_field = 0, cond_op = '', "
            "cond_value = '' WHERE cond_field = ?", (field_id,))
        self.db.execute("DELETE FROM form_answers WHERE field_id = ?",
                        (field_id,))
        self.db.execute("DELETE FROM form_fields WHERE id = ?", (field_id,))
        self.db.commit()

    # ---------------------------------------------------- پاسخنامه‌ها
    def open_response(self, form_id: int, user_id: int) -> FormResponse:
        """draft موجود را برمی‌گرداند یا یکی می‌سازد — یکتا per کاربر."""
        r = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT * FROM form_responses WHERE form_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
            (form_id, user_id))
        if r:
            return _row_resp(r)
        cur = self.db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO form_responses (form_id, user_id, status, "
            "started_ts) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
            (form_id, user_id, R_DRAFT, self._now()))
        self.db.commit()
        return self.get_response(int(cur.lastrowid))  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def get_response(self, rid: int) -> FormResponse | None:
        r = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT * FROM form_responses WHERE id = ?", (rid,))
        return _row_resp(r) if r else None

    def response_of(self, form_id: int, user_id: int):
        r = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT * FROM form_responses WHERE form_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
            (form_id, user_id))
        return _row_resp(r) if r else None

    def update_response(self, rid: int, **fields) -> None:
        allowed = {"status", "submitted_ts", "pay_id", "score",
                   "ticket_code"}
        fields = {k: v for k, v in fields.items() if k in allowed}
        if not fields:
            return
        keys = ", ".join(f"{k} = ?" for k in fields)
        self.db.execute(f"UPDATE form_responses SET {keys} WHERE id = ?",
                        (*fields.values(), rid))
        self.db.commit()

    def responses(self, form_id: int, status: str = "",
                  limit: int = 200) -> list[FormResponse]:
        if status:
            rows = self.db.query(
                "SELECT * FROM form_responses WHERE form_id = ? "
                "AND status = ? ORDER BY id LIMIT ?",
                (form_id, status, limit))
        else:
            rows = self.db.query(
                "SELECT * FROM form_responses WHERE form_id = ? "
                "ORDER BY id LIMIT ?", (form_id, limit))
        return [_row_resp(r) for r in rows]

    def counts(self, form_id: int) -> dict:
        r = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM form_responses WHERE form_id = ? "
            "AND status = 'submitted'", (form_id,))
        d = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM form_responses WHERE form_id = ? "
            "AND status = 'draft'", (form_id,))
        return {"submitted": int(r["n"] if r else 0),
                "draft": int(d["n"] if d else 0)}

    # -------------------------------------------------------- پاسخ‌ها
    def set_answer(self, rid: int, fld: FormField, *, text: str = "",
                   number: int = 0, options: list | None = None,
                   file_id: str = "", file_kind: str = "",
                   is_correct: int = -1) -> FormAnswer:
        opts = json.dumps(options or [], ensure_ascii=False)
        old = self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT * FROM form_answers WHERE response_id = ? "
            "AND field_id = ?", (rid, fld.id))
        if old:
            self.db.execute(
                "UPDATE form_answers SET value_text = ?, value_number = ?, "
                "value_options = ?, file_id = ?, file_kind = ?, "
                "is_correct = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (text, number, opts, file_id, file_kind, is_correct,
                 int(old["id"])))
            self.db.commit()
            return _row_ans(self.db.query_one(
                "SELECT * FROM form_answers WHERE id = ?",
                (int(old["id"]),)))
        cur = self.db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO form_answers (response_id, field_id, value_text, "
            "value_number, value_options, file_id, file_kind, is_correct) "
            "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (rid, fld.id, text, number, opts, file_id, file_kind,
             is_correct))
        self.db.commit()
        return _row_ans(self.db.query_one(
            "SELECT * FROM form_answers WHERE id = ?",
            (int(cur.lastrowid),)))  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def answers(self, rid: int) -> list[FormAnswer]:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT * FROM form_answers WHERE response_id = ? ORDER BY id",
            (rid,))
        return [_row_ans(r) for r in rows]

    def answers_map(self, rid: int) -> dict:
        """field_id → FormAnswer؛ خوراک شرط نمایش و گزارش."""
        return {a.field_id: a for a in self.answers(rid)}

    def field_answers(self, field_id: int, limit: int = 500) -> list:
        rows = self.db.query(
            "SELECT a.* FROM form_answers a JOIN form_responses r "
            "ON r.id = a.response_id "
            "WHERE a.field_id = ? AND r.status = 'submitted' "
            "ORDER BY a.id LIMIT ?", (field_id, limit))
        return [_row_ans(r) for r in rows]
