"""فرم‌ساز — سرویس (فاز ۳۶).

ساخت/انتشار فرم، فیلتر شرطی فیلدها هنگام پر کردن، اعتبارسنجی per نوع،
ثبت پاسخ، نمرهٔ آزمون، تحویل (رسید + گواهی/بلیت) و گزارش per فیلد.
بدون کانال و بدون لیترال فارسی — کلیدهای خطا را لایهٔ صفحه ترجمه کند.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re

from ..core.clock import Clock
from ..core.num import digits_only
from ..domain.forms import (A_EVENT, A_PUBLIC, F_DRAFT, F_PAUSED,
                            F_PUBLISHED, FIELD_TYPES, FORM_CERT_BASE,
                            R_DRAFT, R_SUBMITTED, Form, FormField,
                            FormRepo)

_EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$")
_URL_RE = re.compile(r"^(https?://)[^\s]+$")

# کلیدهای خطا: bad_input / bad_number / bad_range / bad_mobile /
# bad_email / bad_url / need_one / need_more / need_choice


class FormService:
    def __init__(self, frepo: FormRepo, erepo=None, clock: Clock | None = None,
                 csvc=None, setrepo=None) -> None:
        self.repo = frepo
        self.erepo = erepo
        self.clock = clock
        self.csvc = csvc
        self.setrepo = setrepo

    def _now(self) -> float:
        return self.clock.ts() if self.clock else 0.0

    # --------------------------------------------------------- ساختار
    def create(self, title: str, by: int, **kw) -> dict:
        title = " ".join(str(title or "").split())
        if len(title) < 3:
            return {"result": "bad_title"}
        kind = str(kw.get("kind") or "general")
        access = str(kw.get("access") or A_PUBLIC)
        if kind not in ("general", "survey", "quiz", "order"):
            return {"result": "bad_kind"}
        if access not in (A_PUBLIC, "link", A_EVENT, "private"):
            return {"result": "bad_access"}
        event_id = int(kw.get("event_id") or 0)
        if access == A_EVENT and not event_id:
            return {"result": "need_event"}
        form = self.repo.create_form(
            title=title[:80], kind=kind, access=access, event_id=event_id,
            intro=str(kw.get("intro") or "")[:500],
            price=max(0, int(kw.get("price") or 0)),
            gives_cert=1 if kw.get("gives_cert") else 0,
            gives_ticket=1 if kw.get("gives_ticket") else 0,
            created_by=int(by or 0))
        return {"result": "ok", "id": form.id}

    def publish(self, form_id: int) -> dict:
        form = self.repo.get_form(form_id)
        if form is None:
            return {"result": "none"}
        if form.status == F_PUBLISHED:
            return {"result": "already"}
        fields = self.repo.fields(form_id)
        if not fields:
            return {"result": "no_fields"}
        for f in fields:
            meta = FIELD_TYPES.get(f.type) or {}
            if not str(f.label or "").strip():
                return {"result": "field_no_label", "field_id": f.id}
            if meta.get("kind") in ("one", "multi", "quiz"):
                if len(f.options) < 2:
                    return {"result": "field_few_options", "field_id": f.id}
                if meta.get("kind") == "quiz" and not (
                        0 <= f.correct < len(f.options)):
                    return {"result": "field_no_correct", "field_id": f.id}
            if f.cond_field and not f.cond_op:
                return {"result": "field_bad_cond", "field_id": f.id}
        self.repo.update_form(form_id, status=F_PUBLISHED,
                              published_ts=self._now())
        return {"result": "published"}

    def set_status(self, form_id: int, status: str) -> dict:
        if status not in (F_PUBLISHED, F_PAUSED, F_DRAFT):
            return {"result": "bad"}
        form = self.repo.get_form(form_id)
        if form is None:
            return {"result": "none"}
        if status == F_PUBLISHED and form.status != F_PUBLISHED:
            return self.publish(form_id)
        self.repo.update_form(form_id, status=status)
        return {"result": "ok", "status": status}

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- شرط‌ها
    @staticmethod
    def _ans_value(ans) -> str:
        if ans is None:
            return ""
        if ans.value_options:
            return ",".join(str(x) for x in ans.value_options)
        if ans.value_text:
            return str(ans.value_text)
        if ans.value_number:
            return str(ans.value_number)
        return ""

    def condition_met(self, fld: FormField, amap: dict) -> bool:
        if not fld.cond_field or fld.cond_op not in (
                "eq", "ne", "contains", "ncontains", "gt", "lt",
                "empty", "nempty"):
            return True
        ref = amap.get(fld.cond_field)
        val = self._ans_value(ref)
        want = str(fld.cond_value or "")
        op = fld.cond_op
        if op == "empty":
            return ref is None or val == ""
        if op == "nempty":
            return ref is not None and val != ""
        if ref is None:
            # هنوز پاسخی نیست: eq/contains/gt/lt برقرار نیست، ne/ncontains هست
            return op in ("ne", "ncontains")
        if op == "eq":
            return val.strip() == want.strip()
        if op == "ne":
            return val.strip() != want.strip()
        if op == "contains":
            parts = [p.strip() for p in val.split(",")]
            return want.strip() in parts or want.strip() in val
        if op == "ncontains":
            parts = [p.strip() for p in val.split(",")]
            return want.strip() not in parts and want.strip() not in val
        if op in ("gt", "lt"):
            try:
                a, b = float(val), float(want)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                return False
            return a > b if op == "gt" else a < b
        return True

    def visible_fields(self, form_id: int, rid: int) -> list:
        amap = self.repo.answers_map(rid)
        return [f for f in self.repo.fields(form_id)
                if self.condition_met(f, amap)]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ پرکردن
    def start(self, form: Form, user) -> dict:
        if form is None or user is None:
            return {"result": "none"}
        if form.status != F_PUBLISHED:
            return {"result": "paused" if form.status == F_PAUSED
                    else "draft"}
        prev = self.repo.response_of(form.id, user.id)
        if prev is not None and prev.status == R_SUBMITTED:
            return {"result": "done", "resp": prev}
        resp = self.repo.open_response(form.id, user.id)
        return {"result": "ok", "resp": resp}

    def validate(self, fld: FormField, *, text: str = "",
                 options: list | None = None, number: int = 0,
                 files: int = 0) -> str:
        meta = FIELD_TYPES.get(fld.type) or {}
        kind = str(meta.get("kind") or "text")
        text = str(text or "").strip()
        options = options or []
        if kind == "digits":
            d = digits_only(text)
            if len(d) != 11 or not d.startswith("09"):
                return "bad_mobile"
        elif kind == "email":
            if not _EMAIL_RE.match(text):
                return "bad_email"
        elif kind == "url":
            if not _URL_RE.match(text):
                return "bad_url"
        elif kind == "number":
            if not text and not number:
                return "bad_number"
            try:
                n = int(text) if text else int(number)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                return "bad_number"
            if fld.min_val and n < fld.min_val:
                return "bad_range"
            if fld.max_val and n > fld.max_val:
                return "bad_range"
        elif kind == "rating":
            n = int(number or 0)
            if not 1 <= n <= int(fld.max_val or 5):
                return "bad_range"
        elif kind in ("one", "yesno", "quiz"):
            if len(options) != 1:
                return "need_choice"
        elif kind == "multi":
            if not options:
                return "need_one"
        elif kind in ("photo", "video", "voice", "file"):
            if not files:
                return "need_file"
        elif kind in ("prov", "city", "date"):
            if not text:
                return "bad_input"
        elif not text:
            return "bad_input"
        return ""

    def save_answer(self, resp, fld: FormField, *, text: str = "",
                    options: list | None = None, number: int = 0,
                    file_id: str = "", file_kind: str = "") -> dict:
        meta = FIELD_TYPES.get(fld.type) or {}
        kind = str(meta.get("kind") or "text")
        if kind == "digits":
            text = digits_only(text)
        if kind in ("number", "rating"):
            try:
                number = int(text) if text and not number else int(number)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                number = 0
            text = str(number)
        is_correct = -1
        if kind == "quiz":
            try:
                is_correct = 1 if int(options[0]) == int(fld.correct) else 0
            except (IndexError, TypeError, ValueError):
                is_correct = 0
        self.repo.set_answer(resp.id, fld, text=text, number=number,
                             options=options or [], file_id=file_id,
                             file_kind=file_kind, is_correct=is_correct)
        return {"result": "ok"}

    def missing(self, form_id: int, rid: int) -> list:
        amap = self.repo.answers_map(rid)
        out = []
        for f in self.visible_fields(form_id, rid):
            if not f.required:
                continue
            a = amap.get(f.id)
            meta = FIELD_TYPES.get(f.type) or {}
            kind = str(meta.get("kind") or "text")
            if a is None:
                out.append(f)
            elif kind in ("photo", "video", "voice", "file"):
                if not a.file_id:
                    out.append(f)
            elif kind == "multi":
                if not a.value_options:
                    out.append(f)
            elif not str(a.value_text or "").strip() and \
                    not a.value_options and not a.value_number:
                out.append(f)
        return out

    def score_of(self, form_id: int, rid: int) -> tuple:
        """(کسب‌شده، کل) — فقط فیلدهای آزمونِ دیده‌شده."""
        amap = self.repo.answers_map(rid)
        got = total = 0
        for f in self.visible_fields(form_id, rid):
            if (FIELD_TYPES.get(f.type) or {}).get("kind") != "quiz":
                continue
            total += int(f.score or 1)
            a = amap.get(f.id)
            if a is not None and a.is_correct == 1:
                got += int(f.score or 1)
        return got, total

    def submit(self, form: Form, resp) -> dict:
        """ثبت نهایی — فرم پولی اول باید پرداخت شود (result=need_pay)."""
        if resp is None or resp.status == R_SUBMITTED:
            return {"result": "done" if resp else "none"}
        miss = self.missing(form.id, resp.id)
        if miss:
            return {"result": "missing",
                    "labels": [str(f.label or f.id) for f in miss]}
        if int(form.price or 0) > 0 and not resp.pay_id:
            return {"result": "need_pay"}
        got, total = self.score_of(form.id, resp.id)
        fields: dict = {"status": R_SUBMITTED,
                        "submitted_ts": self._now(), "score": got}
        if int(form.gives_ticket or 0) and not resp.ticket_code:
            from ..domain.events import gen_ticket
            fields["ticket_code"] = gen_ticket()
        self.repo.update_response(resp.id, **fields)
        fresh = self.repo.get_response(resp.id)
        return {"result": "ok", "resp": fresh, "score": got,
                "score_total": total}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ تحویل
    def cert_event_id(self, form_id: int) -> int:
        return -(FORM_CERT_BASE + int(form_id))

    def issue_cert(self, form: Form, user, holder: str) -> dict:
        """گواهی فرم — تنبل و هم‌خانواده با مرکز صدور (event_id منفی)."""
        if self.csvc is None or not int(form.gives_cert or 0):
            return {"result": "skip"}
        months = 24
        if self.setrepo is not None:
            try:
                months = int(str(self.setrepo.get("cert_valid_months", 24)))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                months = 24
        try:
            cert = self.csvc.issue(self.cert_event_id(form.id), user.id,
                                   {}, int(form.created_by or 0),
                                   valid_months=months if months >= 0
                                   else 24)
        except Exception:                     # noqa: BLE001 — گزارش می‌شود
            return {"result": "error"}
        return {"result": "ok", "cert_id": cert.id}

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- گزارش
    def report(self, form_id: int) -> dict | None:
        form = self.repo.get_form(form_id)
        if form is None:
            return None
        fields = self.repo.fields(form_id)
        items = []
        for f in fields:
            meta = FIELD_TYPES.get(f.type) or {}
            kind = str(meta.get("kind") or "text")
            rows = self.repo.field_answers(f.id)
            item: dict = {"id": f.id, "label": f.label, "type": f.type,
                          "kind": kind, "n": len(rows)}
            if kind in ("one", "multi", "yesno", "quiz"):
                tally: dict = {}
                for a in rows:
                    for opt in (a.value_options or []):
                        s = str(opt)
                        tally[s] = tally.get(s, 0) + 1
                item["tally"] = sorted(tally.items(),
                                       key=lambda kv: -kv[1])
            elif kind in ("number", "rating"):
                nums = [a.value_number for a in rows if a.value_number]
                item["avg"] = round(sum(nums) / len(nums), 2) if nums \
                    else 0
            elif kind in ("photo", "video", "voice", "file"):
                item["files"] = sum(1 for a in rows if a.file_id)
            else:
                item["samples"] = [str(a.value_text) for a in rows
                                   if str(a.value_text or "").strip()][:50]
            if kind == "quiz":
                item["correct"] = sum(1 for a in rows if a.is_correct == 1)
            items.append(item)
        counts = self.repo.counts(form_id)
        return {"form": form, "items": items, **counts}

    def export_rows(self, form_id: int) -> tuple:
        """(سرستون‌ها، ردیفها) برای اکسل — یک ستون per فیلد."""
        rep = self.report(form_id)
        if rep is None:
            return [], []
        fields = self.repo.fields(form_id)
        head = ["user_id"] + [str(f.label or f.id) for f in fields]
        rows = []
        for resp in self.repo.responses(form_id, status=R_SUBMITTED,
                                        limit=100000):
            amap = self.repo.answers_map(resp.id)
            line = [resp.user_id]
            for f in fields:
                a = amap.get(f.id)
                if a is None:
                    line.append("")
                elif a.value_options:
                    line.append(" | ".join(str(x) for x in a.value_options))
                elif a.file_id:
                    line.append(a.file_kind or "file")
                else:
                    line.append(a.value_text or (a.value_number or ""))
            rows.append(line)
        return head, rows

def _top(urepo: UserRepo, ctx: Ctx):
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if user is None or not can(user.role, "manage_forms"):
        return None
    return user

Hub:

python


def on_hub(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, _a=0):
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    forms = frepo.list_forms()
    lines = [t("frm_list_head")]
    rows = []
    if not forms:
        lines.append(t("frm_none"))
    for i, f in enumerate(forms[:_HUB], 1):
        lines.append(t("frm_hub_line", i=fa_num(i), title=f.title,
                       status=_st_fa(f)))
        rows.append([ui.btn(_label(f.title, 30), f"frmv:{f.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_new"), "frmn:1"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "adm:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm"
Row count: HUB=8 + 1 = 9 ✓.

publish result mapping:

python


_PUB_MSG = {
    "published": "frm_pub_ok",
    "already": "frm_already_pub",
    "no_fields": "frm_pub_no_fields",
    "none": "frm_none_found",
}
def _pub_reply(frepo, responder, ctx, out) -> None:
    res = str(out.get("result"))
    if res in _PUB_MSG:
        responder.reply(ctx, _PUB_MSG[res])
        return
    if res == "field_no_label":
        fld = frepo.get_field(int(out.get("field_id") or 0))
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_pub_field_no_label",
                        n=fa_num(fld.ord if fld else 0))
        return
    key = {"field_few_options": "frm_pub_field_few_options",
           "field_no_correct": "frm_pub_field_no_correct",
           "field_bad_cond": "frm_pub_field_bad_cond"}.get(res,
                                                          "err_generic")

"""فرم‌ساز — صفحه‌های ادمین (فاز ۳۶).

ساخت فرم، فیلدها، شرط نمایش، انتشار و لینک. گیت: manage_forms.
همهٔ متن‌ها با کلیدهای texts.py (frm_*/ft_*/cond_*)؛ ورودی متنی با
state و یک interceptor واحد. پرکردن فرم توسط کاربر در فاز ۳۶ب.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from ....core.num import digits_only, fa_num
from ....domain.events import EventRepo
from ....domain.forms import (ACCESS, COND_OPS, F_PAUSED, F_PUBLISHED,
                              FIELD_CATS, FIELD_TYPES, KINDS, MEDIA_KINDS,
                              Form, FormField, FormRepo, default_label)
from ....domain.users import UserRepo
from ....services.form_service import FormService
from ....services.permissions import can
from ....services.state_store import StateStore
from .. import ui
from ..ctx import Ctx
from ..router import v_int, v_page, v_word
from ..texts import t
from .support import _w

STEP_FRM = "frm_build"
_HUB = 8           # فرم در فهرست هاب
_PAGE = 7          # فیلد در هر صفحه
_FA_COMMA = chr(0x060C)

_ASK_FIELD = {"label": "frm_label_q", "help": "frm_help_q",
              "options": "frm_options_q", "score": "frm_score_q",
              "min": "frm_min_q", "max": "frm_max_q",
              "maxf": "frm_files_q"}
_ASK_FORM = {"intro": "frm_intro_q", "price": "frm_price_q"}
_PUB_MSG = {"published": "frm_pub_ok", "already": "frm_already_pub",
            "no_fields": "frm_pub_no_fields", "none": "frm_none_found"}
_PUB_FIELD_MSG = {"field_few_options": "frm_pub_field_few_options",
                  "field_no_correct": "frm_pub_field_no_correct",
                  "field_bad_cond": "frm_pub_field_bad_cond"}
_OPT_KINDS = ("one", "multi", "quiz")


def _label(text: str, n: int) -> str:
    text = (text or "").strip()
    return text if len(text) <= n else text[:n - 1] + "…"


def _top(urepo: UserRepo, ctx: Ctx):
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if user is None or not can(user.role, "manage_forms"):
        return None
    return user


def _kind_fa(form: Form) -> str:
    return t("fk_" + (form.kind if form.kind in KINDS else "general"))


def _acc_fa(form: Form) -> str:
    return t("fa_" + (form.access if form.access in ACCESS else "public"))


def _st_fa(form: Form) -> str:
    return t("fs_" + form.status)


def _type_fa(ftype: str) -> str:
    return t("ft_" + ftype) if ftype in FIELD_TYPES else t("ft_text")


def _fld_label(fld: FormField) -> str:
    lab = str(fld.label or "").strip()
    return lab if lab else _type_fa(fld.type)


def _fld_kind(fld: FormField) -> str:
    meta = FIELD_TYPES.get(fld.type) or {}
    return str(meta.get("kind") or "text")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- هاب

def on_hub(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
           responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    forms = frepo.list_forms()
    lines = [t("frm_list_head")]
    rows: list[list[dict]] = []
    if not forms:
        lines.append(t("frm_none"))
    for i, f in enumerate(forms[:_HUB], 1):
        lines.append(t("frm_hub_line", i=fa_num(i), title=_label(f.title, 40),
                       status=_st_fa(f)))
        rows.append([ui.btn(_label(f.title, 30), f"frmv:{f.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_new"), "frmn:1"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "adm:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm"


def on_new_ask(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
               state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FRM, {"sub": "title"})
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_new_q")
    return "frm-new"


# ------------------------------------------------------------ نمای فرم

def _pub_reply(frepo: FormRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, out: dict) -> None:
    res = str(out.get("result") or "")
    if res in _PUB_MSG:
        responder.reply(ctx, _PUB_MSG[res])
        return
    if res == "field_no_label":
        fld = frepo.get_field(int(out.get("field_id") or 0))
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_pub_field_no_label",
                        n=fa_num(fld.ord if fld else 0))
        return
    key = _PUB_FIELD_MSG.get(res, "err_generic")
    if key == "err_generic":
        responder.reply(ctx, key)
        return
    fld = frepo.get_field(int(out.get("field_id") or 0))
    responder.reply(ctx, key,
                    label=_fld_label(fld) if fld else "—")


def on_view(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
            urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    form = frepo.get_form(fid)
    if form is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return "frm-none"
    c = frepo.counts(fid)
    lines = [t("frm_view_head", title=form.title, status=_st_fa(form),
               kind=_kind_fa(form), access=_acc_fa(form),
               nf=fa_num(len(frepo.fields(fid))),
               nresp=fa_num(c["submitted"]))]
    if int(form.price or 0) > 0:
        lines.append(t("frm_view_price", price=fa_num(form.price)))
    if form.access == "event" and form.event_id:
        ev = erepo.get_event(form.event_id)
        lines.append(t("frm_view_event",
                       title=_label(ev.title, 40) if ev else "—"))
    if form.intro:
        lines.append(form.intro)
    rows: list[list[dict]] = [
        [ui.btn(t("btn_frm_fields"), f"frmf:{fid}")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_frm_kind"), f"frmk:{fid}"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_frm_access"), f"frma:{fid}")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_frm_intro"), f"frmqa:{fid}:intro"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_frm_price"), f"frmqa:{fid}:price")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_frm_ticket_on" if form.gives_ticket
                  else "btn_frm_ticket_off"), f"frmtk:{fid}"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_frm_cert_on" if form.gives_cert
                  else "btn_frm_cert_off"), f"frmct:{fid}")]]
    if form.status == F_PUBLISHED:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_pause"), f"frmst:{fid}:paused"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_frm_link"), f"frml:{fid}")])
    elif form.status == F_PAUSED:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_resume"), f"frmst:{fid}:published"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_frm_link"), f"frml:{fid}")])
    else:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_publish"), f"frmpub:{fid}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_frm_link"), f"frml:{fid}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_del"), f"frmdel:{fid}"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "frm:1")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm-view"


def on_kind(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    if frepo.get_form(fid) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return "frm-none"
    rows = []
    for i in range(0, len(KINDS), 2):
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("fk_" + k), f"frmkx:{fid}:{k}")
                     for k in KINDS[i:i + 2]])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frmx:{fid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("frm_kind_q"), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm-kind"


def on_kind_set(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int, kind: str) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    if frepo.get_form(fid) is None or kind not in KINDS:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return "frm-none"
    frepo.update_form(fid, kind=kind)
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_saved")
    return on_view(fsvc, frepo, _EREPO, urepo, responder, ctx, fid)


def on_access(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    if frepo.get_form(fid) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return "frm-none"
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("fa_" + a), f"frmax:{fid}:{a}")] for a in ACCESS]
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frmx:{fid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("frm_access_q"), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm-acc"


def on_access_set(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                  urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                  fid: int, acc: str) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    form = frepo.get_form(fid)
    if form is None or acc not in ACCESS:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return "frm-none"
    if acc == "event":
        return on_event_pick(fsvc, frepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid)
    frepo.update_form(fid, access=acc, event_id=0)
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_saved")
    return on_view(fsvc, frepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid)


def on_event_pick(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                  urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    evs = erepo.list_events(("upcoming", "running"), limit=_HUB)
    rows: list[list[dict]] = []
    lines = [t("frm_event_q")]
    if not evs:
        lines.append(t("frm_event_none"))
    for ev in evs:
        rows.append([ui.btn(_label(ev.title, 30), f"frmex:{fid}:{ev.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frma:{fid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm-ev"


def on_event_set(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                 urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                 fid: int, eid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    if frepo.get_form(fid) is None or erepo.get_event(eid) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return "frm-none"
    frepo.update_form(fid, access="event", event_id=eid)
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_saved")
    return on_view(fsvc, frepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid)


def _toggle(frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
            fid: int, column: str) -> bool:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return False
    form = frepo.get_form(fid)
    if form is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return False
    cur = int(getattr(form, column) or 0)
    frepo.update_form(fid, **{column: 0 if cur else 1})
    return True


def on_ticket(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
              urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    if not _toggle(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid, "gives_ticket"):
        return "frm-none"
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_saved")
    return on_view(fsvc, frepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid)


def on_cert(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
            urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    if not _toggle(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid, "gives_cert"):
        return "frm-none"
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_saved")
    return on_view(fsvc, frepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid)


def on_publish(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
               urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    _pub_reply(frepo, responder, ctx, fsvc.publish(fid))
    return on_view(fsvc, frepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid)


def on_status(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
              urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
              fid: int, st: str) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    out = fsvc.set_status(fid, st)
    if st == F_PUBLISHED:
        _pub_reply(frepo, responder, ctx, out)
    elif str(out.get("result")) == "ok":
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_status_set", status=_st_fa(
            frepo.get_form(fid)))
    else:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
    return on_view(fsvc, frepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid)


def on_link(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    if frepo.get_form(fid) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return "frm-none"
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_link_text", link=f"/start form_{fid}")
    return "frm-link"


def on_del_q(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
             responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    form = frepo.get_form(fid)
    if form is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return "frm-none"
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_frm_del"), f"frmdelx:{fid}")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frmv:{fid}")]]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("frm_del_q", title=form.title), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm-delq"


def on_delete(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    frepo.delete_form(fid)
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_deleted")
    return on_hub(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx)


# ------------------------------------------------------------- فیلدها

def _fields_page(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                 responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int, page: int) -> str:
    form = frepo.get_form(fid)
    if form is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return "frm-none"
    fields = frepo.fields(fid)
    lines = [t("frm_fields_head", title=_label(form.title, 40))]
    rows: list[list[dict]] = []
    if not fields:
        lines.append(t("frm_fields_none"))
    pages = max(1, -(-len(fields) // _PAGE))
    page = max(0, min(int(page), pages - 1))
    for f in fields[page * _PAGE:(page + 1) * _PAGE]:
        req = t("frm_req_mark") if f.required else ""
        lines.append(t("frm_field_line", i=fa_num(f.ord),
                       label=_label(_fld_label(f), 30),
                       type=_type_fa(f.type), req=req))
        rows.append([ui.btn(_label(_fld_label(f), 20), f"frme:{f.id}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_frm_up"), f"frmup:{f.id}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_frm_dn"), f"frmdn:{f.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_fadd"), f"frmt:{fid}"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frmv:{fid}")])
    if pages > 1:
        nav = []
        if page > 0:
            nav.append(ui.btn(t("btn_prev"), f"frmpg:{fid}:{page - 1}"))
        nav.append(ui.btn(t("btn_next"), f"frmpg:{fid}:{page + 1}"
                          if page + 1 < pages else f"frmpg:{fid}:0"))
        rows.append(nav)
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm-fields"


def on_fields(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    return _fields_page(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid, 0)


def on_fields_pg(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                 responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int, page: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    return _fields_page(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid, page)


def on_tcat(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    if frepo.get_form(fid) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return "frm-none"
    rows = []
    for i in range(0, len(FIELD_CATS), 2):
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("ftc_" + c), f"frmtc:{fid}:{c}")
                     for c in FIELD_CATS[i:i + 2]])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frmf:{fid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("frm_cat_q"), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm-tcat"


def on_tpick(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
             responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int, cat: str) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    if frepo.get_form(fid) is None or cat not in FIELD_CATS:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return "frm-none"
    types = [k for k, v in FIELD_TYPES.items() if v.get("cat") == cat]
    rows = []
    for i in range(0, len(types), 2):
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("ft_" + x), f"frmta:{fid}:{x}")
                     for x in types[i:i + 2]])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frmt:{fid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("frm_cat_q"), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm-tpick"


def on_tadd(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int, ftype: str) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    if frepo.get_form(fid) is None or ftype not in FIELD_TYPES:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return "frm-none"
    fld = frepo.add_field(fid, ftype)
    seed: dict = {"label": t(default_label(ftype))[:80]}
    if ftype == "yesno":
        seed["options"] = [t("opt_yes"), t("opt_no")]
    frepo.update_field(fld.id, **seed)
    return on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fld.id)


def on_edit(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    fld = frepo.get_field(ffid)
    if fld is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_field_none")
        return "frm-none"
    kind = _fld_kind(fld)
    req = t("frm_req_mark") if fld.required else ""
    lines = [t("frm_field_head", label=_fld_label(fld),
               type=_type_fa(fld.type), req=req)]
    if fld.help:
        lines.append(fld.help)
    if fld.options:
        lines.append(t("frm_field_options",
                       opts=(" " + _FA_COMMA + " ").join(
                           str(o) for o in fld.options[:10])))
    if kind == "number" and (fld.min_val or fld.max_val):
        lines.append(t("frm_field_range", min=fa_num(fld.min_val),
                       max=fa_num(fld.max_val)))
    if kind in MEDIA_KINDS:
        lines.append(t("frm_field_files", n=fa_num(fld.max_files)))
    if kind == "quiz":
        lines.append(t("frm_field_score", n=fa_num(fld.score)))
        if 0 <= fld.correct < len(fld.options):
            lines.append(t("frm_field_correct",
                           opt=str(fld.options[fld.correct])))
    if fld.cond_field:
        ref = frepo.get_field(fld.cond_field)
        op = t("cond_" + fld.cond_op) if fld.cond_op in COND_OPS else "—"
        if fld.cond_value:
            lines.append(t("frm_field_cond",
                           ref=_fld_label(ref) if ref else "—", op=op,
                           val=_label(fld.cond_value, 30)))
        else:
            lines.append(t("frm_field_cond_nv",
                           ref=_fld_label(ref) if ref else "—", op=op))
    rows: list[list[dict]] = [
        [ui.btn(t("btn_frm_label"), f"frmq:{ffid}:label"),
         ui.btn(t("btn_frm_req_on" if fld.required
                  else "btn_frm_req_off"), f"frmrq:{ffid}")],
        [ui.btn(t("btn_frm_help"), f"frmq:{ffid}:help")]]
    if kind in _OPT_KINDS:
        row = [ui.btn(t("btn_frm_options"), f"frmq:{ffid}:options")]
        if kind == "quiz":
            row.append(ui.btn(t("btn_frm_correct"), f"frmco:{ffid}"))
        rows.append(row)
    if kind == "quiz":
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_score"), f"frmq:{ffid}:score")])
    if kind == "number":
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_min"), f"frmq:{ffid}:min"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_frm_max"), f"frmq:{ffid}:max")])
    if kind in MEDIA_KINDS:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_files"), f"frmq:{ffid}:maxf")])
    cond = [ui.btn(t("btn_frm_cond"), f"frmcnd:{ffid}")]
    if fld.cond_field:
        cond.append(ui.btn(t("btn_frm_cond_clear"), f"frmcclr:{ffid}"))
    rows.append(cond)
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_copy"), f"frmcp:{ffid}"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_frm_fdel"), f"frmdf:{ffid}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frmf:{fld.form_id}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm-edit"


def _field_guard(frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                 ffid: int):
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return None
    fld = frepo.get_field(ffid)
    if fld is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_field_none")
    return fld


def on_ask_field(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                 state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                 ffid: int, sub: str) -> str:
    fld = _field_guard(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    if fld is None or sub not in _ASK_FIELD:
        return "frm-none"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FRM, {"sub": sub, "ffid": ffid})
    responder.reply(ctx, _ASK_FIELD[sub])
    return "frm-ask"


def on_ask_form(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                fid: int, sub: str) -> str:
    if _top(urepo, ctx) is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return "frm-denied"
    if frepo.get_form(fid) is None or sub not in _ASK_FORM:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
        return "frm-none"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FRM, {"sub": sub, "fid": fid})
    responder.reply(ctx, _ASK_FORM[sub])
    return "frm-ask"


def on_req(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
           responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int) -> str:
    fld = _field_guard(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    if fld is None:
        return "frm-none"
    frepo.update_field(ffid, required=0 if fld.required else 1)
    return on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)


def on_correct(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
               responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int) -> str:
    fld = _field_guard(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    if fld is None:
        return "frm-none"
    if not fld.options:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_pub_field_few_options",
                        label=_fld_label(fld))
        return on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    rows = [[ui.btn(_label(str(o), 30), f"frmcox:{ffid}:{i}")]
            for i, o in enumerate(fld.options[:8])]
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frme:{ffid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("frm_correct_q"), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm-correct"


def on_correct_set(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                   responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int, idx: int) -> str:
    fld = _field_guard(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    if fld is None or not 0 <= idx < len(fld.options):
        return "frm-none"
    frepo.update_field(ffid, correct=idx)
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_saved")
    return on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)


def on_move(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int, up: bool) -> str:
    fld = _field_guard(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    if fld is None:
        return "frm-none"
    frepo.move_field(ffid, up=up)
    return _fields_page(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fld.form_id, 0)


def on_up(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
          responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int) -> str:
    return on_move(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid, True)


def on_dn(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
          responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int) -> str:
    return on_move(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid, False)


def on_copy(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int) -> str:
    fld = _field_guard(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    if fld is None:
        return "frm-none"
    cp = frepo.copy_field(ffid)
    if cp is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "frm-none"
    return on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, cp.id)


def on_fdel_q(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int) -> str:
    fld = _field_guard(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    if fld is None:
        return "frm-none"
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_frm_fdel"), f"frmdfx:{ffid}")],
            [ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frme:{ffid}")]]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("frm_fdel_q", label=_fld_label(fld)),
                        ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm-fdelq"


def on_fdelete(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
               responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int) -> str:
    fld = _field_guard(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    if fld is None:
        return "frm-none"
    fid = fld.form_id
    frepo.delete_field(ffid)
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_fdeleted")
    return _fields_page(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid, 0)


# ---------------------------------------------------------- شرط نمایش

def on_cond(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int) -> str:
    fld = _field_guard(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    if fld is None:
        return "frm-none"
    others = [f for f in frepo.fields(fld.form_id) if f.id != ffid]
    if not others:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_cond_none")
        return on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    rows = [[ui.btn(_label(_fld_label(f), 28), f"frmcndf:{ffid}:{f.id}")]
            for f in others[:8]]
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frme:{ffid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("frm_cond_q"), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frm-cond"


def _op_menu(responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int) -> None:
    rows = []
    for i in range(0, len(COND_OPS), 2):
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("cond_" + op), f"frmcndop:{ffid}:{op}")
                     for op in COND_OPS[i:i + 2]])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frmxe:{ffid}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("frm_cond_op_q"), ui.kb(rows))


def on_cond_ref(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                ffid: int, ref: int) -> str:
    fld = _field_guard(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    if fld is None or frepo.get_field(ref) is None or ref == ffid:
        return "frm-none"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FRM, {"sub": "cndop", "ffid": ffid,
                                      "ref": ref})
    _op_menu(responder, ctx, ffid)
    return "frm-condop"


def on_cond_op(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
               state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
               ffid: int, op: str) -> str:
    fld = _field_guard(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    if fld is None or op not in COND_OPS:
        return "frm-none"
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_FRM or str(data.get("sub")) != "cndop" \
            or int(data.get("ffid") or 0) != ffid:
        _op_menu(responder, ctx, ffid)
        return "frm-condop"
    ref = int(data.get("ref") or 0)
    if op in ("empty", "nempty"):
        frepo.update_field(ffid, cond_field=ref, cond_op=op, cond_value="")
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_saved")
        return on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    reff = frepo.get_field(ref)
    if reff is not None and reff.options:
        data["op"] = op
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FRM, data)
        rows = [[ui.btn(_label(str(o), 28), f"frmcndv:{ffid}:{i}")]
                for i, o in enumerate(reff.options[:8])]
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_cond_free"), f"frmcndt:{ffid}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frmxe:{ffid}")])
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, t("frm_cond_val_q"), ui.kb(rows))
        return "frm-condval"
    data["op"] = op
    data["sub"] = "cndv"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FRM, data)
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_cond_val_q")
    return "frm-condval"


def on_cond_val(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                ffid: int, idx: int) -> str:
    fld = _field_guard(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    if fld is None:
        return "frm-none"
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_FRM or str(data.get("sub")) != "cndop":
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_cancel")
        return on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    reff = frepo.get_field(int(data.get("ref") or 0))
    if reff is None or not 0 <= idx < len(reff.options):
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    frepo.update_field(ffid, cond_field=reff.id,
                       cond_op=str(data.get("op") or ""),
                       cond_value=str(reff.options[idx])[:80])
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_saved")
    return on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)


def on_cond_free(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                 state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int) -> str:
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_FRM or str(data.get("sub")) != "cndop" \
            or int(data.get("ffid") or 0) != ffid:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_cancel")
        return on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    data["sub"] = "cndv"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FRM, data)
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_cond_val_q")
    return "frm-condval"


def on_cond_clear(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                  responder, ctx: Ctx, ffid: int) -> str:
    fld = _field_guard(frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
    if fld is None:
        return "frm-none"
    frepo.update_field(ffid, cond_field=0, cond_op="", cond_value="")
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_saved")
    return on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)


# --------------------------------------------------------- لغو/بازگشت

def on_cancel_form(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
                   urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
                   ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    return on_view(fsvc, frepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid)


def on_cancel_field(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                    state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                    ffid: int) -> str:
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    return on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)


# ------------------------------------------------------- ورودی متنی

def frm_text_interceptor(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo,
                         erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                         state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                         text: str) -> bool:
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_FRM:
        return False
    sub = str(data.get("sub") or "")
    user = _top(urepo, ctx)
    if user is None:
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "no_perm")
        return True

    if sub == "title":
        title = " ".join(text.split())
        if len(title) < 3:
            responder.reply(ctx, "frm_title_bad")
            return True
        out = fsvc.create(title, user.id)
        if out.get("result") != "ok":
            responder.reply(ctx, "frm_title_bad")
            return True
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_created", title=_label(title, 40))
        on_view(fsvc, frepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx,
                int(out["id"]))
        return True

    if sub in ("intro", "price"):
        fid = int(data.get("fid") or 0)
        if frepo.get_form(fid) is None:
            state.clear(ctx.user_id)
            responder.reply(ctx, "frm_none_found")
            return True
        if sub == "intro":
            val = "" if text.strip() in ("-", "—") else text.strip()[:500]
            frepo.update_form(fid, intro=val)
        else:
            d = digits_only(text)
            if not d:
                responder.reply(ctx, "frm_price_bad")
                return True
            frepo.update_form(fid, price=int(d[:9]))
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_saved")
        on_view(fsvc, frepo, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid)
        return True

    if sub in _ASK_FIELD or sub == "cndv":
        ffid = int(data.get("ffid") or 0)
        fld = frepo.get_field(ffid)
        if fld is None:
            state.clear(ctx.user_id)
            responder.reply(ctx, "frm_field_none")
            return True
        bad = _apply_field_text(frepo, state, responder, ctx, data,
                                sub, fld, text)
        if bad:
            return True
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_saved")
        on_edit(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, ffid)
        return True

    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    return False


def _apply_field_text(frepo: FormRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
                      ctx: Ctx, data: dict, sub: str, fld: FormField,
                      text: str) -> bool:
    """مقداردهی فیلد از متن؛ True یعنی هنوز در گام هستیم (خطا/تکرار)."""
    if sub == "label":
        val = " ".join(text.split())[:80]
        if not val:
            responder.reply(ctx, "frm_label_q")
            return True
        frepo.update_field(fld.id, label=val)
        return False
    if sub == "help":
        val = "" if text.strip() in ("-", "—") else text.strip()[:120]
        frepo.update_field(fld.id, help=val)
        return False
    if sub == "options":
        opts: list[str] = []
        for line in text.split("\n"):
            o = " ".join(line.split())[:80]
            if o and o not in ("-", "—") and o not in opts:
                opts.append(o)
        if len(opts) < 2:
            responder.reply(ctx, "frm_options_bad")
            return True
        patch: dict = {"options": opts}
        if fld.correct >= len(opts):
            patch["correct"] = -1
        frepo.update_field(fld.id, **patch)
        return False
    if sub == "cndv":
        val = " ".join(text.split())[:80]
        if not val:
            responder.reply(ctx, "frm_cond_val_q")
            return True
        frepo.update_field(fld.id, cond_field=int(data.get("ref") or 0),
                           cond_op=str(data.get("op") or ""),
                           cond_value=val)
        return False
    d = digits_only(text)
    if not d and text.strip() not in ("0", "-"):
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_num_bad")
        return True
    n = int(d[:6]) if d else 0
    if sub == "score":
        frepo.update_field(fld.id, score=min(n, 1000))
    elif sub == "min":
        frepo.update_field(fld.id, min_val=n)
    elif sub == "max":
        frepo.update_field(fld.id, max_val=n)
    elif sub == "maxf":
        frepo.update_field(fld.id, max_files=min(max(n, 1), 10))
    else:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_num_bad")
        return True
    return False

def register_form_routes(r, fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo,

"""تست فاز ۳۶a: فرم‌ساز ادمین — ساخت، فیلد، شرط، انتشار، حذف."""
from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.forms import FormRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.form_service import FormService


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 17, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock,
                              transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    formrepo = FormRepo(db, clock)
    formsvc = FormService(formrepo, clock=clock)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved",
                 full_name="ادمین گروه")
    member = urepo.create(555, first_name="عضو")
    urepo.update(member.id, status="approved")
    yield {"bot": bot, "clock": clock, "sent": sent, "urepo": urepo,
           "db": db, "formrepo": formrepo, "formsvc": formsvc}
    set_clock(old)


def step(env, update, uid=999):
    env["clock"].advance_hours(0.01)
    env["bot"].process_update(update)
    env["bot"].outbox.drain()


def cb(data, uid=999):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=999):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def last(env):
    return str(env["sent"][-1].get("text") or "")


def all_text(env):
    return "\n".join(str(p.get("text") or "") for p in env["sent"])


def all_markup(env):
    return "\n".join(str(p.get("reply_markup") or "") for p in env["sent"])


def last_markup(env):
    return str(env["sent"][-1].get("reply_markup") or "")


def _new_form(env, title="فرم نظرسنجی پاییز"):
    step(env, cb("frm:1"))
    step(env, cb("frmn:1"))
    step(env, msg(title))
    forms = env["formrepo"].list_forms()
    assert forms, all_text(env)
    return forms[0]

def test_move_copy_delete(env):
    form = _new_form(env)
    f1 = _add_field(env, form.id, "text", "text")
    f2 = _add_field(env, form.id, "text", "email")
    ids = [f.id for f in env["formrepo"].fields(form.id)]
    assert ids == [f1.id, f2.id]
    step(env, cb(f"frmf:{form.id}"))
    step(env, cb(f"frmup:{f2.id}"))
    ids = [f.id for f in env["formrepo"].fields(form.id)]
    assert ids == [f2.id, f1.id]
    step(env, cb(f"frmdn:{f2.id}"))
    ids = [f.id for f in env["formrepo"].fields(form.id)]
    assert ids == [f1.id, f2.id]
    step(env, cb(f"frmcp:{f1.id}"))
    fields = env["formrepo"].fields(form.id)
    assert len(fields) == 3
    cp = fields[-1]
    assert cp.label == f1.label and cp.id != f1.id
    step(env, cb(f"frmdf:{cp.id}"))
    assert t("frm_fdel_q", label=cp.label) in last(env)
    step(env, cb(f"frmdfx:{cp.id}"))
    assert len(env["formrepo"].fields(form.id)) == 2
    assert t("frm_fdeleted") in all_text(env)

def test_condition_flow_and_clear(env):
    form = _new_form(env)
    f1 = _add_field(env, form.id, "choice", "one")
    step(env, cb(f"frmq:{f1.id}:options"))
    step(env, msg("خوب\nبد"))
    f2 = _add_field(env, form.id, "text", "textarea")
    # شرط: اگر f1 برابر «خوب»
    step(env, cb(f"frmcnd:{f2.id}"))
    assert t("frm_cond_q") in last(env)
    step(env, cb(f"frmcndf:{f2.id}:{f1.id}"))
    assert t("frm_cond_op_q") in last(env)
    step(env, cb(f"frmcndop:{f2.id}:eq"))
    # f1 گزینه دارد → مقدار از گزینه‌ها
    assert "frmcndv:" in last_markup(env)
    step(env, cb(f"frmcndv:{f2.id}:0"))
    fresh = env["formrepo"].get_field(f2.id)
    assert fresh.cond_field == f1.id and fresh.cond_op == "eq"
    assert fresh.cond_value == "خوب"
    step(env, cb(f"frme:{f2.id}"))
    assert t("cond_eq") in all_text(env)
    # حذف شرط
    step(env, cb(f"frmcclr:{f2.id}"))
    fresh = env["formrepo"].get_field(f2.id)
    assert fresh.cond_field == 0 and fresh.cond_op == ""

"""پرکردن فرم — صفحه‌های کاربر (فاز ۳۶b).

ورود از خانه (فرم‌های عمومی)، لینک مستقیم (/start form_N) یا گیتِ
ثبت‌نام رویداد. پرسش‌ها یکی‌یکی با انتخابگر (شهر/تاریخ از pickers،
رسانه از زنجیرهٔ media)؛ پایان = خلاصه + ثبت. فرم پولی روی همان
لایهٔ پرداخت می‌نشیند (target_kind="form") و بعد از پرداخت، ثبت
نهایی و تحویل (رسید/گواهی) خودکار انجام می‌شود.
"""

                              F_PUBLISHED, MEDIA_KINDS, R_SUBMITTED,
                              Form, FormField, FormRepo)
from ....domain.payments import M_CARD, M_GATEWAY

from .support import _w

STEP_FRMF = "frm_fill"

_TEXT_KINDS = ("text", "multiline", "digits", "email", "url", "number")
_ERR_KEY = {"bad_input": "frm_e_bad_input", "bad_number": "frm_e_bad_number",
            "bad_range": "frm_e_bad_range",
            "bad_mobile": "frm_e_bad_mobile", "bad_email": "frm_e_bad_email",
            "bad_url": "frm_e_bad_url", "need_one": "frm_e_need_one",
            "need_choice": "frm_e_need_choice",
            "need_file": "frm_e_need_file", "need_more": "frm_e_need_more"}
_SEND_KEY = {"photo": "frm_u_send_photo", "video": "frm_u_send_video",
             "voice": "frm_u_send_voice", "file": "frm_u_send_file"}


def _label(text: str, n: int) -> str:
    text = (text or "").strip()
    return text if len(text) <= n else text[:n - 1] + "…"


def _type_fa(ftype: str) -> str:
    from ....domain.forms import FIELD_TYPES
    return t("ft_" + ftype) if ftype in FIELD_TYPES else t("ft_text")


def _fld_label(fld: FormField) -> str:
    lab = str(fld.label or "").strip()
    return lab if lab else _type_fa(fld.type)


def _fld_kind(fld: FormField) -> str:
    from ....domain.forms import FIELD_TYPES
    meta = FIELD_TYPES.get(fld.type) or {}
    return str(meta.get("kind") or "text")


def _user_ok(urepo: UserRepo, frepo: FormRepo, ctx: Ctx, fid: int):
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    form = frepo.get_form(fid)
    if user is None or form is None:
        return None, None, None
    return user, form, None


def _form_open(form: Form, user) -> str:
    """چرا فرم برای این کاربر باز نیست — رشتهٔ خالی یعنی باز است."""
    if form.status != F_PUBLISHED:
        return "frm_u_paused" if form.status == F_PAUSED \
            else "frm_u_unavailable"
    if form.access == A_PRIVATE and str(user.role) not in ("admin", "owner"):
        return "frm_u_unavailable"
    return ""
