def home_forms_row(frepo: FormRepo | None, user) -> list:
    """ردیف خانه: فقط وقتی فرم عمومیِ بازی هست."""
    if frepo is None or user is None:
        return []
    forms = [f for f in frepo.list_forms(statuses=(F_PUBLISHED,))
             if f.access == A_PUBLIC]
    if not forms:
        return []
    return [[ui.btn(t("btn_forms_user"), "frms:1")]]


def on_list(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            responder, ctx: Ctx, _a: int = 0) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if user is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_unavailable")
        return "frmu-none"
    forms = [f for f in frepo.list_forms(statuses=(F_PUBLISHED,))
             if f.access == A_PUBLIC
             or (f.access == A_PRIVATE and user.role in ("admin", "owner"))]
    lines = [t("frm_u_list_head")]
    rows: list[list[dict]] = []
    if not forms:
        lines.append(t("frm_u_none"))
    for f in forms[:8]:
        rows.append([ui.btn(_label(f.title, 30), f"frmu:{f.id}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "nav:home")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frms"


# ----------------------------------------------------------- پرسش‌ها

def _visible(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, fid: int, rid: int):
    return fsvc.visible_fields(fid, rid)


def _err_reply(responder, ctx: Ctx, fld: FormField, err: str) -> None:
    key = _ERR_KEY.get(err, "frm_e_bad_input")
    if err == "bad_range":
        responder.reply(ctx, key, min=fa_num(fld.min_val),
                        max=fa_num(fld.max_val or 5))
    else:
        responder.reply(ctx, key)


def _q_head(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, fid: int, rid: int,
            fld: FormField) -> list[str]:
    vis = _visible(fsvc, frepo, fid, rid)
    n = len(vis)
    i = next((k for k, f in enumerate(vis, 1) if f.id == fld.id), fld.ord)
    lines = [t("frm_u_q_head", i=fa_num(i), n=fa_num(n)),
             _fld_label(fld)]
    if fld.help:
        lines.append(fld.help)
    return lines


def _prompt(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, form: Form,
            rid: int, fld: FormField, note: str = "") -> str:
    kind = _fld_kind(fld)
    lines = _q_head(fsvc, frepo, form.id, rid, fld)
    if note:
        lines.insert(0, note)
    cancel = [ui.btn(t("btn_frm_u_cancel"), f"frmxu:{form.id}")]
    if kind in ("one", "yesno", "quiz"):
        rows = [[ui.btn(_label(str(o), 30), f"frmsel:{rid}:{fld.id}:{i}")]
                for i, o in enumerate(fld.options[:9])]
        rows.append(cancel)
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
        return "frmf-q"
    if kind == "multi":
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FRMF,
                  {"sub": "multi", "rid": rid, "ffid": fld.id,
                   "sel": []}, merge=False)
        return _multi_render(frepo, state, responder, ctx, form, rid,
                             fld, lines)
    if kind == "rating":
        rows = [[ui.btn(fa_num(n), f"frmrate:{rid}:{fld.id}:{n}")
                 for n in range(1, 6)], cancel]
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
        return "frmf-q"
    if kind in ("prov", "city"):
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines))
        pickers.cty_start(state, responder, ctx, resume="frmf_city",
                          extra={"rid": rid, "ffid": fld.id,
                                 "fid": form.id,
                                 "want": "prov" if kind == "prov"
                                 else "city"})
        return "frmf-pick"
    if kind == "date":
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines))
        pickers.jdp_start(state, responder, ctx, resume="frmf_date",
                          with_time=False,
                          extra={"rid": rid, "ffid": fld.id,
                                 "fid": form.id})
        return "frmf-pick"
    if kind in MEDIA_KINDS:
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FRMF,
                  {"sub": "media", "rid": rid, "ffid": fld.id,
                   "mkind": kind}, merge=False)
        lines.append(t(_SEND_KEY.get(kind, "frm_u_send_file")))
        responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb([cancel]))
        return "frmf-media"
    # متن/عدد/موبایل/ایمیل/نشانی — ورودی متنی
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FRMF,
              {"sub": "text", "rid": rid, "ffid": fld.id}, merge=False)
    lines.append(t("frm_u_send_text"))
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb([cancel]))
    return "frmf-text"


def _multi_render(frepo: FormRepo, state: StateStore, responder,
                  ctx: Ctx, form: Form, rid: int, fld: FormField,
                  lines: list[str]) -> str:
    _step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    sel = [str(x) for x in (data.get("sel") or [])]
    head = list(lines)
    head.append(t("frm_u_multi_head"))
    if sel:
        head.append(t("frm_u_multi_sel",
                      opts="، ".join(_label(s, 20) for s in sel)))
    rows = []
    for i, o in enumerate(fld.options[:9]):
        mark = "*" if str(o) in sel else ""
        rows.append([ui.btn(_label(mark + str(o), 30),
                            f"frmtog:{rid}:{fld.id}:{i}")])
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_multi_ok"), f"frmdone:{rid}:{fld.id}"),
                 ui.btn(t("btn_frm_u_cancel"), f"frmxu:{form.id}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(head), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frmf-multi"


def _advance(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
             state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, form: Form,
             rid: int, note: str = "") -> str:
    vis = _visible(fsvc, frepo, form.id, rid)
    amap = frepo.answers_map(rid)
    for f in vis:
        if f.id not in amap:
            return _prompt(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx,
                           form, rid, f, note=note)
    return _summary(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, form, rid,
                    note=note)


def _ans_text(fld: FormField, ans) -> str:
    if ans is None:
        return "—"
    kind = _fld_kind(fld)
    if kind in MEDIA_KINDS or ans.file_id:
        return t("frm_u_ans_file")
    if kind == "rating":
        return t("frm_u_rating_val", n=fa_num(ans.value_number))
    if ans.value_options:
        return "، ".join(_label(str(o), 24) for o in ans.value_options)
    val = str(ans.value_text or "").strip()
    return _label(val, 40) if val else "—"


def _summary(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
             responder, ctx: Ctx, form: Form, rid: int,
             note: str = "", prev: bool = False) -> str:
    resp = frepo.get_response(rid)
    if resp is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_unavailable")
        return "frmu-none"
    vis = _visible(fsvc, frepo, form.id, rid)
    amap = frepo.answers_map(rid)
    lines = [t("frm_u_prev_head") if prev else
             (note or t("frm_u_summary"))]
    rows: list[list[dict]] = []
    for f in vis[:8]:
        lines.append(t("frm_u_ans_row", label=_label(_fld_label(f), 30),
                       value=_ans_text(f, amap.get(f.id))))
        if not prev:
            rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_edit_ans"),
                                f"frmedit:{rid}:{f.id}")])
    if not prev:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_submit"), f"frmsub:{rid}"),
                     ui.btn(t("btn_frm_u_cancel"), f"frmxu:{form.id}")])
    else:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "nav:home")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frmf-sum"


# ------------------------------------------------------------- ورود

def on_entry(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
             urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
             fid: int, note: str = "") -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    form = frepo.get_form(fid)
    if user is None or form is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_unavailable")
        return "frmu-none"
    closed = _form_open(form, user)
    if closed:
        responder.reply(ctx, closed)
        return "frmu-closed"
    resp = frepo.response_of(fid, user.id)
    if resp is not None and resp.status == R_SUBMITTED:
        return _summary(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, form,
                        resp.id, prev=True)
    out = fsvc.start(form, user)
    if out.get("result") == "done" and out.get("resp") is not None:
        return _summary(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, form,
                        int(out["resp"].id), prev=True)
    if out.get("result") != "ok":
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_unavailable")
        return "frmu-closed"
    head = note or (form.intro if resp is None else "")
    return _advance(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, form,
                    int(out["resp"].id), note=head)


def _draft(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
           responder, ctx: Ctx, rid: int):
    """resp+form+user معتبر و در حال پرکردن — یا None (با پیام)."""
    resp = frepo.get_response(rid)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if resp is None or user is None or resp.user_id != user.id:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_unavailable")
        return None, None, None
    form = frepo.get_form(resp.form_id)
    if form is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_unavailable")
        return None, None, None
    if resp.status == R_SUBMITTED:
        _summary(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, form, rid, prev=True)
        return None, None, None
    return resp, form, user


def on_select(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, rid: int,
              ffid: int, idx: int) -> str:
    resp, form, user = _draft(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, rid)
    if resp is None:
        return "frmu-stale"
    fld = frepo.get_field(ffid)
    if fld is None or fld.form_id != form.id \
            or not 0 <= idx < len(fld.options):
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_stale")
        return "frmu-stale"
    err = fsvc.validate(fld, options=[fld.options[idx]])
    if err:
        _err_reply(responder, ctx, fld, err)
        return "frmf-err"
    fsvc.save_answer(resp, fld, options=[fld.options[idx]])
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    return _advance(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, form, rid)


def on_rate(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, rid: int,
            ffid: int, n: int) -> str:
    resp, form, user = _draft(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, rid)
    if resp is None:
        return "frmu-stale"
    fld = frepo.get_field(ffid)
    if fld is None or fld.form_id != form.id:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_stale")
        return "frmu-stale"
    err = fsvc.validate(fld, number=n)
    if err:
        _err_reply(responder, ctx, fld, err)
        return "frmf-err"
    fsvc.save_answer(resp, fld, number=n)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    return _advance(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, form, rid)


def _multi_state(frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore,
                 responder, ctx: Ctx, rid: int, ffid: int):
    resp = frepo.get_response(rid)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    fld = frepo.get_field(ffid)
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if (resp is None or user is None or resp.user_id != user.id
            or fld is None or resp.status == R_SUBMITTED
            or step != STEP_FRMF or str(data.get("sub")) != "multi"
            or int(data.get("rid") or 0) != rid
            or int(data.get("ffid") or 0) != ffid):
        return None, None, None, None
    form = frepo.get_form(resp.form_id)
    return resp, form, fld, data


def on_toggle(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, rid: int,
              ffid: int, idx: int) -> str:
    resp, form, fld, data = _multi_state(frepo, urepo, state, responder,
                                         ctx, rid, ffid)
    if resp is None or form is None or fld is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_stale")
        return "frmu-stale"
    if not 0 <= idx < len(fld.options):
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_stale")
        return "frmu-stale"
    val = str(fld.options[idx])
    sel = [str(x) for x in (data.get("sel") or [])]
    if val in sel:
        sel.remove(val)
    else:
        sel.append(val)
    data["sel"] = sel
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FRMF, data)
    lines = _q_head(fsvc, frepo, form.id, rid, fld)
    return _multi_render(frepo, state, responder, ctx, form, rid, fld,
                         lines)


def on_multi_done(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                  state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, rid: int,
                  ffid: int) -> str:
    resp, form, fld, data = _multi_state(frepo, urepo, state, responder,
                                         ctx, rid, ffid)
    if resp is None or form is None or fld is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_stale")
        return "frmu-stale"
    sel = [str(x) for x in (data.get("sel") or [])]
    err = fsvc.validate(fld, options=sel)
    if err:
        _err_reply(responder, ctx, fld, err)
        lines = _q_head(fsvc, frepo, form.id, rid, fld)
        return _multi_render(frepo, state, responder, ctx, form, rid,
                             fld, lines)
    fsvc.save_answer(resp, fld, options=sel)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    return _advance(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, form, rid)


def on_edit(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
            state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, rid: int,
            ffid: int) -> str:
    resp, form, user = _draft(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, rid)
    if resp is None:
        return "frmu-stale"
    fld = frepo.get_field(ffid)
    if fld is None or fld.form_id != form.id:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_stale")
        return "frmu-stale"
    return _prompt(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, form, rid,
                   fld)


def on_summary(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
               responder, ctx: Ctx, rid: int) -> str:
    resp, form, user = _draft(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, rid)
    if resp is None:
        return "frmu-stale"
    return _summary(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, form, rid)


def on_cancel(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_cancel",
                    markup=ui.kb([[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "nav:home")]]))
    return "frmu-cancel"


# --------------------------------------------------------- ثبت و پرداخت

def _send_form_ticket(responder, chat_id: int, form: Form, code: str,
                      holder: str) -> bool:
    """رسیدِ فرم — هم‌خانواده بلیت رویداد؛ اگر رندر نشد، متن می‌رود."""
    try:
        path = ticket_art.ticket_path(
            title=form.title, info=t("fk_" + form.kind),
            holder=holder, code=code, brand=t("brand"),
            labels={"holder": t("tk_holder"), "code": t("tk_code")})
    except Exception:
        return False
    return responder.send_photo_file(chat_id, path, "frm_u_ticket_cap")


def _deliver(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, certs: CertRepo,
             csvc: CertService, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
             responder, ctx: Ctx, form: Form, out: dict) -> str:
    resp = out.get("resp")
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    total = int(out.get("score_total") or 0)
    got = int(out.get("score") or 0)
    rows = []
    if form.access == "event" and form.event_id:
        rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_reg_back"), f"reg:{form.event_id}")])
    if total > 0:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_done_score", got=fa_num(got),
                        total=fa_num(total),
                        markup=ui.kb(rows) if rows else None)
    else:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_done",
                        markup=ui.kb(rows) if rows else None)
    if resp is not None and resp.ticket_code and user is not None:
        holder = user.full_name or user.first_name or t("name_fallback")
        if not _send_form_ticket(responder, ctx.chat_id, form,
                                 resp.ticket_code, holder):
            responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_ticket_cap")
    if int(form.gives_cert or 0) and user is not None:
        holder = user.full_name or user.first_name or t("name_fallback")
        cert_out = fsvc.issue_cert(form, user, holder)
        if cert_out.get("result") == "ok" and cert_out.get("cert_id"):
            from .certs import on_view as cert_view
            cert_view(certs, csvc, erepo, urepo, responder, ctx,
                      int(cert_out["cert_id"]))
        else:
            responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_cert_hint")
    return "frmf-done"


def on_submit(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, certs: CertRepo,
              csvc: CertService, erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
              state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, rid: int) -> str:
    resp, form, user = _draft(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, rid)
    if resp is None:
        return "frmu-stale"
    out = fsvc.submit(form, resp)
    res = str(out.get("result"))
    if res == "missing":
        labels = "، ".join(_label(str(x), 20)
                           for x in (out.get("labels") or []))
        return _advance(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, form,
                        rid, note=t("frm_u_missing", labels=labels))
    if res == "need_pay":
        return on_pay_choice(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, form.id)
    if res == "ok":
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        return _deliver(fsvc, frepo, certs, csvc, erepo, urepo,
                        responder, ctx, form, out)
    responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_stale")
    return "frmu-stale"


def on_pay_choice(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                  responder, ctx: Ctx, fid: int) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    form = frepo.get_form(fid)
    if user is None or form is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_unavailable")
        return "frmu-none"
    resp = frepo.response_of(fid, user.id)
    if resp is None or resp.status == R_SUBMITTED:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_stale")
        return "frmu-stale"
    methods = [m for m in _PSVC.methods_enabled()
               if m in (M_GATEWAY, M_CARD)] if _PSVC else []
    lines = [t("frm_u_pay_q", amount=money_label(int(form.price)))]
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_m_" + m), f"frmpaym:{fid}:{m}")]
            for m in methods]
    rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frmsum:{resp.id}")])
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))
    return "frmf-pay"


def on_pay_method(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                  setrepo, state: StateStore, responder, api, cfg,
                  ctx: Ctx, fid: int, method: str) -> str:
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    form = frepo.get_form(fid)
    if _PSVC is None or user is None or form is None \
            or method not in (M_GATEWAY, M_CARD):
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_unavailable")
        return "frmu-none"
    if method not in _PSVC.methods_enabled():
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_unavailable")
        return "frmu-off"
    st = _PSVC.start_form(user, form, method)
    if st.err or st.payment is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return "frmf-payerr"
    pay = st.payment
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    if method == M_GATEWAY:
        api.call("sendInvoice", chat_id=ctx.chat_id,
                 title=form.title[:32],
                 description=t("pay_invoice_desc",
                               title=form.title)[:255],
                 payload=str(pay.id), provider_token=cfg.pay_token,
                 prices=_invoice_prices(_PAYREPO, pay, setrepo))
        responder.reply(ctx, "pay_invoice_sent")
        return "frmf-invoice"
    if not _card_block(_PSVC, setrepo, responder, ctx, pay):
        for admin_id in cfg.admin_ids:
            responder.bulk(admin_id, "pay_card_unset_alert")
        responder.reply(ctx, "pay_card_unset")
        return "frmf-nocard"
    state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_PHOTO, {"pid": pay.id}, merge=False)
    return "frmf-card"


# پرداخت بعد از موفقیت — از pay.py صدا زده می‌شود (بدون ctx)
_PSVC: PayService | None = None
_PAYREPO = None
_FORMREPO: FormRepo | None = None
_FORMSVC: FormService | None = None


def finalize_after_pay(psvc, payrepo, formrepo: FormRepo,
                       formsvc: FormService, urepo: UserRepo,
                       responder, cfg, pay) -> None:
    user = urepo.get(pay.user_id)
    form = formrepo.get_form(int(pay.target_id))
    if user is None or form is None:
        return
    holder = user.full_name or user.first_name or t("name_fallback")
    resp = formrepo.response_of(form.id, user.id)
    if resp is not None and resp.status != R_SUBMITTED:
        formrepo.update_response(resp.id, pay_id=pay.id)
        fresh = formrepo.get_response(resp.id)
        out = formsvc.submit(form, fresh)
        got = int(out.get("score") or 0)
        total = int(out.get("score_total") or 0)
        if str(out.get("result")) == "ok":
            rows = []
            if form.access == "event" and form.event_id:
                rows.append([ui.btn(t("btn_frm_reg_back"),
                                    f"reg:{form.event_id}")])
            if total > 0:
                responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "frm_u_paid_score",
                               got=fa_num(got), total=fa_num(total),
                               markup=ui.kb(rows) if rows else None)
            else:
                responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "frm_u_paid_done",
                               markup=ui.kb(rows) if rows else None)
            done = formrepo.get_response(resp.id)
            if done is not None and done.ticket_code:
                _send_form_ticket(responder, user.bale_id, form,
                                  done.ticket_code, holder)
            if int(form.gives_cert or 0):
                formsvc.issue_cert(form, user, holder)
                responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "frm_u_cert_hint")
        else:
            responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "frm_u_paid_done")
    else:
        responder.bulk(user.bale_id, "frm_u_paid_done")
    for admin_id in cfg.admin_ids:
        responder.bulk(admin_id, "frm_paid_admin", name=holder,
                       title=_label(form.title, 30))
    if pay.method in psvc.receipt_auto():
        send_receipt(psvc, payrepo, None, urepo, responder, pay,
                     user.bale_id)


# ------------------------------------------------------- انتخابگرها

def _resume_city(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                 state: StateStore, ctx: Ctx, _state, responder,
                 res: dict) -> None:
    rid = int(res.get("rid") or 0)
    ffid = int(res.get("ffid") or 0)
    resp = frepo.get_response(rid)
    fld = frepo.get_field(ffid)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if resp is None or fld is None or user is None \
            or resp.user_id != user.id or resp.status == R_SUBMITTED:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_stale")
        return
    form = frepo.get_form(resp.form_id)
    if form is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_unavailable")
        return
    if res.get("cancel"):
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_cancel", markup=ui.kb(
            [[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "nav:home")]]))
        return
    if res.get("typed"):
        state.set(ctx.user_id, STEP_FRMF,
                  {"sub": "text", "rid": rid, "ffid": ffid}, merge=False)
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_send_text")
        return
    want = str(res.get("want") or "city")
    val = str(res.get("prov") if want == "prov" else res.get("city"))
    val = (val or "").strip()
    if not val:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return
    fsvc.save_answer(resp, fld, text=val)
    _advance(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, form, rid)


def _resume_date(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                 state: StateStore, ctx: Ctx, _state, responder,
                 res: dict) -> None:
    rid = int(res.get("rid") or 0)
    ffid = int(res.get("ffid") or 0)
    resp = frepo.get_response(rid)
    fld = frepo.get_field(ffid)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if resp is None or fld is None or user is None \
            or resp.user_id != user.id or resp.status == R_SUBMITTED:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_stale")
        return
    form = frepo.get_form(resp.form_id)
    if form is None:
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_unavailable")
        return
    if res.get("cancel"):
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_cancel", markup=ui.kb(
            [[ui.btn(t("btn_back"), "nav:home")]]))
        return
    ts = float(res.get("ts") or 0)
    if not ts:
        responder.reply(ctx, "err_generic")
        return
    fsvc.save_answer(resp, fld, text=_jal_date(ts), number=int(ts))
    _advance(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, form, rid)


# ------------------------------------------------------ ورودی متنی

def formfill_text_interceptor(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo,
                              erepo: EventRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                              state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
                              text: str) -> bool:
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_FRMF or str(data.get("sub")) != "text":
        return False
    rid = int(data.get("rid") or 0)
    ffid = int(data.get("ffid") or 0)
    resp = frepo.get_response(rid)
    fld = frepo.get_field(ffid)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if resp is None or fld is None or user is None \
            or resp.user_id != user.id:
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_stale")
        return True
    form = frepo.get_form(resp.form_id)
    if form is None or resp.status == R_SUBMITTED:
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_unavailable")
        return True
    err = fsvc.validate(fld, text=text)
    if err:
        _err_reply(responder, ctx, fld, err)
        return True
    fsvc.save_answer(resp, fld, text=text)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    _advance(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, form, rid)
    return True


# --------------------------------------------------------- رسانه‌ها

def _media_state(state: StateStore, ctx: Ctx, want: str):
    step, data = state.get(ctx.user_id)
    if step != STEP_FRMF or str(data.get("sub")) != "media" \
            or str(data.get("mkind") or "") != want:
        return None
    return data


def _save_media(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx, data: dict,
                kind: str, file_id: str) -> bool:
    rid = int(data.get("rid") or 0)
    ffid = int(data.get("ffid") or 0)
    resp = frepo.get_response(rid)
    fld = frepo.get_field(ffid)
    user = urepo.get_by_bale(ctx.user_id)
    if resp is None or fld is None or user is None \
            or resp.user_id != user.id or resp.status == R_SUBMITTED:
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_stale")
        return True
    form = frepo.get_form(resp.form_id)
    if form is None:
        state.clear(ctx.user_id)
        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_u_unavailable")
        return True
    fsvc.save_answer(resp, fld, file_id=file_id, file_kind=kind)
    state.clear(ctx.user_id)
    _advance(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, form, rid)
    return True


def photo_dispatch(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                   state: StateStore, responder, nxt, ctx: Ctx,
                   file_id: str) -> bool:
    data = _media_state(state, ctx, "photo")
    if data is not None:
        return _save_media(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx,
                           data, "photo", file_id)
    return bool(nxt(ctx, file_id)) if nxt else False


def media_dispatch(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                   state: StateStore, responder, nxt, ctx: Ctx,
                   kind: str, file_id: str) -> bool:
    want = "voice" if kind in ("voice", "audio") else "video"
    data = _media_state(state, ctx, want)
    if data is not None:
        return _save_media(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx,
                           data, want, file_id)
    return bool(nxt(ctx, kind, file_id)) if nxt else False


def doc_dispatch(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, urepo: UserRepo,
                 state: StateStore, responder, nxt, ctx: Ctx,
                 file_id: str, file_name: str = "") -> bool:
    data = _media_state(state, ctx, "file")
    if data is not None:
        return _save_media(fsvc, frepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx,
                           data, "file", file_id)
    return bool(nxt(ctx, file_id, file_name)) if nxt else False


# ------------------------------------------------------- لینک مستقیم

def deep_link(fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, erepo: EventRepo,
              urepo: UserRepo, state: StateStore, responder, ctx: Ctx,
              payload: str) -> bool:
    payload = (payload or "").strip()
    if not payload.startswith("form_"):
        return False
    rest = payload[5:]
    if not rest.isdigit():
        return True
    on_entry(fsvc, frepo, erepo, urepo, state, responder, ctx, int(rest))
    return True

"""تست فاز ۳۶b: پرکردن فرم — ویزارد، رسانه، انتخابگر، پرداخت، گیت."""
from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from nora.channels.bale import main as bale_main
from nora.channels.bale.texts import t
from nora.core.clock import FakeClock, set_clock
from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.events import EventRepo
from nora.domain.forms import FormRepo
from nora.domain.payments import PaymentRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.form_service import FormService


@pytest.fixture()
def env(db):
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 9, 17, 12, 0, 0))
    old = set_clock(clock)
    sent = []

    def transport(url, params):
        sent.append(params)
        return {"ok": True, "result": []}

    settings = Settings(bot_token="t", admin_ids=(999,), ai_enabled=False,
                        safir_bot_id=1, safir_api_key="k")
    bot = bale_main.build_bot(settings, db=db, clock=clock,
                              transport=transport)
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    erepo = EventRepo(db)
    formrepo = FormRepo(db, clock)
    formsvc = FormService(formrepo, erepo, clock)
    payrepo = PaymentRepo(db, clock)
    admin = urepo.create(999, first_name="ادمین")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role="admin", status="approved",
                 full_name="ادمین گروه")
    member = urepo.create(555, first_name="مریم", status="approved")
    urepo.update(member.id, status="approved", full_name="مریم رادمهر")
    yield {"bot": bot, "clock": clock, "sent": sent, "urepo": urepo,
           "erepo": erepo, "db": db, "formrepo": formrepo,
           "formsvc": formsvc, "payrepo": payrepo,
           "member": urepo.get(member.id)}
    set_clock(old)


def step(env, update, uid=555):
    env["clock"].advance_hours(0.01)
    env["bot"].process_update(update)
    env["bot"].outbox.drain()


def cb(data, uid=555):
    return {"callback_query": {"id": "c1", "from": {"id": uid},
                               "message": {"chat": {"id": uid}},
                               "data": data}}


def msg(text, uid=555):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "text": text}}


def photo_msg(file_id="PH1", uid=555):
    return {"message": {"from": {"id": uid}, "chat": {"id": uid},
                        "photo": [{"file_id": file_id}]}}


def last(env):
    return str(env["sent"][-1].get("text") or "")


def all_text(env):
    return "\n".join(str(p.get("text") or "") for p in env["sent"])


def all_markup(env):
    return "\n".join(str(p.get("reply_markup") or "") for p in env["sent"])


def last_markup(env):
    return str(env["sent"][-1].get("reply_markup") or "")


def _mkform(env, title="فرم پاییز", kind="general", **kw):
    repo, svc = env["formrepo"], env["formsvc"]
    fid = svc.create(title, 1, kind=kind, **kw)["id"]
    return repo.get_form(fid)


def _add(env, fid, ftype, **patch):
    repo = env["formrepo"]
    fld = repo.add_field(fid, ftype)
    if patch:
        repo.update_field(fld.id, **patch)
    return repo.get_field(fld.id)


# ------------------------------------------------------------- فهرست

def test_home_row_and_list(env):
    f = _mkform(env)
    _add(env, f.id, "text", label="نام")
    env["formsvc"].publish(f.id)
    step(env, cb("evs:1"))
    assert "frms:1" in all_markup(env)
    step(env, cb("frms:1"))
    assert t("frm_u_list_head") in last(env)
    assert f"frmu:{f.id}" in last_markup(env)


def test_draft_form_not_listed(env):
    f = _mkform(env)
    step(env, cb("frms:1"))
    assert t("frm_u_none") in last(env)


def test_deep_link_entry(env):
    f = _mkform(env)
    _add(env, f.id, "text", label="نام")
    env["formsvc"].publish(f.id)
    step(env, msg(f"/start form_{f.id}"))
    assert t("frm_u_q_head", i="۱", n="۱") in all_text(env)
    assert "نام" in all_text(env)

def test_fill_choice_text_rating(env):
    f = _mkform(env)
    f1 = _add(env, f.id, "one", label="کیفیت؟", options=["خوب", "بد"])
    f2 = _add(env, f.id, "text", label="نام")
    f3 = _add(env, f.id, "rating", label="چند ستاره؟")
    env["formsvc"].publish(f.id)
    step(env, cb(f"frmu:{f.id}"))
    assert f"frmsel:" in last_markup(env)
    step(env, cb(f"frmsel:{env['formrepo'].response_of(f.id, 2).id if False else 1}:{f1.id}:0")
         if False else cb("frmu:%d" % f.id))
    # ورود مجدد → پرسش اول (هنوز پاسخی نیست)
    resp = env["formrepo"].response_of(f.id, env["member"].id)
    assert resp is not None
    step(env, cb(f"frmsel:{resp.id}:{f1.id}:0"))
    assert t("frm_u_q_head", i="۲", n="۳") in last(env)
    step(env, msg("مریم"))
    assert t("frm_u_q_head", i="۳", n="۳") in last(env)
    step(env, cb(f"frmrate:{resp.id}:{f3.id}:4"))
    # خلاصه
    assert t("frm_u_summary") in last(env)
    assert t("frm_u_rating_val", n="۴") in last(env)
    step(env, cb(f"frmsub:{resp.id}"))
    assert t("frm_u_done") in all_text(env)
    fresh = env["formrepo"].get_response(resp.id)
    assert fresh.status == "submitted"
    # ورود دوباره → نمای پیشین
    step(env, cb(f"frmu:{f.id}"))
    assert t("frm_u_prev_head") in last(env)


def test_mobile_validation(env):

def test_paid_form_gateway(env):
    f = _mkform(env, price=10000)
    _add(env, f.id, "text", label="نام")
    env["formsvc"].publish(f.id)
    step(env, cb(f"frmu:{f.id}"))
    resp = env["formrepo"].response_of(f.id, env["member"].id)
    step(env, msg("مریم"))
    step(env, cb(f"frmsub:{resp.id}"))
    # روش پرداخت
    assert t("frm_u_pay_q", amount="") not in ""  # sanity
    assert "frmpaym:" in last_markup(env)
    step(env, cb(f"frmpaym:{f.id}:gateway"))
    inv = [p for p in env["sent"] if "invoice_payload" in str(p)
           or p.get("title")]
    assert any("sendInvoice" in str(p) or p.get("provider_token")
               for p in env["sent"]) or inv
    pay = env["payrepo"].open_for_target_user("form", f.id,
                                              env["member"].id)
    assert pay is not None and pay.status != "paid"
    total = env["payrepo"].total_of(pay)
    step(env, {"message": {"from": {"id": 555}, "chat": {"id": 555},
                           "successful_payment": {
                               "invoice_payload": str(pay.id),
                               "provider_payment_charge_id": "ch_1",
                               "total_amount": total}}})
    assert t("frm_u_paid_done") in all_text(env)
    fresh = env["formrepo"].get_response(resp.id)
    assert fresh.status == "submitted" and fresh.pay_id == pay.id

def test_event_gate(env):
    erepo = env["erepo"]
    ev = erepo.create_event(title="کارگاه عکاسی", kind="workshop",
                            start_ts=1789000000.0, status="published")

    fld = _add(env, f.id, "text", label="نام")

    assert erepo.reg_of(ev.id, env["member"].id) is None
    # پرکردن از مسیر گیت
    step(env, cb(f"frmu:{f.id}"))
    resp = env["formrepo"].response_of(f.id, env["member"].id)
    step(env, msg("مریم"))

    assert f"reg:{ev.id}" in all_markup(env)
    # حالا ثبت‌نام باز است
    step(env, cb(f"reg:{ev.id}"))
    assert erepo.reg_of(ev.id, env["member"].id) is not None

def export_form(head: list, rows: list, title: str, dest: Path) -> Path:
    import openpyxl
    book = openpyxl.Workbook()
    sheet = book.active
    sheet.title = "form"[:31]
    sheet.append([str(h) for h in head])
    for r in rows:
        sheet.append(list(r))
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    book.save(str(dest))
    return dest

def on_report(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid):
    if _top(...) is None: no_perm
    rep = fsvc.report(fid)
    if rep is None: frm_none_found
    form = rep["form"]
    lines = [t("frm_rep_head", title=_label(form.title, 40), submitted=fa_num(rep["submitted"]), draft=fa_num(rep["draft"]))]
    if not rep["submitted"] and not rep["draft"]:
        lines.append(t("frm_rep_empty"))
    for it in rep["items"]:
        label = _label(str(it.get("label") or "—"), 24)
        kind = str(it.get("kind") or "text")
        if "tally" in it:
            parts = _JOIN.join(f"{_label(str(o), 16)} ({fa_num(n)})" for o, n in it["tally"][:6])
            lines.append(t("frm_rep_tally", label=label, parts=parts or "—"))
            if kind == "quiz":
                lines.append(t("frm_rep_correct", label=label, n=fa_num(it.get("correct") or 0)))
        elif "avg" in it:
            lines.append(t("frm_rep_avg", label=label, avg=fa_num(f"{it['avg']:.1f}")))
        elif "files" in it:
            lines.append(t("frm_rep_files", label=label, n=fa_num(it["files"])))
        else:
            lines.append(t("frm_rep_text_n", label=label, n=fa_num(it.get("n") or 0)))
    rows = [[ui.btn(t("btn_frm_export"), f"frmxl:{fid}"), ui.btn(t("btn_back"), f"frmv:{fid}")]]
    responder.reply_raw(ctx, "\n".join(lines), ui.kb(rows))

def on_export(fsvc, frepo, urepo, responder, ctx, fid, *, var_dir, clock):

        responder.reply(ctx, "frm_exp_done")

"""Forms in the web panel — mirror of the bat forms/formfill page.
Build/edit/fields/display conditions/publish/status/results/Excel export.
Gate: manage_forms. No Persian literals and no channels import.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from ..domain.forms import (ACCESS, COND_OPS, FIELD_CATS, FIELD_TYPES,
                            KINDS, FormRepo)
from ..services.form_service import FormService
def forms_list(*, frepo: FormRepo) -> list:
    out = []
    for f in frepo.list_forms():
        c = frepo.counts(f.id)
        out.append({"id": f.id, "title": f.title, "kind": f.kind,
                    "access": f.access, "status": f.status,
                    "event_id": f.event_id, "price": int(f.price),
                    "gives_cert": int(f.gives_cert),
                    "gives_ticket": int(f.gives_ticket),
                    "n_fields": len(frepo.fields(f.id)),
                    "submitted": c["submitted"], "draft": c["draft"]})
    return out
def form_meta(*, erepo) -> dict:
    types = []
    for k, v in FIELD_TYPES.items():
        types.append({"type": k, "cat": v.get("cat"),
                      "kind": v.get("kind"),
                      "max": int(v.get("max") or 0),
                      "score": int(v.get("score") or 0)})
    evs = [{"id": ev.id, "title": ev.title}
           for ev in erepo.list_events(("upcoming", "running"), limit=50)]
    return {"types": types, "cats": list(FIELD_CATS),
            "kinds": list(KINDS), "access": list(ACCESS),
            "ops": list(COND_OPS), "events": evs}
def _form_dict(frepo, f) -> dict:

def form_detail(*, frepo, fid) -> dict | None:

PYTHON
"""فرم‌ها در پنل وب — آینهٔ صفحه‌های forms/formfill بات (فاز ۳۶).

ساخت/ویرایش فرم، فیلدها، شرط نمایش، انتشار/وضعیت، نتیجه‌ها و خروجی
اکسل. گیت: manage_forms. بدون لیترال فارسی و بدون import از channels —
برچسب‌ها در app.js. داده‌های فارسی (عنوان/گزینه) از دیتابیس می‌آید.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from ..core.clock import Clock
from ..domain.forms import (ACCESS, COND_OPS, FIELD_CATS, FIELD_TYPES,
                            KINDS, FormField, FormRepo)
from ..services.form_service import FormService

_MAX_OPTS = 30


def _field_dict(fl: FormField) -> dict:
    return {"id": fl.id, "form_id": fl.form_id, "ord": fl.ord,
            "type": fl.type, "label": fl.label, "help": fl.help,
            "options": [str(o) for o in fl.options],
            "required": int(fl.required), "min_val": int(fl.min_val),
            "max_val": int(fl.max_val), "max_files": int(fl.max_files),
            "cond_field": int(fl.cond_field), "cond_op": fl.cond_op,
            "cond_value": fl.cond_value, "score": int(fl.score),
            "correct": int(fl.correct)}


def _form_dict(frepo: FormRepo, f) -> dict:
    c = frepo.counts(f.id)
    return {"id": f.id, "title": f.title, "kind": f.kind,
            "access": f.access, "status": f.status,
            "event_id": int(f.event_id), "intro": f.intro,
            "price": int(f.price), "gives_cert": int(f.gives_cert),
            "gives_ticket": int(f.gives_ticket),
            "created_ts": f.created_ts, "published_ts": f.published_ts,
            "n_fields": len(frepo.fields(f.id)),
            "submitted": c["submitted"], "draft": c["draft"]}


# ------------------------------------------------------------- فهرست

def forms_list(*, frepo: FormRepo) -> list:
    return [_form_dict(frepo, f) for f in frepo.list_forms()]


def form_meta(*, erepo) -> dict:
    types = []
    for k, v in FIELD_TYPES.items():
        types.append({"type": k, "cat": str(v.get("cat") or "text"),
                      "kind": str(v.get("kind") or "text"),
                      "max": int(v.get("max") or 0),
                      "score": int(v.get("score") or 0)})
    evs = [{"id": ev.id, "title": ev.title}
           for ev in erepo.list_events(("upcoming", "running"),
                                       limit=50)]
    return {"types": types, "cats": list(FIELD_CATS),
            "kinds": list(KINDS), "access": list(ACCESS),
            "ops": list(COND_OPS), "events": evs}


def form_detail(*, frepo: FormRepo, fid: int) -> dict | None:
    f = frepo.get_form(fid)
    if f is None:
        return None
    return {"form": _form_dict(frepo, f),
            "fields": [_field_dict(x) for x in frepo.fields(fid)]}


# -------------------------------------------------------------- فرم

def form_create(*, fsvc: FormService, actor, body: dict) -> dict:
    return fsvc.create(str(body.get("title") or ""), actor.id,
                       kind=str(body.get("kind") or "general"))


def form_update(*, fsvc: FormService, frepo: FormRepo, fid: int,
                body: dict) -> dict:
    f = frepo.get_form(fid)
    if f is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    patch: dict = {}
    if "title" in body:
        title = " ".join(str(body.get("title") or "").split())
        if len(title) < 3:
            return {"result": "bad_title"}
        patch["title"] = title[:80]
    if "intro" in body:
        patch["intro"] = str(body.get("intro") or "").strip()[:500]
    if "kind" in body:
        kind = str(body.get("kind") or "")
        if kind not in KINDS:
            return {"result": "bad_kind"}
        patch["kind"] = kind
    if "access" in body:
        acc = str(body.get("access") or "")
        if acc not in ACCESS:
            return {"result": "bad_access"}
        patch["access"] = acc
    if "event_id" in body:
        patch["event_id"] = int(body.get("event_id") or 0)
    acc = str(patch.get("access", f.access))
    eid = int(patch.get("event_id", f.event_id))
    if acc == "event" and not eid:
        return {"result": "need_event"}
    if acc != "event":
        patch["event_id"] = 0
    if "price" in body:
        try:
            patch["price"] = max(0, int(body.get("price") or 0))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return {"result": "bad_price"}
    for flag in ("gives_cert", "gives_ticket"):
        if flag in body:
            patch[flag] = 1 if body.get(flag) else 0
    frepo.update_form(fid, **patch)
    return {"result": "ok"}


def form_status(*, fsvc: FormService, fid: int, status: str) -> dict:
    return fsvc.set_status(fid, str(status or ""))


def form_delete(*, frepo: FormRepo, fid: int) -> dict:
    frepo.delete_form(fid)
    return {"result": "ok"}


# ------------------------------------------------------------ فیلد

def field_add(*, frepo: FormRepo, fid: int, ftype: str) -> dict:
    if frepo.get_form(fid) is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    if ftype not in FIELD_TYPES:
        return {"result": "bad_type"}
    fld = frepo.add_field(fid, ftype)
    return {"result": "ok", "id": fld.id, "field": _field_dict(fld)}


def field_update(*, frepo: FormRepo, ffid: int, body: dict) -> dict:
    fld = frepo.get_field(ffid)
    if fld is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    patch: dict = {}
    if "label" in body:
        patch["label"] = " ".join(str(body.get("label") or "").split())[:80]
    if "help" in body:
        patch["help"] = str(body.get("help") or "").strip()[:120]
    if "options" in body:
        raw = body.get("options")
        if not isinstance(raw, list):
            return {"result": "bad_options"}
        opts: list[str] = []
        for o in raw[:_MAX_OPTS]:
            s = " ".join(str(o).split())[:80]
            if s and s not in opts:
                opts.append(s)
        patch["options"] = opts
        if fld.correct >= len(opts):
            patch["correct"] = -1
        if not opts:
            patch["correct"] = -1
    if "required" in body:
        patch["required"] = 1 if body.get("required") else 0
    for num_key in ("min_val", "max_val"):
        if num_key in body:
            try:
                patch[num_key] = max(0, int(body.get(num_key) or 0))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                return {"result": "bad_number"}
    if "max_files" in body:
        try:
            patch["max_files"] = min(max(int(body.get("max_files")
                                         or 1), 1), 10)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return {"result": "bad_number"}
    if "score" in body:
        try:
            patch["score"] = min(max(int(body.get("score") or 0), 0),
                                 1000)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return {"result": "bad_number"}
    if "correct" in body:
        try:
            c = int(body.get("correct"))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return {"result": "bad_number"}
        opts = patch.get("options", fld.options)
        if c != -1 and not 0 <= c < len(opts):
            return {"result": "bad_correct"}
        patch["correct"] = c
    if "cond_field" in body:
        try:
            ref = int(body.get("cond_field") or 0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return {"result": "bad_cond"}
        if ref:
            reff = frepo.get_field(ref)
            if reff is None or reff.form_id != fld.form_id or ref == ffid:
                return {"result": "bad_cond"}
        patch["cond_field"] = ref
        if not ref:
            patch["cond_op"] = ""
            patch["cond_value"] = ""
    if "cond_op" in body:
        op = str(body.get("cond_op") or "")
        if op and op not in COND_OPS:
            return {"result": "bad_cond"}
        patch["cond_op"] = op
        if op in ("", "empty", "nempty"):
            patch["cond_value"] = ""
    if "cond_value" in body and "cond_value" not in patch:
        patch["cond_value"] = str(body.get("cond_value") or "")[:80]
    frepo.update_field(ffid, **patch)
    return {"result": "ok", "field": _field_dict(frepo.get_field(ffid))}


def field_move(*, frepo: FormRepo, ffid: int, up: bool) -> dict:
    if frepo.get_field(ffid) is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    frepo.move_field(ffid, up=bool(up))
    return {"result": "ok"}


def field_copy(*, frepo: FormRepo, ffid: int) -> dict:
    cp = frepo.copy_field(ffid)
    if cp is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    return {"result": "ok", "id": cp.id, "field": _field_dict(cp)}


def field_delete(*, frepo: FormRepo, ffid: int) -> dict:
    if frepo.get_field(ffid) is None:
        return {"result": "none"}
    frepo.delete_field(ffid)
    return {"result": "ok"}


# ---------------------------------------------------------- نتیجه‌ها

def form_report(*, fsvc: FormService, fid: int) -> dict | None:
    rep = fsvc.report(fid)
    if rep is None:
        return None
    items = []
    for it in rep["items"]:
        row = {"id": it["id"], "label": it.get("label") or "",
               "type": it.get("type") or "", "kind": it.get("kind") or "",
               "n": int(it.get("n") or 0)}
        if "tally" in it:
            row["tally"] = [[str(o), int(n)] for o, n in it["tally"]]
        if "avg" in it:
            row["avg"] = float(it["avg"])
        if "files" in it:
            row["files"] = int(it["files"])
        if "correct" in it:
            row["correct"] = int(it["correct"])
        if "samples" in it:
            row["samples"] = [str(s)[:80] for s in it["samples"][:20]]
        items.append(row)
    form = rep["form"]
    return {"form": _form_dict(fsvc.repo, form), "items": items,
            "submitted": rep["submitted"], "draft": rep["draft"]}


def form_export(*, fsvc: FormService, fid: int, var_dir,
                clock: Clock) -> Path | None:
    head, rows = fsvc.export_rows(fid)
    if not rows:
        return None
    from . import import_export
    stamp = clock.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M")
    dest = Path(str(var_dir)) / "exports" / f"form-{fid}-{stamp}.xlsx"
    import_export.export_form(head, rows, dest)
    return dest

"""فرم‌ها در پنل وب — فاز ۳۶c: ساخت، فیلد، شرط، انتشار، گزارش، اکسل."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer

from nora.core.config import Settings
from nora.domain.forms import FormRepo
from nora.domain.users import UserRepo
from nora.services.form_service import FormService
from web.server import create_app


class FakeResponder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.sent = []

    def bulk(self, chat_id, key, markup=None, **ph):
        self.sent.append(("bulk", chat_id, key))

    def bulk_raw(self, chat_id, text, markup=None):
        self.sent.append(("raw", chat_id, text))


async def _client(db, fake_clock, *, role="owner", bale_id=999):
    urepo = UserRepo(db)
    fake = FakeResponder()
    admin = urepo.create(bale_id, first_name="مدیر")
    urepo.update(admin.id, role=role, status="approved",
                 full_name="مدیر نورا")
    settings = Settings(env="dev", bot_token="123:T",
                        admin_ids=(bale_id,))
    app = create_app(settings, db, dev_bale_id=bale_id,
                     responder=fake, clock=fake_clock)
    client = TestClient(TestServer(app))
    await client.start_server()
    r = await client.post("/api/auth", json={"dev": True})
    tok = (await r.json())["token"]
    return client, {"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok}, admin, fake


async def _mk(client, hdr, **kw):
    body = {"title": "فرم نظرسنجی", "kind": "survey"}
    body.update(kw)
    r = await client.post("/api/forms", headers=hdr, json=body)
    return await r.json()

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_field_crud(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, _a, _f = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    fid = (await _mk(client, hdr))["id"]
    r = await client.post(f"/api/forms/{fid}/fields", headers=hdr,
                          json={"type": "one"})
    out = await r.json()
    assert out["ok"]
    f1 = out["id"]
    r = await client.post(f"/api/forms/{fid}/fields", headers=hdr,
                          json={"type": "rating"})
    f2 = (await r.json())["id"]
    # ویرایش
    r = await client.post(f"/api/fields/{f1}/update", headers=hdr,
                          json={"label": "کیفیت؟", "options": ["خوب", "بد"],
                                "required": True})
    out = await r.json()
    assert out["ok"]
    assert out["field"]["options"] == ["خوب", "بد"]
    assert out["field"]["required"] == 1
    # rating پیش‌فرض بازه دارد
    r = await client.get(f"/api/forms/{fid}", headers=hdr)
    fields = (await r.json())["data"]["fields"]
    rating = [x for x in fields if x["id"] == f2][0]
    assert rating["min_val"] == 1 and rating["max_val"] == 5
    # جابه‌جایی
    r = await client.post(f"/api/fields/{f2}/move", headers=hdr,
                          json={"up": True})
    assert (await r.json())["ok"]
    r = await client.get(f"/api/forms/{fid}", headers=hdr)
    fields = (await r.json())["data"]["fields"]
    assert fields[0]["id"] == f2
    # کپی و حذف
    r = await client.post(f"/api/fields/{f1}/copy", headers=hdr, json={})
    cp = (await r.json())["id"]
    r = await client.post(f"/api/fields/{cp}/delete", headers=hdr, json={})
    assert (await r.json())["ok"]
    # نوع نامعتبر
    r = await client.post(f"/api/forms/{fid}/fields", headers=hdr,
                          json={"type": "hack"})
    assert not (await r.json())["ok"]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_condition_and_quiz(db, fake_clock):
    client, hdr, _a, _f = await _client(db, fake_clock)
    fid = (await _mk(client, hdr, kind="quiz"))["id"]
    f1 = (await client.post(f"/api/forms/{fid}/fields", headers=hdr,
                            json={"type": "quiz"})).json() if False else None
    r = await client.post(f"/api/forms/{fid}/fields", headers=hdr,
                          json={"type": "quiz"})
    q = (await r.json())["id"]
    r = await client.post(f"/api/forms/{fid}/fields", headers=hdr,
                          json={"type": "textarea"})
    tx = (await r.json())["id"]
    # گزینه‌ها + گزینهٔ درست
    r = await client.post(f"/api/fields/{q}/update", headers=hdr,
                          json={"label": "۲+۲؟", "options": ["۳", "۴"],
                                "correct": 1, "score": 2,
                                "required": True})
    assert (await r.json())["ok"]
    # correct بیرون از بازه
    r = await client.post(f"/api/fields/{q}/update", headers=hdr,
                          json={"correct": 5})
    assert not (await r.json())["ok"]
    # شرط روی خودش → رد
    r = await client.post(f"/api/fields/{tx}/update", headers=hdr,
                          json={"cond_field": tx, "cond_op": "eq"})
    assert (await r.json())["result"] == "bad_cond"
    # شرط معتبر
    r = await client.post(f"/api/fields/{tx}/update", headers=hdr,
                          json={"label": "چرا؟", "cond_field": q,
                                "cond_op": "eq", "cond_value": "۴"})
    out = await r.json()
    assert out["ok"] and out["field"]["cond_op"] == "eq"
    # انتشار
    r = await client.post(f"/api/forms/{fid}/status", headers=hdr,
                          json={"status": "published"})
    assert (await r.json())["ok"]
    r = await client.get(f"/api/forms/{fid}", headers=hdr)
    assert (await r.json())["data"]["form"]["status"] == "published"

async function frmLoadList() {
  state.frm.items = (await api("/api/forms")).items;
}
async function frmLoadMeta() {
  if (!state.frm.meta) state.frm.meta = (await api("/api/forms/meta")).data;
}
function frmOpenCenter() {
  state.usr.view = "forms"; state.frm.view = "list"; state.frm.items = null;
  state.frm.confirmKey = "";
  if (BP && BP.BackButton) { try { BP.BackButton.show(); } catch (e) {} }
  render(); window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}
function frmBack() {
  const v = state.frm.view;
  if (v === "report") { state.frm.view = "detail"; render(); return; }
  if (v === "field") { state.frm.view = "detail"; frmReloadDetail(); return; }
  if (v === "detail") { state.frm.view = "list"; state.frm.items = null; render(); frmRefreshList(); return; }
  usrBack();
}

async function frmRefreshList() {
  try { await frmLoadList(); } catch (e) { state.error = e.message; }
  render();
}
async function frmOpenDetail(fid) {
  state.frm.view = "detail"; state.frm.fid = fid; state.frm.detail = null;
  state.frm.confirmKey = ""; state.frm.addOpen = false;
  render(); window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  try {
    state.frm.detail = (await api("/api/forms/" + fid)).data;
    await frmLoadMeta();
  } catch (e) { state.error = e.message; }
  render();
}
async function frmReloadDetail() {
  if (!state.frm.fid) return;
  state.frm.view = "detail"; state.frm.detail = null; render();
  try { state.frm.detail = (await api("/api/forms/" + state.frm.fid)).data; await frmLoadMeta(); }
  catch (e) { state.error = e.message; }
  render();
}
function frmConfirm(key, fn) {
  if (state.frm.confirmKey === key) { state.frm.confirmKey = ""; fn(); }
  else { state.frm.confirmKey = key; render(); }
}
async function frmCreate() {
  if (state.frm.busy) return;
  state.frm.busy = true;
  const title = (document.getElementById("frmTitle") || {}).value || "";
  const kindSel = document.getElementById("frmKind");
  const kind = kindSel ? kindSel.value : "general";
  try {
    const r = await api("/api/forms", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ title: title.trim(), kind }) });
    if (r.ok) { state.frm.newOpen = false; showToast(FRM_RES_FA.ok); await frmOpenDetail(r.id); }
    else showToast(FRM_RES_FA[r.result] || r.result);
  } catch (e) { showToast("انجام نشد — دوباره تلاش کنید"); }
  state.frm.busy = false; render();
}

async function frmSetStatus(st) {
  if (state.frm.busy) return;
  state.frm.busy = true;
  try {
    const r = await api(`/api/forms/${state.frm.fid}/status`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ status: st }) });
    showToast(FRM_RES_FA[r.result] || (r.ok ? FRM_RES_FA.ok : r.result));
  } catch (e) { showToast("انجام نشد — دوباره تلاش کنید"); }
  state.frm.busy = false; state.frm.confirmKey = "";
  await frmReloadDetail();
}
async function frmSaveForm() {
  // Settings form inside detail: intro/price/access/event/ticket/cert
  if (state.frm.busy) return;
  state.frm.busy = true;
  const g = (id) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : null; };
  const body = {};
  const intro = g("frmIntro"); if (intro !== null) body.intro = intro;
  const price = g("frmPrice"); if (price !== null) body.price = Number(price) || 0;
  const acc = g("frmAcc"); if (acc !== null) body.access = acc;
  const ev = g("frmEvent"); if (ev !== null) body.event_id = Number(ev) || 0;
  body.gives_ticket = !!(document.getElementById("frmTicket") || {}).checked;
  body.gives_cert = !!(document.getElementById("frmCert") || {}).checked;
  try {
    const r = await api(`/api/forms/${state.frm.fid}/update`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    showToast(FRM_RES_FA[r.result] || (r.ok ? FRM_RES_FA.ok : r.result));
  } catch (e) { showToast("انجام نشد — دوباره تلاش کنید"); }
  state.frm.busy = false;
  await frmReloadDetail();
}
async function frmDelete() { ... POST delete → showToast, state.frm.view="list"; frmRefreshList(); }
async function frmAddField(type) {
  try {
    const r = await api(`/api/forms/${state.frm.fid}/fields`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ type }) });
    if (r.ok) { state.frm.addOpen = false; await frmReloadDetail(); frmFieldOpen(r.id); }
    else showToast(FRM_RES_FA[r.result] || r.result);
  } catch (e) { showToast("انجام نشد"); }
}
async function frmFieldOpen(ffid) {
  state.frm.view = "field"; state.frm.ffid = ffid; state.frm.confirmKey = "";
  render(); window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}
function frmField() { // Current field from detail cache
  const d = state.frm.detail; if (!d) return null;
  return d.fields.find((f) => f.id === state.frm.ffid) || null;
}
async function frmFieldSave() {
  const f = frmField(); if (!f || state.frm.busy) return;
  state.frm.busy = true;
  const g = (id) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : null; };
  const body = {};
  const label = g("ffLabel"); if (label !== null) body.label = label;
  const help = g("ffHelp"); if (help !== null) body.help = help;
  const opts = g("ffOpts");
  if (opts !== null) body.options = opts.split("\n").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const req = document.getElementById("ffReq"); if (req) body.required = req.checked;
  const mn = g("ffMin"); if (mn !== null && mn !== "") body.min_val = Number(mn) || 0;
  const mx = g("ffMax"); if (mx !== null && mx !== "") body.max_val = Number(mx) || 0;
  const mf = g("ffFiles"); if (mf !== null && mf !== "") body.max_files = Number(mf) || 1;
  const sc = g("ffScore"); if (sc !== null && sc !== "") body.score = Number(sc) || 0;
  const co = g("ffCorrect"); if (co !== null && co !== "") body.correct = Number(co);
  const cf = g("ffCondF"); if (cf !== null) body.cond_field = Number(cf) || 0;
  const cop = g("ffCondOp"); if (cop !== null) body.cond_op = cop;
  const cv = g("ffCondV"); if (cv !== null) body.cond_value = cv;
  try {
    const r = await api(`/api/fields/${f.id}/update`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    showToast(FRM_RES_FA[r.result] || (r.ok ? FRM_RES_FA.ok : r.result));
    if (r.ok && state.frm.detail) {
      state.frm.detail.fields = state.frm.detail.fields.map((x) => (x.id === f.id ? r.field : x));
    }
  } catch (e) { showToast("انجام نشد — دوباره تلاش کنید"); }
  state.frm.busy = false; render();
}
async function frmFieldMove(up) { POST move → reload detail }
async function frmFieldCopy() { POST copy → reload detail }
async function frmFieldDel() { POST delete → state.frm.view="detail"; reload }
async function frmOpenReport() {
  state.frm.view = "report"; state.frm.report = null; render(); window.scrollTo(0,0);
  try { state.frm.report = (await api(`/api/forms/${state.frm.fid}/report`)).data; }
  catch (e) { state.error = e.message; }
  render();
}
async function frmExcel(fid) {
  if (state.frm.busy) return;
  state.frm.busy = true;
  try {
    const res = await fetchWithAuth(`/api/forms/${fid}/excel`, { method: "POST" });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("export_failed");
    const blob = await res.blob();
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = `nora-form-${fid}.xlsx`;
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 4000);
  } catch (e) { showToast("خروجی آماده نشد — پاسخی ثبت نشده؟"); }
  state.frm.busy = false; render();
}

function frmDetailView() {
  const d = state.frm.detail;
  const back = `<span class="backbtn" id="frmback">${svg("i-back")}فرم‌ها</span>`;
  if (!d) return back + loadingCard();
  const f = d.form;
  const m = state.frm.meta || { events: [], ops: [] };
  const del = state.frm.confirmKey === "del";
  const stBtn = f.status === "published"
    ? `<button class="btn" data-frmst="paused">توقف</button>`
    : (f.status === "paused"
      ? `<button class="btn pri" data-frmst="published">ادامه</button>`
      : `<button class="btn pri" data-frmst="published">انتشار</button>`);
  const fields = d.fields.map((x) => {
    const cond = x.cond_field ? `<div class="t2">شرط: ${esc((d.fields.find((y) => y.id === x.cond_field) || {}).label || "؟")} ${FRM_COND_FA[x.cond_op] || x.cond_op} ${x.cond_value ? "«" + esc(x.cond_value) + "»" : ""}</div>` : "";
    return `<div class="row evrow" data-ffopen="${x.id}">
      <div class="av">${faNum(x.ord)}</div>
      <div class="main"><div class="t1">${esc(x.label || FRM_TYPE_FA[x.type] || x.type)}${x.required ? " ·" : ""}</div>
        <div class="t2">${FRM_TYPE_FA[x.type] || x.type}${x.options && x.options.length ? " · " + x.options.map(esc).join(" / ") : ""}</div>${cond}</div>
      <div class="side">
        <button class="btn minbtn" data-ffup="${x.id}">↑</button>
        <button class="btn minbtn" data-ffdn="${x.id}">↓</button>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");

function frmFieldView() {
  const d = state.frm.detail;
  const f = frmField();
  const back = `<span class="backbtn" id="frmback">${svg("i-back")}فیلدها</span>`;
  if (!d || !f) return back + loadingCard();
  const ty = ((state.frm.meta || {}).types || []).find((x) => x.type === f.type) || { kind: "text" };
  const kind = ty.kind || "text";
  const hasOpts = ["one", "multi", "quiz"].includes(kind);
  const isQuiz = kind === "quiz";
  const isNum = kind === "number";
  const isMedia = ["photo", "video", "voice", "file"].includes(kind);
  const others = d.fields.filter((x) => x.id !== f.id);
  const del = state.frm.confirmKey === "fdel" + f.id;
  const opts = isNum ? `<div class="btnrow">
      <input class="finp" id="ffMin" type="number" placeholder="کمینه" value="${f.min_val || ""}">
      <input class="finp" id="ffMax" type="number" placeholder="بیشینه" value="${f.max_val || ""}"></div>` : "";
  ...
  return back + `<div class="h2">فیلد ${faNum(f.ord)} · ${FRM_TYPE_FA[f.type]}</div>
  <div class="card g">
    <input class="finp" id="ffLabel" placeholder="عنوان فیلد" maxlength="80" value="${esc(f.label || "")}">
    <input class="finp" id="ffHelp" placeholder="راهنما (اختیاری)" maxlength="120" value="${esc(f.help || "")}">
    ${hasOpts ? `<textarea class="finp" id="ffOpts" rows="4" placeholder="هر گزینه در یک خط">${(f.options || []).map(esc).join("\n")}</textarea>` : ""}
    ${isQuiz ? `<div class="btnrow"><input class="finp" id="ffScore" type="number" min="0" placeholder="امتیاز" value="${f.score || ""}">
      <select class="finp" id="ffCorrect"><option value="-1">گزینهٔ درست…</option>${(f.options || []).map((o, i) => `<option value="${i}" ${f.correct === i ? "selected" : ""}>${esc(o)}</option>`).join("")}</select></div>` : ""}
    ${isMedia ? `<input class="finp" id="ffFiles" type="number" min="1" max="10" placeholder="سقف فایل" value="${f.max_files || 1}">` : ""}
    ${opts}
    <label class="row" style="border:0;padding:6px 4px"><input type="checkbox" id="ffReq" ${f.required ? "checked" : ""}> <span class="t2">پاسخ اجباری است</span></label>
    <div class="h2" style="margin-top:8px">شرط نمایش</div>
    <select class="finp" id="ffCondF"><option value="0">همیشه نمایش داده شود</option>${others.map((x) => `<option value="${x.id}" ${f.cond_field === x.id ? "selected" : ""}>بعد از «${esc(x.label || FRM_TYPE_FA[x.type] || x.type)}»</option>`).join("")}</select>
    ${f.cond_field ? `<select class="finp" id="ffCondOp">${((state.frm.meta || {}).ops || []).map((op) => `<option value="${op}" ${f.cond_op === op ? "selected" : ""}>${FRM_COND_FA[op] || op}</option>`).join("")}</select>
    ${["empty", "nempty"].includes(f.cond_op) ? "" : `<input class="finp" id="ffCondV" placeholder="مقدار شرط" maxlength="80" value="${esc(f.cond_value || "")}">`}` : ""}
    <div class="btnrow">
      <button class="btn pri" id="ffSave">${svg("i-check", "ic")}ذخیره</button>
      <button class="btn" id="ffCopy">کپی</button>
      <button class="btn dan minbtn" id="ffDel">${del ? "مطمئنی؟" : "حذف"}</button>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

frmReportView:

js


function frmReportView() {
  const d = state.frm.report;
  const back = `<span class="backbtn" id="frmback">${svg("i-back")}فرم</span>`;
  if (!d) return back + loadingCard();
  const items = d.items.map((it) => {
    let body = "";
    if (it.tally) {
      const total = Math.max(1, it.tally.reduce((s, x) => s + x[1], 0));
      body = it.tally.map(([o, n]) => `<div class="row" style="padding:6px 4px">
        <div class="main"><div class="t2">${esc(o)}</div>
        <div class="bar"><span style="width:${Math.round((n / total) * 100)}%"></span></div></div>
        <div class="side t2">${faNum(n)}</div></div>`).join("");
      if (it.correct !== undefined) body += `<div class="t2" style="padding:4px">${faNum(it.correct)} پاسخ درست از ${faNum(it.n)}</div>`;
    } else if (it.avg !== undefined) {
      body = `<div class="t2" style="padding:4px">میانگین ${faNum(it.avg)} از ${faNum(it.n)} پاسخ</div>`;
    } else if (it.files !== undefined) {
      body = `<div class="t2" style="padding:4px">${faNum(it.files)} فایل دریافت شد</div>`;
    } else if (it.samples) {
      body = it.samples.slice(0, 5).map((s) => `<div class="t2" style="padding:4px">«${esc(s)}»</div>`).join("") + `<div class="t2" style="padding:4px">${faNum(it.n)} پاسخ متنی</div>`;
    }
    return `<div class="card g"><div class="card-t">${esc(it.label || FRM_TYPE_FA[it.type] || it.type)}</div>${body || `<div class="t2" style="padding:4px">${faNum(it.n)} پاسخ</div>`}</div>`;
  }).join("");
  return back + `<div class="h2">نتیجه‌ها · ${esc(d.form.title)}</div>
  <div class="t2" style="margin:0 4px 8px">${faNum(d.submitted)} ثبت‌شده · ${faNum(d.draft)} نیمه‌کاره</div>
  ${items || `<div class="card g"><div class="empty">${svg("i-chart")}<div class="t1">پاسخی نیست</div></div></div>`}
  <div class="btnrow"><button class="btn pri" id="frmXls2">خروجی اکسل</button></div>`;
}

js


function faDec(n) {
  const s = (Math.round((Number(n) || 0) * 10) / 10).toLocaleString("en-US");
  return s.replace(/\d/g, (d) => FA_DIGITS[+d]);
}

    f5 = frepo.add_field(fid, "textarea"); frepo.update_field(f5.id, label="چرا می‌خواهید شرکت کنید؟", help="اختیاری — کوتاه بنویسید")
    f6 = frepo.add_field(fid, "city"); frepo.update_field(f6.id, label="شهر محل سکونت")
    # Conditional field: if سطح=حرفه‌ای → portfolio URL
    f7 = frepo.add_field(fid, "url"); frepo.update_field(f7.id, label="نشانی نمونه‌کار", cond_field=f3.id, cond_op="eq", cond_value="حرفه‌ای")
    print(fsvc.publish(fid))
if "نظرسنجی دورهٔ پاییز" not in titles:
